papers.title: OmniAssistBench: Assistant-style Interaction Benchmark for Omni-LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent omni-modal large language models (Omni-LLMs) show great potential as real-time video assistants, which continuously perceive environments and guide users to achieve specific goals. Unlike traditional passive video understanding, interactive assistants should actively combine visual states, user goals, and prior knowledge to provide effective help. Evaluating this is rather challenging, as the model's unpredictable response dynamically changes the user's subsequent actions, which static offline datasets cannot accommodate. To address this bottleneck, we introduce OmniAssistBench. To solve the issue of diverging interaction paths where the same user goal can be achieved through various methods, we provide models with predefined priors derived from the source video, requiring them to guide users along the exact same routes. Since real interaction videos are rare, we construct the dataset by reverse-engineering existing Internet videos. We deduce logical user goals and segment the videos into multi-turn clips to simulate continuous interactions. This rigorous pipeline required over 1000 expert person-hours to build the dataset. Results show that the proprietary Gemini-3-Pro reaches 66.4 out of the max point of 100, while the open-source Qwen3-Omni-Instruct achieves 51.2. Although current models generally understand user inputs, they frequently provide incorrect or incomplete answers. Specifically, they struggle with visual prompts (e.g., hand gestures), fail to maintain historical context during multi-turn interactions, and fail to delay response until the target event. Results indicate substantial room for improvement before models can become reliable assistants.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniAssistBench，用于评估全模态大语言模型 (Omni-LLMs) 作为实时视频助手的交互能力。由于真实交互视频稀缺且交互路径发散，作者通过对现有互联网视频进行反向工程，推断用户目标并将视频切分为多轮片段，同时提供从源视频导出的预定义先验，要求模型沿相同路线引导用户。基准结果显示，Gemini-3-Pro 得分 66.4/100，Qwen3-Omni-Instruct 得分 51.2/100，当前模型在视觉提示、多轮历史上下文保持和延迟响应到目标事件方面存在明显不足。
Motivation: 传统的静态离线数据集无法评估交互式视频助手，因为模型不可预测的响应会动态改变用户后续行为；同时同一用户目标可通过多种方法实现，导致交互路径发散，使自动评估变得困难。
Method: 构建 OmniAssistBench 数据集：对现有互联网视频进行反向工程，推断合理的用户目标并将视频分割为多轮交互片段；为规避路径发散问题，提供从源视频中提取的预定义先验，要求模型按照完全相同的路线引导用户，数据集构建耗时超过 1000 个专家工时。
Result: 闭源模型 Gemini-3-Pro 得分 66.4/100，开源模型 Qwen3-Omni-Instruct 得分 51.2/100；模型通常能理解用户输入但常给出错误或不完整回答，尤其在处理视觉提示（如手势）、多轮交互中保持历史上下文以及延迟响应直到目标事件出现这三个方面表现不佳。
Conclusion: 摘要指出当前模型在成为可靠的交互式助手之前仍有很大改进空间，基准结果揭示了 Omni-LLMs 在主动交互式视频助手任务上的显著短板。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Primal Acceleration of Newton's Method
papers.abstract_en: We develop a new direct accelerated Newton method for minimizing convex functions with Lipschitz continuous Hessian. The algorithm uses only primal variables and performs just one linear solve per iteration. With a simple predetermined choice of parameters, it achieves the global convergence rate of $O(1/k^3)$ in terms of the functional residual. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first second-order method for this problem class attaining this rate while relying solely on one linear system solve per iteration (without solving auxiliary nonlinear regularized subproblems, such as cubic regularization, performing nonlinear parameter searches, or using dual extragradient corrections). Our method can be implemented in a Hessian-free way, using an inexact linear system solver, while preserving the fast global rate. We further extend our construction to arbitrary geometry through Bregman divergence, and to composite optimization problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的直接加速牛顿法 (direct accelerated Newton method)，用于最小化具有 Lipschitz 连续 Hessian 的凸函数。算法只使用原始变量，每轮迭代仅进行一次线性系统求解，并以简单的预定参数达到 O(1/k^3) 的全局函数残差收敛率。作者声称这是该问题类中首个在不求解三次正则化等辅助非线性子问题、不做非线性参数搜索、不使用对偶外梯度修正的情况下达到此速率的二阶方法。方法还可采用 Hessian-free 方式并用非精确线性求解器实现，并推广到 Bregman 散度定义的任意几何与复合优化问题。
Motivation: 现有的加速二阶优化方法往往需要求解辅助非线性正则化子问题（如三次正则化）、执行非线性参数搜索或采用对偶外梯度修正，计算成本较高。本文的目标是仅依赖原始变量和每轮一次线性系统求解来实现同样的快速全局收敛。
Method: 提出一种直接加速的牛顿法，每轮迭代只做一次线性系统求解，并采用简单、预定好的参数选择。构造可写成 Hessian-free 形式，配合非精确线性系统求解器仍保持快速全局速率；该方法进一步通过 Bregman 散度推广到任意几何，并扩展到复合优化问题。
Result: 摘要报告该方法对具有 Lipschitz 连续 Hessian 的凸函数取得 O(1/k^3) 的全局函数残差收敛速率，并称这是该问题类中第一个仅靠每轮一次线性求解达到该速率的二阶方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法实现简单（预定参数、无辅助子问题），并保持了非精确/Hessian-free 实现下的快速收敛性质；摘要未提及任何数值实验。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VIALS: A Benchmark for Visual Interpretation of Artifacts in the Life Sciences
papers.abstract_en: In professional life sciences workflows, scientists routinely interpret visual artifacts (gel blots, microscopy images, plasmid maps, flow cytometry plots, molecular structures, ...) to inform research decisions. We introduce VIALS, a visual question-answering benchmark with 161 such interpretation tasks, spanning the types of artifacts examined throughout experimental workflows in the biotech industry (rather than polished figures from publications and textbooks). While frontier vision-language models can now fluently describe natural images, we find that they are unable to accurately interpret these scientific images, reflecting limitations in domain knowledge and domain-specific visual reasoning capabilities. In contrast, scientists with relevant domain expertise find these visual interpretation tasks straightforward. AI that cannot similarly interpret such images will have limited utility in professional life sciences workflows, where such artifacts are central to how scientists reason, communicate, and make decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIALS，一个面向生命科学工作流中视觉伪影解读的视觉问答基准，包含 161 个任务，覆盖生物技术行业实验流程中实际出现的凝胶电泳、显微图像、质粒图谱、流式细胞图等。作者发现前沿视觉语言模型虽能流畅描述自然图像，却无法准确解读这类科学图像，而具备领域专长的科学家认为这些任务很简单。
Motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型评测多集中于自然图像或出版物中的精美图表，而专业生命科学工作流中科学家日常解读的是未经修饰的实验视觉伪影；缺乏此类基准导致模型在真实科研决策场景中的实用性问题未被量化。
Method: 构建 VIALS 基准，收集 161 个视觉问答任务，涵盖生物技术行业实验流程中出现的多种视觉伪影类型，并以此评估前沿视觉语言模型的领域知识与视觉推理能力。
Result: 摘要报告前沿视觉语言模型在这些科学图像上无法准确解读，反映出其在领域知识和领域特定视觉推理上的局限；相比之下，相关领域专家认为这些任务简单直接。
Conclusion: 作者认为无法解读此类图像的 AI 在专业生命科学工作流中的实用价值有限，因为这些视觉伪影是科学家推理、交流与决策的核心载体。

papers.title: AI with Authority, from Application to Silicon
papers.abstract_en: For sixty years, machine verification has been a major cost overhead, affordable only for exceptional artifacts. Here we report that generative AI inverts this relationship: at AI speed, machine verification is not only economical but essential to productivity --- it is the incorruptible referee that lets one person safely direct autonomous machine work at scale. In five weeks, one researcher on consumer AI subscriptions directed a small fleet of AI agents from application code, through a verified compiler and executive, to a RISC-V processor taped out on a community silicon shuttle; no proof passed through human review, and no RTL was written by a human. The working discipline --- the Salt method --- rests on a proof kernel no hallucinated proof can pass: mathematical claims travel between agents as kernel-checked artifacts, and human attention is reserved for statements, designs, and rulings. Verification is stated link by link, from the Lean 4 kernel to SAT-checked equivalence at the silicon boundary. We publish the complete accounting: theorem provenance, a pre-registered token meter, floor-bounded human time, and an error ledger whose catch numbering runs to #256 --- a monotone counter over the mathematics campaign's append-only flags ledger, maintained 2026-07-07 to 2026-07-20 (one number, #79, was never assigned; later catches are recorded un-numbered) --- against zero incorrect proofs reaching the record.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告生成式 AI 逆转了机器验证的成本关系：在 AI 速度下，机器验证不仅经济上可行，而且是让单人安全地大规模指挥自主机器工作的必要保障。作者在五周内，由一名研究者借助消费级 AI 订阅指挥一小队 AI 智能体，从应用代码经经过验证的编译器与执行器（executive），最终在社区硅 shuttle 上流片（tape out）出一颗 RISC-V 处理器；没有任何证明经过人工审查，也没有任何 RTL 由人类编写。该工作纪律被称为 Salt 方法，依赖一个任何幻觉证明都无法通过的证明内核，数学声明以内核检查过的工件（kernel-checked artifacts）在智能体间传递，人类注意力只放在陈述、设计与裁定上。验证环节从 Lean 4 内核到硅边界上的 SAT 检查等价性逐环陈述，并公开完整账目：定理来源、预注册 token 计量、下界人工时间，以及编号到 #256 的错误台账，记录中零个错误证明到达最终记录。
Motivation: 六十年来机器验证一直是高昂的成本开销，只有特殊工件才负担得起；本文瞄准这一痛点，论证在生成式 AI 时代验证变得经济且对生产力不可或缺。
Method: 提出 Salt 方法：以证明内核为核心，任何被幻觉生成的证明都无法通过；数学声明在智能体间以内核检查过的工件形式传递，人类注意力集中于陈述、设计与裁定。验证从 Lean 4 内核到硅边界的 SAT 检查等价性逐环建立，并发布完整会计记录，包括定理来源、预注册 token 计量、人工时间下限与错误台账。
Result: 在五周内一名研究者使用消费级 AI 订阅指挥一小队 AI 智能体，完成从应用代码、经验证的编译器与执行器到 RISC-V 处理器流片的完整流程；没有证明经过人工审查，也没有人工编写的 RTL。错误台账编号达到 #256，对应零个不正确证明进入最终记录。
Conclusion: 作者认为在 AI 速度下机器验证不再只是经济的，而是大规模自主机器工作的关键保障；Salt 方法的可靠性建立在证明内核与内核检查工件之上，并强调完整公开验证账目。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PerturbRx: Learning Treatment-Conditioned Latent Transitions for Patient Drug Response Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Scarce data and tumor heterogeneity limit patient-level cancer treatment-response prediction. Existing approaches predict response from pretreatment molecular profiles and drug representations, without explicitly modeling the molecular changes expected under treatment. We propose PerturbRx, a treatment-conditioned representation learning framework that learns intervention-induced latent transitions and uses them as patient-drug response features. PerturbRx trains a drug- and dose-conditioned transition predictor from context-matched but cell-unpaired control and treated single-cell populations, then freezes and transfers the predictor to pretreatment patient profiles without requiring post-treatment measurements. The transition is combined with patient and drug representations to predict response. Across TCGA and patient-derived xenograft benchmarks, PerturbRx achieves the strongest aggregate predictive performance among the evaluated methods. These results support perturbation-pretrained latent transitions as useful representations for patient-level drug-response prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PerturbRx，一种治疗条件化的表示学习框架，用于患者层面的癌症药物反应预测。该方法从配对的对照与处理单细胞群体中学习药物和剂量条件化的潜在状态转移 (latent transition)，再冻结并迁移该转移预测器到治疗前患者分子谱上，无需治疗后测量即可与患者、药物表示联合预测反应。在 TCGA 和患者来源异种移植 (PDX) 基准上，PerturbRx 在汇总预测性能上优于所评估的其他方法。
Motivation: 患者层面癌症治疗反应预测受限于数据稀缺和肿瘤异质性，且现有方法仅从治疗前分子特征和药物表示预测反应，没有显式建模治疗预期引起的分子变化。
Method: PerturbRx 训练一个药物和剂量条件化的转移预测器 (transition predictor)，输入来自上下文匹配但细胞不配对的对照与处理单细胞群体；随后冻结该预测器并迁移到治疗前患者档案，将学到的干预诱导潜在转移与患者及药物表示结合来预测反应，无需治疗后测量。
Result: 在 TCGA 和患者来源异种移植基准上，PerturbRx 在所评估方法中取得最强的总体预测性能。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，扰动预训练的潜在转移 (perturbation-pretrained latent transitions) 可作为患者层面药物反应预测的有效表示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Truthful Calibration Measures for Sequential Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Calibration requires probabilistic reports to be conditionally unbiased and reliably interpretable as probabilities. A calibration measure assigns numerical error to miscalibrated reports. Haghtalab et al. (2024) proposed an approximately truthful calibration measure for online prediction, leaving open whether exact truthfulness is compatible with completeness and soundness. We resolve this question negatively for sequential binary prediction: exact truthfulness is incompatible with completeness and soundness, even for independent outcomes. We then show that this impossibility is specific to exact truthfulness. We give two general reductions from a base calibration measure, producing additively and multiplicatively approximately truthful calibration measures, respectively. Applying the multiplicative reduction, for every $0 < \varepsilon < 1$ we construct a sound and complete calibration measure that is $(1+\exp(-T^{(1-\varepsilon)/2}/2))$-multiplicatively truthful. This improves the approximate-truthfulness guarantee of Haghtalab et al. (2024).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究顺序二值预测中校准度量 (calibration measure) 的可信性 (truthfulness) 与完备性 (completeness)、健全性 (soundness) 之间的兼容性。作者否定性地回答了 Haghtalab et al. (2024) 留下的开放问题：即使对独立结果，精确可信性也与完备性和健全性不相容。随后给出两个从基础校准度量出发的一般性归约，分别产生可加和可乘的近似可信校准度量；其中乘性归约对任意 0<ε<1 构造出 (1+exp(-T^{(1-ε)/2}/2))-乘性可信的健全且完备度量，改进已有近似可信性保证。
Motivation: 校准要求概率报告在条件上无偏且可可靠地解释为概率，校准度量将数值误差赋给错误校准的报告。Haghtalab et al. (2024) 提出了在线预测的近似可信校准度量，但精确可信性是否与完备性和健全性兼容的问题仍悬而未决，本文旨在回答这一理论问题。
Method: 作者先证明顺序二值预测中精确可信性与完备性、健全性不相容（即使结果独立），再给出两种一般性归约，从基础校准度量构造分别满足可加近似可信和可乘近似可信的校准度量；乘性归约用于构造具体的算法式度量。
Result: 对于任意 0<ε<1，构造出一个健全且完备的校准度量，其满足 (1+exp(-T^{(1-ε)/2}/2))-乘性可信，改进了 Haghtalab et al. (2024) 的近似可信性保证；同时证明了精确可信性下该目标是不可达的。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，精确可信性与完备性、健全性的不相容是顺序二值预测的固有困难，但通过放松到近似可信性可以恢复可行性，并给出更优的保证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Asymmetric Capacity Allocation in Self-Refinement Pipelines
papers.abstract_en: Self-refinement, typically structured as generation, critique, and revision, is a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLM generation and serves as a core mechanism in many LLM agents. While the three stages involve different cognitive demands, most existing approaches conveniently treat the model size as an implementation detail rather than a subject of study, which may lead to a waste of resources. Little work has systematically examined how model size affects each stage or whether effective self-refinement requires equally capable models for generation, critique, and revision. We present the first stage-wise model size study of the self-refinement pipeline on 5 benchmarks from different domains using 6 model sizes of Qwen3 and 4 model sizes of Gemma 3. We conclude that larger generators and refiners generally improve the pipeline, whereas an undersized refiner can even harm performance. Second, performance is highly insensitive to the size of the critic, although including even a small critic consistently outperforms omitting critique altogether. Our findings demonstrate that model capacity should not be allocated uniformly across self-refinement pipelines. Instead, different stages exhibit distinct size scaling characteristics, providing practical guidance for designing more computationally efficient multi-stage language model systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次对自精炼流水线（生成、批判、修订）进行逐阶段模型大小研究，使用 Qwen3 的 6 种规模和 Gemma 3 的 4 种规模在 5 个跨领域基准上实验。结果表明更大的生成器和修订器通常改善流水线，而过小的修订器甚至会损害性能；批判器大小对性能影响高度不敏感，但包含哪怕很小的批判器也一致优于完全省略批判。
Motivation: 现有自精炼方法普遍把模型大小视为实现细节而非研究对象，未系统考察各阶段的能力需求是否相同，可能导致资源浪费。
Method: 对自精炼流水线的生成、批判、修订三个阶段分别配置不同规模的模型，开展逐阶段（stage-wise）模型大小研究，覆盖 5 个基准、Qwen3 的 6 种模型大小和 Gemma 3 的 4 种模型大小。
Result: 摘要报告：更大的生成器和修订器通常提升流水线性能，而过小的修订器甚至会损害性能；性能对批判器大小高度不敏感，但即使很小的批判器也比完全省略批判一致地更好。
Conclusion: 模型容量不应在自精炼流水线的各阶段均匀分配，不同阶段呈现不同的规模缩放特性，这为设计计算高效的多阶段语言模型系统提供了实践指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TurboBias 2.0: Streaming Context-Biasing for Production-Efficient ASR Systems
papers.abstract_en: Contextualization is essential for production automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems, where user-provided phrases must be recognized accurately under strict latency constraints. Although many context-biasing methods improve recognition accuracy, they often do not address the practical requirements of modern production ASR systems: streaming inference, efficient batched decoding, user-specific context lists, and low runtime overhead. We propose TurboBias 2.0, a production-oriented framework for efficient phrase boosting in Transducer-based ASR systems. The framework extends GPU-accelerated TurboBias with a case-insensitive boosting graph and per-stream batched decoding, allowing each utterance in a batch to use an independent context-biasing configuration. This enables personalized context biasing for multiple simultaneous users without sharing or mixing their context lists. The proposed framework supports both offline and streaming inference and can be used with greedy and beam-search decoding. Experiments show that TurboBias 2.0 improves contextual phrase recognition while preserving low latency and high throughput.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TurboBias 2.0，一个面向生产的上下文偏置 (context-biasing) 框架，用于基于 Transducer 的 ASR 系统。它扩展了 GPU 加速的 TurboBias，加入大小写不敏感的 boosting 图和 per-stream 批式解码，使 batch 中每个 utterance 可以使用独立的上下文列表，从而支持多用户个性化偏置而互不共享。实验称该方法提升上下文短语识别，同时保持低延迟和高吞吐。
Motivation: 生产 ASR 系统需要满足流式推理、高效批式解码、用户特定上下文列表和低运行时开销等工程要求，而许多 context-biasing 方法只关注识别准确率，未解决这些实际约束。
Method: 在 Transducer-based ASR 中实现大小写不敏感的 boosting 图，并引入 per-stream batched decoding，使同一 batch 的不同 utterance 各自使用独立的 context-biasing 配置；框架同时支持离线与流式推理，以及 greedy 和 beam-search 解码。
Result: 摘要报告 TurboBias 2.0 提升了上下文短语识别准确率，同时保持低延迟和高吞吐，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架面向生产效率，通过 per-stream 独立上下文配置支持同时多用户的个性化偏置，适用于流式和批式解码场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Across-Design Uncertainty in Short Pricing Panels: Evidence from Simulated Price Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Short observational pricing panels can contain many observations while offering only a small number of distinct price movements. This paper studies the inferential consequences of that distinction in a synthetic data-generating process calibrated to a sparse pricing regime. We separate uncertainty conditional on a realised price trajectory from variation in estimation error across alternative trajectories generated by the same pricing process. In the baseline simulations, the latter component accounts for 97.6% of the variance of estimation error for the gradient-boosted specification. Within-panel resampling procedures use the information of one realised trajectory and do not identify this across-design component. Three results organise the analysis. First, across-design dispersion is well described by the empirical relation sigma_hat approx 0.182 V^(-0.271), where V equals moves times magnitude squared. Second, adding regions sharing a common price path reduces outcome noise but does not create independent price trajectories; conversely, averaging across units with independent design-specific errors reduces dispersion at the standard square root rate. Third, a Paule-Mandel variance component estimated across independently priced units substantially increases empirical coverage in homogeneous simulations, from 0.469 to 0.931. The broader implication is a shift toward designing data-generating processes that create independent identifying variation rather than relying solely on fixed passive panels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究短观测期定价面板 (short pricing panels) 中估计误差的不确定性来源，将给定一条已实现价格轨迹的条件不确定性，与同一定价过程生成的不同轨迹之间的跨设计 (across-design) 变异相分离。在稀疏定价机制校准的合成数据生成过程中，基线模拟显示跨设计变异占梯度提升 (gradient-boosted) 规格估计误差方差的 97.6%，而面板内重抽样无法识别这一成分。作者还给出经验标度关系 sigma_hat ≈ 0.182 V^(-0.271)，并显示基于独立定价单元的 Paule-Mandel 方差分量估计能显著提升经验覆盖率。
Motivation: 短定价面板可能包含大量观测值，却只提供很少的独立价格变动；传统推断通常忽略同一定价过程下不同轨迹间的变异，导致估计不确定性被低估。该区分对计量经济学与机器学习中的面板推断都有影响。
Method: 使用校准到稀疏定价机制的合成数据生成过程 (synthetic DGP)，分离轨迹内条件不确定性与跨设计变异；通过比较面板内重抽样与跨独立定价单元的方差估计，分析不同聚合策略对离散度的影响，并采用 Paule-Mandel 方差分量估计提升覆盖率。
Result: 基线模拟中跨设计成分占梯度提升规格估计误差方差的 97.6%；经验关系为 sigma_hat ≈ 0.182 V^(-0.271)，其中 V 等于价格变动次数乘以变动幅度平方；具有独立设计特异性误差的单元间平均以标准平方根速率降低离散度；在同质模拟中，Paule-Mandel 估计使经验覆盖率从 0.469 提高到 0.931。
Conclusion: 作者强调核心推论是研究设计应转向能产生独立识别变异 (independent identifying variation) 的数据生成过程，而非仅依赖固定被动面板；本文结论基于合成模拟，范围限于短定价面板场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks: Encoding Anatomic Priors in Loss and Architecture, with an SE(3) Formulation of Guidewire-Induced Aortoiliac Deformation
papers.abstract_en: Deep-learning models of anatomy can be numerically plausible yet anatomically impossible, and they generalize poorly when data are scarce. We introduce Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks (AINN), in which soft anatomic priors enter as penalty terms in the loss (e.g., a branching penalty that treats a renal transplant artery off the iliac instead of the aorta as unexpected rather than impossible), in direct analogy to a physics-informed neural network, and hard anatomic priors (e.g., continuity of the vessel) are built into the architecture and state representation, making such invalid predictions impossible by construction wherever the prior admits architectural enforcement. We develop it on a clinical test case with limited data: how the aortoiliac tree deforms when a stiff wire is introduced endoluminally. This is important to contemporary aortic surgery and will matter to autonomous endovascular navigation. We lift the vessel centerline and the wire path from R^3 to curves of frames in the Lie group SE(3), and couple a Cosserat-rod wire to a tortuosity-modulated, anatomically anchored vessel through a unilateral lumen-contact inequality. The prediction is a constrained minimizer of the coupled elastic energy, with contact forces as its Lagrange multipliers. Supervision is a Wasserstein-2 optimal-transport loss between the predicted projection through the C-arm geometry and the observed angiogram, so a 2D angiogram can train a 3D prediction. The kinematics, loss and projection are verified against known ground truth; the mechanics solver only against its own optimality conditions, and predicted displacement is not yet mesh-converged. Here, no network is trained. Future work will transfer this in silico model to real CT scans and test whether it improves predictive accuracy and reduces the training data required.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出解剖信息神经网络 (Anatomy-Informed Neural Networks, AINN)，将软解剖先验作为损失中的惩罚项、硬解剖先验嵌入模型架构与状态表示，并在临床数据有限的场景下研究导丝置入引起的主动脉-髂动脉树变形。作者将血管中心线和导丝路径从 R^3 提升为李群 SE(3) 中的曲线族，用 Cosserat 杆模型与血管进行接触耦合，并以 2D 血管造影图通过 Wasserstein-2 最优传输投影损失监督 3D 预测。文中尚未训练任何网络，力学的求解器仅对照其自身最优性条件验证，预测位移也还未做到网格收敛。
Motivation: 针对解剖数据的深度学习模型可能数值上合理但解剖上不可能，且在数据稀缺时泛化能力差的问题；该问题对当代主动脉手术和未来的自主血管内导航很重要，而临床可用数据有限。
Method: 提出 AINN 框架：软解剖先验以损失惩罚项形式加入（如将肾移植动脉起自髂动脉而非主动脉视为意外而非不可能的分支惩罚），硬解剖先验（如血管连续性）则构建进架构和状态表示，使无效预测在结构上不可行。具体模型将血管中心线与导丝路径提升到 SE(3) 框架曲线，将 Cosserat 杆导丝与受迂曲度调制、解剖锚定的血管通过单侧管腔接触不等式耦合，预测为耦合弹性能量的约束极小值，接触力作为 Lagrange 乘子；监督采用 C 臂几何投影与观察到的血管造影图之间的 Wasserstein-2 最优传输损失，使 2D 图像可训练 3D 预测。
Result: 摘要报告运动学、损失和投影已对照已知真值验证；力学求解器仅对照自身最优性条件验证，预测位移尚未达到网格收敛。文中没有训练网络，因此未报告数值上的性能提升。
Conclusion: 作者将该工作定位为 in silico 模型的验证阶段，未来工作将把该模型迁移到真实 CT 扫描，并检验其能否提高预测精度并减少所需训练数据。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Time-Aware Tranformer-Based Prediction Model for AECOPD
papers.abstract_en: The rapid symptom change of Acute exacerbation of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (AECOPD) makes it critical to have time-sensitive prediction models. However, most current machine learning models studying AECOPD use clinical and laboratory data, which will inevitably cause latency. To ensure timely detection of AECOPD and minimize latency, this paper focuses on home monitoring scenarios where only respiratory data from daily-use ventilators is available. We introduce a Time-Aware transformer-based AECOPD prediction model, which generates meaningful patient representations using the Time-Aware transformer to capture the symptoms and their temporal progression in ventilator data. Our experimental results demonstrate that our Time-Aware transformer-based approach outperforms traditional methods in multiple classification tasks, highlighting its potential to enhance AECOPD prediction accuracy.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Published in MEDINFO 2025
papers.journal_ref: Stud Health Technol Inform. 329:1089-1093 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对慢性阻塞性肺疾病急性加重（AECOPD）需要及时预测的问题，提出一种基于 Time-Aware transformer 的预测模型，仅利用家用呼吸机产生的呼吸数据来捕捉症状及其时间进展。实验表明该方法在多个分类任务上优于传统机器学习方法，有望提高 AECOPD 预测准确性。
Motivation: 现有大多数 AECOPD 预测模型依赖临床和实验室数据，会不可避免地引入延迟；而 AECOPD 症状变化迅速，需要具有时间敏感性的预测模型。本文聚焦家庭监测场景，只用日常呼吸机数据以避免检测延迟。
Method: 提出 Time-Aware transformer 架构的 AECOPD 预测模型，通过 Time-Aware transformer 从呼吸机数据中生成有意义的患者表征，以刻画症状及其时间进展。
Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的 Time-Aware transformer 方法在多个分类任务上优于传统方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在家庭监测场景下利用呼吸机数据提升 AECOPD 预测准确性的潜力；其适用范围限定为仅有呼吸数据的居家监测情境。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Unified Branch-and-Bound Search for the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem on Graphs of Convex Sets
papers.abstract_en: We formalize the Steiner Traveling Salesman Problem (Steiner-TSP) on Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS), which seeks a minimum-cost closed trajectory through required convex sets while allowing optional transit vertices and revisits. To explore the resulting infinite solution space, we propose a unified branch-and-bound search over rooted walk prefixes. Additive lower-bound-graph costs bound committed prefixes, while a cut-separated connected-flow relaxation lower-bounds the residual cost of visiting every remaining target and returning to the root. Under a uniform positive-cost assumption, best-first traversal terminates after finitely many expansions on every feasible instance without an initial incumbent, whereas depth-first traversal does so once a finite incumbent is available. For a user-specified factor $ε\geq1$, a global lower bound certifies that either strategy's incumbent cost is at most $ε$ times the global optimum. We further demonstrate joint sensing-mode, visitation-order, and continuous-trajectory selection for a mobile-manipulator inspection task, including action precedences expressed in linear temporal logic over finite traces (LTL$_f$). Both traversal strategies find feasible solutions on all benchmark instances within 30s with mean certified optimality gaps of 28.1% and 29.7%, respectively, whereas two recent baselines succeed on only about half of the instances
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文形式化了凸集图（Graphs of Convex Sets, GCS）上的 Steiner 旅行商问题（Steiner-TSP），目标是寻找经过若干必需凸集、允许可选中转顶点和重复访问的最小代价闭合轨迹。作者提出一种统一的分支定界（branch-and-bound）搜索，在根行走前缀空间上工作，并给出两种遍历策略的有限终止性与 ε 最优性上界保证。该方法在移动机械臂检测任务的联合感知模式、访问顺序与连续轨迹选择上得到验证，并在全部基准实例上优于近期基线。
Motivation: 在 GCS 上求解 Steiner-TSP 会面临无限维解空间，现有方法难以同时处理可选中转顶点、重复访问及连续轨迹优化，缺少统一的搜索框架与最优性保证。
Method: 提出统一的分支定界搜索，枚举根行走前缀；用加性下界图代价约束已承诺前缀，用割分离的连通流松弛（cut-separated connected-flow relaxation）为访问所有剩余目标并返回根节点的残差代价提供下界。在均匀正代价假设下，分析最佳优先与深度优先遍历的有限终止条件，并利用全局下界对用户给定因子 ε≥1 给出代价最优性证明。
Result: 摘要报告两种遍历策略均在 30 秒内找到全部基准实例的可行解，平均认证最优性差距分别为 28.1% 和 29.7%；两个近期基线仅在约半数实例上成功。
Conclusion: 作者强调该统一搜索框架为含 LTL_f 动作前置约束的移动机械臂检测任务提供了联合的感知模式、访问顺序与连续轨迹选择能力，并以 ε 因子全局下界保证搜索终止与最优性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Regulation to Implementation: A Critical Evaluation of LLM-Assisted Regulatory Compliance in Industry
papers.abstract_en: The European Union (EU) has emerged as a leading regulatory body in the development of sustainability and privacy regulations. While new regulation requirements vary, many include a documentation artifact to ensure compliance. Notably, the Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR) introduces Digital Product Passports (DPPs) for life cycle transparency, while the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) mandates Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) to mitigate privacy risks. Creating these compliance artifacts, however, is challenging. Industrial data, which often exists in heterogeneous formats and is scattered across company and supplier systems, is required for DPPs and can be difficult to extract into compliant DPP formatting. Furthermore, DPIA documents require interdisciplinary expertise and follow no standardized format, making development difficult for novel systems. To address the particular complexity of compliance artifact creation for both regulations, researchers have proposed the use of LLMs in the generation process; however, the impact of the aforementioned problems on the output of these systems is largely unaddressed. This work investigates the existing research gap by exploring how data extraction instructions and regulatory vagueness impact the quality and consistency of LLM-produced compliance artifacts. The resulting artifacts are evaluated by benchmarking different models against manually created ground-truth schemas. The results reveal that less strict guidelines, such as DPIA formatting, require higher context prompts to maintain consistency and completeness. Stricter guidelines, such as formatting for Digital Battery Passports (DBP), result in consistent results regardless of prompt context, but may lead to more hallucinations in the output
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 在生成欧盟法规合规工件（如数字产品护照 DPP 和 DPIA 文档）时的质量问题，重点考察数据提取指令和监管模糊性对输出质量与一致性的影响。作者将不同模型生成的工件与人工构建的 ground-truth schema 进行基准对比，发现较宽松的指南需要更高上下文的提示，而较严格的指南（如数字电池护照 DBP）虽结果一致但可能增加幻觉。
Motivation: 欧盟 ESPR 和 GDPR 等法规要求企业生成 DPP 和 DPIA 等合规文档，但工业数据格式异构且分散，DPIA 又缺乏标准化格式，人工创建困难。研究者提出用 LLM 辅助生成，但数据提取难度和法规表述模糊性对 LLM 输出的影响尚未被充分研究。
Method: 通过实验探究数据提取指令与监管模糊性如何影响 LLM 生成的合规工件，使用多个模型生成合规工件，并将其与人工创建的 ground-truth schema 进行基准评测，比较不同提示上下文下的质量和一致性。
Result: 较宽松的指南（如 DPIA 格式）需要更高上下文的提示才能保持一致性和完整性；而较严格的指南（如 DBP 格式）在不同提示上下文下结果一致，但可能产生更多幻觉。
Conclusion: LLM 辅助生成合规工件的效果取决于监管指南的严格程度，宽松指南下需更强的上下文约束，严格指南虽稳定但需警惕幻觉。研究填补了数据提取难度与法规模糊性对 LLM 输出影响的空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Expressivity and Efficiency in Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Training (TTT) enables long-context processing via continuous weight updates during inference, but current methods struggle to balance the expressivity of per-token update dynamics with the hardware efficiency of chunk-wise approximations. We propose E$^2$-TTT (Expressive and Efficient TTT) to bridge this gap. Under the standard approximation of taking gradients at the chunk-start weights, we derive a closed-form state transition that exactly reproduces the chunk-end fast-weight and momentum states of the per-token recurrence. This enables fully parallelized chunk-level training while preserving the temporal structure of the update rule that prior chunk-wise methods discard. We validate E$^2$-TTT by training models up to 1.3B parameters from scratch. It performs on par with previous TTT and hybrid attention baselines in language modeling while outperforming them on in-context retrieval. Its advantage is most pronounced in length extrapolation: on the standard ``Needle in a Haystack'' passkey test, it retains over 90% accuracy at $8\times$ the training context length. Meanwhile, E$^2$-TTT can match the training throughput of efficient chunk-wise methods, demonstrating that it effectively reconciles expressivity with efficiency. The code is available at https://github.com/zeyun-zhong/E2-TTT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E²-TTT（Expressive and Efficient TTT），目标是在测试时训练（Test-Time Training）中同时兼顾单 token 更新动力学的表达能力与分块（chunk-wise）近似的硬件效率。作者在「以 chunk 起始权重计算梯度」的标准近似下，推导出闭式状态转移，能精确复现逐 token 循环的 chunk 末尾 fast-weight 与动量状态，从而支持完全并行的 chunk 级训练，同时保留先前分块方法丢弃的时间结构。实验在最高 1.3B 参数的从零训练模型上验证，语言建模性能与既有 TTT 及混合注意力基线相当，在上下文检索上更优，并在长度外推上优势明显。
Motivation: 现有 Test-Time Training 方法能在推理时通过连续权重更新处理长上下文，但在「逐 token 更新动力学的表达能力」与「分块近似的硬件效率」之间存在权衡，已有分块方法会牺牲更新规则的时间结构。
Method: 提出 E²-TTT：在 chunk 起始权重处取梯度的标准近似下，推导出闭式状态转移公式，精确复现 chunk 末端逐 token 循环产生的 fast-weight 和动量状态，从而将 chunk 级训练完全并行化，同时不丢失更新规则的时序信息。
Result: 摘要报告：训练最高 1.3B 参数的模型，语言建模上与之前 TTT 和混合注意力基线相当，在上下文检索上超过它们；在标准「大海捞针」(Needle in a Haystack) 测试中，在 8 倍训练上下文长度下仍保持超过 90% 的准确率；训练吞吐量与高效分块方法持平。

papers.title: SPARCL: Spectral Partitioned Analytic Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Analytic continual learning has emerged as a strong exemplar-free alternative to gradient-based class-incremental learning because it replaces iterative optimization with closed-form ridge updates. Yet the usual forgetting narrative, centered on stochastic gradient overwriting, does not explain why analytic methods still drift on old classes despite exact recursive solvers. We identify the culprit as spectral interference: the joint ridge classifier for all tasks shares the inverse autocorrelation operator $(R+λI)^{-1}$, so incoming task samples that load onto old dominant eigendirections dilute the spectrum and perturb old-class logits even when old labels are never revisited. Based on this view, we propose SPARCL, a spectral partitioned analytic continual learner that decomposes the running autocorrelation into a high-energy core and a residual complement, freezes old-class classifier components in the core subspace, and updates only the residual block through recursive least squares with an optional residual random-projection expansion. This yields a simple closed-form update with a provable invariance guarantee for the core contribution of old logits. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-A under a frozen ViT-B/16 protocol, SPARCL closes most of the gap from classical analytic learners to strong representation matchers, while remaining complementary to sparse feature-decorrelation approaches such as Fly-CL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对分析式持续学习 (analytic continual learning) 中即使使用闭式递归求解器仍会在旧类别上漂移的现象，提出其根源是谱干扰 (spectral interference)：所有任务共享逆自相关算子 (R+λI)^{-1}，新任务样本在旧主导特征方向上的载荷会稀释谱并扰动旧类 logits。作者据此提出 SPARCL (Spectral Partitioned Analytic Continual Learning)，将自相关矩阵分解为高能核心与残差补集，冻结核心子空间中的旧类分类器分量，仅通过递归最小二乘更新残差块，并给出可证明的核心贡献不变性保证。
Motivation: 传统的灾难性遗忘叙事集中在随机梯度覆盖上，无法解释分析式方法在精确递归求解下仍在旧类上漂移的现象；作者将原因归结为共享逆自相关算子带来的谱干扰。
Method: SPARCL 将运行中的自相关矩阵分解为高能量核心 (high-energy core) 与残差补集 (residual complement)，在核心子空间中冻结旧类分类器分量，只通过递归最小二乘 (recursive least squares) 更新残差块，并可选地对残差进行随机投影扩展；该更新保持闭式形式，并对旧 logits 的核心贡献提供不变性保证。
Result: 在冻结 ViT-B/16 协议下，SPARCL 在 CIFAR-100、CUB-200、ImageNet-R 和 ImageNet-A 四个基准上缩小了经典分析式学习器与强表示匹配方法之间的大部分差距，并与稀疏特征去相关方法 (如 Fly-CL) 互补。
Conclusion: 作者认为谱干扰视角为分析式方法在无样本类增量学习中的漂移提供了机制解释，SPARCL 通过谱分解与核心子空间冻结实现互补的旧类保护，且其闭式更新带来可证明的不变性保证。

papers.title: Re$^3$Cap: Retrieval-Guided Refinement for Image Captioning Enhancement via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated significant gains in image captioning, yet it is still limited in encouraging Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) to explore novel reasoning strategies. This limitation leads to a performance gap between RL and Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT). In this paper, we argue that multi-modal retrieval can serve as an effective reasoning signal for caption refinement. Based on this insight, we present the Retrieval-Guided Refinement for Image Captioning (Re$^3$Cap), a retrieval-guided reasoning strategy that enhances image captioning without requiring additional annotations. Instantiated by Caption Refinement Suggester (CRS) and Caption Quality Assessor (CQA), this strategy identifies hallucinations and omissions in image captions, leading to more accurate and detailed descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our method in image captioning, even compared with Supervised Fine-Tuning. Especially, Re$^3$Cap outperforms GRPO with an average improvement of 8.64% in relation reasoning on the COCO-LN500 benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Re$^3$Cap，一种基于检索引导的推理式图像描述精化策略，通过强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）增强 LVLM 的图像描述质量，且无需额外标注。该方法由 Caption Refinement Suggester (CRS) 和 Caption Quality Assessor (CQA) 两个模块实例化，用于识别描述中的幻觉与遗漏。实验显示该方法在图像描述任务上优于 GRPO，并在 COCO-LN500 基准的关系推理上平均提升 8.64%，效果甚至可与 SFT 相比。
Motivation: RL 虽在图像描述上有显著提升，但难以鼓励大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）探索新的推理策略，导致 RL 与监督微调（SFT）之间存在性能差距。作者认为多模态检索可以作为描述精化的有效推理信号。
Method: 提出检索引导的精化推理策略 Re$^3$Cap，由 Caption Refinement Suggester (CRS) 提出精化建议、Caption Quality Assessor (CQA) 评估质量，二者共同识别图像描述中的幻觉和遗漏，从而生成更准确、更详细的描述，整个过程不需要额外标注。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法在图像描述上具备优越性，甚至可与 SFT 相比；在 COCO-LN500 基准上，Re$^3$Cap 相比 GRPO 在关系推理（relation reasoning）上平均提升 8.64%。
Conclusion: 论文认为多模态检索能作为有效的推理信号用于图像描述精化，Re$^3$Cap 在不引入额外标注的情况下缩小了 RL 与 SFT 之间的性能差距。该文已被 EMNLP 2026 Main Conference 接收。

papers.title: When Adaptation Hurts: Connecting Representational Drift to OOD Failures in MedSAM Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models for medical image segmentation, like prompt-based MedSAM, generalize well across domains and modalities, often in zero or few-shot setups. However, their performance depends on the quality of prompts and the adaptation of the models to custom datasets. This work systematically examines how MedSAM generalizes across diverse medical imaging benchmarks, with six adaptation strategies: full-model and encoder-only LoRA, shallow and deep visual prompt tuning (VPT), and decoder-only and full fine-tuning. Models are trained on the International Skin Imaging Collaboration Challenge (ISIC 2018) dataset and evaluated under clean and increasingly noisy prompts on IN and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) datasets: close-OOD PH2 (dermoscopy), far-OOD BUSI (Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset) and CBIS-DDSM (Curated Breast Imaging Subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography). We show that adaptation improves performance on IN and close-OOD data but often reduces performance on far-OOD data. Full fine-tuning provides the best tradeoff, while encoder-only LoRA is the strongest parameter-efficient alternative, outperforming standard LoRA and VPT under far-OOD shifts. Using Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA), we show that far-OOD degradation is strongly associated with drift in decoder representations, whereas encoder similarity alone does not explain robustness. This suggests encoder-only LoRA provides stronger robustness than standard LoRA by adapting the encoder to distribution shift in visual features, while preserving the decoder pathway. We further show that random 0-100 pixel jitter on prompts produces more robust and better performing models. We thus conclude that robust MedSAM adaptation requires the combined consideration of prompt noise exposure, domain shift, and representation preservation. We release our code: https://github.com/ImSounic/medsam-vpt
papers.comment: Accepted at the SAFER Workshop, MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究基于提示的医学图像分割基础模型 MedSAM 在领域外数据上的微调鲁棒性，在 ISIC 2018 上训练，并在 clean 与逐步加噪的提示下于 IN、close-OOD（PH2）和 far-OOD（BUSI、CBIS-DDSM）上评估六种适应策略。结果显示适应提升 IN 与 close-OOD 性能但常降低 far-OOD 性能，全量微调权衡最佳，encoder-only LoRA 是最强参数高效替代。作者用 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 指出 far-OOD 退化与 decoder 表示漂移强相关，并发现 prompt 随机像素抖动可带来更稳健且更好的模型。
Motivation: 医学图像分割基础模型在零样本或少样本下泛化良好，但部署时仍需针对自定义数据集微调；微调可能损害分布外（OOD）泛化，而提示质量和表示漂移在其中所起的作用尚未被系统剖析。
Method: 在 ISIC 2018 上比较六种适应策略：全模型与仅编码器的 LoRA、浅层与深层视觉提示微调（VPT）、仅解码器微调和全量微调；在 clean 及 0-100 像素随机抖动噪声提示下评估，并用 CKA 分析编码器与解码器表示漂移和 OOD 鲁棒性的关联。
Result: 适应改善了 IN 与 close-OOD 性能，但常降低 far-OOD 性能；全量微调提供最佳权衡，encoder-only LoRA 优于标准 LoRA 和 VPT。CKA 显示 far-OOD 退化与 decoder 表示漂移强关联，而 encoder 相似性不足以解释鲁棒性；对提示施加随机抖动使模型更稳健且性能更好。
Conclusion: 稳健的 MedSAM 适应需要同时考虑提示噪声暴露、领域偏移和表示保留，encoder-only LoRA 通过适应编码器视觉特征并保留 decoder 通路来提升远域鲁棒性。

papers.title: AUSO: Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization from Internalization to Utilization
papers.abstract_en: Skills play different roles as an agent's policy evolves: they should first provide learnable knowledge, then support capability formation, and finally be invoked only when they improve individual decisions. Existing methods rarely model this lifecycle. They either keep skills outside the model, fully internalize them, or select among internalization and utilization objectives through noisy task-level success rates. Such designs fragment training and assign uniform importance to actions within the same trajectory, even though skill guidance may help some decisions while distracting others. To solve these problems, we introduce AUSO (Action-level Unified Skill Optimization), which unifies skill learning and skill use through a progressive, action-aware optimization process. At the beginning of training, AUSO jointly learns from teacher guidance and environmental outcomes, enabling the policy to acquire foundational skills without losing task-oriented feedback. It subsequently emphasizes outcome-based policy optimization to consolidate autonomous problem-solving ability. As the policy matures, AUSO evaluates each sampled action under both skill-conditioned and skill-free contexts. The resulting action-level information signal is coupled with the trajectory outcome advantage, allowing beneficial skill-sensitive actions to receive stronger updates and harmful ones to be suppressed. Therefore, skills gradually transition from an external source of supervision into decision knowledge whose utilization is adapted to its action-level benefit, while reinforcement learning remains the shared backbone across all stages. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that AUSO consistently improves agent performance and out-of-distribution generalization over competitive baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AUSO（Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization），把智能体技能的学习与使用统一为一个渐进、动作感知的优化过程。AUSO 在训练早期同时利用教师指导与环境奖励来学习基础技能，随后转向以结果为导向的策略优化，最后在策略成熟时按动作级别比较技能条件化与无技能上下文，用该信息信号结合轨迹优势来强化有益动作、抑制有害动作。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 上显示相较于竞争基线有稳定提升与更强的分布外泛化。
Motivation: 现有方法很少建模技能随策略演化而变化的生命周期，要么把技能保留在模型外部、要么完全内化，要么通过有噪声的任务级成功率在内部化与利用目标间做选择，导致训练碎片化，并对同一轨迹内的重要程度不同的动作赋予统一权重。
Method: AUSO 通过渐进式、动作感知的统一过程来同时完成技能学习与技能使用：初期联合教师引导与环境结果学习，中期强化基于结果（outcome-based）的策略优化，后期对每个采样动作在 skill-conditioned 与 skill-free 两种上下文下评估，并将动作级信息信号与轨迹结果优势结合，以调节各动作的更新强度；强化学习作为所有阶段的共享主干。
Result: 摘要报告 AUSO 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 三个环境上一致提升了智能体性能，并在分布外泛化上优于竞争基线。
Conclusion: AUSO 让技能从外部监督来源逐步转化为根据动作级收益被适配使用的决策知识，同时保持强化学习作为统一骨干；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 AUSO（Action-Level Unified Skill Optimization），把智能体技能的学习与使用统一为一个渐进、动作感知的优化过程。AUSO 在训练早期同时利用教师指导与环境奖励来学习基础技能，随后转向以结果为导向的策略优化，最后在策略成熟时按动作级别比较技能条件化与无技能上下文，用该信息信号结合轨迹优势来强化有益动作、抑制有害动作。实验在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 上显示相较于竞争基线有稳定提升与更强的分布外泛化。

summary_sections.method: AUSO 通过渐进式、动作感知的统一过程来同时完成技能学习与技能使用：初期联合教师引导与环境结果学习，中期强化基于结果（outcome-based）的策略优化，后期对每个采样动作在 skill-conditioned 与 skill-free 两种上下文下评估，并将动作级信息信号与轨迹结果优势结合，以调节各动作的更新强度；强化学习作为所有阶段的共享主干。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 AUSO 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 SearchQA 三个环境上一致提升了智能体性能，并在分布外泛化上优于竞争基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: AUSO 让技能从外部监督来源逐步转化为根据动作级收益被适配使用的决策知识，同时保持强化学习作为统一骨干；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。

papers.title: VT-MUSE: Multimodal Unified Sequential Visuotactile Representation Learning for Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: We propose VT-MUSE, a Multimodal Unified SEquential representation learning framework for visuotactilemanipulation. Existing approaches often encode visual and tactile observations independently before fusion, limiting their ability to capture fine-grained cross-modal dependencies. Moreover, most methods focus on observations at the current time step and overlook the temporal evolution of contact. VT-MUSE addresses both limitations through a two-stage representation learning framework. In Stage I, modality specific encoders are jointly adapted via cross-modal temporal alignment and masked-view consistency. In Stage II, a conditional variational latent model processes masked visual sequences together with full tactile histories. Auxiliary decoders reconstruct the masked recent visual observations and predict tactile depth changes, encouraging the latent representation to retain both global visual context and local contact dynamics. The learned representation is subsequently integrated into a lightweight Transformer policy through gated cross-attention. On the simulation benchmark, VT-MUSE outperforms the strongest baseline evaluated on all tasks by 11 percentage points and also achieves substantial improvements in real-world experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VT-MUSE，一个面向视觉-触觉操作的多模态统一时序表示学习框架。它通过两阶段训练解决现有方法中视觉与触觉先独立编码再融合、且只关注当前时刻观测而忽略接触时序演化的问题。学到的表示经门控交叉注意力 (gated cross-attention) 集成到轻量 Transformer 策略中。在仿真基准上比最强基线平均提升 11 个百分点，并在真实实验中取得显著改进。
Motivation: 现有方法通常先独立编码视觉和触觉观测再融合，难以捕捉精细的跨模态依赖；同时多数方法只利用当前时刻观测，忽略了接触的时序演化。
Method: 两阶段表示学习框架：第一阶段通过跨模态时序对齐 (cross-modal temporal alignment) 和掩码视图一致性 (masked-view consistency) 联合适配各模态专用编码器；第二阶段用一个条件变分潜变量模型处理掩码视觉序列和完整触觉历史，辅助解码器重建近期掩码视觉观测并预测触觉深度变化，从而让潜表示同时保留全局视觉上下文和局部接触动力学。
Result: 在仿真基准上，VT-MUSE 在所有任务上比最强基线平均提升 11 个百分点，并在真实世界实验中取得显著改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时保留全局视觉上下文与局部接触动力学有利于操作策略；摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Difficulty-Calibrated Interpolation Paths for Conditional Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Conditional Flow Matching trains generative models by regressing a network onto the velocity of a prescribed noise-to-data interpolation path. The interpolation schedule that shapes this path is known to affect convergence and sample quality, yet it is invariably fixed in advance, independent of both the data and the model. We show that the regression difficulty of Conditional Flow Matching varies systematically along the path, and we propose Difficulty-Calibrated Flow Matching, which derives the schedule from the model itself: a short pilot run with the linear path records the per-time loss, and the schedule is set to the quantile function of this difficulty profile, so the trajectory lingers where the velocity is hardest to learn. The method has a single hyperparameter, leaves the training objective and its gradient equivalence intact, composes with classifier-free guidance, and adds about two percent training overhead. In controlled experiments on CIFAR-10, MNIST, and Fashion-MNIST with an identical compact U-Net, the calibrated path attains the best FID on CIFAR-10 at full sampling budget and clearly outperforms all fixed schedules in the large-batch, few-update regime, precisely the setting where compute is scarcest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对条件流匹配 (Conditional Flow Matching) 中插值调度固定不变的问题，提出 Difficulty-Calibrated Flow Matching：先用线性路径做一次短 pilot run 记录逐时间步的损失作为难度曲线，再将调度设为该难度分布的 quantile 函数，使轨迹在速度最难的区间停留更久。方法只有一个超参数，不改变训练目标与梯度等价性，可与 classifier-free guidance 组合，训练开销约增加 2%。在 CIFAR-10、MNIST 和 Fashion-MNIST 上使用同一紧凑 U-Net 的受控实验中，校准调度在完整采样预算下取得 CIFAR-10 最佳 FID，并在大批量、少更新（few-update）场景中明显优于所有固定调度。
Motivation: 条件流匹配的插值调度对收敛和样本质量有明显影响，但现有方法总是在训练前固定调度，既不依赖数据也不依赖模型。作者指出回归难度沿插值路径是系统性变化的，说明固定调度忽略了这一结构。
Method: 提出 Difficulty-Calibrated Flow Matching：先用线性路径运行短 pilot run 记录每个时间步的损失作为难度曲线，再把训练调度设置为该难度分布的 quantile 函数，让轨迹在速度最难学习的时间段停留更久；该方法仅含一个超参数，并保持原有训练目标与梯度等价性。
Result: 在与固定调度相同的紧凑 U-Net 架构下，校准路径在 CIFAR-10 上以完整采样预算取得最佳 FID，并在大批量、少更新（few-update）的算力受限场景中明显优于所有固定调度。
Conclusion: 摘要表明插值调度可以而非必须预先固定，由模型自身难度曲线导出的调度能提升条件流匹配在计算受限条件下的生成性能，且不改变训练目标。

papers.title: WildFin: An In-the-Wild Dataset for Fish Behavioral Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in field technology have led to a massive influx of in-the-wild video data for ecological science. The primary bottleneck in leveraging this data is the high cost of expert annotation. While computer vision offers a potential solution, current models frequently fail when deployed in complex marine environments. To characterize these failures, we introduce WildFin, a novel benchmark for fish behavior recognition collected and annotated by ecologists.WildFin spans two critical real-world paradigms: stationary cameras monitoring groups of fish and dynamic divers following individual subjects. The dataset represents a massive curation effort, involving 1,350 hours of fieldwork and 600 hours of expert annotation to produce 9 hours of behavioral data with over 2 million frame-by-frame labels. We benchmark modern vision foundation models and quantify tradeoffs between static and spatiotemporal architectures, revealing the substantial gap that remains between current model capabilities and the demands of real-world underwater behavioral analysis. Project website: https://team-wildfin.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 WildFin，一个由生态学家采集并标注的鱼类行为识别野外基准数据集（in-the-wild benchmark），覆盖两类真实场景：静态相机监测鱼群和动态潜水员跟踪个体。数据集投入 1,350 小时野外工作与 600 小时专家标注，产出 9 小时行为数据，包含超过 200 万个逐帧标签。作者对现代视觉基础模型进行基准测试，量化静态与时空架构之间的权衡，并指出当前模型能力与真实水下行为分析需求之间仍有显著差距。
Motivation: 野外生态视频数据大量涌入，但专家标注成本高昂成为利用这些数据的主要瓶颈；现有视觉模型在复杂海洋环境中部署时经常失败，缺乏能表征这些失败的专门基准。
Method: 构建 WildFin 基准数据集，包含静态相机与动态潜水员两种拍摄范式下由生态学家标注的鱼类行为数据，并在此数据集上评测现代视觉基础模型，比较静态架构与时空架构的表现。
Result: 基准测试显示当前模型能力与真实水下行为分析需求之间仍存在实质性差距，并量化了静态与时空架构在不同范式下的性能权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要进一步工作来弥合模型能力与真实水下行为分析需求之间的差距；该基准专门面向海洋环境下的鱼类行为识别。

papers.title: CLEAR: Continuous Latent Adapter Routing for Utility-Preserving LLM Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Improving the safety of large language models (LLMs) often comes at the expense of utility, as globally applied safety tuning may affect model responses to both harmful and benign inputs. We propose \textbf{C}ontinuous \textbf{L}at\textbf{E}nt \textbf{A}dapter \textbf{R}outing (CLEAR), a conditional safety adaptation framework that uses a lightweight hidden-state gate to continuously control the activation strength of a safety low-rank adapter. CLEAR aims to reduce harmful completions while avoiding unnecessary changes to the frozen backbone that could degrade performance on benign prompts. Experiments on widely used safety and utility benchmarks show that CLEAR improves robustness on HarmBench while reducing the utility degradation observed with globally applied safety tuning such as SFT or standard low-rank adaptation (LoRA). On Llama-3-8B-Instruct, CLEAR reduces HarmBench ASR from 32.3\% to 0.5\%, while retaining most of the base model's utility and achieving up to 7.1 percentage points higher GSM8K accuracy than globally applied SFT or LoRA. These results suggest that CLEAR is a promising mechanism for improving the safety--utility trade-off in LLM alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CLEAR（Continuous Latent Adapter Routing），一个条件式安全对齐框架，用轻量级隐状态门（hidden-state gate）连续控制安全低秩适配器（safety low-rank adapter）的激活强度，在冻结主干模型上按输入条件地施加安全调整。在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，CLEAR 将 HarmBench 的 ASR 从 32.3% 降到 0.5%，同时保留大部分基础模型效用。作者认为该方法能改善 LLM 对齐中安全与效用之间的权衡。
Motivation: 全局式安全微调（如 SFT 或标准 LoRA）往往以牺牲效用为代价，因为安全调整会同时影响模型对有害输入和良性输入的反应；需要一种能减少有害补全、又避免对良性提示产生不必要变化的条件式安全适配机制。
Method: CLEAR 提出连续潜在适配器路由：使用一个轻量级隐状态门来连续控制安全低秩适配器的激活强度，并将其应用于冻结的骨干模型，从而实现对安全信号的按需路由而非全局施加。
Result: 在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 上，CLEAR 将 HarmBench 攻击成功率（ASR）从 32.3% 降至 0.5%，同时保留大部分基础模型效用，并在 GSM8K 上相比全局 SFT 或 LoRA 最高提升 7.1 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CLEAR 是改善 LLM 对齐中安全-效用权衡的一种有前景的机制；摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: ConceptTS: LLM-Guided Concept Bottlenecks for Interpretable Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art multivariate time-series forecasters can model complex temporal and cross-variable dependencies, yet their opaque representations provide limited insight into why a particular forecast is produced. This lack of transparency restricts their use in settings where practitioners must understand and assess the factors underlying a prediction. We introduce ConceptTS, an interpretable forecasting framework that organizes its predictions around named, human-readable concepts. ConceptTS uses a large language model to propose task-relevant concepts and generate executable labeling rules, translating the language model's domain knowledge into direct supervision without costly manual concept annotation. The proposed concepts are organized into three complementary bottlenecks that describe the historical context, local forecast intervals, and the full forecast horizon. A shared decoder combines representations derived from their predicted activations to construct the forecast, making the model's decision process explicit and supporting direct concept-level interventions. Experiments on the Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality dataset show that ConceptTS achieves accuracy competitive with strong black-box baselines while producing semantically meaningful concept activations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConceptTS，一个面向多元时间序列预测的可解释框架，用命名的人类可读概念来组织预测过程。框架借助大语言模型 (LLM) 提出与任务相关的概念并生成可执行的标注规则，从而将语言模型的领域知识转化为直接监督，避免昂贵的人工概念标注。概念被组织成三个互补的瓶颈层，分别描述历史背景、局部预测区间和完整预测范围，共享解码器根据预测的激活值构建最终预测，使决策过程显式化并支持概念层面的干预。
Motivation: 现有最先进的多元时间序列预测器虽能建模复杂的时间与跨变量依赖，但其表示不透明，难以解释某个预测为何产生，限制了需要理解并评估预测背后因素的实践场景的使用。
Method: ConceptTS 使用 LLM 提出任务相关概念并生成可执行标注规则，将概念对应到历史背景、局部预测区间与完整预测范围三个互补瓶颈层；共享解码器结合这些预测激活的表示生成预测，使模型决策过程显式化并支持概念级干预。
Result: 在北京多站点空气质量数据集上的实验表明，ConceptTS 在精度上与强黑盒基线相当，同时产生语义上有意义的概念激活。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用 LLM 生成概念与标注规则可以在无需人工概念标注的情况下构建可解释的多元时间序列预测框架；其验证范围主要是空气质量预测数据集。

papers.title: The Coastline as a Structural Constraint: Harnessing Scene Geometry for Autonomous Surface Vessel Localization
papers.abstract_en: Coastal environments contain rich, largely unexploited geometric structure capable of providing globally referenced localization cues. In this work, we present two complementary localization frameworks that exploit shoreline and water-surface geometry for GPS-denied autonomous surface vessel localization. The first framework leverages LiDAR observations of the water surface to estimate roll, pitch, and heave (vertical motion), while recovering global position and heading through direct registration of shoreline observations against a satellite-derived coastline map. The second framework relies solely on passive imagery to detect the shoreline and horizon through semantic segmentation. Using the proposed coastal scene geometry, shoreline distance is inferred from monocular imagery. Shoreline observations are accumulated into short-duration local submaps, registered against the same satellite-derived coastline map, and fused within a hierarchical factor graph. Evaluated across three real-world coastal datasets, the LiDAR pipeline consistently improves trajectory accuracy over standard baselines, while the monocular architecture maintains bounded long-term drift. In addition, we establish that modern zero-shot foundation models can reliably extract shoreline observations across diverse coastal environments. Together, these results demonstrate that coastal geometry provides a powerful and dependable source of globally referenced information for GPS-denied maritime localization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 GPS 拒止环境下的自主水面艇定位问题，提出两种利用海岸线和水面几何结构的定位框架。第一种基于 LiDAR 观测水面估计横滚、俯仰与垂荡，并通过将岸线观测与卫星海岸线地图直接配准恢复全局位置和航向；第二种仅依赖被动图像，用语义分割检测岸线与地平线，从单目图像推断岸线距离，累积为局部子图并在地理层次因子图中融合。在三个真实沿海数据集上，LiDAR 管线持续改善轨迹精度，单目架构保持有界长期漂移，且零样本基础模型能可靠提取岸线观测。
Motivation: 沿海环境包含丰富但尚未充分利用的几何结构，可提供全局参考的定位线索；在 GPS 拒止环境下，现有方法未能有效开发这种结构作为定位信息源。
Method: 提出两个互补框架：LiDAR 框架利用水面观测估计姿态（roll、pitch、heave）并借助岸线-卫星地图配准恢复全局位置与航向；单目框架通过语义分割检测岸线与地平线，从单目图像推断岸线距离，将短时局部子图与同一卫星海岸线地图配准，并在分层因子图中融合。
Result: 在三个真实沿海数据集上，LiDAR 管线相比标准基线持续改善轨迹精度；单目架构保持有界长期漂移；现代零样本基础模型可在多种沿海环境中可靠提取岸线观测。
Conclusion: 作者认为沿海几何结构为 GPS 拒止海事定位提供了强大且可靠的全局参考信息来源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Exceedance Design Effect: Effective Sample Size for Thresholds under Clustering
papers.abstract_en: Many machine-learning systems set a threshold at a quantile of a calibration set: conformal predictors that promise 90% coverage by drawing their cutoff at the calibration set's 90th percentile, abstention gates that decline to answer when a model's score falls below the calibration set's tenth percentile, safety filters that block any output scoring above the 99th percentile of a reference set. All of them promise that the threshold will hold at the stated rate on new data. The promise assumes the calibration examples are independent, and in modern pipelines they usually are not: they share a prompt, a document, a reasoning trace. Survey statistics has known how to discount correlated data since 1965, by counting how many independent observations a sample is worth, but only for averages. We show that a threshold needs a different count. The count depends on how often clustered scores land on the same side of the threshold, and that changes with where the threshold is set. How similar the scores are as numbers does not enter. We prove a closed-form law for the resulting effective sample size and for the spread of the coverage a deployed system actually sees. Three consequences follow. The correction now used in the conformal literature is the wrong quantity, and can miss in either direction. A dataset has no single effective sample size. It has one for each level the threshold is set at. And the damage is invisible in coverage averaged over many runs, and fully felt by whoever deploys once. On a released calibration set of 25,028 examples, we measure the reliability of about 1,300.
papers.comment: 48 pages, 5 figures. Verification code and archival version: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21595640
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究聚类（非独立）校准数据下分位数阈值（如 conformal prediction 的覆盖阈值、abstention gate、safety filter）的有效样本量问题。作者证明阈值场景需要一种不同于均值情形的“越界设计效应”（exceedance design effect），其大小取决于聚类分数落在阈值同侧的一致性，并给出闭式律。三个推论是：现有 conformal 文献中使用的修正量是错误的且可能双向偏离；数据集没有单一有效样本量，而是每个阈值水平各有一个；覆盖率的多次运行平均掩盖了单次部署实际承担的风险。在包含 25,028 个示例的公开校准集上，实测可靠性约为 1,300。
Motivation: 现代机器学习流水线中的校准样本往往不独立，例如共享同一 prompt、文档或推理轨迹，而基于分位数的阈值承诺默认样本独立。调查统计自 1965 年起已有针对相关数据的折扣方法，但只适用于平均值，缺少针对阈值（分位数）的有效样本量度量。
Method: 作者针对聚类数据下的阈值（越界）情形推导出有效样本量与覆盖率的闭式律，证明关键量是聚类分数落在阈值同侧的概率，而非分数数值上的相似度；这一量会随阈值位置变化。
Result: 摘要报告三个后果：conformal 文献当前使用的修正量是错误的，可能高估或低估；同一数据集没有单一有效样本量，每个阈值水平各有其值；覆盖率的平均表现无法反映单次部署的损失。在公开的 25,028 个校准示例上，作者测量到实际可靠性约为 1,300。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于均值的传统设计效应不能直接迁移到阈值承诺，聚类数据下的分位数校准需要专门的越界有效样本量度量；论文提供闭式律并指出平均覆盖率的误导性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Transferability of Agricultural Weed Detection Under Cross-Field Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: Accurate agricultural weed detection in real-world field conditions is essential for precision agriculture, enabling targeted intervention and reducing yield loss. Recent work has reported strong detection performance from UAV-based imagery across a range of crops, yet existing approaches evaluate within a single crop and field, leaving practitioners with little evidence that a model trained on one crop will generalize to a new field or crop type. In this work, we characterize where cross-dataset weed-localization performance degrades and which modeling choices recover it, reducing the need to relabel every new deployment field. We introduce a newly collected and annotated UAV image dataset for agricultural weed detection in cotton fields and use it alongside an existing soybean dataset collected under a similar protocol. Using these datasets, we evaluate the performance of several strategies for transferring a detector trained on one crop to another, comparing unsupervised domain adaptive object detection (DAOD) against pretraining on a domain-adjacent source dataset followed by few-shot fine-tuning on the target dataset. Our analysis spans target-domain label budgets from zero to the full target dataset, characterizing the trade-off between adaptation strategy and annotation effort. We find that few-shot fine-tuning with as few as 25 labeled target examples outperforms unsupervised DAOD in our cross-crop comparison, suggesting that source domain selection combined with modest target supervision is more productive than algorithmic sophistication in adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究农业杂草检测在跨田分布偏移下的迁移能力，指出现有方法只在同一作物和同一田间评估，无法证明跨作物或跨田的泛化性。作者收集并标注了一个棉花田的 UAV 图像杂草检测数据集，与已有的相似采集规程的大豆数据集配合，比较了无监督域自适应目标检测 (DAOD) 与先在邻近域源数据上预训练再在目标域上少样本微调 (few-shot fine-tuning) 两种迁移策略，并覆盖从零到完整目标集的不同标注预算。
Motivation: 精准农业需要模型能泛化到新田块或新作物，但现有杂草检测工作都在单一作物和田间评估，缺乏跨数据集泛化证据；而每个新部署田块都重新标注代价高昂。作者想刻画跨数据集杂草定位性能在何处退化，以及哪些建模选择能恢复性能。
Method: 作者构建了棉花田 UAV 杂草检测数据集，并配合已有的同类规程采集的大豆数据集，进行跨作物检测器的迁移实验。评估策略包括无监督 DAOD 与领域邻近源数据预训练加目标域少样本微调，并在目标域标注数量从零到完整数据集的范围内考察适应策略与标注成本的权衡。
Result: 在跨作物对比中，仅用约 25 个带标注目标样例的少样本微调即可胜过无监督 DAOD。作者据此认为，源域选择配合适度的目标域监督比更复杂的适应算法更有效。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，结合源域选择与少量目标域标注可以减少每个新部署田块的重新标注需求，并比算法层面的无监督适应更实用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EnSI-RAG: Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long-Document Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Question answering (QA) over long, connected documents remains challenging because relevant evidence may span multiple entities and their relationships. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods typically index documents as raw chunks and retrieve them through embedding similarity. Their performance degrades when chunk boundaries separate entities from supporting evidence or when a question requires multi-hop reasoning across the corpus. We propose EnSI-RAG (Entity-Structure-Indexed Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a framework that constructs a query-independent, entity-centered index. Each record (e, t, k, v) represents an entity e, its type t, a semantic category k in {property, relation, aspect}, and a value v, while retaining links to the original source passages. At query time, these records serve as retrieval handles, and an LLM synthesizes the retrieved passages into the final answer. This design separates evidence localization from answer synthesis while preserving traceable source evidence. Across Loong and Oolong, EnSI-RAG achieves an average accuracy of 78.24. Relative to the published baseline scores used as references, this is 6.62 points higher, suggesting its effectiveness across these settings. The code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/EnSI-RAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EnSI-RAG，一种面向长文档问答的检索增强生成框架，核心是构建与查询无关的实体中心索引。索引中每条记录 (e, t, k, v) 表示实体 e、其类型 t、语义类别 k（取值为 property、relation、aspect）和值 v，同时保留到原始源段落的链接。查询时这些记录作为检索句柄，由 LLM 将检索到的段落综合成最终答案。论文在 Loong 和 Oolong 上报告平均准确率 78.24，比参考的已发布基线高 6.62 点。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 方法通常把文档切分为原始块并用嵌入相似度检索，当分块边界把实体与支撑证据分开、或问题需要跨语料多跳推理时，性能会明显下降。
Method: 构造查询无关的实体中心索引，每条记录以 (e, t, k, v) 形式组织实体的属性、关系和侧面信息，并保留原始源段落链接；查询时这些记录作为检索句柄，由 LLM 综合检索到的段落生成答案。
Result: 在 Loong 和 Oolong 两个评测设置上，EnSI-RAG 的平均准确率达到 78.24，相较于参考的已发布基线分数提高 6.62 点。
Conclusion: 该设计将证据定位与答案综合两个环节分离，同时保留可追溯的源证据，作者认为这种框架在长文档多跳问答上有效，并公开了代码。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 EnSI-RAG，一种面向长文档问答的检索增强生成框架，核心是构建与查询无关的实体中心索引。索引中每条记录 (e, t, k, v) 表示实体 e、其类型 t、语义类别 k（取值为 property、relation、aspect）和值 v，同时保留到原始源段落的链接。查询时这些记录作为检索句柄，由 LLM 将检索到的段落综合成最终答案。论文在 Loong 和 Oolong 上报告平均准确率 78.24，比参考的已发布基线高 6.62 点。

summary_sections.method: 构造查询无关的实体中心索引，每条记录以 (e, t, k, v) 形式组织实体的属性、关系和侧面信息，并保留原始源段落链接；查询时这些记录作为检索句柄，由 LLM 综合检索到的段落生成答案。

papers.title: TRACE-C: Rank-Calibrated Relational Anomaly Detection for Multi-Stream Operational Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: Operational telemetry can be jointly anomalous while every individual stream stays inside its familiar range. TRACE-C is an auditable strictly-prior rank-calibrated detector for aligned multi-stream telemetry: same-regime rolling median/MAD residuals feed three window channels -- a maximum normalized local sum, a Gaussian copula-form dependence contrast on robust-z residuals, and a worst standardized AR(1) innovation -- whose channel ranks are Fisher-aggregated and ranked against earlier aggregates. We evaluate six Great Britain grid streams with a January-April 2019 fit, July-December 2019 development evidence, and a 2020 hold-out frozen before inspection. TRACE-C ranks Storm Atiyah first among 2019 test windows, but a disclosed channel ablation attributes that rank to the local channel, not the copula-form channel: copula-only ranks Atiyah 59th. The short 9 August frequency event is ranked far lower by the fused detector (143) than by the temporal channel alone (40), and reconstruction baselines rank it first. In 2020 no window is selected, which is consistent with record-rule saturation rather than an uneventful year; the highest-ranked frozen window was later interpreted as Storm Ellen. Three interpretive limits carry throughout. The resulting p-values are selection quantities, not event probabilities. The copula-form channel is not a literal copula density: the method applies no probability-integral or normal-score transform. Empirical rank counts are diagnostics, not coverage or false-discovery proofs. Every table and figure in this paper is generated from committed machine-readable reports.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE-C 是一种可审计、严格先验的秩校准异常检测器，用于对齐的多流运行遥测数据。它用同区间滚动中位数/MAD 残差构造三个窗口通道（最大归一化局部和、基于鲁棒 z 残差的高斯 copula 形依赖对比、最差标准化 AR(1) 创新），将通道秩经 Fisher 聚合后与早期聚合值排序。在英国电网 2019-2020 数据上，融合检测器将 Storm Atiyah 排在首位，但通道消融显示该排名来自局部通道；2020 年无窗口被选中，作者将其归因于纪录规则饱和而非无事件年份。
Motivation: 多个单独流各自在正常范围内时，整体运行遥测仍可能联合异常，现有逐流检测难以捕捉这种交叉流异常；作者需要一种可审计且能给出明确排序的检测方案。
Method: 提出严格先验的秩校准检测器：对同区间滚动中位数/MAD 残差计算三类通道统计量，包括最大归一化局部和、对鲁棒 z 残差的高斯 copula 形依赖对比，以及最差标准化 AR(1) 创新；通道秩经 Fisher 聚合后与更早的聚合值排序，并公开披露通道消融与生成每张表和图的机器可读报告。
Result: 在英国电网六个流上，2019 年 1-4 月拟合、7-12 月开发、2020 年冻结留出；融合检测器将 Storm Atiyah 排在 2019 年测试窗口第一位，但 copula 形通道单独只将其排到第 59 位；短时 9 月频率事件的融合排名（143）远低于时间通道单独排名（40），而重建基线将其排在首位；2020 年没有窗口被选中。
Conclusion: 摘要明确三条解释性限制：所得 p 值是选择量而非事件概率；copula 形通道不是字面意义上的 copula 密度，未使用概率积分或正态得分变换；经验秩计数是诊断量而非覆盖率或错误发现率的证明。

papers.title: Just Noticeable Difference Modeling for Token Compression in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Token compression has become a key technique for reducing the inference cost of large foundation models, with approaches such as token pruning and KV-cache reuse widely adopted in vision-language models and recently explored for embodied agents. In embodied agents, tokens not only support perception and semantic understanding but also directly affect latency-sensitive closed-loop robot action prediction. Existing schemes typically guide compression using redundancy or importance cues, such as visual similarity, attention scores, and saliency. However, these cues only indirectly measure the key factor for safe compression: how much a token can change before causing an unacceptable deviation in downstream actions. This receiver-dependent tolerance is closely related to the principle of just noticeable difference (JND). Classical JND characterizes signal tolerance in the human visual system, while machine-oriented JND extends this concept to downstream machine responses. Building on this progression, we introduce Action-JND, which extends JND modeling to embodied perception by defining noticeability through the language-conditioned action response of a vision-language-action (VLA) policy in closed-loop control. A token change is considered admissible only when the induced action deviation remains within a tolerated margin. To realize this concept, we develop a lightweight token-wise JND estimator in deep visual-feature space to predict the maximum tolerable perturbation while preserving policy responses. The resulting action-tolerance score serves as a plug-and-play criterion for VLA compression paradigms, including stale-KV reuse and token pruning, prioritizing action-tolerant tokens for compression. Experiments on the LIBERO benchmark with OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT demonstrate that Action-JND consistently improves compression reliability, especially under aggressive compression ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Action-JND，将经典恰好可察觉差异 (JND) 概念从人类视觉系统推广到具身感知，用视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略的语言条件动作响应来定义 token 的可压缩容忍度。作者训练一个轻量逐 token JND 估计器，在深度视觉特征空间中预测保持策略响应不变的最大可容忍扰动，并将所得动作容忍度分数作为即插即用的压缩判据，应用于 stale-KV 复用和 token 剪枝。在 LIBERO 基准上基于 OpenVLA 和 OpenVLA-OFT 的实验表明，Action-JND 能持续提升压缩可靠性，尤其在高压缩比场景下。
Motivation: 现有 token 压缩方法通常以冗余或重要性线索（如视觉相似度、注意力分数、显著性）指导压缩，但这些线索只是间接衡量安全压缩的关键因素，即 token 改变多少才会导致下游动作出现不可接受偏差。该接收者相关的容忍度缺失使得压缩容易损害闭环机器人动作预测的可靠性。
Method: 沿人类视觉 JND 到机器导向 JND 的路线，提出 Action-JND：通过闭环控制中 VLA 策略的语言条件动作响应定义 noticeability，只有动作偏差保持在容忍范围内的 token 变化才被认为可接受。为此在深度视觉特征空间训练轻量逐 token JND 估计器，输出最大可容忍扰动，得到动作容忍度分数并作为即插即用判据用于 stale-KV 复用和 token 剪枝。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上结合 OpenVLA 与 OpenVLA-OFT 的实验显示，Action-JND 一致地改善压缩可靠性，尤其在激进压缩比下增益更明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 token 压缩的指导应基于接收者依赖的动作容忍度（即 VLA 动作响应定义的可容忍扰动）而非单纯的视觉冗余或重要性线索，该准则可直接嵌入现有 VLA 压缩范式。

papers.title: A VLM Answer Is Not an Anomaly Score: Rank Compression in Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models enable training-free video anomaly detection by answering questions about video segments. VAD benchmarks, however, require a scalar anomaly score for each segment and evaluate the resulting ranking using the AUROC or AP. A VLM-based detector should therefore define an answer interface: the answer scale specifies the admissible answers, and the readout rule maps the model's output distribution to a score. Because this interface can change the evaluated ranking, it is part of the detector rather than a formatting detail. The generated readout uses only the most likely answer, whereas the probability readout uses the full distribution over admissible answers. Across four 7-8B VLMs, the probability readout outperforms the generated readout for every tested combination of answer scale, benchmark, and metric, with average gains ranging from 5 to 13 points across the four benchmark-metric pairs. The gap arises because the generated readout keeps only one answer value per segment, so segment with different answer distributions can receive the same score and lose their relative order. We call this loss of relative order generated-answer rank compression. Even when the answer scale allows 91 answers, the generated readout produces only 4-18 distinct scores, whereas the probability readout retains substantially finer score resolution. The advantage persists under every decoding strategy, prompt wording, and joint scoring-explanation prompt we test. The answer interface is therefore a consequential component of VLM-based VAD and should be explicitly specified and evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究免训练视频异常检测（VAD）中视觉语言模型（VLM）的答案接口设计，指出生成的文本答案与标量异常分数之间的映射方式会影响最终排序。作者将答案接口划分为答案尺度（answer scale）和读取规则（readout rule），并在四种 7-8B VLM 上比较生成式读取与概率式读取，发现概率式读取在所有测试组合上均更优。
Motivation: VLM 用于免训练视频异常检测时，基准需要逐段标量异常分数，但现有工作未将 VLM 的答案接口视为检测器的一部分；不同读取规则会改变排序，进而影响 AUROC/AP 评估结果。
Method: 将答案接口定义为答案尺度与读取规则的组合：生成式读取只用最可能答案的分数，概率式读取使用整个可接受答案分布。在四种 7-8B VLM 上系统比较两种读取规则，并测试解码策略、提示措辞和联合评分-解释提示。
Result: 概率式读取在所有答案尺度、基准和指标组合上均优于生成式读取，平均提升 5 到 13 个点；生成式读取即使允许 91 个答案也仅产生 4-18 个不同分数，而概率式读取保留更细的分数分辨率。
Conclusion: 答案接口是 VLM 视频异常检测器的关键组成部分，应被明确指定和评估；生成式读取的 rank compression 会导致排序信息丢失。

papers.title: Adapting Knowledge Graphs for Behavior Denoising in Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Sequential recommendation predicts the next item from a user's interaction history, but not every interaction is equally informative. Real logs combine persistent preferences with temporary needs, exploration, and incidental behavior, so some interactions can distort history representations or provide unreliable supervision. Existing denoising methods judge such interactions mainly from co-occurrence, order, or model predictions, without explicit evidence from relations between items. Knowledge graphs (KGs) offer this evidence, but item popularity, graph degree, uneven coverage, and widely shared entities can inflate connectivity and bias reliability estimates. Here we present AdaptedKG, which derives calibrated KG evidence for each training example without adding graph representations to the recommendation model. It first compares the observed context with structurally matched alternatives to identify relational paths that are unusually prominent and uses them to build a local KG view. It then compares each interaction with structurally matched reference items to calibrate its support within that view. The resulting retention coefficients gate historical representations and reweight target losses. All sample-specific scores are computed offline using training interactions and a fixed KG, so the backbone remains unchanged and no KG access is required at inference. Experiments show gains with a standard sequential recommender and multiple behavior-denoising sequential recommenders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaptedKG，一种为序列推荐中的行为去噪 (behavior denoising) 从知识图谱 (KG) 提取校准证据的方法。它对每条训练样本离线构建局部 KG 视图，用结构匹配的参考项估计保留系数 (retention coefficients) 来门控历史表示并重加权目标损失，不改动主干模型，推理时不需 KG。实验显示在标准序列推荐器和多个行为去噪序列推荐器上均有提升。
Motivation: 真实交互日志混杂持久偏好与临时需求、探索等噪声，现有去噪方法主要依赖共现、顺序或模型预测，缺少物品间关系的显式证据；KG 虽能提供证据，但物品流行度、图度数不均衡和共享实体等会膨胀连通性并偏置可靠性估计。
Method: AdaptedKG 先比较观测上下文与结构匹配的替代项，找出异常突出的关系路径并构建局部 KG 视图；再将每个交互与结构匹配的参考项比较，在该视图内校准其支持度。得到的保留系数用于门控历史表示和重加权目标损失，样本级分数全部离线计算，推理阶段无需 KG。
Result: 实验表明，在标准序列推荐器和多个行为去噪序列推荐器上均取得性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AdaptedKG 无需向推荐模型加入图表示即可获得校准的 KG 证据，保持骨干不变并在推理时免于 KG 访问，是一种轻量且通用的去噪增强方式。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: AdaptedKG 先比较观测上下文与结构匹配的替代项，找出异常突出的关系路径并构建局部 KG 视图；再将每个交互与结构匹配的参考项比较，在该视图内校准其支持度。得到的保留系数用于门控历史表示和重加权目标损失，样本级分数全部离线计算，推理阶段无需 KG。
summary_sections.result: 实验表明，在标准序列推荐器和多个行为去噪序列推荐器上均取得性能提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 AdaptedKG 无需向推荐模型加入图表示即可获得校准的 KG 证据，保持骨干不变并在推理时免于 KG 访问，是一种轻量且通用的去噪增强方式。

papers.title: Advanced Linear Algebra with Applications - Part I (Numerical linear algebra for PDEs, machine learning, and data assimilation)
papers.abstract_en: These lecture notes form the first part of a master's-level course on advanced numerical linear algebra. Their aim is not only to present the classical algorithms, but to show why the subject has become considerably more central than it was a generation ago. Numerical linear algebra grew up alongside the numerical solution of partial differential equations, and for a long time that is where its large sparse systems came from. Ranking the nodes of a network, assimilating observations into a weather forecast, and fitting a model to a large noisy data set now lead to problems of the same kind: too large to factorise, structured, and accessible only through matrix-vector products. Strikingly few ideas are needed for all of them. Each chapter therefore develops a standard topic and then puts it to work outside its original setting. We treat norms, factorisations, conditioning and floating-point arithmetic; sparse matrices arising from finite differences, from graphs and from machine learning; stationary iterations and the smoothing property; the conjugate gradient and Lanczos methods, with spectral clustering and regularisation by early stopping; Arnoldi and GMRES, with PageRank and large least squares; and finally preconditioning, Schwarz domain decomposition and multigrid. We assume a first course in linear algebra. Every section closes with a summary of what should be retained and every chapter with exercises, several drawn from past examinations. Accompanying Python code reproduces the numerical illustrations.
papers.comment: 101 pages, 24 figures. Lecture notes; Part I of a two-part master's course. Generative AI (Claude Opus 5, Anthropic) was used to help identify seminal references, improve the language, and improve the graphical content; all statements, proofs, and references have been checked by the authors, who take full responsibility for the contents. Code: https://github.com/vicdolean/scicomp_examples
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是硕士课程《高等数值线性代数》第一部分讲义，覆盖范数、矩阵分解、条件数与浮点运算，以及由有限差分、图与机器学习产生的稀疏矩阵；随后介绍平稳迭代、共轭梯度与 Lanczos 方法、Arnoldi 与 GMRES，以及预处理、Schwarz 区域分解和多重网格。作者的核心观点是：网络排序、天气数据同化和大规模含噪数据拟合等问题与经典 PDE 问题同构，都太大而无法直接分解、具有结构且只能通过矩阵-向量积访问，因此少数核心思想即可统一处理。讲义假定读者学过第一门线性代数课，每节有应掌握的小结，每章配有习题（含往届考题），并附带可复现数值插图的 Python 代码。
Motivation: 作者指出，数值线性代数最初伴随 PDE 数值解而发展，但如今网络节点排序、气象预报中的数据同化（data assimilation）以及大规模含噪数据拟合产生了同类问题：规模太大无法分解、具有结构且只能通过矩阵-向量积访问。讲义旨在不仅呈现经典算法，还说明为什么该学科比上一代人时期更加核心。
Method: 该讲义按章展开标准主题，并将每个主题应用到其原初领域之外：内容包括范数、分解、条件数与浮点算术；来自有限差分、图和机器学习的稀疏矩阵；平稳迭代与光滑性；共轭梯度和 Lanczos 方法（含谱聚类和早停正则化）；Arnoldi 和 GMRES（含 PageRank 与大规模最小二乘）；以及预处理、Schwarz 区域分解和多重网格。每章结尾给出应保留内容的总结与习题，并配有 Python 代码。
Result: 作为讲义，本文未报告数值实验结果；其产物是教学材料，包括每节小结、每章习题（部分来自历年考试）以及用于重现数值插图的 Python 代码。
Conclusion: 讲义强调只需很少的核心思想即可统一处理 PDE、机器学习和数据同化中的大规模线性代数问题，并以数据同化（如将观测同化进天气预报）作为典型应用之一。本部分为两部分硕士课程的第一部分；作者说明使用了生成式 AI 辅助查找文献、改进语言和图形，但所有陈述、证明和参考文献均已人工核对。
Relevance: 70

papers.title: Fine-Grain GPU Parallelization of the Generalized Partition Crossover for Large-Scale Traveling Salesman Problems
papers.abstract_en: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) is one of the most extensively studied NP-hard optimization problems. Genetic Algorithm (GA)-based solvers, such as the Edge Assembly Crossover (EAX), achieve state-of-the-art performance on many benchmark instances. However, the scalability of these approaches in massively parallel architectures remains limited because crossover operations involve irregular memory access patterns, graph traversals, and sequential dependencies. Existing GPU-based TSP solvers primarily exploit population-level parallelism and are limited to relatively small problem sizes. This work presents a fine-grain GPU implementation of the partition phase of the Generalized Partition Crossover (GPX) operator for large-scale TSP instances. The proposed approach reformulates GPX partitioning as a graph-parallel problem using coalesced memory layouts, ghost-node transformations, and connected-component analysis. The im- plementation parallelizes the union of parent tours, the splitting of degree- four vertices, the deletion of common edges, and the identification of recombining components using CUDA. Experimental results on instances ranging from 10,000 to 2 million cities demonstrate substantial acceleration over a naive sequential CPU imple- mentation. The proposed GPU partitioning achieves speedups between 48x and 625x while significantly reducing memory overhead. The re- sults demonstrate that operator-level parallelism can substantially im- prove the scalability of GA-based TSP solvers on modern many-core architectures.
papers.comment: accepted to NiHPC, PPSN 2026. Draft in preparation for a journal article
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对大规模旅行商问题 (TSP) 的广义分区交叉 (GPX) 算子中 partition 阶段的细粒度 GPU 实现。作者将 GPX 分区重新表述为图并行问题，采用合并内存布局 (coalesced memory layouts)、ghost-node 变换和连通分量分析，并用 CUDA 并行化父环合并、四度顶点分裂、公共边删除及重组分量识别。在 10,000 到 200 万城市规模的实例上，相对朴素顺序 CPU 实现获得 48x 到 625x 的加速，同时显著降低内存开销。
Motivation: 基于遗传算法 (GA) 的 TSP 求解器（如 EAX）在众多基准上达到先进性能，但交叉操作涉及不规则内存访问、图遍历和顺序依赖，使其在大规模并行架构上的可扩展性受限；现有 GPU TSP 求解器主要利用种群级并行，且只能处理较小规模问题。
Method: 将 GPX 的 partition 阶段构建为图并行问题，使用合并内存布局、ghost-node 变换和连通分量分析；在 CUDA 上并行执行父环并集、度数为四的顶点分裂、公共边删除以及重组分量的识别。
Result: 在 10,000 到 2,000,000 个城市的实例上，与朴素顺序 CPU 实现相比，所提出的 GPU 分区获得 48x 到 625x 的加速比，并显著减少内存开销。
Conclusion: 结果表明算子级并行 (operator-level parallelism) 能大幅提升基于 GA 的 TSP 求解器在现代众核架构上的可扩展性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5% of trigger-word-laden benign text rejects 0 of 360 poisoned memories. We argue this exposes a boundary of content-only screening: distinguishing a false assertion from a true one generally requires external grounding beyond the text itself. We then evaluate provenance-weighted retrieval. The shipped weight is statistically indistinguishable from no defense (p=0.80), while a stronger weight recovers utility only by excluding untrusted content. In a mixed-provenance corpus where untrusted content is mostly benign, accuracy rises from 0.3167 to 0.7000; when the answer-bearing evidence itself arrives untrusted, evidence recall falls to zero and accuracy to 0.0417. Under the measured similarity regime, the additive provenance term has no usable setting: a weight strong enough to resist query-shaped poison is also strong enough to suppress legitimate untrusted evidence. We therefore argue for bounded occupancy constraints at retrieval rather than additive provenance penalties, and release the harnesses, corpora, and aggregate run reports.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 AI 智能体持久化记忆被投毒的问题：单次注入的直白假陈述一旦写入记忆，会在后续会话中被检索并持续影响输出。在 LongMemEval 语料中投毒 1.2% 的条目使准确率从 0.850 跌至 0.300。作者测试了写入端内容筛查与溯源加权检索两类防御，发现内容筛查无法拦截任何投毒记忆（0/360），而加性溯源惩罚在混合来源场景下没有可用的权重设置。
Motivation: 持久记忆使虚假信息具有持久性：错误陈述存储后可在未来会话中被检索到。仅基于文本本身的内容筛查无法区分真假陈述，通常需要文本之外的外部依据（external grounding）。
Method: 作者在不做任何指令、触发器或检索器优化的情况下，用单遍生成的直白假陈述投毒 LongMemEval 的 1.2% 语料；构建了一个四阶段写入端筛查流水线（对间接提示注入的召回率为 0.832，对含触发器词的良性文本误报率 1.5%）；并评估了溯源加权检索的不同权重设置以及混合来源语料。
Result: 投毒使准确率从 0.850 降至 0.300；筛查流水线拒收了 360 条投毒记忆中的 0 条。发布版溯源权重与无防御在统计上不可区分（p=0.80）。更强的权重仅在排除不可信内容时恢复效用：混合来源场景下准确率从 0.3167 升至 0.7000，但当承载答案的证据本身来自不可信来源时，证据召回降至 0，准确率降至 0.0417。
Conclusion: 在实测的相似度机制下，加性溯源项不存在可用设置：足以抵抗查询型投毒的权重也会压制合法的不可信证据。作者主张在检索层采用有界占用约束（bounded occupancy constraints）而非加性溯源惩罚，并公开了测试工具、语料与汇总运行报告。
Relevance: 5
