papers.title: Anchoring Instruction Outside Mask: Exact Reference Caching for Efficient In-Context Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Omnimodal generation is central to a wide range of content creation and editing applications. In-context conditioning is essential to this paradigm. It allows diffusion transformers to process text instructions and visual references in a shared attention sequence. However, each reference image introduces thousands of tokens. Computation therefore grows rapidly with the number of references. Existing methods reduce computation through structured sparse attention, which limits interactions between reference and target tokens. This structure also makes the reference K and V independent of the denoising target, allowing them to be computed once and reused across steps. However, it blocks visual references from attending to the text instruction. This substantially degrades instruction following and reference fidelity in multi-reference editing. To resolve this conflict, we jointly redesign the token sequence and attention mask. Our beyond-mask design uses static text anchors to connect the instruction to the reference branch. It preserves exact K and V reuse without adding parameters. However, this direct architectural conversion degrades generation quality. We recover the lost performance through teacher-forced velocity distillation, followed by a short on-policy stage in which the teacher supervises student-visited states. To our knowledge, this is the first use of on-policy distillation for architectural recovery in diffusion models. Across three image-editing benchmarks, our method matches full-attention generation quality. With five reference images, it accelerates the complete 40-step denoising process by 3.92x, while static text anchors introduce negligible runtime overhead; the speedup reaches 5.47x at ten references in our scaling study.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于上下文扩散Transformer的高效推理方法：通过联合重新设计token序列和注意力掩码，在掩码外使用静态文本锚点（static text anchors）将指令连接到参考分支，从而实现精确的K和V缓存复用而不增加参数。为弥补架构转换造成的质量下降，作者引入教师强制速度蒸馏（teacher-forced velocity distillation）及后续短on-policy阶段。在三个图像编辑基准上该方法匹配全注意力生成质量，5个参考图像下完整40步去噪加速3.92倍，10个参考时达5.47倍。
Motivation: 多参考图像会引入大量token，使计算量随参考数量快速增长；现有结构化稀疏注意力虽然允许复用参考KV，但阻碍了参考token对文本指令的注意，严重损害多参考编辑中的指令跟随与参考保真度。
Method: 联合重新设计token序列与注意力掩码，使用静态文本锚点将指令与参考分支连接起来，在不新增参数的前提下保留精确的K和V复用；随后通过教师强制速度蒸馏和一个短on-policy阶段（由教师监督学生访问的状态）来恢复因直接架构转换而下降的生成质量。
Result: 在三个图像编辑基准上，该方法匹配全注意力生成质量；5个参考图像下40步去噪过程加速3.92倍，静态文本锚点引入的运行时开销可忽略，缩放研究显示10个参考时速度提升达5.47倍。
Conclusion: 这是首次将on-policy蒸馏用于扩散模型的架构恢复；作者认为掩码外锚定结合蒸馏可在多参考图像编辑中接近全注意力质量，同时显著加速推理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Ontology-supported AI Model and Dataset Management
papers.abstract_en: Recently, there has been a great deal of research into improving AI methods and their application. The main focus is on tracking progress, enabling transparent comparisons, and fostering a more profound understanding of AI. In that process, different organizations generate and use plenty of assets that need to be tracked, traced and managed. Moreover, it is important to discover assets relevant for the task at hand. This paper presents research aiming to contribute to answering the question of what is required to exchange and manage AI models and related assets effectively without semantic gaps in an industrial context. We introduce a platform for AI model exchange, which facilitates the usage, exchange, and analysis of AI models and datasets. The platform incorporates an ontology that can foster a more profound common understanding of what is required in these tasks and help tackle the issues mentioned above. Finally, we elucidate the utility of the platform through the illustration of a use case in the context of real-time critical systems.

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向工业场景的 AI 模型与数据集交换管理平台，通过引入本体 (ontology) 来减少模型和资产交换中的语义鸿沟，并支持资产的追踪、管理与发现。摘要以实时关键系统 (real-time critical systems) 中的用例说明平台效用，未报告定量实验结果。
Motivation: 不同组织在 AI 研究与应用中产生大量需要追踪和管理的模型、数据集等资产，且需要能够发现与当前任务相关的资产；摘要认为工业场景中有效交换和管理这些资产存在语义鸿沟。
Method: 构建一个 AI 模型交换平台，支持 AI 模型与数据集的使用、交换和分析，并集成一个本体以建立对这些任务所需信息的共同理解。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量结果，仅通过一个实时关键系统场景的用例说明平台的实用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为本体支持的平台有助于在工业环境中无语义鸿沟地管理与交换 AI 模型及相关资产，但摘要未给出大规模验证或局限性讨论。

papers.title: Event-triggered Implicit Perturbation for Zeroth-Order Fine-Tuning of Spiking Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization estimates gradients using only forward-pass evaluations, making it suitable for fine-tuning non-differentiable, event-driven spiking neural networks (SNNs). However, its deployment on in-memory computing (IMC) accelerators is constrained by the repeated read-modify-write (RMW) operations arising from explicit weight perturbation and the prohibitive hardware footprint of random number generators (RNGs) for statistically independent per-weight perturbations. To address these challenges, we propose an implicit-perturbation ZO (IPZO) architecture in which perturbation sums computed by an event-triggered perturbation generation unit (PGU) are combined with the weighted sums produced by the IMC array, eliminating perturbation-induced RMW operations while preserving weight-stationary execution of IMC. By exploiting spike sparsity, the PGU generates and accumulates perturbation contributions only for spike-activated weight rows, reducing the required row dimension of the RNG array. An address-driven XOR recombination scheme (PGU-XOR) is further introduced to mitigate the spatial correlations caused by direct RNG reuse (PGU-Reuse). The results show that (1) PGU-XOR matches software RNGs in accuracy on Spikingformer/CIFAR-10 (76.41% vs. 76.53%) and perplexity (PPL) on SpikeGPT/WikiText-2 (54.20 vs. 53.23), whereas PGU-Reuse degrades accuracy by 9.56 percentage points and increases PPL by 11.8; (2) implemented in a TSMC 16-nm CMOS technology, PGU-XOR incurs 40.3%-46.0% area and 15.2%-48.9% energy overhead per matrix-vector multiplication relative to PGU-Reuse, yet its faster convergence reduces the total perturbation energy to 0.51x that of PGU-Reuse at iso-accuracy; (3) IPZO reduces the perturbation energy to 0.46x-0.83x that of conventional explicit weight perturbation for a batch size of B=64 and T=4 time steps, with the advantage growing as BT decreases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在存内计算（IMC）加速器上微调脉冲 Transformer 时零阶（ZO）优化所面临的硬件开销问题，提出了一种隐式扰动 ZO 架构 IPZO。该架构通过事件触发的扰动生成单元（PGU）将扰动和与 IMC 阵列的加权和合并，消除了显式权重扰动带来的读改写（RMW）操作，并利用脉冲稀疏性减少随机数生成器（RNG）阵列规模；进一步引入地址驱动的 XOR 重组方案（PGU-XOR）缓解直接复用 RNG 所造成的空间相关性。实验表明 PGU-XOR 在 Spikingformer/CIFAR-10 和 SpikeGPT/WikiText-2 上接近软件 RNG 精度，且相对显式权重扰动可将扰动能量降至 0.46x-0.83x。
Motivation: ZO 优化只需前向传播即可估计梯度，适合微调不可微的事件驱动 SNN，但其在 IMC 加速器上部署受限于显式权重扰动带来的重复 RMW 操作，以及为逐权重独立扰动生成统计独立随机数所需的不可接受的 RNG 硬件面积开销。
Method: 提出隐式扰动 ZO（IPZO）架构：由事件触发扰动生成单元（PGU）计算的扰动和与 IMC 阵列输出的加权和直接合并，从而避免扰动引起的 RMW 并保持 IMC 的权重固定（weight-stationary）执行；PGU 仅对脉冲激活的权重行生成并累加扰动，降低 RNG 阵列所需行维度；另提出地址驱动 XOR 重组方案（PGU-XOR）来缓解直接 RNG 复用（PGU-Reuse）导致的空间相关性。
Result: PGU-XOR 在 Spikingformer/CIFAR-10 上达到 76.41% 精度（软件 RNG 为 76.53%），在 SpikeGPT/WikiText-2 上困惑度（PPL）为 54.20（软件为 53.23），而 PGU-Reuse 精度下降 9.56 个百分点、PPL 增加 11.8；在 TSMC 16-nm CMOS 下，PGU-XOR 相对 PGU-Reuse 每次矩阵向量乘增加 40.3%-46.0% 面积和 15.2%-48.9% 能量开销，但更快收敛使其在等精度下总扰动能量仅为 PGU-Reuse 的 0.51 倍；在批大小 B=64、T=4 时间步下，IPZO 的扰动能量为传统显式权重扰动的 0.46x-0.83x，且优势随 BT 减小而增大。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 IPZO 结合 PGU-XOR 能在匹配软件 RNG 精度的同时显著降低扰动能量与硬件开销，其相对显式权重扰动的优势在较小的批大小与时间步乘积（BT）下更为明显。

papers.title: Enhancing LLMs in Predictive Political QA with Semi-Structured Data
papers.abstract_en: Predictive political question answering (QA), such as predicting how a political actor will vote, goes beyond factual lookup. External political resources offer rich historical evidence, but rarely contain the answer itself. Existing LLM augmentation methods, including actor-profile-based simulation and knowledge graph evidence injection, improve political reasoning but largely treat external resources as knowledge-based evidence, leaving prediction-relevant signals under-modeled. We identify two complementary signals for predictive political QA: actor stances that capture issue-specific preferences, and high-order structure signals that capture indirect dependencies among political actors. We propose PSL, a dual-view framework that converts semi-structured political records into inference-oriented evidence for LLMs. PSL extracts stance signals from question-relevant actor records in a semantic view, and learns structure-aware actor representations from an actor interaction graph in a vector view. Across three real-world datasets and multiple LLMs, PSL consistently outperforms baselines, with ablations confirming the complementary gains of stance and structure signals.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对预测性政治问答 (predictive political QA) 提出 PSL 双视角框架，将半结构化政治记录转化为面向推理的证据。PSL 从语义视角提取问题相关的行动者立场 (stance) 信号，并从向量视角在行动者交互图上学习结构感知表示。摘要报告其在三个真实数据集和多个 LLM 上一致优于基线，消融实验确认立场信号与结构信号的互补增益。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 增强方法（如基于行动者画像的模拟、知识图谱证据注入）多把外部政治资源当作知识型证据处理，忽视了其中蕴含的预测相关信号，导致政治推理能力受限。
Method: 提出 PSL 双视角框架：语义视图从与问题相关的半结构化行动者记录中提取立场信号；向量视图基于行动者交互图 (actor interaction graph) 学习结构感知的行动者表示，并将两类信号注入 LLM 作为推理证据。
Result: 在三个真实数据集和多个 LLM 上，PSL 一致优于基线方法；消融实验表明立场信号与结构信号能带来互补的增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为补充建模立场信号和高阶结构信号可以更充分地利用半结构化政治数据，从而增强 LLM 的预测性政治问答能力。

papers.title: Personalized Privacy Control in LLMs via Attention Head Intervention
papers.abstract_en: The rise of agentic AI enables LLMs to access diverse user data, raising critical privacy concerns. Prior work on contextual privacy studies whether LLMs regulate information disclosure according to context-dependent norms. However, acceptable disclosure boundaries may vary across users even within the same context. To address this limitation, we introduce \textit{personalized privacy}, which incorporates user-specific disclosure preferences into privacy control. We further present P3Bench~(\textbf{P}ersonalized \textbf{P}rivacy \textbf{P}reservation \textbf{Bench}mark), a novel benchmark extending contextual privacy policies with personalized disclosure policies. Experiments show that prompt-based policies fail to reliably enforce personalized privacy policies, with Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma3-4B showing average policy ignorance ratios of 51.25\% and 74.28\%, respectively. Finally, to address this problem, we propose \textsc{Repair}, a robust inference-time attention head intervention method that adjusts disclosure behavior toward policy-consistent responses. Our method significantly improves adherence to user-specific privacy preferences by reducing cases where the model fails to follow the given policy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出个性化隐私（personalized privacy），即在上下文隐私基础上引入用户特定的披露偏好，并构建 P3Bench 基准来评估 LLM 对个性化披露策略的遵循程度。实验发现基于提示词的策略不可靠，Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma3-4B 的平均策略忽视率分别达 51.25% 和 74.28%；为此作者提出 RepaiR，一种推理时的注意力头干预方法，能显著减少模型偏离给定策略的情况。
Motivation: 现有上下文隐私研究只考虑情境相关的披露规范，但即使在同一情境下，不同用户的披露边界也可能不同；Agentic AI 可访问多样用户数据，因此需要纳入用户特定偏好的隐私控制机制。
Method: 引入个性化隐私的概念，将用户特定的披露偏好加入隐私控制；构建 P3Bench 基准，把上下文隐私策略扩展为个性化披露策略；提出 RepaiR，一种推理时的注意力头干预（attention head intervention）方法，通过调整披露行为使模型输出与策略一致。
Result: 摘要报告，提示词策略无法可靠执行个性化隐私策略：Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma3-4B 的平均策略忽视率分别为 51.25% 和 74.28%；RepaiR 显著减少了模型不遵循用户隐私策略的案例。
Conclusion: 作者认为推理时的注意力头干预能有效提升 LLM 对用户特定隐私偏好的遵循，相关评估基于所提出的 P3Bench 基准。

papers.title: Specification Portability Across LLM Development Agents: Cross-Agent Compatibility in Specification-Driven Software Migration
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates cross-agent specification portability using Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration as a controlled software transformation task. The study combines two experimental stages. First, a specification-first migration pipeline was evaluated on 1,006 PL/SQL files, of which 623 were successfully regenerated and 380 generated scripts executed successfully in PostgreSQL 16. Second, cross-agent experiments were conducted on a dataset of 1,802 Oracle scripts with corresponding PostgreSQL implementations using Amazon Kiro, Google Gemini, and GitHub Copilot, with Claude Code and Cursor included in the initial single-agent evaluation. Native and foreign specifications were assessed using Token F1, exact match, SQL syntax validity, AST exact match, AST mean similarity, and immediate runnability. The results show that specification size alone does not predict implementation quality and that cross-agent transfer can produce substantial agent-dependent degradation. The strongest replicated case occurred when Gemini directly consumed a Kiro-origin specification, producing a Token F1 of 0.035, SQL syntax validity of 2.33%, and AST mean similarity of 0.015. Rewriting substantially improved Gemini in the tested configuration, compression did not provide a universal benefit, and retrieval-augmented ingestion was the only common strategy represented on the per-agent Pareto frontiers of both Gemini and Copilot. The findings suggest that specifications in heterogeneous SDD workflows should not automatically be treated as agent-neutral artifacts and motivate explicit consideration of specification portability, agent-specific interpretation, and retrieval-based access in multi-agent software engineering.

papers.title: Curriculum-Aware Interpolate-then-Refine: Learned Physiological Time-Series Imputation under Realistic Missingness
papers.abstract_en: Imputing physiological time series (arterial blood pressure, blood glucose, etc.) is essential for addressing the missingness that pervades clinical data. Yet modern imputation methods perform poorly in this domain: a recent benchmark found that simple linear interpolation outperformed every learned imputer on real-world clinical signals with realistic gaps. We show that this reflects two properties of physiological missingness that generic imputers ignore: gaps may occur when the signal is clinically extreme rather than typical, and gap lengths can easily span orders of magnitude. To this end, we introduce Curriculum-Aware Interpolate-then-Refine (CAIR), a two-stage framework for physiological time-series imputation. Our key motivation is to learn a coarse base curve and then repeatedly correct it toward physiological realism, rather than predict a gap in a single pass. Consequently, CAIR couples a bidirectional-GRU interpolator with a Transformer refiner that corrects its own estimate over three successive passes, trained jointly under a broad, signal-agnostic random-gap curriculum. We evaluate imputers stratified by gap length and missingness mechanism (MCAR, MAR, NMAR) rather than by a single average, and CAIR is the most accurate under every mechanism on continuous glucose monitoring (AI-READI) and arterial pressure in intensive care (MIMIC-III). Its margin over the strongest baseline grows with difficulty, from 9% under MCAR to 19% under value-dependent dropout, where generic learned imputers are weakest. We further show low reconstruction error alone does not recover the burden metrics clinicians act on: interpolants matching CAIR's error fail to preserve those metrics, imputers that recover them are far less accurate, and CAIR alone ranks among the best on both axes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生理时间序列（如动脉血压、血糖）的缺失值填补问题，指出现有学习方法在真实临床缺失模式下甚至不如简单线性插值。作者提出 Curriculum-Aware Interpolate-then-Refine (CAIR) 两阶段框架：用双向 GRU 插值器生成粗略基曲线，再用 Transformer 精炼器在三轮迭代中逐步修正，并通过与信号无关的随机缺失课程 (random-gap curriculum) 联合训练。在 AI-READI 连续血糖监测和 MIMIC-III 重症动脉血压数据上，按缺失长度和缺失机制分层评估，CAIR 在所有机制下均最准确，且相对最强基线的优势随难度从 MCAR 下的 9% 增至值依赖缺失下的 19%。
Motivation: 通用填补器在真实临床信号上表现差，原因是生理缺失的两个特性被忽略：缺失可能发生在信号处于临床极端值而非典型值时，且缺失长度可能跨越多个数量级。这使得现有学习式方法难以超过简单线性插值。
Method: 提出 CAIR，两阶段填补框架：先由双向 GRU 插值器学习一条粗略基曲线，再由 Transformer 精炼器对自身估计进行三轮连续修正；两者在统一的信号无关随机缺失课程下联合训练，目标是从粗到细逐步逼近生理真实信号。
Result: 在连续血糖监测 (AI-READI) 和重症监护动脉血压 (MIMIC-III) 上，按缺失长度与缺失机制 (MCAR、MAR、NMAR) 分层评估，CAIR 在每种机制下均取得最高精度；相对最强基线的优势从 MCAR 下的 9% 扩大到值依赖缺失下的 19%。进一步实验显示，重建误差接近 CAIR 的朴素插值无法保留临床负担指标，而能恢复该指标的填补器精度明显更差，只有 CAIR 在两个维度上都处于最佳之列。
Conclusion: 作者强调仅追求低重建误差不足以恢复临床决策所依赖的负担指标 (burden metrics)；CAIR 通过粗插值再循环修正的方式，在填补精度与临床指标保真之间取得平衡。

papers.title: No PUN Intended: Plausible Unknown Names for Person-Centred LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Person names are widely used as prompt variables in LLM evaluations of factuality, privacy leakage, bias and abstention, but when a name's evidential status is uncontrolled, measurements may conflate memorisation, retrieval, name priors and wrong-person attribution. We operationalise an unknown name as one with plausible First-Last form, no indexed full-name evidence, and no ambiguity signals under a documented validation run, and introduce PUN (Plausible Unknown Names), a protocol for constructing and validating such names, combining Wikidata-derived components, web-enabled LLM screening, and controlled search revalidation. We report acceptance rate, reproducibility, ablations, and a 204-participant human study, finding accepted names are more name-like than controls while participants recover person evidence in only 3% of cases. We release 300 names with comparison controls.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 评估中把人名作为 prompt 变量时证据状态不受控的问题，提出 PUN (Plausible Unknown Names) 协议，用于构造并验证“看似合理但实为未知”的人名：要求具有合理的 First-Last 形式、无索引到的全名证据、且在文档化的验证流程下无歧义信号。作者报告了接受率、可复现性、消融实验以及 204 名参与者的人类研究，发现被接受的名字比对照更“像名字”，而参与者仅有 3% 的情况能恢复人名对应的人物证据，并发布 300 个名字及对照样本。
Motivation: 人名常被用作 LLM 在事实性、隐私泄露、偏差和拒绝回答等评估中的提示变量，但如果名字的证据状态未受控制，测量结果可能混淆记忆、检索、名字先验 (name priors) 与错误人物归因。
Method: 提出 PUN 协议，将未知名字操作化为具备合理 First-Last 形式、无索引全名证据且在文档化验证运行下无歧义信号的名字；构造流程结合 Wikidata 组件、支持网络的 LLM 筛查 (web-enabled LLM screening) 和受控搜索再验证 (controlled search revalidation)。
Result: 摘要报告了接受率、可复现性、消融实验和 204 人的人类研究结果：被接受的名字比对照更接近真实名字形态，而参与者仅在 3% 的情况下能恢复出人物证据；论文同时发布 300 个名字及对比对照。
Conclusion: PUN 协议为以人为中心的 LLM 评估提供了一种可复现地构造和验证未知人名的途径，有助于控制名字先验并避免错误人物归因，适用于事实性、隐私、偏差和拒绝行为等评估场景。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Beyond Imitation: Self-Improving Robot Policies via Off-Policy Q-Planning
papers.abstract_en: Behaviour Cloning (BC) has driven remarkable progress in robot manipulation, yet it is fundamentally limited by its inability to self-improve: a policy that fails cannot learn from that failure without additional human demonstrations. Reinforcement Learning fine-tuning offers a path to self-improvement but has proven difficult to scale to the multi-billion-parameter models underpinning modern robot policies. We propose Q-Planning, which equips a large visuomotor BC policy with a small off-policy Q-function. Because a Q-function estimates value rather than imitates actions, it can be trained on the same successful demonstrations as the BC policy and later absorb both successful and failed deployment rollouts, an asymmetry BC does not have. We exploit this asymmetry to enable value-guided action selection at inference (a single-step Q-weighted average over BC draws) and online self-improvement that fine-tunes only the Q-function, leaving the BC weights untouched. On LIBERO and bimanual RoboTwin, ten iterations of self-improvement lift every benchmark score we tested (LIBERO-10 93% to 99%, RoboTwin 83.8% to 91.4%) and shorten successful episodes on the near-ceiling suites (LIBERO-Object, LIBERO-Goal). On two contact-rich bimanual real-robot tasks, the same loop (BC frozen, no human intervention) improves purely from its own deployment rollouts: stack-cups 40% to 90% and insert-wallet 25% to 80% in five iterations, whereas SFT on successful rollouts alone stalls at 55% and 30%. Under an identical online budget Q-Planning is the only method, among Best-of-N, filtered SFT, IBRL, DSRL, and DAWR, that improves stably from failures without training an auxiliary actor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-Planning，为大规模视觉运动 BC 策略配备一个小型 off-policy Q 函数，使策略能够在推理时进行值引导的动作选择，并在不更新 BC 权重的前提下实现在线自改进。摘要报告在 LIBERO、双臂 RoboTwin 以及两个真实机器人接触丰富任务上，多轮自改进显著提升成功率，且是所比较方法中唯一无需训练辅助 actor 就能稳定从失败中改进的方法。
Motivation: 行为克隆 (BC) 无法自我改进：策略失败后只能依赖额外的人类示教才能学习，而强化学习微调难以扩展到现代机器人策略中的十亿级参数模型。
Method: 利用 Q 函数估计价值而非模仿动作这一不对称性：Q 函数可用与 BC 相同的成功示教训练，随后吸收成功与失败的部署轨迹；推理时对多次 BC 采样做单步 Q 加权平均，在线自改进阶段仅微调 Q 函数。
Result: 十轮自改进将 LIBERO-10 从 93% 提升到 99%、RoboTwin 从 83.8% 提升到 91.4%；真实机器人任务 stack-cups 从 40% 到 90%、insert-wallet 从 25% 到 80%（五轮），而仅用成功轨迹的 SFT 分别停滞在 55% 和 30%。在相同在线预算下，Q-Planning 是 Best-of-N、filtered SFT、IBRL、DSRL、DAWR 中唯一稳定从失败中改进且无需辅助 actor 的方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调，价值函数与策略之间的不对称性可以用来实现无需人工干预、无需训练辅助 actor 的稳定自改进；Q-Planning 在冻结 BC 权重的条件下仅依靠自身部署轨迹改进。

papers.title: SENTRY: Deterministic, Intelligent Risk Assessment for IT Change Management
papers.abstract_en: Technology change management in large financial institutions depends on risk assessments that are accurate, consistent, and auditable. In practice, many institutions still rely on self-reported questionnaires. Those questionnaires are subjective, easy to game, and poor at separating routine changes from the ones that later trigger major incidents. This paper presents SENTRY, a risk assessment platform that replaces questionnaire-based scoring with a deterministic machine learning pipeline built from gradient-boosted decision trees (XGBoost) and hybrid retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The system combines structured operational metadata, application dependency graphs, and historical incident records with a hybrid semantic and lexical search over historical change requests. The retrieval step captures the risk signal in unstructured change request text, then compresses that signal into a single scalar feature before model inference. That design keeps the model deterministic and preserves per-prediction explainability via SHAP values. Evaluated on enterprise-scale change data, SENTRY achieves a ROC AUC of 0.87 and 85% overall accuracy, and it detects high-risk changes at roughly 3.25 times the rate of the existing process. We close by examining the architectural trade-offs behind this design and what they imply for the use of machine learning in regulated change management.

papers.title: Tydra: An Efficient Hybrid Model for Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based tabular foundation models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur quadratic computational cost with context length. On the other hand, subquadratic SSM-based alternatives such as Hydra trade away accuracy for efficiency. To balance both, we introduce Tydra, a hybrid Transformer-State Space Model (SSM) architecture for tabular in-context learning that interleaves attention and SSM layers. Across 30 OpenML datasets, Tydra reduces inference time by 30% relative to TabPFN while retaining much of its predictive performance. Tydra also outperforms an approximately ten-times-larger Hydra model while providing faster inference. The results indicate that hybrid architectures are a promising direction for tabular foundation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tydra，一种用于表格数据上下文学习（in-context learning）的混合 Transformer-状态空间模型（SSM）架构，通过交替堆叠注意力层与 SSM 层来平衡预测性能与计算效率。在 30 个 OpenML 数据集上，Tydra 相对 TabPFN 推理时间减少 30% 且保持大部分预测性能，并优于约为其十倍大小的 Hydra 模型。作者认为混合架构是表格基础模型的一个有前景方向。
Motivation: Transformer 表格基础模型（如 TabPFN）预测性能强但计算成本随上下文长度二次增长，而亚二次 SSM 替代方案（如 Hydra）以降低精度换取效率，需要在二者之间取得平衡。
Method: 提出 Tydra，一种混合 Transformer-SSM 架构，在表格数据上下文学习中交错使用注意力层和 SSM 层，以结合注意力机制的性能优势与 SSM 的亚二次效率。
Result: 在 30 个 OpenML 数据集上，Tydra 较 TabPFN 将推理时间降低 30% 并保留大部分预测性能；同时以更快的推理速度胜过约大十倍的 Hydra 模型。
Conclusion: 摘要表明混合架构是表格基础模型的有前景方向，可以在保持预测能力的同时显著提升推理效率。

papers.title: ES-VP : Energy-Shaped Dynamic Visual Prompting for Efficient Model Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Visual prompting (VP) has emerged as a parameter-efficient method for adapting pre-trained models to downstream tasks. However, existing approaches encounter a trade-off between flexibility and efficiency. Some methods apply a fixed prompt to all images, ignoring individual image characteristics, while others introduce auxiliary networks to generate diverse prompts. Although the latter can improve performance, it also significantly increases parameter usage and the potential for overfitting to specific datasets. Furthermore, the auxiliary networks, combined with inherent biases in pre-trained models, limit scalability and generalization. In this paper, we propose Energy-Shaped Visual Prompting (ES-VP), a novel approach that generates image-specific prompts using low-rank initialization and energy-guided dynamic adaptation, achieving superior performance with fewer parameters compared to single-prompt methods. ES-VP directly utilizes the pre-trained model for adaptive prompt generation, ensuring both parameter efficiency and improved generalization. Extensive experiments conducted on five architectures across fifteen datasets demonstrate that ES-VP consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art (SOTA) single and diverse VP methods. For instance, using the CLIP architecture across four datasets, ES-VP outperforms the SOTA method DAM-VP by an average of 2.6\% in accuracy while utilizing 590$\times$ fewer VP parameters, thereby establishing a new benchmark for efficient and generalizable model adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出能量形状视觉提示（Energy-Shaped Visual Prompting, ES-VP），一种参数高效的视觉提示方法，通过低秩初始化和能量引导的动态适应来生成图像特定提示，无需额外辅助网络。在五个架构、十五个数据集上的实验表明，ES-VP以远少于单提示方法的参数，一致优于现有的单提示和多样视觉提示（VP）方法。例如在CLIP架构的四个数据集上，ES-VP相比SOTA方法DAM-VP平均准确率提升2.6%，同时VP参数减少590倍。
Motivation: 现有视觉提示方法在灵活性和效率之间存在权衡：固定提示忽略图像个体特征，而辅助网络生成多样提示虽提升性能但显著增加参数并存在过拟合风险，且可扩展性和泛化受限。
Method: ES-VP使用低秩初始化（low-rank initialization）和能量引导的动态适应（energy-guided dynamic adaptation）生成图像特定提示，并直接利用预训练模型本身进行自适应提示生成，从而保证参数效率并改善泛化。
Result: 在五个架构、十五个数据集上的实验显示，ES-VP一致优于当前SOTA的单提示和多样VP方法；在CLIP架构的四个数据集上，相比SOTA方法DAM-VP平均准确率提升2.6%，同时VP参数减少590倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ES-VP在参数效率和泛化性上建立了新的基准，为高效且可泛化的模型适应提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Investigating Residual Hearing Loss: Quantification of Fibrosis in a Novel Cochlear OCT Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Cochlear implants (CIs) are bionic prostheses that restores hearing via electrical stimulation of the auditory nerve. Hybrid CIs, which use electroacoustic stimulation (EAS), combine residual low-frequency acoustic hearing with CI electrical stimulation. Intracochlear fibrosis, which forms in response to the presence of the implant, may impede residual hearing function and gradually reduce the efficacy of EAS. It is therefore a translational objective to study the formation of cochlear fibrosis in rodents, with the goal of reducing fibrotic burden and improving outcomes for CI patients. Methods: We generate and annotate a novel dataset of optical coherence tomography (OCT) images from chronically implanted guinea pigs as part of an ongoing study focused on implant induced fibrosis. Objectively assessing fibrotic burden in this model, with high resolution and repeatability, presents an obvious use case for computer vision methods. Results: We present the results of several state-of-the-art semantic segmentation models and compare their efficacy for identifying cochlear fibrosis and other relevant annotations, using a new library of manually segmented OCT images. Conclusions: We find that the best performance is achieved by using a modified version of the well-known UNET architecture (which we term 2D-OCT-UNET) that operates on the upscaled OCT input resolution. Significance: For the first time, we have successfully applied computer vision techniques to an OCT dataset of implanted cochleae with fibrosis. Using this deep learning model, the cochlear fibrotic burden calculation can be reliably carried out as we verify in our experimental section. The dataset and the project code are available at: https://github.com/juliadietlmeier/CF-OCT-segmentation

TL;DR: 本文构建并标注了一个来自慢性植入豚鼠耳蜗的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像数据集，目标是用计算机视觉方法客观量化植入物诱导的耳蜗纤维化（intracochlear fibrosis）。作者比较了多个语义分割模型，发现一种改进的 UNET 架构（称为 2D-OCT-UNET）在放大后的 OCT 输入分辨率上表现最佳。这是首次将计算机视觉技术用于带纤维化的植入耳蜗 OCT 数据集，并验证了基于该深度学习模型的纤维化负担计算的可靠性。
Motivation: 混合人工耳蜗（hybrid CI）依赖电声刺激（EAS）保留残余低频听力，但植入物引起的耳蜗内纤维化会阻碍残余听力并逐渐降低 EAS 效果；在啮齿动物模型中客观、高分辨率且可重复地评估纤维化负担，是计算机视觉方法的明确应用场景。
Method: 生成了来自慢性植入豚鼠的 OCT 图像数据集并进行了人工分割标注，构建手动分割的 OCT 图像库；在该数据集上评估多个最先进的语义分割模型，并提出一种改进的 UNET 变体 2D-OCT-UNET，在放大后的 OCT 输入分辨率上运行。
Result: 摘要报告 2D-OCT-UNET 在识别耳蜗纤维化及相关标注上取得最佳性能；这是首次将计算机视觉技术成功应用于含纤维化的植入耳蜗 OCT 数据集，并验证了纤维化负担计算的可靠性。
Conclusion: 该工作表明深度学习模型可以可靠地完成耳蜗纤维化负担计算，数据集与项目代码已公开在 GitHub 上；研究目标是最终减轻纤维化负担并改善人工耳蜗患者预后。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS): Integrating Established Prioritization Operators for Priority Elicitation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
papers.abstract_en: Pairwise reciprocal matrices are fundamental to the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), a decision-making model. While the Direct Least Squares (DLS) method provides an intuitive mechanism for deriving priority vectors without complex transformations, the DLS provides multiple solutions. Under high levels of inconsistency, such as cyclic contradictions, this non-convexity yields multiple distinct global minima, resulting in unstable priority rankings that critically depend on initial algorithmic guesses. To overcome this structural deficiency, this paper introduces the Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS) optimization model. ARDLS integrates uniquely determined established prioritization operators, such as normalization techniques, the Eigenvector method, Singular Value Decomposition, Cosine Maximization, and the Pseudo-Inverse Gram Matrix (the closed-form solution of Weighted Least Squares), as theoretical anchors within a regularization penalty. This integration systematically breaks mathematical symmetries, tilting the optimization landscape to guarantee convergence upon a single, unique global minimum. Comprehensive numerical experiments and simulations validate that the ARDLS framework successfully reduces root mean square error among established priority operators, while guaranteeing strict mathematical uniqueness. The proposed ARDLS may be the ideal alternative for the AHP applied to many application domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对层次分析法 (AHP) 中成对互反矩阵的排序向量估计问题，提出锚定正则化直接最小二乘 (ARDLS) 优化模型。该方法将归一化技术、特征向量法、奇异值分解、余弦最大化以及伪逆 Gram 矩阵等既有排序算子作为理论锚点纳入正则化惩罚项，以打破数学对称性，从而保证 DLS 在非凸情况下收敛到唯一全局最小值。数值实验表明 ARDLS 在降低既有排序算子之间的均方根误差的同时保证了严格唯一性。
Motivation: 直接最小二乘 (DLS) 方法直觉且无需复杂变换，但在高不一致性（如循环矛盾）下非凸性导致多个不同全局最小值，排序结果不稳定且严重依赖初始猜测。
Method: 提出 ARDLS 优化模型，把多种已被充分确定的排序算子（归一化技术、Eigenvector 方法、SVD、Cosine Maximization、Pseudo-Inverse Gram Matrix）作为理论锚点嵌入正则化惩罚项，系统性地打破数学对称性并使优化景观倾斜，以收敛到唯一全局最小值。
Result: 综合数值实验和模拟验证表明，ARDLS 在保证严格数学唯一性的同时，降低了既有排序算子之间的均方根误差。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 ARDLS 可作为 AHP 在许多应用领域中的理想替代方法，但其结论主要限于排序向量唯一性与误差改善的数值验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Constructing Planning Domain Models from Clinical Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Surgical procedures such as laparoscopic appendectomy are complex, high-stakes processes, yet formalizing their workflows for decision support remains a significant challenge. Inducing probabilistic planning domain models in this setting is particularly difficult due to the lack of structured event data and the prevalence of implicit actions in clinical narratives, which neither empirical symbolic methods nor Large Language Models (LLMs) can adequately address on their own. We introduce NSPIN, a neurosymbolic framework for inducing probabilistic planning domain models from unstructured clinical narratives. Our method extracts and imputes structured event sequences from raw text using a pretrained LLM, then induces a PPDDL model and refines its preconditions with LLM-proposed revisions, guided by empirical validation. We evaluate the approach on 2,660 laparoscopic appendectomy notes written by 9 surgeons. NSPIN yields models that generalize to unseen notes, and expert clinical review indicates its induced knowledge is largely consistent with surgical practice.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Toward Vision Language Model-based Assessment of Clinical Quality and Usability of LGE-MR Images for Cardiac Ablation Planning
papers.abstract_en: LGE cardiac MRI is widely used for left atrial fibrosis assessment and ablation planning in atrial fibrillation patients as knowledge of fibrotic tissue regions identified from LGE-MRI is critical for catheter ablation. Often, poor quality images used during ablation planning can cause mis-localization of ablation targets, directly impacting procedure safety and outcome. The decision of whether a scan meets the minimum quality threshold for ablation planning is currently made informally by the reviewing radiologist and is not captured by any automated system, yet it is arguably the most safety-critical output of the image quality assessment (IQA) process. However, variations in image quality caused by noise, motion artifacts, and poor boundary definition significantly compromise the reliability of downstream segmentation and clinical decision-making tasks. Manual quality assessment by expert radiologists is subjective and difficult to scale, while existing automated methods produce scalar scores without interpretable clinical reasoning. In this work, we propose a two-stage vision language model (VLM) framework for clinically grounded image quality assessment of left atrial LGE-MRI. In the first stage, a fine-tuned VLM generates structured radiology-style quality reports predicting five radiologist-defined criteria: Noise, Motion Artifact, LA Boundary Accuracy, PV Region Accuracy, and Under-segmentation Severity. In the second stage, a GPT-based reasoning module maps the predicted quality and reports to a structured quality scores and binary clinical usability decision for ablation planning. We curate a dataset of 60 annotated image slice-text pairs from 20 patients and benchmark four state-of-the-art VLM architectures. InternVL2 achieves the highest criterion-level accuracy (Avg ACC=0.65, PLCC=0.79), while DeepSeek achieves perfect clinical usability agreement (Acc=1.00, kappa=1.00).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段视觉语言模型（VLM）框架，用于左心房 LGE-MRI 图像的临床质量评估与消融规划可用性判断。第一阶段由微调 VLM 生成结构化放射学风格质量报告，预测噪声、运动伪影、左心房边界准确性、肺静脉区域准确性和欠分割严重度五个标准；第二阶段用基于 GPT 的推理模块将报告映射为质量分数和二元临床可用性决策。作者在 20 例患者的 60 对切片-文本数据上评测四个 VLM 架构，InternVL2 获得最高标准级准确率，DeepSeek 实现完美的临床可用性一致性。
Motivation: LGE-MRI 对房颤消融规划至关重要，但图像质量不足会导致消融靶点定位错误，影响安全与疗效。目前扫描是否达到最低质量阈值由放射科医生非正式判断，缺乏自动化系统；人工评估主观且难以规模化，现有自动方法只输出标量分数，缺乏可解释的临床推理。
Method: 提出两阶段 VLM 框架：第一阶段微调 VLM 生成结构化放射学风格质量报告，预测噪声、运动伪影、LA 边界准确性、PV 区域准确性和欠分割严重度五个放射科医生定义的标准；第二阶段使用基于 GPT 的推理模块将预测质量报告转换为结构化质量分数和用于消融规划的二元临床可用性决策。
Result: 在自建的 60 对图像切片-文本、来自 20 例患者的数据集上评估四个 SOTA VLM 架构，InternVL2 取得最高的标准级准确率（Avg ACC=0.65, PLCC=0.79），DeepSeek 实现完美的临床可用性一致性（Acc=1.00, kappa=1.00）。
Conclusion: 作者提出并验证了可提供可解释临床推理的 VLM 质量评估框架，能够将图像质量映射为消融规划的可用性决策。摘要未明确讨论局限，但数据规模较小（20 例患者、60 对样本）可能限制泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DAMOS: Learning Distortion-Aware Speech Quality Assessment through Explicit Distortion Localization
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech quality assessment aims to predict Mean Opinion Scores (MOS) consistent with human subjective perception and is essential for evaluating speech generation, enhancement, and communication systems. For speech signals, especially synthetic speech, distortions often occur locally, and overall perceptual quality is usually dominated by a small number of perceptually salient distortion regions. However, most existing methods are primarily optimized with utterance-level MOS, which provides only coarse-grained supervision and offer no explicit indication of where perceptually important distortions occur. To address this limitation, we introduce explicit distortion localization as auxiliary knowledge for speech quality assessment. We construct the first partially distorted speech dataset with frame-level distortion annotations and train a localization model to generate distortion cues. Building on these cues, we propose DAMOS, a distortion-aware speech quality assessment framework that integrates localization information into the MOS prediction pipeline. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that DAMOS consistently outperforms existing methods and exhibits strong cross-dataset generalization, validating the effectiveness of explicit distortion localization for speech quality assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAMOS，一种失真感知的语音质量评估框架，通过显式失真定位作为辅助知识来预测 Mean Opinion Scores (MOS)。作者构建了第一个带帧级失真标注的部分失真语音数据集，训练定位模型生成失真线索，并将其集成到 MOS 预测流程中。在多个公共基准上的实验表明，DAMOS 一致优于现有方法并表现出强跨数据集泛化能力，验证了显式失真定位对语音质量评估的有效性。
Motivation: 现有语音质量评估方法大多以语句级 MOS 作为粗粒度监督，无法明确指出感知上重要的失真发生在何处；而合成语音的失真往往局部出现，整体感知质量常由少数显著失真区域主导。
Method: 引入显式失真定位（explicit distortion localization）作为辅助知识：构建带帧级失真标注的部分失真语音数据集，训练一个定位模型来生成失真线索，再将这些线索集成进 MOS 预测流程，形成失真感知的语音质量评估框架 DAMOS。
Result: 在多个公共基准上的实验表明，DAMOS 持续优于现有方法，并展现出强跨数据集泛化能力，验证了显式失真定位在语音质量评估中的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式失真定位能为语音质量评估提供有效的辅助信息，并指出该框架具有良好的跨数据集泛化性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SRL-MPC: Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control
papers.abstract_en: Safe and efficient shape-aware navigation in heterogeneous crowds and robot fleets remains challenging. Traditional approaches often assume homogeneous robots, sparse workspaces, simplified geometry, offline computation, or handcrafted parameters to make the problem tractable, which limits their deployment in dense crowd scenarios. Toward this end, we propose Shape-Aware Reinforcement Learned Model Predictive Control (SRL-MPC), a method for safe, efficient, and adaptive navigation in crowds with heterogeneous shapes without geometry simplification. To encode shape-aware safety, we formulate high-order control barrier function (HOCBF) constraints from geometric separation features (GSFs) based on support function transformation. A reinforcement learning (RL) framework then learns a neural policy that reads GSFs and outputs real-time MPC parameter updates, enabling the MPC solver to adapt to neighboring crowd geometries. The key advantage of SRL-MPC is that it preserves the safety structure and generalizability of MPC while integrating the adaptability and intelligence of RL. Experiments in randomized crowd scenarios with arbitrary shaped robot fleets demonstrate the effectiveness, scalability, and robustness of SRL-MPC. The results show that SRL-MPC substantially outperforms representative baselines in safety and adaptability. Project website: https://hanruihua.github.io/srl_mpc_project/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SRL-MPC，一种面向异构形状机器人编队在密集人群中的安全高效导航方法。方法利用支撑函数变换得到几何分离特征 (GSFs)，构造高阶控制屏障函数 (HOCBF) 约束，并通过强化学习 (RL) 学习神经策略以实时更新 MPC 参数，从而在不简化几何形状的前提下适应周围人群几何。实验在随机人群场景与任意形状机器人编队中验证了方法的有效性、可扩展性和鲁棒性，并在安全性和适应性上显著优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 传统方法为降低问题复杂度，通常假设同质机器人、稀疏工作空间、简化几何、离线计算或手工设计参数，这些假设限制了其在密集人群场景中的部署。
Method: 提出 SRL-MPC 框架：基于支撑函数变换提取几何分离特征，构造 HOCBF 约束以编码形状感知安全性；再通过 RL 学习神经策略读取 GSF 并输出 MPC 参数的实时更新，使 MPC 求解器能适应邻近人群的几何形态，兼顾 MPC 的安全结构与泛化性以及 RL 的适应性和智能性。
Result: 在含任意形状机器人编队的随机人群场景实验中，SRL-MPC 相比代表性基线在安全性和适应性上取得显著优势，并展现出有效性、可扩展性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SRL-MPC 的关键优势在于无需几何简化即可保持 MPC 的安全结构和泛化能力，同时引入 RL 的适应能力，适合密集异构人群中的导航任务。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: From Attention Masks to Inert Zero-Vector Tokens: OAttention and O-Closure for Token Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Attention masks are relation-level controls: they specify which query--source pairs may interact. They do not provide a representation-carried token state that is non-participating at the attention boundary. We assign each token hidden carrier \(h_i\) an active-presence coefficient \(p_i=\lVert h_i\rVert^2/(τ+\lVert h_i\rVert^2)\). The same coefficient has two roles: it gates information emitted by token \(i\), and it determines the mass with which token \(i\) enters computations shared with other tokens. OAttention is the support-coupled attention realization of this rule. It gates the receiver output by \(p_i\) and weights source \(j\) by \(p_j\) in both the attention numerator and partition, while retaining the standard score, visibility relation, exponential competition, and value aggregation. This makes the zero-vector token a zero element and yields exact null-receiver, null-source insertion, self-attention insertion, and empty-support properties. The same token-level presence gives local O-components (OFFN, ONorm, and OInject), presence-weighted OStandardize, the O-Closure law \(M(H\oplus0)=M(H)\oplus0\), and an OTransformer by residual and compositional closure. The canonical operator is checked by contract tests and a GPU evaluation. In a zero-fine-tuning retrofit of a cloned pretrained TabPFN v3 regressor, calibrated hidden-carrier OAttention and Full-O variants change mean RMSE by $+0.088\%$ and $+0.177\%$, respectively, over 18 matched dataset--seed cases. A two-block ablation shows that OAttention alone does not preserve a NULL state through ordinary host components, whereas the OTransformer path does. These are scoped tests of exactness, active-path compatibility, and compositional necessity; they do not establish universal no-loss, arbitrary-host closure, learned attraction to the origin, or a general semantics for missing values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用表示携带的 token 级活跃度系数替代注意力掩码：每个 token 隐藏载体 h_i 引入 p_i=||h_i||^2/(τ+||h_i||^2)，该系数同时门控 token 发出的信息并决定其在共享计算中的参与质量，由此构造 OAttention、局部 O 组件（OFFN、ONorm、OInject）与 O-Closure 律 M(H⊕0)=M(H)⊕0，并由残差与组合闭包得到 OTransformer。零微调改造克隆的预训练 TabPFN v3 回归器时，校准的隐藏载体 OAttention 与 Full-O 变体在 18 组匹配数据集-种子上的平均 RMSE 分别变化 +0.088% 和 +0.177%。作者强调这些只是精确性、活跃路径兼容性与组合必要性的限定测试。
Motivation: 现有注意力掩码是关系级控制，只规定哪些 query-source 对可以交互，并不提供一种表示携带的、在注意力边界处不参与计算的 token 状态；本文针对这一缺失提出表示层的非参与 token 建模。
Method: 为每个 token 的隐藏载体 h_i 赋予活跃度系数 p_i=||h_i||^2/(τ+||h_i||^2)，并用同一系数既门控接收端输出、又在注意力分子与配分函数中按 p_j 加权源 token，同时保留标准分数、可见性关系、指数竞争与值聚合；进一步构造局部 O 组件、presence 加权的 OStandardize、O-Closure 律以及通过残差和组合闭包得到的 OTransformer。
Result: 在克隆预训练 TabPFN v3 回归器的零微调改造中，校准的隐藏载体 OAttention 与 Full-O 变体在 18 个匹配数据集-种子案例上的平均 RMSE 分别变化 +0.088% 和 +0.177%；两模块消融显示 OAttention 单独不能通过普通宿主组件保持 NULL 状态，而 OTransformer 路径可以。
Conclusion: 作者将这些视为对精确性、活跃路径兼容性和组合必要性的限定测试，明确指出结果不建立通用无损失、任意宿主闭包、学习性原点吸引或缺失值一般语义。

papers.title: Thermo-FL: Thermal-Aware Robust Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models for Edge AI
papers.abstract_en: Federated fine-tuning enables large language models to adapt on edge devices without centralizing private data, but practical deployments must address hardware instability and adversarial update corruption together. Thermally constrained clients may throttle, slow local training, or delay synchronous aggregation, while Byzantine clients and communication-layer adversaries can corrupt the updates used to form the global model. To address these challenges, we present Thermo-FL, a thermal-aware federated LoRA fine-tuning framework that uses device temperature as an active control signal for local adapter training and sparse update transmission. On the client side, Thermo-FL adjusts the active LoRA-layer fraction and transmitted update density as devices heat or cool, reducing workload under thermal stress. On the server side, Thermo-FL introduces TERRA, a robust aggregation pipeline for dynamically sparse LoRA updates that combines norm filtering, mask-aware directional validation, adaptive active-coordinate clipping, and mask-aware aggregation. We evaluate Thermo-FL using both a large-scale emulator and a Jetson-based physical testbed. In the emulator, Thermo-FL improves robustness under adversarial sparse aggregation and achieves the strongest BoolQ accuracy across clean and attack settings while remaining competitive on GSM8K. In the physical prototype, Thermo-FL stabilizes device temperature, reduces compressed upload size through bitmap sparse encoding, and preserves GSM8K utility under sign-flip/scale and MITM perturbations. These results show that secure edge LLM adaptation should jointly consider hardware behavior, workload regulation, sparse communication, and aggregation robustness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Thermo-FL，一个面向边缘设备上大语言模型联邦微调的热感知鲁棒框架。客户端根据设备温度动态调整激活的 LoRA 层比例和传输的更新密度，以应对热约束；服务端提出 TERRA 鲁棒聚合管线，针对稀疏 LoRA 更新结合范数过滤、掩码感知方向校验、自适应激活坐标裁剪和掩码感知聚合。在大型仿真器和 Jetson 物理测试台上，Thermo-FL 在对抗设置下提升鲁棒性，在 BoolQ 上取得最强准确率，并在物理原型上稳定温度、减小压缩上传大小、保持 GSM8K 效用。
Motivation: 联邦微调使大语言模型能在不集中私有数据的情况下在边缘设备上适配，但实际部署需同时应对硬件不稳定和对抗性更新破坏：热约束客户端可能节流、变慢或延迟同步聚合，拜占庭客户端和通信层攻击者可破坏全局模型更新。
Method: Thermo-FL 将设备温度作为本地适配器训练和稀疏更新传输的主动控制信号：客户端在设备升温或降温时调整激活 LoRA 层比例和传输更新密度；服务端引入 TERRA 聚合管线，对动态稀疏 LoRA 更新执行范数过滤、掩码感知方向校验、自适应激活坐标裁剪和掩码感知聚合。
Result: 在大型仿真器中，Thermo-FL 在对抗性稀疏聚合下提高了鲁棒性，在干净和攻击设置下取得最强 BoolQ 准确率，并在 GSM8K 上保持竞争力。在基于 Jetson 的物理原型中，Thermo-FL 稳定了设备温度，通过位图稀疏编码减小压缩上传大小，并在符号翻转/缩放和 MITM 扰动下保持 GSM8K 效用。
Conclusion: 结果表明，安全的边缘 LLM 适配应同时考虑硬件行为、负载调节、稀疏通信和聚合鲁棒性。

papers.title: Is Visual Prompting All You Need? Studying VLM Spatial Reasoning under Progressive Visual Scaffolds
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in multimodal reasoning, yet recent work shows that their failures often reflect an interaction between visual grounding and downstream reasoning. What remains less clear is how the visual presentation of a task shapes model performance and failure modes when the underlying reasoning problem is unchanged. We study this question in SPaRC, a benchmark for grid-based visual spatial planning, by introducing lightweight input-side scaffolds that preserve the visual modality while making spatial structure more accessible. Across multiple VLMs, these scaffolds improve task accuracy over the original visual setting by up to 34.0 percentage points and further complement GRPO-based training, yielding up to 4.6 additional accuracy points compared with near-zero gains on the original visual input. Analyses on both end-to-end task solving and object detection show that these gains are closely tied to reductions in grounding-related errors, while rule reasoning remains comparatively challenging. We find that visual presentation is a central factor that determines whether VLM benchmarks measure grounded perception, downstream reasoning, or a mixture of both.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉呈现方式如何影响 VLM 的空间推理表现，基于网格视觉空间规划基准 SPaRC。作者引入保持视觉模态但让空间结构更易获取的轻量级输入侧脚手架 (input-side scaffolds)，在多个 VLM 上使任务准确率较原始视觉设置最多提升 34.0 个百分点，并进一步补充 GRPO 训练，额外带来最多 4.6 个百分点的提升。端到端任务求解与目标检测分析显示，收益主要来自 grounding 相关错误的减少，而规则推理仍然较难。作者由此指出视觉呈现是决定 VLM 基准实际衡量 grounded perception、下游推理还是两者混合的关键因素。
Motivation: 已有工作表明 VLM 的失败常源于视觉 grounding 与下游推理之间的交互，但底层推理问题不变时，视觉呈现如何塑造模型性能与失败模式仍不清楚。本文针对这一空白，系统考察输入侧视觉改动对空间规划任务的影响。
Method: 在 SPaRC 网格空间规划基准上提出轻量级输入侧脚手架，保留原始视觉模态的同时显式暴露空间结构；将该方案与 GRPO 训练结合，并分别对端到端任务求解和目标检测进行误差来源分析。
Result: 摘要报告脚手架在多个 VLM 上将准确率最多提升 34.0 个百分点；与 GRPO 结合时额外提升最多 4.6 个百分点，而原始视觉输入上 GRPO 的增益接近为零。误差分析表明提升主要与 grounding 相关错误减少相关，规则推理仍相对困难。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉呈现是决定 VLM 基准衡量 grounded perception、下游推理或二者混合的核心因素。该结论的适用范围限于 SPaRC 基准及所测试的 VLM 与输入脚手架设置。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Human-JEPA: A Human-Centric Vision Model that Perceives and Anticipates
papers.abstract_en: Machines that understand humans should perceive the present and anticipate the future. Existing human-centric vision model are pretrained on human images, set the state of the art in static dense perception, so motion and anticipation are out of reach. Here we present Human-JEPA, a human-centric vision model trained on video by anchored forecasting: dense targets are pinned to a frozen copy of the initialization, preventing a silent collapse of dense perception, and block masks are replaced by a pure past-to-future split, avoiding a five-point action tax and a seventeen-point re-identification collapse. Under frozen probes, Human-JEPA leads the pixel-anchored specialists on pose and person re-identification at 2.7 times fewer parameters, conceding high-resolution dense parsing, and its released predictor head is the first that does not degrade anticipation. A single safely adapted model thus serves both halves of understanding humans.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Human-JEPA，一个以人为中心的视觉模型，通过在视频上做锚定预测 (anchored forecasting) 进行预训练：把密集目标钉在初始化的冻结副本上以防止密集感知的静默塌缩，并用纯粹的过去到未来切分 (past-to-future split) 替代块掩码。摘要称在冻结探针评估下，该模型在姿态估计和行人重识别上以约 2.7 倍更少的参数领先像素锚定 (pixel-anchored) 专用模型，且其预测头是第一个不会损害时序预判 (anticipation) 的设计。
Motivation: 现有人类中心视觉模型主要在人类图像上预训练，在静态密集感知上达到 SOTA，但无法处理运动与未来预判；作者希望单一模型同时支撑感知与预判，而直接迁移视频预训练方法到密集感知会遇到表征塌缩问题。
Method: 采用锚定预测的预训练目标：将密集预测目标固定在模型初始化的冻结副本上，防止密集感知表征静默塌缩；并将块掩码 (block masking) 替换为纯过去到未来切分，从而避免摘要中提到的五点动作损失 (five-point action tax) 和十七点重识别塌缩 (seventeen-point re-identification collapse)。
Result: 在冻结探针下，Human-JEPA 在姿态估计与行人重识别上以少 2.7 倍的参数超过像素锚定专用模型，但在高分辨率密集解析 (high-resolution dense parsing) 上有所让步；其发布的预测头是第一个不降低预判能力的预测头。
Conclusion: 摘要主张一个经过安全适配的单一模型可以同时服务于理解人类的两个层面，即感知现在与预判未来；同时也明确承认该模型在高分辨率密集解析上做出取舍。

papers.title: AID-Guard: Stateful Authorization for Delegated Agent Effects
papers.abstract_en: Tool-using AI agents turn delegated tasks into provider effects, yet authorization often ends at admission while provider state, delivery, retry, and recovery evolve. A request may change before commit, or response loss may cause a replacement to create a second effect from one approval. We present AID-Guard, a stateful authorization-to-effect closure protocol. It revalidates the approved request and provider state at commit, retains one reservation under ambiguity, and permits release or one successor only after a terminal result or certified no effect with a delivery fence. For supported provider contracts, one reservation yields at most one effect across retry and recovery. To our knowledge, it is the first evaluated agent-authorization protocol to unify these controls in one lifecycle. We implement a Python/SQLite prototype. In a declared loopback MCP domain, 13 live mutations caused no unauthorized provider effects, three concurrent histories were linearizable, and evidence bundles supported public verification and replay. All 210 Stripe provider-contract trials matched predeclared outcomes. Across Stripe and Resend, 40 terminalize-successor schedules, 30 overlapping races, and 10 crash-recovery schedules completed without duplicate effects. Under complete proposer compromise, AID-Guard blocked 44/44 attacks and admitted 44/44 matched legitimate proposals. Its strict exact-manifest profile reduced benign utility by 35.4 to 43.8 percentage points; a typed frontier recovered 9-10 completions without observed unsafe effects. A composition study blocked 20/20 post-admission lifecycle attacks and preserved 8/8 valid or exact-retry executions. The results support authorization-to-effect binding under the evaluated effect-path inventory, provider contracts, and failure schedules.

papers.title: HIERA: Workload-Aware Planning Across Implementation Spaces for GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: High-performance GPU kernels underpin modern deep learning and scientific computing. As workloads become increasingly diverse and GPU hardware evolves rapidly, developing efficient methods for automated GPU kernel generation and optimization has become increasingly important. Existing LLM-based methods typically optimize within a fixed implementation space, limiting either optimization flexibility or search efficiency. We propose \textsc{HIERA}, a hierarchical search-space planning framework for GPU kernel optimization. \textsc{HIERA} constructs contract-augmented task specifications, selects an appropriate implementation space across PyTorch operators, CUDA libraries, and custom CUDA kernels, and uses profiling feedback and expert knowledge to guide structured iterative refinement. Experiments on KernelBench across multiple various workload levels and base LLMs show that \textsc{HIERA} delivers stronger overall implementation validity, sample efficiency, and optimization performance than existing training-free methods, while remaining competitive with the training-based CUDA-L1 without additional model training. A case study on a specialized stencil operator from scientific computing further achieves a \(1.53\times\) speedup over cuDNN, demonstrating the potentiality of the general framework beyond standard machine-learning workloads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIERA，一个面向 GPU kernel 优化的分层搜索空间规划框架。它通过契约增强（contract-augmented）的任务规格构建，在 PyTorch 算子、CUDA 库和自定义 CUDA kernel 之间选择实现空间，并利用 profiling 反馈与专家知识指导结构化迭代优化。在 KernelBench 的多个 workload 级别和多种基座 LLM 下，相比训练-free 方法在实现有效性、样本效率和优化性能上更强，并可与需额外模型训练的 CUDA-L1 竞争。科学计算中的专用 stencil 算子案例相对 cuDNN 实现 1.53x 加速。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 GPU kernel 生成方法通常在固定实现空间内优化，导致优化灵活性或搜索效率受限；随着 workload 日益多样化和 GPU 硬件快速演进，需要更高效的自动 kernel 生成与优化方法。
Method: 构建契约增强的任务规格，跨 PyTorch 算子、CUDA 库与自定义 CUDA kernel 三个实现空间进行选择，结合 profiling 反馈和专家知识进行结构化迭代精化，从而兼顾优化灵活性与搜索效率。
Result: 在 KernelBench 的多个 workload 级别和多种基座 LLM 上，HIERA 在实现有效性、样本效率和优化性能上优于现有 training-free 方法，并与 training-based 的 CUDA-L1 竞争力相当；科学计算 stencil 案例相对 cuDNN 取得 1.53x 加速。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分层搜索空间规划可以在多个实现空间中选择并迭代优化 GPU kernel，不仅适用于标准机器学习 workload，也能推广到科学计算算子。

papers.title: Graph Engineering in the Era of LLM Agents: From Individual Intelligence to System Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have evolved from language generators to autonomous agents capable of complex, long-horizon tasks. This evolution has produced paradigms including Prompt Engineering to elicit model capabilities, Context Engineering to manage information access, Harness Engineering to organize external tools and resources, and Loop Engineering to support continual reflection and self-improvement. Yet as tasks grow more complex, individual intelligence faces a fundamental limit: many tasks require heterogeneous expertise, interdependent subtasks, parallel execution, independent verification, and persistent state, exceeding any single agent's organizational capacity. Augmenting one agent's capabilities or context cannot resolve this architectural mismatch; intelligence must instead be distributed across specialized agents and organized at the system level. We call this System Intelligence: an agent system's ability to organize and coordinate multiple intelligent components into a coherent, adaptive whole pursuing a shared objective. Achieving it requires more than adding agents; it demands explicit structures to organize work, coordinate heterogeneous agents, and maintain evolving execution states. We introduce Graph Engineering, an emerging paradigm for next-generation agent systems. Unlike prior paradigms that mainly optimize individual interactions or agent-level behavior, Graph Engineering constructs explicit, dynamic, evolving graph structures representing tasks, agents, and system states. These abstractions provide a unified foundation for organizing complex objectives, orchestrating heterogeneous agents, modeling system dynamics, and enabling scalable agent evolution. We systematically review the principles, methodologies, and applications of Graph Engineering for LLM agents. Related papers, open-source data, and projects are collected at https://github.com/DEEP-JLU/Awesome-Graph-Engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Graph Engineering 作为面向下一代大语言模型 (LLM) 智能体系统的新兴范式，并回顾了其原理、方法论与应用。作者认为，随着任务复杂度提升，个体智能存在架构性局限，智能需要被分配到多个专业智能体并在系统层面组织，即 System Intelligence。Graph Engineering 通过显式构建代表任务、智能体和系统状态的动态演化图结构，为组织复杂目标、编排异构智能体、建模系统动态和实现可扩展智能体演化提供统一基础。
Motivation: 现有 Prompt Engineering、Context Engineering、Harness Engineering 和 Loop Engineering 等范式主要优化个体交互或智能体行为，但面对需要异构专长、相互依赖的子任务、并行执行、独立验证和持久状态的任务，单智能体的能力或上下文扩展无法解决架构性不匹配，智能必须分布到系统层面。
Method: 作者引入 Graph Engineering 范式，主张构造显式、动态、演化的图结构来表示任务、智能体和系统状态；文章以综述形式系统梳理该范式的设计原则、方法论与典型应用，并整理了相关论文、开源数据和项目资源。
Result: 本文没有报告定量实验结果，属于系统综述；其成果体现为对 Graph Engineering 原理、方法和应用的体系化整理，以及公开的资源集合 (GitHub 仓库)。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Graph Engineering 为组织复杂目标、协调异构智能体、建模系统动态以及支持智能体规模化演化提供了统一基础，是超越个体级优化的下一代智能体系统范式。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Capturing Cardiac Cyclicity through Phase-Equivariant Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: The cyclic structure of physiological processes offers a natural prior for self-supervised representation learning, and the cardiac cycle provides a particularly well-defined setting in which to exploit it. We derive a phase-equivariant self-supervised objective and introduce Winder, a joint-embedding architecture that organises representations into phase-invariant coordinates and phase-rotating harmonic subspaces. Its transport operator is fixed and closed-form, derived from the cycle's geometry rather than learned, and adds no parameters. Evaluated on PTB-XL under a frozen linear-probe protocol, Winder attains diagnostic accuracy within the range reported by state-of-the-art self-supervised methods at a ~1 M parameter footprint, while exhibiting phase-equivariant latent geometry. These findings demonstrate that explicitly encoding cardiac-phase symmetry can preserve diagnostically useful information while yielding a latent geometry that is legible, parameter-efficient, and directly tied to a measurable physiological quantity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用生理过程的循环结构作为自监督表征学习的先验，针对心脏周期提出相位等变自监督目标，并引入 Winder 联合嵌入架构。Winder 将表征组织为相位不变坐标和相位旋转的谐波子空间，其传输算子由周期几何闭式导出、固定且不增加参数。在 PTB-XL 上使用冻结线性探测协议评估，Winder 以约 1M 参数达到现有自监督方法报告范围内的诊断准确率，并展现出相位等变的潜空间几何。作者认为显式编码心脏相位对称性可以保留诊断有用信息，同时获得可读、参数高效且与可测量生理量直接关联的潜空间结构。
Motivation: 循环生理过程为自监督表示学习提供了天然先验，而心脏周期是特别适合利用这一结构的场景，因为其相位结构清晰可定义。
Method: 推导出相位等变的自监督目标，并提出 Winder 联合嵌入架构；该架构把表征分解为相位不变坐标和相位旋转的谐波子空间，传输算子由循环几何闭式得到而非学习得到，且不引入额外参数。
Result: 在 PTB-XL 数据集上以冻结线性探测协议评估，Winder 在约 1M 参数规模下达到同类 SOTA 自监督方法报告中的诊断准确率范围，同时具有相位等变的潜空间几何。
Conclusion: 显式编码心脏相位对称性可以在保留诊断信息的同时，产生可解释、参数高效且直接对应可测量生理量的潜空间几何。

papers.title: COEC: Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation for Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Structured pruning reduces the size and inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by removing weight columns, but the resulting output error can degrade accuracy. Existing training-free compensation methods use an additive bias or a single orthogonal rotation on the output side of the retained weight. These corrections leave its input singular frame unchanged and therefore limit how the retained weight can adapt after column removal. We propose COEC (Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation), a training-free compensation framework that applies alternating left and right orthogonal rotations to the retained weight. The right rotation is optimized on a reduced Stiefel manifold, while singular values are rescaled using generalized cross-validation to select the regularization strength for each layer. COEC further tempers the calibration Gram matrix to reduce the dominance of high-energy activation directions and introduces an alignment penalty that preserves the geometric relation between adjacent attention projections.All components use second-order statistics from a small calibration set and require neither backpropagation through the LLM nor retraining of the model parameters. COEC is independent of the column pruning criterion and can be applied to multiple structured pruning methods. Experiments on the Llama-3, Llama-3.1, and Qwen2.5 model families across multiple structured sparsity levels show that COEC improves perplexity on every model and zero-shot accuracy in most settings over existing compensation methods, with larger gains at higher sparsity. These results show that post-pruning compensation can recover part of the performance lost to column removal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COEC（Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation），一种面向大语言模型结构化剪枝的无训练补偿框架。该方法对保留权重交替施加左右正交旋转，右旋转在约化 Stiefel 流形上优化，并用广义交叉验证（GCV）调整每层奇异值的正则化强度；同时通过校准 Gram 矩阵的 tempering 与对齐惩罚来保留注意力投影间的几何关系。实验在 Llama-3、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 系列模型上验证，COEC 在所有稀疏度水平下改善困惑度，并在多数设置下提升 zero-shot 准确率，剪枝率越高收益越大。
Motivation: 结构化剪枝通过移除权重列降低模型尺寸和推理成本，但会引入输出误差并损害精度。现有的无训练补偿方法只使用加法偏置或输出侧的单次正交旋转，它们不改变保留权重的输入奇异框架，限制了列移除后权重的自适应能力。
Method: COEC 对保留权重交替进行左、右正交旋转，其中右旋转在约化 Stiefel 流形上优化；奇异值通过广义交叉验证选择每层的正则化强度。此外，方法对校准 Gram 矩阵进行 tempering 以削弱高能量激活方向的支配性，并引入对齐惩罚保持相邻注意力投影之间的几何关系。整套方法仅需少量校准集的二阶统计量，无需反向传播或重训练。
Result: 在 Llama-3、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 模型家族、多个结构化稀疏度水平下，COEC 相较于既有补偿方法在每个模型上都改善困惑度，并在多数设置下提升 zero-shot 准确率，且稀疏度越高增益越大。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，无训练的后剪枝补偿能够部分恢复因列移除导致的性能损失，且 COEC 独立于具体的列剪枝准则，可配合多种结构化剪枝方法使用。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 COEC（Calibrated Orthogonal-Equivalence Compensation），一种面向大语言模型结构化剪枝的无训练补偿框架。该方法对保留权重交替施加左右正交旋转，右旋转在约化 Stiefel 流形上优化，并用广义交叉验证（GCV）调整每层奇异值的正则化强度；同时通过校准 Gram 矩阵的 tempering 与对齐惩罚来保留注意力投影间的几何关系。实验在 Llama-3、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 系列模型上验证，COEC 在所有稀疏度水平下改善困惑度，并在多数设置下提升 zero-shot 准确率，剪枝率越高收益越大。
summary_sections.motivation: 结构化剪枝通过移除权重列降低模型尺寸和推理成本，但会引入输出误差并损害精度。现有的无训练补偿方法只使用加法偏置或输出侧的单次正交旋转，它们不改变保留权重的输入奇异框架，限制了列移除后权重的自适应能力。
summary_sections.method: COEC 对保留权重交替进行左、右正交旋转，其中右旋转在约化 Stiefel 流形上优化；奇异值通过广义交叉验证选择每层的正则化强度。此外，方法对校准 Gram 矩阵进行 tempering 以削弱高能量激活方向的支配性，并引入对齐惩罚保持相邻注意力投影之间的几何关系。整套方法仅需少量校准集的二阶统计量，无需反向传播或重训练。
summary_sections.result: 在 Llama-3、Llama-3.1 和 Qwen2.5 模型家族、多个结构化稀疏度水平下，COEC 相较于既有补偿方法在每个模型上都改善困惑度，并在多数设置下提升 zero-shot 准确率，且稀疏度越高增益越大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，无训练的后剪枝补偿能够部分恢复因列移除导致的性能损失，且 COEC 独立于具体的列剪枝准则，可配合多种结构化剪枝方法使用。

papers.title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans
papers.abstract_en: Reliable spatial understanding is an important prerequisite for future medical vision-language systems that aim to support radiological report generation and structured image understanding. While modern vision-language models (VLMs) show promising performance on many medical imaging tasks, recent evidence suggests they remain weak in controlled spatial reasoning and often fail to reliably ground spatial relations in image evidence. Given that radiological reasoning hinges on understanding the relative positions of anatomical structures and findings, this spatial weakness poses risks to diagnostic accuracy. We present a modular medical imaging agent for binary spatial relation verification in axial CT slices. Instead of directly predicting spatial answers end-to-end, the system decomposes the task into explicit stages: language parsing, anatomical localization, and deterministic geometric verification. Natural-language queries are converted into structured relation tuples, queried organs are localized with a YOLO-based detector, and the final spatial decision is computed from object centers using deterministic geometric rules. We evaluate the approach on the held-out MIRP spatial QA benchmark and compare it against representative end-to-end VLM baselines. The best-performing hybrid configuration reaches 94.1% accuracy and 94.2% F1, outperforming direct Qwen2-VL prompting by 42.5 percentage points in accuracy, while preserving interpretable intermediate representations and auditable reasoning stages. The results suggest that explicit modular spatial verification can serve as a promising building block for future report-oriented medical imaging agents.
papers.journal_ref: Published at the MICCAI 2026 Agentic AI for Medicine Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化医学影像智能体，用于轴向CT切片中的二元空间关系验证。系统将任务分解为语言解析、解剖定位和确定性几何验证三个阶段：自然语言查询被转为结构化关系元组，YOLO检测器定位器官，最后用物体中心计算几何规则得出空间判断。在MIRP空间QA基准上，最佳混合配置达到94.1%准确率和94.2% F1，比直接使用Qwen2-VL提示高出42.5个百分点，同时保留了可解释的中间表示和可审计的推理阶段。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在医学影像任务上表现良好，但在受控空间推理上仍然薄弱，难以可靠地将空间关系锚定到图像证据中；而放射学推理高度依赖解剖结构和病灶之间的相对位置，这种空间弱点对诊断准确性构成风险。
Method: 提出模块化智能体，将空间关系验证分解为显式阶段：语言解析（把自然语言查询转换为结构化关系元组）、解剖定位（使用基于YOLO的检测器定位器官）和确定性几何验证（根据检测物体中心计算空间决策），而不是端到端直接预测空间答案。
Result: 在所持出的MIRP空间QA基准上，最佳混合配置达到94.1%准确率和94.2% F1，相比直接使用Qwen2-VL提示的准确率提升42.5个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式的模块化空间验证可以作为面向未来报告型医学影像智能体的有前景的构建模块，其可解释的中间表示和可审计的推理阶段是主要优势。

papers.title: BackDFL: A Unified Benchmark For Backdoor Attacks and Defenses In Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) promises trust-free collaborative learning by replacing the centralized parameter server with peer-to-peer model exchange. However, this architectural shift fundamentally reshapes the threat landscape. Without globally coordinated aggregation, DFL becomes particularly susceptible to backdoor attacks, in which malicious participants implant persistent hidden behaviors while maintaining high clean-task performance. In this paper, we argue that the robustness of DFL has been significantly overestimated. Existing studies rely on simplified threat models, non-adaptive adversaries, fragmented evaluation protocols, inconsistent communication topologies, and ad hoc training configurations, leading to an incomplete understanding of DFL security. To address these limitations, we present BackDFL, a unified benchmark for systematically evaluating DFL under realistic and adaptive backdoor attacks. Through extensive experiments, BackDFL exposes critical failure modes of decentralized learning. Our results demonstrate that both state-of-the-art Byzantine-robust DFL methods and adapted FL backdoor defenses fail under modest malicious participation rates (as low as 15%), especially in heterogeneous settings, while their robustness varies substantially across communication graph topologies.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the ANUBIS Workshop, co-located with ESORICS'26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BackDFL，一个用于去中心化联邦学习 (Decentralized Federated Learning, DFL) 后门攻击与防御的统一评测基准。作者认为现有研究对 DFL 鲁棒性的评估过于乐观，其威胁模型简化、对手非自适应、评测协议碎片化。实验表明，在低至 15% 的恶意参与率下，最先进的 Byzantine 鲁棒 DFL 方法和适配后的 FL 后门防御都会失败，尤其在异质设置中，且鲁棒性随通信图拓扑显著变化。
Motivation: DFL 用点对点模型交换取代中心化参数服务器，从根本上改变了威胁模型，但现有研究依赖简化的威胁模型、非自适应对手和碎片化评测协议，导致对 DFL 安全性的理解不完整，鲁棒性被显著高估。
Method: 构建统一基准 BackDFL，在一致且现实的威胁设置下系统评估后门攻击与防御，统一通信拓扑与训练配置，并引入自适应对手来暴露去中心化学习的失败模式。
Result: 实验显示，在低至 15% 的恶意参与率下，现有 SOTA Byzantine 鲁棒 DFL 方法及适配的 FL 后门防御均失效，尤其是在异质数据设置中；防御鲁棒性在不同通信图拓扑间差异显著。
Conclusion: 作者强调 DFL 的鲁棒性被明显高估，统一的 BackDFL 基准可以揭示现有防御在现实条件下的关键失效模式。

papers.title: Stream3Dv2: Geometric-Semantic Fusion Enhanced Streaming Zero-Shot 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recently, open-vocabulary zero-shot 3D scene understanding using vision foundation models has emerged as a promising alternative to data-intensive supervised methods. However, deploying these models in real-world scenarios is severely hindered by their inability to efficiently handle streaming RGB-D inputs and their inherent vulnerability to noise 2D segmentation masks. To address these critical limitations, we propose Stream3Dv2, a novel training-free framework designed for robust streaming 3D perception. Stream3Dv2 processes sequential data through an original nested local-to-historical architecture, capturing multi-view consistency while circumventing the high computational overhead so as to support timely responses. At its core, we introduce a comprehensive geometric-semantic fusion mechanism that resolves geometric noise and semantic ambiguity by explicitly utilizing semantic guidance and formulating 3D segmentation as solving point-and-set merging and partitioning problems. Furthermore, we present an innovative manifold-distance-based point cloud refinement strategy. This approach leverages local manifold graphs for point-to-manifold optimization that mitigates the boundary delineation failures caused by Euclidean-distance metrics, and employs geometric bounding boxes to dynamically activate and update historical instances for achieving rapid manifold-to-manifold refinement. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that Stream3Dv2 consistently outperforms existing baselines in foundational open-vocabulary streaming 3D segmentation and detection. Finally, we show that integrating our framework with an LLM-based agent enables advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding, underscoring its potential for open-world embodied intelligence. Code will be updated at https://github.com/SubmissionsIn/Stream3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream3Dv2，一个无需训练的流式 zero-shot 3D 场景理解框架，面向流式 RGB-D 输入，通过嵌套 local-to-historical 架构保持多视图一致性并降低计算开销。核心贡献包括几何-语义融合机制，将 3D 分割形式化为点与集合的合并/划分问题，以及基于流形距离的点云细化策略，利用局部流形图修正欧氏距离导致的边界误差，并用几何包围盒动态更新历史实例。实验表明其在开放词汇流式 3D 分割与检测上持续优于现有基线，并与 LLM 智能体集成实现语言驱动的场景理解。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇 zero-shot 3D 场景理解方法依赖视觉基础模型，但难以高效处理流式 RGB-D 输入，且对噪声 2D 分割掩码固有脆弱，限制了实际部署。
Method: 提出 Stream3Dv2 框架，采用嵌套的 local-to-historical 架构处理连续数据；核心是几何-语义融合机制，显式利用语义引导解决几何噪声与语义歧义；并设计流形距离 (manifold-distance) 点云细化策略，先做点对流形优化，再用几何包围盒激活和更新历史实例以加速流形对流形细化。
Result: 在公开数据集上，Stream3Dv2 在开放词汇流式 3D 分割与检测基准中一致优于现有基线；集成 LLM 智能体后支持语言驱动的 3D 场景理解，展示了在开放世界具身智能上的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架有效解决流式感知效率与 2D 掩码噪声鲁棒性问题，可作为开放世界具身智能感知的基础组件；代码将在 GitHub 更新。

papers.title: Llama-Mobile: Efficient 2.7-Bit Quantization of VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Deploying vision-language models (VLMs) on mobile devices is challenging due to their significant memory and compute requirements. We present a framework for quantizing VLMs for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. Our approach combines a quantization pipeline that uses the model itself to generate training data and does not require access to the training setup, with a novel 2.7-bit-per-parameter format supporting efficient execution on Arm CPUs. We validate our approach by compressing the Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct model to 3.7 GB with 8-bit activations, preserving strong performance on a set of standard visual question answering tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向资源受限硬件的视觉-语言模型（VLM）量化框架。其量化流程利用模型自身生成训练数据，无需访问训练设置，并引入一种新颖的 2.7-bit-per-parameter 数值格式，支持在 Arm CPU 上高效执行。作者将 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 模型压缩至 3.7 GB（激活为 8-bit），并在标准视觉问答任务上保持了较强性能。
Motivation: 在移动设备上部署 VLM 面临显著的内存与计算需求挑战，现有量化方案往往依赖训练设置或不易直接迁移到已有模型。
Method: 提出量化框架，包含两条关键路径：一是用模型自身生成训练数据、不依赖训练设置的量化管道；二是新的 2.7-bit-per-parameter 格式，专为 Arm CPU 的高效执行设计。
Result: 摘要报告将 Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct 压缩至 3.7 GB，配合 8-bit 激活，在标准视觉问答任务上保持较强性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法可在移动端硬件上实现高效的 VLM 推理并保持任务性能，但未提供与其他量化基线的详细对比。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Masking Is Not Enough: Generative Restoration for Multimodal De-Identification in Medical AI
papers.abstract_en: Medical image-text data can expose protected health information (PHI) through both visible image content as well as accompanying text, creating a barrier to privacy-preserving medical AI systems. This risk is especially prominent in multimodal systems, where images, questions, reports, and clinical context may enter training, evaluation, or inference pipelines. Existing medical vision-language benchmarks primarily emphasize task utility, while de-identification methods are often evaluated separately from downstream reasoning. We introduce ClinX, an end-to-end multimodal PHI sanitization framework for medical image-text data. ClinX detects visible identifiers with optical character recognition (OCR), constructs binary PHI masks, and applies ClinX-PRISM, a no-skip generative restoration module with privacy-oriented post-processing for burned-in identifier suppression. In parallel, text-side PHI is reduced through progressive de-identification levels: regex masking, context-aware masking, and rewrite-based sanitization. We evaluate ClinX in medical visual question answering (MedVQA), jointly measuring PHI leakage and downstream utility across image-side, text-side, and combined de-identification settings. Results show that OCR-only masking is not sufficient as a standalone solution, and restoration-based sanitization better preserves clinically relevant visual context while sharply reducing recoverable PHI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClinX，一个用于医学图像-文本数据多模态 PHI（受保护健康信息）去标识化的端到端框架。ClinX 用 OCR 检测可见标识符并构造二值 PHI 掩码，配合名为 ClinX-PRISM 的无跳跃生成式修复模块抑制烧录式标识符；文本侧则通过正则掩码、上下文感知掩码和基于重写的净化等渐进式去标识化级别降低 PHI。作者在医学视觉问答（MedVQA）上联合评测 PHI 泄漏与下游效用，结论是纯 OCR 掩码不足以独立去标识化，基于修复的净化能更保留临床相关视觉上下文并显著减少可恢复的 PHI。
Motivation: 医学图像-文本数据可通过可见图像内容和伴随文本同时暴露 PHI，阻碍隐私保护的医学 AI 系统；现有医学视觉语言基准侧重任务效用，而去标识化方法常与下游推理能力分开评估。
Method: ClinX 使用 OCR 检测可见标识符，构造二值 PHI 掩码，并应用 ClinX-PRISM——一种带隐私导向后处理的无跳跃（no-skip）生成式修复模块——来抑制烧录式标识符；文本侧采用三种渐进去标识化层级：正则掩码、上下文感知掩码和基于重写的净化。
Result: 在 MedVQA 的联合评估中，OCR-only 掩码作为独立方案不够充分，而基于修复的净化方法在显著减少可恢复 PHI 的同时，更好地保留了临床相关的视觉上下文。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多模态去标识化应结合文本与图像侧的多种净化手段，且生成式修复相比单纯掩码能更平衡地兼顾隐私保护与下游医学推理效用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Root cause analysis via difference graph discovery from linear time-series data
papers.abstract_en: Root cause analysis aims to identify the mechanisms responsible for anomalies in complex dynamical systems. In this paper, we study root cause analysis in linear time-series through the lens of difference graph discovery. We focus on effect-defying root causes, corresponding to variables whose causal coefficients change between a normal and an anomalous regime. We formalize this problem using linear discrete-time dynamic structural causal models and adapt several methods originally introduced for discovering difference graphs between two populations to the time-series setting, where the two populations are replaced by a normal and an anomalous regime. We first evaluate the proposed approaches on simulated data, and then demonstrate their practical relevance on real-world datasets from IT monitoring and intensive care monitoring. Our results show how difference graph discovery can help localize causal mechanisms responsible for anomalous behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究线性时间序列中的根因分析，将其建模为差异图发现问题，并针对效应违抗型根因（因果系数在正常与异常机制间变化）提出形式化框架。作者将原本用于两群体差异图发现的方法适配到时间序列场景，在模拟数据和IT监控、重症监护监控的真实数据上评估，结果显示差异图发现有助于定位异常行为的因果机制。
Motivation: 复杂动态系统中的异常根因识别具有实际重要性，现有方法多针对静态或特定场景，缺乏将差异图发现推广到时间序列异常机制的系统研究。
Method: 使用线性离散时间动态结构因果模型形式化问题，将正常与异常两种机制视为两个群体，把多种差异图发现算法适配到时间序列设定。
Result: 在模拟数据上评估所提方法，并在IT监控和重症监护监控真实数据集上展示其实际可用性，结果说明差异图发现能辅助定位异常行为的因果机制。
Conclusion: 作者认为差异图发现为时间序列根因分析提供了有效视角，尤其适用于因果系数变化的效应违抗型根因场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CIVA: Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks on Visual World-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Visual world-model agents such as DreamerV3 act through a recurrent latent state rather than a single observation, which weakens frame-wise observation attacks and makes their perturbations vary sharply over time under a strict per-frame perturbation constraint. We study white-box, causal, online attacks on such agents and propose Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks (\textbf{CIVA}). Our key observation is that, along a rollout, critic-guided perturbations concentrate in a low-dimensional subspace induced by the victim's own critic. Based on this observation, CIVA first probes the frozen victim offline with critic-guided PGD and extracts a low-rank value-subspace by SVD. At test time, it optimizes only the subspace coefficients, smooths them with an exponential moving average (EMA), and maps them back to pixels. This design attacks value-sensitive recurrent dynamics while keeping the online optimization cheap and temporally coherent. Extensive experiments on DMC walker walk, Atari Pong, and Crafter show that CIVA consistently outperforms five recent methods; on DMC walker walk, it achieves the largest reward drop of 26.07\% while keeping temporal variation low, with TempAbs of 0.646.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉世界模型智能体（如 DreamerV3）在白盒、因果、在线攻击下的脆弱性。作者提出 Critic-Induced Value-Subspace Attacks (CIVA)，利用沿轨迹 critic 引导的对抗扰动集中在低维子空间这一观察，通过离线 SVD 提取值子空间，在线仅优化子空间系数并用 EMA 平滑，从而产生时间连贯的像素扰动。实验在 DMC walker walk、Atari Pong 和 Crafter 上表明 CIVA 优于五种近期方法，并在 DMC walker walk 上取得最大奖励下降 26.07%，同时保持较低的时间变化（TempAbs 0.646）。
Motivation: 现有逐帧观测攻击对基于循环潜在状态行动的世界模型智能体效果有限，且严格逐帧扰动约束下扰动随时间剧烈变化。需要一种能攻击值敏感循环动态、同时保持在线优化廉价和时间连贯的攻击方法。
Method: CIVA 先离线用 critic 引导的 PGD 探测冻结的受害者模型，并通过 SVD 提取低秩值子空间；测试时仅优化子空间系数，用指数移动平均（EMA）平滑，再映射回像素空间。
Result: 在 DMC walker walk、Atari Pong 和 Crafter 上的实验显示 CIVA 一致优于五种近期方法；在 DMC walker walk 上取得最大奖励下降 26.07%，TempAbs 为 0.646，表明时间变化较低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用受害者自身 critic 诱导的低维值子空间可以高效生成时间连贯的对抗扰动，攻击价值敏感的循环动态。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Remote sensing of the temporal and spatial variability of atmospheric refractivity using ADS-B interferometry (ADSBi)
papers.abstract_en: The extreme variability of humidity in the lower atmosphere over short spatial and temporal scales presents an enormous challenge for existing observing systems. Variations in humidity can be detected due to changes in the refractive properties of the atmosphere, which influence the propagation of electromagnetic radiation. We demonstrate the ability to retrieve high-resolution refractivity gradient measurements using an interferometer to measure the refraction of the Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) radio transmission routinely broadcast by commercial aircraft. The ADS-B interferometry (ADSBi) technique is sensitive to small-scale spatial and temporal variability in the refractivity gradient due to changes in humidity. We demonstrate how the retrieval of refractivity profiles is possible exploiting the differences in the observed refraction of radio transmissions broadcast by aircraft at different distances and altitudes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用干涉仪测量商用飞机常规播发的ADS-B无线电信号在大气中的折射，借此反演低层大气折射率梯度的高分辨率时空变化。作者展示ADS-B干涉测量（ADSBi）对湿度变化引起的小尺度折射率梯度变率敏感，并能利用不同距离与高度飞机信号的折射差异反演折射率剖面。该技术面向现有观测系统难以捕捉的低层湿度短时空尺度变率问题。
Motivation: 低层大气湿度在短时间与小空间尺度上变化剧烈，现有观测系统难以捕捉；而湿度变化会改变大气折射性质并影响电磁波传播，为遥感探测提供了物理基础。
Method: 采用干涉仪测量商用飞机例行广播的ADS-B无线电传输的折射，形成ADSBi技术；通过联合不同距离和高度的飞机广播所观测到的折射差异，反演大气折射率梯度甚至折射率剖面。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能够获取高分辨率折射率梯度测量，且对湿度引起的折射率梯度小尺度时空变率敏感；并演示了从多距离、多高度飞机信号中反演折射率剖面的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ADSBi可作为现有观测系统的补充手段，用于感知低层大气的快速湿度变化；但未给出定量精度评估或与业务观测系统的直接对比。
Relevance: 75

papers.title: Large Language Models at the Intersection of Software Engineering and Software Security:An Evidence-Centered Structured Survey and Research Agenda
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are moving from code completion toward repository-scale agents that retrieve context, edit files, execute tools, and participate in security-sensitive workflows. The evidence for these systems, however, remains divided between software engineering evaluations centered on functional task completion and software security evaluations centered on vulnerability detection, secure generation, or exploit-oriented validation. This evidence-centered structured survey synthesizes representative work available through May 31, 2026 across software engineering tasks, software security tasks, adaptation mechanisms, artifact granularity, and evaluation design. In addition to a task taxonomy, we introduce an assurance framework that separates functional correctness, security, operational reliability, evidence provenance, and agent authority. The review shows that execution feedback and repository access can substantially improve engineering task completion, but do not by themselves establish security; conversely, static-analysis labels or vulnerability-classification scores rarely establish deployable correctness. We identify recurring validity threats--weak test oracles, duplicated and temporally leaked data, changing agent harnesses, proxy-only security checks, and under-reported budgets and human intervention--and derive a minimum reporting protocol for cross-study comparison. The resulting research agenda prioritizes jointly secure-and-functional benchmarks, repository-scale threat models, calibrated human oversight, longitudinal maintainability evidence, and reproducible agent evaluation. The central conclusion is that model capability should be judged as an assurance case supported by task-appropriate evidence, rather than by a single benchmark score.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇以证据为中心的结构化综述 (structured survey)，整合截至 2026 年 5 月 31 日关于大语言模型在软件工程与软件安全交叉领域的代表性工作，涵盖软件工程任务、软件安全任务、适配机制、工件粒度与评测设计。作者提出任务分类体系 (task taxonomy) 和一个将功能正确性、安全性、运行可靠性、证据溯源与智能体权限相分离的保证框架 (assurance framework)。综述发现执行反馈与仓库访问能显著提升工程任务完成度，但本身不足以建立安全性；同时识别出常见有效性威胁并推导出跨研究比较的最低报告协议。
Motivation: LLM 正从代码补全走向可检索上下文、编辑文件、执行工具并参与安全敏感工作流的仓库级智能体 (repository-scale agents)，但相关证据分散在软件工程（功能任务完成）与软件安全（漏洞检测、安全生成、利用导向验证）两个评估社群中，缺乏统一的、可跨研究比较的证据组织方式。
Method: 采用证据为中心的综述方法，对软件工程任务、软件安全任务、适配机制、工件粒度和评测设计五个维度进行系统综合；在任务分类之外提出了包含功能正确性、安全性、运行可靠性、证据溯源和智能体权限五个维度的保证框架，并基于对有效性威胁的分析给出最低报告协议。
Result: 综述表明执行反馈和仓库访问可以大幅改善工程任务完成，但并不能单独建立安全性；反之，静态分析标签或漏洞分类分数也很少能证明可部署的正确性。作者还归纳出反复出现的有效性威胁，包括弱测试预言 (weak test oracles)、重复与时间泄漏数据、变化的智能体 harness、仅代理式安全检查，以及预算和人工干预报告不足。
Conclusion: 核心结论是模型能力应被评判为一种由任务匹配证据支撑的保证案例 (assurance case)，而非单一基准分数。据此提出的研究议程优先关注兼具安全与功能的联合基准、仓库级威胁模型、校准化的人工监督、纵向可维护性证据和可复现的智能体评估。
Relevance: 5
