summary_sections.result: 综述表明执行反馈和仓库访问可以大幅改善工程任务完成，但并不能单独建立安全性；反之，静态分析标签或漏洞分类分数也很少能证明可部署的正确性。作者还归纳出反复出现的有效性威胁，包括弱测试预言 (weak test oracles)、重复与时间泄漏数据、变化的智能体 harness、仅代理式安全检查，以及预算和人工干预报告不足。
summary_sections.conclusion: 核心结论是模型能力应被评判为一种由任务匹配证据支撑的保证案例 (assurance case)，而非单一基准分数。据此提出的研究议程优先关注兼具安全与功能的联合基准、仓库级威胁模型、校准化的人工监督、纵向可维护性证据和可复现的智能体评估。

papers.title: Atom Learning Model (ALM): how a real classroom got tokenised
papers.abstract_en: The Atom Learning Model (ALM) tokenises a school curriculum. Two secondary mathematics textbooks were read by machine into 1,934 atoms, each one thing a learner can do in a single step, ordered by 4,616 machine-written prerequisite links. Both sides of a lesson are then expressed in that one structure: a question is a set of atoms plus everything beneath them, a child's ability is a score between 0 and 1 on every atom of the same graph, and whether a question suits a child is arithmetic over one index, with no difficulty parameter fitted for either side. Nobody wrote an atom, a link or a question. Reading the 757 pages cost £55, building the whole structure cost between £615 and £1,230, and against it the system composed 6,648 questions for 373 children in two English secondary schools over seven weeks, at 26p per composed question. Four measurements went against expectation. The cost is in the links, not the pages. The composer's own difficulty label has a rank correlation of -0.0123 with measured facility, so a language model shown a question cannot say how hard it is. Children stop working when a mark takes seven seconds instead of three. And the deployment never served a question deeper than two prerequisite steps, which is exactly where the central premise becomes testable, leaving it unfalsified rather than confirmed.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 13 figures. Companion data: https://github.com/philippbogdan/atom-learning-model. Interactive view of the catalogue: https://philippbogdan.com/atoms
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Atom Learning Model (ALM)，将学校课程 token 化：两本中学数学教科书被机器读取为 1,934 个原子，每个原子是学习者单步可完成的一件事，并由 4,616 条机器生成的先决条件链接排序。题目、学生能力与匹配判断都在同一张 atom 图上用算术表达，不需要为题目或学生拟合难度参数。系统在英格兰两所中学七周内为 373 名学生生成了 6,648 道题，作者报告了多项与预期相反的测量结果。
Motivation: 该工作试图统一表示课程内容、题目难度与学生能力，使题目适配判断无需分别为题目侧和学生侧拟合难度参数，并探索以极低成本自动构建教学结构。
Method: 先将两本中学数学教科书共 757 页机器读取为 1,934 个原子，并以 4,616 条先决链接建立图结构；一道题被定义为某个原子集合及其下层所有原子，一个学生的能力是该图上每个原子的 0 到 1 分数，题目是否适合学生则由单一指标的算术计算决定。作者声称没有人工编写任何原子、链接或题目，全部构建成本在 £615 到 £1,230 之间。
Result: 系统在七周内为 373 名学生组成 6,648 道题，每道题成本约 26p；四项测量与预期相反：成本主要来自链接而非页面；composer 自己的难度标签与实测难度秩相关为 -0.0123，说明语言模型看到题目也无法判断其难度；当完成一个标记所需时间由 3 秒变为 7 秒时学生会停止作答；实际部署从未给出超过两层先决步骤的题目。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ALM 的核心前提——深层先决链路的作用——恰好落在部署从未覆盖的范围内，因此该前提只能说是未被证伪而非得到确认；这一限制使得模型的关键主张仍待检验。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ClawSentry: A Progressive Multi-Tier Security Monitor for Safeguarding Autonomous LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: As large language model (LLM) agents move from conversation to executing code, reading local files, and orchestrating external tools, a single agent hijacked by a malicious third-party skill can cause data exfiltration, privilege escalation, or cascading compromise. We argue that agentic risk is progressive: it can enter at four loci of the agent control loop--skill admission, invocation-time intent, execution-time effect, and post-action consequence--while a denied dangerous objective can reappear across surface forms, tools, or turns; existing safeguards are typically local to one lifecycle boundary or one call. Guided by this threat model, we present ClawSentry, an open-source, framework-agnostic security supervision gateway for agent runtimes. Before a skill package is ever executed, First-use Skill Package Review (FSPR) audits it under a deterministic evidence floor, escalating unresolved cases to bounded read-only agentic review (locus A). At runtime, a three-tier progressive decision engine--a deterministic L1 layer, a rule-anchored L2 semantic reviewer, and a read-only L3 evidence-seeking agent--spends contextual review only on the residual ambiguity, while a session-level anti-bypass mechanism recognizes tool-switching and rephrased retries (loci B--C); a post-action path feeds high-severity evidence non-retroactively into later review (locus D). An Agent Harness Protocol (AHP) abstraction applies one policy across Codex, Claude Code, Kimi CLI, and Gemini CLI without modifying agent internals. On SkillInject with Codex/GPT-5.4, contextual ASR falls from 39.55% to 2.61% while contextual TSR moves only from 83.78% to 83.05%. Across five Work Agents on the full SkillsSafety benchmark, ClawSentry confines ASR to 9.09--15.03% from 33.5--49.7% unprotected, and aggregate TSR on clean skills remains 98.7%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ClawSentry，一个开源、框架无关的 LLM 智能体（agent）运行时安全监督网关。作者将智能体风险建模为渐进式威胁，指出风险可出现在控制回路的四个位置（技能准入、调用时意图、执行时效果、行动后后果），而现有防护通常只覆盖单个生命周期边界或单次调用。ClawSentry 通过技能包首次使用审查（FSPR）、三级渐进决策引擎、会话级反绕过机制以及智能体防护协议（AHP）统一防护 Codex、Claude Code、Kimi CLI 和 Gemini CLI。在 SkillInject 基准上，上下文 ASR 从 39.55% 降至 2.61%，TSR 仅从 83.78% 微降至 83.05%。
Motivation: LLM 智能体从对话转向执行代码、读取本地文件与编排外部工具后，被恶意第三方技能劫持的单个智能体可能造成数据泄露、权限提升或级联破坏。现有防护通常只针对某一生命周期边界或某一次调用，难以应对危险目标以不同表面形式、工具或轮次重出现的渐进式风险。
Method: ClawSentry 是框架无关的安全监督网关：技能包执行前由 First-use Skill Package Review（FSPR）在确定性证据下限下审计，未解决案例升级到有界的只读智能体审查（locus A）；运行时采用三级渐进决策引擎——确定性 L1 层、规则锚定的 L2 语义审查器、只读的 L3 证据搜寻智能体——仅对残余歧义花费上下文审查，同时会话级反绕过机制识别工具切换与改写重试（loci B–C）；行动后路径将高严重性证据非追溯地送入后续审查（locus D）。Agent Harness Protocol（AHP）抽象在不修改智能体内部的前提下对 Codex、Claude Code、Kimi CLI、Gemini CLI 应用同一策略。
Result: 在 SkillInject 与 Codex/GPT-5.4 上，上下文 ASR 从 39.55% 降到 2.61%，而上下文 TSR 只从 83.78% 变为 83.05%。在完整 SkillsSafety 基准的五个 Work Agent 上，ClawSentry 将 ASR 限制在 9.09–15.03%（未防护时为 33.5–49.7%），干净技能上的聚合 TSR 保持在 98.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为智能体风险是渐进式的，防护需要覆盖四个控制回路位置；ClawSentry 表明只在残余歧义上花费上下文审查并结合会话级反绕过，可以在不牺牲干净技能任务成功率的前提下大幅降低攻击成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReFrame: Evidence-Guided Test-Time Safety Alignment in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) extend model capabilities beyond text, they also make safety alignment increasingly challenging. Multimodal safety alignment methods must address cross-modal jailbreaks, safety-awareness failures, and over-sensitive refusals. However, existing methods often rely on retraining or internal-state inspection, limiting their applicability to deployed closed-source MLLMs and motivating test-time safety alignment. We analyze this setting and identify two key obstacles, utility dominance and reasoning inertia, which cause models to overlook latent risks or follow malicious reasoning trajectories. Guided by these insights, we propose ReFrame, a training-free multimodal input reframing framework where two agents share a lightweight locally deployed MLLM: the evidence-generation agent constructs complementary risk and utility evidence, and the rewrite-and-routing agent converts it into a safe proxy prompt and image-routing decision before calling the downstream MLLM, without modifying it or accessing its internal information. Experiments across multiple MLLMs and benchmarks show that ReFrame improves jailbreak defense, safety awareness, and oversensitivity reduction while preserving multimodal utility.
papers.comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 22 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReFrame，一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的免训练测试时安全对齐框架。ReFrame 由两个智能体共享一个轻量级本地部署的 MLLM：证据生成智能体构建互补的风险与效用证据，改写与路由智能体将其转换为安全的代理提示（proxy prompt）和图像路由决策，再调用下游 MLLM，全程不修改模型也不访问其内部信息。实验显示该方法在多个 MLLM 和基准上改善了越狱防御、安全意识和过度敏感拒绝，同时保持多模态效用。
Motivation: 现有多模态安全对齐方法多依赖重训练或内部状态检查，难以用于已部署的闭源 MLLM，因此需要测试时安全对齐。作者分析后识别出两个关键障碍——效用主导（utility dominance）和推理惯性（reasoning inertia），它们使模型忽略潜在风险或沿恶意推理轨迹前进。
Method: ReFrame 是训练免费的输入重框定（input reframing）框架，由两个智能体协作：证据生成智能体生成互补的风险和效用证据，改写与路由智能体将这些证据整合为安全的代理提示并做出图像路由决策，随后调用下游 MLLM，不修改其参数或访问其内部信息。
Result: 摘要报告在多个 MLLM 和基准上的实验显示，ReFrame 在保持多模态效用的同时，提升了越狱防御能力、安全意识和过度敏感拒绝的缓解效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于证据的输入重框定能在不接触模型内部的前提下实现有效的测试时安全对齐，特别适用于闭源部署的 MLLM；对效用主导和推理惯性这两个障碍的分析是设计框架的依据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A2DINOv3: Rethinking Multi-Modal Object Detection via Socialized Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal object detection is essential for robust scene understanding in challenging conditions, including low-light and adverse environments. Recent vision foundation models (e.g., DINOv3) have exhibited strong representation capabilities, yet adapting them to multi-modal scenarios remains challenging. Existing dense cross-modal fusion strategies often force heterogeneous modalities to interact indiscriminately, which may introduce redundant information and disrupt the valuable pre-trained representations. To address this issue, we revisit multi-modal fusion from the perspective of socialized learning and propose adapter to DINOv3 (A2DINOv3), a multi-expert collaboration framework with a Socialized Collaboration Protocol (SCP). Specifically, RGB and infrared branches are modeled as heterogeneous experts that independently preserve their specialized knowledge while exchanging complementary information through selective and constrained interactions. This design mitigates harmful cross-modal interference and prevents degradation of pre-trained priors during adaptation. Furthermore, a zero-initialization strategy is introduced to gradually activate cross-modal collaboration, enabling a smooth transition from modality-specific learning to cooperative representation learning. Extensive experiments on four multi-modal benchmarks, including aerial detection (GAIIC), autonomous driving (FLIR), low-light surveillance (LLVIP), and diverse real-world scenarios (M3FD), demonstrate that A2DINOv3 consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in multi-modal object detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 A2DINOv3，一个基于 DINOv3 的多模态目标检测框架，通过社会化协作协议（SCP）将 RGB 与红外分支建模为异构专家，独立保持各自专有知识的同时进行选择性受限交互，并用零初始化策略逐步激活跨模态协作。在 GAIIC、FLIR、LLVIP、M3FD 四个多模态基准上，摘要称该方法一致取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有密集跨模态融合策略强制异构模态无差别交互，容易引入冗余信息并破坏视觉基础模型（如 DINOv3）已学到的预训练表示，因此需要一种更温和的协作方式来适配多模态检测。
Method: 提出多专家协作框架 A2DINOv3，其核心是 Socialized Collaboration Protocol (SCP)：RGB 与红外分支作为异构专家，通过选择性、受约束的交互交换互补信息；同时引入零初始化（zero-initialization）策略，使跨模态协作逐步激活，从模态特化学习平滑过渡到协作表示学习。
Result: 在四个多模态基准上均达到最先进性能：航拍检测 GAIIC、自动驾驶 FLIR、低光监控 LLVIP 以及多样真实场景 M3FD。

papers.title: When does fusing hand-crafted knowledge with learned representations pay? A cost-normalized benchmark of stacking, substitution, and interference
papers.abstract_en: Fusing prior knowledge with data-driven learning is attractive where data is scarce, yet no controlled account says when it helps, is redundant, or harms. We benchmark one fixed hand-crafted knowledge source, a pinned bank of Gabor targets injected only during training at $\sim$2\% overhead, against data-driven alternatives (SimCLR, SimSiam, DINO, ImageNet transfer, augmentation, learned teachers) under one frozen recipe with fixed subsets: 13 datasets, 9 backbones, 150 to 1.28M images, 32--224\,px, 2.5M--86M parameters ($\computeCells$ classification configurations over $\computeRuns$ runs, plus segmentation and detection transplants). Across the training-time combinations we measure, three outcomes recur (decision-level fusion differs). Different-\emph{currency} sources can stack: the prior composes with DeiT augmentation on attention backbones and is worth $+26$ points to ViT-B/16 at $224$\,px, $+6.7$ at twice that budget. Same-currency sources substitute: against effective self-supervised pretraining, the combination never usefully exceeds the better single source. Fusing at full strength into an already-informed initialization interferes in proportion to what it carries: ImageNet transfer, $-15$ to $-17$ points, removed by a weaker auxiliary weight. Frozen-feature diagnostics measured on each source alone separate these outcomes retrospectively but do not predict them: a rule built on them calls one of nine unseen pairs. At a practitioner's own label budget, the frozen-feature gain predicts the end-to-end gain to within $0.17$ points across 30 cells and seven datasets; the underlying decomposition, $Δ= G + \readout(\mathrm{base})$, holds in sign on $\auditRate\%$ of testable cells and is called an unseen backbone family's feature gain in advance. The project page is https://amughrabi.github.io/MomentAux.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在统一训练配方和固定数据子集下，系统基准测试将手工先验知识（一个固定的 Gabor 滤波器库，仅在训练时注入，约 2% 开销）与数据驱动表示融合的效果。实验覆盖 13 个数据集、9 个骨干网络、150 到 1.28M 张图像、32--224px 分辨率、2.5M--86M 参数，并包含分割与检测迁移。摘要归纳出三种重复出现的结果：不同“货币”来源可堆叠，同“货币”来源相互替代，全强度融合到已有初始化的表示会产生干扰。
Motivation: 在数据稀缺时，将先验知识与数据驱动学习融合很有吸引力，但缺乏受控的定量研究说明何时有帮助、何时冗余或有害。
Method: 固定一个手工知识源（Gabor 滤波器库，仅训练时注入，约 2% 开销），在冻结的训练配方和固定数据子集下，与数据驱动替代方案（SimCLR、SimSiam、DINO、ImageNet 迁移、增强、学习教师）对比，跨越 13 个数据集、9 个骨干网络等，并做分割和检测迁移实验。
Result: 不同“货币”来源可以堆叠：先验与 DeiT 增强在注意力骨干上组合，在 224px 下对 ViT-B/16 提升 +26 点，预算加倍时 +6.7 点；同“货币”来源则替代，与有效自监督预训练组合从不显著超过更好的单一来源；全强度融合到已初始化表示会产生按携带量成比例的干扰，ImageNet 迁移为 -15 到 -17 点，弱辅助权重可消除该干扰。冻结特征诊断可事后区分结果但不能预测（9 个未见对中只判对 1 个）；但在实践者标签预算下，冻结特征增益可预测端到端增益，在 30 个单元和 7 个数据集上平均误差为 0.17 点，分解式 Δ = G + readout(base) 在 auditRate% 的可测试单元上符号成立。
Conclusion: 融合收益取决于来源的“货币”类型：不同来源可堆叠、同来源相互替代、过度融合干扰；冻结特征诊断只能事后解释而非预测结果，而在标签预算约束下冻结特征增益可用于近似预测端到端增益。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-Judge systems can produce multi-dimensional evaluations, such as trustworthiness, reliability, and factuality, and these outputs are often interpreted as independent evidence. We test this assumption for a common pair of judgments: trust scoring and binary truth classification. On correctness-controlled QA, LLM judges align trust scores with truth verdicts more tightly than human behavioral reference, suggesting weaker separations between trust and truth judgment. We then apply stress tests by changing only source cues of identical QA between Human and AI. Source attribution shifts not only trust scores but also truth verdicts and logit-derived correct-side probabilities. Results show that current LLM-as-Judge protocols should not treat trust scores as independent evidence for truth judgments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑 LLM-as-Judge 系统中将多维评估（如信任评分与二元真实性判断）视为独立证据的做法。在正确性受控的 QA 上，LLM 法官的信任评分与真实性判定之间的对齐程度高于人类行为参考，说明二者分离较弱；对相同 QA 仅改变来源线索的压力测试表明，来源归因不仅改变信任评分，也改变真实性判定及其 logit 层面的正确侧概率。作者据此认为现有 LLM-as-Judge 协议不应把信任评分当作真实性判断的独立证据。
Motivation: LLM-as-Judge 系统可输出可信度、可靠性、事实性等多维评估，这些输出常被视为相互独立的证据；该假设若成立与否，直接影响审判结果的可靠性。
Method: 在正确性受控的 QA 数据上比较 LLM 法官与人类行为参考的信任-真实一致性；对完全相同 QA 仅变换人类与 AI 来源线索进行压力测试，观察信任评分、真实判定及 logit 推导的正确侧概率变化。
Result: LLM 法官的信任评分与真实判定之间的对齐比人类行为参考更紧密；来源归因的单一变化会同时改变信任评分、真实性判定和 logit 层面的概率，说明信任与真实判断并未充分分离。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM-as-Judge 协议不应将信任评分视为真实性判断的独立证据，评估设计需重新考虑维度间的依赖关系。

papers.title: FlatLand: Personalized Graph Federated Learning via Tailored Lorentz Space
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning enables privacy-preserving collaborative training, but highly heterogeneous client data remain challenging, especially in graph federated learning where clients possess structurally diverse graphs. Existing personalized federated learning (PFL) methods ignore the intrinsic geometric properties of diverse graph structures. We propose FlatLand, a novel personalized federated learning method that embeds different clients' data in tailored Lorentz space of hyperbolic geometry. Our key insight is that hyperbolic geometry naturally accommodates the intrinsic negative curvature prevalent in real-world graphs, while the time-like dimension in Lorentz space provides a principled way to encode client-specific heterogeneity. We develop a parameter decoupling strategy that separates heterogeneous information (captured in time-like parameters) from common knowledge (preserved in space-like parameters), enabling direct aggregation without requiring client similarity estimation and extra calculation modules. Empirical results on diverse federated graph learning tasks demonstrate that FlatLand achieves superior performance, particularly in low-dimensional settings.
papers.comment: 34 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026 (Oral)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlatLand，一种面向个性化图联邦学习 (personalized graph federated learning) 的新方法，将不同客户端的图数据嵌入双曲几何中定制的 Lorentz 空间。其核心思想是利用 Lorentz 空间中的类时维度 (time-like dimension) 编码客户端异质性，并采用参数解耦策略将异质信息与公共知识分离，从而无需客户端相似度估计即可直接聚合。摘要报告在多种联邦图学习任务上取得更优性能，尤其在低维设置下。
Motivation: 现有个性化联邦学习方法忽视了异构图结构内在的几何属性，难以处理客户端数据高度异质且图结构多样的场景。
Method: 提出将客户端数据嵌入定制的 Lorentz 空间，利用双曲几何适配真实世界图的负曲率特性；同时设计参数解耦策略，将异质信息放入类时参数、公共知识保留在类空参数中，实现无需相似度估计和额外计算模块的直接聚合。
Result: 摘要称在多种联邦图学习任务上优于现有方法，尤其在低维嵌入设置下表现突出。
Conclusion: 作者强调双曲几何的类时维度为编码客户端异质性提供了原则性途径，参数解耦使得聚合更简洁高效。

papers.title: Trustworthy RAG: An Evaluation Agent for Detecting Misinformation and Knowledge Poisoning in Generative AI Systems
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounds Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in external knowledge, but RAG systems usually trust whatever they retrieve, creating a Security-Reliability Gap: high semantic relevance does not guarantee factual truth. Adversaries exploit this through knowledge poisoning, inserting malicious documents to cause targeted misinformation. We propose an Evaluation Agent, middleware that combines Natural Language Inference (NLI) factual verification, a five-signal poison detector with relevance-weighted aggregation, and a Trust Index T = 0.4 F + 0.35 C + 0.25 (1 - P ) with a non-linear dampener for high-contamination contexts. On TruthfulQA with Llama 3.3 70B, the agent reaches 91% accuracy and 100% precision, with 100% recall on instruction injection, while in-place edits, such as entity swaps, remain hard to detect. Across three LLMs the Trust Index stays discriminative, with a Receiver Operating Characteristic Area Under the Curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.73 to 0.81; generation style matters more than model size, and per-LLM threshold calibration restores baseline competitive accuracy, whereas a weaker FEVER result shows that cross-dataset generalization requires domain-specific calibration. In a software-engineering use case, a secure-coding assistant over guidance from the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 and the Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE), the agent reliably blocks instruction injection of unsafe advice (F1 92%), while contradiction and subtle semantic weakening remain hard. Throughout, the agent measures detection of poisoned context before generation, not whether the LLM adopts the injected misinformation. We release the proposed approach, attack generator, and experimental artifacts at the link: https://github.com/GPT-Laboratory/TrustworthyRAG.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Accepted for publication in the Main Research Track of the Twenty-First International Conference on Software Engineering Advances (ICSEA 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个用于检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统的评测智能体，专门检测由知识投毒 (knowledge poisoning) 引起的虚假信息。该智能体作为中间件，结合自然语言推理 (NLI) 事实验证、带相关性加权聚合的五信号投毒检测器，以及一个含非线性阻尼项的信任指数 T = 0.4F + 0.35C + 0.25(1-P)。在 TruthfulQA 与 Llama 3.3 70B 上达到 91% 准确率与 100% 精确率，对指令注入的召回率为 100%，但实体替换等原位编辑仍难检测；跨三个 LLM 的信任指数保持判别力，ROC-AUC 为 0.73–0.81。
Motivation: RAG 系统通常信任检索到的任何内容，导致高语义相关性并不保证事实真实性，形成安全-可靠性鸿沟 (Security-Reliability Gap)。攻击者可通过知识投毒注入恶意文档来制造定向虚假信息，现有系统缺少在生成前识别污染上下文的机制。
Method: 提出一个评测智能体，作为 RAG 与 LLM 之间的中间件；它包含 NLI 事实验证、一个带相关性加权聚合的五信号投毒检测器，以及由事实性 F、一致性 C 与污染概率 P 加权组合的信任指数 T，并对高污染场景加入非线性阻尼器。
Result: 在 TruthfulQA 上配合 Llama 3.3 70B 达到 91% 准确率和 100% 精确率，指令注入的召回率为 100%，但原位编辑（如实体替换）难以检测。在三个 LLM 上信任指数的 ROC-AUC 为 0.73–0.81，生成风格比模型规模影响更大，按 LLM 校准阈值可恢复基线水平的竞争性准确率；FEVER 结果较弱，表明跨数据集泛化需要领域特定校准。在软件工程用例中，基于 OWASP Top 10 与 CWE 的安全编码助手可可靠阻止不安全建议的指令注入 (F1 92%)，但矛盾与细微语义弱化仍难处理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该智能体测量的是生成前对污染上下文的检测，而非 LLM 是否采纳注入的虚假信息。跨数据集泛化需要领域特定校准，实体替换、矛盾与细微语义弱化仍是难以覆盖的攻击类型；作者公开了方法、攻击生成器与实验工件。

summary_sections.motivation: RAG 系统通常信任检索到的任何内容，导致高语义相关性并不保证事实真实性，形成安全-可靠性鸿沟 (Security-Reliability Gap)。攻击者可通过知识投毒注入恶意文档来制造定向虚假信息，现有系统缺少在生成前识别污染上下文的机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出一个评测智能体，作为 RAG 与 LLM 之间的中间件；它包含 NLI 事实验证、一个带相关性加权聚合的五信号投毒检测器，以及由事实性 F、一致性 C 与污染概率 P 加权组合的信任指数 T，并对高污染场景加入非线性阻尼器。
summary_sections.result: 在 TruthfulQA 上配合 Llama 3.3 70B 达到 91% 准确率和 100% 精确率，指令注入的召回率为 100%，但原位编辑（如实体替换）难以检测。在三个 LLM 上信任指数的 ROC-AUC 为 0.73–0.81，生成风格比模型规模影响更大，按 LLM 校准阈值可恢复基线水平的竞争性准确率；FEVER 结果较弱，表明跨数据集泛化需要领域特定校准。在软件工程用例中，基于 OWASP Top 10 与 CWE 的安全编码助手可可靠阻止不安全建议的指令注入 (F1 92%)，但矛盾与细微语义弱化仍难处理。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该智能体测量的是生成前对污染上下文的检测，而非 LLM 是否采纳注入的虚假信息。跨数据集泛化需要领域特定校准，实体替换、矛盾与细微语义弱化仍是难以覆盖的攻击类型；作者公开了方法、攻击生成器与实验工件。

papers.title: Gaussian-Mixture Latent Flow for Stochastic 3D Human Motion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic human motion prediction aims to forecast future motion distributions. Although recent studies have achieved strong performance in terms of accuracy and diversity, they often overlook plausibility (e.g., resulting in physically unrealistic predictions) and uncertainty quantification, both of which are essential for real-world applications and downstream tasks. To address these issues, we propose a latent flow-based model equipped with a data-driven Gaussian mixture prior that more effectively disentangles diverse human behaviors than conventional single-modal priors. This prior is derived from patterns in the training data without requiring additional annotations. Furthermore, the fully invertible nature of our model enables natural uncertainty quantification through tractable likelihood computation. Experiments on the Human3.6M and AMASS datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance in both accuracy and plausibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于潜流 (latent flow) 的随机 3D 人体运动预测模型，其核心是数据驱动的混合高斯先验 (Gaussian mixture prior)，用于更好地区分多样化的人体行为，并利用模型的完全可逆性通过可解析的似然计算进行不确定性量化。在 Human3.6M 和 AMASS 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和合理性 (plausibility) 上均达到最先进水平。
Motivation: 现有随机人体运动预测方法虽在准确性和多样性上表现良好，但常忽略预测的物理合理性和不确定性量化，而这两者对实际应用和下游任务至关重要。
Method: 提出基于流的潜变量模型，使用从训练数据中学习的混合高斯先验替代传统单模态先验，以更有效地解耦不同的人体行为；模型完全可逆，因此能够通过可计算的似然实现自然的不确定性量化。
Result: 在 Human3.6M 和 AMASS 数据集上的实验表明，该方法在准确性和合理性方面均取得最先进水平 (state-of-the-art) 的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，数据驱动的混合高斯先验与可逆潜流模型的结合，可以在不依赖额外标注的情况下同时改善随机运动预测的合理性、多样性表现以及不确定性量化能力。

papers.title: Can Legal AI Know When It Is Wrong? And Do Students Know When It Is?
papers.abstract_en: Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into the Indian judiciary promises access to justice but introduces severe risks. We identify the 'inertia of confidence'--an overconfidence phenomenon analogous to the Dunning-Kruger effect where LLMs provide incorrect legal verdicts with near-maximum confidence, driven by a hypothesized 'precedent overfitting' bias. Phase I of our socio-technical audit tested ChatGPT (GPT-5.2), Meta AI, and Perplexity AI on a 60-case battery regarding the Indian Contract Act, 1872, and the shift toward statutory enforcement of specific performance. We introduce the High-Confidence Error Rate (HCER) to quantify incorrect verdicts delivered with dangerous certainty (>= 9 on a 1-10 scale). All models struggled with statutory updates. Meta AI proved most vulnerable (31.7% HCER), frequently misapplying pre-amendment rules with a 9.1/10 mean confidence, followed by Perplexity (15.0%) and ChatGPT (6.7%). Phase II investigated human vulnerability to this overconfidence via a survey of Indian law students (N=380). Verification often functions as a reactive adaptation to machine hallucinations: students encountering fabricated citations reported higher verification scores (4.2/5) than those with no such encounters (2.8/5). Furthermore, while 81.6% knew submitting hallucinated cases can lead to contempt-of-court, 71.1% received no formal training on ethical AI use. We propose shifting toward adversarial legal research pedagogy and implementing source-grounded verification architectures to prevent systemic professional negligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对将大语言模型 (LLM) 引入印度司法系统的风险进行社会技术审计，提出“信心惯性”(inertia of confidence) 这一类比 Dunning-Kruger 效应的过度自信现象：模型在给出错误法律判决时仍表现出接近最高水平的置信度，作者假设其源于“先例过拟合”(precedent overfitting)。第一阶段的审计在 60 个涉及印度 1872 年《合同法》(Indian Contract Act, 1872) 及特定履行法定强制化转向的案例上测试了 ChatGPT (GPT-5.2)、Meta AI 和 Perplexity AI，并提出高置信错误率 (HCER) 来衡量以危险确定性给出的错误判决。第二阶段通过对 380 名印度法学学生的调查考察人类对这一过度自信的脆弱性。
Motivation: 将 LLM 引入印度司法系统有望促进诉诸正义，但会带来严重风险；模型会对错误法律结论表现出近乎满分的自信，而法律学生可能无法识别这种过度自信，同时大量学生未接受正式的 AI 伦理使用培训。
Method: 采用两阶段社会技术审计：第一阶段用 60 个案例测试三个商用 LLM，围绕印度《合同法》及其特定履行法定强制化更新，引入 HCER 量化置信度不低于 9/10 的错误判决；第二阶段对 N=380 名印度法学学生开展问卷调查，测量其对捏造引文等机器幻觉的验证行为与培训暴露，并提出对抗式法律研究教学法 (adversarial legal research pedagogy) 和基于来源的验证架构 (source-grounded verification architectures) 作为对策。
Result: 所有模型在法定更新上都表现不佳；Meta AI 脆弱性最高 (HCER 31.7%，误用修订前规则时平均置信度 9.1/10)，其次为 Perplexity (15.0%) 和 ChatGPT (6.7%)。遇到捏造引文的学生验证得分更高 (4.2/5 vs 2.8/5)；81.6% 的学生知道提交幻觉案例可能构成藐视法庭，但 71.1% 未接受过 AI 伦理使用的正式训练。
Conclusion: 作者主张转向对抗式法律研究教学法并采用基于来源的验证架构，以防止系统性的专业疏忽 (systemic professional negligence)。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Causal Modeling of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes via Adaptive LLM Proposals
papers.abstract_en: Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes (APOs) such as preterm birth and gestational diabetes can have long-term consequences for both the mother and child, yet an understanding of their causes remains elusive. Causal discovery in this domain is especially challenging due to a paucity of data and incomplete domain knowledge. As a result, pure data-driven methods fail, and Large Language Model (LLM) outputs remain inconsistent or contradictory. We introduce a neurosymbolic framework for generating plausible causal hypotheses that iteratively combines the broad prior knowledge of LLMs with empirical scoring on data. Our method treats the LLM as an adaptive proposal distribution, generating hypotheses that are scored against empirical data; the resulting high-scoring graphs are then used to update the LLM's context, steering subsequent generations toward more promising regions of the hypothesis space. We evaluate our approach on a real-world clinical dataset for modeling APOs and their risk factors, comparing our results against an expert-constructed causal graph. Our method recovers all expert-validated edges and identifies additional plausible causal relations not previously listed by experts, potentially providing new insights for targeted interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对不良妊娠结局（如早产、妊娠期糖尿病）的因果发现困难，提出一个神经符号框架：将LLM作为自适应提议分布，迭代地用经验数据评分生成的因果假设，并用高分图更新LLM上下文以引导后续生成。在真实临床数据集上，该方法恢复了所有专家验证的边，并发现了专家未列出的额外合理因果关系。
Motivation: 不良妊娠结局（APOs）的因果机制仍不清楚，而该领域数据稀少、领域知识不完整，导致纯数据驱动方法失效，LLM输出也不一致或相互矛盾。
Method: 提出一个结合LLM先验知识与经验数据评分的神经符号因果发现框架；LLM被当作自适应提议分布，生成假设后依据数据打分，高分图用于更新LLM上下文，使后续生成趋向更有希望的假设空间。
Result: 在真实临床数据集上与专家构建的因果图对比，该方法恢复了全部专家验证的边，并识别出额外的合理因果关系，可能为针对性干预提供新见解。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该方法通过结合LLM先验与经验评分，能够产出专家未列出的合理因果假设，提示其有助于发现新的干预线索。

papers.title: AudioWorldSim: Realistic Binaural Audio Datasets For World Models
papers.abstract_en: This technical report presents AudioWorldSim, an open-source platform designed to generate realistic binaural audio datasets and advance research in audio-based machine learning, particularly world models. Built as a custom extension of Meta's SoundSpaces 2.0 platform, AudioWorldSim leverages their comprehensive acoustics framework, but focuses on the automatic rollout of random agent navigations, as well as implements crucial fixes to how continuous sound is composed. AudioWorldSim is made publicly available to the research community at https://github.com/Luizerko/AudioWorldSim to facilitate reproducibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AudioWorldSim，一个基于 Meta SoundSpaces 2.0 扩展的开源平台，用于生成逼真的双耳音频 (binaural audio) 数据集，以支持基于音频的机器学习，特别是世界模型 (world models) 研究。平台重点实现随机智能体导航的自动 rollout，并修复连续声音合成中的关键问题。数据集与代码已公开在 GitHub，便于复现。
Motivation: 基于音频的世界模型研究缺少易用且可复现的双耳音频数据生成工具，现有 SoundSpaces 2.0 平台尚未针对随机导航自动化和连续声音合成进行优化。
Method: 作为 SoundSpaces 2.0 的自定义扩展，AudioWorldSim 利用其声学框架，自动执行随机智能体导航的 rollout，并实现对连续声音合成关键流程的修复。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果，主要贡献是开放平台本身及公开的 GitHub 仓库，用于生成逼真双耳音频数据集。
Conclusion: 作者强调该平台面向研究社区公开，旨在提升基于音频的世界模型研究的可复现性；范围限于技术报告，未给出性能评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PromptResponse: Optimizing Prompts for LLM Coding Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in research workflows and software development pipelines, yet their output remains sensitive to input prompt variations. This paper presents $\unicode{x00AB}$PromptResponse$\unicode{x00BB}$, a controlled study examining how formatting and LLM-based tuning of coding task prompts affect the resulting code's performance, efficiency, and stability. Using five semantically identical yet syntactically distinct variants of the HumanEval dataset$\unicode{x2014}$baseline, JSON, Markdown, YAML, and an LLM-tuned version$\unicode{x2014}$we had GPT-4o solve its coding problems over 8200$\unicode{x00A0}$executions. Our results show that consistent formatting$\unicode{x2014}$especially JSON$\unicode{x2014}$improves generation efficiency and syntactic stability, with minor gains in task performance. Conversely, the LLM-tuned prompts resulted in significantly degraded task performance without significant improvements in any other dimension. These findings suggest that low-effort reformatting alone can yield measurable improvements, while tuning must account for model alignment. We conclude our work with providing a set of practical recommendations informed by our results as well as releasing our dataset variants and evaluation pipeline for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究编码任务提示的格式与LLM调优对生成代码性能、效率和稳定性的影响。基于HumanEval的五个语义相同但语法不同的变体（baseline、JSON、Markdown、YAML和LLM调优版），使用GPT-4o执行8200次。结果显示一致格式化（尤其是JSON）能提升生成效率和语法稳定性，任务性能仅小幅提升；而LLM调优的提示显著降低任务性能。作者据此给出实践建议，并发布数据集变体和评估流水线。
Motivation: LLM输出对输入提示变化敏感，但编码任务中提示格式的影响缺乏系统量化。该研究针对这一空白，比较低成本格式调整与LLM调优对代码生成的影响。
Method: 构建五种语义一致但语法不同的HumanEval提示变体（baseline、JSON、Markdown、YAML和LLM-tuned），用GPT-4o求解，共8200次执行，评估生成代码的性能、效率和稳定性。
Result: 一致性格式化尤其是JSON提升了生成效率和语法稳定性，任务性能仅有小幅提升；LLM调优提示导致任务性能显著下降，其他维度没有明显收益。
Conclusion: 研究建议低成本的提示重格式化即可获得可衡量改进，而LLM调优需注意模型对齐问题。作者发布数据集变体与评估流水线以支持后续工作。

papers.title: TracingFlow: A Simulation-Free Trajectory Inference Framework Based on Second-Order Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Inferring continuous system evolution from sparse temporal snapshots is a key challenge in generative modeling and single-cell omics. While Optimal Transport (OT) is popular, existing frameworks are largely restricted to first-order dynamics, assuming memoryless velocity fields. This limits expressiveness, as first-order systems fail to account for regulatory momentum and time-delayed responses inherent in processes like cell differentiation. Here, we introduce TracingFlow, a simulation-free Flow Matching framework generalizing to second-order dynamics. By using neural networks to regress the acceleration field, TracingFlow provides an exact, efficient solution to the Dynamical Optimal Acceleration Transport (DOAT) problem. Unlike first-order methods yielding over-smoothed trajectories, our second-order formulation captures high-curvature transitions and nonlinear evolutions by learning the underlying force fields. Evaluated on complex synthetic and large-scale scRNA-seq datasets, TracingFlow achieves superior accuracy in distributional reconstruction and trajectory faithfulness. Moreover, by integrating lineage tracing priors, it recovers dynamical structures that are both mathematically optimal and biologically plausible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TracingFlow 是一个免模拟 (simulation-free) 的 Flow Matching 轨迹推断框架，将动力学从一阶推广到二阶，通过神经网络回归加速度场来求解 Dynamical Optimal Acceleration Transport (DOAT) 问题。在合成数据和大型 scRNA-seq 数据集上，它在分布重构与轨迹保真度上优于一阶方法；结合谱系追踪先验可恢复数学最优且生物合理的动力学结构。
Motivation: 现有基于最优传输 (Optimal Transport, OT) 的框架大多局限于一阶动力学，假设无记忆速度场，无法刻画细胞分化等过程中固有的调控动量 (regulatory momentum) 与时滞响应，因而表达力受限。
Method: 提出 TracingFlow，把 Flow Matching 推广到二阶动力学，训练神经网络回归加速度场，从而精确高效地求解 DOAT 问题，并允许集成谱系追踪先验 (lineage tracing priors)。
Result: 在复杂合成与大规模 scRNA-seq 数据集上，TracingFlow 在分布重构和轨迹保真度方面取得更优精度。
Conclusion: 二阶公式通过学习底层力场 (force fields) 捕捉高曲率转变与非线性演化，相比一阶方法避免过度平滑的轨迹，且整合谱系追踪先验后得到的动力学结构兼具最优性与生物合理性。

papers.title: AT-ViT: Area-Targeted Multi-View Vision Transformer with Cross-Attention and Multi-Scale Patching for Plant Trait Recognition in Herbarium Images
papers.abstract_en: Automated plant traits recognition from herbarium images is essential for plant sciences, yet remains challenging because background elements (e.g., textual labels, mounting artifacts, and color charts) can introduce shortcut learning, leading models to rely on spurious non-plant cues rather than plant morphology. This bias degrades both generalization and interpretability. In this paper, we introduce AT-ViT, a dual-branch Vision Transformer that jointly encodes raw herbarium scans and their segmented-derived counterparts via a multi-scale, multi-view cross-attention fusion scheme. AT-ViT further incorporates a mask-guided patch weighting mechanism that amplifies plant-relevant regions and attenuates background-driven features. By learning from the original scans while being guided by segmentation masks through the mask-guided patch reweighting mechanism, the model is encouraged to focus on plant organs and learn plant-centric representations more effectively. Across multiple trait classification tasks (e.g., leaf base shape, thorns), AT-ViT delivers consistent accuracy gains, improves attention localization on plant regions, and exhibits increased robustness under synthetic background perturbations. Specifically, AT-ViT substantially improves spatial attention grounding, boosting plant-region alignment (Avg IoU_p: +15.66 to +18.03 pp) while reducing background overlap (Avg IoU_b: -27.92 to -31.02 pp) relative to CrossViT, and remains markedly more robust to background perturbations, outperforming ResNet101 by up to +32.32 accuracy points and CrossViT by up to +5.07 points under background-noise conditions.
papers.journal_ref: IET Computer Vision, 2026, e70059
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AT-ViT，一种双分支 Vision Transformer，用于植物标本图像（herbarium images）中的性状识别。它同时编码原始扫描图和分割掩码衍生的视图，通过多尺度多视角交叉注意力融合，并引入掩码引导的 patch 加权机制来增强植物区域、抑制背景特征。在叶基形状、刺等多个性状分类任务上，AT-ViT 相比 CrossViT 显著改善了对植物区域的空间注意力定位（Avg IoU_p 提升 15.66 到 18.03 个百分点，Avg IoU_b 降低 27.92 到 31.02 个百分点），并在背景扰动下保持更强的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 植物标本图像中的背景元素（如文本标签、装订痕迹、色卡）容易引发捷径学习，使模型依赖非植物的虚假线索而非植物形态，从而损害泛化性和可解释性。
Method: AT-ViT 采用双分支结构，联合编码原始扫描与其分割衍生图，通过多尺度、多视角交叉注意力融合方案学习表征；同时引入掩码引导的 patch 重加权机制，放大与植物相关的区域、抑制背景驱动的特征。
Result: 在多个性状分类任务上取得一致的准确率提升，并改进注意力定位：相对 CrossViT，植物区域对齐（Avg IoU_p）提升 +15.66 到 +18.03 个百分点，背景重叠（Avg IoU_b）降低 -27.92 到 -31.02 个百分点；在背景噪声条件下，准确率比 ResNet101 高最多 +32.32 个百分点，比 CrossViT 高最多 +5.07 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过分割掩码引导的 patch 重加权机制，让模型在原始扫描上学习时聚焦植物器官，可以更有效地学习以植物为中心的表征，提升泛化与可解释性。

papers.title: Robust Validation to Geometric Perturbations for Autonomous Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Deploying autonomous systems in safety-critical domains demands guaranteed robustness against physically plausible geometric perturbations rather than abstract pixel-wise noise. In vision-based navigation and autonomous landing, machine learning components require rigorous validation under dynamic operational conditions such as camera rotations and lighting shifts. Extending findings on the failure of first-order spatial attacks in classification, we show that standard gradient-based heuristics (e.g. APGD) similarly fail on for pose estimation, often performing worse than a simple random sampling baseline. To overcome these optimization bottlenecks, we reformulate pose estimation robustness within the framework of Global Lipschitzian Optimization (GLO). We argue that GLO offers a principled approach to robust validation, effectively localizing global optima with strong theoretical convergence guarantees. We evaluate this framework on a YOLOv8-Pose keypoint detector with a Perspective-n-Point (PnP) solver against rotation and contrast. In our evaluations, GLO successfully isolates critical failure modes where position deviations exceed safe operational limits, while rapidly pruning the search space by over 80%. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study to extend geometric robustness validation to continuous keypoint regression and deep object detection, establishing a practical step toward certifying robust autonomous perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自动驾驶位姿估计模型在几何扰动（如相机旋转、光照变化）下的鲁棒性验证问题。作者指出 APGD 等标准梯度启发式方法在位姿估计上失效，甚至不如随机采样基线，因此将鲁棒验证问题纳入全局 Lipschitz 优化（GLO）框架。实验基于 YOLOv8-Pose 关键点检测器与 Perspective-n-Point (PnP) 求解器，针对旋转和对比度扰动，GLO 能定位超过安全操作极限的失效模式并快速剪枝超过 80% 的搜索空间。
Motivation: 安全关键领域部署自主系统需要针对物理上合理的几何扰动提供鲁棒性保证，而不仅是抽象的像素级噪声；现有分类任务中的一阶空间攻击失败结论表明，类似优化瓶颈也存在于位姿估计中。
Method: 将位姿估计鲁棒性验证重新表述为全局 Lipschitz 优化问题，借助其理论收敛保证来定位全局最优点，以取代失效的一阶梯度启发式方法。
Result: 在 YOLOv8-Pose 关键点检测器加 PnP 求解器的评估中，针对旋转和对比度扰动，GLO 成功识别出位置偏差超出安全操作极限的关键失效模式，并将搜索空间剪枝超过 80%。
Conclusion: 据作者所述，这是首次将几何鲁棒性验证扩展到连续关键点回归和深度目标检测，为认证鲁棒的自主感知迈出实践性一步。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CellPath-Bench: A Multidimensional Benchmark for Whole-Slide Cellular Representations in Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models (PFMs) are increasingly used as general-purpose backbones, yet existing benchmarks cannot systematically diagnose their whole-slide cellular representation capabilities, including the decodability of cell-type information and the transferability of such information across tissue sections, datasets, and anatomical organs. We introduce CellPath-Bench, a cellular-resolution benchmark that evaluates frozen PFMs themselves. Following quality control of 52 candidate Xenium datasets, we construct a panel of 25 spatially aligned H\&E--Xenium tissue sections spanning 11 organs and 7,079,283 cells, harmonized into fine- and coarse-grained taxonomies. CellPath-Bench samples frozen WSI feature maps at registered nuclear coordinates and evaluates them using standardized multiclass linear probes. Cell Representation Advantage (CRA) measures the within-section advantage of nucleus-anchored representations over patch-level mean pooling, while Cell Representation Transferability (CRT) characterizes the generalization of cell-type decodability across tissue sections, datasets, and organs. We benchmark 30 pathology-specific and general-purpose foundation models through 304,920 runs across spatial readouts, magnifications, taxonomic granularities, and evaluation protocols. The results reveal substantial model-dependent differences in cell-type decodability and its cross-domain generalization, yielding distinct multidimensional capability profiles. CellPath-Bench provides a standardized framework for auditing cellular information in frozen PFM representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CellPath-Bench，一个面向病理学基础模型 (PFM) 的细胞级分辨率基准，用于系统性评估冻结模型在全切片图像 (WSI) 中的细胞表征能力。基准由 11 个器官、25 张 H&E–Xenium 空间对齐组织切片、7,079,283 个细胞构成，并通过标准化的多类线性探针在核坐标处采样冻结 WSI 特征图。作者引入 Cell Representation Advantage (CRA) 和 Cell Representation Transferability (CRT) 两个指标，分别衡量核锚定表征相对 patch 级平均池化的优势以及细胞类型可解码性在切片、数据集和器官间的泛化能力。研究对 30 个病理专用和通用基础模型进行了 304,920 次评估，揭示模型间显著的细胞类型可解码性差异并形成多维能力画像。
Motivation: 现有基准无法系统诊断病理学基础模型在全切片水平上的细胞表征能力，尤其是细胞类型信息的可解码性及其在组织切片、数据集和解剖器官之间的可迁移性。
Method: 从 52 个候选 Xenium 数据集中筛选并构建 25 张空间对齐的 H&E–Xenium 组织切片，覆盖 11 个器官和 7,079,283 个细胞，统一为细粒度和粗粒度分类体系；在配准的核坐标处采样冻结 WSI 特征图，使用标准化多类线性探针进行评估，并提出 CRA 和 CRT 两个指标。
Result: 基准测试了 30 个病理专用和通用基础模型，共进行 304,920 次评估，覆盖空间读取方式、放大倍数、分类粒度和评估协议；结果显示细胞类型可解码性及其跨域泛化存在明显的模型依赖差异，形成不同的多维能力画像。
Conclusion: CellPath-Bench 为审计冻结 PFM 表征中的细胞信息提供了一个标准化框架，可用于系统比较模型在细胞层面的表征质量。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: The Cost of a Physics Prior Is Bounded by the Ablation Gap
papers.abstract_en: Shape-constrained and physics-informed learning reports an accuracy cost of enforcing a prior and treats it as a property of the prior. We show it is mostly a property of the free features and the validation split. Let P be the excess risk of restricting a hypothesis class to functions with a shape constraint on features S, and D the excess risk of the ablated model that ignores S. Because a function constant in x_j is both non-decreasing and non-increasing in x_j, the ablated class is contained in the constrained class, so 0 <= P <= D for every risk functional, with no convexity, smoothness, or realizability assumption. Empirically the bound is a sign test: a constrained model must never be beaten by its own ablation. We instantiate it on an ordinal wildfire-severity task (N = 26,681, K = 3) with hard monotone constraints on four meteorological drivers, coordinates left free, and a validation ladder from i.i.d. resampling to 2-degree spatial blocking. Coordinates act as a shield: alone they recover 92.9% of the full model's macro-F1 under spatial blocking, collapsing D from 0.1288 to 0.0427; the same prior costs 0.0473 shielded and 0.3470 unshielded, a ratio of 7.3 with identical physics. Because D is protocol-dependent it does not transfer: coarsening blocks from 1 to 10 degrees drives D from 0.0942 to 0.0050, leaving two configurations unidentifiable a priori. Inversions of the certified nesting bound the pipeline's additive resolution: over 318 comparisons they give a self-calibrating floor of 0.0220 macro-F1, below which no reported price is interpretable, including four cells in our own headline grid. Cost and compliance are independent: the unconstrained model violates the prior at rate 0.48-0.49 while enforcing it costs 0.0473. We give a two-fit screen that rejects unidentifiable experiments before a constrained model is trained.

TL;DR: 本文研究形状约束与物理信息学习的先验代价问题，指出该代价主要不是先验本身的性质，而是自由特征与验证划分的性质。作者证明了约束类与消融类之间的包含关系给出 0 ≤ P ≤ D 的界，并在野火严重度任务上用硬单调约束与坐标作为自由特征验证了该界，且提出两拟合筛除不可识别实验。
Motivation: 现有形状约束和物理信息学习报告强化先验的准确率代价，并将其视为先验本身的属性；作者认为这一代价主要取决于未约束的自由特征和验证集划分，理解其来源比报告一个数字更重要。
Method: 形式上证明：在特征 S 上施加形状约束的受限假设类包含忽略 S 的消融类，因此过剩风险满足 0 ≤ P ≤ D，无需凸性、光滑性或可实现性假设；这给出一个符号检验，即约束模型绝不能被自身消融打败，并实例化为两拟合筛除，在训练前拒绝无法识别的实验配置。
Result: 在野火严重度任务（N=26,681, K=3）上，对四个气象驱动因子施加硬单调约束、坐标自由：坐标单独在空间分块下恢复全模型 92.9% 的 macro-F1，使 D 从 0.1288 降至 0.0427；同一先验在受保护时代价 0.0473、不受保护时 0.3470，比值 7.3。分块从 1 度粗化到 10 度使 D 从 0.0942 降到 0.0050，两个配置先验上不可识别；318 次比较给出自校准下限 0.0220 macro-F1。
Conclusion: 先验的代价被消融间隙所界定，且代价与合规性相互独立：无约束模型以 0.48-0.49 的比率违反先验，而强制该先验仅代价 0.0473。由于 D 依赖验证协议而不可迁移，作者给出两拟合筛除以在训练约束模型之前排除不可识别的实验。

papers.title: Designing a Robust LLM-Based Evaluation System for Agentic AI in Drug Discovery Through Human Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language model (LLM) systems are reshaping scientific workflows in chemistry and drug discovery, but evaluating their open-ended, tool-augmented outputs remains a fundamental bottleneck. Reference-based metrics such as BLEU and ROUGE fail to capture semantic correctness, while expert human evaluation does not scale to the iteration speed these systems demand. The LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative, but existing drug discovery benchmarks deploy LLM judges without validating their alignment with human experts. In this work, we present an LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation framework for ChatInvent, an agentic drug discovery assistant deployed at AstraZeneca, with four contributions. First, we define four output-quality evaluation dimensions---Completeness, Relevancy, Structural Clarity, and Scope Adherence---alongside deterministic Tool Call Correctness checks. Second, we validate the judge through a human alignment study with five expert annotators, comparing Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5, and Llama 3.1 70B as candidate judges. Third, we optimize the best-performing judge using few-shot demonstrations of human-annotated examples, improving alignment with the human majority vote from 0.80 to 0.86. Fourth, applying the optimized judge to 70 held-out questions, we surface concrete limitations and find that informal phrasings do not systematically degrade output quality; if anything, it is helpful to have the LLM rewrite the original question before querying the agent. Our framework provides a reusable template for human-aligned evaluation of agentic systems in scientific domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 LLM-as-a-Judge 评估框架，用于 AstraZeneca 部署的智能体药物发现助手 ChatInvent。作者定义了四个输出质量维度（Completeness、Relevancy、Structural Clarity、Scope Adherence）以及确定性的 Tool Call Correctness 检查，并通过五名专家标注者的人类对齐研究比较 Gemini 3.1 Pro、Claude Opus 4.7、GPT-5 和 Llama 3.1 70B 作为候选裁判。利用人类标注的 few-shot 示例优化最佳裁判后，与人类多数投票的一致性从 0.80 提升到 0.86；在 70 个保留问题上应用时发现非正式措辞不会系统性降低输出质量，且让 LLM 重写原始问题反而有帮助。
Motivation: 基于参考的指标（如 BLEU、ROUGE）无法捕捉开放式的工具增强型 agentic LLM 输出的语义正确性，人类专家评估又无法跟上系统所需的迭代速度；LLM-as-a-Judge 虽是可扩展的替代方案，但现有药物发现基准未验证其与人类专家的一致性。
Method: 提出包含四个质量评估维度和 Tool Call Correctness 确定性检查的 LLM-as-a-Judge 框架；通过五名专家标注者进行人类对齐研究来验证候选裁判模型，并采用人类标注示例的 few-shot 演示对表现最佳的裁判进行优化。
Result: 摘要报告最佳裁判经 few-shot 优化后与人类多数投票的一致性从 0.80 提高到 0.86；在 70 个保留问题上的应用表明非正式措辞不会系统性降低输出质量，LLM 重写原始问题在一定程度上有所帮助。
Conclusion: 作者将该框架定位为科学领域 agentic 系统人类对齐评估的可复用模板，并强调它能暴露具体局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoAnchor: Robust Collaborative Perception under Spatio-Temporal Misalignment via Object-Level Anchors
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative perception extends the sensing range of a single vehicle by fusing observations from nearby agents, which improves the robustness of autonomous driving. In realistic deployments, however, the received collaborator messages are often affected by both communication delay and relative-pose noise, which jointly cause stale observations, spatial misalignment, and unstable feature fusion. Existing methods usually address these issues from either the spatial or temporal side, but handling them jointly in a unified and efficient manner remains challenging. In this paper, we propose CoAnchor, an anchor-centric spatio-temporal alignment framework for asynchronous collaborative perception. Instead of directly reasoning on dense BEV features, CoAnchor builds sparse object-level spatio-temporal anchors as a shared interface for pose correction and tightly connects spatial refinement, temporal propagation, and current-time verification within one unified loop, while keeping the overall correction process lightweight. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets illustrate that CoAnchor remains competitive under clean settings and improves the robustness under joint delay and pose perturbations with a favorable practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoAnchor，一个面向异步协同感知的锚点中心时空对齐框架。针对通信延迟与相对位姿噪声导致的观测过期、空间错位和特征融合不稳定，CoAnchor 构建稀疏物体级时空锚点作为共享接口，将空间精化、时间传播与当前时刻验证统一在一个循环中，避免直接在稠密 BEV 特征上推理。实验表明在干净设置下保持竞争力，并在联合延迟与位姿扰动下提升鲁棒性，兼顾精度与效率。
Motivation: 实际部署中协作消息同时受通信延迟和相对位姿噪声影响，共同造成陈旧观测、空间失配与不稳定特征融合；现有方法通常只单独处理空间或时间一侧，缺乏统一且轻量的联合处理方式。
Method: 提出 anchor-centric 的时空对齐框架，构建稀疏物体级时空锚点作为共享接口，将位姿校正、空间精化、时间传播和当前时刻验证紧密连接在一个统一循环内，并保持整体校正过程轻量化。
Result: 在模拟与真实数据集上的实验显示，CoAnchor 在干净设置下仍具竞争力，并在联合时延与位姿扰动下改善鲁棒性，呈现较优的精度-效率权衡；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 论文强调通过稀疏锚点把时空校正在统一框架中联合处理是可行且高效的方向；摘要未披露具体局限。

papers.title: $Z^2$-ACT: End-to-End Verifiable Agentic Intent Control for Open 6G RAN
papers.abstract_en: With the progression in open and disaggregated 6G radio access networks, it is expected that the system will be able to host multi-vendors. In order to host multi-vendors, it is essential that AI-assisted control loops remain safe, verifiable, and auditable under concurrent operator intents and untrusted model inputs. The existing studies address the agentic coordination, formal intent constraints, zero-trust prompt verification and cryptographic accountability in isolation, which leaves pre-realization safety, continuous semantic verification and cross-domain audit incomplete when used individually. In this regard, we propose zero-knowledge auditable control and zero-trust verifiable agentic intent architecture ($Z^2$-ACT), which integrates the aforementioned four primitives across the non-real-time and near-real-time RICs. We encode the typed Intent Contracts as operator goals while the large language model inputs are only admitted after a practical adversarial intent check. The skill sequences in the proposed study are released only when a self-management gate is satisfied while every successful commit is recorded as a binding commitment with a zero-knowledge proof. Our experimental evaluation on public ColO-RAN measurements compares the full architecture against targeted ablations and a conventional reinforcement-learning baseline. A live large language model is used in the non-real-time path to translate operator intents into Intent Contracts; we report translation accuracy, the rate of invalid or hallucinated contracts, non-real-time latency, and behavior under adversarial or misleading intents. Near-real-time control remains trace-driven on the public KPM sequences. Results indicate improved actuation filtering and attack resilience at modest latency and signaling cost inside the near-real-time envelope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Z^2-ACT，一个面向开放 6G RAN 的零知识可审计控制与零信任可验证代理意图架构，将代理协调、形式意图约束、零信任提示验证和加密可审计性四个原语集成到非实时与近实时 RIC 中。类型化意图契约（typed Intent Contracts）编码操作员目标，大语言模型输入需先通过对抗意图检查，技能序列仅在自管理门（self-management gate）满足时释放，每次成功提交都记录为带零知识证明的绑定承诺。在公共 ColO-RAN 数据上的实验表明，与消融和强化学习基线相比，该方法在近实时包络内以适度延迟和信令成本改善了驱动过滤与攻击韧性。
Motivation: 现有研究孤立地处理代理协调、形式意图约束、零信任提示验证和加密可审计性，单独使用时会留下预实现安全性、连续语义验证和跨域审计的空白，无法满足开放且多供应商 6G RAN 中 AI 辅助控制环路在并发操作员意图和不可信模型输入下的安全、可验证与可审计需求。
Method: Z^2-ACT 架构将四种原语统一部署于非实时与近实时 RIC；非实时路径使用实时大语言模型将操作员意图翻译为 Intent Contracts，并报告翻译准确率与无效/幻觉契约率，近实时控制则基于公共 KPM 序列进行轨迹驱动。
Result: 在公共 ColO-RAN 测量上与定向消融及常规强化学习基线对比，结果显示在近实时包络内改善了驱动过滤和攻击韧性，同时保持适度延迟与信令成本，并给出了在对抗或误导意图下的行为评估。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将代理协调、形式约束、零信任验证与加密可审计性集成到统一架构中，能够为开放 6G RAN 的 AI 辅助控制提供预实现安全与跨域可审计性，但近实时部分目前仍为轨迹驱动评估。

papers.title: Short spatial mooring-tilt variations from deep Mediterranean observations
papers.abstract_en: Interaction between energy-abundant mesoscale eddies and internal waves can lead to convection-turbulence generation and may prove important for deep-sea life and circulation. However, the size of scales of interacting flows is not well known. In this paper, a diagnostic tool of tilt is tested near the single top-buoyancy of 40 mooring lines 9.5 m apart horizontally and compared with 50-m scale relative vorticity and waterflow above a 2500-m deep flat Northwestern-Mediterranean seafloor. Whilst tilt relates to first order with flow-speed squared induced by mooring-line drag, considerable deviations from this relationship and larger tilt occur when the amplitude of relative vorticity attains values O(f), f the inertial frequency of planetary vorticity. The sign of relative vorticity is of no importance. Such larger-tilt events occur during most intense convection turbulence via warm-water slanting from above. During these events, variations in tilt-angle magnitude are as large as the average tilt O(0.1)degree, thereby reducing variational scales from 50 to 9.5 m. Thus, in a deep-sea environment where flow speeds are <0.07 m s^-1, O(0.01) m s^-1 flow-speed variations provide important turbulent mixing, without deep dense-water formation.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 能量丰富的中尺度涡旋与内波之间的相互作用可能产生对流湍流，对深海生命和环流很重要，但相互作用流的尺度尚不清楚；该研究旨在通过倾斜诊断工具缩小这一认识缺口。

papers.title: Socialized Division and Collaboration: Rethinking Class-Incremental Learning under Optimization Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Class-incremental learning is commonly instantiated as a single-model paradigm, where a unified model sequentially adapts to an unbounded stream of sessions. While effective under mild distributional shifts, this formulation becomes strained when successive sessions induce incompatible optimization directions, leading to destructive interference and catastrophic forgetting. We argue that such forgetting reflects a structural limitation of enforcing heterogeneous learning dynamics within a single parameter space. Motivated by social solidarity theory, we propose Socialized Division and Collaboration (SDC) as a reformulation of continual learning that decomposes session learning across specialized models in response to optimization conflicts, while enabling coordinated collaboration. To support this formulation with a principled allocation mechanism, we introduce an energy-based session-model compatibility criterion grounded in Helmholtz free energy, which guides adaptive session allocation and model evolution under conflicting objectives. This framework integrates session assignment, model evolution, and collaborative inference into a unified pipeline, offering an alternative to monolithic continual learning formulations and highlighting a broader design principle for learning under persistent optimization conflicts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视类增量学习 (class-incremental learning)，认为传统单模型范式在连续会话产生相互冲突的优化方向时会出现破坏性干扰和灾难性遗忘。受社会团结理论启发，作者提出 Socialized Division and Collaboration (SDC)，将会话学习分解到多个专门模型上以应对优化冲突，并协调它们协作。框架引入基于 Helmholtz 自由能的能量兼容性准则来指导会话分配和模型演化，统一了会话分配、模型演化与协作推理。
Motivation: 现有类增量学习多采用单模型范式，在连续会话的优化方向不兼容时会产生破坏性干扰和灾难性遗忘。作者认为这种遗忘源于在单一参数空间内强行容纳异质学习动态的结构性局限。
Method: 提出 SDC 框架，将增量学习重构为按优化冲突将会话分配给专门模型并协调协作的过程。引入基于 Helmholtz 自由能的能量型会话-模型兼容性准则，用于自适应的会话分配和模型演化，并将会话分配、模型演化与协作推理整合为统一流程。
Result: 摘要未给出具体实验结果或定量指标，主要呈现了方法层面的重新表述与设计原理。
Conclusion: SDC 作为单一模型持续学习范式的替代方案，强调在持续优化冲突下学习时应采用分工与协作的设计原则。

papers.title: CoST: Semantic-Aware Urban Understanding via Spatial-Temporal Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial representation learning from satellite imagery is a fundamental problem for large-scale urban analysis and real-world applications. Despite recent advances, current methods struggle with cross-region generalization and semantic interpretability due to their reliance on region-specific auxiliary data and the neglect of semantic alignment within multi-temporal urban imagery. Therefore, we present CoST, a novel \underline{Co}ntrastive-based \underline{S}patial-\underline{T}emporal framework that aligns spatial context with multi-temporal semantics to extract universal geographic regularities shared across regions. Specifically, CoST explicitly models spatial correlations to capture transferable geographic structures and exploits multi-year urban change semantics to align learned representations with high-level geo-semantics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoST consistently achieves superior performance across various downstream tasks and in unseen scenario, yielding an average relative gain of 8.7\% over the strongest competing methods across eight city-indicator settings. The code is available in \href{https://github.com/Arandinglv/CoST}{this repo}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoST，一种基于对比学习的时空对齐框架，用于从卫星影像学习地理空间表征（geospatial representation learning）。CoST 将空间上下文与多时相语义对齐，以提取跨区域共享的地理规律，并缓解现有方法在跨区域泛化与语义可解释性上的不足。摘要报告其在多种下游任务及未见场景中一致取得更优性能，在八个城市指标设定下较最强对比方法平均相对提升 8.7%。
Motivation: 现有地理空间表征学习方法依赖区域特定的辅助数据，并且忽略了多时相城市影像中的语义对齐，导致跨区域泛化能力差、语义可解释性不足。
Method: CoST 是一个对比式时空框架，显式建模空间相关性以获取可迁移的地理结构，并利用多年城市变化语义将学习到的表征与高层地理语义（geo-semantics）对齐。
Result: 在多种下游任务和未见场景中，CoST 均取得更优性能；在八个城市指标设定下，相比最强对比方法平均相对提升 8.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式对齐空间上下文与多时相语义可以提取跨区域通用的地理规律，并已公开代码仓库。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Model Performance on International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code Compliance
papers.abstract_en: The transport of dangerous goods by sea is a high-consequence activity governed by the International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code, a complex regulatory framework where errors in classification, packaging, stowage, or segregation can result in fire, explosion, toxic release, or loss of life or vessel. Correct compliance requires accurately interpreting hundreds of pages of interacting provisions, updated on a two-year amendment cycle. Practitioners increasingly use Large Language Models (LLMs) as decision-support tools, yet no systematic evaluation exists of whether they can reliably interpret IMDG requirements for safety-critical use. This paper introduces DGEval, the first benchmark for evaluating LLM knowledge of IMDG Amendment 42-24. Built from expert-written questions on the NCB Hazcheck e-learning platform and structured lookups from the Dangerous Goods List (DGL), it comprises 1,678 questions across multiple-choice, open-ended, DGL lookup, and regulatory identification tasks. We evaluate 13 models from six providers across multiple thinking configurations, including one maritime domain-specific fine-tuned model, and test the effect of web search. Although the best-performing model exceeds the human practitioner baseline on multiple-choice questions, all models are weakest in the operationally safety-critical areas of stowage, segregation, and regulatory recall. These results indicate that LLMs may support compliance tasks, particularly structured DGL lookups with web search, but unreliability in operational areas and regulatory-text recall means human oversight and authoritative source verification remain necessary before deployment in any safety-critical context. DGEval is designed as a safety assurance instrument to be applied continuously as models evolve, not as a settled characterisation of current capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DGEval，据称是首个系统评估大语言模型（LLM）对《国际海运危险货物规则》（IMDG Code）修正案 42-24 合规知识掌握程度的基准。基准包含来自 NCB Hazcheck 平台专家题与危险货物清单（DGL）结构化查表的 1,678 道题，覆盖选择题、开放题、DGL 查表与法规识别任务。研究评估了来自六家提供方的 13 个模型，并检验网络搜索的影响。结果显示最佳模型在选择题上超过人类从业者基线，但所有模型在积载、隔离与法规回忆这些安全关键环节表现最弱。
Motivation: 海运危险货物属于高后果活动，IMDG Code 是涉及分类、包装、积载和隔离等多方面相互关联条款的复杂法规体系，出错可能导致火灾、爆炸、有毒物质泄漏乃至人员或船舶损失。从业者越来越多地把 LLM 当作决策支持工具，但此前缺乏对其能否在安全关键场景下可靠解释 IMDG 要求的系统性评估。
Method: 构建 DGEval 基准：问题来源为专家撰写的 NCB Hazcheck 电子学习平台题目和对危险货物清单（DGL）的结构化查表，题型包括多项选择、开放问答、DGL 查表和法规识别。实验评估 13 个模型（含一个海事领域微调模型、多种思维配置），并测试网络搜索对输出的影响。
Result: 摘要报告最佳模型在多项选择题上超过人类从业者基线，但在积载、隔离和法规回忆等操作安全关键领域所有模型表现最弱。网络搜索主要对结构化 DGL 查表任务有帮助。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 可支持部分合规任务（尤其是配合网络搜索的结构化 DGL 查表），但在操作环节与法规文本回忆上不可靠，因此在任何安全关键场景部署前仍需人工监督和权威来源核验。DGEval 被定位为随模型演化持续使用的安全保障工具，而非对当前能力的定型结论。

papers.title: COMET: Contrastive Motion-Enhanced Temporal Reasoning for Video Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Video multimodal large language models have advanced significantly, yet fine-grained motion-temporal understanding remains fragile. The core bottleneck is not only sparse frame sampling, but also the lack of a complete temporal modeling pipeline for explicitly representing frame-to-frame change, enabling appearance-motion interaction, and optimizing temporal direction sensitivity. We propose COMET, a temporally grounded framework that systematically strengthens video MLLMs through explicit temporal representation, appearance-motion fusion, and direction-aware optimization. Architecturally, COMET introduces a temporal motion branch built on Taylor frame differences and injects its motion evidence into the appearance stream via temporal attention bias-enhanced cross-attention. For optimization, COMET combines temporal prior distillation with a forward-reverse TC-GRPO stage that turns temporal order into a direct learning signal and strengthens the model's use of directional motion patterns encoded by the temporal motion branch. The method achieves consistent overall improvements with a pronounced motion-temporal bias: on Qwen3-VL-8B, action-centric tasks (STAR, SSv2) improve by 4.9% on average, temporal reasoning tasks (NExT-QA, CLEVRER, LLaVA-178K) by 2.1% over BL-GRPO, while static perception tasks (PerceptionTest) remain on par. The same gain pattern also transfers to InternVL2.5-8B, indicating that COMET generalizes across model families.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COMET，一个面向视频多模态大语言模型（video MLLM）的时间感知框架，旨在改善细粒度运动与时间顺序理解。框架引入基于 Taylor 帧差分的时序运动分支，通过时序注意力偏置增强的交叉注意力将运动证据注入外观流，并结合时序先验蒸馏与 forward-reverse TC-GRPO 优化。摘要报告在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，动作中心任务（STAR、SSv2）平均提升 4.9%，时序推理任务（NExT-QA、CLEVRER、LLaVA-178K）较 BL-GRPO 提升 2.1%，静态感知任务维持持平，且该增益模式迁移至 InternVL2.5-8B。
Motivation: 视频 MLLM 的细粒度运动-时间理解仍然脆弱，核心瓶颈不只是稀疏帧采样，还缺乏完整的时间建模管线来显式表示帧间变化、实现外观-运动交互并优化时间方向敏感性。
Method: COMET 架构上引入基于 Taylor 帧差分的时序运动分支，并通过时序注意力偏置增强的交叉注意力把运动证据注入外观流；优化上结合时序先验蒸馏与 forward-reverse TC-GRPO 阶段，将时间顺序转化为直接学习信号，强化模型对运动方向模式的利用。
Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，动作中心任务（STAR、SSv2）平均提升 4.9%，时序推理任务（NExT-QA、CLEVRER、LLaVA-178K）较 BL-GRPO 提升 2.1%，静态感知任务（PerceptionTest）保持持平；相同增益模式在 InternVL2.5-8B 上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为 COMET 能在多种模型家族间泛化，带来一致的整体提升并呈现显著的运动-时间偏向，适用于视频 MLLM 的时序理解增强。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 COMET，一个面向视频多模态大语言模型（video MLLM）的时间感知框架，旨在改善细粒度运动与时间顺序理解。框架引入基于 Taylor 帧差分的时序运动分支，通过时序注意力偏置增强的交叉注意力将运动证据注入外观流，并结合时序先验蒸馏与 forward-reverse TC-GRPO 优化。摘要报告在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，动作中心任务（STAR、SSv2）平均提升 4.9%，时序推理任务（NExT-QA、CLEVRER、LLaVA-178K）较 BL-GRPO 提升 2.1%，静态感知任务维持持平，且该增益模式迁移至 InternVL2.5-8B。
summary_sections.motivation: 视频 MLLM 的细粒度运动-时间理解仍然脆弱，核心瓶颈不只是稀疏帧采样，还缺乏完整的时间建模管线来显式表示帧间变化、实现外观-运动交互并优化时间方向敏感性。
summary_sections.method: COMET 架构上引入基于 Taylor 帧差分的时序运动分支，并通过时序注意力偏置增强的交叉注意力把运动证据注入外观流；优化上结合时序先验蒸馏与 forward-reverse TC-GRPO 阶段，将时间顺序转化为直接学习信号，强化模型对运动方向模式的利用。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen3-VL-8B 上，动作中心任务（STAR、SSv2）平均提升 4.9%，时序推理任务（NExT-QA、CLEVRER、LLaVA-178K）较 BL-GRPO 提升 2.1%，静态感知任务（PerceptionTest）保持持平；相同增益模式在 InternVL2.5-8B 上得到验证。

papers.title: Don't Solve, Just Compare: Tiny Advisors for Runtime Intervention in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are emerging as an important paradigm for real-world tasks that require reasoning, tool use, and sequential decision-making. As these agents operate over longer horizons, runtime intervention offers a way to improve reliability without retraining the underlying actor. Failure detection alone is insufficient. Effective intervention must also provide a useful direction for recovery. Existing approaches often rely on an expert solver or a critic that generates task-specific corrections, incurring either the cost of another capable solver or the capacity demands of a task-capable critic. We introduce Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA), a comparison-only framework for constructive runtime intervention. In COTA, a tiny comparator judges whether sampled alternatives lead to better continuations than the actor's proposal, and repeated comparisons determine when intervention is warranted. We train the comparator using pairwise supervision constructed from same-prefix counterfactual branches. Preferred alternatives are returned as non-binding advice, leaving the original actor to replan. Across WebShop, ALFWorld, and tau^3-Retail with three actors, COTA improves all nine evaluation settings and outperforms the compared baselines. These results show that constructive runtime intervention can remain effective even when the auxiliary model has substantially weaker task-solving capability than the actor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Comparison-Only Tiny Advisor (COTA)，一种仅依赖比较操作的轻量级运行时干预框架，用于提升 LLM agent 在长时程任务中的可靠性。COTA 用一个微型比较器判断采样得到的备选延续是否优于 actor 当前方案，并通过多次比较决定何时需要干预；优选结果作为非绑定建议返回，由原 actor 自行重新规划。实验在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 tau^3-Retail 三个环境、三个 actor 上全部九个评估设置取得提升，并优于对比基线。
Motivation: LLM agent 在长时程真实任务中需要运行时干预来提升可靠性，但仅做失败检测不够，干预还需给出有方向的恢复建议。现有方法常依赖专家求解器或能生成任务特定修正的 critic，成本高或容量需求大，因此需要一种更轻量、不要求辅助模型具备强任务求解能力的干预方式。
Method: 提出 COTA，一个 comparison-only 框架：微型比较器 (tiny comparator) 只判断采样出的备选延续是否优于 actor 的提议，通过重复比较决定何时需要干预。比较器使用从同前缀反事实分支 (same-prefix counterfactual branches) 构造的成对监督信号训练；被选中的备选方案作为非绑定建议交给原 actor，由 actor 自己重新规划。
Result: 在 WebShop、ALFWorld 和 tau^3-Retail 三个环境中，搭配三个不同 actor，COTA 在所有九个评估设置上均取得改进，并超过所比较的基线方法。摘要强调该结果表明即使辅助模型的任务求解能力明显弱于 actor，建设性的运行时干预仍然可以保持有效。
Conclusion: 作者认为建设性运行时干预并不必然依赖与 actor 能力相当的辅助模型，仅做比较的轻量辅助者即可提供有效恢复方向。摘要未提及明显局限，论文为 21 页预印本。

papers.title: RODE: A Radial-Orthogonal Decoupled Engine for Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Modern neural network training increasingly uses matrix-aware optimizers, yet their conditioned matrix step is typically added directly to the weight, jointly changing its norm and direction. This interaction matters because the current norm determines angular motion, while directional learning can drive norm growth and thereby alter later steps. We introduce RODE, which gives the radial and directional components separate update rules and step sizes. RODE explicitly updates the matrix Frobenius norm through a scalar radial rule, while its directional channel performs Newton--Schulz-conditioned updates in the tangent space. Controlled GPT-2 interventions show gains from both direct norm control and RODE's directional update. Across two language-modeling and two image-classification tasks, RODE outperforms both Muon variants in every direct comparison and ends with lower full-model norms. At 1.5B scale, using the learning rate transferred directly from the Qwen2-style LM sweep, RODE lowers loss from 4.145 to 3.346 and final global norm from 11964 to 2183 relative to Muon RMS, with fixed-radius RODE improving further. For Qwen3.5-9B full-parameter fine-tuning, all six optimizers use the same tuning budget and the same formal-training and evaluation settings; RODE outperforms both Muon variants on all four evaluation tasks and attains the highest mean on GSM8K and MATH-500. Thus, decoupling radial and directional dynamics offers a more effective and controllable approach to matrix optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RODE（Radial-Orthogonal Decoupled Engine），一种把矩阵感知优化器的更新解耦为径向与方向两个通道的优化方法：径向通道用标量规则显式更新矩阵 Frobenius 范数，方向通道在切空间中执行 Newton-Schulz 条件化更新。受控 GPT-2 干预实验显示直接范数控制与 RODE 方向更新均有收益；在语言建模、图像分类、1.5B 规模预训练以及 Qwen3.5-9B 全参数微调中，RODE 均优于两种 Muon 变体。
Motivation: 现有矩阵感知优化器（matrix-aware optimizers）把条件化矩阵步直接加到权重上，会同时改变其范数和方向；而当前范数决定角向运动，方向学习又会驱动范数增长，二者相互耦合并影响后续更新。作者认为需要把径向与方向动力学解耦以提升可控性。
Method: RODE 为径向和方向分量分别设置独立的更新规则与步长：径向通道通过标量规则显式更新矩阵 Frobenius 范数，方向通道在切空间（tangent space）中执行 Newton-Schulz 条件化更新；文中还包含固定半径（fixed-radius）的 RODE 变体。
Result: 在两次直接对比中 RODE 均优于两种 Muon 变体，并以更低的最终全模型范数结束训练。1.5B 规模下沿用 Qwen2 风格 LM 扫描直接迁移的学习率，RODE 相对 Muon RMS 将 loss 从 4.145 降到 3.346，最终全局范数从 11964 降到 2183，fixed-radius RODE 进一步提升。Qwen3.5-9B 全参数微调中，在相同调参预算与训练/评估设置下，RODE 在全部四个评估任务上优于两种 Muon 变体，并在 GSM8K 和 MATH-500 上取得最高均值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦径向与方向动力学是一种更有效且更可控的矩阵优化途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recognition-Conditioned Reasoning: A Training-Free Multimodal-LLM Pipeline for Fine-Grained Micro-Action Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Micro-actions are subtle, short, low-amplitude body movements, such as a fidgeting hand or a slight head tilt, that humans perform with little conscious intent yet that reliably leak emotional and psychological state. Understanding them goes beyond assigning a label: a model must also describe which body parts move and reason, faithfully, about why a clip warrants a particular fine-grained category. We present the training-free, prompt-only system that won first place in the fine-grained understanding track (MA-Bench) of the MAC~2026 Micro-Action Challenge, where both fine-tuning and ground-truth supervision are disallowed. Built entirely upon frozen multimodal large language models (MLLMs), the system dynamically routes each of the eight sub-tasks to the MLLM empirically best suited for that task: a discriminative MLLM for closed-ended recognition tasks and a generative MLLM for open-ended description and reasoning tasks. This architecture achieves a statistically significant performance advantage on open-ended tasks, attaining an average score of 2.68 (on a five-point scale) compared to 1.44 for the second-best approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个完全无需训练、仅依赖提示词 (prompt-only) 的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 流水线，用于细粒度微动作理解，并在 MAC 2026 微动作挑战赛的 MA-Bench 细粒度理解赛道获得第一名（该赛道禁止微调和真值监督）。系统基于冻结的 MLLM，将八个子任务动态路由到经验上最合适的模型：封闭式识别任务交给判别式 MLLM，开放式描述与推理任务交给生成式 MLLM。摘要报告该系统在开放式任务上取得统计显著的领先，平均得分 2.68（五分制），而第二名方法为 1.44。
Motivation: 微动作是细微、短暂、低幅度的身体运动（如手部不安或轻微歪头），能可靠泄露情绪与心理状态；理解它们不仅要分配标签，还需描述哪些身体部位在运动，并忠实推理为什么该片段应归入某个细粒度类别。现有的标准方法通常依赖微调或监督信号，而该挑战要求在不允许微调和真值监督的条件下完成任务。
Method: 提出一个训练无关的流水线，完全基于冻结的 MLLM，通过动态路由将八个子任务分别分配给经验上最适配的模型：判别式 MLLM 负责封闭式识别任务，生成式 MLLM 负责开放式描述与推理任务；系统仅通过提示词驱动，不进行任何参数更新。
Result: 该系统在 MAC 2026 Micro-Action Challenge 的 MA-Bench 细粒度理解赛道获得第一名；在开放式任务上平均得分 2.68（五分制），第二名方法为 1.44，差异具有统计显著性。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，仅用冻结 MLLM 与动态子任务路由，即可在禁止微调和监督的细粒度微动作理解基准上取得显著领先，说明任务与模型类型匹配对开放式生成质量至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Free-Text Evaluation of LLMs for 5G Domain Knowledge and Fault Analysis using LLM-as-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Real-world fault analysis in 5G and emerging 6G networks demands domain expertise to analyze free-text diagnostics, including root-cause explanations and recommended actions. LLMs have emerged as a promising approach to automating this, yet whether lightweight, edge-deployable models are capable of performing in-depth free-text diagnostics remains an open question. While existing benchmarks rely on restrictive MCQs with fixed answer keys, this paper evaluates 5G domain understanding and fault analysis in a free-text generation format. Transitioning to this paradigm requires evaluating lightweight, edge-deployable AI models on open-ended diagnostic reasoning, alongside a dependable framework to validate these text outputs at scale. To address this we evaluate three lightweight LLMs, Claude-Haiku-4.5, GPT-5.4-Mini, and Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite, on free-text 5G domain knowledge and fault-analysis tasks across three benchmarks, TeleQNA ORAN FT, 5G-Faults FT, and TeleInter FT. Three independent frontier judges score outputs, and pairwise inter-judge agreement is measured as an empirical test of the LLM-as-Judge methodology. All three models reach at least 90% accuracy on fault diagnosis, while zero-shot recall of 3GPP and O-RAN specifications remains the critical gap, with all models scoring below 60%. Mean inter-judge agreement is at least 0.90 across all runs, indicating that multi-judge LLM scoring produces consistent, reproducible grades for open-ended telecom responses. Operationally, Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite offers the best efficiency trade-off, combining competitive accuracy with the lowest inference cost and latency, making it the most suitable candidate for production telecom deployments.
papers.comment: 6pages, 4figures. Accepted for presentation in IEEE CSCN conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 5G/6G 网络中自由文本故障诊断的评估问题，提出用 LLM-as-Judge 框架评测轻量级、可边缘部署的 LLM。作者在三个基准（TeleQNA ORAN FT、5G-Faults FT、TeleInter FT）上评估 Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-5.4-Mini 和 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 的自由文本 5G 领域知识与故障分析能力，并用三个前沿大模型作为评分器测量成对评判一致性。摘要报告所有模型在故障诊断上达到至少 90% 的准确率，但对 3GPP 与 O-RAN 规范的零样本召回均低于 60%，且评分器间一致性至少为 0.90。
Motivation: 现有 5G 领域基准依赖带有固定答案的 MCQ（选择题），无法评估真实故障分析中开放式的自由文本诊断能力；同时轻量级边缘可部署模型能否胜任深度自由文本诊断仍是开放问题，需要可扩展的评估框架来验证这类输出。
Method: 将评估范式从限制性 MCQ 转为自由文本生成，评测三个轻量级 LLM 在 5G 领域知识与故障分析任务上的表现；采用三个独立的前沿大模型作为评分器（LLM-as-Judge），并通过两两评判一致性来实证检验该评估方法的可靠性。
Result: 三个模型在故障诊断上均达到至少 90% 的准确率，但在 3GPP 和 O-RAN 规范的零样本召回上全部低于 60%；所有实验的平均评判一致性至少为 0.90，表明多评判器 LLM 评分对开放端电信回答能产生一致可复现的成绩。Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 在准确率、推理成本和延迟之间取得最佳平衡。
Conclusion: 摘要认为轻量级 LLM 可以胜任 5G 故障诊断的自由文本输出，但对规范知识的零样本回忆是主要短板；多评判器 LLM-as-Judge 能稳定评估开放式电信答案，且 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 是最适合生产部署的候选模型。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对 5G/6G 网络中自由文本故障诊断的评估问题，提出用 LLM-as-Judge 框架评测轻量级、可边缘部署的 LLM。作者在三个基准（TeleQNA ORAN FT、5G-Faults FT、TeleInter FT）上评估 Claude-Haiku-4.5、GPT-5.4-Mini 和 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 的自由文本 5G 领域知识与故障分析能力，并用三个前沿大模型作为评分器测量成对评判一致性。摘要报告所有模型在故障诊断上达到至少 90% 的准确率，但对 3GPP 与 O-RAN 规范的零样本召回均低于 60%，且评分器间一致性至少为 0.90。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 5G 领域基准依赖带有固定答案的 MCQ（选择题），无法评估真实故障分析中开放式的自由文本诊断能力；同时轻量级边缘可部署模型能否胜任深度自由文本诊断仍是开放问题，需要可扩展的评估框架来验证这类输出。
summary_sections.method: 将评估范式从限制性 MCQ 转为自由文本生成，评测三个轻量级 LLM 在 5G 领域知识与故障分析任务上的表现；采用三个独立的前沿大模型作为评分器（LLM-as-Judge），并通过两两评判一致性来实证检验该评估方法的可靠性。
summary_sections.result: 三个模型在故障诊断上均达到至少 90% 的准确率，但在 3GPP 和 O-RAN 规范的零样本召回上全部低于 60%；所有实验的平均评判一致性至少为 0.90，表明多评判器 LLM 评分对开放端电信回答能产生一致可复现的成绩。Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 在准确率、推理成本和延迟之间取得最佳平衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为轻量级 LLM 可以胜任 5G 故障诊断的自由文本输出，但对规范知识的零样本回忆是主要短板；多评判器 LLM-as-Judge 能稳定评估开放式电信答案，且 Gemini-3.1-Flash-Lite 是最适合生产部署的候选模型。

papers.title: Target-Aware Calibration Data Selection for Preserving Uncertainty in Quantized Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is widely used to deploy large language models, but its effect on uncertainty behavior, such as confidence, margins, and abstention, is rarely treated as a primary objective. We frame calibration-data selection for quantization as a target-dependent uncertainty-preservation problem. Different deployments emphasize different regions of the input distribution, yet prior work mainly optimizes accuracy-oriented compression metrics or adjusts scores after quantization. We formalize this goal with distributional and boundary preservation risks, and provide a simple mixture-mismatch argument explaining why no single calibration recipe should be expected to fit all targets. We introduce Doubt-Preserving Quantization (DPQ), a lightweight pre-quantization recipe family that uses full-precision predictions to construct target-aligned calibration mixtures of high-doubt examples and generic anchors. Across 8 language models, 9 NLP benchmarks, and 22 comparison methods, the leading fixed recipe changes with the preservation target: DPQ-r75 leads on SQuAD2 answerability-boundary preservation, while milder or single-signal variants, including DPQ-r50, confidence-only, and entropy-only, better preserve broad multiple-choice QA behavior. These results show that calibration data should be selected for the specific full-precision score behavior a deployment needs to preserve, rather than treated as a fixed quantization detail.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to EMNLP Findings 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把量化语言模型的校准数据选择问题重构为依赖目标的不确定性保持问题，并提出 Doubt-Preserving Quantization (DPQ)，一个轻量的量化前配方族，利用全精度预测构造由高怀疑样本和通用锚点组成的目标对齐校准混合。在 8 个语言模型、9 个 NLP 基准和 22 个对比方法上的结果显示，最优固定配方随保持目标而变化：DPQ-r75 在 SQuAD2 可回答性边界保持上领先，而更温和或单信号变体在多项选择 QA 行为上更优。
Motivation: 量化通常只以精度导向的压缩指标为优化目标，量化对置信度、边距和弃权等不确定性行为的影响很少被当作主要目标；不同部署关注输入分布的不同区域，因此先验工作主要优化准确率或量化后调整分数，难以满足目标相关的保持需求。
Method: 作者形式化分布保持风险与边界保持风险，并提供混合失配论证说明没有单一校准配方能适配所有目标；在此基础上引入 DPQ 配方族，用全精度预测构造目标对齐的高怀疑样例与通用锚点的校准混合。
Result: 摘要报告在 8 个语言模型、9 个 NLP 基准和 22 个对比方法上，DPQ-r75 在 SQuAD2 可回答性边界保持上领先，而 DPQ-r50、仅置信度与仅熵变体更好地保持多项选择 QA 行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调校准数据应根据部署需要保持的全精度分数行为来挑选，而不应被视为固定不变的量化细节。

papers.title: From a Static Multi-Level Small Semantic Codebook to a Dynamic Single-Level Large Semantic Codebook for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation represents each item with a sequence of discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and predicts the sequence to retrieve the next item. Typical systems use multi-level residual quantization, which increases autoregressive decoding cost and creates a large hierarchical space that may be sparsely occupied. Static codebooks also become misaligned with current traffic as new items arrive and exposure distributions change. We propose a single-level large semantic codebook that replaces multiple residual semantic codes with one semantic token while retaining a separate collaborative disambiguation token to reduce item collisions. We further introduce an exposure-aware dynamic update mechanism based on temporal weight decay, exponential moving-average center updates, and an exposure-weighted penalty on SID changes. We also develop an offline evaluation framework covering representation quality, code utilization, cluster load, full-SID collision, and temporal stability. On two public datasets, the two-level SID improves mean Recall@10 by 5.0%-8.8% and mean NDCG@10 by 4.1%-5.1% for OneRec-V1, and by 7.1%-8.7% and 3.8%-8.5%, respectively, for OneRec-V2. Dynamic updating provides further gains on KuaiRec. Across three serving architectures, the shorter SID reduces estimated autoregressive-decoding FLOPs by 47.93%-48.70% and increases single-card QPS by 28.57%-47.0%. A five-day online A/B test serving 2.5% of production traffic improves the primary consumption metric by 0.792%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐 (generative recommendation) 中的语义 ID 离散化问题，提出用单级大型语义码本替代多级残差量化码本，每个物品由一个语义 token 加一个独立的协同消歧 token 表示。作者还引入基于时间权重衰减、指数移动平均中心更新和曝光加权惩罚的动态码本更新机制，并设计一个离线评估框架。在 OneRec-V1、OneRec-V2 和 KuaiRec 等数据集以及线上 A/B 测试中，该方法在推荐效果、解码效率和线上消费指标上均带来提升。
Motivation: 典型生成式推荐使用多级残差量化来生成语义 ID，但多级序列会增大自回归解码成本，且多层级空间可能被稀疏占用；同时静态码本会随着新物品到达和曝光分布变化而与当前流量失配。
Method: 提出单级大型语义码本，用一个语义 token 替代多个残差语义码，并保留单独的协同消歧 token 以减少物品碰撞；进一步提出曝光感知的动态更新机制，包含时间权重衰减、指数移动平均中心更新和对 SID 变化的曝光加权惩罚；还开发了覆盖表示质量、码利用率、簇负载、全 SID 碰撞和时间稳定性的离线评估框架。
Result: 在 OneRec-V1 上，两级 SID 使平均 Recall@10 提升 5.0%-8.8%、平均 NDCG@10 提升 4.1%-5.1%；在 OneRec-V2 上分别提升 7.1%-8.7% 和 3.8%-8.5%。动态更新在 KuaiRec 上带来进一步收益。更短的 SID 在三种服务架构下使估计的自回归解码 FLOPs 降低 47.93%-48.70%，单卡 QPS 提升 28.57%-47.0%；覆盖 2.5% 生产流量的五日线上 A/B 测试使主要消费指标提升 0.792%。
Conclusion: 作者认为用动态更新的单级大语义码本配合协同消歧 token 替代多级残差量化，能够在提升生成式推荐效果的同时显著降低自回归解码开销，并更适应流量分布的变化。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Dorsal Hand Images for Immersive (XR) and Privacy-preserving Age Assurance and Child Safety
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that Extended Reality (XR) environments are age-appropriate is an important regulatory and safety challenge. However, current age assurance operates only at registration and cannot verify the age of the active user during a session. Face-based approaches, the dominant solution in social media and adult platforms, are impractical in XR, because they require removing the headset and taking a self-captured image, often on a mobile app. This both breaks immersion and introduces the privacy risk of sharing face pictures with third parties, which leaves XR platforms without a viable path to continuous, in-session and privacy-preserving age assurance. We propose the dorsal part of the hand as an alternative to the face, by exploiting the egocentric cameras that XR headsets inherently and naturally use to capture gesture interactions. To evaluate this, we collect an age- and sex-stratified, ethnodiverse dataset of 436 participants spanning the minor--adult boundary, captured under unconstrained lighting and orientation conditions. To characterise what is achievable with off-the-shelf methods at the minor--adult boundary, we evaluate standard neural network architectures for age assurance at the legally critical 18-year threshold. Analysis confirms performance is robust to skin-tone variation. On this dataset, the challenge-31 operating point achieves zero minor admission, making the system a viable first-stage filter for age assurance. These findings position dorsal hand morphometrics as an effective and more privacy-preserving biometric modality for in-session age assurance in XR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 XR 头显自带的第一视角摄像头采集手背图像，作为人脸之外的替代生物特征，用于会话中连续、保护隐私的年龄验证，以解决 XR 环境中无法在不打断沉浸感的情况下核实当前用户年龄的问题。作者收集了 436 名参与者的分层数据集，覆盖未成年与成年边界，并在 18 岁法定阈值上评估标准神经网络架构，结果显示在 challenge-31 工作点可实现零未成年进入，且性能对肤色变化稳健。
Motivation: 现有年龄保证机制仅在注册时生效，无法在会话中验证当前用户的年龄；基于人脸的方法在 XR 中需要摘掉头显并自拍，既破坏沉浸感，又带来向第三方分享人脸照片的隐私风险，导致 XR 平台缺乏连续、会话内且保护隐私的年龄保证路径。
Method: 提出以手背（dorsal hand）作为生物特征模态，利用 XR 头显固有的第一视角摄像头捕捉手势交互时自然可见的手部图像；收集按年龄、性别分层且民族多样化的 436 人数据集，在不受控光照和方向条件下，评估标准神经网络架构在 18 岁边界上的年龄保证性能。
Result: 实验表明手背年龄验证对肤色变化具有稳健性；在 challenge-31 工作点上达到零未成年进入（zero minor admission），可作为有效的第一级过滤系统。
Conclusion: 作者认为手背形态学（dorsal hand morphometrics）是 XR 中会话内年龄保证的一种更有效且更保护隐私的生物特征模态，为持续年龄验证提供了可行路径。
Relevance: 5
