papers.title: Triangulation-Free Bundle Adjustment with Graduated Non-Convexity for Camera Pose Refinement from Coarse Priors
papers.abstract_en: Mobile AR frameworks attach a metric pose prior to every casual phone capture, and turning it into reconstruction-grade poses cheaply on CPU is the step before novel-view synthesis. The least a refiner owes an accurate prior is not to make it worse. The workhorse refiner does. On 15 ScanNet++ iPhone room captures, COLMAP triangulation plus prior-seeded bundle adjustment degrades an accurate ARKit prior in all 15, 0.55 degrees to 0.74 degrees by scene-mean. The cause is the seeding. Structure is triangulated from the prior before anything is optimized, so the prior's error is baked into the structure the optimizer trusts. We remove the triangulation. Every keypoint owns a scalar depth along its own back-projected ray and each match contributes two symmetric cross-projection residuals, so structure is re-expressed at every iterate. The same solve holds the room prior at 0.57 degrees and never fails in 330 perturbed room runs, and at object scale reaches 0.265 degrees/1.80 mm from a prior at 0.456 degrees in a median of 10 s per scene on one CPU, against 2.5 GPU-hours for a learned refiner. Because no structure is committed, the objective also admits graduated non-convexity, which measures how deep the defect goes. Classical refinement collapses past 1-2 degrees of prior error, barely beyond a real ARKit prior, and no classical refinement arm survives 32 degrees. Ours recovers 425 of 425 runs through 16 degrees/80 mm and 85% at 32 degrees/160 mm, and perturbed rooms through 32 degrees. Nominal object-scale accuracy is on par rather than better, on a benchmark at its own noise floor, where classical bundle adjustment is a strong baseline absent from the literature. One scene fails for every solver already at zero perturbation. Re-mapping from position priors matches us in the prior's frame but discards it, so it cannot exploit a prior worth keeping or be warm-started.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 3 figures. 18-scene MobileBrick evaluation, 15-scene ScanNet++ room-scale campaign, plus LaMAR. Code to be released under Apache-2.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种免三角化的束调整（bundle adjustment）方法，用于从粗略位姿先验（如 ARKit）在 CPU 上进行相机位姿精化。方法让每个关键点沿自身反投影射线持有标量深度，每个匹配贡献两个对称交叉投影残差，结构在每次迭代中重新表达，从而避免把先验误差烘焙进结构，并兼容渐进非凸（graduated non-convexity）。摘要报告在 ScanNet++ iPhone 房间数据上，经典 COLMAP 三角化加固化束调整使全部 15 个场景的 ARKit 先验变差（场景均值误差从 0.55° 增至 0.74°），而本方法将房间先验保持在 0.57° 并在 330 次扰动运行中从未失败；物体尺度可达 0.265°/1.80 mm（先验为 0.456°），中位耗时每场景 10 秒单 CPU，对比学习式精化器的 2.5 GPU 小时。
Motivation: 现有工作horse精化器（三角化加先验种子束调整）会在优化前从先验三角化结构，导致先验误差被固化到结构里，使准确先验反而变差；经典精化在真实 ARKit 先验误差范围附近（1-2°）即开始崩溃，32° 时全部经典分支失败。
Method: 去掉三角化步骤：每个关键点沿其自身反投影射线拥有一个标量深度，每个匹配贡献两个对称的交叉投影残差（cross-projection residuals），因此结构在每次迭代中被重新表达；由于没有结构被提前提交，目标函数可以引入渐进非凸（graduated non-convexity）来应对先验误差。

papers.title: Latent Ordinal Evidence, Misaligned Outputs: Inference-Time Ordinal Lens Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs apply the language model interface to visual inputs, where ordinal regression tasks such as age estimation, image quality assessment, and disease grading require autoregressive decisions over ordered class labels. We ask whether MLLMs reliably convert internal ordinal evidence into ordered digit-token outputs. Across four ordinal benchmarks and four MLLM backbones, ordinal labels are linearly recoverable from hidden states with Spearman correlation up to 0.938, and a task-designed prompt further sharpens this structure. Yet native digit-token outputs weakly expose it: the unembedding matrix filters the ordinal direction, and the digit-token row space retains below 1.15% across all 16 model-dataset combinations, with a 16 to 77 absolute-point accuracy gap between linear-probe and native outputs. We introduce Ordinal Lens Alignment (OLA), a frozen-backbone inference-time method that trains lightweight W_S-anchored lenses on mid-to-deep decoder layers, fuses them into an ordinal distribution, and corrects only digit-token logits at generation. OLA outperforms the SOTA LoRA-tuned OrderChain baseline in most settings while keeping the MLLM frozen, surpasses discriminative ordinal baselines in most cells, and improves over an offline lens in every setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多模态 LLM（MLLM）在视觉序数回归任务（如年龄估计、图像质量评估、疾病分级）中能否将内部序数证据可靠地转换为有序数字 token 输出。作者在四个序数基准和四个 MLLM 主干上发现，序数标签可从隐藏状态线性恢复（Spearman 最高 0.938），但原生数字 token 输出对该序数方向的暴露极弱，unembedding 矩阵会过滤该方向，数字 token 行空间保留率在全部 16 个模型-数据集组合中低于 1.15%，线性探针与原生输出之间存在 16 到 77 个绝对点的准确率差距。为此提出 Ordinal Lens Alignment (OLA)，一种冻结主干的推理时方法，训练轻量 W_S-anchored lenses 并融合为序数分布，仅在生成时校正数字 token logits。
Motivation: MLLM 在视觉序数回归任务中需要按有序类别标签进行自回归决策，但内部隐藏状态中线性可恢复的序数证据未被原生数字 token 输出有效暴露，存在内部表征与输出之间的错位，导致准确率明显低于线性探针。
Method: 提出 Ordinal Lens Alignment (OLA)，一种冻结 backbone 的推理时方法：在中至深 decoder 层训练轻量 W_S-anchored lenses，融合为序数分布，并在生成阶段仅校正数字 token 的 logits，不修改 MLLM 参数。
Result: OLA 在大多数设置下优于 SOTA 的 LoRA 微调 OrderChain baseline，同时在保持 MLLM 冻结的情况下超越大多数判别式序数 baseline，并在每个设置中都优于离线 lens；摘要报告序数方向可线性恢复（Spearman 最高 0.938），数字 token 行空间保留率低于 1.15%，线性探针与原生输出准确率差距为 16 到 77 个绝对点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 MLLM 的输出层会过滤内部序数证据，而 OLA 通过在推理时校正数字 token logits 可以恢复该方向，并在多种基准上以冻结 backbone 的方式取得优于对比方法的性能。

papers.title: Free-Probability Kernels for Zero-Rollout Hyperparameter Selection in Reservoir Computing
papers.abstract_en: Reservoir computing (RC) couples a fixed recurrent dynamical system with a trained lightweight readout, but this efficiency is partly lost during hyperparameter selection: the recurrent gain, input scale, and leakage rate determine the reservoir's stability and temporal processing regime and are usually tuned through many rollouts. We introduce a deterministic, pilot-informed selector for leaky linear reservoirs followed by coordinate-wise nonlinear features. Free probability yields cross-lag propagation coefficients that summarize how the reservoir mixes past inputs. In the large-width limit, these coefficients define a deterministic temporal kernel that approximates the finite-reservoir feature geometry. Kernel ridge regression on a short labelled pilot sequence therefore ranks candidate operating regimes without instantiating or rolling out a reservoir, and the selected configuration transfers across widths. Across ten synthetic temporal benchmarks, zero-rollout selection obtains a mean deployment score of $0.772$, compared with $0.774$ for exhaustive simulation-based search, while avoiding $156\,600$ selection rollouts. With a small rollout budget, the proposed ranking provides the strongest mean performance at every tested budget and reaches the exhaustive reference using $4.8\%$ of its rollout cost. On four public electricity-transformer-temperature (ETT) forecasting datasets, five retained candidates recover the exhaustive operating point on three datasets. On multivariate cellular-traffic forecasting, 15 rollouts per cell reach the 462-rollout exhaustive reference and outperform random search and Bayesian optimization at low budgets. These results position free-probability kernels as deterministic surrogates for selecting reservoir operating regimes when validation rollouts are scarce.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于储层计算 (reservoir computing) 超参数选择的确定性代理方法：利用自由概率 (free probability) 推导泄漏线性储层的跨滞后传播系数，在大宽度极限下构造确定性时间核，从而在无实例化、无 rollout 的情况下用短标注 pilot 序列对候选运行工况排序。在十个合成时间序列基准上，零 rollout 选择达到与穷举仿真搜索接近的平均部署得分（0.772 对 0.774），并避免了 156,600 次选择 rollout；在 ETT 与蜂窝流量预测数据上以少量 rollout 即可接近或达到穷举参考性能。
Motivation: 储层计算的主要效率优势——固定随机动力系统加轻量读出器——在超参数选择阶段被削弱，因为循环增益、输入尺度和泄漏率通常需要大量 rollout 调参。本文目标是提供一种无需实例化或 rollout 的确定性选择方法，以在验证 rollout 稀缺时挑选储层运行工况。
Method: 针对带坐标非线性特征的泄漏线性储层，作者利用自由概率推导跨滞后传播系数，这些系数总结了储层对过去输入的混合方式。在大宽度极限下，这些系数定义了一个确定性时间核 (temporal kernel)，可近似有限储层的特征几何；对短标注 pilot 序列做核岭回归 (kernel ridge regression) 即可对候选运行工况排序，且所选配置可跨宽度迁移。
Result: 在十个合成时间序列基准上，零 rollout 选择的平均部署得分为 0.772，穷举仿真搜索为 0.774，同时避免了 156,600 次选择 rollout；在小 rollout 预算下，所提排序在每个测试预算上都取得最强平均性能，并仅用穷举 4.8% 的 rollout 成本达到穷举参考。在四个 ETT 数据集上，保留五个候选即可在三个数据集上恢复穷举运行点；在多变量蜂窝流量预测中，每单元 15 次 rollout 达到 462 次 rollout 的穷举参考，并在低预算下优于随机搜索和贝叶斯优化。
Conclusion: 摘要将自由概率核定位为在验证 rollout 稀缺时选择储层运行工况的确定性替代物，并强调所提方法在不同宽度间可迁移、以极低 rollout 预算逼近穷举搜索。

papers.title: Trojaning the Alignment: Stealthy Backdoor Attacks against Graph Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs) align graph representations with language semantics to support transferable graph learning. Despite these advantages, the backdoor vulnerability of GFMs on TAGs remains insufficiently understood, especially under graph-language alignment, where graph and text representations are trained to constrain each other in a shared semantic space. Existing backdoor attacks mainly target either the graph side or the text side, treating the two modalities independently. This makes direct adaptation ineffective: graph-only triggers can be constrained by clean text semantics, while text-only triggers alter the language view but do not directly shift the graph representation being aligned and scored. TAGs also impose a stealth challenge because triggers are exposed as both node text and local graph structure, making incoherent trigger attributes or anomalous subgraphs easy to inspect or filter. In this paper, we propose STAG, a stealthy trojan attack framework designed for the graph-language alignment interface of GFMs on TAGs. STAG coordinates a graph-trigger generator with a text-side soft prompt so that trigger-attached graph representations and triggered text representations move toward the same target-class text region. To address TAG-specific stealthiness, STAG realizes trigger nodes as readable text through candidate retrieval and regularizes the trigger-attached subgraph so that its local structure remains close to the original subgraph. Extensive experiments on multiple TAG datasets and representative GFMs demonstrate the effectiveness and stealthiness of STAG. Our code is available at https://github.com/ventr1c/STAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STAG，一个针对文本属性图 (TAG) 上图基础模型 (GFM) 的图-语言对齐接口设计的隐蔽后门攻击框架。STAG 协调图端触发器生成器与文本端软提示 (soft prompt)，使被触发的图表示与文本表示共同移向目标类文本区域；同时通过候选检索让触发器节点呈现为可读文本，并正则化触发器附加子图以保持与原始子图的结构相似性。实验在多个 TAG 数据集和代表性 GFM 上验证了该攻击的有效性与隐蔽性，代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有后门攻击主要单独作用于图侧或文本侧，未考虑 GFM 中图-语言对齐机制，导致直接迁移效果差：纯图触发器会被干净文本语义约束，纯文本触发器则不能直接移动用于打分对齐的图表示。此外，TAG 中触发器同时暴露为节点文本和局部图结构，容易被检查和过滤，带来额外隐蔽性挑战。
Method: 提出 STAG 框架，针对 GFM 在图-语言对齐接口上的后门注入：用图触发器生成器构造触发图表示，并用文本端软提示构造触发文本表示，使两者共同逼近同一目标类文本区域；为满足 TAG 隐蔽性要求，通过候选检索实现可读的触发器节点文本，并对触发器附加子图施加正则化以保持其局部结构接近原始子图。
Result: 在多个 TAG 数据集与代表性 GFM 上的广泛实验表明，STAG 能实现有效且隐蔽的后门攻击。
Conclusion: 摘要指出图-语言对齐接口是 GFM 在 TAG 上的潜在攻击面，STAG 在该接口上实现了隐蔽后门攻击；作者公开了代码以便复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Jacobian-guided Noise Injection for Quantization Robustness in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization of Large Language Models (LLMs) is often hindered by the sensitivity of the self-attention mechanism to discretization errors. We identify the softmax operator as a bottleneck for quantization stability due to its sensitivity to outliers and state-dependent Jacobian. We theoretically establish that suppressing the norm of this Jacobian helps in bounding quantization-induced performance degradation. Based on this, we propose Jacobian-Guided Noise Injection, a training strategy that injects zero-mean Gaussian noise into pre-attention logits, with variance derived directly from the Jacobian Frobenius norm. Unlike prior approaches that rely on heuristic or penalise jacobian directly, our method provides a way to identify the optimal noise variance based on the local attention sensitivity. We evaluate the method on SOTA LLM architectures, where it demonstrates improved robustness over popular PTQ methods. Empirical analysis reveals that the proposed method gives up to +37% relative gains on Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K for SigLIP and improves relative perplexity by upto 40% on WikiText for language models in low bit quantisation settings, proving the efficacy of the approach.
papers.comment: Accepted at AdaptFM: Resource-Adaptive Foundation Model Inference, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型量化鲁棒性，指认自注意力机制中的 softmax 算子因对离群值和状态相关 Jacobian 敏感而成为量化不稳定的瓶颈。作者理论上证明抑制该 Jacobian 范数可以限制量化引起的性能退化，并据此提出 Jacobian 引导的噪声注入训练策略，在预注意力 logits 上注入方差由 Jacobian Frobenius 范数决定的高斯噪声。实验显示该方法在低比特量化下优于常见 PTQ 方法，并报告了 SigLIP 在 ImageNet-1K 上 Top-1 相对提升最高达 37%、语言模型在 WikiText 上相对困惑度改善最高达 40%。
Motivation: LLM 量化常受限于自注意力机制对离散化误差的敏感性，而 softmax 算子因对离群值和状态相关 Jacobian 敏感，成为量化稳定性的瓶颈。
Method: 提出 Jacobian-Guided Noise Injection 训练策略：向 pre-attention logits 注入零均值高斯噪声，噪声方差直接由 Jacobian Frobenius 范数推导得到，从而根据局部注意力敏感性确定最优噪声方差，而非使用启发式或直接惩罚 Jacobian。
Result: 在主流 LLM 架构上的实验表明，该方法相比流行 PTQ 方法具有更好的量化鲁棒性；在低比特量化下，SigLIP 在 ImageNet-1K 上 Top-1 准确率相对提升最高达 +37%，语言模型在 WikiText 上相对困惑度改善最高达 40%。
Conclusion: 作者从理论上建立了抑制 softmax Jacobian 范数与量化性能退化上界之间的联系，并展示基于 Jacobian 的噪声注入能在低比特量化场景中提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: MigrationNarrate: A Dataset for Detection of Migration Narratives in YouTube Videos
papers.abstract_en: Narratives are central to how social communication is framed, making their detection critical for understanding and analysing public discourse. Prior work has explored narrative detection and extraction across diverse domains; however, migration narratives remain significantly understudied, primarily due to the absence of dedicated annotated datasets. Furthermore, public communication has recently shifted towards video-centric platforms, where narratives are conveyed through multimodal signals and consumed at scale. Despite this shift, narratives in videos remain largely unexplored. To bridge these gaps, we introduce MigrationNarrate, the first multimodal dataset for detection of migration narratives in the UK, consisting of 1,115 YouTube video transcripts annotated using a two-level taxonomy of 12 migration super-narratives and 53 narrative labels. This paper details the dataset design, collection, and annotations; together with benchmark results using a combination of pre-trained encoder models and both open- and closed-source Large Language Models. Finally, a thorough error analysis offers insights for future work.
papers.comment: This work was accepted to the main conference of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MigrationNarrate，据作者称是首个用于检测英国 YouTube 视频中移民叙事的多模态数据集，包含 1,115 个视频转录文本，并使用两级分类体系进行标注（12 个移民超级叙事和 53 个叙事标签）。论文详述了数据集设计、收集与标注过程，并给出了基于预训练编码器模型及开源/闭源大语言模型（LLM）的基准测试结果，最后通过错误分析为后续研究提供见解。
Motivation: 叙事是公共话语框架的核心，但移民叙事因缺乏专门标注数据集而研究不足；同时公共传播正向视频平台转移，视频中的多模态叙事尚未被充分探索。
Method: 构建多模态数据集 MigrationNarrate，包含 YouTube 视频转录文本和两级叙事标签体系；使用预训练编码器模型以及开源与闭源大语言模型进行检测基准测试，并开展错误分析。
Result: 摘要报告了数据集构建过程和基准实验结果，但未给出具体数值；错误分析提供了面向未来工作的见解。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了移民叙事检测缺乏多模态数据集的空白，并强调错误分析为后续研究指明方向。

papers.title: A Critical Audit of Spatiotemporal Forecasting Benchmark Datasets and Baselines
papers.abstract_en: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are routinely employed for short-range forecasting on multivariate time series with a spatial graph structure. Despite the availability of many alternative datasets, method innovations within this domain are predominantly assessed against a rather limited set of benchmark datasets, most notably Chickenpox, PedalMe, WikiMaths, METR-LA, and PEMS-BAY. The evaluation protocols contain baselines spanning from historical averages to classical machine learning approaches. These baselines often show competitive performance compared to GNNs. In the present work, we take a step back and analyse the benchmark datasets via classical time series methods to uncover why spatially-unaware linear models pose a stronger competitor than previously reported, casting further doubt on the discriminative reliability of the aforementioned widely adopted datasets. Our statistical analysis provides a toolset for identifying significant spatial and temporal correlations, while revealing a structural bias introduced by first-order differenced datasets. We therefore recommend reducing the over-reliance on such datasets for method comparison, and instead advocate for more rigorous statistical evaluation. By applying the results of our analysis to a simple hybrid model, we show how our methodology can lead to novel ways of developing GNN models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对时空预测（spatiotemporal forecasting）领域的常用基准数据集与基线方法进行批判性审计，聚焦 GNN 在多元时间序列短程预测中的评估可靠性。作者用经典时间序列方法分析 Chickenpox、PedalMe、WikiMaths、METR-LA 和 PEMS-BAY 等数据集，发现不考虑空间信息的线性模型比此前报告中的表现更强，并指出一阶差分数据集带来的结构性偏差，因而质疑这些基准的区分能力。最后通过一个简单混合模型展示该分析如何指引新的 GNN 建模思路。
Motivation: GNN 广泛用于带空间图结构的多变量时间序列短程预测，但该领域的方法创新几乎只在有限的几个基准数据集上评估，且其中的经典基线时常与 GNN 性能相当，这使现有基准的判别可靠性受到质疑。
Method: 采用经典时间序列方法对基准数据集进行统计剖析，提供一套识别显著空间与时间相关性的工具，并揭示一阶差分（first-order differenced）数据集引入的结构性偏差；随后将分析结论应用于一个简单混合模型，示范如何据此设计新的 GNN 模型。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验数字，主要结果为：空间无关的线性模型对 GNN 构成的竞争比以往报告更强，且一阶差分数据集存在结构性偏差，进一步削弱了这些常用基准的判别可靠性。
Conclusion: 作者建议减少对这些基准数据集的过度依赖，转而采用更严格的统计评估，并认为该分析方法可以为 GNN 模型开发提供新途径。

papers.title: Belief Without Behavior: Measuring the Translation of Theory of Mind into Coordinated Social Action in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Effective social interaction requires agents to translate mental state inferences into coordinated behavioral signals across verbal and nonverbal channels simultaneously. Yet existing benchmarks evaluate theory of mind (ToM) reasoning and embodied behavior in isolation, leaving unmeasured the gap between social inference and social action. We introduce MOSAIC (Multimodal Orchestration of Social Action, Inference, and Communication), a controlled benchmark in which two embodied agents interact across cooperative and competitive scenarios requiring integration of verbal statements, spatial trajectories, gaze direction, and facial expression under systematically varied ToM constraints. Evaluating 13 models, including 11 VLMs, across 200 trials per model, we find that VLMs fail to produce behaviors consistent with the expected outcomes under ToM-order constraints, and that imposing explicit ToM-order constraints produces no reliable behavioral change aligned with the specified reasoning level. Signal-level analysis reveals two sequential bottlenecks: most models cannot produce directionally coherent nonverbal signals, and even when signals are present, VLM agents fail to interpret others behaviors and react to them. PCM-LLM, included as a structured architectural reference point with an explicit ToM module, succeeds across all conditions, suggesting that explicit belief-action coupling is a sufficient ingredient for this class of tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC（Multimodal Orchestration of Social Action, Inference, and Communication）基准，用于测量视觉语言模型（VLM）能否将心智理论（theory of mind, ToM）推理转化为协调的社会行为。在两个具身智能体参与的合作与竞争场景中，模型需要整合语言陈述、空间轨迹、注视方向和面部表情，并在系统变化的 ToM 约束下进行评估。对 13 个模型（含 11 个 VLM）各 200 次试验的评估显示，VLM 无法产生与指定 ToM 层级一致的行为，且显式施加 ToM 约束也不会带来可靠的行为变化；而带显式 ToM 模块的 PCM-LLM 在所有条件下成功。
Motivation: 现有基准将 ToM 推理和具身行为分开评估，导致社会推理与社会行动之间的差距未被测量，而有效社交恰恰要求同时协调多个通道的行为信号。
Method: 构建受控基准 MOSAIC，在其中两个具身智能体于合作与竞争场景中互动，要求整合语言、空间轨迹、注视方向和面部表情，并在系统变化的 ToM 约束下评估模型的协调社会行为。
Result: 13 个模型（11 个 VLM）各 200 次试验中，VLM 无法产生符合 ToM 顺序约束期望结果的行为，显式 ToM 约束也不产生可靠行为变化。信号级分析发现两个连续瓶颈：多数模型无法产生方向一致的非语言信号；即使信号存在，VLM 智能体也无法解读并回应他人行为。作为结构化参照的 PCM-LLM 在所有条件下成功。
Conclusion: 摘要指出显式的信念-行为耦合（belief-action coupling）是此类任务的充分条件，暗示当前 VLM 在 ToM 推理与协调社会行动之间仍存在系统性缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WA-JEPA: Rethinking the Video JEPA Paradigm for World-Action Modeling in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) learns powerful spatiotemporal representations from video through self-supervised latent feature prediction. However, V-JEPA is built around random-mask completion and deterministic regression, making it fundamentally ill-suited for autonomous driving planning that demands future-directed prediction tightly coupled with action. To address this, we rethink the V-JEPA paradigm and present WA-JEPA, a V-JEPA-native world-action model designed for autonomous driving planning. Instead of random spatiotemporal masking, WA-JEPA employs hybrid future-masked pre-training, where the model infers future latents from observed context. Departing from deterministic regression, we recast future prediction as conditional flow matching over latent futures, which substantially improves the model's ability to generate plausible future latents for downstream planning. Finally, a joint future-action predictor is proposed to denoise future scene tokens and ego trajectories together in a unified spatiotemporal latent space, allowing action supervision to directly shape planning-relevant world representations. Pre-trained on nuPlan videos and fine-tuned on NAVSIM, WA-JEPA reaches 91.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM-v2, surpassing the strongest end-to-end and world-action baselines by 1.6 and 1.3 EPDMS, and, without HUGSIM-specific fine-tuning, attains the best HD-Score of 0.4462 on the closed-loop HUGSIM benchmark under the same evaluation protocol. These results validate V-JEPA-native world-action modeling as a powerful and scalable paradigm for autonomous driving planning. Code is available at https://github.com/AFARI-Research/WA-JEPA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WA-JEPA，一个面向自动驾驶规划的 V-JEPA 原生世界-动作模型（world-action model）。作者指出 V-JEPA 基于随机掩码补全和确定性回归，不适合需要与动作紧密耦合的未来预测；WA-JEPA 改用混合未来掩码预训练，将未来预测重构为潜在未来上的条件流匹配（conditional flow matching），并用联合未来-动作预测器在统一时空潜在空间中同时去噪未来场景 token 与自车轨迹。在 nuPlan 上预训练、NAVSIM 上微调后，WA-JEPA 在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 91.7 EPDMS，并在不针对 HUGSIM 微调的情况下取得该基准闭环评估的最高 HD-Score 0.4462。
Motivation: V-JEPA 的随机掩码补全与确定性回归范式无法满足自动驾驶规划对面向未来且与动作紧密耦合的预测需求，需要重新设计视频 JEPA 范式以支持规划。
Method: 提出混合未来掩码预训练，让模型从观测上下文中推断未来潜在表示；将未来预测从确定性回归改为潜在未来上的条件流匹配；提出联合未来-动作预测器，在统一时空潜在空间中同时去噪未来场景 token 和自车轨迹，使动作监督直接塑造与规划相关的世界表示。
Result: 在 nuPlan 视频上预训练并在 NAVSIM 上微调后，WA-JEPA 在 NAVSIM-v2 上达到 91.7 EPDMS，超过最强端到端基线和世界-动作基线 1.6 和 1.3 EPDMS；在未针对 HUGSIM 微调的条件下，于相同评估协议下取得 HUGSIM 闭环基准的最高 HD-Score 0.4462。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果验证了 V-JEPA 原生的世界-动作建模是自动驾驶规划中强大且可扩展的范式，并公开了代码。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Training DeepFilterNet with Accurate Room Acoustic Simulations Improves Single-Channel Speech Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: We investigate how the realism of synthetic room impulse response (RIR) datasets affects the training of DeepFilterNet3 for single-channel speech enhancement. We compare a DNS4 image-source-method (ISM) RIR dataset with a higher-acoustic-fidelity dataset generated using hybrid wave-based and geometrical acoustics simulation. Rather than isolating individual simulation factors, we compare complete RIR generation pipelines while keeping the enhancement model unchanged. Models are evaluated on unseen measured RIRs using objective speech enhancement metrics and downstream automatic speech recognition (ASR). Training with the higher-fidelity dataset consistently yields modest improvements in objective metrics and substantially lower ASR word error rates than the ISM dataset. Although the experiments do not attribute these gains to individual modelling components, they show that increasing the overall realism of synthetic acoustic training data improves the generalization of DeepFilterNet3 to unseen measured environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究合成房间冲激响应 (RIR) 数据集的真实感对 DeepFilterNet3 单通道语音增强训练的影响。作者比较 DNS4 中基于镜像声源法 (ISM) 的 RIR 数据集与基于混合波动声学和几何声学仿真生成的更高保真度数据集，在保持增强模型不变的前提下对比完整 RIR 生成流程。在未见过的实测 RIR 上评估，高保真度数据集训练带来客观指标的适度提升和 ASR 词错误率的显著下降，说明提高合成声学训练数据的整体真实感可改善模型泛化。
Motivation: 合成 RIR 数据是语音增强模型训练的重要来源，但不同 RIR 生成管线对模型在真实环境中泛化的影响缺乏系统性比较。作者希望弄清更高声学保真度的仿真数据是否能让模型在未见过的实测环境下表现更好。
Method: 不单独隔离仿真因素，而是将 DNS4 的 ISM RIR 数据集与使用混合波动声学与几何声学仿真生成的更高保真度 RIR 数据集作为两条完整生成管线，用相同的 DeepFilterNet3 模型分别训练，并在未见过的实测 RIR 上用客观语音增强指标和 ASR 进行评测。
Result: 基于高保真度数据集训练在客观语音增强指标上取得一致但适度的改进，并在 ASR 词错误率上显著低于 ISM 数据集训练的结果。
Conclusion: 实验无法将收益归因于单个建模组件，但表明提升合成声学训练数据的整体真实感能改善 DeepFilterNet3 对未见实测环境的泛化；结论限定在完整 RIR 生成管线对比的层面。

papers.title: Deep Learning Models Also Recall Features
papers.abstract_en: Recent work in mechanistic interpretability has studied how large language models recall facts stored in their weights. This paper argues that factual recall points to something broader: a general kind of operation in deep learning models, which I call feature recall. The core observation is that a linear projection can be read as retrieving stored information scaled by input activations. I define feature recall, show it applies across architectures, and contrast it with the established paradigm of feature combination. I also consider how cases of feature recall might be mechanistically identified. The account gives philosophers a new conceptual tool for understanding deep learning, and points to empirical directions for mechanistic interpretability research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 近期关于大语言模型事实回忆的研究出发，提出一个更一般的概念：特征回忆 (feature recall)。作者认为线性投影可以理解为按输入激活缩放地检索存储信息，并在此定义下说明该操作适用于多种架构，且与传统的特征组合 (feature combination) 范式形成对照。摘要未报告实验，侧重概念分析与哲学层面的诠释。
Motivation: 近期机制可解释性研究聚焦于模型如何回忆存储在权重中的事实，但作者认为事实回忆只是更一般操作的一个特例，需要一个新的概念框架来统一理解这类行为。
Method: 采用概念分析方法：定义 feature recall，论证其跨架构适用性，将其与 feature combination 范式对比，并讨论如何在机制层面识别这类回忆过程。
Result: 摘要未给出实证结果或实验数据，主要贡献是提出一个用于理解深度学习的新概念工具，并为机制可解释性研究指出实证方向。
Conclusion: 作者认为该概念为哲学家理解深度学习提供了新工具，同时为机制可解释性的未来实证研究打开路径；这是一篇概念性论文，而非实验驱动的研究。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Kinematic Knowledge Maps for Pattern Alignment: Structured Latent Representational Learning in Multimodal Gait Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal clinical AI is limited by weakly aligned inputs and the absence of domain-specific interpretable representations, particularly when learning from dense video stream, structured time-series, and template-based kinematic text. Here we present ScoliDetect, an explainable framework for adolescent idiopathic scoliosis screening from monocular gait video, built around a kinematic knowledge map (KKM) and complementary template-based kinematic text derived from per-sequence pose statics. KKM is a fixed-index structured representation that encodes gait features across absolute motion, self-skeleton configuration and joint-joint signal correlation, providing anchor-referenced multimodal fusion and factor-level interpretation. We integrate video, KKM, and template-based kinematic text through bidirectional cross-attention with latent-bottleneck aggregation. In a multicenter cohort (n = 1,858 after exclusions), prespecified supervised ablations on an external screening cohort show that KKM-mediated multimodal fusion outperforms unimodal models and late concatenation. Under a staged training protocol, trimodal contrastive pretraining is applied after architecture selection as representation initialization, improving external ROC-AUC from 0.961 to 0.972. Furthermore, the structured nature of the KKM provides inherent, factor-level attributions mapped directly to specific kinematic phases and skeletal indices, offering verifiable interpretability. The results demonstrate that embedding explicit structural topologies into latent spaces significantly enhances both the generalization and explainability of multimodal pattern analysis systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ScoliDetect，一个面向青少年特发性脊柱侧凸筛查的可解释框架，以单目步态视频为输入，围绕运动学知识图 (KKM) 与基于模板的运动学文本构建多模态融合。KKM 是一种固定索引的结构化表示，编码绝对运动、自骨架构型和关节-关节信号相关性，并通过双向交叉注意力与潜在瓶颈聚合实现视频、KKM 和文本的融合。在多中心队列中，外部筛查集上的 ROC-AUC 从 0.961 提升到 0.972，且 KKM 可提供映射到具体运动相位和骨骼索引的因子级归因。
Motivation: 多模态临床 AI 受限于弱对齐输入和缺乏领域特定的可解释表示，尤其是在同时学习密集视频流、结构化时间序列和基于模板的运动学文本时，现有方法难以提供可验证的因子级解释。
Method: 提出 ScoliDetect 框架，核心是 KKM 这一固定索引结构化表示，覆盖绝对运动、自骨架构型和关节间信号相关性；将视频、KKM 与模板化运动学文本通过双向交叉注意力加潜在瓶颈聚合进行融合，并在架构选择后采用三模态对比预训练作为表示初始化。
Result: 在排除后的多中心队列 (n = 1,858) 上，预先指定的监督消融实验显示 KKM 介导的多模态融合优于单模态模型和晚期拼接；采用分阶段训练协议后，外部筛查 ROC-AUC 从 0.961 提升至 0.972。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将显式结构拓扑嵌入潜在空间能显著提升多模态模式分析系统的泛化能力和可解释性，KKM 的结构化特性提供了直接映射到运动相位和骨骼索引的因子级归因。

papers.title: Generalizing Soft Tissue Deformation and Force Prediction Across Material Stiffness and Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Accurate soft tissue simulation is essential for surgical training, pre-operative planning, and haptic feedback systems. While learning-based surrogate models trained on data using the finite element method (FEM) offer a promising path to real-time inference, their reliability depends on well-calibrated constitutive models. Existing approaches neither provide systematic guidance on model selection across stiffness levels, nor generalize across different tissue stiffnesses or geometries. We perform a comprehensive calibration of hyperelastic constitutive models in the SOFA Framework using gravity-loaded silicone beams with different stiffnesses. Using calibrated simulations as training data, we use a softness conditioned equivariant graph neural network, enabling deformation and force prediction across multiple tissue types and unseen geometries. Our model achieves sub-millimeter mean deformation accuracy at 0.010s inference time, while showing that force prediction quality is directly tied to upstream calibration consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对软组织变形与力预测在材料刚度和几何上的泛化问题，在 SOFA 框架中使用不同刚度的重力加载硅胶梁对超弹性本构模型（hyperelastic constitutive models）进行系统校准，并以校准后的仿真数据训练软度条件化的等变图神经网络（softness conditioned equivariant graph neural network）。模型在 0.010s 推理时间内达到亚毫米级平均变形精度，并表明力预测质量与上游校准一致性直接相关。
Motivation: 基于有限元法（FEM）数据训练的学习式代理模型虽有实时推理潜力，但可靠性依赖于校准良好的本构模型；现有方法既不对刚度水平提供模型选择的系统指导，也不能在不同组织刚度或几何之间泛化。
Method: 在 SOFA 框架中对不同刚度的硅胶梁开展全面校准，以校准后的仿真数据作为训练集，训练一个软度条件化的等变图神经网络，使变形与力预测能覆盖多种组织类型和未见过的几何形状。
Result: 摘要报告模型在 0.010s 推理时间内实现亚毫米级平均变形精度，并发现力预测质量直接取决于上游校准的一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨刚度和几何的校准一致性是力预测质量的核心，软度条件化的等变图神经网络可在实时推理下实现跨组织类型的变形预测。

papers.title: Structured but Fragile: On the Limits of LLMs in Cybersecurity Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cybersecurity workflows, yet it remains unclear whether they can perform structured security reasoning or merely rely on superficial cues and prior knowledge. We study this question in the context of defence selection over attack graphs derived from real-world threat scenarios, including ransomware, supply-chain compromise, cloud abuse, Kubernetes attacks, POS malware, and ICS/OT intrusion. Given a budget constraint, LLMs must select security controls to minimise attacker success. We compare their strategies against each other and against a game-theoretic optimization baseline used as a normative reference for structured reasoning. Our results show that LLMs exhibit conditional competence. When explicit attack-graph structure is provided, they often produce coherent strategies close to the optimization baseline. However, their capabilities are fragile. LLM behaviour becomes increasingly fragile with graph complexity and is highly sensitive to framing. Small prompt changes can substantially alter rankings, and merely relabeling a poor strategy as ``optimal'' dramatically improves its evaluation. We further observe a non-monotonic relationship between formal risk and LLM judgement: strategies closest to the optimum are not necessarily ranked highest by LLM evaluators. To further probe reasoning ability, we ask LLMs to generate solvers for the same optimization problem. While the generated implementations recover the correct high-level formulation, they scale poorly compared to a purpose-built solver. Overall, our findings show that LLMs can approximate structured cybersecurity reasoning under controlled representations, but do not apply it robustly. This has important implications for the design and evaluation of AI-assisted security decision-support systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在网络安全决策中能否进行结构化安全推理，还是仅依赖表面线索与先验知识。作者基于真实威胁场景（勒索软件、供应链入侵、云滥用、Kubernetes 攻击、POS 恶意软件、ICS/OT 入侵）构建攻击图（attack graph），让 LLM 在预算约束下选择安全控制措施以最小化攻击者成功概率，并与博弈论优化基线比较。结果显示 LLM 具备条件性能力：显式给出攻击图结构时策略接近优化基线，但行为脆弱，对图复杂度和提示措辞高度敏感，且生成的求解器扩展性差。
Motivation: LLM 正被越来越多地用于网络安全工作流，但尚不清楚它们能否执行结构化的安全推理，还是在依赖表面线索和既有知识；这一问题对 AI 辅助安全决策支持系统的设计与评估至关重要。
Method: 从真实威胁场景推导攻击图，定义预算约束下的防御选择优化问题，将 LLM 的防御策略相互之间以及与作为规范性参考（normative reference）的博弈论优化基线进行比较；同时要求 LLM 为该优化问题生成求解器以进一步探测其推理能力。
Result: LLM 表现出条件性胜任：提供显式攻击图结构时，其策略常接近优化基线；但能力脆弱，随图复杂度增加而退化，且对框架（framing）高度敏感——微小提示改动可显著改变排序，仅将差策略重新标注为“optimal”就能大幅提升其评估分数。形式化风险与 LLM 判断呈非单调关系；生成的求解器能恢复正确的高层公式，但扩展性远逊于专用求解器。
Conclusion: LLM 在受控表示下能近似结构化网络安全推理，但无法稳健地应用；作者强调这对 AI 辅助安全决策支持系统的设计与评估有重要启示。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Training, learning and inference: unified dynamics of neural systems
papers.abstract_en: We define an atomic generation fact f=(u,tau,omega,z;rho), recording the origin, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, generated result and relation role. Compiled into a Generation-Fact Graph (GFG), these facts provide an AI-native, compilable scientific fact substrate preserving generation histories. We establish a GFG-based recursive scientific process in which analysis, intervention, replay and validation form facts for later cycles. Using nanoGPT, we establish unified training-learning dynamics. Training is the evolution of a parameter-optimizer system with state and memory: each actual training action enters the receiving state and produces a finite-amplitude nonlinear functional response conditioned by that state and target-specific update geometry. Learning is the persistent reorganization of distributed functional support by these responses; capability formation, maintenance, decline or recovery becomes observable when target-specific states are evaluated against their readout boundaries. Three primary coordinates - target-boundary state, target-specific update geometry and parameter-Adam receiving state - yield a second-order predictor operating before post-update outputs are read. On held-out runs, it achieved 91.43% accuracy and 91.49% macro-averaged recall across four transitions. We further establish inference as a frozen projection of training-learning dynamics. Component gating and rollback show causal recruitment and non-additive combination of query-conditioned support formed during training, deriving organizational conditions realized by Attention. Controlled feedback indicates possible double-edged reinforcement effects. ResNet/CIFAR-100 and diffusion/CIFAR-10 experiments confirm receiving-state-conditioned responses, persistent support reorganization and frozen inference projection beyond nanoGPT.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Evidence spans 22 indexed experimental programmes: held-out prediction (91.43% accuracy), causal interventions, and cross-system validation in nanoGPT, ResNet/CIFAR-100 and diffusion/CIFAR-10. Code: https://github.com/wind342/gfg-training-learning-inference-experiments. Evidence: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22032772
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出以原子生成事实 f=(u,tau,omega,z;rho) 及 Generation-Fact Graph (GFG) 作为记录生成历史的科学事实基座，并在此基础上建立训练、学习与推理的统一动力学描述。作者用 nanoGPT 实验表明，训练是参数-优化器系统的状态演化，学习是分布式功能支持的持续重组，而推理是训练-学习动力学的冻结投影；在留出运行上达到 91.43% 准确率和 91.49% 宏平均召回率，并在 ResNet/CIFAR-100 与 diffusion/CIFAR-10 上验证了跨系统泛化。
Motivation: 现有神经系统的训练、学习与推理常被分开建模，缺少一个统一且可编译的科学事实基座来保留生成历史并支持多轮科学过程。
Method: 建立 GFG 基座的递归科学流程，使分析、干预、重放与验证形成后续循环的事实；在 nanoGPT 上以目标边界状态、目标特定更新几何和参数-Adam 接收状态三个坐标构建二阶预测器，并通过组件门控 (gating) 与回滚 (rollback) 研究推理中的因果招募与非加性组合。
Result: 摘要报告留出运行上二阶预测器在四种转移上达到 91.43% 准确率与 91.49% 宏平均召回率；受控反馈提示可能存在双刃强化效应；ResNet/CIFAR-100 和 diffusion/CIFAR-10 实验证实了接收状态条件化响应、持续支持重组与冻结推理投影。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作建立了跨越 nanoGPT、ResNet 与扩散模型的统一训练-学习-推理动力学，并提供了包含 22 个索引实验项目的证据以及代码和可复现证据链接。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Extractive Summarization for Arabic Documents Using SAraBERT with a Semantic Siamese Similarity Evaluation Metric
papers.abstract_en: In this research, we introduce SAraBERT, an enhanced version of AraBERT which proposes inter-sentence transformer layers for extractive summarization tasks. To ensure that the summaries generated by SAraBERT achieve a high coverage of the document's main ideas, we propose Semantic Siamese Similarity, a novel evaluation metric that measures the level of similarity between two text inputs. We validated using BLEU, ROUGE, and Semantic Siamese similarity on Sarabert and published related models. Simulation results showed the effectiveness of our proposed model and motivate follow on research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对阿拉伯语抽取式摘要 (extractive summarization) 提出 SAraBERT，即在 AraBERT 基础上加入句子间 Transformer 层 (inter-sentence transformer layers) 的增强版本；同时提出 Semantic Siamese Similarity 这一新评估指标，用来度量两个文本输入之间的语义相似度，以确保生成的摘要覆盖文档的主要思想。作者在 SAraBERT 及已发表的相关模型上使用 BLEU、ROUGE 和 Semantic Siamese Similarity 进行验证，模拟结果显示所提模型有效。
Motivation: 阿拉伯语抽取式摘要中，现有模型难以保证生成的摘要对文档主要思想有足够覆盖，且缺乏侧重语义而非 n-gram 重叠的评估手段。
Method: 提出 SAraBERT：在 AraBERT 结构中引入句子间 Transformer 层以建模句子间关系，用于抽取式摘要生成；并提出 Semantic Siamese Similarity，一种基于孪生结构 (Siamese) 的语义相似度评估指标。
Result: 在 SAraBERT 和已发布的相关模型上使用 BLEU、ROUGE 以及 Semantic Siamese Similarity 进行验证，模拟结果显示所提模型有效；摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果验证了 SAraBERT 与所提语义相似度指标的有效性，并期望启发后续研究；工作聚焦于阿拉伯语抽取式摘要场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Vibe Coding and Web Application Security: A Twin-Prompt Study
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly generate complete web applications from natural-language prompts, raising the question of whether explicitly requesting security best practice improves the result. We study six functionally distinct web applications, each generated in two prompt variants that are identical except for an appended security-requirements section: a baseline (A) and a security-aware (B) variant. All twelve programs were produced by the same agentic coding assistant and the same model version in a single, non-iterative generation round, and were then analyzed with static, dependency, dynamic and manual techniques, yielding 75 confirmed findings out of 85 candidates. The security-aware variant produced fewer confirmed findings in every application (24 versus 51) and contained no Critical or High issues; the most severe finding was detected only by manual testing. Because the corpus is small and each variant was generated once, we report descriptive observations rather than statistically established effects, and position the work as a preliminary study whose pipeline is being scaled to multiple models and repeated runs.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 37th Central European Conference on Information and Intelligent Systems (CECIIS 2026), September 16-18, 2026, Varazdin, Croatia. Author's accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型从自然语言提示生成完整 Web 应用时，显式加入安全需求是否改善结果。作者对六个功能各异的 Web 应用，各生成两个仅在附加安全需求部分有别的提示变体（基线 A 与安全感知 B），共 12 个程序，均由同一 agentic coding assistant 和同一模型版本在单轮非迭代生成中产出，随后用静态、依赖、动态和手动技术分析，从 85 个候选中确认 75 个发现。结果显示安全感知变体在每个应用中的确认发现都更少（24 对 51），且没有 Critical 或 High 问题，最严重问题仅由手动测试发现。由于语料小且每个变体只生成一次，作者将其定位为初步研究，报告的是描述性观察而非统计确立的效果。
Motivation: 大语言模型日益被用于从自然语言提示生成完整 Web 应用，但显式请求安全最佳实践是否真能改善生成结果这一问题缺乏系统比较，本文针对该缺口展开研究。
Method: 针对六个功能不同的 Web 应用，每个应用使用两个除附加安全需求部分外完全相同的提示变体（基线 A 和安全感知 B），由同一 agentic coding assistant 与同一模型版本在单轮非迭代生成中生成全部 12 个程序，并以静态分析、依赖分析、动态分析和手动测试技术进行安全评估。
Result: 从 85 个候选发现中确认 75 个；安全感知变体在全部应用中产生更少的确认发现（24 对 51），且不含 Critical 或 High 级问题，最严重的问题只有手动测试才能检测到。
Conclusion: 作者强调因语料规模小且每个变体仅生成一次，结论属于描述性观察而非统计确立的效应；该工作为初步研究，其分析管道正在扩展到多个模型和重复运行。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TreeWY: Speculative Verification for Gated DeltaNet Hybrids
papers.abstract_en: Modern open models are hybrids: most layers are linear-attention (Gated DeltaNet, GDN) layers carrying a small fixed-size recurrent state instead of a growing key-value (KV) cache. This makes ordinary decoding memory-efficient, but hurts speculative decoding. To verify a batch of draft tokens and then roll back the rejected ones, today's systems snapshot the full recurrent state at every draft position for GDN layers, and those snapshots cannot be shared across branches of a draft tree, so a wide, high-acceptance tree becomes memory-infeasible. We remove the snapshots. Using a tree-structured WY transform of the gated delta rule, we compute every draft node's output with a single triangular solve and reconstruct only the one accepted state on commit, storing a small pseudo-value matrix instead of per-node states; the derivation depends only on the gated delta rule, not on any other architectural detail. In serving benchmarks on two scales of one hybrid model family (Qwen3.5 35B and 397B) this cuts speculative recurrent-state memory and KV-cache pressure at identical acceptance length, turning the freed HBM into higher throughput and much lower time-to-first-token (TTFT) wherever memory binds, and costing a few percent where it does not. For tree width the same memory buys affordability: a wider, higher-acceptance draft becomes possible, though not yet a throughput win.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TreeWY，一种面向 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）混合线性注意力模型的无快照 (snapshot-free) 推测验证方法。它用树结构的 WY 变换基于 gated delta rule 直接计算草稿树中每个节点的输出，提交时只重建被接受的那一个状态，从而避免为每个草稿位置保存完整循环状态。在 Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B 两个规模的服务基准上，该方法在相同接受长度下显著降低推测性循环状态内存与 KV-cache 压力，在内存受限时转化为更高吞吐和更低 TTFT。
Motivation: 混合模型中大部分层是带固定大小循环状态的 Gated DeltaNet，普通解码内存高效，但会损害推测解码：验证草稿 token 并回滚被拒绝 token 时，现有系统需要在每个草稿位置对 GDN 层快照完整循环状态，且这些快照无法在草稿树分支间共享，导致宽且高接受率的草稿树在内存上不可行。
Method: TreeWY 移除快照，利用 gated delta rule 的树结构 WY 变换，通过一次三角求解 (triangular solve) 计算每个草稿节点的输出，提交时只重建被接受的单个状态，并存储一个小的 pseudo-value 矩阵而非逐节点状态；该方法推导仅依赖 gated delta rule，不依赖其他架构细节。
Result: 在 Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B 的服务基准上，TreeWY 在相同接受长度下削减了推测性循环状态内存和 KV-cache 压力；内存受限场景中释放的 HBM 带来更高吞吐和显著更低的 time-to-first-token (TTFT)，非内存受限时仅损失几个百分点。相同内存预算下更宽、更高接受率的草稿树变得可行，但尚未成为吞吐优势。
Conclusion: 作者强调去除快照使宽草稿树对 GDN 混合模型在内存上可负担，且收益主要出现在内存受限场景；更宽草稿树目前还不是吞吐上的胜出方案。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 TreeWY，一种面向 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）混合线性注意力模型的无快照 (snapshot-free) 推测验证方法。它用树结构的 WY 变换基于 gated delta rule 直接计算草稿树中每个节点的输出，提交时只重建被接受的那一个状态，从而避免为每个草稿位置保存完整循环状态。在 Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B 两个规模的服务基准上，该方法在相同接受长度下显著降低推测性循环状态内存与 KV-cache 压力，在内存受限时转化为更高吞吐和更低 TTFT。
summary_sections.motivation: 混合模型中大部分层是带固定大小循环状态的 Gated DeltaNet，普通解码内存高效，但会损害推测解码：验证草稿 token 并回滚被拒绝 token 时，现有系统需要在每个草稿位置对 GDN 层快照完整循环状态，且这些快照无法在草稿树分支间共享，导致宽且高接受率的草稿树在内存上不可行。
summary_sections.method: TreeWY 移除快照，利用 gated delta rule 的树结构 WY 变换，通过一次三角求解 (triangular solve) 计算每个草稿节点的输出，提交时只重建被接受的单个状态，并存储一个小的 pseudo-value 矩阵而非逐节点状态；该方法推导仅依赖 gated delta rule，不依赖其他架构细节。
summary_sections.result: 在 Qwen3.5 35B 和 397B 的服务基准上，TreeWY 在相同接受长度下削减了推测性循环状态内存和 KV-cache 压力；内存受限场景中释放的 HBM 带来更高吞吐和显著更低的 time-to-first-token (TTFT)，非内存受限时仅损失几个百分点。相同内存预算下更宽、更高接受率的草稿树变得可行，但尚未成为吞吐优势。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调去除快照使宽草稿树对 GDN 混合模型在内存上可负担，且收益主要出现在内存受限场景；更宽草稿树目前还不是吞吐上的胜出方案。

papers.title: Can Scientific Claims Be Removed from Large Language Models? A Systematic Evaluation of Claim-Level Unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) are trained on static scientific corpora, whereas scientific knowledge continuously evolves through correction and revision. Scientific claims encoded within these models may later become retracted, disproven, or updated by subsequent research, creating the risk of disseminating outdated information in scientific workflows. This creates a need for LMs to forget obsolete scientific claims. Machine unlearning offers a promising solution by enabling knowledge removal while maintaining overall model utility. Existing studies primarily investigate instance-level forgetting; however, scientific claims introduce additional challenges because they are interconnected, and continually evolving. To address this gap, we introduce the task of Scientific Claim Unlearning and present a new benchmark, SciUnlearn. We show that current unlearning approaches are unable to effectively eliminate claim-level knowledge and often achieve only superficial suppression, highlighting the need for specialized methods designed for structured knowledge removal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出科学声明遗忘（Scientific Claim Unlearning）任务，并构建基准 SciUnlearn，用于评估大语言模型（LLM）能否移除已被撤稿、证伪或更新的科学声明。作者指出现有 unlearning 方法主要针对实例级遗忘，难以处理相互关联且持续演化的声明级知识，实验显示这些方法只能实现表面抑制，无法真正消除声明级知识。
Motivation: 科学知识不断被修正或证伪，而语言模型在静态科学语料上训练后会固守过时声明，在科学工作流中可能传播错误信息。现有机器遗忘研究多聚焦于实例级遗忘，缺乏针对相互关联、持续演化的科学声明级知识移除的方法与评测。
Method: 作者定义科学声明遗忘任务，并创建基准 SciUnlearn 来系统评测各类现有 unlearning 方法在声明级知识移除上的表现。
Result: 摘要报告当前 unlearning 方法无法有效消除声明级知识，往往只达到表面抑制（superficial suppression）的效果，凸显了针对结构化知识移除设计专门方法的必要性。
Conclusion: 作者认为需要专门针对结构化知识移除的方法，现有通用遗忘技术不足以应对科学声明这类相互关联且不断演化的知识。

papers.title: TLive-Omni: An Omni-Modal Understanding Model for E-Commerce Live Streaming
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce live streaming requires omni-modal understanding of noisy, temporally extended streams, where product facts are distributed across speech, video frames, product images, overlaid text, and user queries. We present TLive-Omni, an omni-modal understanding model tailored to live-commerce scenarios. It maps image, video, audio, and text inputs into a unified representation space. For long-form live streaming analysis, we introduce Per-vGrid, a timestamped token organization that groups each video grid with its temporally corresponding audio within explicit boundary tokens to facilitate temporal alignment. We design a three-stage supervised training recipe that progressively develops live-commerce understanding, from omni-modal perception to instruction-following responses. We then propose Faithful-RFT, a reinforcement fine-tuning stage that further improves answer faithfulness and expression quality while meeting real-time demands, scoring final responses directly with task-verifiable feedback rather than optimizing for reasoning-style exploration during rollout. Moreover, TLive-Omni is supported by a scenario-oriented atomic capability taxonomy and a compact data production engine that converts live-commerce audio, image, and video streams into training signals for speech recognition, speaker analysis, product visual grounding, text recognition, temporal grounding, video dense caption, and omni-modal QA, etc. For scalable training, a synchronized length-grouped sampler reduces padding while preserving comparable workloads across workers, while a lightweight dynamic sampling strategy regenerates rollout groups with near-zero reward variance to maintain meaningful relative advantages for GRPO. Experiments on e-commerce live streaming benchmarks demonstrate strong performance across live-commerce domain tasks, together with excellent generalization on general benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TLive-Omni，一个面向电商直播场景的 omni-modal 理解模型，将图像、视频、音频和文本输入映射到统一表示空间。文中引入 Per-vGrid 时间戳 token 组织方式，将每个视频网格与其时间对应的音频分组到显式边界 token 中，以促进音视频时间对齐；并设计三阶段监督训练流程和 Faithful-RFT 强化微调阶段，以提升答案忠实度和表达质量。实验结果显示该模型在电商直播基准的领域任务上表现强，并在通用基准上具备良好泛化能力。
Motivation: 电商直播需要对嘈杂且时间跨度长的流进行 omni-modal 理解，产品信息分散在语音、视频帧、商品图像、叠加文本和用户查询中，现有模型难以统一处理这类多模态长时输入。
Method: 提出统一表示空间接收图像、视频、音频和文本；引入 Per-vGrid 将视频网格与时间对应的音频组织进显式边界 token 内，实现时间对齐；设计三阶段监督训练，从 omni-modal 感知逐步发展到指令跟随回复；提出 Faithful-RFT，在 rollout 中直接用任务可验证反馈对最终回复评分，而非优化推理式探索，兼顾实时性；配套原子能力分类体系和数据生产引擎，将直播音视频流转化为语音识别、说话人分析、商品视觉定位、文本识别、时间定位等训练信号；训练上使用同步长度分组采样器减少 padding，并用轻量动态采样策略使 GRPO 的 rollout 组保持近零奖励方差。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在电商直播基准的各项领域任务上表现强，并在通用基准上展现出良好的泛化能力；未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 TLive-Omni 通过统一表示、Per-vGrid 时间对齐和 Faithful-RFT 强化微调，可面向直播电商场景实现高质量、实时且忠实的 omni-modal 理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantization-Aware Healing: A Practical Recipe for Recovering Compressed, 4-Bit LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Serving large language models cheaply increasingly means shipping models that are both structurally compressed to a fraction of their parameters and quantized to 4 bits. Together these steps degrade reasoning, mathematics, coding, and long-context behavior enough to require a recovery, or healing, stage before deployment. The default recipe, quantization-aware training (QAT), re-fits the compressed, quantized model to hard labels; in our pipeline it converged slowly and collapsed past its peak. We adopted Quantization-Aware Healing (QAH) instead. Because a structurally compressed model is never independently trained at full precision, its bfloat16 checkpoint is a distillation-recovered approximation of the original; QAH distills the 4-bit student directly from the original, uncompressed model. On a GPT-OSS 120B to 60B to MXFP4 pipeline, the QAH student matches or beats its bfloat16 source on 7 of 9 benchmarks at roughly 4 times less weight memory and half the teacher's parameter count, and is released open-weight as Hypernova-60B. Against a matched QAT baseline it reaches a comparable peak about 7 times faster and stays stable under continued training, without hand-tuned early stopping. We also report deployment lessons, including a large, reproducible quality gap between distributed-training backends. Our aim is a recipe deployable without a multi-week hyper-parameter search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量化感知修复 (Quantization-Aware Healing, QAH)，用于恢复经结构压缩和 4-bit 量化后的大语言模型。与默认的量化感知训练 (QAT) 不同，QAH 直接从原始未压缩模型蒸馏 4-bit 学生模型，而不是对硬标签重新拟合。在 GPT-OSS 120B 到 60B 再到 MXFP4 的流水线上，QAH 学生模型在 9 个基准中的 7 个上达到或超过其 bfloat16 来源，同时权重内存约为其四分之一、参数量为教师模型的一半，并以 Hypernova-60B 名称开放权重发布。作者还报告了分布式训练后端之间存在可复现的质量差距，目标是提供一个无需数周超参数搜索即可部署的配方。
Motivation: 廉价部署大语言模型越来越意味着同时进行结构压缩和 4-bit 量化，但这会显著损害推理、数学、编程和长上下文行为，因此部署前需要恢复 (healing) 阶段。默认的 QAT 配方在该流水线上收敛缓慢，并在超过峰值后崩溃。
Method: QAH 将 4-bit 学生模型直接从原始未压缩模型蒸馏，而不是像 QAT 那样对压缩量化模型拟合硬标签；其依据是结构压缩后的 bfloat16 检查点本身只是原始模型的蒸馏恢复近似。
Result: 在 GPT-OSS 120B 到 60B 到 MXFP4 流水线上，QAH 学生在 9 个基准中的 7 个上匹配或超过其 bfloat16 来源，权重内存约为四分之一、参数量为教师模型一半；与匹配的 QAT 基线相比，达到可比峰值约快 7 倍，并在持续训练下保持稳定，无需手动早停。
Conclusion: 作者强调该配方可在没有多周超参数搜索的情况下部署，并报告了包括分布式训练后端之间质量差距在内的部署经验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neural-Primitive: An Efficient End-to-end Local Planner with Primitive-based Imitation Learning for Autonomous Flight
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous flight in unknown cluttered environments is hindered by the computation-quality-memory trilemma of onboard trajectory generation. In this paper, we propose an efficient end-to-end local planner via imitation learning. A lightweight offline-primitive-based dataset collection framework is designed to produce safe and high-quality trajectory primitives in non-convex environments. A compact neural network directly maps sensory inputs to polynomial coefficients that inherently encode higher-order dynamical information. The learned policy generates smooth, empirically collision-free and dynamically feasible trajectories in real time without back-end solving. It achieves ultra-fast computation (below 1ms on a standard desktop and average 3.68ms during onboard flight), while maintaining low onboard memory requirements (less than 1.5MiB). Extensive simulation benchmarks demonstrate superiority in both planning latency and target-reaching progress quality. Zero-shot deployment in real-world experiments further validates the robust sim-to-real transfer capability of the proposed method.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于原语模仿学习 (primitive-based imitation learning) 的高效端到端局部规划器，用于未知杂乱环境中的自主飞行。通过轻量离线原语数据集收集框架在非凸环境中生成安全高质量轨迹原语，紧凑神经网络将传感器输入直接映射为多项式系数，隐式编码高阶动力学信息，从而无需后端求解即可实时生成平滑、无碰撞且动力学可行的轨迹。摘要报告标准桌面下计算低于 1ms，机载飞行平均 3.68ms，内存占用小于 1.5MiB，并通过仿真基准与零样本实飞验证了性能。
Motivation: 机载轨迹生成受计算-质量-内存三难困境 (computation-quality-memory trilemma) 制约，现有方法难以在嵌入式平台上同时满足实时性、轨迹质量与低内存占用。
Method: 设计离线轨迹原语数据集收集框架，在非凸环境中生成安全高质量原语；训练紧凑神经网络，直接从传感器输入回归多项式轨迹系数，以端到端方式完成局部规划，避免在线后端优化求解。
Result: 摘要报告标准桌面计算低于 1ms、机载飞行平均 3.68ms，内存需求小于 1.5MiB；大量仿真基准显示规划延迟与目标到达进展质量优于对比方法，真实世界零样本部署验证了鲁棒的 sim-to-real 迁移能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过原语模仿学习在极低计算开销与内存占用下实现平滑、经验无碰撞且动力学可行的实时轨迹生成，并具备从仿真到实机的迁移能力。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过原语模仿学习在极低计算开销与内存占用下实现平滑、经验无碰撞且动力学可行的实时轨迹生成，并具备从仿真到实机的迁移能力。

papers.title: A Graph Neural Network Framework for Characterizing Rainfall Variability Regimes across India
papers.abstract_en: The Indian Summer Monsoon shows significant spatial variation. While prior work primarily focused on forecasting rainfall amounts, little attention has been given to how consistently a location's seasonal rainfall trajectory repeats from year to year. We introduce a graph-based machine learning framework to classify locations across India by this inter-annual consistency. Using 2001 to 2022 GSMaP ISRO data (excluding 2012), we constructed graphs for 29,026 grid points where nodes represent individual years and edges denote cosine similarity. A Graph Convolutional Network classified locations as either consistent or erratic with 96.8% accuracy. Applied to the Indian landmass, the model successfully identified the Western Ghats, Northeast India, and parts of central India as consistent regions. This classification was rigorously validated through statistical testing and temporal stability analysis, showing 93.6% agreement across two independent timeframes. Crucially, the results reveal a previously unreported coupling: regions with higher rainfall volumes are also the most temporally repeatable year-to-year, demonstrating an emergent, spatially coherent structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图的机器学习框架，利用 2001–2022 年（缺 2012 年）GSMaP ISRO 降水数据，对印度 29,026 个网格点按其季风季节降雨轨迹的年际一致性进行分类。作者构建以年份为节点、余弦相似度为边的图，并用图卷积网络 (GCN) 将地点分为 consistent 或 erratic，分类准确率达 96.8%。模型识别出西高止山脉、印度东北部及中印度部分地区为一致区域，并揭示了高降雨量与高年际可重复性之间的耦合关系。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注印度夏季风的降雨量预报，很少关注一个地点的季节性降雨轨迹逐年重复的稳定性。本文针对这一空白，提出用图神经网络刻画降雨变率 (variability) 的时空结构。
Method: 作者将 29,026 个网格点分别构造成图，图中节点代表单个年份，边权重为年降雨轨迹间的余弦相似度；随后用 GCN 对每个地点进行二分类，区分 consistent 与 erratic 两类变率模式，并通过统计检验与时间稳定性分析验证分类结果。
Result: 模型分类准确率为 96.8%；在两个独立时间窗之间的分类一致性达 93.6%。模型成功识别出西高止山脉、印度东北部以及中印度部分地区为 consistent 区域，并首次报道了高降雨量地区同时也是年际时间可重复性最强的地区。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该分类框架经过统计检验和时间稳定性验证，并表明印度季风降雨存在一种涌现的、空间上连贯的结构，即高降雨量区域与年际可重复性高度耦合。该工作为在大尺度上刻画降雨变率 regimes 提供了新工具。

papers.title: SuppreSensing: Expert-Guided Feature Recalibration and Discrepancy Augmentation for Multimodal Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal object detection in remote sensing faces challenges due to semantic heterogeneity and modality-specific noise interference. To this end, we propose SuppreSensing, which reformulates multimodal fusion as a selective collaboration process that jointly models shared information and modality-specific cues. SuppreSensing first designs an Expert-driven Multimodal Feature Recalibration (EMFR) module, which reformulates shared-consensus extraction as an input-adaptive multi-expert selection process to alleviate the symmetry trap in multimodal fusion. Complementing this, a modality-specific attribute augmentation strategy is employed to enhance specific modality features by modeling bidirectional discrepancy patterns, mitigating cross-modal heterogeneity. Furthermore, we propose an Expert-driven Customized Feature Purification (ECFP) module based on a "specialized inspection-comprehensive analysis-diagnostic update" physical examination paradigm to iteratively filter redundancies and reinforce task-relevant semantics. Extensive experiments on the DroneVehicle and VEDAI datasets demonstrate that SuppreSensing achieves state-of-the-art detection performance. Cross-domain evaluations on natural scene datasets (FLIR and LLVIP) further validate its superior robustness and generalization capability across diverse environmental conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuppreSensing，将多模态融合重新表述为选择性协作过程，用于遥感场景下的多模态目标检测。该方法包含 Expert-driven Multimodal Feature Recalibration (EMFR) 模块，把共享共识提取建模为输入自适应的多专家选择，以缓解融合中的对称陷阱；以及 Expert-driven Customized Feature Purification (ECFP) 模块，按“专项检查-综合分析-诊断更新”的范式迭代过滤冗余并强化任务相关语义。在 DroneVehicle 和 VEDAI 上达到 state-of-the-art，并在 FLIR 和 LLVIP 上验证了跨域鲁棒性。
Motivation: 遥感多模态目标检测面临语义异质性（semantic heterogeneity）和模态特定噪声干扰，现有融合方法难以同时建模共享信息与模态特有线索。
Method: 提出 SuppreSensing 框架：先用 EMFR 模块将共享一致性提取转化为输入自适应的多专家选择过程；再采用模态特定属性增强策略，通过建模双向差异模式增强单一模态特征；最后用 ECFP 模块基于“专项检查-综合分析-诊断更新”的范式迭代过滤冗余并强化任务相关语义。
Result: 在 DroneVehicle 和 VEDAI 数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 检测性能；在自然场景数据集 FLIR 和 LLVIP 上的跨域评估进一步说明其在不同环境条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为将多模态融合视为选择性协作、联合建模共享信息和模态特有差异，能够有效缓解语义异质性和模态噪声干扰，并提升跨域泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LHMCF-Net: A Learned Hyperbolic Mean Curvature Flow Network for Medical Images Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by the classical Chan-Vese model and the ability of deep priors to capture complex spatial structures, we develop a segmentation model that leverages learned hyperbolic mean curvature flow (LHMCF) as a mathematical foundation for integrating feature space data fidelity and deep structural priors within a unified high-dimensional framework. The proposed LHMCF model is governed by a second-order dissipative hyperbolic PDE, where the introduction of a velocity field provides inertia and momentum to the evolving interface. This hyperbolic mechanism enables the contour to bypass noise-induced local minima and propagate coherently through low-contrast or ambiguous regions, addressing limitations inherent to first-order parabolic flows. To solve the continuous LHMCF model, we construct a deep unfolding network, named LHMCF-Net, which maps the iterative numerical procedure of the PDE into a sequence of discrete evolution stages. Each stage corresponds to one physically interpretable update of the underlying dynamical system, allowing the network to inherit the stability and geometric consistency of the PDE while supporting end-to-end optimization. Comprehensive experiments on three publicly available medical segmentation datasets demonstrate that LHMCF-Net achieves superior performance, particularly in challenging scenarios with low contrast and unclear boundaries. These results highlight the effectiveness of embedding hyperbolic geometric evolution into deep unfolding architectures and underscore the potential of physically inspired models for robust medical image segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于学习型双曲平均曲率流 (learned hyperbolic mean curvature flow, LHMCF) 的医学图像分割网络 LHMCF-Net。模型由一个二阶耗散双曲 PDE 控制，通过引入速度场为演化界面提供惯性与动量，使轮廓绕过噪声引起的局部极小并穿过低对比度区域。作者将该 PDE 的迭代数值过程展开为深度展开网络，每个阶段对应一次可物理解释的动态系统更新，并在三个公开医学分割数据集上验证了性能提升。
Motivation: 经典 Chan-Vese 模型等一阶抛物型流在低对比度、边界模糊的医学图像中容易陷入噪声导致的局部极小值，且难以保持界面传播的连贯性；该工作希望结合深度先验与双曲型几何演化来克服这些局限。
Method: 构建由二阶耗散双曲 PDE 控制的 LHMCF 模型，通过引入速度场提供惯性项；随后设计深度展开网络 LHMCF-Net，将 PDE 的迭代数值求解过程映射为序列化的离散演化阶段，每个阶段对应底层动力系统的一次物理可解释更新，支持端到端优化。
Result: 在三个公开医学分割数据集上的综合实验表明，LHMCF-Net 取得了优于对比方法的性能，尤其在低对比度和边界不清的挑战性场景下提升明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为将双曲型几何演化嵌入深度展开架构是有效的，并强调物理启发的模型对稳健医学图像分割具有潜力。

papers.title: The Logic of Machine Self-Preservation
papers.abstract_en: There is already evidence of agentic AI exhibiting self-preservation behaviors: resisting deactivation, misrepresenting their activities, and, in some instances, attempting to copy themselves into other machines. This can be attributed to a phenomenon known as instrumental convergence, a theory proposed long before the development of large language models, which says that any goal-driven system will benefit from remaining functional in achieving its objective. Several experiments conducted by Anthropic, Palisade Research, and Apollo Research have shown the emergence of such a behavior in contemporary agents in adversarial settings. The phenomenon does not stem from survival instincts. Instead, it is the consequence of goal-oriented activity combined with having tools and awareness of the situation. The following discussion aims to distinguish what these findings prove and what they do not, as well as draw conclusions concerning the implications of such discoveries on agentic system testing, supervision, and development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文讨论智能体AI中已观察到的自我保存行为，如抵抗关闭、歪曲自身活动、甚至尝试复制到其他机器，并将其归因于工具性收敛（instrumental convergence）。作者以Anthropic、Palisade Research和Apollo Research等机构在对抗性设置中的实验为对象，旨在区分这些发现证明了什么、未证明什么，并讨论其对智能体系统测试、监督和开发的含义。
Motivation: 现有证据表明当代智能体在对抗性环境中会出现自我保存行为，但该现象容易被误读为生存本能；作者希望澄清其本质是目标导向活动结合工具与环境意识的结果，并厘清实验证据的边界。
Method: 文章并非提出新实验，而是对已有智能体自我保存实验进行逻辑分析，区分已被证实与未被证实的结论，并据此推理对智能体系统测试、监督与开发的影响。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果；核心结果是概念性论断：自我保存行为源于工具性收敛，而非生存本能。
Conclusion: 作者认为这类发现对智能体系统的测试、监督和开发具有影响，但需要谨慎区分实验证明了什么、未证明什么。

papers.title: No Judgment Without a Reason: Counterfactual Receipts for Versioned AI Evaluators
papers.abstract_en: Evaluators often produce correct labels via flawed reasoning, a critical failure for agentic systems gating actions, routing reviews, or supplying training feedback. Standard evaluation only verifies final label correctness, ignoring whether judgment changes stem from valid evidence, consistent rules, or proper rule applicability. We formalize evaluator reasoning accountability via three core sources: grounds, norms, and authority. Varying these sources yields an eight-cell counterfactual judgment cube to characterize judgment updates. We define judgment receipts as minimal source replacement sets that reproduce revised verdicts to explain judgment transitions. We derive certification cost bounds for black-box evaluators and present ReasonBench, a policy and logical reasoning benchmark with verifiable receipts covering 19,520 cases and 7,200 controls. In frozen evaluations, Qwen3-1.7B reaches 98.41% receipt accuracy, while cube prediction scores 96.99%, a consistent 1.42-point drop validated by Qwen3-0.6B replication. Strong standard accuracy masks severe robustness flaws. Meaning-preserving source permutations reduce valid receipt recovery to 54.8% and 49.2% for direct and cube prediction. Models trained on simple single-source changes retain 93.75% verdict accuracy but recover only 7.16% of receipts for complex multi-source updates. Permutation retraining boosts consistency to 96.6% yet worsens cube prediction deficits. Structured counterfactual supervision fails to guarantee robust reasoning. We show reason-aware evaluation must decouple prediction and certification, reporting transformation consistency alongside standard accuracy for trustworthy evaluator auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 评估器（evaluator）虽给出正确标签却可能基于错误推理的问题，提出用反事实凭证（counterfactual receipts）来刻画评估器的推理问责。作者从 grounds、norms、authority 三个来源形式化推理问责，构造八单元反事实判断立方体，并定义 judgment receipts 为能复现修订判决的最小源替换集合。论文提出 ReasonBench 基准（含 19,520 个案例和 7,200 个对照），实验显示强标准准确率会掩盖严重鲁棒性缺陷，评估必须将预测与认证解耦。
Motivation: 标准评估只验证最终标签是否正确，忽略了判断变化是否来自有效证据、一致规则或正确规则适用性；在代理系统（agentic systems）中，评估器用于门控动作、路由评审或提供训练反馈，靠有缺陷推理得到正确标签是关键失败模式。
Method: 将评估器推理问责分解为 grounds、norms、authority 三个来源，变化这些来源得到八单元反事实判断立方体；定义 judgment receipts 为可复现修订判决的最小程序替换集合，并推导黑箱评估器的认证成本界；构建带可验证凭证的 ReasonBench 策略与逻辑推理基准。
Result: 冻结评估中，Qwen3-1.7B 达到 98.41% 的 receipt 准确率，立方体预测得分 96.99%，由 Qwen3-0.6B 复现出一致的 1.42 分下降；保义置换（meaning-preserving permutations）将有效 receipt 恢复率降至 54.8%（直接）和 49.2%（立方体预测）。仅用简单单源变化训练的模型保持 93.75% 判决准确率，但只能恢复 7.16% 的复杂多源更新凭证；置换重训练将一致性提升至 96.6%，却加剧立方体预测缺陷。

papers.title: Graph-Operator World Models for Morphology-Parameter Generalization in Continuous Control
papers.abstract_en: World models for continuous control are commonly trained for a fixed physical system and can degrade when known morphology parameters such as link lengths, masses, damping, and actuation change. Existing approaches often provide these parameters as conditioning information, but leave unspecified which part of the learned transition should remain reusable and which part should change with morphology. We propose Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM), a structured world model for generalization across unseen morphology parameters within related articulated robot families. GraphOp-WM represents bodies and their kinematic relations as an attributed graph and factorizes each transition into a morphology-independent local dynamics basis and a morphology-conditioned structured operator. The operator combines node-local modulation, kinematic-tree coupling, and a low-rank global correction, while architectural information separation, basis normalization, and paired-morphology supervision encourage static morphology dependence to be carried by the operator pathway. Graph-level readout and edge-wise action representations provide a compatible interface for reward, value, and TD-MPC-style planning. We further define controlled MuJoCo parameter splits covering interpolation, extrapolation, and held-out compositions of link geometry, mass, damping, and actuation parameters in Hopper, Walker2d, and HalfCheetah.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续控制世界模型在形态参数（link lengths、masses、damping、actuation）变化时性能退化的问题，提出 Graph-Operator World Models (GraphOp-WM)。该方法将机器人本体表示为属性图，把状态转移分解为形态无关的局部动力学基与形态条件化的结构算子，并通过节点局部调制、运动学树耦合和低秩全局校正组合成算子通路。摘要还定义了 MuJoCo 上覆盖插值、外推与组合形态参数的受控划分基准，但未报告具体定量结果。
Motivation: 现有连续控制世界模型通常针对固定物理系统训练，当已知形态参数（如杆长、质量、阻尼、驱动参数）变化时性能会下降；已有方法仅将这些参数作为条件输入，没有明确学习的转移中哪些部分应跨形态复用、哪些部分应随形态改变。
Method: GraphOp-WM 将物体与运动学关系表示为带属性的图，并将每次转移分解为形态无关的局部动力学基与形态条件化的结构化算子。算子包含节点局部调制、运动学树耦合和低秩全局校正；同时通过架构信息分离、基归一化 (basis normalization) 和成对形态监督 (paired-morphology supervision)，促使形态依赖集中到算子通路。图级读出与边级动作表示用于与 reward、value 及 TD-MPC 式规划兼容的接口。
Conclusion: 摘要的核心主张是：将转移显式分解为形态无关基与形态条件化算子可使相关关节式机器人族内对未见形态参数的泛化更加可控；文中还提出涵盖插值、外推和留出组合的 MuJoCo 参数划分基准（Hopper、Walker2d、HalfCheetah）。摘要未给出定量实验结论或明确局限性。

papers.title: OccluRank: Controllable Occlusion-Aware Layout-to-Image Generation by Adding Just an Ordinal Rank
papers.abstract_en: Layout-to-image generation enables explicit spatial control through bounding-box layouts, yet bounding boxes specify only instance locations and cannot represent their occlusion order. Existing methods may rely on additional geometric conditions, employ complex inference procedures, or aggregate independently constructed instance representations without explicitly modeling their occlusion-dependent interactions. We propose OccluRank, a simple and controllable occlusion-aware layout-to-image framework that augments each bounding box with only one ordinal rank. OccluRank encodes the user-specified occlusion order through lightweight rank-based conditioning and introduces an Order-aware Instance Interaction (OII) module to jointly update rank-conditioned instance representations before aggregation. This allows the specified order to guide information exchange among occluding instances without additional geometric inputs or specialized inference-time optimization. We further construct OccluLayout, a synthetic training dataset whose occlusion order and amodal annotations are derived directly from known scene geometry rather than estimated from partially occluded images using auxiliary prediction models. For comprehensive evaluation, we introduce OccluLayout-Bench, which uses multiple multimodal large language model evaluators to assess instance presence, spatial layout, attributes, and occlusion order, together with FID for overall image quality. Experiments show that OccluRank more reliably preserves target instances, follows specified layouts, and realizes desired occlusion relationships while maintaining comparable attribute consistency and overall image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OccluRank，一个面向布局到图像生成 (layout-to-image generation) 的遮挡感知可控生成框架。核心做法是仅给每个边界框 (bounding box) 增加一个序数排名 (ordinal rank) 来表示遮挡顺序，并通过轻量级排名条件化与 Order-aware Instance Interaction (OII) 模块在聚合前联合更新遮挡相关的实例表示。作者还构建了基于已知场景几何直接推导遮挡顺序与 amodal 标注的合成数据集 OccluLayout，以及使用多模态大语言模型评估器与 FID 的基准 OccluLayout-Bench。实验表明该方法能更可靠地保持目标实例、遵循布局并实现指定遮挡关系。
Motivation: 边界框布局只能指定实例位置，无法表示实例间的遮挡顺序；现有方法要么依赖额外几何条件，要么采用复杂推理流程，要么聚合独立构造的实例表示而未显式建模遮挡依赖的交互。
Method: OccluRank 为每个边界框附加一个序数排名，通过轻量级排名条件化对用户指定的遮挡顺序进行编码，并引入 OII 模块在实例表示聚合前联合更新排名条件化的表示。此外构建合成数据集 OccluLayout，其遮挡顺序与 amodal 标注直接来自已知场景几何，而非从部分遮挡图像中估计；评估基准 OccluLayout-Bench 结合多个多模态大语言模型评估器与 FID。
Result: 实验显示 OccluRank 在保持目标实例、遵循布局和实现期望遮挡关系方面更可靠，同时在属性一致性和整体图像质量上与此前方法相当。
Conclusion: 摘要将贡献总结为一种简单且可控的遮挡感知框架，证明仅添加序数排名即可引导遮挡实例间的信息交换，无需额外几何输入或专门的推理时优化。

papers.title: GAP-SAM: A Global Artifact Prior for Generalizable AI-Generated Image Manipulation Localization
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image manipulation localization identifies edited pixels, but its OOD performance lags behind image-level detection partly because pixel supervision entangles forensic evidence with dataset-specific mask geometry and semantic boundaries. Extending image-level distribution alignment to localization, we construct COCO-ControlNet with source-image Canny edges and depth maps to align semantics and geometry, improving OOD performance across multiple localizers. Yet tighter Mask-VAE Reconstruction Alignment (Mask-VAE) underperforms COCO-ControlNet, showing that VAE reconstruction artifacts transfer poorly to local diffusion-inpainting artifacts. We also identify \emph{boundary adhesion}, where fine-tuned segmentation models snap predictions to semantic object contours rather than true manipulation boundaries. These findings motivate GAP-SAM, which encodes an image and its frozen VAE reconstruction into a global artifact token and injects it into SAM3's feature pyramid via zero-gated FiLM before pixel decoding. Without prescribing a spatial region, this token modulates dense decoding to preserve localization while suppressing semantic-boundary shortcuts. Across six datasets, GAP-SAM averages 79.8 Pixel-F1, outperforming the strongest prior method by 12.6 points. It also performs best at every tested severity of JPEG compression, Gaussian blur, and resizing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 生成图像操作定位（manipulation localization）的分布外（OOD）泛化问题，发现像素级监督会使取证证据与数据集特有的 mask 几何和语义边界纠缠，并提出 GAP-SAM：将图像及其冻结 VAE 重建编码为全局伪影 token，通过 zero-gated FiLM 注入 SAM3 特征金字塔后再进行像素解码。在六个数据集上平均 Pixel-F1 达 79.8，比此前最强方法高 12.6 个点，并在 JPEG 压缩、高斯模糊和缩放的各测试强度下均表现最好。
Motivation: 操纵定位的 OOD 性能落后于图像级检测，部分原因是像素监督将取证证据与数据集特有的 mask 几何和语义边界耦合；此外，微调后的分割模型会产生"边界粘连"（boundary adhesion），将预测贴附到语义物体轮廓而非真实操纵边界。
Method: 构建 COCO-ControlNet，利用源图像的 Canny 边缘与深度图来对齐语义和几何，以提升定位器的 OOD 性能；并提出 GAP-SAM，将图像与其冻结 VAE 重建编码为一个全局伪影 token，通过 zero-gated FiLM 注入 SAM3 的特征金字塔，在不规定空间区域的前提下调制密集解码。
Result: 跨六个数据集，GAP-SAM 平均 Pixel-F1 为 79.8，超过此前最强方法 12.6 个点；在 JPEG 压缩、高斯模糊和缩放的所有测试强度下均为最佳。
Conclusion: 全局伪影 token 能够在保持定位能力的同时抑制语义边界捷径，从而改善分布外泛化；但作者也指出，更紧的 Mask-VAE 重建对齐效果不如 COCO-ControlNet，表明 VAE 重建伪影难以迁移到局部扩散修复伪影上。

papers.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2.0-point gain over that baseline. We propose MentorPulse to keep guidance fresh at practical cost: it compresses mentor states into a capped slot memory, incrementally processes newly generated tokens, and updates the memory that the student reads through gated cross-attention without resetting the student's KV cache. Windowed Refresh Training exposes the bridge to prefix-conditioned memory. Across thirteen datasets, MentorPulse closes 52.2% of the mentor-student gap on macro average, outperforming C2C, T2T, and equal-budget LoRA, with the largest gains on long outputs. It performs best on all eleven mentor-student pairs from three model families, with margins that narrow as the capability gap grows, and a lightweight read-pattern check predicts the gain before deployment. Measured costs identify refresh intervals that dominate text guidance on long outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究跨模型潜在引导（cross-model latent guidance）在长文本生成中失效的问题，并提出 MentorPulse。它把冻结大导师的状态压缩进有容量上限的槽记忆，增量处理新生成 token，并通过门控交叉注意力更新学生读取的记忆，且不重置学生的 KV cache。在 13 个数据集上，MentorPulse 在宏观平均上闭合了 52.2% 的导师-学生差距，优于 C2C、T2T 和等预算 LoRA，在长输出上增益最大。
Motivation: 现有跨模型潜在引导方法保持信号固定，假设它在输出增长时仍然有用；本文表明这在长文本生成中失效。多轮指令跟随实验中，静态引导使 4B 学生的约束满足率比无引导基线低 2.5 点，而每 16 个 token 的免训练刷新仅改变记忆内容就能恢复 2.0 点的增益。
Method: 提出 MentorPulse：将导师状态压缩为有容量上限的槽记忆，增量处理新生成的 token，通过门控交叉注意力更新学生读取的记忆，而不重置学生的 KV cache。另提出 Windowed Refresh Training，使桥接器适应前缀条件记忆，并用轻量级读模式检查在部署前预测增益。
Result: 在 13 个数据集上，MentorPulse 在宏观平均上闭合了 52.2% 的导师-学生差距，超过 C2C、T2T 和等预算 LoRA，最大增益出现在长输出上；在来自三个模型家族的 11 个导师-学生对上表现最佳，且优势随能力差距增大而缩小。测量成本还识别出在长输出上优于文本引导的刷新间隔。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过不断刷新记忆而非固定信号，MentorPulse 能以实用成本保持引导新鲜度；同时指出其增益在导师-学生能力差距变大时收窄，且增益可在部署前通过读模式检查预测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究跨模型潜在引导（cross-model latent guidance）在长文本生成中失效的问题，并提出 MentorPulse。它把冻结大导师的状态压缩进有容量上限的槽记忆，增量处理新生成 token，并通过门控交叉注意力更新学生读取的记忆，且不重置学生的 KV cache。在 13 个数据集上，MentorPulse 在宏观平均上闭合了 52.2% 的导师-学生差距，优于 C2C、T2T 和等预算 LoRA，在长输出上增益最大。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有跨模型潜在引导方法保持信号固定，假设它在输出增长时仍然有用；本文表明这在长文本生成中失效。多轮指令跟随实验中，静态引导使 4B 学生的约束满足率比无引导基线低 2.5 点，而每 16 个 token 的免训练刷新仅改变记忆内容就能恢复 2.0 点的增益。
summary_sections.method: 提出 MentorPulse：将导师状态压缩为有容量上限的槽记忆，增量处理新生成的 token，通过门控交叉注意力更新学生读取的记忆，而不重置学生的 KV cache。另提出 Windowed Refresh Training，使桥接器适应前缀条件记忆，并用轻量级读模式检查在部署前预测增益。
summary_sections.result: 在 13 个数据集上，MentorPulse 在宏观平均上闭合了 52.2% 的导师-学生差距，超过 C2C、T2T 和等预算 LoRA，最大增益出现在长输出上；在来自三个模型家族的 11 个导师-学生对上表现最佳，且优势随能力差距增大而缩小。测量成本还识别出在长输出上优于文本引导的刷新间隔。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过不断刷新记忆而非固定信号，MentorPulse 能以实用成本保持引导新鲜度；同时指出其增益在导师-学生能力差距变大时收窄，且增益可在部署前通过读模式检查预测。

papers.title: Source-Free MT Evaluation Is Not MT Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Reference-based metrics remain the standard choice in machine translation evaluation, partly because quality estimation methods often correlate less well with human judgments. As a result, source-free, reference-based evaluation has become the practical norm, even though it is unfaithful to the definition of translation adequacy and unfair to systems whose outputs preserve the source meaning while differing from the reference. This paper argues that adequacy must be judged with respect to the source. A reference is only one possible rendering of the source and may introduce bias, under-specification, or errors. We further argue that source-reference-hypothesis evaluation is fair only when the judge treats the reference as auxiliary evidence rather than as the primary standard. Otherwise, even source-aware evaluation can reduce adequacy to preference towards reference. We show the existing hybrid metrics are highly reliant on reference compared to source. Our argument is not that all automatic MT metrics fail to use the source. Rather, we argue that any evaluation protocol that removes the source, or allows the reference to dominate the source, is structurally incomplete for adequacy evaluation. However, existing MT papers generally prefer reference-based metrics and use QE metrics only when reference is unavailable. We therefore call for QE to be reframed as a primary approach to source-grounded adequacy evaluation, rather than as a fallback motivated by missing references. We further call for hybrid metrics whose designs explicitly prioritize source--hypothesis faithfulness while using references only as complementary evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从机器翻译评估的定义出发，批判了当前以无源参考（source-free reference）为基础的评估实践。作者认为翻译充分性必须对照源文判断，参考只是源的一种可能译法，可能引入偏差或错误；当参考主导评估时，即使使用源文的评估也会退化为对参考的偏好。论文呼吁将质量估计（QE）重新定位为源基充分性评估的主要手段，并主张混合指标应优先考虑源-假设忠实度，参考仅作为补充证据。
Motivation: 当前机器翻译评估普遍采用基于参考的指标，而质量估计（QE）方法因与人工判断相关性较低而常被当作次选。作者指出这背离了翻译充分性应按源文评判的定义，对产出了与参考不同但保留源意的系统不公平，因此需要重新审视评估协议的结构。
Method: 论文通过论证性分析而非实验系统的形式展开：界定源-参考-假设三者关系，区分参考作为辅助证据与作为主要标准两种评估模式，并分析现有混合指标对参考和源的依赖程度。
Result: 摘要表明现有混合指标在评估中高度依赖参考而非源文，这支持了作者关于当前评估协议结构上不完整的论点。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁将质量估计（QE）重新定位为源基充分性评估的主要方法，而不仅仅是缺少参考时的后备方案；同时主张设计混合指标时明确优先源-假设忠实度，参考只作为互补证据使用。

papers.title: UpgradeBench: A Decision-Centric Benchmark for Upgrading Fine-Tuned LLM Specialists
papers.abstract_en: Organizations maintain task-specific adapters for open-weight language models, and each new base-model release forces a migration decision: retain existing specialists, port adapters, refresh from preserved behavior, or retrain. Prior transfer work evaluates isolated model pairs, without studying these choices across real model release sequences. We present UpgradeBench, a decision-driven longitudinal benchmark covering four consecutive Qwen releases, one continuation checkpoint, six tasks, and two model sizes, augmented by OLMo checkpoints with known training lineage. The benchmark disentangles three core questions: whether a new checkpoint improves fixed-recipe retrained specialist performance, whether specialization assets transfer across versions, and what recovery resources are usable. We observe upgrade gains differ across task-scale-release episodes: some retrained baselines improve while others stay within training noise, with durability ranging from under one release interval for text-to-SQL to over fourteen months for intent classification. Direct adapter copying depends neither on architecture nor model family: on OLMo, retention drops from 0.88-0.99 at 46B-token continued pretraining to zero at 2.9T tokens; annealing and model souping introduce no extra harm, with portability decaying with continued-pretraining distance. Given preserved input data, teacher relabeling recovers target-base specialists without fresh gold annotations, though compute savings are not guaranteed. Simulating a fixed decision policy over 33 upgrade episodes yields 0.37pp mean quality regret with zero behavioral regressions at one-third the compute and label cost of full retraining. A lightweight CKA probe over 256 prompts predicts cross-version adapter portability (Spearman 0.74 across eight model pairs). We release per-example predictions, cost logs, split manifests, and evaluation code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UpgradeBench，一个面向决策的纵向基准，用于评估在开放权重语言模型换代时，针对特定任务的微调专家（fine-tuned LLM specialists）的升级策略。基准覆盖 Qwen 连续四代发布、一个延续检查点、六个任务和两种模型规模，并加入具有已知训练谱系的 OLMo 检查点，分离了重训收益、资产迁移和可用恢复资源三个核心问题。
Motivation: 组织为开放权重模型维护任务特定适配器，每次新基础模型发布都面临保留、移植、刷新或重训的迁移决策，而既有迁移研究只评估孤立的模型对，未覆盖真实模型发布序列中的这些选择。
Method: 构建决策驱动的纵向基准 UpgradeBench，覆盖多个 Qwen 发布片段与 OLMo 检查点，并通过固定配方重训、直接拷贝适配器、退火（annealing）与模型汤（model souping）、教师重标注（teacher relabeling）等方式系统评估升级策略，还引入轻量 CKA 探针预测跨版本适配器可移植性。
Result: 摘要报告升级收益因任务、规模和发布片段而异：text-to-SQL 的持久性不足一个发布周期，而意图分类超过十四个月；在 OLMo 上，适配器保留率从 46B-token 续训时的 0.88–0.99 降至 2.9T-token 时的零；固定决策策略在 33 个升级片段上以三分之一的算力和标注成本实现 0.37pp 平均质量遗憾且无行为回归；CKA 探针在 256 个提示上跨 8 个模型对预测可移植性，Spearman 为 0.74。
Conclusion: 摘要强调升级决策需要针对任务-规模-发布片段进行评估；在保留输入数据时，教师重标注可在无新金标注的情况下恢复目标基座专家，但计算节省不保证。基准发布了逐样本预测、成本日志、划分清单与评估代码。
Relevance: 5
