papers.title: Semantically Compatible Knowledge Distillation for Cross-Domain Object Detection with Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) offer strong generalization capabilities for domain-adaptive object detection (DAOD). However, existing VFM-based methods overlook the spatial-scale discrepancy between teacher and student feature maps, resulting in semantic incompatibility that weakens both feature alignment and pseudo-label learning. Moreover, domain shift can cause source-trained VFM teachers to miss target-domain objects, limiting the quality of their pseudo-labels. To address these issues, we propose the Semantic Localization-Enhanced Teacher (SLE-T), a semantically compatible knowledge-distillation framework built around a lightweight SLE Adapter for DINOv2. SLE Adapter injects pretrained local-texture priors into DINOv2 to improve cross-domain recognition and reformulates its features into dense representations that are spatially and semantically compatible with the student detector. SLE-T transfers the resulting teacher knowledge through either pseudo-label learning or feature alignment. We instantiate SLE-T with DINOv2-B and DINOv2-L (the ViT-B and ViT-L variants) and compare them with the larger DINOv2-G teacher. Extensive experiments on three DAOD benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, and ablation studies confirm the importance of teacher-student semantic compatibility. Notably, SLE-T with DINOv2-B produces competitive or superior pseudo-labels using approximately one-quarter of the training time of DINOv2-G and substantially less GPU memory, demonstrating efficient VFM knowledge transfer under limited computational resources.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的语义兼容知识蒸馏框架 SLE-T，用于跨域目标检测 (DAOD)。其核心是围绕 DINOv2 的轻量 SLE Adapter，将预训练局部纹理先验注入 DINOv2 并重构为与学生检测器在空间和语义上兼容的稠密特征，再通过伪标签学习或特征对齐迁移教师知识。作者以 DINOv2-B/L 作为教师并对比更大的 DINOv2-G，在三个 DAOD 基准上取得 SOTA；DINOv2-B 版本以约四分之一训练时间和显著更少 GPU 内存获得有竞争力乃至更优的伪标签。
Motivation: 现有基于 VFM 的 DAOD 方法忽略了教师与学生特征图之间的空间-尺度差异，造成语义不兼容，削弱特征对齐和伪标签学习；同时域偏移会使源域训练的教师漏检目标域物体，限制伪标签质量。
Method: 提出语义定位增强教师 (SLE-T)，围绕 DINOv2 构建轻量 SLE Adapter：向 DINOv2 注入预训练局部纹理先验以提升跨域识别，并将特征重构为与学生检测器空间和语义兼容的稠密表示，通过伪标签学习或特征对齐两种方式传递教师知识。
Result: 在三个 DAOD 基准上的实验表明该方法达到 SOTA，消融实验确认师生语义兼容性的重要性；SLE-T 使用 DINOv2-B 教师时，以约 DINOv2-G 四分之一的训练时间和大幅减少的 GPU 内存，生成有竞争力或更优的伪标签。
Conclusion: 作者强调教师-学生语义兼容是实现高效 VFM 知识迁移的关键，并展示了有限计算资源下的高效性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Explainable Deepfake Detection with Feature-robust Augmentation and Evidence-grounded Explanation Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Explainable deepfake detection extends binary classification by requiring models to not only predict authenticity but also provide interpretable justifications. This expanded scope is critical in practice, where users like forensic analysts need insight into the rationale behind the detection. Despite advancements, current approaches suffer from two critical deficiencies: (1)vulnerability to image quality degradation: detection accuracy plummets on low-quality samples, while naive augmentation strategies may induce feature drift and impair performance as diversity expands. (2) factually flawed explanations: explanation models may omit manipulation evidence or hallucinate irrelevant details, undermining interpretability. To address it, we propose a framework with two innovations. For robust deepfake detection, we introduce Feature-robust Augmentation, which comprises diversified degradation-aware augmentation strategies, and a supervised contrastive learning pattern paired with a mean-teacher architecture that stabilizes features against augmentations through consistency constraints. For explanation, we devise an evidence-grounded preference optimization process that guides model to prioritize genuine manipulation traces by learning from chosen-rejected explanation pairs, where rejected samples are constructed via evidence omission or irrelevant information injection. The proposed approach wins the first place in ACM Multimedia 2026 Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge.The code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/EDD.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可解释深度伪造检测的两个缺陷——对图像质量退化脆弱、以及解释模型可能遗漏操纵证据或产生无关幻觉——提出一个双组件框架。其一为特征鲁棒增强（Feature-robust Augmentation），结合多样化退化感知增强与监督对比学习、mean-teacher 架构的一致性约束；其二为基于证据的偏好优化（evidence-grounded preference optimization），通过选择-拒绝解释对引导模型优先关注真实操纵痕迹。该方法在 ACM Multimedia 2026 可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛中获得第一名。
Motivation: 现有可解释深度伪造检测方法在低质量图像上检测精度会急剧下降，而朴素的数据增强策略可能引起特征漂移并损害性能；同时解释模型可能省略操纵证据或幻觉出无关细节，削弱解释的可信度。
Method: 提出一个包含两项创新的框架：一是 Feature-robust Augmentation，由多样化且感知退化的增强策略组成，并采用监督对比学习结合 mean-teacher 架构，通过一致性约束稳定特征；二是证据基础的偏好优化过程，通过构建遗漏证据或注入无关信息的拒绝样本，与真实解释配对，让模型学习优先关注真正的操纵痕迹。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 ACM Multimedia 2026 可解释深度伪造检测挑战赛中取得第一名，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过增强检测鲁棒性和解释的事实依据，同时缓解低质量图像下的精度下降与解释幻觉问题，并在挑战赛场景中验证了有效性。

papers.title: InfinityEdit: Infinite Video Editing with a Lightweight Edit-Ignition Adapter
papers.abstract_en: With large pretrained models, existing methods have effectively improved instruction-based video editing. However, most of them rely on an in-place editing assumption. They align the edited video with the given source clip frame by frame over a fixed time span. This pattern fails for open-ended streams, e.g., restyling a live game or applying a camera move to an ongoing shot. In such cases, edits must extend to future frames as they arrive, rather than be applied to a static input clip. In this paper, we study this setting and name it infinite video editing: given a preceding segment and an edit request, a model must generate the next segment that continues the stream while applying the requested edit. This process repeats as an unbounded sequence of edit instructions arrives. This task brings two challenges: the edit must be a faithful continuation rather than a frame-wise rewrite, and generation quality must remain stable as edits accumulate. To address them, we first design a data-collection pipeline for infinite video editing. Based on the collected data, we propose InfinityEdit, a lightweight edit adapter that equips a streaming video generator with unbounded editing ability. The adapter contains three attention modules. History cross-attention guides the denoising frames using the input frames. Temporal causal self-attention keeps temporal cues flowing only from earlier frames to later ones. Edit cross-attention injects the edit request into generation. During inference, the adapter is activated only in the chunk where an edit request arrives. Subsequent chunks are generated by the original model with a reset anchor frame. This scheme applies the edit while preserving the original model's infinite generation ability. Extensive experiments show that InfinityEdit faithfully continues the stream under each edit, and stays stable over unbounded edit sequences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对开放式的无限视频编辑设定，提出InfinityEdit，一个轻量级编辑适配器，使流式视频生成器能够将编辑请求持续应用到不断到达的未来帧。适配器包含历史交叉注意力、时序因果自注意力和编辑交叉注意力三个模块，推理时仅在编辑指令到达的chunk激活，后续chunk由原始模型生成并重置锚帧，以保留原始无限生成能力。实验表明该方法能忠实延续流并在无界编辑序列上保持稳定。
Motivation: 现有基于指令的视频编辑大多依赖就地编辑假设，即在一个固定时间跨度内逐帧对齐源片段，这无法处理开放流场景（如实时游戏重风格化或对持续镜头应用相机运动），因为编辑必须随未来帧到来而延伸而非应用于静态输入片段。
Method: 设计了一个针对无限视频编辑的数据收集pipeline，并提出InfinityEdit轻量适配器，包含三个注意力模块：历史交叉注意力（用输入帧引导去噪帧）、时序因果自注意力（仅允许时序信息从早期帧流向后期帧）和编辑交叉注意力（将编辑请求注入生成过程）。推理时适配器仅在编辑请求到达的chunk中激活，其余chunk由原始模型生成并重置锚帧。
Result: 大量实验表明InfinityEdit在每个编辑指令下都能忠实延续视频流，并在无界编辑序列上保持生成质量稳定；摘要未给出具体量化数字。
Conclusion: 该方案在施加编辑的同时保留了原始模型的无限生成能力，适用于需要持续响应编辑指令的视频流场景；摘要未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: Decoupling Policy Extraction for Offline Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Offline RL methods commonly jointly train the actor and critic, where the critic is used to guide the actor toward higher-value actions. This coupled learning process is well motivated in online RL, where an improved actor collects new data that can further update the actor and the critic. However, training data remains fixed in offline RL, making actor-side policy improvement unable to generate new data to validate or correct the critic. Moreover, retaining this coupled paradigm leads to two related challenges. Firstly, actor updates can drift toward high-valued but potentially out-of-distribution (OOD) actions and amplify critic overestimation. Secondly, conservative value estimation or behavior-cloning regularization creates a difficult trade-off between suppressing OOD actions and selecting high-value actions within the data-supported region. Motivated by this observation, we revisit the conventional offline RL paradigm and propose decoupling policy improvement from actor training. Specifically, we train the actor solely to model the behavior distribution and perform policy improvement at inference time by reranking multiple actor-generated proposals with a separately learned critic. We refer to this paradigm as the decoupled policy extraction paradigm. Under such paradigm, the actor provides behavior-supported action candidates, while the critic performs value-based selection within this candidate set. Extensive experiments show that the decoupled policy extraction paradigm outperforms both behavior cloning and jointly learned offline RL methods, while remaining effective even with a naive Q-learning critic.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视离线强化学习 (offline RL) 中 actor 与 critic 联合训练的传统范式，提出将策略改进与 actor 训练解耦：actor 仅建模行为分布，推理时用单独训练的 critic 对多个 actor 生成的候选动作重排序。该方法称为解耦策略提取范式 (decoupled policy extraction paradigm)，在实验中优于行为克隆 (behavior cloning) 和联合训练的离线 RL 方法，即使使用朴素 Q-learning critic 也保持有效。
Motivation: 离线 RL 中数据固定，actor 侧的策略改进无法生成新数据来校验或修正 critic；保留联合训练范式会导致两个问题：actor 更新漂移到高价值但可能分布外 (OOD) 的动作并放大 critic 过估计，以及保守价值估计或行为克隆正则化在抑制 OOD 动作和选择数据支持区域内高价值动作之间存在困难权衡。
Method: 提出解耦策略提取范式：训练 actor 时仅学习行为分布，不进行策略改进；策略改进在推理阶段完成，通过一个单独学习的 critic 对 actor 生成的多个候选动作进行重排序，从而实现候选集合内的基于价值的选择。
Result: 大量实验表明，该解耦策略提取范式在性能上同时超过行为克隆和联合学习的离线 RL 方法，并且在仅使用朴素 Q-learning critic 的情况下依然有效。
Conclusion: 作者主张重新审视传统离线 RL 范式，将策略改进与 actor 训练解耦可以缓解分布外动作漂移与价值过估计问题，且该范式对 critic 质量要求较低。

papers.title: EmotionDialogCN: A Spontaneous Multimodal Dataset for Mandarin Emotional Dialogue
papers.abstract_en: Face-to-face audiovisual interaction is central to human communication, conveying rich emotional and social cues. However, existing multimodal dialogue datasets remain limited by inadequate emotion annotations, poor emotional diversity, and small scale. We introduce EmotionDialogCN, a large-scale audiovisual-emotional dataset designed to capture authentic face-to-face communication. It contains 21,880 dialogue sessions performed by 119 professional actors across 20 everyday scenarios, covering 18 emotion categories with over 400 hours of recordings, the largest and most comprehensive dataset of its kind. A novel data collection framework minimizes equipment interference, enabling natural and nuanced emotional expressions. EmotionDialogCN achieves an emotion distribution deviation of 0.64 from real human emotion statistics (versus 5.65 for prior datasets) and consistent subject framing (52-59% frame occupancy). Together, these properties translate into stable unimodal and multimodal performance across acoustic, lexical, and visual modalities, with fusion results further underscoring strong multimodal alignment and cross-modal complementarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 EmotionDialogCN，一个大规模普通话音视频情感对话数据集，包含 119 位专业演员在 20 个日常场景中的 21,880 段对话，覆盖 18 种情绪类别、超过 400 小时录音。数据收集框架尽量减少设备干扰，情绪分布与真实人类情绪统计的偏差为 0.64（此前数据集为 5.65），人物构图占比为 52-59%。在声学、词汇和视觉模态上的单模态与多模态实验均表现稳定，融合结果说明了多模态对齐与跨模态互补性。
Motivation: 现有情感对话数据集存在情绪标注不充分、情绪多样性差和规模小的问题，难以支撑对真实面对面交流中丰富情感与社会线索的研究。
Method: 提出一种新的数据收集框架以最小化设备干扰，并由专业演员在 20 个日常场景中表演 21,880 段对话，采集音视频与情感标注，构建大规模多模态情感对话数据集。
Result: 数据集规模与覆盖度超过同类资源：情绪分布偏差为 0.64，相较此前数据集 5.65 更接近真实人类情绪统计；人物构图占用稳定在 52-59%。声学、词汇、视觉模态上的单模态与多模态表现稳定，融合结果体现强多模态对齐与跨模态互补。
Conclusion: 作者强调 EmotionDialogCN 在规模、情绪多样性和自然性上的优势，并认为这些性质可转化为稳定的多模态情感识别表现。

papers.title: IMU-Free Body-Frame State Estimation with Sparse Scene Flow for Quadcopters
papers.abstract_en: We present a vision-only state estimation system for X-configuration quadcopters equipped with a canonical stereo camera pair and no inertial sensors. The system operates entirely in the body frame, requiring only synchronised stereo images and motor thrust commands. A continuous-discrete extended Kalman filter on a composite manifold state $\langle SE(3), \mathbb{R}^3, \ldots \rangle$ maintains estimates of body-frame pose, velocity, angular velocity, gravity, and disturbances, using stationary scene points as implicit inertial references. Feature points are detected (FAST, Shi-Tomasi), tracked temporally (SSD, Lucas-Kanade) and matched across cameras (NCC), with search regions predicted from filter-derived pose and point uncertainty. Chi-squared gating on the normalised innovation admits only stationary points to the filter. The system also produces a sparse 3D point cloud carrying per-point position, velocity and joint covariance. These come from a 4-view (two stereo pairs at two timestamps) full bundle adjustment that jointly estimates position and velocity from stereo disparity and temporal parallax, with the filter-derived relative pose as a prior. Feature points in the EKF do not enter the solver; their information is reflected through the pose prior. Point cloud density is spatially adaptive: an external focus point directs allocation, producing dense coverage in the region of attention and sparse coverage elsewhere. The output is a body-frame state estimate, a calibrated pose change, and a sparse scene flow. It is intended as a measurement source for a downstream world model anchored in the current body frame, without dependence on GPS, IMU, or any world-frame infrastructure, though the architecture accommodates their future integration.
papers.comment: 56 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables. Evaluated on the VID dataset (arXiv:2103.11152)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种纯视觉、无 IMU 的 X 构型四旋翼状态估计系统，仅需同步双目图像与电机推力指令，在机体系 (body frame) 内完成估计。系统用连续-离散扩展卡尔曼滤波器 (EKF) 在复合流形状态上估计位姿、速度、角速度、重力和扰动，以静止场景点为隐式惯性参考；同时通过双时刻双目 4 视图 bundle adjustment 生成带位置、速度和联合协方差的稀疏 3D 点云与场景流 (scene flow)。输出被设计为下游机体系世界模型的测量源，不依赖 GPS、IMU 或世界坐标系设施。
Motivation: 目标是在无 GPS、无 IMU 且无任何世界坐标系基础设施的条件下为四旋翼提供状态估计，用静止场景点替代惯性传感器作为参考，使系统可服务于以当前机体系为锚定的下游世界模型。
Method: 方法包括 FAST/Shi-Tomasi 特征检测、SSD/Lucas-Kanade 时序跟踪、NCC 跨相机匹配，并用滤波器预测的位姿与点不确定性引导搜索区域；带卡方门控 (chi-squared gating) 的归一化新息只允许静止点进入滤波器。点云来自两个时刻两个双目帧的 4 视图完整 bundle adjustment，以滤波器相对位姿为先验，联合估计点位置与速度；点云密度由外部焦点位置引导，实现注意力区域密集覆盖、其余区域稀疏覆盖。
Result: 摘要未给出量化数值结果，仅说明系统在 VID 数据集 (arXiv:2103.11152) 上评估，输出机体系状态估计、校准后的位姿变化与稀疏场景流。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该架构设计为下游世界模型的测量源，可在纯视觉条件下运行，同时指出架构预留了未来集成 GPS、IMU 或世界坐标系基础设施的扩展空间。

papers.title: A Collaborative Multi-Modality Interaction for VLA-based End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by jointly integrating perception, reasoning, and decision making within a unified multimodal framework. However, most existing VLA models formulate end-to-end autonomous driving as a visual question answering task, leading to unreliable and less interpretable decision reasoning. In addition, they fail to establish effective multi-modal interaction across heterogeneous sensors, thereby limiting robust scene perception and reliable driving reasoning in long-tail driving scenarios. To this end, we propose a robust VLA-based end-to-end autonomous driving system that combines multi-modality interaction with multi-trajectory planning and optimization, enabling more reliable, interpretable, and safer driving decisions. Our method comprises three core components: (1) Affinity-Guided Optimal Transport for main-auxiliary modality two-way interaction; (2) Distribution-Consistent Modality Transfer for heterogeneous modality distribution transfer and cross-modal interaction; (3) Multi-modal Multi-Trajectory Planning along with Perception-Oriented Trajectory Refinement for better driving decisions to long-tail driving scenarios. Experimental results in open-loop and closed-loop datasets demonstrate improvements in safety long-horizon driving reasoning and road scene perception over existing driving systems, highlighting the ability of our mutli-modality interaction and multi-trajectory planning and optimization for scalable VLA-based systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有VLA（Vision-Language-Action）模型在端到端自动驾驶中将决策视为视觉问答任务、缺乏可解释性，且异构传感器间多模态交互不足的问题，提出了一种结合多模态交互与多轨迹规划优化的VLA驾驶系统。系统包含三个核心组件：基于亲和力引导的最优传输（Affinity-Guided Optimal Transport）的主辅模态双向交互、分布一致的模态迁移（Distribution-Consistent Modality Transfer）、以及面向感知的多模态多轨迹规划与轨迹细化。在开环和闭环数据集上的实验表明，该方法在安全长时驾驶推理和道路场景感知上优于现有系统。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常把端到端自动驾驶建模为视觉问答任务，导致决策推理不可靠且缺乏可解释性；同时它们未能建立异构传感器之间有效的多模态交互，限制了长尾驾驶场景下的鲁棒场景感知和可靠驾驶推理。

Conclusion: 作者强调所提出的多模态交互与多轨迹规划及优化方案能够支持可扩展的VLA驾驶系统，提升驾驶决策的可靠性、可解释性与安全性。

papers.title: KREL: Automatic Medical Coding via Knowledge-Guided Reasoning over Clinical Evidence with LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Medical Coding (AMC), which assigns standardized International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes to clinical notes, is essential for medical reimbursement, quality reporting, and clinical research. Existing pre-trained language model (PLM)-based methods typically formulate AMC as an extreme multi-label classification problem over a predefined code set, while recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches instead frame it as generation or multi-step reasoning. However, key challenges remain, including the extreme length of clinical notes that hinders effective interpretation, the vast ICD label space, and complex coding rules that are not explicitly captured by LLMs. In this work, we propose Knowledge-Guided Reasoning over Clinical Evidence with LLMs (KREL), a framework that leverages LLMs for clinical text understanding and reasoning while integrating external ICD coding guidelines as structured knowledge. This design enables tight coupling between domain knowledge and LLM reasoning, reducing hallucinations and improving compliance with coding standards. Experiments on benchmark datasets show that KREL consistently outperforms strong PLM-based and state-of-the-art LLM-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KREL（Knowledge-Guided Reasoning over Clinical Evidence with LLMs），一个面向自动医学编码 (Automatic Medical Coding, AMC) 的框架，将外部 ICD 编码指南作为结构化知识与大语言模型推理相结合。KREL 在临床文本理解与推理中显式引入编码规则，以缓解幻觉并提升对编码标准的遵从度。在基准数据集上的实验显示其持续优于强 PLM 基线和现有 LLM 基线的 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有 PLM 方法把 AMC 视为预定义代码集上的极端多标签分类，而 LLM 方法采用生成或多步推理，但临床笔记超长、ICD 标签空间巨大且编码规则复杂，LLM 尚未显式捕获这些规则，导致理解不充分与规则遵从不足。
Method: KREL 利用 LLM 进行临床文本理解和推理，并把外部 ICD 编码指南集成为结构化知识，使领域知识与 LLM 推理紧密耦合，从而减少幻觉并提高编码合规性。
Result: 摘要报告在基准数据集上，KREL 一致性地优于强 PLM 基线和最新的 LLM 基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者强调将外部编码指南作为结构化知识与 LLM 推理耦合，能在自动医学编码中带来更可靠的性能与规则遵从。

papers.title: EviRank: Structured Relevance Evidence for Multimodal Image Re-ranking
papers.abstract_en: Real-world image search queries are multimodal and compositional: ``find this shirt in pink'' specifies an entity to retain, an attribute to modify, and context to ignore. Yet existing re-rankers either compress such multifaceted relevance into an opaque embedding or rely on free-form chain-of-thought that easily omits or hallucinates fine-grained constraints. Drawing on rubric- and checklist-based evaluation from NLP, we recast multimodal image re-ranking as a semantic constraint satisfaction problem and propose EviRank, which parses any query - text-only, image-only, or composed - into a unified evidence package: typed criteria across six semantic slots (e.g., entities, attributes, relations), each labelled required, forbidden, or ignorable. Re-ranking then reduces to evidence-conditioned verification, combining deterministic rubric scoring and evidence-grounded listwise comparison in a single training-free procedure. The explicit evidence can further serve as structured supervision for optionally distilling a lightweight student. Across five benchmarks spanning text-to-image, image-to-image, and composed image retrieval, EviRank achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the distilled student preserves over 90% of the teacher's capability at substantially lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EviRank，一种面向多模态图像重排序的训练无关方法。它将文本、图像或组合查询解析为统一的结构化证据包，包含跨六个语义槽（如实体、属性、关系）的类型化标准，并标注 required、forbidden 或 ignorable，再通过确定性 rubric 评分与基于证据的 listwise 比较完成重排序。摘要称其在 text-to-image、image-to-image 和 composed image retrieval 五类基准上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，且蒸馏出的轻量学生模型保留教师模型 90% 以上的能力。
Motivation: 现实图像检索查询通常是多模态且组合式的，而现有重排序方法要么把多方面相关性压缩进不透明嵌入，要么依赖自由格式思维链，容易遗漏或幻觉细粒度约束。
Method: 将多模态图像重排序重构为语义约束满足问题，提出 EviRank：先把任意查询解析为统一证据包，再由证据条件驱动的验证完成重排序，结合确定性 rubric 评分和基于证据的 listwise 比较，全程无需训练；显式证据还可作为结构化监督信号用于蒸馏轻量学生模型。
Result: 摘要报告 EviRank 在五个基准（覆盖 text-to-image、image-to-image 与 composed image retrieval）上达到 state-of-the-art 性能，蒸馏学生模型在显著降低成本的同时保留超过 90% 的教师能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式结构化证据可将重排序转化为可验证的约束满足过程，并支持低成本学生蒸馏，从而缓解现有方法在细粒度多模态查询上的不可解释与幻觉问题。

papers.title: Breaking High Confidence: Practical Face Impersonation under High-Security Thresholds
papers.abstract_en: Face recognition systems (FRSs) are increasingly deployed in critical real-world services for authentication, such as banking applications and airport identity checks, necessitating stringent security configurations. Consequently, the security vulnerabilities of FRSs have garnered significant attention. While existing studies have extensively explored FRS security, prior analyses have primarily focused on medium-security threshold settings, which are not directly applicable to FRSs operating under high-security constraints. In this paper, we propose the first successful impersonation attack against FRSs under high-security threshold settings. Among various threat models, we focus on a practical and challenging scenario: score-based impersonation attacks under strict rate limits. To precisely evaluate the feasibility of such attacks, we provide a principled mathematical analysis characterizing the gaps in each stage of the attack pipeline. Our method significantly enhances impersonation capabilities in score-based attacks, even under elevated decision thresholds. On the LFW benchmark, with a budget of only 100 confidence score queries per identity, our attack achieves an impersonation success rate exceeding 92\% against Amazon Rekognition at a confidence score threshold of 99-recommended setting for law enforcement scenarios. We further observe consistently robust performance across multiple open-source FRSs evaluated at similarly stringent decision thresholds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个在高层安全阈值设置下对 Face Recognition Systems (FRS) 成功的 impersonation attack。作者聚焦于严格查询速率限制下的基于分数的攻击，并提供分阶段的数学分析来刻画攻击流程中各环节的差距。在 LFW 基准上，仅用每个身份 100 次置信度查询，即可在 Amazon Rekognition 的 99 分推荐阈值（执法场景设置）下达到超过 92% 的冒充成功率，并在多个开源 FRS 上保持稳健表现。
Motivation: 现有 FRS 安全性研究主要针对中等安全阈值设置，其结果不能直接适用于在高层安全约束下运行的 FRS；该论文针对这一空白，研究实际且具有挑战性的严格速率限制下的基于分数的 impersonation attack。
Method: 提出一种 score-based impersonation attack，适用于严格查询速率限制的威胁模型；通过原理性的数学分析刻画攻击流程各阶段的 gap，并据此优化冒充能力。
Result: 在 LFW 基准上，以每身份 100 次 confidence score 查询的预算，攻击在 Amazon Rekognition 的 99 分置信度阈值下实现超过 92% 的冒充成功率；在多个开源 FRS 的类似严格阈值下也表现出一致的稳健性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明在高层安全阈值下对 FRS 进行实际 impersonation attack 是可行的，且该方法显著增强了基于分数攻击的冒充能力。

papers.title: LoRC: Detecting AI-Generated Images via Low-Rank Collapse in Semantic Residuals
papers.abstract_en: Modern generators faithfully model macroscopic semantics, producing synthetic images that appear highly realistic. Consequently, decisive forensic cues reside in subtle non-semantic visual discrepancies. To reveal these cues, we revisit AIGI detection from a geometric perspective and identify an architecture-agnostic signature. Specifically, modern generators exhibit low-rank collapse (\textit{i.e.}, rank degeneracy) in the semantic-residual orthogonal subspace while largely preserving the dominant semantic direction. This structural flattening consistently emerges during the final decoding stage, forming a shared bottleneck across diverse generator architectures. Motivated by this signature, we propose \textbf{LoRC}, a framework that decouples semantic dominance to capture the collapsed residual geometry induced by the generative decoding bottleneck. Our method improves accuracy by an average of 7.0\% across multiple benchmarks and achieves 97.0\% accuracy on 39 unseen generators. These results demonstrate strong cross-model generalization and robustness, making LoRC a reliable approach for AIGI detection in complex real-world environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRC，一种从几何角度检测 AI 生成图像（AIGI）的框架。作者发现现代生成器在语义残差正交子空间中表现出低秩坍缩（low-rank collapse），即在保留主导语义方向的同时残差方向出现秩退化，且该现象在最终解码阶段跨生成器架构一致出现。LoRC 通过解耦语义主导成分来捕捉生成解码瓶颈导致的残差几何坍缩，在多个基准上平均提升 7.0% 准确率，并在 39 个未见生成器上达到 97.0% 准确率。
Motivation: 现代生成器能真实建模宏观语义，真实与合成图像之间的决定性取证线索存在于细微的非语义视觉差异中；现有方法缺少跨生成器架构通用的几何层面检测签名。
Method: 识别出一个与架构无关的签名：语义残差正交子空间中的低秩坍缩（秩退化），并据此提出 LoRC 框架，将语义主导成分解耦，以捕捉生成解码瓶颈所诱导的残差几何坍缩。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多个基准上的检测准确率平均提升 7.0%，并在 39 个未见生成器上达到 97.0% 准确率，表明其具备较强的跨模型泛化能力与鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LoRC 是一种可靠的 AIGI 检测方法，能够适应复杂真实环境下的跨模型泛化需求。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 LoRC 是一种可靠的 AIGI 检测方法，能够适应复杂真实环境下的跨模型泛化需求。

papers.title: Multi-Modal Traffic Sign Detection with Semantic Attributes for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Reliable traffic sign detection is a prerequisite for the global deployment of autonomous driving systems, where regulatory compliance and road safety depend on perceiving signs correctly across regions, ranges, and weather conditions. Despite recent progress, vision-based methods continue to face three fundamental limitations: poor cross-regional generalization due to high diversity across countries, degraded performance on small-object detection at long ranges (traffic signs occupy as little as $10{\times}10$ pixels at 200m), and fragile temporal tracking under the strongly non-linear perspective distortion that occurs as a vehicle approaches a sign. In this paper, we address the problem of robust, long-range, region-agnostic traffic sign perception by combining camera and Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) sensing. We present a multi-modal detection framework whose Intensity-Aware Deformable Fusion module aligns retro-reflective LiDAR cues with camera features, anchoring detection on geometric invariants rather than region-specific visual appearance. We further introduce a dual motion-model tracker that explicitly accounts for non-linear perspective transformations during vehicle approach, substantially improving temporal consistency over linear motion assumptions. Additionally, we develop a semantic attribute classification pipeline that estimates occlusion level, readability, sign embeddedness, and road relevance, providing actionable context to downstream planning. Extensive evaluation on our dataset, spanning 60+ countries and 2,500+ hours of driving data, shows that the proposed pipeline achieves an Object Miss Ratio (OMR) of 0.49% across 221,068 evaluation sequences, demonstrating globally generalizable traffic sign perception in commercial-grade autonomous driving systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合相机与 LiDAR 的多模态交通标志检测框架，包含 Intensity-Aware Deformable Fusion 模块（将 retro-reflective LiDAR 线索与相机特征对齐）、双运动模型跟踪器（显式建模车辆接近时的非线性透视变换）以及语义属性分类管线（估计遮挡、可读性、嵌入程度和道路相关性）。在覆盖 60+ 国家和 2,500+ 小时驾驶数据的自有数据集上，221,068 个评估序列的 Object Miss Ratio (OMR) 为 0.49%，旨在实现商用自动驾驶中跨区域、长距离、全天候的交通标志感知。
Motivation: 视觉方法在交通标志检测上存在三个基本局限：跨区域泛化差（不同国家标志差异大）、远距离小目标检测退化（200m 处标志仅约 10x10 像素）、以及车辆接近时强非线性透视畸变导致的时间跟踪不稳定。
Method: 提出多模态检测框架：Intensity-Aware Deformable Fusion 将 LiDAR 的 retro-reflective 几何线索与相机特征对齐，使检测锚定在几何不变量而非区域特定外观上；双运动模型跟踪器显式处理车辆接近时的非线性透视变换；语义属性分类管线提供遮挡程度、可读性、嵌入程度与道路相关性等上下文信息。
Result: 摘要报告在包含 60+ 国家和 2,500+ 小时驾驶数据的评估中，该管线在 221,068 个评估序列上达到 0.49% 的 Object Miss Ratio (OMR)，表明其具备全球可泛化的交通标志感知能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结合 LiDAR 几何不变量的多模态方案可实现区域无关的稳健交通标志感知（traffic sign perception），并为下游规划提供可操作的语义上下文。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Nothing Changed but the Model: CellFill -- Bounded In-Cell Learning for Bit-Identical, Revocable Updates to Quantized LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Every way of teaching a deployed language model something new -- full fine-tuning, adapter merging, model editing -- replaces the released checkpoint, and with it every evaluation and cache that referred to those exact bits. We instead learn inside the dequantization gap: with the integer codes and scales of a 4-bit release frozen, new knowledge is written only into the per-weight residual that lives strictly inside each quantization decision cell. Re-quantization then returns the released artifact bit-for-bit, a machine-checkable guarantee; updates are exactly revocable by dropping the residual; and drift is bounded. We give six propositions and three training paths, including CellFill, a bounded reparameterization that makes invariance structural rather than enforced. Exact invariance turns out to be nearly free: across three paired seeds the constrained dense path matches an unconstrained reference whose weights provably escape the artifact (58.9 vs 59.3 percent fact recall; paired difference -0.5 points, 95% CI [-5.0,+4.0]), and is better on held-out cross-domain perplexity. Against the natural null hypothesis -- serving the same update as an unmerged adapter -- projecting into the cells reduces cross-domain forgetting in every run that converged, and a diverged control shows the boundary: projection is a trust region, not a repair. What no method escapes is the cost of knowledge itself, and the apparent free lunch of in-domain perplexity improving past the anchor is an artifact of rehearsal sharing a corpus with the metric. Methods differ threefold at matched rehearsal in knowledge bought per point of cross-domain perplexity, a ranking that is not the recall ranking. The method transfers to a 27B hybrid linear-attention model (2.4e10 constrained weights, verified bit-identical), where matched recall costs about half as much cross-domain perplexity as at 1.7B.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CellFill，一种在 4-bit 量化 LLM 发布权重的去量化间隙内进行学习的方法：冻结整数码和缩放因子，只把新知识写入严格位于每个量化决策单元内部的逐权重残差。重新量化后得到与发布 artifact 逐位一致的结果（机器可验证），更新可通过丢弃残差精确撤回，漂移有界。摘要报告该方法在事实回忆上匹配无约束参考，并成功迁移到 27B 混合线性注意力模型。
Motivation: 现有对已部署模型的更新方式——全微调、adapter 合并、模型编辑——都会替换已发布的 checkpoint，使依赖这些精确比特的评测和缓存全部失效。作者希望在保持发布产物 bit 不变的前提下写入新知识，使更新可验证、可撤销且漂移有界。
Method: 在 4-bit 发布的整数码与缩放因子冻结条件下，将新知识只写入去量化间隙内的逐权重残差（per-weight residual），该残差严格位于量化决策单元内部；提出 CellFill，一种有界重参数化（bounded reparameterization），使不变性成为结构性性质而非外部强制。摘要还给出六个命题和三条训练路径。
Result: 三对种子的约束稠密路径在事实回忆上与无约束参考相当（58.9 vs 59.3，配对差 -0.5 点，95% CI [-5.0,+4.0]），并在留出跨域困惑度上更好；与未合并 adapter 相比，投影到单元内在每个收敛运行中都减少跨域遗忘。方法迁移到 27B 混合线性注意力模型（2.4e10 个约束权重，验证 bit 一致），同等回忆下跨域困惑度代价约为 1.7B 模型的一半。
Conclusion: 作者强调任何方法都无法避免知识本身造成的跨域困惑度代价；in-domain 困惑度超过锚点看似免费，实则源于 rehearsal 与评测指标共用同一语料的假象。在匹配 rehearsal 条件下，单位跨域困惑度代价所能获得的知识量在不同方法间相差三倍，且该效率排序不同于 recall 排序。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RDANet: Relative Degradation Aware Network for Infrared Small Target Detection
papers.abstract_en: Infrared small target detection is still challenging in remote sensing imagery, because the targets are extremely small, exhibit weak local contrast, and are often embedded in complex and highly variable backgrounds. In addition to these inherent difficulties, we observe that existing detectors often show unstable performance when the target scale changes or when the scene background varies. This scale- and scene-sensitive degradation indicates that current methods are insufficient in simultaneously preserving target structure during feature downsampling and maintaining discriminative local contrast under background shifts, which finally results in unbalanced detection performance across different conditions. To improve detection robustness, this paper proposes a Relative Degradation Aware Network (RDANet) for infrared small target detection. RDANet consists of two dedicated modules: Multi-Scale Anti-Alias Downsampling (MSAD) and Prototype-Guided Skip Memory (PGSM). MSAD introduces multi-scale anti-alias filtering together with pixel-fold aggregation to reduce aliasing effects during resolution reduction, so that target shape information can be better preserved while irrelevant background responses are suppressed. PGSM further enhances the skip features by retrieving patch-level prototypes from a shared memory and adaptively integrating them into the current representation, which helps maintain stable local contrast cues under diverse scene backgrounds. Experiments on three public benchmarks show that RDANet achieves the best performance on most evaluation metrics, while scale- and background-stratified evaluations indicate more stable behavior across target sizes and scene complexity. The code is available at https://github.com/BIT-RuiLiu/RDANet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向红外小目标检测的 Relative Degradation Aware Network（RDANet），针对目标尺度变化和背景变化导致的检测性能不稳定问题，设计多尺度抗混叠下采样（MSAD）和原型引导跳跃记忆（PGSM）两个模块。在三个公共基准上，RDANet 在多数指标上取得最佳性能，并在按尺度和背景分层的评估中表现更稳定。
Motivation: 红外小目标本身极小、局部对比弱、背景复杂多变；现有检测器在目标尺度变化或场景背景变化时性能不稳定，根源在于下采样时难以保留目标结构、背景偏移时难以维持判别性局部对比，导致不同条件下的检测性能不均衡。
Method: 提出 RDANet，包含两个专用模块：MSAD 通过多尺度抗混叠滤波与像素折叠聚合（pixel-fold aggregation）减少分辨率降低时的混叠效应，保留目标形状信息并抑制无关背景响应；PGSM 从共享记忆（shared memory）检索补丁级原型并自适应融入跳跃特征，以维持不同场景背景下的稳定局部对比线索。
Result: 在三个公开基准上的实验表明，RDANet 在大多数评估指标上取得最佳性能，且按目标尺度和场景复杂度分层评估显示其行为更稳定。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合抗混叠下采样和原型引导的记忆增强可以有效改善红外小目标检测在尺度与背景变化下的鲁棒性；代码已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReCurveflow: A Flow Matching Framework that Learns Curved Reaction Trajectories to Predict Transition State Geometries
papers.abstract_en: Predicting transition states (TS) in chemical reactions is crucial, as they provide insights into reaction mechanisms. Recent work on TS prediction have focused on flow matching supervised on straight linear paths that do not align with actual reaction trajectories. We propose a novel flow matching-based framework ReCurveflow that learns to predict TS geometries supervised on continuously curved reference paths interpolated from a full NEB-derived band of molecular geometries. We also introduce off-path correction, which grants ReCurveflow with the ability to produce corrective velocity fields when engaged off-path geometry states during inference rollout, leading to better resistance against exposure bias and accuracy in TS prediction. Across three data splits and six evaluation metrics, ReCurveflow achieves the best result on the majority of split-metric combinations against seven baselines. Qualitative analyses further show that ReCurveflow generates reaction trajectories with energy profiles that closely track the reference NEB path, provides initializations that ease the NEB optimization bottleneck, and exhibits the intended corrective behavior in its learned velocity fields. The ReCurveflow codebase is publicly available at https://github.com/dmis-lab/ReCurveflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCurveflow，一个基于流匹配（flow matching）的反应过渡态（TS）几何预测框架。与在直线线性路径上监督的以往工作不同，ReCurveflow 在从完整 NEB-derived 分子几何能带插值得到的连续弯曲参考路径上学习，并引入离路径校正（off-path correction）以提升推理时对曝光偏差（exposure bias）的鲁棒性。在三个数据划分和六个评估指标上，ReCurveflow 在大多数划分-指标组合上优于七个基线，定性分析显示其生成的轨迹能量剖面接近参考 NEB 路径。
Motivation: 现有过渡态预测的流匹配方法在直线线性路径上监督，与真实反应轨迹不一致，导致预测精度受限。需要一种能学习弯曲反应路径的框架，以更贴合实际化学反应轨迹。
Method: 提出 ReCurveflow 框架，在从完整 NEB-derived 分子几何能带插值的连续弯曲参考路径上监督流匹配。同时引入离路径校正机制，使模型在推理 rollout 中遇到离路径几何状态时能输出校正速度场，从而抵抗曝光偏差并提升过渡态预测准确性。
Result: 在三个数据划分和六个评估指标上，ReCurveflow 在大多数划分-指标组合上取得最佳结果，对比七个基线。定性分析进一步表明其生成的反应轨迹能量剖面紧密跟随参考 NEB 路径，提供缓解 NEB 优化瓶颈的初始化，且学习到的速度场表现出预期的校正行为。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，学习弯曲反应轨迹并结合离路径校正是提升过渡态预测精度与鲁棒性的有效途径，相关代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identify, Locate, Link: End-to-End Key-Value Extraction from Document Images
papers.abstract_en: Document processing pipelines traditionally cascade optical character recognition (OCR) engines with downstream models for structured information extraction, leading to multi-stage error propagation. We fine-tune SmolDocling, a compact 256M-parameter vision-language model (VLM), to perform end-to-end key-value extraction directly from document images, jointly solving identification, localization, and association in a single pass without OCR preprocessing. We extend DocTags with specialized key, value, region, and link tags, enabling many-to-many relationships in a unified output sequence. To address data limitations, we design an augmentation pipeline combining synthetic form filling and graph-based crops that preserve complete key-value subgraphs. We further introduce a layout-aware evaluation framework extending text matching with spatial bounding box verification. On FUNSD, XFUND, and a large-scale private dataset, our model outperforms larger zero-shot VLM baselines under layout-aware evaluation, while being 27 times smaller than Qwen2.5-VL (7B) and over 5 times faster at inference. The model weights will be released publicly after publication.

papers.title: Coverage-Driven Verification for Safety-by-Design in AI-Based Collision Avoidance Systems
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) offers significant potential for future aviation systems; however, its integration into safety-critical applications requires compliance with the aviation sector's stringent safety standards. For AI and Machine Learning (ML)-based systems, the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) emphasizes the need to demonstrate the representativeness and completeness of the Operational Design Domain (ODD) and the associated data distributions used during development and verification. Despite this requirement, a structured engineering process for defining target distributions and evaluating representativeness within ODDs remains largely unexplored. This work presents a method for representativeness assessment of AI/ML constituent ODDs in the context of aviation safety assurance. Starting from the methodical identification of suitable target distributions, a process flow is proposed that guides developers from ODD definition and parameter distribution modeling to the quantitative assessment and interpretation of coverage results with respect to EASA's learning assurance objectives. As quantitative measures, the chi-squared goodness-of-fit test is examined and found unsuitable for the large data sets arising in this setting, leading to the adoption of the Kullback--Leibler divergence and Cramér's $V$ for the representativeness assessment. The method is demonstrated using the example of AI-based airborne collision avoidance, employing experimental data from previous Horizontal Collision Avoidance System (HCAS) and Vertical Collision Avoidance System (VCAS) simulations. The results illustrate how statistical distribution comparison methods can support the assessment of representativeness for safety-critical AI applications and contribute toward a systematic Safety-by-Design AI engineering process aligned with emerging EASA guidance.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向航空安全认证中的 AI/ML 组件，提出一种对运行设计域 (Operational Design Domain, ODD) 代表性 (representativeness) 进行定量评估的方法，以回应 EASA 对 ODD 数据分布完整性的学习保证要求。方法从目标分布识别出发，形成从 ODD 定义、参数分布建模到覆盖率定量评估与解读的流程；在检验卡方拟合优度检验后发现其不适合大数据集，转而采用 KL 散度和 Cramér's V。作者用机载防撞系统的 HCAS/VCAS 仿真数据进行了演示，说明统计分布比较方法可支持安全关键 AI 应用的代表性评估。
Motivation: EASA 要求 AI/ML 系统证明开发和验证所用 ODD 及其数据分布具有代表性和完整性，但目前缺少一套结构化的工程流程来定义目标分布并评估 ODD 内的代表性。
Method: 提出从目标分布识别开始的流程，引导开发者依次完成 ODD 定义、参数分布建模以及对覆盖率结果的定量评估；比较了卡方拟合优度检验、KL 散度和 Cramér's V 等统计量并选择后两者。
Result: 卡方拟合优度检验被判定不适用于本场景下的大规模数据集，因此采用 KL 散度与 Cramér's V；基于此前 HCAS 和 VCAS 仿真实验数据的案例展示了这些统计分布比较方法在代表性评估中的作用。
Conclusion: 该方法能够支持安全关键 AI 应用的代表性评估，并有助于形成与 EASA 新兴指南一致的、系统的 Safety-by-Design AI 工程流程。

papers.title: Sharing the Control Authority Between Deep Reinforcement Learning and Model Predictive Control: Application to Multi-Class Transportation Networks
papers.abstract_en: Transportation networks, in particular multi-class transportation networks (i.e., networks with mixed vehicle types), are complex systems that are challenging to control. Recently, Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), which learns control policies from interactions with the environment, and Model Predictive Control (MPC), which uses a system model to optimize control inputs, have been increasingly utilized for transportation network control. However, nonlinear system dynamics and high-dimensional state spaces in large-scale networks limit DRL's learning capacity under time-constrained training and increase MPC's computation time, hindering real-time implementation with limited computational resources. Moreover, MPC depends on an accurate network model, which is often unavailable for complex systems such as multi-class transportation networks. This paper proposes a novel DRL-MPC framework for multi-class transportation networks that divides control authority between DRL and MPC, combining DRL's fast online computation and model independence with MPC's built-in optimization and constraint-handling capabilities. In the hierarchical framework, MPC operates at the higher level and determines low-frequency control inputs whose slower update rate accommodates its high computation time, while DRL operates at the lower level and determines high-frequency control inputs using its fast online deployment. The framework is evaluated on a multi-class freeway network against a hierarchical MPC controller and a hybrid state-feedback-MPC controller, including scenarios with model mismatch and noisy traffic demands. Results show that the proposed framework outperforms the hybrid state-feedback-MPC controller, substantially reduces online computation time compared with the hierarchical MPC controller, and provides more effective constraint enforcement under model mismatch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于多类交通网络（multi-class transportation networks）的分层 DRL-MPC 控制框架，将控制权在深度强化学习（DRL）与模型预测控制（MPC）之间分配：MPC 在上层以较低频率产生控制输入，DRL 在下层以较高频率在线决策。框架在多类高速公路上与分层 MPC 和混合状态反馈-MPC 控制器对比，并包含模型失配和噪声交通需求场景。结果表明该框架优于混合状态反馈-MPC，相对分层 MPC 大幅降低在线计算时间，并在模型失配下更有效地施加约束。
Motivation: 大规模多类交通网络具有非线性系统动力学和高维状态空间，DRL 在训练时间受限时学习能力受限，MPC 则计算量大且依赖精确网络模型；而精确模型对多类交通网络这类复杂系统常常不可得，限制了实时控制实现。
Method: 提出分层 DRL-MPC 框架：MPC 位于上层，决定低频控制输入，以匹配其较高的计算时间；DRL 位于下层，决定高频控制输入，以利用其快速在线部署能力。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在多类高速公路上优于混合状态反馈-MPC 控制器，与分层 MPC 控制器相比大幅减少在线计算时间，并在模型失配下提供更有效的约束执行。
Conclusion: 作者认为按控制频率共享 DRL 与 MPC 的控制权，可以在保留 MPC 的优化与约束处理能力的同时利用 DRL 的快速在线计算和模型无关性，适用于多类交通网络控制。

papers.title: MGAL: A Multilingual Granularity-Aware Long-Context Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Evaluation of long-context Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced rapidly. However, most existing benchmarks are limited to the document level and focus mainly on high-resource languages, leaving many fine-grained challenges insufficiently evaluated. To address this gap, we present MGAL, the first multilingual, granularity- and position-aware long-context benchmark. MGAL is constructed from United Nations (UN) reports spanning 8K to 128K tokens across the six official UN languages. It covers four coherent levels of linguistic granularity (word, sentence, paragraph, and document) and further stratifies entries by their position within the document (begin, middle, and end), indexed at both the document and paragraph levels. This design enables systematic diagnosis of multilingual long-context comprehension across different granularities. Through extensive experiments and analyses, we find that: (1) LLMs perform well at word-level tasks but struggle with coarser-grained ones; and (2) Closed-source models retain a clear performance advantage in lower-resource languages. We further identify two new challenges: (1) Under local semantic crowding, where neighboring sentences share topics and entities, models tend to follow surface cues (e.g., connectives like ``however'' or repeated entities) rather than the discourse role of the sentence in surrounding context (e.g., background, outcome); and (2) A gap between fluency and consistency in generated outputs, where models produce text that reads smoothly but drifts from the source facts. In addition, we observe several patterns in line with prior studies, including reliance on nearby evidence and reuse of options under uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MGAL，一个多语言、粒度感知和位置感知的长上下文基准，基于联合国报告构建，覆盖六种官方语言，长度从 8K 到 128K tokens，包含词、句、段、文档四个语言粒度层级，并按文档内位置（开头、中间、结尾）分层，在文档和段落级别进行索引。实验发现 LLM 在词级任务上表现良好，但在更粗粒度任务上表现挣扎；闭源模型在低资源语言中保持明显性能优势。作者还识别出两个新挑战：在局部语义拥挤（相邻句子共享主题和实体）时模型倾向于依赖表面线索（如连接词或重复实体）而非句子的话语角色，以及生成输出中流畅性与一致性之间存在差距。
Motivation: 现有长上下文 LLM 评估基准大多局限于文档级别，且主要关注高资源语言，导致许多细粒度挑战未被充分评估，缺少对多语言和不同语言粒度的系统性诊断。
Method: 构建 MGAL 基准，使用联合国报告作为语料，覆盖六种官方语言和 8K 至 128K tokens 的长度范围；设计四个语言粒度层级（词、句、段、文档），并按文档内位置（begin、middle、end）分层，同时在文档和段落级别建立索引，以支持多语言长上下文理解的多粒度诊断。
Result: 实验发现：LLM 在词级任务上表现良好但在更粗粒度任务上表现较差；闭源模型在低资源语言中保持明显性能优势。此外识别出两个新挑战：局部语义拥挤下模型依赖表面线索而非话语角色，以及生成输出存在流畅性与一致性之间的差距；还观察到与以往研究一致的模式，如依赖邻近证据和不确定性下复用选项。
Conclusion: MGAL 可作为系统诊断多语言长上下文理解能力的基准，覆盖不同粒度和文档位置；摘要强调词级与粗粒度任务间的表现差距、低资源语言上的模型差距，以及新发现的语义拥挤和流畅性-一致性缺口。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BC-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Engineering in a Domain-Specific Language for ERP
papers.abstract_en: Agentic engineering systems have shown strong performance on general-purpose benchmarks, yet their effectiveness in enterprise resource planning (ERP) domain-specific languages (DSLs) remains underexplored. We introduce BC-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate agentic engineering on real-world tasks in AL, the DSL for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. BC-Bench comprises 101 manually curated tasks extracted from two Microsoft-owned production repositories, reflecting authentic ERP development workflows. Adapting the SWE-Bench methodology, we address the unique constraints of the AL ecosystem---including limited public resources and complex environment provisioning. Beyond generating functional code, BC-Bench evaluates test generation and supports multimodal problem statements where visual context is commonly present. We evaluate multiple frontier models across two agent harnesses, utilizing multi-run metrics to account for nondeterminism. In the Bug Fixing category, under our evaluated settings, between-model differences in resolution rate are larger than differences between the two evaluated agent harnesses, and improvements reported on general-purpose benchmarks do not consistently transfer to AL. These results highlight the need for domain-specific evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BC-Bench，一个面向微软 Dynamics 365 Business Central 中 ERP 领域特定语言 AL 的智能体工程评测基准。基准包含从两个微软生产仓库提取的 101 个手工整理任务，借鉴 SWE-Bench 方法并针对 AL 生态的公共资源有限和环境配置复杂问题做了适配。评测覆盖代码生成、测试生成以及含视觉上下文的多模态问题描述，并采用多运行指标处理不确定性问题。结果显示在 Bug Fixing 类别中，模型间的解决率差异大于两个智能体 harness 之间的差异，且通用基准上的提升并不能一致迁移到 AL。
Motivation: 智能体工程系统在通用基准上表现强劲，但在企业资源规划（ERP）领域特定语言上的有效性尚未充分探索；同时 AL 生态缺乏公开资源且环境装配复杂，需要专门评测。
Method: 构建 BC-Bench 基准，包含从两个微软生产代码仓库提取的 101 个真实任务，改编 SWE-Bench 方法以适应 AL 生态约束，并额外评测测试生成与多模态问题描述。评测使用两个智能体 harness 和多个前沿模型，通过多运行指标来应对随机性。
Result: 在 Bug Fixing 类别中，不同模型间的解决率差异大于两个被测智能体 harness 之间的差异，且通用基准上报告的改进并不能一致地迁移到 AL 领域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要针对特定领域进行评测，不能依赖通用基准的表现推断 ERP DSL 场景下的智能体工程效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RAG Deserves an Index: Why Ingest-Time Compilation Beats Query-Time Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Nearly every retrieval-augmented question-answering system in production ships with a hidden interpreter: on each query a language model re-derives the meaning of raw corpus text and then throws that work away. Cheaper models do not close the gap: per-token prices have fallen by orders of magnitude while inference spend has risen, because context volume grows faster than prices fall. This is the modern equivalent of the full-table scan, and the remedy is the one databases found fifty years ago: do the expensive work once, at write time, into a maintained structure that makes reads cheap. A corpus whose read pattern is known before it ever meets a user can and should be indexed too. We call the paradigm ingest-time semantic compilation (ISC): compile a corpus's meaning into a queryable substrate with two coupled layers - incrementally maintained embeddings, and atomic claims whose provenance is validated at compile time - and treat that substrate as a first-class database object with its own DDL, maintenance contract, migration contract, and cost model. Two existence proofs support it. Substrate upkeep scales with change rather than corpus size: incremental updates run 33.7x cheaper than reconstruction while tracking it to floating-point precision. And on a held-out sample of 500 broadcast-interview transcripts, compiled claims as the retrieval payload win all 32 budget-by-model cells: 85.2% correct from roughly 2.2k reader tokens against 72.5% from 16.3k for the best chunk configuration anywhere. The only baseline that keeps pace is a contextualized-chunk pipeline with hybrid retrieval and reranking, statistically indistinguishable from compiled claims at roughly twenty-one times the query-path tokens - and it reaches that parity, we argue, precisely because it has itself begun to compile. We close with the systems agenda this opens, from compilation planners to read planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），提出检索增强问答系统应借鉴数据库的索引思想，在写入时一次性编译语料语义，而不是在每次查询时由语言模型重新解释原始文本。作者将该范式命名为 ingest-time semantic compilation (ISC)，并给出两个存在性证明：增量式嵌入维护比全量重建便宜 33.7 倍且精度一致；在 500 条广播访谈记录样本上，编译后的 claim 作为检索载荷在全部 32 个预算-模型组合中胜出，达到 85.2% 正确率，而最佳分块配置为 72.5%。
Motivation: 生产环境中的检索增强问答系统每次查询都让语言模型重新推导原始语料的含义并丢弃结果，导致推理成本随上下文体积增长而失控；作者认为这等同于数据库时代的全表扫描，需要像数据库五十年前那样在写时做昂贵工作以降低读成本。
Method: 提出 ingest-time semantic compilation (ISC)：将语料含义编译成可查询的底层结构，包含两层耦合组件——增量维护的嵌入（embeddings）以及编译时验证来源的原子式 claim；该底层结构被当作具有 DDL、维护契约、迁移契约和成本模型的一等数据库对象对待。
Result: 增量更新比全量重建便宜 33.7 倍且能精确追踪结果；在 500 条广播访谈转录样本上，编译后的 claim 在 32 个预算-模型组合中全部胜出（85.2% 正确率、约 2.2k reader token），最佳分块配置为 72.5% 正确率、16.3k token；唯一接近的基线是结合混合检索与重排序的上下文分块管线，但需要约 21 倍查询路径 token。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果说明索引应被纳入 RAG 系统的核心议程，并由此提出从编译规划器（compilation planners）到读取规划（read planning）的系统研究方向；论文作为立场文件强调范式转变而非完整系统实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: Agentic Catalog Enrichment with Multi-source Evidence Grounding
papers.abstract_en: Product catalogs underpin search, discovery, and recommendation in e-commerce, yet they are often attribute-sparse: the attributes shoppers and downstream systems rely on are either buried in unstructured content such as titles and images or missing from the catalog altogether. Manually enriching e-commerce catalogs is impractical given their scale and rapid growth. This paper introduces TRACE, a novel framework for automated catalog attribute enrichment using agentic Large Language Models (LLMs). A ScoutAgent triangulates multimodal evidence across merchant catalogs, syndicated feeds, and identity-matched web search to propose candidate attribute values with supporting evidence, while a JudgeAgent verifies the proposed value for each attribute value against its supporting evidence and decides whether to publish it or route it to human review. On an offline human evaluation dataset, TRACE's proposed attribute values were 98.2% accurate at 74.7% attribute coverage. Deployed in production on an industry-scale catalog, TRACE increased impression-weighted enrichment coverage across four business verticals by 90.4%. An online experiment subsequently showed that surfacing the enriched attributes on the product detail page increased checkout conversion by 0.48%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一个基于智能体大语言模型（agentic LLMs）的电商目录属性自动补全框架。ScoutAgent 跨商家目录、整合信息源与身份匹配的网页搜索，对多模态证据进行三角验证并提出候选属性值；JudgeAgent 根据证据核验每个值并决定直接发布或转人工审核。离线评估中候选属性值准确率为 98.2%，覆盖率为 74.7%；生产部署使四个业务垂直领域的曝光加权补全覆盖提升 90.4%；在线实验显示在产品详情页展示补全属性使结账转化率提升 0.48%。
Motivation: 电商目录搜索、发现和推荐依赖属性，但目录常缺乏属性：属性要么埋藏在标题、图像等非结构化内容中，要么完全缺失；人工补全在海量且快速增长的目录规模下不现实。
Method: 提出 TRACE 框架，包含两个智能体组件：ScoutAgent 负责跨多个证据源（商家目录、整合信息源、身份匹配的网页搜索）检索并三角验证候选属性值；JudgeAgent 逐属性核验候选值与支持证据，决定发布或转人工审查。
Result: 离线人工评估数据集上，TRACE 提出的属性值准确率为 98.2%，属性覆盖率为 74.7%；在工业规模目录生产部署中，四个业务垂直领域的曝光加权补全覆盖提升 90.4%；在线实验表明在产品详情页展示补全属性使结账转化率提升 0.48%。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于多源证据的智能体 LLM 流程可以用于自动化构建电商目录的丰富属性，并通过 JudgeAgent 的发布/转人工决策机制保证质量；该结论限于目录补全这一具体领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Foundation Models for Partial Causal Identification
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the development of causal foundation models for bounding the effect of interventions and counterfactuals from observational data. We show that a canonical prior can be defined with full support over the space of structural causal models with discrete observables. With this canonical prior, we translate the problem of bounding counterfactuals into that of learning distributions over functions that map data (and possibly structural assumptions) to a causal query of interest. This extends the promising causal foundational modelling paradigm to the estimation of partially-identifiable causal effects, i.e., under unobserved confounding, where multiple values are equally compatible with the observed data and prior structural assumptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于从观测数据界定干预效应和反事实效应上界/下界的因果基础模型（causal foundation models）。作者证明可以在离散可观测变量的结构因果模型（SCM）空间上定义一个具有完全支持的规范先验（canonical prior），从而将反事实界定的问题转化为学习从数据（及可能的结构假设）到目标因果查询的函数分布。该工作将因果基础建模范式扩展到部分可识别（partially identifiable）因果效应的估计，即在存在未观测混杂时多个取值都与观测数据和先验结构假设相容的情形。
Motivation: 现有因果基础模型范式主要面向点识别（point identification）的因果效应估计，而真实观测数据常存在未观测混杂，导致因果效应只能被界定为区间而非唯一值。本文试图把这一范式推广到部分可识别场景，使得基础模型也能估计反事实的边界。
Method: 提出在离散可观测变量的结构因果模型空间上定义一个具有完全支持的规范先验；借助该先验，把反事实效应界定问题转化为学习一个分布，该分布将数据（连同可选的结构假设）映射到感兴趣的因果查询上。该表述不要求点识别，可直接处理多个候选值均与观测数据相容的情形。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验数值或基准结果，主要贡献是理论上证明了可将因果基础建模范式用于部分可识别因果效应的边界估计，即把界定反事实转化为在函数空间上学习分布的问题。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架将因果基础模型的应用范围从点识别扩展到部分可识别场景，为存在未观测混杂时的干预与反事实效应界定提供了一种基础模型式的求解路径。摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: KoViDoRe: Korean Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in multimodal retrieval have improved the ability to retrieve information from visually rich documents such as PDFs and reports. However, existing benchmarks remain largely centered on English and provide limited coverage of Korean visual documents with complex structures. Furthermore, most existing Korean resources primarily evaluate single-page retrieval, failing to capture realistic scenarios that require evidence aggregation across multiple pages. To address these gaps, we introduce KoViDoRe, a benchmark for Korean visual document retrieval. The dataset is constructed from publicly available Korean documents with diverse layouts, including tables, figures, and multi-column structures. We develop a multi-stage data curation pipeline consisting of structured document parsing, synthetic query generation using both summary-based and context-based strategies, and relevance mapping with human verification. Using KoViDoRe, we evaluate a wide range of multimodal retrieval models and observe that current models struggle to effectively handle Korean visual document retrieval, particularly in settings involving structured content and diverse query types. Motivated by this finding, we further curate a large-scale training dataset, Ko-VDR Train Public, to support the development of retrieval models tailored to Korean visual documents. Together, KoViDoRe and Ko-VDR Train Public provide a unified benchmark and training resource for Korean visual document retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出韩语视觉文档检索基准 KoViDoRe，并从公开韩语文档构建包含表格、图形、多栏等多样版式的数据集。作者开发了多阶段数据整理流程，包括结构化文档解析、基于摘要与基于上下文的合成查询生成，以及人工验证的相关性映射。基于该基准评估多种多模态检索模型，发现现有模型在韩语视觉文档检索上表现不佳，尤其是在结构化内容和多样查询类型场景下。作者还发布了大规模训练集 Ko-VDR Train Public，作为统一的基准与训练资源。
Motivation: 现有跨模态检索基准以英文为主，韩语视觉文档资源有限，且大多只评估单页检索，无法覆盖需要跨页证据聚合的真实场景。
Method: 采用多阶段数据整理流水线：结构化文档解析、结合摘要式与上下文式策略的合成查询生成、人工验证的相关性映射；并进一步构建大规模训练数据集 Ko-VDR Train Public。

papers.title: SAC-Copula: Quality-Preserving Watermarking for Diffusion Language Models via Smooth Correlated Gumbel Fields
papers.abstract_en: Watermarking diffusion language models (DLMs) requires mechanisms compatible with iterative parallel unmasking rather than autoregressive decoding. Existing sampling-based watermarking methods typically inject position-wise i.i.d. perturbations, which can be poorly aligned with DLM decoding dynamics and degrade generation quality. We propose SAC-Copula, a quality-preserving watermarking method for DLMs based on smooth, locally correlated Gumbel perturbation fields constructed via a Gaussian copula. We further develop a SAC-aware detector using covariance-aware filtering and native-sample calibration. Mechanism-level analysis shows that local correlation reduces latent perturbation roughness and better matches iterative refinement dynamics. Experiments on LLaDA show that SAC-Copula achieves a favorable quality-detectability trade-off compared with existing baselines. In particular, further evaluations on Dream-7B and additional datasets show that SAC-Copula substantially improves PPL tail stability over the i.i.d. Gumbel baseline, while maintaining strong low-FPR detectability and competitive overall generation quality. Additional token-edit stress tests further assess watermark robustness under controlled synchronization drift.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 24 pages, 13 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAC-Copula，一种面向扩散语言模型 (DLM) 的保质量水印方法。该方法通过高斯 copula 构造平滑且局部相关的 Gumbel 扰动场，并配套设计了 SAC-aware 检测器（协方差感知滤波与原生样本校准）。机制分析表明局部相关性降低潜在扰动的粗糙度并更好地匹配迭代并行 unmasking 的解码动态；在 LLaDA、Dream-7B 及额外数据集上的实验显示其相比 i.i.d. Gumbel 基线在质量与可检测性之间取得更优权衡。
Motivation: 现有基于采样的水印方法通常注入逐位置的 i.i.d. 扰动，这与 DLM 的迭代并行 un-masking 解码动态对齐不佳，容易损害生成质量。
Method: 提出 SAC-Copula，即通过 Gaussian copula 构造平滑、局部相关的 Gumbel 扰动场；同时提出 SAC-aware 检测器，采用协方差感知过滤 (covariance-aware filtering) 和原生样本校准 (native-sample calibration) 进行水印检测。
Result: 在 LLaDA 上实现优于现有基线的质量-可检测性权衡；在 Dream-7B 和额外数据集上，相比 i.i.d. Gumbel 基线显著改善 PPL 尾部稳定性，同时保持较强的低 FPR 可检测性和有竞争力的整体生成质量；额外的 token 编辑压力测试用于评估同步漂移下的水印鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调局部相关性能够降低潜在扰动的粗糙度并更好匹配迭代精化动态，从而在保障检测能力的同时维持生成质量。

papers.title: Advantage-level Aggregation Reinforcement Learning for X-point Target Magnetic Configuration Control in an EXL-50U Experiment-Calibrated Simulation Environment
papers.abstract_en: Managing divertor heat loads is a central challenge for compact, high-power tokamaks. To increase local flux expansion and decouple the dissipation volume from the core, EHL-2 adopts the X-point target (XPT) divertor. This requires the secondary X-point to remain on the divertor leg; displacement degrades the topology and exhaust geometry. Current experiments, including EXL-50U discharges, rely on precomputed feedforward waveforms with PID loops on global quantities. Lacking dedicated closed-loop feedback for the secondary null, XPT operation is repeatable but not routine. We formulate XPT feedback as a multi-objective reinforcement learning (RL) control problem in a free-boundary environment calibrated to EXL-50U discharge #13906. To address strong coupling among plasma current, shape, and null constraints - where reward scalarisation collapses objective-specific temporal credit - we develop Advantage Aggregation (AdvA). AdvA preserves objective-wise temporal credit before worst-objective-aware nonlinear scalarisation and introduces a residual correction to policy updates. AdvA-PPO is evaluated against Reward-PPO and a feedforward-plus-PID baseline under nominal operation, measurement uncertainties, and unseen initial equilibria. On a 500 ms rollout, AdvA-PPO raises the mean worst-channel score from 0.23 to 0.81 over Reward-PPO, reducing X-point flux RMSE by ~20x. Under combined measurement uncertainties, it is the only learned controller completing the horizon while retaining a usable XPT shape. Multi-initialization fine-tuning enables a single AdvA-PPO policy to complete full-horizon operation across divertor and limiter initial equilibria. These results provide a simulation-based foundation for future real-time XPT validation on EXL-50U.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对紧凑高功率托卡马克中 X-point target (XPT) 偏滤器的二次 X 点缺乏专用闭环反馈问题，将 XPT 控制建模为基于 EXL-50U 放电 #13906 校准的自由边界仿真环境中的多目标强化学习问题，并提出 Advantage Aggregation (AdvA)。AdvA 在非线性标量化前保留各目标的时间信用，并对策略更新加入残差修正。摘要报告 AdvA-PPO 在 500 ms rollout 上将平均最差通道得分从 0.23 提升到 0.81，X 点通量 RMSE 降低约 20 倍。
Motivation: EHL-2 采用 XPT 偏滤器来管理偏滤器热负荷，要求二次 X 点保持在偏滤器支路上；现有 EXL-50U 等实验依赖预计算前馈波形与全局量 PID 回路，缺少针对次级零点的专用闭环反馈，使 XPT 运行可重复但非常规。
Method: 将 XPT 反馈控制表述为自由边界环境中的多目标 RL 控制问题，环境用 EXL-50U 放电 #13906 校准；提出 Advantage Aggregation (AdvA)，在各目标标量化前保留目标独立的时间信用，再面向最差目标进行非线性标量化，并在策略更新中引入残差修正，与 PPO 结合为 AdvA-PPO。
Result: 摘要报告在 500 ms rollout 评估中，AdvA-PPO 的平均最差通道得分相对 Reward-PPO 从 0.23 提升至 0.81，X 点通量 RMSE 降低约 20 倍；在组合测量不确定性下，AdvA-PPO 是唯一能完成全程并保持可用 XPT 形状的学习控制器；多初始化微调使单一策略在偏滤器与限制器初始平衡下都能完成全时段运行。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果为未来在 EXL-50U 上进行实时 XPT 验证提供了基于仿真的基础；目前结果来自仿真环境，尚未涉及硬件实时实验。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: STAR-OPD: Structured Aspect-Cascade-Aware On-Policy Reward Distillation for ABSA Quadruple Extraction
papers.abstract_en: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) quadruple extraction requires jointly predicting target, aspect, opinion, and sentiment over reviews that often contain multiple fine-grained sentiment tuples. While large chain-of-thought (CoT) models perform well on this task, distilling them into smaller deployable models remains difficult. We identify a task-specific failure mode in distilled ABSA extraction: student errors at the target-aspect interface create structurally invalid states, such as broken target-aspect bindings and hallucinated targets, which then corrupt downstream predictions. Conventional off-policy distillation is poorly suited to this setting because it trains only on teacher-generated trajectories and provides little supervision on the student-induced structural states that dominate inference. To address this mismatch, we propose STAR-OPD (STructured Aspect-cascade-aware On-Policy Reward Distillation), which builds on generic on-policy distillation and instantiates it for ABSA quadruple extraction with cascade-aware, set-structured rewards. STAR-OPD trains on student rollouts and applies set-structured rewards that directly target binding consistency, target grounding, and fine-grained aspect disambiguation. Experiments on E-ABSA20K and SemEval-2014 show that STAR-OPD consistently outperforms off-policy and general on-policy baselines, reduces target hallucination, and substantially improves performance on structurally hard cases. With Qwen3-4B, STAR-OPD substantially narrows the student-teacher gap while improving inference efficiency, highlighting the importance of on-policy structural correction for distilled ABSA extraction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 ABSA 四元组抽取中蒸馏大模型到小模型时的结构失效问题，提出 STAR-OPD（结构化方面级联感知的在线策略奖励蒸馏）。该方法基于通用在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation），为 ABSA 四元组抽取实例化了级联感知的集合结构奖励，直接约束目标-方面绑定一致性、目标接地和细粒度方面消歧。实验在 E-ABSA20K 和 SemEval-2014 上显示其持续优于离线策略和通用在线策略基线，减少目标幻觉并显著改善结构困难样本。
Motivation: ABSA 四元组抽取需要同时预测目标、方面、意见和情感，蒸馏后的学生模型在目标-方面接口处产生结构无效状态（如断裂的绑定和幻觉目标），这些错误会污染下游预测；而常规离线策略蒸馏只基于教师轨迹训练，难以监督学生推理时占主导的结构性错误状态。
Method: 提出 STAR-OPD，在通用在线策略蒸馏基础上，针对 ABSA 四元组抽取设计级联感知、集合结构的奖励（set-structured rewards），直接针对绑定一致性、目标接地和细粒度方面消歧，并基于学生自身的 rollout 进行训练。
Result: 在 E-ABSA20K 和 SemEval-2014 上，STAR-OPD 一致优于离线策略与通用在线策略基线，减少目标幻觉，并在结构困难样本上显著提升性能；使用 Qwen3-4B 时大幅缩小师生差距并提高推理效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对蒸馏后的 ABSA 抽取，在线策略的结构性修正（尤其是集合结构奖励）比离线策略更有效，是缩小师生差距并提升推理效率的关键。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fine-tuning LLMs for Tourist Trajectory Prediction using Field Experiment Data
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating mobility interventions at tourist destinations requires predicting visitor behavior under varying conditions. Traditional methods struggle because tourist decisions depend heavily on context like weather and fatigue, yet models cannot generalize to unobserved scenarios. Large Language Models offer a solution by encoding commonsense knowledge about human behavior from pretraining, enabling reasoning about context-dependent decisions, while natural language representation flexibly integrates heterogeneous information. Fine-tuning on local trajectories adapts this general understanding to destination-specific patterns. We validate this approach using 566 trajectories from Wakayama Castle Park, Japan. Our fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B achieves 49.1% next POI accuracy and maintains strong performance on undersampled scenarios like rainy days, demonstrating effective generalization. This establishes LLMs as high-fidelity behavior models for context-dependent tourist prediction, providing groundwork for counterfactual analysis of mobility interventions.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI for Urban Planning (AI4UP) at AAAI-26, Singapore, January 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型 (LLM) 进行游客轨迹预测，借助预训练中包含的人类行为常识来处理天气、疲劳等上下文相关决策，并用实地实验数据微调以适应目的地特有模式。研究使用日本和歌山城公园的566条轨迹验证，微调后的Llama-3.1-8B达到49.1%的下一POI准确率，并在雨天等欠采样场景保持较强性能。
Motivation: 传统轨迹预测方法难以泛化到未观测场景，因为游客决策高度依赖天气、疲劳等上下文因素，而现有模型无法对这些因素变化进行推理。作者认为LLM从预训练中编码了人类行为常识，能对上下文相关决策进行推理，从而弥补这一缺口。
Method: 采用自然语言表示来灵活整合异构信息，并通过在目标地点的局部轨迹上微调LLM，将通用理解转化为目的地特定的行为模式，用于预测游客的下一兴趣点 (POI)。
Result: 在Wakayama Castle Park的566条轨迹上，微调后的Llama-3.1-8B实现49.1%的下一POI准确率，并在雨天等训练样本不足的场景下仍保持较强性能，显示出有效泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要将LLM定位为面向上下文相关游客预测的高保真行为模型，工作为评估旅游地出行干预的反事实分析奠定基础；需注意该研究关注行为预测而非天气或降水本身的预报。

summary_sections.result: 在Wakayama Castle Park的566条轨迹上，微调后的Llama-3.1-8B实现49.1%的下一POI准确率，并在雨天等训练样本不足的场景下仍保持较强性能，显示出有效泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将LLM定位为面向上下文相关游客预测的高保真行为模型，工作为评估旅游地出行干预的反事实分析奠定基础；需注意该研究关注行为预测而非天气或降水本身的预报。

papers.title: Prediction certification cannot replace explanation certification: a competence envelope for trustworthy AI under compound stress
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly make consequential judgments - which patient is deteriorating, which building is safe to enter, whether an image is authentic and are trusted on the strength of how accurately and confidently they predict. The safeguards that certify them are correspondingly prediction-based: accuracy, calibration and conformal coverage all measure how well a model performs. Whether such checks are sufficient to establish model trustworthiness has remained unclear. Here we prove that they cannot. We establish a separation theorem showing that a reliable model and a compromised one can be identical under every prediction-side certificate, including accuracy, calibration and coverage, yet differ arbitrarily in explanation fidelity and deployment behaviour. Detecting this failure requires access to the model's decision mechanism in addition to its predictions. We introduce the competence envelope as an operational framework that combines prediction and explanation certification into a single deployable criterion. Across diverse datasets and model classes, the proposed framework reveals failure modes that prediction-side certification alone does not capture. Certification against failures that are invisible in prediction behaviour therefore requires evidence about the model's decision mechanism as well as its outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明仅基于预测侧（prediction-side）的认证指标（准确率、校准、conformal coverage）不足以确立AI系统的可信度。作者提出分离定理（separation theorem），说明一个可靠模型与一个被破坏的模型可以在所有预测侧证书上完全一致，却在解释保真度和部署行为上任意不同。为弥补这一缺口，文章提出“competence envelope”作为结合预测与解释认证的可部署框架，并在多种数据集与模型类别上展示其能揭示预测侧认证无法捕获的失效模式。
Motivation: 现有AI信任保障机制主要依赖预测侧指标，如准确率、校准与覆盖率，但这类检查是否足以确证模型可信度一直不明确。作者针对这一不确定性，试图从理论上回答预测侧证书是否足以保证可信。
Method: 通过证明分离定理说明预测侧证书相同的模型在解释保真度与部署行为上可任意不同；并引入competence envelope框架，将预测认证与解释认证合并为单一可部署判据，要求同时获取模型决策机制的证据。
Result: 在多样数据集和模型类别上，该框架能揭示预测侧认证单独无法捕获的失效模式；理论结果支持检测此类不可见于预测行为的失败需要访问模型决策机制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，针对预测行为不可见的失效，认证必须同时依赖模型输出与决策机制证据，仅靠预测侧认证在逻辑上不足以保证可信。

papers.title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability across $k$ adversarial turns. MTCR comprises: (i) compositional certification via embedding-space mode decomposition, yielding tighter certified lower bounds than naive multiplication; (ii) $(α,β)$-safety persistence, improving the degradation rate from $\underline{p}^{k}$ to $β^k$ (with $β> \underline{p}$) and yielding interpretable horizon estimates; (iii) matching information-theoretic upper bounds establishing tightness; and (iv) a unified algorithm combining these results. Experiments on six LLMs under $ε$-bounded and Crescendo-style attacks confirm that empirical safety consistently exceeds the certified bounds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在多轮对话中的越狱攻击（multi-turn jailbreak attacks）提出多轮认证鲁棒性框架 MTCR。作者用 State-Adversarial MDP 建模对话安全，定义 k 轮认证鲁棒性为最坏情况下的安全概率，并提出基于嵌入空间模式分解的组合认证、安全持续性 (α,β)-safety persistence、信息论上界以及统一算法。实验在六个 LLM 上验证经验安全概率始终高于认证下界。
Motivation: 现有认证鲁棒性方法仅支持单轮输入，朴素的多轮组合会使认证界限随轮数指数级退化，无法为多轮对话安全提供可用的认证保证。
Method: 提出 MTCR 框架：将对话安全建模为 State-Adversarial MDP；用嵌入空间模式分解做组合认证以得到比朴素相乘更紧的下界；引入 (α,β)-safety persistence 将退化率从 p^k 改进为 β^k（β>p）并提供可解释的时域估计；同时给出匹配的信息论上界以证明紧致性。
Result: 在六个 LLM 上，针对 ε-有界和 Crescendo 风格攻击的实验表明，经验安全概率一致高于认证下界。
Conclusion: 摘要强调组合界限与安全持续性相结合可以为多轮 LLM 安全提供可验证的鲁棒性保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scaling Muon for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The matrix-aware optimizer Muon improves large model training by balancing updates across singular directions, yet its scaling behavior and end-to-end efficiency on large Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remain unclear. We first establish Muon's scaling behavior on DiTs from 1.3B to 15B parameters, showing that its optimization and generative quality advantages over AdamW persist across model scales. However, at scale, the 5-step Newton--Schulz iteration (NS5) performed at every optimization step, together with full-momentum materialization, introduces substantial computation and communication overhead that can offset Muon's step-efficiency advantage. We introduce \emph{Periodic Row-wise Muon}, which performs a full NS5 spectral update once every \(K\) steps and applies a low compute and communication cost row-wise constrained update based on the current momentum at the remaining steps. We further co-design a distributed implementation that operates directly on sharded momentum during non-refresh steps and accelerates spectral refreshes through bucketed all-gather and communication--computation overlap. Across all scales, Muon improves the best observed generative quality over AdamW by 12.9--19.1\%. Compared with vanilla Muon, Periodic Row-wise Muon remains within 0.5\% in best generative quality on the 1.3B--4B models and improves it by 4.5\% at 9B. It reduces optimizer time by 46.9--54.3\%, end-to-end step time by 15.7--24.3\%, and logical communication volume by 66.7\%, while reaching its respective best generative quality with 33.7--64.8\% less active training time. These results show that Periodic Row-wise Muon preserves Muon's generative quality advantage while translating it into end-to-end training efficiency for large DiTs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究矩阵感知优化器 Muon 在大型扩散 Transformer (DiT) 上的扩展行为，发现其对 AdamW 的优化与生成质量优势在 1.3B 到 15B 参数规模下持续存在，但每步的 5 次 Newton–Schulz 迭代 (NS5) 与全动量物化带来巨大计算和通信开销。作者提出 Periodic Row-wise Muon，每隔 K 步做一次完整 NS5 谱更新，其余步骤用低代价的按行约束更新，并配合面向分片动量的分布式实现。实验显示该方法在保持生成质量的同时显著降低优化器时间、端到端步时间和通信量。
Motivation: Muon 在大型模型训练中通过平衡奇异方向的更新来提升效率，但其在大型 DiT 上的扩展行为与端到端效率尚不明确；随规模增大，每步的 NS5 迭代和全动量物化带来的开销可能抵消其步效率优势。
Method: 提出 Periodic Row-wise Muon：每 K 步执行一次完整 NS5 谱更新，其余步骤基于当前动量进行低计算和低通信代价的按行约束更新；并共同设计分布式实现，在非刷新步骤直接操作分片动量，通过分桶 all-gather 与计算通信重叠加速谱刷新。
Result: 在所有规模下，Muon 相比 AdamW 将最佳生成质量提升 12.9%–19.1%；Periodic Row-wise Muon 在 1.3B–4B 模型上与原始 Muon 的最佳生成质量差距在 0.5% 以内，在 9B 规模上反而提升 4.5%。它减少优化器时间 46.9%–54.3%、端到端步时间 15.7%–24.3%、逻辑通信量 66.7%，并以少 33.7%–64.8% 的有效训练时间达到各自最佳生成质量。
Conclusion: Periodic Row-wise Muon 保留了 Muon 的生成质量优势，并将其转化为大型 DiT 的端到端训练效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhancing Localized Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Efficient Segment-to-Video Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Though Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have shown impressive potential in video understanding, long video understanding (LVU) remains challenging since distracting noise in complex and lengthy contexts can obscure localized details, misleading MLLMs to produce incorrect answers. Recent works mitigate these issues by incentivizing deep reasoning to include relevant evidence. However, these methods have two main problems: First, the reinforcement fine-tuning framework (RFT) they leveraged incurs substantial training overheads, including high annotation costs and complicated reward designs. Second, the self-reflective and iterative-perception mechanism in some methods causes lengthy outputs and high inference latency. To alleviate these problems, we propose a novel Segment-to-Video Supervision} method (S2V) to efficiently enhance fine-grained reasoning in LVU. Specifically, we generate question answer pairs (VQA) based on localized segments, and then transfer these segment-based VQA back to the whole video for training. Due to focusing on short segments, segment-based VQA can naturally notice details which tend to be overlooked from a whole-video perspective. Training on such data can enforce MLLMs to correctly associate fine-grained details with QA while avoiding distracting noise in the whole video. The S2V training involves just reinforcement learning (RL) with a simple accuracy reward based on only 10K VQA samples and the resulting S2V model predicts answer using a single forward pass with limited output tokens. Experimental results demonstrate that S2V can consistently improve LVU performance across multiple LVU benchmarks, outperforming both general MLLMs and reasoning-based methods not only in LVU accuracy but also in training and inference efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Segment-to-Video Supervision（S2V）方法，用于提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在长视频理解（LVU）中的细粒度推理能力。该方法基于局部片段生成 VQA，再将这些片段级问答迁移到整段视频上进行训练，使模型能正确关联细节与问答并规避整段视频中的干扰噪声。S2V 仅用 10K VQA 样本、采用带简单准确率奖励的强化学习（RL），推理时只需单次前向传播并限制输出 token 数。实验表明 S2V 在多个 LVU 基准上持续提升性能，并在准确率、训练效率和推理效率上均优于通用 MLLM 和基于推理的方法。
Motivation: 长视频理解中复杂而冗长的上下文会引入干扰噪声，掩盖局部细节，导致 MLLM 产生错误答案；现有通过激励深度推理来包含相关证据的方法存在两个问题：强化微调（RFT）框架带来高标注成本和复杂奖励设计，且自我反思、迭代感知机制导致输出冗长和推理延迟高。
Method: 提出 S2V 训练方法：先在局部片段上生成问答对（VQA），再将片段级 VQA 迁移回整段视频用于训练，使模型聚焦短片段从而注意到整段视角下易被忽略的细节；训练仅采用 RL 加简单准确率奖励，基于 10K VQA 样本，推理时单次前向传播并限制输出 token 数。
Result: 实验结果显示 S2V 在多个 LVU 基准上均能一致提升长视频理解性能，不仅在 LVU 准确率上优于通用 MLLM 和基于推理的方法，还在训练与推理效率上更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于局部片段的监督可以有效增强长视频中的细粒度推理，同时避免自反思等机制带来的额外推理延迟，但结论范围限于所报告的长视频理解基准与设定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Resolution-Consistent Greedy Neural Approximation on Infinite-Dimensional Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We develop constructive approximation and learning guarantees for shallow neural models with infinite-dimensional inputs observed through finitely many coordinates. The analysis is based on a parameter-normalized neural dictionary and its associated weighted variation class. Within this class, the approximation error separates into a distribution-dependent coordinate-truncation term and a greedy finite-width term. For empirical regression, a fully-corrective greedy procedure yields population guarantees whose statistical complexity is uniform in the retained input resolution. The same framework extends to Hilbert-valued responses without an explicit dependence on the output dimension. The dimension-free statements are statistical, not computational: selecting a new neuron still requires solving a nonconvex parameter-search problem. The quasi-Polish construction underlying recent infinite-dimensional universal approximation results provides a motivating example, and synthetic experiments illustrate the predicted resolution, width, and sample-size regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究输入为无限维空间、并通过有限多个坐标观测的浅层神经网络的构造性逼近与学习保证。作者提出参数归一化的神经字典（neural dictionary）及其加权变差类，将逼近误差分解为依赖数据分布的坐标截断项与贪婪有限宽度项。对经验回归，fully-corrective 贪婪过程给出统计复杂度在保留输入分辨率上一致（uniform）的总体保证，并可推广到 Hilbert 值响应。作者强调这些无维数陈述是统计意义上的而非计算意义上的，选择新神经元仍需求解非凸参数搜索问题。
Motivation: 无限维输入只能通过有限坐标观测时，缺乏同时处理坐标截断与有限宽度的构造性逼近/学习理论。作者希望得到统计复杂度不依赖于保留输入分辨率的回归保证，并避免对输出维数的显式依赖。
Method: 基于参数归一化神经字典及其加权变差类展开分析，把误差分解为坐标截断项与贪婪有限宽度项；对经验回归采用 fully-corrective 贪婪过程，并将框架扩展到 Hilbert 值响应；以 quasi-Polish 构造作为无限维泛逼近的动机性示例。
Result: 摘要给出经验回归的总体保证（population guarantees），其统计复杂度在保留输入分辨率上均匀；同一框架可扩展到 Hilbert 值响应且不显式依赖输出维数。合成实验展示了所预测的分辨率、宽度与样本量区间。
Conclusion: 作者指出这些无维数陈述是统计保证而非计算保证：每次挑选新神经元仍需解决非凸参数搜索问题，因此理论结果不消除计算瓶颈。

papers.title: When Generated Images Look Right and Retrieve Wrong: Coverage-Guided Cross-Scale Re-Indexing for Knowledge-Faithful Generative Perception
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal information systems increasingly route generated visual content back through the same vision-language index that informed its production, so the output must remain retrievable by the queries it was meant to serve. When the scene contains entities at vastly different scales, existing language-guided generators condition on a single, globally pooled text embedding and quietly drop scale-specific concepts, breaking concept-query retrieval even when pixel fidelity is high. We formalise this failure as semantic collapse and propose CERES, a closed-loop multimodal indexing framework that builds a three-level semantic pyramid, mines implicit concepts via a co-occurrence-aware router, performs scale-routed cross-attention into a lightweight U-Net generator, and verifies coverage by re-indexing the generated image with the same frozen VLM. A continuously differentiable soft-Jaccard coverage objective returns dense gradients to the 0.39M-parameter generator under explicit non-degeneracy conditions, and coverage is verified by an independent DINOv2 linear probe trained only on external scene and object labels. On four pansharpening benchmarks across seven settings, CERES delivers the new state of the art with the largest gains where scale variation is most extreme. It also improves concept-query retrieval Recall@5 by +14.0 points and image-text mean reciprocal rank by 0.19 over the strongest baseline, showing that the closed loop preserves queryable content rather than self-referential feature consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态信息系统将生成图像重新送入原视觉-语言索引时出现的检索失败问题，将其形式化为 semantic collapse，并提出封闭循环的多模态索引框架 CERES。CERES 构建三级语义金字塔、用共现感知路由器挖掘隐式概念，通过尺度路由的交叉注意力生成图像，并用冻结的 VLM 和独立训练的 DINOv2 线性探针验证概念覆盖。在四个全色锐化 (pansharpening) 基准的七种设置上取得了新的最优结果，概念查询检索 Recall@5 提升 14.0 点，图像-文本 MRR 提升 0.19。
Motivation: 当场景中包含尺度差异极大的实体时，现有语言引导生成器仅依赖单一全局池化文本嵌入，会丢失尺度特定概念，导致即使像素保真度高，概念-查询检索仍然失败。作者将这一缺陷形式化为语义崩塌，并指出需要让生成结果对原本要服务的查询保持可检索性。
Method: 提出 CERES，一个封闭循环的多模态索引框架：构建三级语义金字塔，通过共现感知路由器挖掘隐式概念，进行尺度路由的交叉注意力进入轻量 U-Net 生成器，并用同一冻结 VLM 对生成图像重新索引以验证覆盖。引入连续可微的 soft-Jaccard 覆盖目标，在显式非退化条件下为仅 0.39M 参数的生成器提供稠密梯度，覆盖验证由仅在外部场景和物体标签上训练的独立 DINOv2 线性探针完成。
Result: 在四个全色锐化基准的七种设置上取得新的最优结果，在尺度变化最剧烈的场景收益最大；相较最强基线，概念-查询检索 Recall@5 提升 +14.0 点，图像-文本平均倒数排名 (MRR) 提升 0.19，表明闭环保留的是可查询内容而非自参照的特征一致性。
Conclusion: 论文表明，闭环生成-再索引范式能有效缓解多尺度场景下的语义崩塌，使生成图像对原查询保持可检索性。摘要强调其核心价值在于可查询内容保持，而非追求与自身特征一致。
Relevance: 3
