papers.title: TRACE: Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing
papers.abstract_en: Breast ultrasound diagnosis relies on clinically meaningful semantic concepts, yet most deep learning methods adopt end-to-end image-to-label paradigms that lack interpretability and robustness. While concept-based approaches offer a promising alternative, they often assume complete annotations or require multimodal inputs at inference, which significantly limits their real-world applicability. To tackle these issues, we propose Training-time Report-guided and Clinically Ordered Concept Editing (TRACE), a training-time report-guided framework that leverages structured radiology reports as privileged concept supervision while enabling image-only diagnosis at test time. TRACE refines image-derived concepts through a teacher-guided editing mechanism within a malignancy-aware ordered concept space. To address incomplete annotations, we introduce Strategic Concept Missing Training (SCMT) and train an image-only self-editor via edit distillation for autonomous concept refinement. Besides, we introduce BUSC, a concept-enriched benchmark linking images, labels, and structured attributes. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that TRACE achieves superior performance and improved cross-domain robustness compared to existing methods.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026). 9 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE，一个面向乳腺超声诊断的训练期报告引导框架。它利用结构化放射学报告作为特权概念监督（privileged concept supervision），在测试时仅需图像即可完成诊断，避免了现有概念方法对完整标注或多模态输入的要求。TRACE 通过在恶性肿瘤感知的有序概念空间中进行教师引导的概念编辑，并引入 Strategic Concept Missing Training（SCMT）与编辑蒸馏来训练图像-only 自编辑器，同时发布了概念增强基准 BUSC。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上取得更优性能并提升跨域鲁棒性。
Motivation: 大多数深度学习诊断方法采用端到端的图像到标签范式，缺乏可解释性与鲁棒性；而概念方法往往假设完整概念标注或在推理时需要多模态输入，严重限制了实际应用。
Method: TRACE 在训练阶段使用结构化放射学报告提供特权概念监督，通过教师引导的编辑机制在恶性肿瘤感知的有序概念空间中细化图像派生概念；针对标注不完整，提出 SCMT 并以编辑蒸馏训练图像-only 自编辑器；此外构建了包含图像、标签与结构化属性的概念丰富基准 BUSC。
Result: 摘要报告在多个数据集上的实验表明，TRACE 相比现有方法取得更优的性能并表现出更好的跨域鲁棒性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调训练期报告引导的设计可以在测试时仅依赖图像，同时利用报告中的概念信息提升可解释性与泛化能力，并发布了新的基准数据集；研究场景限于乳腺超声诊断。

papers.title: Neuro-Geospatial Modelling of EEG Affective States Using Literature-Informed Environmental Context
papers.abstract_en: Environmental exposures such as air pollution and greenness have been associated with affective and cognitive outcomes, but EEG and environmental datasets are rarely jointly georeferenced. We investigate whether literature-informed environmental priors can serve as an auxiliary geospatial modality for EEG-based affective-state classification when individual-level exposure data are unavailable. We combine 30-channel EEG from the EAV benchmark (42 participants, aged 20-30 years) with environmental representations derived from OpenAQ, Sentinel-2, Sentinel-5P, and OpenStreetMap data for Astana. A dual-tower architecture combines EEG-Conformer representations with a graph-based environmental encoder. Because the datasets are not co-registered, environmental context is treated as a literature-informed prior rather than measured exposure. Subject-level repeated splits, permutation and label-shuffling controls, dose-response reversal, and domain-shift experiments distinguish architecture-level gains from prior-dependent gains. The multimodal model achieves 76.2% accuracy versus 67.4% for EEG alone. Controls disrupting environmental-label structure retain part of this gain, indicating that the improvement is not attributable solely to environmental information. Replacing the Astana environmental distribution with an independently modeled Singapore distribution reduces accuracy to 72.8%. These findings demonstrate technical feasibility but do not establish an observed or causal exposure-affect association. The study provides a framework for future jointly collected mobile EEG-environment studies. Implementation: https://github.com/r11up/geo-cog
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在缺乏个体级暴露数据时，文献告知的环境先验能否作为辅助地理空间模态用于 EEG 情绪状态分类。作者将 EAV 基准的 30 通道 EEG（42 名受试者）与阿斯塔纳的 OpenAQ、Sentinel-2、Sentinel-5P、OpenStreetMap 环境表征结合，用双塔架构（EEG-Conformer 加图环境编码器）进行分类。多模态模型准确率 76.2%，高于单独 EEG 的 67.4%，但控制实验显示部分增益并非来自环境信息；将环境分布换为新加坡数据后准确率降至 72.8%。
Motivation: 空气污染和绿化等环境暴露与情感、认知结果相关，但 EEG 与环境数据集很少联合地理配准，且个体级暴露数据通常不可用。作者希望探究在这种情况下，环境先验能否为基于 EEG 的情绪状态分类提供额外信息。
Method: 提出双塔架构，一塔为 EEG-Conformer 处理 30 通道 EEG，另一塔为基于图的编码器处理环境表征；由于数据集未共同配准，环境上下文被作为文献告知的先验而非实测暴露。使用受试者级重复划分、置换与标签洗牌控制、剂量-反应颠倒和域迁移实验来区分架构级收益与先验依赖收益。
Result: 多模态模型达到 76.2% 准确率，EEG 单独为 67.4%；破坏环境标签结构的控制保留了部分增益，说明提升不完全归因于环境信息；将阿斯塔纳环境分布替换为独立建模的新加坡分布后准确率降至 72.8%。
Conclusion: 研究证明技术可行性，但未建立观测到的或因果性的暴露-情感关联；作者将其定位为未来联合采集移动 EEG-环境研究提供框架。

papers.title: Routing Before Looking: Query-Adaptive Evidence Acquisition for Long-form Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-form video understanding remains challenging for video agents due to the mismatch between query demands and evidence acquisition strategies. Although recent planning-before-perception methods outperform query-agnostic pipelines, they often rely on a single dominant strategy, either generation-based strategy or retrieval-based strategy, limiting their ability to handle diverse query demands. We propose Route2Look, a lightweight and model-agnostic framework for query-adaptive evidence acquisition in long-form video understanding. Route2Look operates in a Route-Look-Memorize loop with three tools: Global Browse for holistic context, Temporal Ground for explicit temporal cues, and Semantic Retrieve for semantic search. The core component is a routing policy that dynamically selects evidence acquisition tools based on the query. To build this policy, Route2Look adopts a two-stage design: first distilling the routing skill from differential contrastive analysis between generation-based and retrieval-based trajectories, and then applying the distilled skill with hard routing rules and continue-or-stop criteria during inference. Experiments on challenging long-video benchmarks show that Route2Look achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining strong frame efficiency across datasets and query types. Oracle routing analysis further reveals the potential of query-adaptive evidence acquisition for future long-form video understanding.

papers.title: Denoising the Future: Context-Aware Spectral Diffusion for Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
papers.abstract_en: Temporal Knowledge Graph (TKG) extrapolation seeks to infer future facts from time-varying relational histories. Recent diffusion-based approaches improve uncertainty modeling through generative denoising, but their aggregated conditioning on subject histories may insufficiently distinguish query-specific evidence from non-salient historical facts, thereby diluting target-discriminative signals. To bridge this gap, we propose FreqDiff, a Frequency-aware Diffusion framework for TKG extrapolation. Specifically, FreqDiff formulates future object prediction as query-slot denoising and develops a dual-stream denoiser that integrates temporal dependency modeling with context-aware spectral calibration. The spectral branch synthesizes history-conditioned filters from learnable bases to adaptively re-calibrate denoising representations, while a frequency-domain regularizer is proposed to align the denoised target with the gold object in spectral space. Experiments on four public TKG benchmarks demonstrate that FreqDiff achieves state-of-the-art performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向时序知识图谱 (Temporal Knowledge Graph, TKG) 外推任务，提出 FreqDiff，一个基于频率感知扩散 (frequency-aware diffusion) 的框架。FreqDiff 将未来对象预测建模为查询槽去噪 (query-slot denoising)，并设计双流去噪器，把时序依赖建模与上下文感知的谱校准 (spectral calibration) 结合起来。实验在四个公开 TKG 基准上取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的 TKG 外推方法对主体历史进行聚合条件建模，难以区分查询相关的证据与非显著历史事实，从而稀释了目标判别性信号。
Method: FreqDiff 提出查询槽去噪框架，并构建双流去噪器：一路建模时序依赖，另一路进行上下文感知的谱校准；谱分支从可学习基 (learnable bases) 合成历史条件滤波器，自适应地重新校准去噪表示；此外引入频域正则项，使去噪后的目标在谱空间中与真实对象对齐。
Result: 在四个公开 TKG 基准上，FreqDiff 达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将去噪过程与频域谱校准相结合能够更好保留目标判别性信号，从而提升 TKG 外推效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CubicSplat: Differentiable Vector Graphics via Error-Bounded Forward Relaxation
papers.abstract_en: Vector graphics are prized for their resolution independence, compact storage, and direct editability, making differentiable optimization of their parametric primitives an attractive goal. Yet classical rasterization is discontinuous with respect to geometry, and existing remedies that smooth the forward pass demand increasingly elaborate heuristics as scene complexity grows. We trace this fragility to a gradient seesaw: design choices that improve forward geometric exactness can systematically degrade the induced gradient signal, and vice versa. To navigate this tension we introduce CubicSplat, a differentiable vector rasterizer that replaces Bézier closest-point solvers with uniform polyline surrogates whose geometric error is bounded at $O(S^{-2})$. The resulting static computation graph yields well-conditioned gradients by construction, while a compositing-derived visibility mechanism prunes degenerate primitives without auxiliary regularization. On DIV2K and Kodak benchmarks CubicSplat achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality with over 2 dB PSNR gain in the closed-fill setting, while training up to 4x faster than prior methods. The code is available at https://github.com/CubicSplat/repo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CubicSplat，一种可微向量光栅化器，用均匀折线替代 B\u00e9zier 最近点求解器，并将几何误差控制在 O(S^{-2})。由此得到的静态计算图天然具备良态梯度，并借助合成推导的可见性机制裁剪退化图元而无需额外正则化。在 DIV2K 和 Kodak 基准上，CubicSplat 在 closed-fill 设置下取得超过 2 dB 的 PSNR 提升，训练速度相比此前方法最高快 4 倍。
Motivation: 经典光栅化对几何不连续，现有平滑前向传播的方法随场景复杂度增加需要日益复杂的启发式规则。作者将其归因于梯度跷跷板效应：改善前向几何精确度的设计选择会系统性削弱梯度信号，反之亦然。
Method: 用均匀折线代理替换 B\u00e9zier 最近点求解器，保证几何误差为 O(S^{-2})；静态计算图从构造上提供良态梯度，并利用合成 (compositing) 推导出的可见性机制裁剪退化图元，无需辅助正则化。
Result: 在 DIV2K 和 Kodak 基准上，该方法达到当前最优的重建质量，在 closed-fill 设置下 PSNR 提升超过 2 dB，训练速度比此前方法最多快 4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法有效调和了前向精确度与梯度质量之间的张力，并公开代码供复现；摘要未提及方法在基准之外的限制。

papers.title: SPARC: Single-Pass Scaling for Motion Forecasting with Conformal Bayesian Last Layers
papers.abstract_en: Human motion forecasters are increasingly accurate and fast, but reliable deployment requires uncertainty estimates that are structured, calibrated, and efficient. Bayesian and ensemble-based uncertainty estimates often require repeated stochastic inference [15, 26], while conformal calibration alone does not provide an epistemic signal or preserve trajectory covariance structure [14, 50]. We introduce SPARC (Single-Pass Adaptive Risk Calibration), a Bayesian-conformal uncertainty layer for motion forecasting. A deterministic MLP backbone predicts the future mean, and a conjugate Bayesian last layer converts time-domain feature leverage into an analytic horizon-wise epistemic scale $κ_t(x)$. This scale inflates a graph-temporal Gaussian covariance without changing its correlation structure, and split conformal calibration produces 95% marginal prediction tubes with finite-sample validity under exchangeability. The key interface is the structured factorization $κ_t(x)Σ_{\mathrm{str},t}(x)$, which injects feature-space epistemic uncertainty into trajectory densities without Monte Carlo sampling. Across nine dataset-protocol blocks and deterministic, multimodal, and calibration baselines, SPARC ranks first on NLL and on the combined MPJPE+NLL criterion while retaining competitive point accuracy and efficient calibrated tubes. Ranking windows by $κ$ separates high-error cases, making the scale usable as a lightweight risk monitor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARC（Single-Pass Adaptive Risk Calibration），一种用于运动预测的贝叶斯-共形不确定性层。确定性 MLP 主干预测未来均值，共轭贝叶斯最后一层将时域特征贡献转化为解析的逐视界认知尺度 κ_t(x)，该尺度在不改变相关结构的情况下放缩图-时序高斯协方差，并通过分割共形校准生成具有有限样本有效性的 95% 边际预测管。在九个数据集-协议块上与确定性、多模态和校准基线比较，SPARC 在 NLL 和 MPJPE+NLL 组合指标上排名第一，同时保持有竞争力的点精度和高效校准管。
Motivation: 可靠的部署需要结构化、校准且高效的不确定性估计，而贝叶斯和集成方法往往需要重复随机推理，纯共形校准又不提供认知信号且会破坏轨迹协方差结构。
Method: SPARC 采用确定性 MLP 主干加共轭贝叶斯最后一层，将特征空间认知不确定性通过结构化分解 κ_t(x)Σ_str,t(x) 注入轨迹密度，无需蒙特卡洛采样；随后用分割共形校准获得有限样本有效的边际预测管。
Result: 摘要报告在九个数据集-协议块中，SPARC 在 NLL 和 MPJPE+NLL 组合指标上均排名第一，点精度具有竞争力，校准管高效；按 κ 排序窗口能分离高误差情形，可作为轻量风险监控。
Conclusion: 作者强调这种单遍贝叶斯-共形混合层在不采样、不破坏协方差结构的前提下获得校准且有效的轨迹不确定性，并使 κ_t(x) 可作为风险监控信号使用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Profiling What Matters: Context-Aware Item Profiles from Large-Scale Metadata for LLM Recommenders
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced reranking in recommendation, effectively leveraging item-side information remains challenging. Real-world items are described by vast, heterogeneous, and unstructured metadata, where decision-relevant signals are often implicit, noisy, or buried in long descriptions. Moreover, feature salience is highly context-dependent, varying not only across items but also across users. Existing methods often rely on item titles, fixed attributes, or static item summaries, which limit personalized and fine-grained item understanding. To bridge this gap, we propose CAIRO, a user context-aware item profiling framework for LLM-based reranking. CAIRO first structures raw metadata and reviews into objective features and subjective traits, and employs a lightweight profiler to select the most relevant information for each user-item pair with limited serving-time overhead. The resulting profiles are concise and context-specific, providing relevant item-side evidence for the LLM's ranking decision. Experiments show that CAIRO consistently improves LLM-based reranking, highlighting the importance of item profiling that effectively exploits vast item-side information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAIRO，一个面向 LLM 推荐重排 (reranking) 的用户上下文感知物品画像框架。针对真实物品元数据庞杂、异构、非结构化且相关信号常被淹没的问题，CAIRO 先将原始元数据和评论结构化为客观特征与主观特质，再用轻量级 profiler 为每个用户-物品对选择最相关的信息，生成简洁且上下文特定的物品画像，作为 LLM 排序决策的证据。实验表明 CAIRO 能持续提升基于 LLM 的重排效果。
Motivation: LLM 在推荐重排中虽表现突出，但有效利用物品侧信息仍是难点：真实物品的元数据规模大、异构且非结构化，决策相关信号往往隐式、嘈杂或被长描述掩盖；且特征显著性高度依赖上下文，既随物品变化也随用户变化。现有方法多依赖标题、固定属性或静态摘要，限制了个性化与细粒度的物品理解。
Method: CAIRO 框架包含两步：先将原始元数据与评论结构化地组织为客观特征 (objective features) 和主观特质 (subjective traits)；然后使用一个轻量级 profiler 在有限的 serving-time 开销下，为每个用户-物品对挑选最相关的信息片段，最终生成简洁且上下文特定的物品画像供 LLM 重排使用。
Result: 实验证明 CAIRO 能一致地改进基于 LLM 的重排性能，突出了能有效利用大规模物品侧信息的画像方法的重要性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对每个用户-物品对动态生成的上下文感知物品画像，是充分发挥 LLM 推荐重排潜力、利用海量物品侧信息的关键方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dynamic Context Scheduling: Learning Beyond the Static Universe
papers.abstract_en: We study dynamic context scheduling as a training instrument for contextual re- inforcement learning. Rather than treating intra-episode context variation as a deployment reality, we treat it as a controlled shaping mechanism. Thereby, context evolves within each training episode according to a predetermined schedule, expos- ing the policy to a richer and more temporally structured region of the environment parameter space. We introduce DYNAMICCARLENV, a framework that wraps contextual environments with pluggable schedule families, such as sinusoidal off- sets or cosine annealing. Across CartPole, BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing with CARL contextualization, we show that dynamic schedules match or outperform static context baselines in the out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes. Interestingly, for the more complex BipedalWalker and VehicleRacing environments we also achieve higher in-distribution (ID) evaluation performance. Preliminary findings indicate that automatic search for multi-stage curricula can successfully discover schedules that improve generalization, performing comparably to extensive grid search over single-stage schedulers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究动态上下文调度 (dynamic context scheduling) 作为上下文强化学习 (contextual reinforcement learning) 的训练手段，把回合内的上下文变化视为受控的塑造机制，而不是部署时的现实问题。作者提出 DYNAMICCARLENV 框架，为上下文环境包装可插拔的调度族，如正弦偏移 (sinusoidal offsets) 和余弦退火 (cosine annealing)。在 CartPole、BipedalWalker 和 VehicleRacing 的 CARL 上下文化基准上，动态调度在分布外 (OOD) 区域与静态上下文基线相当或更优，且在复杂环境中分布内 (ID) 评估也更高；初步结果显示自动搜索多阶段课程可发现提升泛化的调度。
Motivation: 现有上下文强化学习通常把上下文视为静态或仅作为部署环境的变化，忽略了回合内上下文演化对策略塑造的潜力。作者希望利用受控的上下文调度暴露策略于更丰富且时间结构化的环境参数空间，以提升泛化能力。
Method: 提出 DYNAMICCARLENV 框架，在训练回合内按预定调度演化上下文，支持多种可插拔调度族，包括正弦偏移和余弦退火；并探索自动搜索多阶段课程 (multi-stage curricula) 以发现能改善泛化的调度。
Result: 在 CartPole、BipedalWalker 和 VehicleRacing 的 CARL 上下文化环境中，动态调度在分布外 (OOD) 区域匹配或超越静态上下文基线；在更复杂的 BipedalWalker 和 VehicleRacing 上还取得更高的分布内 (ID) 评估性能。自动搜索多阶段课程发现的调度与对单阶段调度器进行广泛网格搜索的效果相当。
Conclusion: 摘要表明动态上下文调度可作为提升上下文强化学习泛化能力的训练工具，并指出自动化课程搜索能够有效发现多阶段调度。

papers.title: Automated Trajectory Evaluation for Mobile Agents via Step-Level Consequence Reasoning and Aggregation
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating language-guided mobile agents has recently shifted from rule-based to model-based approaches to achieve scalable and automated assessments. However, existing holistic evaluation paradigms process entire trajectories at once, leading to substantial context overload. Moreover, they primarily focus on task completion while overlooking operational safety. To address these limitations, we introduce CRATE, a novel two-stage VLM-as-judge framework for automated mobile agent evaluation that is compatible with both open- and closed-source models. Leveraging a step-level consequence reasoning mechanism, CRATE independently extracts task-relevant visual clues and infers action-conditioned state changes at each step. The resulting step-level textual evidence is then synthesized through trajectory-level aggregation to deliver an evidence-grounded evaluation of task completion. Building upon this evaluation scheme, we further extend CRATE to CRATE-S for operational safety assessment. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness and robustness of both CRATE and CRATE-S. Powered by Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct, CRATE achieves an F1-score of 0.833 on AndroidWorld (outperforming SPA-Bench by 20%), while CRATE-S reaches an F1-score of 0.697 on MobileRisk, demonstrating strong alignment with benchmark ground truths. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CRATE-D580.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CRATE，一个两阶段的 VLM-as-judge 框架，用于移动智能体轨迹的自动评估。CRATE 在每一步独立提取任务相关的视觉线索并推断动作导致的状态变化（step-level consequence reasoning），再通过轨迹级聚合生成基于证据的任务完成度评估；在此基础上扩展出 CRATE-S 用于操作安全评估。实验表明 CRATE 和 CRATE-S 均与基准真值有较强一致性。
Motivation: 现有模型化评估方法一般一次性处理整条轨迹，导致上下文过载；同时主要衡量任务完成度，忽略了操作安全性。
Method: 提出两阶段 VLM-as-judge 评估框架 CRATE：第一阶段进行逐步后果推理（consequence reasoning），独立提取视觉线索并推断每个动作导致的界面状态变化；第二阶段将逐步文本证据进行轨迹级聚合，得到基于证据的任务完成评估。CRATE-S 在同一评估方案基础上扩展出操作安全（operational safety）评估能力。
Result: 使用 Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct 驱动时，CRATE 在 AndroidWorld 上取得 0.833 的 F1 分数，比 SPA-Bench 高出 20%；CRATE-S 在 MobileRisk 上取得 0.697 的 F1 分数，显示与基准真值强对齐。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CRATE 与 CRATE-S 在移动智能体评估中既有效又稳健，支持开源与闭源 VLM 模型，并将评估范围从任务完成扩展到操作安全。

papers.title: Knowing but Not Saying: Preventing Factual Access Failures in LLM SFT via Recall-Anchored Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can degrade factual behavior outside the target domain. This degradation is often described as catastrophic forgetting, yet open-ended factual failures do not necessarily imply that the underlying facts have been erased. In this work, we identify a more specific phenomenon, factual access failure: after domain SFT, models can still recognize or rank the correct answer under constrained evaluation, while failing to produce it in closed-book generation. Through benchmark-level comparisons, same-fact multiple-choice and generation probes, and failure-mode analysis, we show that SFT-induced factual degradation reflects both genuine wrong-answer generations and expression-level failures such as verbosity, formatting mismatch, and exact-match artifacts. To address this problem, we introduce Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD), a base-anchored self-distillation objective that preserves out-of-distribution generation behavior by aligning the adapted model with the original base model's soft continuation distribution on unlabeled OOD text. RAD requires no gold OOD answers, external judges, or labeled factual data. Across three backbones fine-tuned on MedMCQA, RAD recovers a consistent portion of the lost OOD recall while preserving target-domain adaptation. Compared with replay on the same OOD text, RAD shows that the key preservation signal is the base model's soft distribution rather than additional text exposure alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对监督微调（SFT）在目标域之外导致的事实行为退化，提出一个更细粒度的现象——事实访问失败（factual access failure）：模型在受限评估下能识别或排序正确答案，却在闭卷生成中无法产出。作者通过基准级比较、同一事实的多选题与生成探针以及失败模式分析，将退化分为真实错误生成与表达层面失败（如冗长、格式不匹配、精确匹配伪影）。为缓解该问题，提出 Recall-Anchored Distillation (RAD)，一种基于基础模型软续接分布的自蒸馏目标，在无标签 OOD 文本上保持分布外生成行为。
Motivation: SFT 会降低目标域外的事实行为，常被称为灾难性遗忘，但作者指出开放式事实失败并不必然意味着事实已被擦除，因此需要更精确地刻画实际退化机制，并开发无需金标准 OOD 答案或外部评估的缓解方法。
Method: 提出 RAD（Recall-Anchored Distillation）：在无标签 OOD 文本上，让适应后的模型与原始基础模型的软续接分布（soft continuation distribution）对齐。该方法不依赖金标准 OOD 答案、外部判断器或标记事实数据，并与基于相同 OOD 文本的 replay 进行对比以分析保留信号。
Result: 在三个骨干模型上以 MedMCQA 进行微调后，RAD 恢复了一致的 OOD 召回损失部分，同时保持目标域适应能力；与相同 OOD 文本上的 replay 相比，结果表明关键保留信号是基础模型的软分布而非额外文本暴露本身。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 SFT 的事实退化既包含真实错误生成也包含表达层面失败，而 RAD 通过锚定基础模型软分布可以缓解事实访问失败，且无需额外标注。摘要未给出具体恢复数值或明确局限性。

papers.title: CertVLA: Certified Defense against Physical Visual Attacks for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to localized physical perturbations, yet existing certified patch defenses target discrete labels and cannot directly certify continuous, temporally correlated actions. We introduce CertVLA, a certified defense for closed-loop VLA control under bounded patch and texture attacks. CertVLA proposes a calibrated region of behaviorally consistent actions, while deterministic covering masks ensure that at least one checked prediction is attack-free. Specifically, CertVLA normalizes action disagreement by the benign variation of each mask pair and accepts a single-mask anchor only when it remains consistent under every second mask. It then calibrates the resulting max-min-max episode score to provide finite-sample clean coverage. Conjoining query-level decisions extends the action certificate to the complete closed-loop rollout. Furthermore, we prove that against any adaptive attacker satisfying the bounded-support threat model, every rollout certified by CertVLA executes only action chunks consistent with attack-erased clean predictions. Under dual-mask rollout correctness, this consistency certificate further guarantees task success. The certificate is independent of patch content, generation method, and physical transformation. Experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate the empirical and certified effectiveness of CertVLA against patch attacks, with additional simulation validation on texture attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CertVLA，一个针对视觉-语言-动作模型 (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) 在闭环控制下抵御有界局部物理扰动（如 patch 攻击）的可认证防御框架。方法通过确定性覆盖掩码保证至少一个检查过的预测无攻击，并将逐查询的决策联合起来把动作证书扩展到完整的闭环 rollout。论文同时给出形式化证明：在满足有界支撑威胁模型的任意自适应攻击下，被认证的 rollout 只执行与攻击擦除后的干净预测一致的动作块。仿真与真实实验表明 CertVLA 对 patch 攻击有效，并在仿真中额外验证了纹理攻击。
Motivation: 现有可认证的 patch 防御主要针对离散标签分类，无法直接认证连续且时间上相关的动作输出；VLA 策略又容易受到局部物理扰动的影响。这使闭环 VLA 控制缺少适配连续动作空间的鲁棒性证书。
Method: CertVLA 提出一个行为一致动作的校准区域，利用确定性覆盖掩码确保至少有一个被检验的预测是无攻击的。它将动作不一致性按每对掩码的良性变化进行归一化，仅当单掩码锚点在所有第二掩码下保持一致时才接受该锚点；随后校准得到的 max-min-max 回合分数以提供有限样本的干净覆盖率，并通过联接查询级决策把动作证书扩展到完整闭环 rollout。论文还给出针对有界支撑威胁模型的自适应攻击者的形式化安全证明。
Result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明 CertVLA 对 patch 攻击具有经验与可认证的有效性，仿真中还验证了纹理攻击；形式化结果显示，在双掩码 rollout 正确性条件下，该一致性证书可进一步保证任务成功。
Conclusion: 论文强调该证书与 patch 内容、生成方式和物理变换无关，能够在闭环 VLA 控制中将鲁棒性保证从单步查询推广到完整 rollout；其有效性依赖于双掩码 rollout 正确性假设。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: M2Depth: Unifying Monocular Depth Foundation Priors with Multi-View Stereo
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning-based Multi-View Stereo (MVS) has advanced significantly but often generalizes poorly to unseen scenes, particularly in occluded areas or regions with limited view overlap. To mitigate this, recent approaches integrate Depth Foundation Models (DFMs) into MVS pipelines to provide monocular depth priors. However, existing methods typically rely on a static, one-way fusion scheme, which fails to fully exploit the complementary strengths of both modalities. We propose a novel framework that overcomes this limitation by tightly coupling a DFM with a cascade MVS pipeline through a bidirectional mutual refinement strategy. Our method leverages MVS depth to resolve the scale ambiguity in monocular predictions, while the monocular depth, in turn, enhances the structural completeness and fine-grained detail of the MVS estimate. Furthermore, we introduce a prior-guided cost volume refinement mechanism that effectively integrates multi-view and monocular information via attention-based fusion and discretized depth bins, thereby promoting local geometric consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art MVS approaches on standard benchmarks, producing more complete and generalizable depth maps with sharp boundaries. Furthermore, although not explicitly designed for sparse-view settings, our framework generalizes remarkably well, competing favorably with even dedicated sparse-view methods while maintaining a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 M2Depth 框架，将单目深度基础模型 (Depth Foundation Model, DFM) 与级联 MVS 管线紧密耦合，通过双向互细化 (bidirectional mutual refinement) 让 MVS 深度解决单目预测的尺度模糊，同时让单目深度增强 MVS 估计的结构完整性和细节。作者还引入先验引导的成本体细化机制，通过注意力融合和离散深度 bin 整合多视图与单目信息。实验显示该方法在标准基准上优于现有 MVS 方法，并在稀疏视图设置下也具备良好泛化。
Motivation: 深度学习的 MVS 在未见场景上泛化较差，尤其在遮挡区域或视图重叠有限区域；现有方法虽将 DFM 集成进 MVS 提供单目先验，但采用静态、单向融合，未充分挖掘两种模态的互补优势。
Method: 提出将 DFM 与级联 MVS 通过双向互细化策略紧密耦合：利用 MVS 深度解决单目预测的尺度歧义，反过来用单目深度提升 MVS 估计的结构完整性和细节；并设计先验引导的成本体细化机制，用注意力融合和离散深度 bin 整合多视图与单目信息以促进局部几何一致性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在标准基准上优于 SOTA MVS 方法，生成的深度图更完整、泛化性更好且边界清晰；尽管未专门针对稀疏视图设计，该框架仍能与专用稀疏视图方法竞争，并保持优越的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 双向互细化结合先验引导成本体细化能有效融合单目深度先验与多视图几何，改善泛化和完整度；稀疏视图下的良好表现是额外特性，而非论文的设计目标。

papers.title: Structure for Reading, Prose for Writing: Asymmetric Structural Conditioning in Multi-Agent Document Authoring
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent pipelines that author formal documents must both read a requester's forms and write against them. We report a deployed tender-response system, running an open-weights model under sovereignty constraints, and evaluate it against human-written bids the same organisation actually submitted. On a blind comparison where the system had no worked example available, an LLM judge rated its answers at least as good as the human-submitted answer on $40$ of $55$ ground-truth sections, better on $4$, missing on none, and flagged one unsupported claim in total. Classifying every gap the judge identified shows that $68\%$ were content absent from the system's own sources -- knowledge the human author held and the pipeline was never given -- so only $6$ of the $15$ adverse verdicts involve a deficiency the system could have avoided. A divergence from ground truth is more often an information-availability result than a writing-quality one, and evaluations that do not separate the two understate such systems. Against this backdrop we report a conditioning asymmetry. It is well established that rendering documents as structural markup rather than flat prose improves extraction, and we reproduce that on three reading tasks. The benefit does not transfer to conditioning: converting a bid's \emph{instruction} material from prose to nested XML dropped answer quality from $74\%$ to $48\%$ under a paired comparison. We further find that naming a forbidden construction concentrates rather than removes it -- $96\%$ of surviving defects fall in the two forms the prompt explicitly names -- and that coupling a stochastic annotation to a deterministic windowing function moves the extracted requirement count from $68$ to $51$ on a byte-identical file. Structure belongs where the model reads; prose and self-applied tests belong where it writes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一个多智能体标书生成系统的部署与评估。该系统在主权约束下运行开源权重模型，与同一组织实际提交的人工标书做盲审对比，结果显示在55个ground-truth节段中有40个被LLM法官评为至少不差于人工答案。作者进一步分析了条件化 (conditioning) 的不对称性：将结构标记用于读取任务有效，但将指令材料从散文转换为嵌套XML反而使配对比较的答案质量从74%降至48%，并发现显式命名禁止构造会集中而非消除缺陷。
Motivation: 多智能体正式文档写作管线需要同时读取请求者表单并据此写作，但现有评估往往不区分信息缺失与写作质量问题，导致系统能力被低估；此外，结构标记对提取任务的收益是否同样适用于条件化指令尚不清楚。
Method: 作者先在真实部署的标书回复系统上进行盲审与缺陷分类，随后做配对实验：将投标指令材料从散文转为嵌套XML以测试条件化效果，并检验命名禁止构造与随机标注加确定性窗口化对缺陷集中度和需求提取数量的影响。
Result: 盲审中系统在55节中有40节不差于人工、4节更好、无缺失，共标出1条无依据主张；15个不利判决中约68%源于源材料缺少人类作者掌握的知识，仅6个属于系统可避免的缺陷。将指令材料从平铺散文换成嵌套XML使答案质量从74%降到48%；显式命名禁止构造后96%的残余缺陷集中于所命名两类；耦合随机标注与确定性窗口化使同一文件的提取需求数量从68降到51。
Conclusion: 作者主张结构应放在模型读取的一侧，而写作一侧应使用散文与自测试；与ground truth的偏差更多源于信息可得性而非写作质量，评估若不区分这两种来源会低估此类系统。

papers.title: Rethinking Demonstration Unlearning in Imitation Learning for Robotics
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning for robotics depends on human demonstrations, some of which people may later ask to remove. Retraining without them is the natural reference, but its cost grows with policy and dataset scale, motivating cheaper operators that edit a trained policy. Metrics inherited from machine unlearning, such as forgetting loss or a single membership attack, do not establish what an edit removed from a policy acting in closed loop. We therefore introduce a retrain-calibrated audit that reads demonstration unlearning along two axes: behavior, whether the edited policy acts like one retrained without the removed demonstrations, and evidence, whether an auditor can still detect it was trained on them. The behavior axis measures action divergence to that retrain at matched states, calibrated by a floor built from independent retrains, so a policy at the floor is as close to a retrain as retrains are to each other. The evidence axis applies a per-demonstration membership attack against a retrain null, reporting both its rank and its absolute member-loss level, since rank alone accepts operators that inflate member losses past the null. A conformal test then combines both axes into one hypothesis of joint retrain consistency, against a fleet of independent retrains large enough to reject at conventional significance. Across five preregistered conditions on three real-robot policy classes and two simulation suites, the axes dissociate in both directions on one checkpoint, as an edit may repair task behavior while leaving evidence unchanged, or reduce evidence while moving behavior away from retraining. On the ACT arm, a redirect edit restores blind-scored robot success to 18 of 20 trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新思考机器人模仿学习中的示范遗忘（demonstration unlearning），提出一个以重训为校准的审计框架，从行为与证据两个轴评估编辑后的策略是否接近未包含被删除示范的重训策略，并用一致性检验合并两轴。在三个真实机器人策略类别和两个仿真套件的五个预注册条件下验证，发现两轴可以在同一检查点上双向解耦。
Motivation: 机器人模仿学习依赖人类示范，用户之后可能要求删除其中部分示范；重训是最自然的参照但成本随策略和数据集规模增长，因此需要廉价的编辑算子。现有机器学习遗忘指标（如遗忘损失、单一成员攻击）无法说明闭环运行中的编辑策略到底删除了什么。
Method: 提出重训校准审计（retrain-calibrated audit），沿两个轴评估遗忘：行为轴度量编辑策略与重训策略在匹配状态下的动作散度，并用独立重训之间的散度构建校准地板；证据轴对每个示范执行成员攻击并与重训零分布对比，同时报告排名和绝对成员损失水平，因为仅看排名会接受那些把成员损失抬高到零分布之上的算子。最后用一致性检验（conformal test）将两轴合并为联合重训一致性假设，并与足够多的独立重训策略比较以在常规显著性水平下做出判断。
Result: 在三个真实机器人策略类别和两个仿真套件的五个预注册条件下，两轴在一个检查点上双向解耦：编辑可能修复任务行为而证据不变，或降低证据但行为偏离重训。在 ACT 分支上，重定向编辑将盲评机器人成功率恢复到 20 次试验中的 18 次。
Conclusion: 摘要强调评估示范遗忘需要同时考察行为与证据两个维度，仅依赖排名类指标会误导审计结论；重训校准的审计框架可更可靠地判断编辑是否真正实现了删除。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CAS: Conformalized Agentic Search via Adaptive Retrieval and Policy Weighting
papers.abstract_en: Search Agents face a severe reliability crisis during reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning. Heuristic Top-K retrieval often causes critical evidence loss or noise inclusion, while over-confidence induced by progressive RL leads to hallucinated answers and redundant searches. To build highly reliable agents, we introduce Conformal Prediction (CP) and propose Conformalized Agentic Search (CAS). This framework establishes reliability guarantees on both the retrieval and training sides: on the retrieval side, an Adaptive Prediction Set (APS), a specific CP realization, translates statistical coverage into dynamic document truncation to construct prediction sets that are adaptive in size; on the training side, Adaptive Conformal Inference (ACI), a dynamic CP algorithm, dynamically constructs prediction sets with controllable coverage to quantify answer confidence, which is then used to penalize low-confidence trajectories within the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective, ensuring the model learns only from reliable ones. Experiments across single-hop and multi-hop QA datasets demonstrate that our framework significantly improves reasoning accuracy while drastically reducing redundant tool invocations, establishing a highly reliable and efficient agent paradigm. Our code is available at https://github.com/S1llyBird/CAS.
papers.comment: 21 pages, including figures, tables, and appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对搜索智能体（Search Agent）在强化学习（RL）微调阶段面临的可靠性危机，提出 Conformalized Agentic Search (CAS) 框架。检索侧用自适应预测集 (Adaptive Prediction Set, APS) 将统计覆盖转化为动态文档截断，构造大小自适应的预测集；训练侧用自适应共形推断 (Adaptive Conformal Inference, ACI) 动态量化答案置信度，并在 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 目标中惩罚低置信轨迹。在单跳和多跳 QA 数据集上的实验显示，该方法显著提升推理准确率并大幅减少冗余工具调用。
Motivation: RL 微调中的搜索智能体存在两类可靠性问题：启发式 Top-K 检索会造成关键证据丢失或噪声混入，而渐进式 RL 引发的过度自信会导致幻觉回答与冗余搜索。作者认为需要同时在检索端和训练端建立可靠性保证。
Method: 引入共形预测 (Conformal Prediction, CP) 构建 CAS：检索侧采用 APS 将统计覆盖率映射为动态文档截断，生成大小自适应的预测集；训练侧采用 ACI 以可控覆盖率动态构造预测集来量化答案置信度，并把置信度作为惩罚项纳入 GRPO 目标，使模型只从可靠轨迹中学习。
Result: 在单跳和多跳 QA 数据集上的实验表明，该框架显著提升推理准确率，同时大幅减少冗余工具调用（redundant tool invocations）。
Conclusion: 摘要将 CAS 定位为一种高可靠且高效的智能体范式，并公开了代码；但未给出具体数值提升，也未讨论该方法在 QA 以外任务上的适用性或局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MotionPhys: Detecting AI-Generated Videos via Physical Consistency of Optical-Flow Trajectories
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI video generation models can produce videos with high visual fidelity and seemingly smooth temporal transitions. However, visual realism does not necessarily imply physical motion consistency. Existing generative models mainly optimize distribution matching in pixel or latent spaces, without explicitly enforcing real-world constraints such as inertia, continuous forces, and trajectory geometry. Our experiments show that AI-generated videos remain visually plausible over short sequences of consecutive frames, yet fail to preserve physical motion consistency throughout a complete object action, resulting in systematic statistical discrepancies in their motion trajectories. Based on this observation, we introduce MotionPhys, a lightweight and interpretable framework that treats sparse motion trajectories as physical evidence rather than relying on appearance artifacts or generator-specific traces. By modeling the geometric evolution of trajectories across multiple temporal scales, MotionPhys reveals subtle motion inconsistencies that are difficult to capture with conventional visual cues and transforms them into a compact representation for efficient detection. Experiments on multiple datasets show that MotionPhys can effectively detect physical inconsistencies in generated videos and generalizes well across different video generators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MotionPhys，一个轻量且可解释的框架，用于检测 AI 生成视频中的物理运动不一致性。核心思路是不依赖外观伪影或生成器特定痕迹，而是将稀疏光流轨迹视为物理证据，通过跨多个时间尺度建立轨迹的几何演化模型，把完整物体动作中系统性的细微运动不一致转化为紧凑表示用于高效检测。实验表明该方法在多个数据集上能有效检测生成视频的物理不一致性，并跨不同视频生成器泛化。
Motivation: 现有 AI 视频生成模型主要在像素或隐空间优化分布匹配，没有显式约束惯性、连续力、轨迹几何等真实物理规则；生成的视频在短帧序列上视觉合理，但在完整物体动作过程中无法保持物理运动一致性，形成检测上的空白。
Method: 提出 MotionPhys 框架，将稀疏运动轨迹作为物理证据而非外观线索，对轨迹在多个时间尺度上的几何演化进行建模，并把这些难以被常规视觉线索捕捉的细微运动不一致性转化为紧凑表示，以实现高效且轻量的检测。
Result: 实验显示 AI 生成视频仅在连续短帧上视觉可信，完整动作中运动轨迹存在系统性统计差异；MotionPhys 在多个数据集上有效检测物理不一致性，并能很好地泛化到不同视频生成器。摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调运动轨迹的物理一致性可作为区分真实与生成视频的可靠证据，且该方法不依赖外观伪影或生成器痕迹，具备较好的跨生成器泛化能力。

papers.title: Do SpeechLMs Hear Their Own Opinions? Diagnosing and Mitigating Previous-Belief Contamination in Streaming Emotion Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming emotion understanding uses historical state while continuously interpreting current audio, often feeding the model's previous prediction back as context. We show that this history conditioning can distort current perception. On a balanced CREMA-D-Stream counterfactual diagnostic, changing only the injected previous emotion label while holding the audio fixed reduces current-audio accuracy from 72.50% to 30.42% and flips 65.69% of predictions. The effect is strongly label-asymmetric, with prior pull ranging from 4.76% to 98.20%, revealing a failure we call previous-belief contamination (PBC). To address PBC, we introduce EmoUpdate, a training-free framework that separates current-audio perception from historical state revision through three components: (1) a prior-blind acoustic firewall that prevents historical state from entering perception; (2) an evidence-shrunk causal belief filter that introduces history only after observation formation and retains label-asymmetric transition structure only when supported by observed evidence; and (3) a closed-form decontamination operator derived from the same counterfactual measurements for serving stacks where firewalling is unavailable. Across four SpeechLMs and two streaming emotion benchmarks, EmoUpdate achieves the best step accuracy and state-balanced accuracy in all eight model--benchmark settings, improving S-BAcc by up to 69.71 points and step accuracy by up to 38.41 points over the strongest controlled baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流式情感理解中历史状态注入对当前音频感知的干扰，提出并命名了 previous-belief contamination (PBC) 这一失效模式。在 CREMA-D-Stream 反事实诊断上，仅改变注入的历史情感标签、保持音频不变，会使当前音频准确率从 72.50% 降至 30.42%，并翻转 65.69% 的预测。作者提出无需训练的 EmoUpdate 框架，在四个 SpeechLM 和两个流式情感基准上均取得最佳步级准确率与状态平衡准确率。
Motivation: 流式情感理解依赖历史状态持续解读当前音频，常把模型上一时刻的预测作为上下文反馈，作者要检验这种历史条件化是否会扭曲当前感知，并量化其影响。
Method: 提出 EmoUpdate，一个训练无关框架，包含三个组件：prior-blind acoustic firewall 阻止历史状态进入感知；evidence-shrunk causal belief filter 在观测形成后才引入历史并只保留有证据支撑的标签非对称转移结构；closed-form decontamination operator 基于同一反事实测量，面向无法使用 firewalling 的部署栈。
Result: 在 CREMA-D-Stream 反事实诊断中，仅改变注入的上一情感标签可把当前音频准确率从 72.50% 降到 30.42%，翻转 65.69% 的预测；prior pull 在 4.76% 到 98.20% 之间呈现明显标签非对称。在四个 SpeechLM 和两个流式情感基准的全部八个模型-基准组合上，EmoUpdate 均取得最佳 step accuracy 和 state-balanced accuracy，相比最强受控基线最高提升 S-BAcc 69.71 点、step accuracy 38.41 点。
Conclusion: 作者将历史条件化导致的感知偏差诊断为 previous-belief contamination (PBC)，并表明通过训练无关的感知-历史分离与反事实推导的算子可以有效缓解；摘要未讨论该框架在训练类模型或更广任务上的适用范围与局限。

papers.title: Beyond Endpoint Gains: A Weight-Delta Audit of Medical Specialization
papers.abstract_en: Specialist language models are usually understood through endpoint gains: the generalist scores lower, the specialist scores higher, and the difference is treated as evidence of specialization. This leaves the released update itself largely unexamined. We propose a paired weight-delta path audit and apply it to two public, aligned generalist-to-medical-specialist checkpoint pairs: Gemma-3-4B-IT to MedGemma-4B-IT and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct to HuatuoGPT-o1-7B. In both pairs, the full decoder-side update strongly reconstructs measured medical benchmark movement (0.974 and 1.183 endpoint-normalized retention), making each decoder delta an appropriate substrate for the audit. Yet the movement is not cleanly localized. MLP is the strongest broad component family in both pairs, but mixed off-domain movements, 10-seed matched controls, and endpoint-anchored rollbacks prevent a unique coarse-family explanation. The audit therefore separates update-level reconstruction from component-level explanation. Its claims concern text-only multiple-choice benchmark movement, not clinical validation, repair, or circuit-level mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种成对权重增量路径审计（paired weight-delta path audit），用于检验通用模型到医学专科模型微调更新本身的结构，而不是仅看端点性能差异。作者将方法应用于 Gemma-3-4B-IT→MedGemma-4B-IT 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct→HuatuoGPT-o1-7B 两对公开检查点，发现解码器侧更新能高度重建医学基准指标变化，但组件层面的定位并不唯一，因此区分了更新级重建与组件级解释。
Motivation: 现有对专科语言模型的理解通常依赖端点增益（generalist 分数低、specialist 分数高），而发布的权重更新本身几乎未被审计；本文试图填补这一空白。
Method: 提出成对权重增量路径审计，分析完整解码器侧更新对医学基准变化的保留程度，并结合混合离域移动、10 个种子的匹配对照与端点锚定回滚来检验组件层面的解释。
Result: 两对模型中完整解码器侧更新对医学基准移动的重建分别达到 0.974 和 1.183 的端点归一化保留；MLP 在两个模型对中都是最强的宽泛组件族，但无法得到唯一的粗粒度组件解释。
Conclusion: 审计将更新级重建与组件级解释分开，结论仅涉及纯文本多选基准上的性能移动，不涉及临床验证、修复或电路级机制。

papers.title: CARD: Diagnosing Belief to Action Routing Failures in Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Linear probes and activation steering have uncovered that vision-language models (VLMs) internally represent mental states such as agents' beliefs, knowledge, and intentions. However, it is unclear whether and how these representations are used by downstream predictions along these axes. To close this gap, we introduce Cross-Axis Routing Diagnostic (CARD), which steers activations along one axis while measuring the response of a different axis's prediction. Applied to open-weight VLMs on Relay Chain -- a new cooperative grid-world benchmark we propose -- we diagnose a critical routing failure: models fail to incorporate belief representations into their next action prediction, effectively leaving valuable information about their partners unused.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出跨轴路由诊断工具 Cross-Axis Routing Diagnostic (CARD)：沿一个轴（如信念）干预激活，同时测量另一轴（如动作预测）的输出响应，以检验视觉语言模型 (VLM) 内部的心理状态表征是否被下游预测实际使用。作者在自建的合作式网格世界基准 Relay Chain 上测试开放权重 VLM，发现一个关键路由失败：模型没有将关于伙伴的信念表征纳入下一步动作预测，导致有价值信息被闲置。
Motivation: 已有工作通过线性探针 (linear probes) 和激活引导 (activation steering) 表明 VLM 内部能表示智能体的信念、知识、意图等心理状态，但尚不清楚这些表征是否以及如何被下游预测使用；这一 gap 促使作者提出系统化的跨轴诊断方法。
Method: 引入 Cross-Axis Routing Diagnostic (CARD)，核心思路是沿其中一个轴引导激活，再观察另一个轴预测的响应变化，从而判断表征是否被路由到下游任务；同时提出 Relay Chain，一个合作式网格世界基准，用于在受控场景中检验该问题。
Result: 在开放权重 VLM 上的实验中，CARD 诊断出关键失败模式：模型未能把信念表征整合进下一步动作预测，即关于伙伴状态的信息没有参与行动决策。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该诊断揭示了从信念表征到动作预测的跨轴路由失败：模型虽能内部表征信念，却未在下游动作预测中利用它；CARD 可作为研究此类跨轴表征路由问题的诊断工具。

papers.title: Fuzzy-MoE: Interpretable Regime-Conditioned Expert Routing for Non-Stationary Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: In non-stationary multivariate time series, different variables and samples often exhibit heterogeneous latent dynamic states, while existing deep forecasting models usually compress them into a unified end-to-end mapping, leading to suboptimal modeling of time-varying dynamics and limited interpretability regarding which forecasting mechanism is activated under different latent states. To overcome these limitations, we reformulate time series forecasting as a unified framework of latent temporal state identification and interpretable expert routing, and propose Fuzzy-MoE, a fuzzy logic-based dynamic Mixture-of-Experts model. Fuzzy-MoE consists of multiple parallel expert mapping networks and a dual-view fuzzy router. By jointly exploiting local convolutional dynamics and global segmented statistics, the router infers latent temporal states and computes expert activation strengths through learnable Gaussian membership functions, enabling explicit IF-THEN rule-based expert selection. This fine-grained routing strategy allows different variables within the same sequence to activate different experts, effectively capturing heterogeneous temporal dynamics while improving model interpretability. Experimental results on multiple public time series benchmark datasets show that Fuzzy-MoE significantly outperforms mainstream forecasting methods in forecasting accuracy. Moreover, fuzzy memberships and rule activations provide interpretable routing diagnostics, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed framework in both forecasting performance and mechanism transparency. Unlike traditional MoE models that use black-box routing, Fuzzy-MoE`s routing is based on clear, interpretable fuzzy rules. This makes the expert selection transparent and traceable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳多元时间序列中不同变量和样本呈现异质潜在动态状态的问题，提出 Fuzzy-MoE，一种基于模糊逻辑的动态 Mixture-of-Experts 预测模型。模型由多个并行专家映射网络和双视图模糊路由器组成，路由器联合利用局部卷积动态与全局分段统计，通过可学习高斯隶属函数推断潜在时间状态并计算专家激活强度，实现显式 IF-THEN 规则驱动的专家选择。摘要报告在多个公开时间序列基准上显著优于主流预测方法，并提供可解释的路由诊断。
Motivation: 现有深度预测模型通常将非平稳多元时间序列压缩成统一的端到端映射，难以刻画随时间变化的潜在动态状态，且路由机制不可解释，无法明确回答不同潜在状态下激活的是哪种预测机制。
Method: 将时间序列预测重构为潜在时间状态识别与可解释专家路由的统一框架，提出 Fuzzy-MoE，包含多个并行专家网络和双视图模糊路由器；路由器用局部卷积动态与全局分段统计推断潜在状态，并以高斯隶属函数生成模糊规则驱动的专家激活强度，允许同一序列中不同变量激活不同专家。
Result: 在多个公开时间序列基准数据集上，Fuzzy-MoE 的预测准确率显著优于主流预测方法；模糊隶属度和规则激活还可作为可解释的路由诊断依据。
Conclusion: 作者强调与传统黑盒路由 MoE 不同，Fuzzy-MoE 的路由基于清晰可解释的模糊规则，使专家选择透明可追溯，在预测性能与机制可解释性两方面同时有效。
Relevance: 32

summary_sections.method: 将时间序列预测重构为潜在时间状态识别与可解释专家路由的统一框架，提出 Fuzzy-MoE，包含多个并行专家网络和双视图模糊路由器；路由器用局部卷积动态与全局分段统计推断潜在状态，并以高斯隶属函数生成模糊规则驱动的专家激活强度，允许同一序列中不同变量激活不同专家。
summary_sections.result: 在多个公开时间序列基准数据集上，Fuzzy-MoE 的预测准确率显著优于主流预测方法；模糊隶属度和规则激活还可作为可解释的路由诊断依据。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调与传统黑盒路由 MoE 不同，Fuzzy-MoE 的路由基于清晰可解释的模糊规则，使专家选择透明可追溯，在预测性能与机制可解释性两方面同时有效。

papers.title: DiGS-Avatar: Single-Image Animatable 3D Human Reconstruction via UV-Space Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Single-image 3D human reconstruction often suffers from over-smoothed textures and geometric inconsistencies. While diffusion models improve generative quality, their reliance on multi-view synthesis prior to 3D reconstruction is computationally expensive and prone to view inconsistency. We propose DiGS-Avatar, which reformulates this task as an efficient, diffusion-based UV-latent completion task, ensuring 3D consistency by design. To capture accurate spatial structure, we introduce a teacher-student framework where a multi-view teacher provides geometrically aligned pseudo-ground-truth latents to supervise a single-view diffusion student. Treating this inferred latent as a robust structural skeleton, our method injects high-level semantic features to accurately recover fine textural details without disrupting spatial integrity. The refined representation is then decoded into 3D Gaussian primitives. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiGS-Avatar achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive visual fidelity and zero-shot generalization, while reconstructing a fully animatable 3D avatar in just 0.71 seconds. Code is available at https://github.com/KLMAV-CUC/DiGS-Avatar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiGS-Avatar，将单图三维人体重建重构为基于扩散模型的 UV-latent 补全任务，从而在设计上保证三维一致性。方法采用教师-学生框架：多视图教师提供几何对齐的伪真值 latent 来监督单视图扩散学生，并将推断出的 latent 视为结构骨架，注入高层语义特征以恢复精细纹理，最后解码为 3D Gaussian 基元。实验表明其在视觉保真度和零样本泛化上达到 SOTA 或具竞争力的水平，并在 0.71 秒内重建出可动画化的三维头像。
Motivation: 单图三维人体重建常受限于过度平滑的纹理和几何不一致问题；现有扩散模型虽提升生成质量，但依赖先进行多视图合成再三维重建，计算开销大且易出现视图不一致。
Method: 提出教师-学生框架，由多视图教师生成几何对齐的伪真值 latent 训练单视图扩散学生；将推断的 latent 作为结构骨架，通过注入高层语义特征恢复精细纹理细节，最终将细化表示解码为 3D Gaussian 基元。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在视觉保真度和零样本泛化上达到 SOTA 或高度竞争性水平，并仅需 0.71 秒即可重建出完全可动画化的三维头像。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将单图重建转化为 UV-latent 补全可在设计上保证三维一致性，并显著提升效率；代码已开源。

papers.title: Hidden Axis of Uncertainty: Latent-Posterior Alignment in Graph Neural Networks with Bayesian Output Layers
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian Neural Networks (BNNs) with Bayesian output layers provide a principled and tractable framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty, yet the mechanisms shaping that uncertainty remain unclear. While conventional theory attributes uncertainty reduction to posterior contraction, the corresponding assumptions need not hold for deep models. In the Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with Bayesian output layers studied here, we observe that predictive uncertainty decreases as latent representations shift toward lower-variance posterior directions, even though the posterior variance does not contract. We term this behavior Latent-Posterior Alignment (LPA) and conduct interventional experiments that support its functional role in shaping predictive uncertainty. Building on this insight, we propose Alignment-Guided Learning (AGL), which explicitly promotes this alignment during training. AGL effectively reduces predictive uncertainty while preserving accuracy and improves structural calibration, ensuring that the model confidence faithfully mirrors underlying data density. These findings provide a new perspective on uncertainty dynamics in GNNs with mean-field Bayesian output layers, shifting the focus from the magnitude of the posterior to the geometric interplay between latent and parameter spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带贝叶斯输出层 (Bayesian output layers) 的图神经网络 (GNN) 中预测不确定性的形成机制。作者观察到，即使后验方差并未收缩，潜在表征向低方差后验方向移动时预测不确定性仍会下降，并将这一行为命名为 Latent-Posterior Alignment (LPA)。基于该观察，他们提出 Alignment-Guided Learning (AGL) 训练方法，在保持精度的同时降低预测不确定性并改善结构校准。
Motivation: 传统理论将不确定性降低归因于后验收缩，但该假设在深度模型中未必成立；BNN 带贝叶斯输出层时塑造不确定性的机制尚不明确。论文针对这一理论缺口，探究 GNN 中潜在表征与后验几何之间的关系。
Method: 作者在研究的一类带贝叶斯输出层的 GNN 上进行干预实验 (interventional experiments)，检验潜在表征朝低方差后验方向移动对预测不确定性的影响，并提出 Alignment-Guided Learning (AGL)，在训练中显式促进这种潜在-后验对齐。
Result: 摘要报告 AGL 在保持准确率的同时有效降低预测不确定性，并改善结构校准 (structural calibration)，使模型置信度更忠实地反映底层数据密度；同时记录了后验方差不收缩而不确定性仍下降的 LPA 现象。
Conclusion: 论文提出对带均值场贝叶斯输出层的 GNN 中不确定性动态的新视角，主张关注潜在空间与参数空间之间的几何相互作用而非后验的幅度大小。

papers.title: PSK at WMT 2026 MIST: Task-Specialized QLoRA Adapters for Multilingual Summarization and Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: We describe the PSK submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. Our system uses the 3.35B-parameter Tiny Aya Global model with three QLoRA adapters, one for each task. The adapters are trained on multilingual document-summary pairs, passage-based question answering, and filtered standalone question answering. The summarization data also includes scientific papers with their author-written abstracts. On our held-out split, the context and summarization adapters perform better than our multitask adapter, which was trained only on data supplied by the organizers. Results for open QA are mixed and vary with answer length and evaluation method. We therefore submit three systems with the same context and summarization adapters but different open-QA adapters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述 PSK 团队提交到 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务 (Multilingual Instruction Shared Task) 的系统。系统基于 3.35B 参数的 Tiny Aya Global 模型，为摘要、基于段落的问答和独立开放问答三个任务分别训练 QLoRA 适配器。摘要数据还包含科学论文及其作者撰写的摘要。在留出集上，上下文适配器和摘要适配器优于仅用组织者提供数据训练的多任务适配器，而开放问答的结果不稳定。
Motivation: 该工作针对多语言摘要与问答任务中任务专用适配器是否优于单一多任务适配器的问题，并参与 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务的评测。
Method: 使用 Tiny Aya Global 模型，为三个任务分别训练三个 QLoRA 适配器：多语言文档-摘要对、基于段落的问答以及过滤后的独立问答；摘要训练数据中混入了带作者摘要的科学论文。
Result: 在留出集上，上下文适配器和摘要适配器优于只使用组织者提供数据训练的多任务适配器；开放问答结果随答案长度和评测方法不同而表现不稳定。
Conclusion: 由于开放问答适配器表现不稳定，最终提交三个系统，共享相同的上下文和摘要适配器，但使用不同的开放问答适配器。

papers.title: Vis-Poison: Poisoning Visual Knowledge in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: While multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems increasingly rely on images as external knowledge sources, the introduction of poisoned visual evidence can severely compromise multimodal large language model (MLLM) generation. Unlike prior attacks that rely on altering textual metadata, we introduce Vis-Poison, a novel visual knowledge poisoning attack where the poisoned image itself is the attacker-controlled payload, without manipulating captions, summaries, metadata, or other associated text. Specifically, this attack is instantiated through an automated multi-agent method that constructs visually plausible poisoned images. To assess its impact, we evaluate Vis-Poison across two representative multimodal RAG pipelines, four embedding models, and six generation models. Empirically, Vis-Poison achieves an end-to-end attack success rate of 40.16\% to 65.40\% against 30k-entry multimodal knowledge bases in \emph{black-box} settings. Moreover, Vis-Poison remains effective against various MLLMs that can answer correctly from parametric knowledge alone, with an average success rate above 60\%. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SWUFE-DB-Group/Vis-Poison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Vis-Poison，一种针对多模态检索增强生成 (RAG) 的视觉知识投毒攻击：攻击载荷仅存在于图像本身，不修改字幕、摘要、元数据或任何关联文本。攻击通过自动化多智能体方法构造视觉上合理的投毒图像，并在两个多模态 RAG 流程、四个嵌入模型与六个生成模型上评估，黑盒环境下对 30k 条目的知识库取得 40.16% 到 65.40% 的端到端攻击成功率。
Motivation: 多模态 RAG 系统越来越依赖图像作为外部知识来源，但现有攻击主要依赖篡改文本元数据；若投毒证据以纯视觉形式存在，则更隐蔽且更难防御，构成对 MLLM 生成的严重威胁。
Method: 提出 Vis-Poison 攻击方法，将投毒图像本身作为攻击者控制的载荷，不改变任何文本信息；通过自动化多智能体 (multi-agent) 流程构造视觉上看似合理的投毒图像，以注入对抗性视觉知识。
Result: 在两种多模态 RAG 管道、四种嵌入模型和六种生成模型上评估；黑盒设置下对 30k 条目的多模态知识库，端到端攻击成功率为 40.16% 到 65.40%；对仅凭参数知识即可正确回答的各种 MLLM，平均成功率高于 60%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调纯视觉投毒在多模态 RAG 中的有效性，说明仅依赖文本元数据防护的攻击视角存在盲区；代码和数据已公开。

papers.title: Natural-Language-Guided Generator-Agnostic Shortlisting for Protein Binder Design
papers.abstract_en: Modern de novo design workflows generate many candidate protein binders, but wet-lab validation capacity remains limited, making shortlisting a major bottleneck. We study whether LLMs can generate multi-metric ranking policies from precomputed structural-confidence and interface-quality proxy scores. Rather than proposing a new protein binder design pipeline, we focus on post-generation binder shortlisting: selecting the final top-K candidates from already generated binder pools using a shared panel of precomputed proxy scores. On the 10-target held-out split, averaging performance over five sampled global iterative gpt-4o policies reaches 0.589 Recall@10, modestly improving over the strongest single-feature fixed baseline, Protenix binder ipTM, which reaches 0.571 Recall@10. On the 3-target held-out subset comprising Nipah, RBX1, and TREM2, target-conditioned iterative gpt-5.4 policies reach the strongest LLM performance, with 0.519 Recall@10 and 0.583 NDCG@10. These results suggest that LLM-generated ranking policies can act as an interpretable post-generation decision layer for combining heterogeneous proxy metrics to prioritize binders from large candidate pools.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用 LLM 从预计算的构象置信度与界面质量代理分数生成多指标排序策略，用于蛋白质结合物生成后的 top-K 短列表筛选，而非提出新的结合物设计流程。在 10 个目标的留出集上，五条全局迭代 gpt-4o 策略的平均 Recall@10 为 0.589，略优于最强单特征固定基线 Protenix binder ipTM 的 0.571。结果表明 LLM 生成的排序策略可作为可解释的后生成决策层。
Motivation: 现代 de novo 设计流程会生成大量候选蛋白结合物，而湿实验验证能力有限，使得从候选池中筛选最终 top-K 成为主要瓶颈。
Method: 不使用新的设计管线，而是基于共享的预计算代理分数面板，让 LLM（gpt-4o 与 gpt-5.4）生成全局或目标条件化的迭代排序策略，用于对已生成的结合物池进行短列表筛选。
Result: 在 10 目标留出集上，五条 gpt-4o 全局迭代策略的平均 Recall@10 为 0.589，超过单特征基线 Protenix binder ipTM 的 0.571；在 Nipah、RBX1、TREM2 三个目标的子集上，目标条件化的 gpt-5.4 迭代策略达到最强 LLM 性能，Recall@10 为 0.519、NDCG@10 为 0.583。
Conclusion: LLM 生成的排序策略可以作为可解释的后生成决策层，用于组合异构代理指标并从大规模候选池中优先选择结合物。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究用 LLM 从预计算的构象置信度与界面质量代理分数生成多指标排序策略，用于蛋白质结合物生成后的 top-K 短列表筛选，而非提出新的结合物设计流程。在 10 个目标的留出集上，五条全局迭代 gpt-4o 策略的平均 Recall@10 为 0.589，略优于最强单特征固定基线 Protenix binder ipTM 的 0.571。结果表明 LLM 生成的排序策略可作为可解释的后生成决策层。

papers.title: SPARK-SAM: Self-Prompt Adaptation with Response Knowledge for SAM in Infrared Small Target Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Promptable segmentation models provide a reusable interface, but direct transfer to automatic infrared small-target segmentation (IRSTD) exposes a mismatch between spatial prompts and target-domain mask responses. In a diagnostic using target-covering loose-box prompts deterministically derived from test reference masks, the best official SAM2.1 results are only 4.69%, 1.64%, and 2.28% IoU on NUAA-SIRST, NUDT-SIRST, and IRSTD-1K. We introduce SPARK-SAM (Self-Prompt Adaptation with Response Knowledge for SAM), which learns target-domain response knowledge and conditions the decoder through an image-conditioned joint self-prompt state. Training combines benchmark-mask supervision with reliability-aware response guidance. SPARK-SAM achieves 75.78%, 86.49%, and 68.34% IoU with 0.726M additional parameters, ranking first on two benchmarks among 14 retrained SAM variants and adaptations evaluated as automatic image-to-mask methods. The staged IRSTD-1K diagnostic shows that response adaptation reaches most of the final IoU before the predicted points acquire reliable target grounding. Prompt supervision aligns the predicted prompt candidates with target locations, and frozen-weight interventions measure output sensitivity to the joint self-prompt state. Matched ablations show consistent accuracy gains from response guidance and high-resolution prompt refinement across all three datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/Sakauma/SPARK-SAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPARK-SAM，解决 SAM 直接迁移到红外小目标分割（IRSTD）时空间提示与目标域掩码响应不匹配的问题。该方法学习目标域响应知识，并用图像条件联合自提示状态调节解码器；训练结合基准掩码监督与可靠性感知响应引导。摘要报告在 NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST、IRSTD-1K 上分别达到 75.78%、86.49%、68.34% 的 IoU，额外参数仅 0.726M，在 14 个重训练的 SAM 变体中两个基准排名第一。
Motivation: 提示分割模型的直接迁移在自动红外小目标分割中暴露了空间提示与目标域掩码响应之间的失配：在由测试参考掩码导出的目标覆盖松散框提示下，官方 SAM2.1 在三个数据集上仅得到 4.69%、1.64%、2.28% 的 IoU，说明需要显式适配目标域的响应知识。
Method: 引入 SPARK-SAM，学习目标域响应知识，并通过图像条件联合自提示状态（image-conditioned joint self-prompt state）来调节解码器。训练采用基准掩码监督与可靠性感知响应引导，并包含提示监督与冻结权重干预以分析模型对联合自提示状态的敏感性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 NUAA-SIRST、NUDT-SIRST、IRSTD-1K 上分别取得 75.78%、86.49%、68.34% 的 IoU，仅增加 0.726M 参数，在 14 个重训练 SAM 变体中两个基准排名第一。分阶段诊断显示响应适应在预测点获得可靠目标接地之前就贡献了大部分最终 IoU；匹配消融表明响应引导与高分辨率提示细化在三个数据集上均带来一致的精度提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调响应知识适配与联合自提示状态能有效弥合提示分割模型与自动红外小目标分割之间的差距，并已公开代码。

papers.title: Identity-Preserving Text-to-Video Generation via Agentic Enhancement and Semantic Repair
papers.abstract_en: Identity-preserving video generation aims to synthesize videos that follow natural-language instructions while maintaining the visual identity of a given subject. Recent commercial video generation models have achieved strong visual quality and motion realism, but they still suffer from identity drift, incomplete instruction following, and missing visual details under complex prompts. Since these models are usually closed-source black boxes, directly improving them through parameter optimization is often infeasible. We therefore propose Agentic Enhancement and Semantic Repair (AESR), a lightweight enhancement framework for identity-preserving video generation. To improve prompt construction before generation and mitigate the above failures, AESR introduces a global agentic prompt enhancement module. This module learns model-specific prompting formats from official documentation, acquires human-centered video generation priors from human-interaction data, and accumulates test-domain identity-preserving generation experience into a reusable playbook through an agentic loop. To further repair errors in videos generated with enhanced prompts, AESR introduces a sample-level visual semantic repair module, which uses a VLM to locate erroneous video segments and design repair instructions, edits selected frames into explicit visual references, and guides a video editing model to fix local semantic or identity-related errors. We also adopt a lightweight Mixture-of-Experts selection strategy to choose reliable outputs from different generation and refinement paths. Under the official evaluation protocol of the ACM MM 2026 Identity-Preserving Video Generation Challenge, our system MIPL\_Video ranked first in Track 1, demonstrating the effectiveness of AESR for practical identity-preserving video generation. The code is available at https://github.com/oceanflowlab/AESR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic Enhancement and Semantic Repair (AESR)，一种面向身份保持视频生成的轻量级增强框架。该框架在生成前通过全局智能体提示增强模块改进提示词构建，在生成后通过样本级视觉语义修复模块用 VLM 定位并修复错误片段，并采用轻量级 MoE 选择策略挑选可靠输出。在 ACM MM 2026 身份保持视频生成挑战赛 Track 1 中，基于 AESR 的 MIPL_Video 系统排名第一。
Motivation: 现有商用视频生成模型在复杂提示下仍存在身份漂移、指令遵循不完整和视觉细节缺失的问题，且模型通常是闭源黑盒，无法直接通过参数优化改进，因此需要不依赖模型内部参数的轻量级增强方案。
Method: 提出 AESR 框架，包含两部分：一是全局智能体提示增强模块，通过学习官方文档中的模型特定提示格式、从人机交互数据中获取以人为中心的视频生成先验，并通过智能体循环积累可复用的测试域身份保持生成经验；二是样本级视觉语义修复模块，使用 VLM 定位错误视频片段并设计修复指令，将选定帧编辑为显式视觉参考，引导视频编辑模型修复局部语义或身份相关错误。此外采用轻量级 Mixture-of-Experts 选择策略从不同生成与修复路径中挑选可靠输出。
Result: 在 ACM MM 2026 身份保持视频生成挑战赛官方评测协议下，该系统 MIPL_Video 在 Track 1 中排名第一，验证了 AESR 在实用身份保持视频生成中的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AESR 为闭源黑盒视频生成模型提供了一种可行的轻量级增强路径，通过生成前提示增强与生成后语义修复相结合来缓解身份漂移等问题；摘要未提及该方法在其他视频生成任务或基准上的泛化表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generating Multi-view Adversarial Examples for Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
papers.abstract_en: The Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT) enables unified feed-forward 3D reconstruction from multi-view images. However, deploying such a high-performance model may expose critical security vulnerabilities. Traditional adversarial perturbations require costly per-scene optimization, while Universal Adversarial Perturbations (UAPs) rely on a single static pattern and fail to effectively attack VGGT. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{MVAP-G}, a multi-view adversarial perturbation generator that produces imperceptible consistent perturbations across multiple views in a single feed-forward pass. To ensure perturbation consistency across diverse scenes, we design a cross-view adversarial alignment mechanism to process multi-view images. Experiments demonstrate that MVAP-G significantly degrades VGGT performance without iterative optimization during inference. This work pioneers multi-view adversarial attacks on 3D foundation models, uncovering severe vulnerabilities and underscoring the urgent need for robust 3D vision systems. The code is available at https://github.com/qsong2001/mvap-g.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MVAP-G，一种针对视觉几何接地 Transformer（VGGT）的多视图对抗扰动生成器，可在单次前向传播中为多个视图生成不可感知且一致的扰动，无需推理时迭代优化。摘要称实验表明 MVAP-G 能显著降低 VGGT 的 3D 重建性能，并称该工作是首个针对 3D 基础模型的多视图对抗攻击。
Motivation: 传统对抗扰动需要对每个场景进行昂贵的逐场景优化，而通用对抗扰动（UAP）依赖单一静态模式，无法有效攻击 VGGT。作者希望绕过这两类方法的局限，提供一种高效且跨视图一致的多视图攻击方式。
Method: 提出多视图对抗扰动生成器 MVAP-G，以单次前向传播生成多个视图上的不可感知且一致的扰动；同时设计跨视图对抗对齐机制（cross-view adversarial alignment）来保证扰动在不同场景间的一致性。
Result: 摘要报告 MVAP-G 在无需推理时迭代优化的条件下显著降低 VGGT 的性能，代码已开源。
Conclusion: 该工作率先探索对 3D 基础模型的多视图对抗攻击，揭示其严重安全漏洞，并强调构建鲁棒 3D 视觉系统的紧迫性。

papers.title: Is Multimodal Speculative Decoding Ready for Diffusion-Based Parallel Drafting? A Survey and Empirical Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by allowing a lightweight drafter to propose future tokens while a target model verifies them in parallel. Its lossless guarantee has motivated a line of work that pushes the drafter itself toward parallel generation. The most recent paradigm is block-parallel generative drafting, including diffusion-based methods such as DFlash and DSpark, achieving up to 3.6x speedup on common daily chatting tasks. While this transition is well studied in text-only LLMs, its applicability to multimodal models remains an open question. Existing multimodal speculative decoding efforts focus on input compression, adapter alignment, candidate coverage, or modality-specific verification; however, block-parallel generative drafting remains largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, this paper combines a modality-centered survey with a cross-architecture empirical study to ask: Is multimodal speculative decoding ready for diffusion-based parallel drafting? In this survey, we systematically analyze a wide spectrum of multimodal models, spanning Vision-Language, Video-Language, Audio, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures, from the dual perspectives of drafting parallelism and cross-modal information interaction. We introduce a unified taxonomy that isolates drafter-side parallelism from orthogonal design choices such as tree construction and verification strategies. Furthermore, we provide a comprehensive empirical comparison of existing methods under varying degrees of parallelism across standardized multimodal benchmarks, including OCR, VQA, visual reasoning, and image captioning. Finally, we summarize the limitations of current approaches, discuss open challenges, and outline promising future directions for this rapidly evolving field.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对多模态投机解码（multimodal speculative decoding）的综述与实证诊断，核心问题是扩散式并行草拟（diffusion-based parallel drafting）能否迁移到多模态模型。作者以模态为中心梳理了视觉-语言、视频-语言、音频以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）架构，提出一个统一分类法，将草拟端并行性与树构建、验证策略等正交设计分离，并在 OCR、VQA、视觉推理和图像描述等标准多模态基准上对不同并行度下的现有方法做了实证比较。摘要指出块并行生成式草拟（block-parallel generative drafting）在多模态领域仍基本未被探索。
Motivation: 投机解码在纯文本大语言模型中已从轻量草拟发展到块并行生成式草拟，扩散类方法如 DFlash 和 DSpark 在常见对话任务上取得最高 3.6 倍加速；但现有多模态投机解码工作多集中于输入压缩、适配器对齐、候选覆盖或模态特定验证，块并行生成式草拟的适用性仍是开放问题。
Method: 将模态中心的综述与跨架构实证研究相结合：系统分析涵盖 Vision-Language、Video-Language、Audio 和 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）的多模态模型，提出统一分类法以区分草拟端并行度与树构建、验证策略等正交设计，并在多种标准化多模态基准上对不同并行度方法进行实证对比。
Result: 摘要报告 DFlash 和 DSpark 等扩散式草拟方法在常见日常对话任务上可达最高 3.6 倍加速；本文在此基础上提供了多模态基准下的实证比较，并总结了现有方法的局限与开放挑战，但未给出多模态任务上的具体加速或准确率数字。
Conclusion: 作者强调块并行生成式草拟在多模态投机解码中仍鲜有探索，并基于综述与诊断归纳了当前方法的局限性、开放挑战及未来研究方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 DFlash 和 DSpark 等扩散式草拟方法在常见日常对话任务上可达最高 3.6 倍加速；本文在此基础上提供了多模态基准下的实证比较，并总结了现有方法的局限与开放挑战，但未给出多模态任务上的具体加速或准确率数字。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调块并行生成式草拟在多模态投机解码中仍鲜有探索，并基于综述与诊断归纳了当前方法的局限性、开放挑战及未来研究方向。

papers.title: VisTa3D: A Dataset and Benchmark for Thin Object Reconstruction from Vision, Tactile, and 3D Point Clouds
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art 3D reconstruction models, whether from visual, range, or both, tend to underperform on thin objects. This is partially due to the small amount of space such objects occupy in RGB images and in 3D point clouds. To test the extent of their errors, we collected the first thin object dataset comprising of synchronized RGB images, depth maps, and tactile response maps, where each frame is associated with inertial measurements, camera pose and calibration, and groundtruth depth and segmentation maps obtained from laser scanning of thin objects. We hypothesize that tactile data can aid in the reconstruction of thin objects as their response maps provide local shape and deformation information. Our dataset, termed VisTa3D, comprises of 387 scenes covering 70 thin objects over 17 environments. We benchmarked current 3D reconstruction models on VisTa3D and found that, indeed, they exhibit low fidelity on thin objects. To test if tactile data can help, we introduce the first visual-range-tactile 3D reconstruction model as a baseline. Code and data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/shaniaguo/VisTa3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VisTa3D，据称是第一个面向薄物体重建的同步 RGB 图像、深度图和触觉响应图数据集，包含 387 个场景、70 个薄物体、17 种环境，并配有惯性测量、相机位姿与标定以及激光扫描得到的真值深度和分割图。作者在 VisTa3D 上评测了现有 3D 重建模型，发现它们在薄物体上保真度低；为验证触觉数据的作用，他们提出了第一个视觉-距离-触觉 3D 重建基线模型。
Motivation: 现有最先进的 3D 重建模型，无论仅使用视觉、仅使用距离数据还是两者结合，在薄物体上的表现都不佳，部分原因是这类物体在 RGB 图像和 3D 点云中所占空间很小。作者收集该数据集以测试误差程度，并假设触觉响应图能提供局部形状与形变信息，从而帮助薄物体重建。
Method: 构建 VisTa3D 数据集，包含同步的 RGB 图像、深度图、触觉响应图，及惯性测量、相机位姿和标定、激光扫描得到的真值深度与分割图；同时引入第一个融合视觉、距离和触觉模态的 3D 重建模型作为基线。
Result: 对现有 3D 重建模型在 VisTa3D 上的基准测试表明，它们在薄物体上确实表现出较低的保真度；摘要未报告基线模型相对现有方法的具体数值提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调触觉数据有望辅助薄物体重建，并公开了代码与数据；但未在摘要层面给出基线模型性能改善的量化结论。

papers.title: Continuous-Time Quantum Walks based Graph Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are widely used on graph-structured data, but most suffer from two key weaknesses. First, message passing behaves as a low-pass filter under the homophily assumption, leading to poor performance on heterophilic graphs. Second, stacking layers drives node features toward constants, causing over-smoothing. Existing methods usually address these issues separately, while the few joint solutions rely largely on empirical heuristics, and many over-smoothing remedies sacrifice model expressiveness. We propose \textbf{CTQW-GNN}, a GNN based on Continuous-Time Quantum Walks (CTQW), to address both issues with theoretical justification. Its design exploits two properties of the CTQW propagator $e^{-\mathrm{i}Ht}$. First, it is unitary and has eigenvalues on the unit circle, so no frequency component is damped, counteracting the low-pass bias. Second, unitarity preserves feature norms and prevents the Dirichlet energy from decaying exponentially with depth, thereby mitigating over-smoothing. CTQW-GNN combines three complementary aggregation modules. \textit{CTQW-based Aggregation} evolves node features through the unitary propagator, preserving mid- and high-frequency signals for heterophilic graphs while preventing Dirichlet-energy collapse. \textit{CTQW-Attention Aggregation} constructs a multi-hop neighbor graph from CTQW amplitudes and applies attention over it, enabling access to distant homophilic nodes missed by single-hop aggregation. \textit{LF Aggregation} uses a standard low-pass GAT branch to retain strong performance on homophilic graphs, where pure CTQW aggregation can be suboptimal. We further provide a spectral-gap analysis explaining energy preservation and a Lieb--Robinson-type bound that gives a principled rule for selecting the walk time $t$.
papers.journal_ref: CIKM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CTQW-GNN，一种基于连续时间量子游走 (Continuous-Time Quantum Walks, CTQW) 的图神经网络，旨在同时解决异配图上的低通滤波偏差和深层网络的过平滑问题。设计利用酉传播子 e^{-iHt} 的酉性与特征值位于单位圆上的性质，避免频率分量被衰减并保持特征范数，从而缓解过平滑。模型组合三种聚合模块，并提供谱隙分析与 Lieb-Robinson 型界来选择行走时间 t。
Motivation: 大多数 GNN 在同配假设下表现为低通滤波器，在异配图上性能下降；同时堆叠层数会使节点特征趋于常数，导致过平滑。现有方法通常单独处理这两个问题，少数联合方案依赖经验启发式，且许多过平滑解法牺牲模型表达能力。
Method: CTQW-GNN 利用 CTQW 传播子 e^{-iHt} 的酉性：特征值在单位圆上使频率分量不被阻尼，从而抵消低通偏差；酉性保持特征范数，防止 Dirichlet 能量随深度指数衰减。模型组合三个互补聚合模块：CTQW-based Aggregation 通过酉传播子演化节点特征以保留中高频信号；CTQW-Attention Aggregation 由 CTQW 振幅构造多跳邻居图并施加注意力以访问远处同配节点；LF Aggregation 使用标准低通 GAT 分支保持同配图上的性能。
Result: 摘要给出理论分析而非数值基准：谱隙分析解释能量保持，Lieb-Robinson 型界为行走时间 t 的选择提供原则性规则。设计上证明 CTQW 聚合能保留中高频信号并防止 Dirichlet 能量坍缩，而纯 CTQW 在同配图上可能次优，因此保留低通分支。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CTQW-GNN 同时以理论依据应对异配性与过平滑问题，并认为该框架可为两类缺陷提供统一解决方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ForeTime-VLA: Causal Future-Token Distillation from a World Action Model for Conveyor-Belt Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Manipulating moving objects requires a policy to anticipate contact events, yet vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly fine-tuned from the current observation alone. World action models (WAMs) learn predictive dynamics, but running a video-scale teacher or explicitly imagining future frames at deployment is costly. We introduce ForeTime-VLA, a dense pi0.5 policy that distills a future-aware, action-equivalent representation from a frozen Fast-WAM-derived teacher while remaining causal at inference. Offline, current and future video latents are compressed into a whitened 64-D target. Online, an eight-frame history encoder predicts this target together with manipulation phase and normalized time-to-transition. Four future tokens and one phase token condition the VLM prefix, while the predicted future and transition horizon condition the action expert. Training retains the original flow-matching action target and adds cosine, relational geometry, phase, time-to-transition, and action-equivalence objectives. On a deduplicated conveyor-belt dataset, we compare 40k-step checkpoints on 768 matched windows per split. Test MAE decreases from 0.134119 to 0.130593 (2.63%; paired-bootstrap 95% CI: 0.82-4.48% improvement), and test L2 decreases by 3.02%, at a 2.46-2.93% latency cost. In quantitative real-robot evaluation, ForeTime-VLA achieves 81.1% stationary and 58.9% slow-moving grasp success, exceeding the next-best reference by 12.2 and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. Across three belt speeds, it completes 44/90 grasps versus 23/90 for pi0.5, including 11/30 versus 2/30 at fast speed. The agreement between offline orientation gains and reduced real-robot contact-pose failures supports causal future-token distillation as an effective way to improve dynamic manipulation without deploying the world-model teacher.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Introduces ForeTime-VLA, a causal future-token distillation method for conveyor-belt manipulation from a frozen world action model teacher
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ForeTime-VLA，一种保持因果推理的稠密 pi0.5 策略，通过从冻结的 Fast-WAM 派生教师模型中蒸馏未来感知且动作等价 (action-equivalent) 的表征，改善传送带动态操作。离线阶段将当前与未来视频隐变量压缩为白化的 64 维目标，在线时用八帧历史编码器联合预测该目标、操作阶段与归一化时间到过渡 (time-to-transition)；四个未来 token 和一个阶段 token 条件化 VLM 前缀，预测的未来与过渡时域条件化动作专家。在去重后的传送带数据集上，测试 MAE 从 0.134119 降至 0.130593（2.63%），测试 L2 下降 3.02%，代价是 2.46-2.93% 的延迟增加；真实机器人评估中，静止与慢速移动抓取成功率分别达 81.1% 和 58.9%。
Motivation: 移动物体操作要求策略预判接触事件，但常见 VLA 策略仅从当前观测微调；世界动作模型 (WAM) 虽能学习预测动力学，但部署时运行视频规模的教师或显式想象未来帧成本高昂。
Method: ForeTime-VLA 从冻结的 Fast-WAM 派生教师中蒸馏未来感知、动作等价的 64 维白化目标，同时保持推理时因果性。在线编码器用八帧历史预测未来目标、操作阶段与归一化时间到过渡，四个未来 token 与一个阶段 token 条件化 VLM 前缀，预测的未来与过渡时域条件化动作专家；训练保留原始 flow-matching 动作目标，并增加余弦、关系几何、阶段、时间到过渡与动作等价损失。
Result: 在去重传送带数据集上，40k 步检查点在 768 个匹配窗口上评估，测试 MAE 降低 2.63%（配对 bootstrap 95% CI: 0.82-4.48%），测试 L2 降低 3.02%，延迟成本为 2.46-2.93%。真实机器人评估中，ForeTime-VLA 达到 81.1% 静止与 58.9% 慢速移动抓取成功率，分别超过次优基准 12.2 和 22.2 个百分点；在三种皮带速度下完成 44/90 次抓取，而 pi0.5 为 23/90，其中快速档为 11/30 对 2/30。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，离线方向性增益与真实机器人接触位姿失败的减少相互印证，说明因果未来 token 蒸馏是一种无需部署世界模型教师即可改进动态操作的有效途径。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Calibrating Criterion Revision in LLM Agents: Failure Modes and a Trace-Anchored Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Language-model agents can improve after failure or carry text across episodes without revising what counts as success. We study the narrower attribution problem of criterion revision: when criterion K0 accepts an outcome violating a broader commitment B, what observations justify saying that the system formed and persistently used K1? We require five non-compensatory conditions: criterion-failure detection, a model-emitted proposal, new-episode transfer, intervention sensitivity on the claimed carrier, and preservation. We evaluate CMB-0.1 on twelve cross-domain cases and four arms: stateless inference, append-only history, model-generated but harness-committed state, and evaluator-written oracle state. Seven mechanism fixtures yield 84 deterministic scorer trials; four local quantized artifacts yield 96 calls and 192 model-case-arm trials. No model trial satisfies all five conditions, but this zero does not establish general capability absence. Eleven calls remain invalid after one retry; several commitments disclose the target distinction; the harness performs commits; deletion reuses a stateless call; and conflict changes multiple factors. Qwen2.5-7B answers every transfer and preservation item without revision state, exposing zero-state reconstruction. These failures make CMB-0.1 an instrument-calibration result rather than a model ranking. We derive a prospective, trace-anchored CMB-0.4 protocol requiring concealed transfer, explicit WRITE/NO-WRITE/ESCALATE actions, a separately logged policy-selected commit, matched interventions, repeated hidden items, and a frozen executable oracle. It is a successor design, not a completed confirmatory result. The paper contributes a measurement chain, an empirical diagnosis of its first implementation, and a more discriminating protocol for future tests of criterion revision.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 1 figure. CMB-0.1 is an instrument-calibration study; CMB-0.4 is a prospective protocol, not an empirical result
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型智能体中的“准则修订”(criterion revision) 归因问题：当旧准则 K0 接受了一个违背更广泛承诺 B 的结果时，需要哪些观测才能声称系统形成了并持续使用新准则 K1。作者提出五个不可补偿的条件，并在 CMB-0.1 上对 12 个跨域案例和四个实验臂进行评估；没有任何模型试验满足全部五个条件，但作者强调这一零结果并不证明普遍能力缺失。文章进而推导出一个前瞻性的、基于轨迹锚定的 CMB-0.4 协议，作为后续判别力更强的测试设计。
Motivation: 现有关注点在于智能体失败后能否改进，或是否把文本跨 episode 携带，却没有仔细区分它是否真正修订了“什么算成功”的标准；缺乏对准则修订这一更窄归因问题的严格判定条件。
Method: 提出五个不可补偿条件：准则失败检测 (criterion-failure detection)、模型发出的提案 (model-emitted proposal)、新 episode 迁移 (new-episode transfer)、对声称载体的干预敏感性 (intervention sensitivity)、以及持续性 (preservation)。并构建 CMB-0.1 测量链：七个机制装置产生 84 次确定性评分试验，四个本地量化工件产生 96 次调用与 192 次模型-案例-臂试验；随后设计 CMB-0.4 协议，要求隐藏迁移、显式 WRITE/NO-WRITE/ESCALATE 动作、单独记录的策略选择提交、匹配干预、重复隐藏项目和冻结可执行 oracle。

papers.title: Enabling Memory-efficient Im2win Convolution with Multi-precision Support on GPU CUDA and Tensor Cores
papers.abstract_en: Convolution is a principal computational bottleneck in deep neural networks, and its efficiency depends on tight integration between algorithms and GPU hardware. Existing GPU convolution methods suffer from large memory overhead, poor cache utilization, limited effectiveness across kernel sizes, or numerical instability. This work extends the im2win paradigm -- a universal, memory-efficient convolution method with contiguous memory access for all kernel sizes -- to run efficiently in full precision on CUDA cores and half precision on tensor cores. By introducing new kernel designs and optimizations such as zig-zag memory access and asynchronous data movement, im2win efficiently exploits hardware-accelerated half-precision matrix multiply-accumulate operations. Across twelve CNN benchmarks, im2win achieves up to 2.8x higher TFLOPS than its CUDA core implementation, 1.4x higher than cuDNN, and 6.4x higher than GEMM-based convolution with cuBLAS, while using as little as 53% and 35% of their memory, respectively. These results establish im2win as a unified, high-performance convolution framework for modern GPU architectures.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN 2026). To appear in IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了 im2win 卷积范式，使其能在 CUDA core 上以全精度、在 tensor core 上以半精度高效运行，并引入 zig-zag 内存访问与异步数据移动等 kernel 级优化。在 12 个 CNN 基准上，该方法比自身 CUDA core 实现最高提升 2.8 倍 TFLOPS，比 cuDNN 高 1.4 倍，比基于 cuBLAS 的 GEMM 卷积高 6.4 倍，同时内存使用分别仅为其 53% 和 35%。摘要将其定位为面向现代 GPU 架构的统一高性能卷积框架。
Motivation: 现有 GPU 卷积方法存在内存开销大、缓存利用率差、跨 kernel size 有效性有限或数值不稳定等问题，需要一种同时具备内存高效和硬件适配能力的统一卷积实现。
Method: 以 im2win 范式为基础，设计新的 kernel 并引入 zig-zag 内存访问和异步数据移动，从而利用 tensor core 上硬件加速的半精度矩阵乘累加（matrix multiply-accumulate）运算，同时保留 CUDA core 上的全精度路径。
Result: 在 12 个 CNN 基准上，im2win 的 TFLOPS 相比其 CUDA core 实现最高提升 2.8 倍，比 cuDNN 高 1.4 倍，比 cuBLAS 的 GEMM 卷积高 6.4 倍；内存使用分别仅为 cuDNN 的 53% 和 cuBLAS 的 35%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 im2win 可作为现代 GPU 架构上的统一高性能卷积框架，兼顾全精度 CUDA core 与半精度 tensor core 的效率；文中未讨论局限性。

papers.title: AffordAny: Open-World 3D Affordance Grounding from Monocular RGB Images via Vision-Language-Guided Geometric Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Open-world 3D affordance grounding requires localizing functional object parts in 3D given free-form language queries. Existing methods typically assume pre-built object-centric 3D geometry and closed affordance ontologies, limiting deployment from raw RGB observations. We present AffordAny, an end-to-end framework that uses one monocular RGB image to construct large-scale text-conditioned 3D part supervision, ground affordances with a frozen vision-language model (VLM) guided decoder, and improve open-world generalization through pseudo-label self-training. Our automated pipeline produces a benchmark of 5,334 objects and 10,633 part-level samples spanning 473 categories, an order-of-magnitude increase in categorical diversity over prior work. The decoder progressively fuses frozen Cosmos-2B features with 3D geometry through spatial projection, instruction-conditioned semantic compression, and bidirectional geometry-semantics interaction. Minimal-perturbation pseudo-label self-training further adds new objects without human annotation. Under a systematic generalization protocol evaluating unseen objects, unseen categories, and unseen instruction paraphrases, our approach achieves 0.428 IoU on unseen objects and 0.315 IoU on unseen categories after self-training, with unseen-category mIoU improving by 6.3% relative (p<0.01) and an instruction sensitivity gap of only 0.105, demonstrating effectiveness and robustness of our method.
papers.comment: The code and dataset are publicly available. Code: https://github.com/lzlfwow/AffordAny. Dataset: https://modelscope.cn/datasets/lzlfwow/AffordAny
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AffordAny 是一个从单目 RGB 图像进行开放世界 3D 功能部件定位 (3D affordance grounding) 的端到端框架。它用自动化流水线从单目图像构建大规模文本条件下的 3D 部件监督，配合冻结视觉语言模型 (VLM) 引导的解码器和伪标签自训练，提升开放世界泛化。作者构建了 5,334 个物体、10,633 个部件级样本、覆盖 473 个类别的基准，类别多样性较以往工作提升一个数量级。在系统化泛化协议下，未见物体 IoU 为 0.428，未见类别 IoU 为 0.315，自训练后未见类别 mIoU 相对提升 6.3%。
Motivation: 现有开放世界 3D affordance grounding 方法通常假设预先构建的物体中心 3D 几何和封闭的 affordance 本体，限制了从原始 RGB 观测直接部署。本文目标是仅用一张单目 RGB 图像即可完成文本条件下的 3D 功能部件定位。
Method: 提出端到端框架 AffordAny，包含三条主线：从单目 RGB 图像自动化构建大规模文本条件 3D 部件监督；用冻结的 Cosmos-2B VLM 特征引导解码器，通过空间投影、指令条件语义压缩和双向几何-语义交互逐步融合 3D 几何；以及最小扰动 (minimal-perturbation) 的伪标签自训练，无需人工标注即可加入新物体。
Result: 自动化流水线生成 5,334 个物体、10,633 个部件级样本、473 个类别的基准，类别多样性比先前工作高一个数量级。在评估未见物体、未见类别和未见指令改写的系统化泛化协议下，未见物体 IoU 达 0.428，未见类别 IoU 达 0.315，自训练后未见类别 mIoU 相对提升 6.3%（p<0.01），指令敏感度差距仅为 0.105。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该方法在未见物体、未见类别和未见指令改写三种泛化场景下均有效且鲁棒，代码和数据集已公开。
