papers.title: DirEAG: Dirichlet Evidence Aggregation for Calibrating Verbalized Confidence in Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Reliable confidence estimation is essential for using large language models in mathematical reasoning, but black-box verbalized confidence is difficult to calibrate. When the same problem is queried under multiple confidence-steering prompts, the resulting answer-confidence observations contain useful uncertainty information, yet their scales may shift across steering levels, models, and datasets. Existing black-box uncertainty methods often rely on answer agreement, sample consistency, or entropy, which describe output variation but do not model the numerical meaning of self-reported confidence. Conversely, direct averaging or heuristic aggregation of elicited confidence cannot learn prompt- and task-dependent bias. We propose DirEAG, a Dirichlet Evidence Aggregation method that converts each elicited answer-confidence observation into calibrated soft evidence over generated candidate answers and an additional null state, allowing the model to represent cases where none of the candidates is correct. Experiments on GSM8K, SVAMP, and GSM-Hard with Qwen, Mistral, and Gemma models show that, compared with direct confidence averaging and heuristic confidence-steering aggregation, DirEAG often achieves better calibration while maintaining competitive answer selection. Ablations further reveal that evidence aggregation and final binary calibration address distinct parts of the calibration problem.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 3 figures. Code is available at https://github.com/horacehsugithub/DirEAG. Accepted by PRICAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DirEAG，一种基于 Dirichlet 证据聚合的置信度校准方法，用于数学推理任务中大语言模型的黑盒口头化置信度 (verbalized confidence)。该方法在多种置信度引导提示 (confidence-steering prompts) 下反复查询同一问题，把每次得到的答案-置信度观测转换为关于候选答案以及一个额外空状态 (null state) 的软证据，从而统一处理不同引导层级、模型和数据集间的尺度偏移。在 GSM8K、SVAMP 和 GSM-Hard 上搭配 Qwen、Mistral 与 Gemma 的实验表明，与直接置信度平均和启发式引导聚合相比，DirEAG 常能获得更好的校准效果，同时保持有竞争力的答案选择性能。
Motivation: 大语言模型在数学推理中的可靠性依赖于置信度估计，但黑盒口头化置信度难以校准；已有黑盒不确定性方法多依赖答案一致性、样本一致性或熵，只刻画输出变化，并未建模自报置信度的数值含义，而直接平均或启发式聚合又无法学习提示与任务相关的偏差。
Method: 提出 Dirichlet 证据聚合方法 DirEAG：将每次通过不同置信度引导提示诱导得到的答案-置信度观测转换为经过校准的软证据，分配到生成的候选答案与一个额外的空状态上；系统随机不确定性 (aleatoric uncertainty) 与认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty) 分别通过引导层级和单元样本的过离散效应 (overdispersion) 来建模，并使用 Dirichlet 分布将平均证据聚合起来，最后通过二元概率校准把聚合证据映射为校准的置信度。
Result: 在 GSM8K、SVAMP、GSM-Hard 数据集上使用 Qwen、Mistral 和 Gemma 系列模型的实验中，相比直接置信度平均与启发式置信度引导聚合，DirEAG 通常取得更好的校准效果，同时答案选择性能保持竞争力；消融实验进一步表明证据聚合与最终二元校准分别处理校准问题的不同部分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，把口头化置信度转化为 Dirichlet 软证据并聚合，能有效学习提示和任务相关的偏差而不依赖模型内部信息；证据聚合与最终二元校准两者互补，分别解决校准问题的不同侧面。

papers.title: AGIDefect-4K: A Richly Annotated Dataset for AI-Generated Image Defect Detection, Localization and Explanation
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI can now produce highly realistic images, yet current models still exhibit subtle but critical defects that undermine their reliability. While existing AI-generated image (AGI) evaluation benchmarks have made notable progress, comprehensive AGI defect diagnosis remains underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce AGIDefect-4K, a richly annotated dataset of 4,000 images from 15 state-of-the-art generative models spanning both open-source and closed-source systems. AGIDefect-4K features hierarchical defect annotations: (1) detection labels identifying whether defects exist, (2) pixel-level segmentation masks localizing defective regions, and (3) detailed textual explanations characterizing defect types and their perceptual impact. Each image is further annotated with an overall quality score. Building on this, we present AGIDA (AGI Defect Assistant), a baseline framework leveraging Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) for joint defect detection, localization, explanation, and quality prediction. Comprehensive benchmarking on AGIDefect-4K reveals that AGI defect understanding remains challenging, underscoring the value of this dataset. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/sxfly99/AGIDefect-4K.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AGIDefect-4K，一个包含 4000 张来自 15 个开源与闭源生成式模型图像的数据集，用于 AI 生成图像缺陷诊断。数据集提供层次化标注：缺陷存在性检测标签、像素级分割掩码、缺陷类型及感知影响的文本解释，以及整体质量分数。作者还提出基于多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的基线框架 AGIDA，进行联合缺陷检测、定位、解释与质量预测。基准评测表明 AGI 缺陷理解仍具挑战性，数据集已公开。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像 (AGI) 评估基准虽有进展，但全面的缺陷诊断仍未被充分探索；当前生成模型仍会产生细微但关键的缺陷，影响其可靠性。
Method: 构建 AGIDefect-4K 数据集，包含分层缺陷标注（检测标签、像素级分割掩码、文本解释、质量分数）；在此基础上提出 AGIDA 基线框架，利用多模态大语言模型联合完成缺陷检测、定位、解释和质量预测。
Result: 在 AGIDefect-4K 上的综合基准评测显示，AGI 缺陷理解仍然具有挑战性，说明该数据集具有研究价值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该数据集弥补了 AGI 缺陷诊断研究的空白，并公开数据集以促进后续研究；摘要未提及方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Object Detection for Vision Transformer-Based Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose a novel object detection method that enables us to protect sensitive visual information of test images. Previous studies considering visual information protection focus on image classification tasks. This paper proposes an object detection method using perceptual encryption for the first time. The proposed method can achieve almost the same accuracy as that of models without any protection by utilizing the embedding structure of the Vision Transformer (ViT) and a domain adaptation technique with keys. In experiments, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified in terms of accuracy and visual protection under the use of ViTdet, which is a ViT-based object detection model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出将感知加密 (perceptual encryption) 用于物体检测任务，以保护测试图像中的敏感视觉信息。方法利用 Vision Transformer (ViT) 的嵌入结构和带密钥的域自适应 (domain adaptation) 技术，使基于 ViT 的检测模型 ViTdet 在加密图像上达到与无保护模型几乎相同的精度。实验同时验证了检测精度与视觉保护效果。
Motivation: 已有视觉信息保护研究主要针对图像分类任务，缺少对物体检测任务的支持；本文旨在填补这一空白，在检测任务中实现对测试图像敏感信息的保护。
Method: 提出一种基于感知加密的物体检测方法，核心是利用 ViT 的嵌入结构并引入带密钥的域自适应技术，使模型在处理加密图像时仍能保持检测性能。
Result: 实验在基于 ViT 的物体检测模型 ViTdet 上验证了方法的有效性，声称可达到与无保护模型几乎相同的精度，同时提供视觉信息保护。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作是感知加密在物体检测中的首次应用，表明结合 ViT 嵌入结构与域自适应可以在保护视觉信息的同时维持检测精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Regularization for Long-Tailed Semi-Supervised Learning via Gaussian Feature Bridges
papers.abstract_en: Real-world semi-supervised learning (SSL) often encounters significant challenges with long-tailed label distributions and noisy pseudo-labels, which hinder generalization and amplify confirmation bias. In this work, we introduce a novel framework, Gaussian Bridge Consistency (GBC), to address these challenges by constructing semantic interpolation paths between unlabeled samples and high-quality class anchors. Our method maintains a dynamic Prototype Atlas that stores a diverse and evolving set of labeled and pseudo-labeled exemplars per class. For each unlabeled instance, GBC forms a class-conditional Gaussian Feature Bridge in the latent space, enabling the student model to traverse a smooth trajectory from uncertain predictions to reliable class prototypes. A bridge consistency loss is applied along this path to enforce alignment with a geometrically interpolated target distribution. Furthermore, we propose BridgeMix, a confidence-aware feature mixing strategy that interpolates both sample and anchor pairs to amplify cross-sample generalization. Extensive experiments on CIFAR10-LT and ImageNet-LT (USB benchmarks) validate the robustness and effectiveness of GBC under realistic long-tailed SSL settings, consistently improving long tail-class performance without sacrificing scalability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯桥一致性（Gaussian Bridge Consistency, GBC）框架，用于缓解长尾分布与噪声伪标签下的半监督学习（SSL）问题。GBC 在潜在空间中为每个无标注样本构建类条件高斯特征桥，使 student 模型沿平滑轨迹从不确定预测过渡到可靠类原型，并施加桥一致性损失；同时提出 BridgeMix 置信度感知的特征混合策略。在 CIFAR10-LT 与 ImageNet-LT（USB 基准）上的实验表明该方法能稳定提升长尾类别性能。
Motivation: 真实世界的 SSL 常面临长尾标签分布和噪声伪标签，这会阻碍泛化并放大确认偏差（confirmation bias），现有方法在此类设定下表现不佳。
Method: 维护一个动态的 Prototype Atlas，按类存储不断演化且有代表性的有标注与伪标注样本；对每个无标注实例，在潜在空间中构造类条件高斯特征桥，并沿该路径施加桥一致性损失，使预测与几何插值得到的目标分布对齐；此外提出 BridgeMix，通过插值样本对与锚点对来增强跨样本泛化。
Result: 在 CIFAR10-LT 和 ImageNet-LT（USB 基准）上的大量实验验证了 GBC 在现实长尾 SSL 设定下的鲁棒性与有效性，持续提升长尾类别性能且不牺牲可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GBC 通过几何化特征插值与一致性约束，能够在真实长尾 SSL 场景下同时改善尾部类别表现并保持可扩展性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ArtiMo: Agent-Driven Articulated Mesh Animation
papers.abstract_en: Animating articulated 3D meshes via text requires satisfying strict kinematic constraints, modeling causal interactions between parts, and achieving instruction fidelity. Due to the absence of task-specific training data and explicit articulation supervision, existing data-driven mesh animation methods are largely inapplicable to this setting. To address this, we propose ArtiMo, a novel agent-driven framework for text-guided articulated mesh animation. Operating in a zero-shot manner, ArtiMo develops an agentic pipeline powered by Large Language and Vision-Language Models (LLMs/VLMs) to orchestrate motion generation. By synergizing the explicit kinematic constraints of URDF with the agent's reasoning and planning capabilities, it effectively produces causally coherent part motions and interactions without requiring model fine-tuning. To ensure motion correctness, the agent additionally utilizes a visual self-improvement mechanism: generated animations are rendered into compact keyframes and motion cues, enabling the VLM to iteratively diagnose and correct errors. Furthermore, we contribute a new benchmark dataset spanning 21 articulated object categories, featuring high-quality motion annotations enriched with causal relationships. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ArtiMo significantly outperforms baselines, particularly on complex, causally driven motions. The project page is available at https://zou-2004.github.io/ArtiMo/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtiMo，一个面向文本驱动关节网格动画 (articulated mesh animation) 的零样本 (zero-shot) agent 框架。它利用 LLM/VLM 的推理与规划能力，结合 URDF 显式运动学约束来生成因果一致的部件运动，并通过视觉自改进机制迭代修正错误。作者还构建了包含 21 个关节物体类别、带因果关系标注的新基准，实验显示 ArtiMo 在复杂因果驱动运动上显著优于基线。
Motivation: 现有数据驱动的网格动画方法缺乏任务专属训练数据和显式关节监督，难以满足文本驱动关节网格动画中的严格运动学约束、部件间因果交互建模和指令保真度要求。
Method: ArtiMo 构建了一个由 LLM/VLM 驱动的 agent 管线，在零样本设置下将 URDF 的显式运动学约束与 agent 的推理规划能力结合，生成因果关系一致的部件运动；同时引入视觉自改进机制，将生成动画渲染为紧凑关键帧和运动线索，供 VLM 迭代诊断并纠正错误。
Result: 在包含 21 个关节物体类别并带有因果运动标注的新基准上，ArtiMo 显著优于基线方法，尤其在复杂、因果驱动的运动上表现突出。
Conclusion: 摘要强调零样本 agent 管线配合 URDF 运动学约束与视觉自改进机制，可在无需微调的情况下有效生成关节网格动画；该方法针对文本驱动关节动画场景，适用范围限于带 URDF 描述的关节物体。

papers.title: Bridging Language and Spherical Space: Object-Centric Control for Text-to-Panorama Generation
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic image generation is increasingly important for immersive applications such as virtual reality, augmented reality, and 3D content creation. Unlike perspective images, panoramic images represent a viewer-centered $360^\circ$ surrounding space, where directional expressions such as left, right, front, and behind play a central role in spatial understanding. However, existing text-to-panorama methods largely rely on implicit spatial reasoning and often fail to faithfully ground object-level directional descriptions in spherical panoramic scenes. A straightforward alternative is to introduce explicit layouts, but requiring manually specified spatial conditions reduces the flexibility of language-based interaction and does not directly resolve the misalignment between egocentric directional language and panoramic image space. To address this issue, we propose PanoCtrl, an object-centric framework for controllable text-to-panorama generation. Our method explicitly bridges natural language and spherical panoramic space by converting textual descriptions into structured object-level spherical conditions and integrating them into the diffusion process. Specifically, we introduce PanoParse, a text-conditioned parser that predicts object semantics and spherical bounding field-of-view (BFoV) parameters, and \textbf{PanoControl}, which injects object-level semantic and spatial guidance into the diffusion transformer through object-aware attention and spatial residual enhancement. To support this task, we construct PanoGround, a dataset with object-level spherical annotations and diverse directional descriptions for controllable panoramic generation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PanoCtrl achieves state-of-the-art performance in both spatial alignment and image quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PanoCtrl，一个面向可控文本到全景图生成 (text-to-panorama generation) 的 object-centric 框架，旨在将自然语言中的方向性描述（如 left、right、front、behind）显式锚定到球面全景空间。方法包括文本条件解析器 PanoParse（预测物体语义与球面视场角 BFoV 参数）和 PanoControl（通过 object-aware attention 与空间残差增强将语义和空间引导注入扩散 Transformer）。作者还构建了带物体级球面标注和方向性描述的 PanoGround 数据集，并在实验中声称取得空间对齐与图像质量上的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有文本到全景图方法依赖隐式空间推理，难以忠实对齐物体级方向描述与球面全景空间；显式布局方案又需要人工指定空间条件，降低了语言交互灵活性。
Method: 提出 PanoCtrl，将文本解析为结构化的物体级球面条件（物体语义和球面边界视场角 BFoV）并融入扩散过程；其中 PanoParse 负责解析文本，PanoControl 通过 object-aware attention 和 spatial residual enhancement 注入引导；并构建 PanoGround 数据集支撑训练。
Result: 摘要报告 PanoCtrl 在空间对齐和图像质量两方面均达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 该工作表明显式桥接语言与球面空间、以物体级条件控制扩散过程可以有效改进可控文本到全景图生成的空间对齐。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Identity-Aware Human-Object Interaction Motion Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Existing human-object interaction (HOI) motion captioning methods typically describe what happens while referring to the subject using generic terms such as "a person" or "someone", without grounding the caption in subject identity. To address this limitation, we introduce Identity-Aware Human-Object Interaction Motion Captioning task. This task requires each generated caption to specify both the subject identity and the corresponding HOI motion. For example, the model generates "Sub_ID lifts the chair" rather than "A person lifts the chair". For this task, we design identity-aware HOI motion captions based on the BEHAVE and InterCap datasets. We further propose ID-HOINet, which learns from multi-view videos while supporting single-view identity-aware HOI motion caption generation. ID-HOINet contains two core components: Multi-View Identity-Motion Learning Module (MVIML) and Two-Stage Caption Rewriting Strategy (TSCR). MVIML learns from multi-view videos by modeling dependencies across temporal stages and camera viewpoints, capturing identity and interaction motion features. At inference, the TSCR first retrieves the subject identity and generates identity-agnostic HOI motion captions. TSCR then rewrites these captions with the predicted identity to produce the final identity-aware HOI motion captions. Experiments demonstrate that ID-HOINet achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code will be released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出身份感知的人-物交互(hoi)运动描述任务，要求生成文本同时指定主体身份和交互动作，例如输出"Sub_ID lifts the chair"而非"A person lifts the chair"。作者基于BEHAVE和InterCap数据集构建身份感知HOI运动描述，并提出ID-HOINet，从多视角视频中学习、支持单视角推理生成。实验表明该方法取得state-of-the-art性能。
Motivation: 现有HOI运动描述方法通常用"a person"或"someone"等通用词指代主体，缺乏对主体身份的语义绑定，无法满足需要区分具体个体的应用场景。
Method: 提出ID-HOINet，包含多视角身份-运动学习模块(MVIML)和两阶段描述重写策略(TSCR)。MVIML建模时间阶段与相机视角之间的依赖，从多视角视频中提取身份和交互运动特征；推理时TSCR先检索主体身份并生成身份无关的HOI运动描述，再用预测的身份重写为最终身份感知描述。
Result: 实验表明ID-HOINet在身份感知HOI运动描述任务上达到state-of-the-art表现；摘要未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 该方法通过身份检索加描述重写的两阶段策略，实现了单视角下的身份感知HOI运动描述生成；代码将在论文被接收后发布，摘要未说明明确局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VortexChat: An agentic framework for autonomous multi-objective integrated photonic design
papers.abstract_en: The advancement of modern integrated photonics is frequently bottlenecked by device design workflows that rely heavily on manual simulation and expert intuition. While inverse design offers an alternative, it remains constrained by expert supervision and a lack of end-to-end automation. To address these issues, we present VortexChat, an agentic framework for the autonomous, end-to-end inverse design of integrated photonic devices directly from natural language specifications. VortexChat couples a large language model (LLM) decision agent with topology generation, gradient-based refinement, and full-wave electromagnetic simulation. This closed-loop architecture enables the system to iteratively decompose design objectives, orchestrate computational tools, and update strategies based on feedback with minimal human intervention. Constrained by the absolute metrics of the Vortex100 Benchmark, VortexChat autonomously generates devices that strictly meet all predefined performance thresholds without any human-in-the-loop. As an experimental demonstration, we fabricated a broadband terahertz perfect vortex beam multiplexer, autonomously designed by VortexChat, with measurements confirming high-efficiency operation, high mode purity and low inter-channel crosstalk in agreement with full-wave simulations. These results demonstrate that an LLM agent can assume key aspects of expert decision-making in photonic inverse design while maintaining physical fidelity and fabrication feasibility, providing a scalable route towards autonomous design of complex integrated photonic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VortexChat，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）决策智能体的自主框架，用于集成光子器件的端到端逆向设计：从自然语言规格直接生成满足性能阈值的器件。该系统耦合拓扑生成、基于梯度的细化（gradient-based refinement）和全波电磁仿真，形成闭环迭代，在 Vortex100 Benchmark 上无需人工介入即生成严格满足所有预定义阈值的器件。作者还实验制造了太赫兹完美涡旋光束复用器，测量证实高效率、高模式纯度和低串扰，与全波仿真一致。
Motivation: 现代集成光子学设计流程依赖手动仿真和专家直觉，逆向设计虽有潜力但仍受限于专家监督和缺少端到端自动化，阻碍了器件设计的可扩展性。
Method: VortexChat 将 LLM 决策智能体与拓扑生成、基于梯度的细化和全波电磁仿真耦合，构成闭环架构，能够迭代分解设计目标、编排计算工具并根据仿真反馈更新策略，以最小化人工干预。
Result: 在 Vortex100 Benchmark 的绝对指标约束下，VortexChat 自主生成严格满足所有预定义性能阈值的器件，无需人工介入。实验演示的宽带太赫兹完美涡旋光束复用器经测量确认与全波仿真一致，具有高效率、高模式纯度和低通道间串扰。
Conclusion: 该结果表明 LLM 智能体能够承担光子逆向设计中的关键专家决策，同时维持物理保真度和制造可行性，为复杂集成光子系统的自主设计提供一条可扩展路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TopoSurfel: Closing the Loop between Gaussian Surfels and Meshes for Surface Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting has achieved remarkable success in novel view synthesis. However, extracting high-fidelity surfaces directly from 3DGS remains challenging due to its discrete and unstructured nature. Existing 3DGS-based reconstruction methods typically rely on multi-view geometric consistency or local constraints. Without an explicit structured geometric prior during optimization, these methods often struggle to resolve structural ambiguities, leading to artifacts and floaters, particularly in textureless or occluded regions. To address this limitation, we propose TopoSurfel, a novel framework that closes the loop between Gaussian surfels and continuous meshes. Unlike recent methods that incorporate mesh extraction into the differentiable pipeline by introducing auxiliary neural networks or extra per-Gaussian parameters, we dynamically extract a continuous proxy mesh via a non-trainable differentiable iso-surfacing process. Leveraging this differentiable connection, we introduce a mesh-guided surfel evolution strategy, including normal alignment and geometry-aware density control, to effectively suppress floaters and fill surface holes. Furthermore, to address the initialization challenges in large-scale environments, we propose a spatially aware hybrid re-initialization strategy that ensures robust reconstruction across complex scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TopoSurfel achieves competitive geometric reconstruction accuracy while maintaining high-quality mesh-based novel view synthesis. The code for our method is available at https://github.com/Fan-Treasure/TopoSurfel.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TopoSurfel，一个在 3D Gaussian Splatting 表面重建中闭环连接 Gaussian surfel 与连续网格的框架。作者通过不可训练的微分等值面提取 (differentiable iso-surfacing) 动态获得代理网格，并利用网格引导的 surfel 演化策略抑制 floaters 并填补表面空洞。实验表明该方法在几何重建精度和基于网格的新视角合成质量上均具有竞争力，代码已开源。
Motivation: 3DGS 因离散且非结构化的表达难以直接提取高保真表面；现有 3DGS 重建方法多依赖多视图几何一致性或局部约束，缺少显式结构化几何先验，在无纹理或遮挡区域容易出现结构歧义、伪影和 floaters。
Method: 提出一种非训练参数的可微等值面提取过程，从 Gaussian surfel 动态提取连续代理网格，从而建立可微连接；在此基础上引入网格引导的 surfel 演化策略，包括法向对齐 (normal alignment) 与几何感知密度控制；针对大规模场景的初始化困难，提出空间感知的混合重初始化策略。
Result: 大量实验表明，TopoSurfel 在几何重建精度上达到有竞争力的水平，同时保持高质量的基于网格的新视角合成 (mesh-based novel view synthesis)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过不可训练的可微等值面提取闭环连接 surfel 与网格，可有效抑制伪影并填充空洞，且无需引入辅助神经网络或额外每-Gaussian 参数；代码可在 GitHub 获取。

papers.title: CDRL: Certification-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Neutrino Flavor Model Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Many scientific discovery problems require searching combinatorial hypothesis spaces under complex domain constraints. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a promising approach, but existing methods rely on scalar rewards that provide limited information about why candidate solutions fail, leading agents to repeatedly explore invalid regions. We introduce Certification-Driven Reinforcement Learning (CDRL), a framework that leverages structured feedback from symbolic reasoning tools. When a candidate violates domain constraints, these tools produce certificates identifying the actions responsible for failure. CDRL converts these certificates into reusable constraints that eliminate classes of invalid solutions and guide exploration toward valid regions. We evaluate CDRL on neutrino flavor model discovery in theoretical particle physics, where the hypothesis space exceeds $10^{26}$ possible models, and compare it with the state-of-the-art RL approach previously used for this task. Across three theory spaces, CDRL achieves up to 1.95$\times$ higher valid model rates and up to 6.33$\times$ higher neutrino model rates while evaluating up to 4$\times$ fewer candidates. We further extract 40 interpretable rules from search trajectories using a post-hoc decision-tree framework and show that reusing them as soft constraints yields gains of up to 2$\times$ in valid model rates and 3$\times$ in neutrino model discovery across all three theory spaces. These results suggest that CDRL uncovers reusable structure in combinatorial search spaces and provides a general framework for scientific model discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Certification-Driven Reinforcement Learning (CDRL)，一种利用符号推理工具生成的结构化证书反馈来指导强化学习搜索的框架。当候选解违反领域约束时，推理工具产生证书指出导致失败的 action，CDRL 将这些证书转换为可复用约束，消除整类无效解并引导探索。作者将该框架应用于理论粒子物理中的中微子味道模型发现，在超过 10^26 个可能的模型假设空间中，相比此前用于该任务的 SOTA RL 方法，在三个理论空间里将有效模型率最高提升到 1.95 倍，中微子模型率最高提升到 6.33 倍，同时评估候选数最多减少 4 倍。
Motivation: 许多科学发现问题需要在复杂领域约束下搜索组合假设空间，RL 虽有潜力，但现有方法依赖标量奖励，无法提供候选解为何失败的详细信息，导致智能体反复探索无效区域。
Method: 提出 CDRL 框架：在候选违反约束时，利用符号推理工具生成证书 (certificates) 识别导致失败的 action，再将证书转化为可复用的硬约束或软约束，以消除无效解类别并引导搜索进入有效区域。
Result: 在三个理论空间上，CDRL 相比 SOTA RL 方法实现高达 1.95 倍更高的有效模型率和 6.33 倍更高的中微子模型率，且评估候选数最多减少 4 倍。另用事后决策树框架提取 40 条可解释规则，将其作为软约束复用时，三个理论空间的有效模型率提升最高 2 倍、中微子模型发现率提升最高 3 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CDRL 能发掘组合搜索空间中的可复用结构，并为科学模型发现提供通用框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Validity on Real Software Histories: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors in Code-Assistant Memory over GitHub Fixes
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has no model of time: when a fact changes across a coding session - a function is renamed, an endpoint moves, a dependency is bumped - RAG retrieves both the old and new value with near-identical similarity and cannot tell which is current, so it serves the superseded value. Paper 1 showed, on synthetic single-value benchmarks, that a deterministic (subject, relation, object) supersession memory eliminates this failure. Here we validate it end-to-end on real software history. From 707 real GitHub issues (SWE-bench Lite + Verified) we extract 130 clean atomic state transitions, a fix that changes one identifiable value from a pre-fix to a post-fix form, and render each marker-free (the stale and current statements differ only in the value). On this set, MemStrata reaches 0.91 answer accuracy versus RAG's 0.57-0.59; and, the structural result, when forced to answer RAG serves the superseded value 36-38% of the time (an LLM reranker does not help) while MemStrata drives this to ~0, at RAG retrieval latency (~2.1 s vs ~18 s for the reranker). We are explicit about scope: only ~18% of real fixes are clean atomic transitions; Paper 2 isolates the memory mechanism on that class, and extraction coverage of the remaining fixes is the orthogonal problem we defer to follow-on work. A real product bug surfaced and was fixed during the study (a case/punctuation-insensitive value comparison), with the moat property (deterministic-supersession accuracy on clean code mutations) preserved and verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对检索增强生成 (RAG) 在代码助手中缺乏时间模型的问题，在真实软件历史上端到端验证确定性（subject, relation, object）替代记忆机制。作者从 707 个真实 GitHub issue（SWE-bench Lite + Verified）中提取 130 个干净的原子状态迁移，并把新旧语句渲染成仅值不同的无标记形式。结果显示 MemStrata 的答案准确率为 0.91，远高于 RAG 的 0.57–0.59，同时把 RAG 中 36–38% 的过时值输出降到约 0，且延迟保持在 RAG 水平。
Motivation: RAG 没有时间模型：代码会话中事实发生变化（函数重命名、端点移动、依赖升级）时，新旧值相似度接近，RAG 无法判断哪个是当前值，因而常常返回已被取代的值。
Method: 论文把此前在合成单值基准上验证的确定性 supersession memory（MemStrata）放到真实软件历史中验证：从 707 个 GitHub issue 提取 130 个干净原子状态迁移（一次修复只改变一个可识别值），并确保基准中过时与当前语句仅在值上不同。
Result: 在提取的基准上，MemStrata 达到 0.91 的答案准确率，而 RAG 为 0.57–0.59；被迫作答时 RAG 有 36–38% 的概率输出被取代的值且 LLM reranker 无法缓解，MemStrata 将这一比例降到约 0，并保持 RAG 级检索延迟（约 2.1 秒，对比 reranker 约 18 秒）。
Conclusion: 作者明确限定范围：真实修复中只有约 18% 属于干净的原子状态迁移，MemStrata 的机制优势局限于此，其余修复的抽取覆盖被视为正交问题留给后续工作；研究过程中发现并修复了一个真实产品 bug（大小写/标点不敏感的值比较），并验证了 moat 属性（干净代码变更上的确定性替代准确性）得以保持。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 论文把此前在合成单值基准上验证的确定性 supersession memory（MemStrata）放到真实软件历史中验证：从 707 个 GitHub issue 提取 130 个干净原子状态迁移（一次修复只改变一个可识别值），并确保基准中过时与当前语句仅在值上不同。
summary_sections.result: 在提取的基准上，MemStrata 达到 0.91 的答案准确率，而 RAG 为 0.57–0.59；被迫作答时 RAG 有 36–38% 的概率输出被取代的值且 LLM reranker 无法缓解，MemStrata 将这一比例降到约 0，并保持 RAG 级检索延迟（约 2.1 秒，对比 reranker 约 18 秒）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者明确限定范围：真实修复中只有约 18% 属于干净的原子状态迁移，MemStrata 的机制优势局限于此，其余修复的抽取覆盖被视为正交问题留给后续工作；研究过程中发现并修复了一个真实产品 bug（大小写/标点不敏感的值比较），并验证了 moat 属性（干净代码变更上的确定性替代准确性）得以保持。

papers.title: Aristotelian Manifolds: Leveraging Platonic Perceptual Features for Backpropagation Free Rapid Concept Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper formalizes and systematically characterizes Aristotelian Manifolds, a generalized structural framework built upon the Platonic Representation Hypothesis. We position high-capacity foundation models as universal perceptual filters and conduct a comprehensive layer-wise investigation to map how knowledge is functionally synthesized within these latent subspaces. Across diverse architectural paradigms and multi-domain datasets, we rigorously chart the interplay between network depth, dimensionality reduction, and distance metrics. Our characterization reveals that semantic maturation does not follow a singular, monotonic path; instead, different data domains exhibit highly distinct geometric response profiles, characterized by intermediate mound-like peaks for specialized clinical modalities and sigmoidal plateaus for natural visual tasks. By profiling the exact coordinates where these manifolds achieve peak representational efficiency, we establish a predictable taxonomy for layer selection and feature compression. Ultimately, this systematic characterization demonstrates that mapping the internal geometry of frozen representations provides a robust, backpropagation-free, and interpretable framework for understanding and exploiting foundation model latent spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在柏拉图表示假说 (Platonic Representation Hypothesis) 基础上形式化了亚里士多德流形 (Aristotelian Manifolds)，把高容量基础模型视为通用感知滤波器，并对冻结表示进行逐层分析，以刻画知识在潜在子空间中的功能综合方式。研究发现语义成熟并非沿单一单调路径发生，不同数据领域呈现明显不同的几何响应轮廓：专门临床模态出现中间丘状峰，自然视觉任务则呈现 S 形平台。通过定位表示效率峰值所在坐标，论文建立了一个可预测的层选择与特征压缩分类体系。
Motivation: 现有研究对基础模型潜在空间如何随网络深度综合知识缺乏系统性刻画，且语义成熟常被假定为单调过程。作者希望建立可预测的层选择与特征压缩准则，从而无需反向传播即可理解并利用冻结表示。
Method: 形式化 Aristotelian Manifolds 框架，并在多种架构范式与多领域数据集上对冻结表示开展逐层研究，系统考察网络深度、降维 (dimensionality reduction) 与距离度量之间的相互作用。
Result: 摘要报告不同数据领域呈现不同的几何响应轮廓：专门临床模态显示中间丘状峰，自然视觉任务显示 S 形平台；通过刻画表示效率达到峰值的精确坐标，建立了可预测的层选择与特征压缩分类体系。
Conclusion: 作者认为系统刻画冻结表示的内部几何能够提供一个稳健、免反向传播且可解释的框架，用于理解和利用基础模型潜在空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes with Applications to Network Dynamic Pricing
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning (RL) in Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes (CTJMDPs) featuring general discrete state spaces (which need not possess a vector space structure) and continuous/discrete action spaces. The setup covers many well-known applications in operations such as multi-product dynamic pricing with capacitated resources (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997). To model the exploration-exploitation tradeoff, we formulate an entropy-regularized continuous-time control problem with stochastic policies. Recent continuous-time RL techniques such as $q$-learning for controlled diffusions in (Jia and Zhou 2023) focus on continuous state spaces $\mathbb{R}^d$ and rely heavily on semimartingale theory in $\mathbb{R}^d$ for their theoretical analysis. Consequently, their methods cannot be directly applied to CTJMDPs with general discrete state spaces, which may lack the algebraic addition and subtraction structures inherent to Euclidean spaces. To bridge this gap, we establish the theoretical foundations of $q$-learning for CTJMDPs and develop model-free $q$-learning algorithms. Compared to naïve time discretization and approximating CTJMDPs using discrete-time MDPs, our approach has several conceptual and empirical benefits. Numerical experiments in network dynamic pricing (Gallego and van Ryzin 1997) show that our proposed RL algorithm reliably learns near-optimal policies and consistently outperforms standard benchmark methods, demonstrating superior solution quality and effective scalability to large-scale network instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间跳跃马尔可夫决策过程 (Continuous-Time Jump Markov Decision Processes, CTJMDPs) 上的强化学习，状态空间为不要求向量空间结构的一般离散空间，动作空间可为连续或离散。作者将探索-利用权衡建模为带熵正则化的连续时间随机策略控制问题，建立 q-learning 的理论基础并提出无模型算法。在网络动态定价数值实验中，算法能够可靠学习近最优策略，并持续优于标准基准方法。
Motivation: 现有连续时间 RL 技术（如针对受控扩散的 q-learning）主要依赖欧氏空间 R^d 中的半鞅理论与代数加减结构，无法直接推广到缺乏向量空间结构的一般离散状态 CTJMDPs；该文旨在弥合这一理论和方法缺口。
Method: 作者建立 CTJMDPs 上 q-learning 的理论基础，并提出无模型 q-learning 算法。相比朴素时间离散化并用离散时间 MDP 近似 CTJMDPs，该方法在概念和经验上都有优势。
Result: 在带容量约束的网络动态定价数值实验中，所提出的 RL 算法可靠地学到近最优策略，并一致优于标准基准方法；摘要同时强调其解质量良好且可扩展到大规模网络实例。
Conclusion: 该工作将熵正则化连续时间 RL 与 q-learning 拓展到一般离散状态空间的 CTJMDPs，并在动态定价中验证了实际有效性；摘要未明确讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies
papers.abstract_en: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. Using Qwen3-8B, decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. We find a capability-auditability tradeoff: the strongest direct policy achieves higher quality but exposes no reasoning to inspect, while the reasoning policy provides a trace at the cost of lower performance, particularly recall of true intervention opportunities. Supervised fine-tuning either suppresses reasoning or preserves it without improving decision quality, while reinforcement learning also fails to improve the reasoning policy. We identify one mechanism underlying this failure: group relative objectives provide no learning signal on confidently wrong prompts when sampled rollouts all select the same action. Controlled activation probes and behavioral ablations show that standard faithfulness methods can overstate evidence that exposed reasoning reflects the underlying decision process. Probability-based metrics saturate under confident decisions, probes are vulnerable to class imbalance and textual leakage, and reasoning ablations can confound reasoning content with changes in inference mode. Together, these results show that exposing reasoning can change an agent's action policy rather than simply make it observable. We provide controls for evaluating reasoning-based oversight of agents that can act or abstain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究智能体系统在行动与弃权之间反复决策时的忠实推理（faithful reasoning）问题，以多方对话中的干预时机（是否发言）为场景，使用 Qwen3-8B 在有无 chain-of-thought 解码下比较直接决策策略、推理策略、监督微调与强化学习。摘要发现存在能力-可审计性权衡：最强的直接策略质量更高但不暴露可检查的推理过程，而推理策略提供轨迹却以性能下降为代价，尤其对真实干预机会的召回更低。作者进一步指出标准忠实性方法可能高估推理暴露与决策过程的一致性，并提供了评估可行动或可弃权智能体推理监督的控制方法。
Motivation: 许多智能体系统需要反复在行动与弃权之间选择，解释只有在真实反映产生动作的计算时才有监督价值，因此忠实推理对智能体监督至关重要。该问题在多方对话的发言时机决策中尤为突出，还涉及类别不平衡、不对称动作成本以及暴露推理可能改变被审计策略的风险。
Method: 使用 Qwen3-8B，在有无 chain-of-thought 推理解码下，比较直接决策策略、推理策略、监督微调（supervised fine-tuning）和强化学习（reinforcement learning）。作者还采用受控激活探针（activation probes）和行为消融来检验所暴露推理是否真正反映底层决策过程。
Result: 最强的直接策略质量更高但不暴露推理，推理策略性能下降且对真实干预机会的召回更低；监督微调要么抑制推理要么保留推理却不提升决策质量，强化学习也未能改善推理策略。作者识别出一个机制：group relative objectives 在采样 rollout 都选择同一动作的自信但错误提示上不提供学习信号。概率类指标在自信决策下饱和，探针易受类别不平衡和文本泄漏影响，推理消融可能混淆推理内容与推理模式变化。
Conclusion: 摘要总结认为暴露推理可以改变智能体的行动策略，而非仅仅使其可观察；作者提供了用于评估可行动或可弃权智能体推理监督的控制方法，为后续研究提供基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lightweight Adaptive ReduNet via Hyperspherical Manifold Learning
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, a white-box neural network called ReduNet has been proposed, which employs the maximal coding rate reduction (MCR$^2$) principle to transform raw data into low-dimensional discriminative features via a forward layer-wise construction process. Unlike traditional deep networks that rely on backpropagation, ReduNet explicitly derives the parameters of each layer from the features of its preceding layer, offering a mathematically interpretable paradigm. However, this layer-wise construction often requires a large number of layers for the MCR$^2$ objective to reach a stable value, which increases the parameter storage of the unfolded module. To address this issue, we propose LA-ReduNet, a lightweight adaptive architecture that refines the layer-wise update rule and enables discriminative feature representations to be obtained with substantially fewer unfolded layers. Specifically, LA-ReduNet employs hyperspherical manifold learning and adaptive step sizes, thereby reducing by an order of magnitude the number of layers required for the MCR$^2$ objective to reach a stable value. Simulation results demonstrate that, while maintaining comparable classification accuracy, LA-ReduNet requires significantly fewer layers for the MCR$^2$ objective to reach a stable value. Remarkably, under the considered experimental settings, LA-ReduNet requires only approximately $1/29$ of the parameter storage of the unfolded ReduNet module for the MCR$^2$ objective to reach a stable value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 ReduNet 这类基于最大编码率降低 (MCR$^2$) 原则的白盒网络在逐层前向构造时需要大量层才能让目标稳定、从而增加参数存储的问题，提出轻量自适应架构 LA-ReduNet。LA-ReduNet 通过超球面流形学习 (hyperspherical manifold learning) 与自适应步长改进逐层更新规则，使 MCR$^2$ 目标达到稳定所需的层数降低一个数量级。仿真表明在保持相近分类精度的条件下，所需参数存储约为原始 ReduNet 展开模块的 1/29。
Motivation: ReduNet 的逐层构造通常需要很多层才能使 MCR$^2$ 目标达到稳定值，这会显著增加展开模块的参数存储开销，是该方法实用化的主要瓶颈。
Method: 提出 LA-ReduNet，对 ReduNet 的逐层更新规则进行细化，引入超球面流形学习和自适应步长，从而在更少的展开层数下获得判别性特征表示。
Result: 仿真结果显示，LA-ReduNet 在保持可比分类精度的同时，显著减少 MCR$^2$ 目标达到稳定所需的层数；在所设实验条件下，参数存储约为原始展开 ReduNet 模块的 1/29。
Conclusion: 摘要强调轻量自适应设计可以有效压缩 ReduNet 的展开深度与参数存储，同时不牺牲分类精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: C-Score: Beyond Accuracy for Robustness Assessment in Semi-Supervised Learning under Open-World Unlabeled Contamination
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-label-based semi-supervised learning has achieved strong performance due to its simplicity and scalability. However, it is typically developed under a closed-world assumption that unlabeled data are drawn from the same distribution as labeled data. In practical deployment, unlabeled data are often collected from open environments and may contain OOD samples. Under such contamination, OOD samples may still receive high-confidence predictions and be incorporated into training as if they were valid target examples. This creates an important evaluation problem: clean in-distribution test accuracy may appear stable even when the internal learning dynamics of SSL have already deteriorated. To address this issue, we study hidden collapse in pseudo-label-based SSL under open-world unlabeled contamination from a diagnostic evaluation perspective. We present C-Score, a compact framework that evaluates training behavior in three complementary spaces: prediction, feature representation, and optimization. C-Score includes PLE and CCI for unlabeled prediction behavior, Sem-Drift for deviation from labeled semantic anchors, and Grad-Align for the compatibility between labeled and unlabeled optimization. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with multiple OOD sources, varying contamination ratios, and four pseudo-label-based SSL algorithms show that C-Score metrics reveal hidden degradation that clean accuracy alone fails to detect: under SVHN contamination, CCI rises over 280% while best-accuracy remains within 3% of the uncontaminated baseline; near-OOD sources (CIFAR-100, STL-10) cause up to 14.9% accuracy collapse (FlexMatch, r=0.5). The results suggest that clean accuracy alone is insufficient for evaluating SSL robustness in open-world environments, and that internal diagnostic signals are necessary for more reliable robustness assessment under unlabeled contamination.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C-Score 框架，用于在开放世界未标注污染下评估伪标签半监督学习（SSL）的鲁棒性。论文指出干净测试准确率可能保持稳定但内部学习动态已恶化，C-Score 从预测、特征表示和优化三个空间提供诊断指标（PLE、CCI、Sem-Drift、Grad-Align）。实验在 CIFAR-10/100 上表明这些指标能发现干净准确率无法检测的隐藏退化。
Motivation: 伪标签 SSL 通常在闭集假设下开发，实际中未标注数据可能含 OOD 样本，OOD 样本可能获得高置信预测并被当作有效目标样本。干净 ID 测试准确率可能看似稳定，而内部学习动态已经恶化，因此需要新的诊断评估方法。
Method: 提出 C-Score 紧凑框架，在三个互补空间评估训练行为：预测空间用 PLE 和 CCI 评估未标注预测行为，特征表示空间用 Sem-Drift 衡量与标记语义锚的偏离，优化空间用 Grad-Align 衡量标记与未标记优化的兼容性。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10 和 CIFAR-100 上，结合多种 OOD 源、不同污染比例和四种伪标签 SSL 算法，C-Score 指标揭示干净准确率无法检测的隐藏退化：SVHN 污染下 CCI 上升超 280% 而最佳准确率仍与未污染基线相差 3% 以内；近 OOD 源（CIFAR-100、STL-10）在 FlexMatch、r=0.5 时导致最高 14.9% 的准确率崩溃。
Conclusion: 摘要认为开放世界环境下仅用干净准确率不足以评估 SSL 鲁棒性，需要内部诊断信号来更可靠地评估未标注污染下的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Amplifying the imaging power of digital sky surveys with space telescopes data and generative AI
papers.abstract_en: While Digital sky surveys provide excellent throughput of image data and can cover a large footprint, their imaging power is normally inferior to that of space-based telescopes. Space-based telescopes, on the other hand, provide excellent imaging power and can image the deep Universe, but cannot provide the same throughput as advanced ground-based sky surveys. Here, we utilize generative AI to elevate the quality of galaxy images taken by ground-based telescopes to the level of details enabled by space telescopes. The solution is based on the nature of galaxy shapes, allowing generative AI trained on space-based images to convert weak signal into detailed and clear galaxy images. The method allows for combining the high throughput of ground-based sky surveys with the image quality of space-based telescopes. The source code for the method is available, as well as paired training data and a catalog of 63,202 galaxy images enhanced by the proposed method. We also provide a software tool that encapsulates the entire pipeline and the custom generative AI model to generate galaxy images with enhanced quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用生成式 AI 将地面望远镜拍摄的星系图像增强到接近空间望远镜的细节水平，从而把地面巡天的高吞吐量与空间望远镜的高成像质量结合起来。作者基于星系形态特点，用空间望远镜图像训练生成模型，把弱信号转换为清晰细节；同时发布源码、配对训练数据、含 63,202 张增强星系图像的目录，以及封装完整流程与模型的软件工具。论文已被 MNRAS 接收。
Motivation: 数字巡天（digital sky surveys）图像吞吐量高、覆盖面积大，但成像能力通常弱于空间望远镜；空间望远镜成像质量高、能观测深空，但吞吐量不及先进地面巡天。作者希望弥合这一差距，使地面巡天也能获得接近空间望远镜的图像细节。
Method: 利用星系形状的固有特性，用基于空间望远镜图像训练的生成式 AI 模型，将地面望远镜的弱信号转换为细节清晰、质量更高的星系图像，从而在同一流程中同时利用地面巡天的高吞吐量和空间望远镜的图像质量。
Result: 摘要报告发布了完整源码、配对训练数据、一个包含 63,202 张经该方法增强的星系图像目录，以及封装整个流程和自定义生成式 AI 模型的软件工具；论文已被 MNRAS 接收。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了生成式 AI 可以将地面巡天的高吞吐量与空间望远镜的图像质量相结合，为提升数字巡天图像能力提供了实用工具和数据集。

papers.title: DreamBench-SWE: A Multi-Session Memory-Hygiene Benchmark for Software Agents
papers.abstract_en: DreamBench-SWE is a multi-session benchmark for software-agent memory hygiene in which later software tasks depend on non-inferable evidence from earlier sessions and are scored by executable hidden oracles. We report the original scaled v2 fold and a separately preregistered v2.1 successor audit designed after that study but frozen before successor outcome inspection. The successor run completed 360/360 work units and 720/720 S3 cells across four conditions. In the original fold, the primary DF-hybrid--B5 contrast was null (95/180 versus 89/180; clustered p=.518, Holm p=1), not evidence of equivalence, and C9/C10 retained B0-headroom limitations. In the successor, no external memory achieved 21/180 passes (rate 0.1167), deterministic verbatim event memory 82/180 (rate 0.4556), the typed-plus-raw reference probe 83/180 (rate 0.4611), and one pinned hosted Mem0 literal-storage configuration 97/180 (rate 0.5389). The registered six-slot Family A retained unavailable slots at p=1; all three available comparisons against no memory rejected after Holm correction. Both preregistered mechanism contrasts were unavailable after pre-evaluation conformance rejection. The secondary literal-storage-versus-verbatim comparison was nonconfirmatory and sensitivity-dependent, while the comparison with the reference probe did not reject. The audit therefore supports DreamBench-SWE as a discriminating executable profile benchmark and characterizes one exact hosted-memory configuration, but it does not establish an external-system mechanism, superiority among memory-bearing conditions, equivalence, or broad product generality. The original v2.0.5 findings and artifacts remain unchanged.
papers.comment: 67 pages. Public benchmark and evidence release: https://github.com/iroiro147/dreambench-swe/releases/tag/v2.1.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DreamBench-SWE，一个面向软件智能体跨会话记忆卫生 (memory hygiene) 的多会话基准，后续任务依赖前序会话中无法推断的证据，并由可执行的隐藏 oracle 评分。论文报告了原始 v2 折与预先注册的 v2.1 后续审计；审计中无外部记忆、确定性逐字事件记忆、typed-plus-raw 参考探针以及一种固定托管的 Mem0 字面存储配置的通过率依次为 0.1167、0.4556、0.4611 和 0.5389。作者结论是该基准可作为有区分度的可执行画像基准，但并未确立外部系统机制、记忆条件间的优越性、等价性或广泛产品通用性。
Motivation: 软件智能体在跨会话任务中需要良好的记忆卫生，但缺乏能检验“后续任务依赖前序会话非可推断证据”这一能力的多会话评测基准。
Method: 构建 DreamBench-SWE 多会话基准，用可执行隐藏 oracle 对任务评分，并设计一个预先注册的 v2.1 后续审计，在四个条件下完成 360/360 个工作单元与 720/720 个 S3 单元，对比无外部记忆、确定性逐字事件记忆、typed-plus-raw 参考探针和一种固定的托管 Mem0 字面存储配置。
Result: 原始折中 DF-hybrid--B5 主对比为 null（95/180 对 89/180，聚类 p=.518，Holm p=1）；后续审计中四种条件通过率分别为 21/180、82/180、83/180、97/180。注册的六槽 Family A 保留不可用槽位 p=1，三个可用的与无记忆的对比经 Holm 校正后均拒绝；两个预先注册的机制对比因预评估一致性拒绝而不可用，字面存储对逐字记忆的次要对比为不可确认且依赖敏感性。
Conclusion: 审计支持 DreamBench-SWE 作为有区分度的可执行画像基准，并刻画了一种确切的托管内存配置；但摘要明确表示其结果不能确立外部系统机制、记忆条件间的优越性、等价性，也不能推广到广泛产品。原始 v2.0.5 的结果与工件保持不变。

papers.title: Shortcut Learning in a Public Grape Disease Dataset: Annotation Granularity as a Modulator, Not a Cause
papers.abstract_en: Public datasets for agricultural disease detection are usually judged fit for use from reported metrics, which say nothing about whether the annotation scheme is internally consistent. On one public grape disease dataset (3288 images, 11995 boxes, 6 classes), varying model capacity, input resolution and detection paradigm yields a test-set mAP50 range comparable to seed-to-seed noise, with the bottleneck at small objects across all five architectures. The finding lies on the data side: one class is annotated at whole-leaf level (median box area 43.16% of the image) while the other five are annotated at lesion level. On 5156 cross-species images containing no grape, 65.7% of the false-positive boxes fall into that one class, an over-representation of 13.41x relative to its share of the training annotations. Counterfactual retraining establishes a causal effect of granularity on the magnitude of the shortcut: shrinking only that class's boxes cuts its cross-species false positives by 66%, and a placebo control confirms the effect is specific to the manipulated class. A manipulation in the opposite direction, with criteria registered in advance, returns a negative result: coarsening the finest class to whole-leaf level (0.57% to 40.37%), matched in box count and share of annotations and with higher in-distribution AP, still leaves its cross-species false positives at zero boxes, while the unmanipulated original class holds 50.0% of them. Annotation granularity is therefore a modulator of this shortcut, not its cause: it can amplify or attenuate a sink that already exists, but cannot create one, and what fixes the destination remains open. We also give a granularity screening statistic requiring neither images nor training, and show airborne lesion-level detection to be optically out of reach. The failure mode is invisible to in-distribution evaluation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个公开葡萄病害检测数据集的标注粒度不一致问题。作者在 3288 张图像、11995 个框、6 类数据上改变模型容量、输入分辨率和检测范式，发现测试集 mAP50 的变化范围与种子随机噪声相当，瓶颈在小目标。数据层面，一个类别被整叶级标注（中位框面积占图像 43.16%），其余五类为病斑级；在 5156 张无葡萄跨物种图像上，65.7% 的假阳性框落入该类别，是其在训练标注占比的 13.41 倍。反事实重训练与安慰剂对照表明，标注粒度只是捷径的调节因子而非原因：缩小该类别的框可削减 66% 的跨物种假阳性，而反向粗化最细类别不产生额外假阳性。
Motivation: 公共农业病害检测数据集通常仅凭报告指标判断是否可用，但指标无法反映标注方案内部是否一致。标注粒度可能诱导模型学习捷径，且分布内评估无法暴露该失败模式。
Method: 通过系统改变模型容量、输入分辨率和检测范式对比性能波动；使用反事实重训练（只缩小目标类别的标注框）和安慰剂对照建立因果关系；另提出一个不需要图像和训练数据的粒度筛查统计量，并分析空气传播病斑级检测的光学可行性。
Result: 测试集 mAP50 波动范围与随机种子噪声相当；65.7% 的跨物种假阳性集中在整叶标注类别，过表示达 13.41 倍；缩小该类别的框使跨物种假阳性降低 66%；反向将最细类别粗化至整叶级（框面积从 0.57% 到 40.37%）后，其跨物种假阳性仍为零，而未操纵的原始类别占据 50.0% 的假阳性。
Conclusion: 标注粒度是捷径的调节因子而非原因：它能放大或衰减已存在的汇聚倾向，但不能凭空创造；如何真正消除该目的地仍是开放问题。分布内评估对这类失败模式不可见。

summary_sections.result: 测试集 mAP50 波动范围与随机种子噪声相当；65.7% 的跨物种假阳性集中在整叶标注类别，过表示达 13.41 倍；缩小该类别的框使跨物种假阳性降低 66%；反向将最细类别粗化至整叶级（框面积从 0.57% 到 40.37%）后，其跨物种假阳性仍为零，而未操纵的原始类别占据 50.0% 的假阳性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 标注粒度是捷径的调节因子而非原因：它能放大或衰减已存在的汇聚倾向，但不能凭空创造；如何真正消除该目的地仍是开放问题。分布内评估对这类失败模式不可见。

papers.title: Auditable by Construction: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Trustworthy LLM Analytics in Enterprise Finance
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise adoption of large language models in finance is constrained less by fluency than by trust: in Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) and other regulated workflows, an answer is usable only if it is traceable to authoritative sources and auditable after the fact. This paper argues that retrieval-augmented generation for enterprise finance should be evaluated on auditability alongside accuracy, and presents the Knowledge-Driven Analytics Framework (KDAF), which builds ontology-driven knowledge systems through six iterative stages and retrieves evidence via Context-Aware Relevance Propagation (CARP), so that every retrieved fact carries its relationship type, confidence, and source lineage. An evaluation on FinanceBench (145 questions) compares KDAF against zero-context inference, BM25, concept-weighted lexical retrieval, and ungrounded graph traversal. First, retrieval is necessary: zero-context inference reaches 4.1% correctness against 10-12% for retrieval-augmented conditions. Second, on answer correctness the retrieval conditions are statistically indistinguishable (KDAF vs BM25: -0.007, 95% CI [-0.021, 0.000]), so accuracy alone does not justify structured retrieval here -- a negative result we report explicitly. Third, on auditability the ordering reverses: KDAF attains the highest citation traceability F1 (0.515), exceeding ungrounded traversal by +0.027 (CI [0.006, 0.050]) and BM25 by +0.052 (CI [0.024, 0.083]), intervals excluding zero. Graph-structured retrieval also admits no evidence from outside the question subject entity (0 of 426 items, against 16.8% and 20.2% for lexical baselines), and every selected item resolves to a complete provenance chain. We argue that auditability, not accuracy, is the axis on which ontology-grounded retrieval earns its cost.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables, 1 algorithm. Artifact deposit with configurations, ontology schema, prompts, audit reports and reconstruction scripts: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22022068
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文主张企业金融场景中的检索增强生成 (RAG) 应同时以可审计性 (auditability) 和准确性为评估维度，并提出知识驱动分析框架 (KDAF)：通过六个迭代阶段构建基于本体 (ontology) 的知识系统，并使用上下文感知相关性传播 (CARP) 检索证据，使每条被检索事实都携带关系类型、置信度与来源血统。在 FinanceBench (145 道题) 上，零上下文推理的正确率为 4.1%，而检索增强条件为 10-12%；在答案正确性上各检索条件统计上不可区分 (KDAF vs BM25 差值为 -0.007，95% CI [-0.021, 0.000])，但 KDAF 的引用可追溯 F1 最高 (0.515)，显著超过无约束图遍历 (+0.027，CI [0.006, 0.050]) 和 BM25 (+0.052，CI [0.024, 0.083])。作者明确报告了准确性维度的负结果，并论证本体化检索的代价由可审计性而非准确性来补偿。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在企业财务中的采用瓶颈不在于流畅性而在于信任：在财务规划与分析 (FP&A) 等受监管流程中，答案只有可追溯到权威来源并能在事后审计才可用。因此需要将可审计性与准确性并列作为企业金融 RAG 的评估维度。
Method: 提出知识驱动分析框架 (KDAF)，通过六个迭代阶段构建本体驱动的知识系统；检索采用上下文感知相关性传播 (CARP)，使每个被检索事实都带有关系类型、置信度和来源血统。评估在 FinanceBench (145 问) 上进行，对比零上下文推理、BM25、概念加权词法检索和无约束图遍历。
Result: 零上下文推理正确率仅 4.1%，检索增强条件为 10-12%，说明检索是必要的；但在答案正确性上各检索条件统计上不可区分 (KDAF vs BM25: -0.007，95% CI [-0.021, 0.000])。在可审计性上，KDAF 的引用可追溯 F1 为 0.515，超过无约束遍历 +0.027 (CI [0.006, 0.050]) 和 BM25 +0.052 (CI [0.024, 0.083])；图结构检索不从问题主体实体之外引入证据 (0/426，而词法基线为 16.8% 和 20.2%)，且每个选中项都能解析出完整的溯源链。
Conclusion: 作者论证，可审计性而非准确性才是本体化检索值得付出成本的轴心，并明确报告了准确性维度的负结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting Resource Efficient Hamiltonian Decomposition for Continuous-Time Quantum Walk Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Simulating a continuous-time quantum walk (CTQW) on a graph in the circuit model of quantum computing requires decomposing its Hamiltonian into terms that can be Trotterized into hardware-native gates. We consider two such decompositions: the standard Pauli decomposition and the recently introduced matching decomposition. Prior work suggests that the matching decomposition uses fewer CX gates on sparse graphs, while the Pauli decomposition uses fewer on denser graphs. Since CX gates dominate error and runtime on current hardware, we train machine learning models to predict, for a given graph, which of the two decompositions produces the smaller CX gate count. We train and evaluate on the complete population of all 11,117 connected eight-vertex graphs from Brendan McKay's database, so the class balance and overlap are measured directly rather than estimated. We use twelve features: ten topological properties of the graph and two that count the terms the Pauli and matching decompositions produce (n_Pauli and n_match), both computable without transpiling the simulation circuit. Standard topological properties alone provide little predictive power. Instead, the dominant signal comes from n_Pauli, a property of the Hamiltonian decomposition rather than an intrinsic property of the graph; degree variance is the only other feature that carries signal. Across a range of models the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) falls in a narrow band, from 0.569 untuned to 0.593 after tuning, so no single architecture stands out. We adopt a single-hidden-layer neural network at MCC 0.593. Applied frozen to a held-out, class-balanced test set of larger graphs (up to 256 vertices) from structured and Erdos-Renyi families, the model transfers, with MCC rising from 0.785 at N=8 to 1 at N>=64.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续时间量子行走（CTQW）模拟中哈密顿量分解的选择问题，针对稀疏图上的匹配分解（matching decomposition）与稠密图上的标准 Pauli 分解，训练机器学习模型预测哪种分解产生更少的 CX 门数。实验覆盖 Brendan McKay 数据库中全部 11,117 个八顶点连通图，模型在 8 顶点上 MCC 为 0.593，并迁移到更大图（256 顶点）时 MCC 升至 1。
Motivation: 在电路模型中模拟 CTQW 需要将哈密顿量分解为可 Trotter 化的项，不同分解的 CX 门数差异影响当前硬件上的错误率和运行时间。先前工作暗示匹配分解在稀疏图上更优、Pauli 分解在稠密图上更优，但缺乏系统预测方法。
Method: 使用十二个特征（十个图的拓扑属性，加上 Pauli 与匹配分解产生的项数 n_Pauli 和 n_match），训练多种机器学习模型对比预测，最终采用单隐层神经网络。
Result: 仅靠拓扑属性预测能力很弱，n_Pauli 是最主要的信号，度方差（degree variance）是唯一有信号的拓扑特征；各模型 MCC 集中在 0.569（未调参）到 0.593（调参后）。冻结模型迁移到最多 256 顶点的结构化和 Erdős–Rényi 图测试集上，MCC 从 N=8 的 0.785 升至 N≥64 的 1。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分解级特征 n_Pauli 而非纯图内在属性主导预测能力，且该模型在不同规模的图上具有良好的迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lift, Associate, and Fuse: A Decision-Centric Framework for 2D-to-3D Foundation Model Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Methods that transfer predictions from two-dimensional foundation models into three-dimensional segmentation are commonly grouped by task or representation. Those groupings obscure the decisions that determine whether a system remains coherent across views: where image evidence is grounded, when observations become one identity, how semantic and granularity conflicts are handled, which information is fused, and what state survives for later queries. We introduce \textbf{Lift, Associate, and Fuse (LAF)}, a decision-centric framework that represents a transfer system as five operators: \textbf{Generate, Associate, Reconcile, Fuse, and Persist/Query}. LAF defines an explicit contract for the persistent carrier---its spatial support, semantic state, identity state, uncertainty, provenance, and supported operations---and identifies the first stage at which discarded evidence becomes unrecoverable. We operationalize the framework as a structured audit protocol and apply it to 161 systems available through 7 August 2026, spanning point-, field-, Gaussian-, object-, graph-, and memory-based carriers. Representation, temporal, relational, and feed-forward stress tests required no additional analytical stage after the final confirmation pass. The resulting decision traces expose four recurring properties: association does not establish identity; carrier design fixes both the query interface and correction boundary; rendered-view, native-3D, and proposal-level evaluations are not interchangeable; and qualifiers such as \emph{training-free}, \emph{real-time}, \emph{open-vocabulary}, and \emph{generalizable} are meaningful only when attached to a stage and a complete cost ledger. LAF therefore supplies a representation-neutral method for comparing existing systems, diagnosing irreversible failures, and specifying revisable 3D perception for future agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Lift, Associate, and Fuse (LAF)，一个面向 2D 基础模型预测迁移到 3D 分割的决策中心框架。LAF 将迁移系统表示为五个算子：Generate、Associate、Reconcile、Fuse 和 Persist/Query，并为持久载体 (persistent carrier) 定义显式契约，包括空间支撑、语义状态、身份状态、不确定性、来源和受支持操作。作者将该框架实例化为结构化审计协议，并应用于截至 2026 年 8 月 7 日的 161 个系统，覆盖点、场、高斯、物体、图和记忆等载体。决策轨迹揭示了四个反复出现的性质，例如关联并不建立身份、载体设计同时决定查询接口与修正边界等。
Motivation: 现有的 2D 到 3D 基础模型迁移方法通常按任务或表示分组，这掩盖了决定系统在跨视角下是否保持一致性的关键决策，例如图像证据在哪里落地、观测何时成为同一身份、语义和粒度冲突如何处理、哪些信息被融合以及哪些状态为后续查询留存。
Method: LAF 将迁移系统表示为五个算子的决策中心框架，并定义持久载体的显式契约及其支持的操作；框架同时指明被丢弃的证据在哪个阶段开始不可恢复。作者把框架操作化为结构化审计协议，对 161 个系统进行表示、时序、关系和前馈压力测试，并生成决策轨迹。
Result: 对 161 个系统的审计暴露了四个反复出现的性质：关联不建立身份；载体设计固定了查询界面和修正边界；渲染视图、原生 3D 与提案级评估不可互换；training-free、real-time、open-vocabulary、generalizable 等限定词只有附加到具体阶段和完整成本账目时才有意义。
Conclusion: LAF 提供了一种表示无关的方法，用于比较现有系统、诊断不可逆失败，并为未来智能体规范可修正的 3D 感知。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RiskTraf: Risk-Extrapolated Residual Learning for Multi-Variate Traffic Flow Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Traffic sensors commonly record flow, speed, and occupancy, but standard traffic flow forecasting benchmarks and models rarely exploit all three raw measurements reliably. Although speed and occupancy provide sensor-native traffic-state information beyond flow alone, existing releases often omit these variables, replace them with proxies, or contain logically inconsistent records. Moreover, direct empirical risk minimization over three-variable inputs may exploit regime-dependent shortcuts, as the relationships among flow, speed, and occupancy vary substantially between free-flow and congested states. We introduce \textbf{PEMSB-3V}, a public benchmark suite that preserves raw flow, speed, and occupancy measurements from PeMS detectors for flow prediction. We also propose \textbf{RiskTraf}, a model-agnostic risk-extrapolated residual plug-in. For each trained spatio-temporal backbone, RiskTraf freezes the selected checkpoint and learns a lightweight zero-start residual head from historical speed and occupancy. The residual head constructs ordered traffic-risk environments and optimizes horizon-wise flow corrections with a risk extrapolation objective, thereby mitigating regime-specific shortcut correlations without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RiskTraf consistently improves diverse forecasting backbones and outperforms debiasing and distribution-shift adaptation methods. Our code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/Guangyu4/RiskTraf.
papers.journal_ref: CIKM' 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEMSB-3V，一个保留 PeMS 检测器原始流量、速度、占用率三变量测量值的公开交通流量预测基准；并在此基础上提出 RiskTraf，一种模型无关的风险外推残差插件。RiskTraf 冻结已训练的时空骨干网络，基于历史速度和占用率学习轻量零起点残差头，通过构造有序交通风险环境并优化风险外推目标来缓解流量-速度-占用率之间随自由流/拥堵状态变化的捷径相关性，同时不修改骨干网络。实验表明 RiskTraf 能一致提升多种预测骨干并优于去偏和分布偏移适应方法。
Motivation: 标准流量预测基准和模型很少可靠利用流量之外的速度与占用率原始测量值，且常用数据存在变量缺失、代理替换或逻辑不一致的问题；此外，直接对三变量输入做经验风险最小化可能利用流量、速度、占用率之间在不同交通状态（自由流 vs 拥堵）下差异显著的捷径相关性。
Method: 构建保留原始三变量测量值的 PEMSB-3V 基准；提出 RiskTraf，一种模型无关的残差插件：冻结训练好的时空骨干检查点，用历史速度和占用率学习轻量零起点残差头，构造有序的交通风险环境，并用风险外推目标逐视界优化流量修正，从而在不改动骨干的前提下缓解特定状态下的捷径相关。
Result: 大量实验表明 RiskTraf 一致提升多种预测骨干的性能，并优于已有的去偏和分布偏移适应方法；代码和基准已开源。
Conclusion: 论文强调利用传感器原生速度与占用率测量并显式处理状态相关捷径可以改善多变量交通流量预测，且其插件式设计保持模型无关性。

papers.title: Meta-clustering of milk mid-infrared spectra identifies dairy cow groups associated with negative energy balance in early lactation
papers.abstract_en: Clustering methods have been used to identify distinct groups of milk samples, cows, or herds. Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, particularly mid-infrared (MIR) spectroscopy, has been applied to individual cow milk samples to predict various milk traits. Applying clustering directly to MIR spectral data may reveal latent groups of cows associated with milk traits or health disorders and can help prevent these conditions or monitor at-risk animals. This study aimed to identify groups of individual dairy cows in early lactation directly from milk MIR spectra and to analyze their associations with milk traits. Using a dataset of 407,632 individual milk MIR records from 3,408 commercial farms, we combined (i) spectral filtering that selects informative wavenumbers, (ii) two dimensionality-reduction methods: principal component analysis (PCA) and an autoencoder, and (iii) two clustering algorithms: k-means and spectral clustering to yield eight different clustering approaches. We regrouped the assigned clusters into meta-clusters that encompassed the most similar ones identified by the eight approaches. Our results revealed five distinct meta-clusters of early-lactation individual dairy cows significantly associated with milk traits. Despite substantial differences, the eight approaches converged on the same five meta-clusters, and the classic, computationally efficient PCA-based k-means approach using the full spectrum recaptured clusters identified by more sophisticated, computationally intensive approaches. The five meta-clusters were strongly associated with DIM and appeared to reflect a gradient of negative energy balance (NEB) severity: severe, moderate, and possibly mild, while the remaining two likely represented cows recovering from NEB, one with rapid restoration of energy balance and one in early recovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 407,632 条来自 3,408 个商业牧场的个体奶牛乳汁中红外 (MIR) 光谱记录，结合谱段筛选、PCA/自编码器降维以及 k-means/谱聚类，构建八种聚类方案并对结果进行 meta-clustering，最终识别出五个与乳汁性状显著关联的早泌乳期奶牛类别。摘要指出这五个 meta-cluster 与泌乳天数 (DIM) 强相关，并反映负能量平衡 (NEB) 严重程度的梯度。
Motivation: 直接对 MIR 光谱聚类可能揭示与乳汁性状或健康紊乱相关的潜在奶牛群体，有助于预防或监测高危动物；现有研究尚未系统比较多种降维与聚类组合并整合其共识结果。
Method: 方法包括三部分组合：选取信息性波数的光谱过滤、PCA 与自编码器两种降维方法、k-means 与谱聚类两种聚类算法，共构成八种聚类途径；随后将各途径分配的簇重组成 meta-clusters，聚合最相似的簇。
Result: 八种方法收敛到相同的五个 meta-cluster，且经典的 PCA 加 k-means（使用全谱）能够复现更复杂、计算密集方法识别出的簇；五个类别与 DIM 强烈关联，呈现 NEB 严重程度梯度（重度、中度、可能轻度），其余两类可能分别代表能量平衡快速恢复和早期恢复中的奶牛。
Conclusion: 摘要强调计算高效的 PCA-k-means 全谱方法足以识别复杂方法发现的奶牛分组，五个 meta-cluster 可作为早泌乳期负能量平衡相关风险分层的依据。

papers.title: Beyond Effectiveness: A Multi-Criteria Framework for Comparing Practical Socio-Technical Interventions
papers.abstract_en: Designers and policymakers in sociotechnical domains like content moderation, privacy interfaces, recommender systems and beyond, must choose among a growing menu of proposed interventions, but typically lack a principled basis for comparing them. Prior work tends to evaluate interventions individually and mostly along the effectiveness criteria, while implementation constraints such as cost, effort and feasibility are often considered separately. We present a multi-criteria framework for evaluating sociotechnical interventions. This framework is instantiated through the case of misinformation, a domain of intense focus for proposed countermeasures. We survey $N=39$ researchers on 40 operationalized interventions across five evaluative criteria: political feasibility, effectiveness, user acceptance, cost, and implementation effort. We find that the interventions that experts judge to be the most effective are not always the most acceptable to the public or the most feasible to implement. We also discuss how this tension has implications for the design of sociotechnical interventions beyond misinformation, and offer a decision framework for practitioners navigating the trade-offs of sociotechnical interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多准则框架，用于比较社会技术干预措施（sociotechnical interventions），并以错误信息（misinformation）领域为例进行实例化。作者调查了39位研究者对40项已操作化的干预措施在政治可行性、有效性、用户接受度、成本和实施努力五个维度上的评价，发现专家认为最有效的干预措施并不总是最容易被公众接受或最可行的。
Motivation: 社会技术领域的设计者和政策制定者需要在众多干预措施中做出选择，但缺乏原则性的比较基础；已有研究通常单独评估干预措施且主要关注有效性，实施约束如成本、努力和可行性常被分开考虑。
Method: 构建一个多准则评估框架，并通过错误信息领域的案例来实例化；具体做法是向39位研究者发放调查，对40项操作化的干预措施在政治可行性、有效性、用户接受度、成本和实施努力五个准则上进行评分。
Result: 调查发现专家评判为最有效的干预措施并不总是公众最可接受的或最易实施的，有效性与其他准则之间存在张力。
Conclusion: 作者讨论了这种张力对错误信息之外的社会技术干预设计的影响，并为从业者提供了一个权衡干预措施取舍的决策框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: One Hierarchy, Two Systems: Semantic Product IDs for Discovery-Surface Ranking and Search-Page Query Reformulation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-merchant e-commerce catalogs contain equivalent and related products under different merchant-scoped identifiers, fragmenting behavioral evidence across merchants. Expert-defined taxonomies, meanwhile, are often too coarse for fine-grained discovery. We investigate whether a single hierarchical Semantic ID (\sid{}) representation can support personalized ranking and query reformulation. Learned once from product-content embeddings, the hierarchy defines product concepts at multiple granularities that each application combines with its own behavioral and serving context. For ranking, we aggregate consumer affinity and product performance over \sid{} prefixes and derive sequence features for candidate products and consumer histories. Controlled ablations show improved offline relevance, while online evaluation of the full ranking treatment shows stronger top-slot add-to-cart engagement and broader exposure for less-popular products. For query reformulation, we ground queries and session transitions in \sid{} concepts, use the hierarchy for navigation and refinement, and filter suggestions against the merchant's assortment. Offline evaluation shows finer intent preservation than taxonomy and higher-quality suggestions than raw query-string transitions; online evaluation shows reduced search effort and earlier access to purchasable products. These results show that a shared semantic product hierarchy can support both recommendation and search while preserving the task-specific context required by each application.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多商家电商目录中，能否用一个统一的层次化语义ID（Semantic ID）表示来同时支持发现页面的个性化排序和搜索页的查询改写。该层次结构从商品内容嵌入中学习一次，以多种粒度定义商品概念，每个应用结合自身的行为和投放上下文使用。离线对照实验显示相关性提升，在线评估显示排名场景中顶层加购参与度更强、冷门商品曝光更广；查询改写场景中用户搜索成本降低、更早触达可购商品。
Motivation: 多商家电商目录中的等效和相关商品使用不同的商家级标识，导致行为证据被割裂；专家定义的品类体系往往过于粗糙，难以支撑细粒度的发现。
Method: 提出单一层次化语义ID（Semantic ID）表示，从商品内容嵌入中学习出多粒度商品概念层次；排序应用在语义ID前缀上聚合消费者亲和力和商品表现，查询改写应用将查询和会话迁移锚定到语义ID概念上，并基于商家选品过滤建议。
Result: 离线评估显示排序相关性提升，在线评估显示顶层加购参与度增强且冷门商品曝光更广；查询改写的离线评估显示意图保留优于传统品类体系、建议质量高于原始查询串迁移，在线评估显示搜索成本降低并更早访问可购商品。
Conclusion: 共享的语义商品层次结构可以同时支撑推荐和搜索两个任务，同时保留每个应用所需的任务特定上下文。

papers.title: MV2GF: Multi-view Pedestrian Detection with a Visual Geometric Foundation Model
papers.abstract_en: Multi-View Pedestrian Detection (MVPD) aims to detect pedestrians in the form of a bird's eye view map from multi-view images. Recent MVPD methods adopt a unified framework that projects 2D image features into a 3D world space and aggregates them into a single feature. Although they are effective, they struggle to generalize to unseen camera configurations during training due to two main issues. First, they are difficult to capture accurate visual geometry across views in unseen camera configurations. Second, they make detection models highly dependent on distortion patterns during training arising from their image feature projection. To address these, we leverage a visual geometric foundation model and propose MV2GF. This foundation model has exhibited strong generalization in capturing visual geometry across views and predicting accurate 3D attributes in diverse camera configurations. MV2GF fuses task-specific features with general-purpose geometric features extracted by the foundation model to effectively capture the visual geometry even in unseen camera configurations. Furthermore, MV2GF projects each pixel in the image features to an appropriate 3D location using 3D pointmaps predicted by the foundation model, preventing the detection model from depending on distortion patterns during training. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of leveraging a visual geometric foundation model for MVPD and that MV2GF generalizes better than existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多视角行人检测（Multi-View Pedestrian Detection, MVPD）在未见相机配置下泛化差的问题，提出 MV2GF，利用视觉几何基础模型融合任务特定特征与通用几何特征，并借助基础模型预测的 3D 点图将图像像素投影到合适的 3D 位置，以缓解对训练时畸变模式的依赖。实验表明 MV2GF 的泛化能力优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有多视角行人检测方法在训练中见过的相机配置之外泛化困难，主要原因是难以在未见配置下捕捉准确的跨视角视觉几何，且检测模型高度依赖图像特征投影产生的畸变模式。
Method: MV2GF 使用视觉几何基础模型提取通用几何特征，并与任务特定特征融合以捕捉跨视角视觉几何；同时通过基础模型预测的 3D 点图将每个图像像素投影到合适的 3D 位置，避免模型依赖训练时的畸变模式。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明利用视觉几何基础模型对 MVPD 有效，且 MV2GF 比现有方法具有更好的泛化能力，但未给出具体量化指标。
Conclusion: 论文的结论是视觉几何基础模型的跨视角几何泛化能力可以迁移到多视角行人检测中，从而改善未见相机配置下的检测性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Provable Edge-of-Stability for Adam on a One-Dimensional Quadratic
papers.abstract_en: The edge-of-stability (EoS) phenomenon of Adam has been widely observed, while its underlying dynamical mechanism is not yet fully understood. We study uncorrected Adam on a one-dimensional quadratic, a clean setting where constant curvature isolates the optimizer-induced dynamics behind the EoS. We characterize the resulting dynamics across the parameter space. In broad regimes, we prove that Adam exhibits a restoring tendency toward its frozen stability threshold $2(1+β_1)/[η(1-β_1)]$. We also identify settings in which this edge-seeking mechanism breaks down, including strictly subcritical periodic orbits and specially tuned trajectories that converge to the optimum while remaining uniformly supercritical. These results give a concrete dynamical explanation for Adam's EoS in a setting free of evolving loss geometry, while also exposing its limitations.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: Adam 的 EoS 现象已被广泛观测，但驱动它的底层动力学机制尚未被完全理解。作者选择一维二次函数的干净设定，用恒定曲率把优化器自身引发的动力学隔离出来，以便从理论上解释 EoS 的成因。

papers.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
papers.abstract_en: Static analyzers have been widely adopted for vulnerability detection in C/C++ programs. Query-based static analyzers (e.g., CodeQL) encode vulnerable code patterns in detection queries and match them against source code. However, existing queries still suffer from false positives (FPs, incorrectly flagging benign code as vulnerable) and false negatives (FNs, missing real vulnerabilities). We present ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized C/C++ programs. Our key insight is that a synthesized program exposes a query's weakness whenever its execution disagrees with the query's verdict. If the program is genuinely vulnerable but the query stays silent, the query has an FN weakness; if the program is safe but the query fires anyway, it has an FP weakness. ARQ then runs an LLM-based refinement loop that repairs the query using these disagreements as ground truth. Unlike previous query refining methods, ARQ requires no labeled datasets, no commit history, and no vulnerability-specific templates. We demonstrate the effectiveness of ARQ by refining 12 official CodeQL queries using three commercial LLMs (GPT-5.4, Claude-Sonnet-4.6, and Gemini-3.5-flash). We compare both ARQ-refined and original CodeQL queries on the Juliet v1.3 and FormAI v2 datasets and show that ARQ-refined queries detect substantially more true positives, by up to 119.8\%, with a Precision of at least 98.0\% throughout. ARQ successfully fixed three unresolved GitHub issues raised in the official CodeQL query repository that had remained open for as long as \textit{27 months}. The refined queries also exposed two previously undiscovered bugs in the real-world libraries libpng and zlib.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ARQ，一个智能体框架，用于自动优化 C/C++ 的 CodeQL 检测查询。其核心思路是利用合成 C/C++ 程序的实际执行结果与查询判定不一致来暴露查询的弱点，再由 LLM 循环修复查询。实验显示，用 ARQ 优化后的 12 个官方 CodeQL 查询在 Juliet v1.3 和 FormAI v2 上检测到显著更多的真阳性，并修复了官方仓库中遗留已久的 GitHub issue。
Motivation: 基于查询的静态分析器如 CodeQL 在 C/C++ 漏洞检测中广泛使用，但现有查询仍存在误报 (false positives) 和漏报 (false negatives)。以往的查询细化方法依赖标注数据集、提交历史或漏洞专用模板，缺乏通用且自动化的途径。
Method: ARQ 通过合成 C/C++ 程序，将程序执行结果与查询判定对照：若程序真实有漏洞但查询未报警，则识别为 FN 弱点；若程序安全但查询误报，则识别为 FP 弱点。随后使用 LLM 驱动的细化循环，以这些不一致作为 ground truth 来修复 CodeQL 查询。
Result: 使用三个商用 LLM（GPT-5.4、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-3.5-flash）精化 12 个官方 CodeQL 查询，在 Juliet v1.3 和 FormAI v2 上真阳性数提升最高达 119.8%，全程精度至少 98.0%。ARQ 成功修复了官方 CodeQL 查询仓库中三个悬而未决的 GitHub issue（最长达 27 个月），并在 libpng 和 zlib 中发现了两个此前未知的 bug。
Conclusion: ARQ 证明了借助合成程序执行证据与 LLM 细化循环，可以在无需标注数据、提交历史或漏洞模板的条件下自动改善 CodeQL 查询，从而提升 C/C++ 漏洞检测效果。

papers.title: MIL-BERT: Classification of Arbitrarily Large Text with Performance and Explanatory Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Many text classification decisions are viable based on constituent excerpts alone. Taking inspiration from the field of multiple instance learning, we present an algorithm for training a neural network to classify text by selecting such excerpts. We show that our approach is also scalable with demonstrated learning against samples with nearly 1M tokens. We evaluate our methods on 7 datasets with emphasis on long-textual collections that far exceed the encoding limit of our base model. We present state-of-the-art results with this algorithm on 3 datasets: identification of political bias in news outlets, trigger warnings in long stories, and demographic characteristics of authors in tweet collections. Furthermore, the model trained on weakly-labeled collections of text (bags) generalizes to accurately classify constituent, smaller instances. Besides a new state-of-the-art for these problems, this approach is one of the few neural methods to excel in these datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIL-BERT，一种受多实例学习 (multiple instance learning) 启发的方法，通过从文本中挑选关键片段（excerpts）来训练神经网络完成分类，从而处理远超基础编码器长度限制的超长文本。作者在 7 个数据集上评估，并在新闻政治偏见识别、长故事触发警告、推文作者人口统计三个数据集上取得当前最优结果；对近 1M token 样本也可进行有效学习。
Motivation: 许多文本分类决策仅依据文本中的部分片段即可做出，而现有神经分类器受限于固定编码长度，难以直接处理超长文本。
Method: 借鉴多实例学习的思想，把待分类文本视为 bag，训练模型自动选择其中具有判别力的片段并据此分类；训练和推理可扩展到大 token 数样本。
Result: 实验显示该方法可对近 1M token 的样本进行学习；在 7 个数据集上评测，并在其中 3 个数据集（新闻政治偏见、长故事触发警告、推文作者人口统计特征）上达到新 SOTA。此外，在弱标签 bag（弱标注集合）上训练的模型能够泛化到对更小组成实例的分类。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法是少数能在这些长文本数据集中表现优异的神经方法，并兼具性能与可解释性（通过选择的片段提供解释）方面的保证。

papers.title: Minimax Optimality of Score-Entropy Discrete Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Discrete diffusion models have demonstrated strong performance across a range of datasets, including natural language data and graph-structured data. Among many variants, score-entropy discrete diffusion (SEDD) has achieved particularly strong empirical results. In SEDD, new samples are generated by iteratively evaluating a sequence of concrete score functions, which are learned by minimizing a score-entropy loss. While much of the prior theoretical literature on discrete diffusion has focused on the sampling efficiency of SEDD under the assumption of small score estimation error, recent work has begun to investigate the finite-sample properties of score estimation itself. In this work, we take a different route by investigating the fundamental statistical limits of concrete score estimation. We focus on uniform and masking discrete diffusions, two of the most widely adopted discrete diffusion models. We establish a minimax lower bound under the score-entropy loss, and propose an MLE-based thresholding estimator that matches this lower bound up to constant and polylogarithmic factors that depend on neighboring density ratios. We further show that, for any target distribution, this density ratio is naturally controlled under both uniform and masking discrete diffusion models, yielding nearly matching minimax lower and upper bounds for the aggregated score estimation error. Our results imply that, with appropriate initialization and discretization, SEDD can achieve nearly optimal minimax sample complexity, as measured by the KL divergence between the target and generated distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离散扩散模型中 concrete score 估计的统计极限，以 uniform 与 masking 两类最常用的离散扩散为对象，建立 score-entropy 损失下的 minimax 下界，并提出基于 MLE 的阈值化估计器，使上界与下界在常数和对数因子内匹配。作者进一步证明这两类扩散模型对任意目标分布都自然控制相邻密度比，从而得到聚合 score 估计误差的近似匹配 minimax 界，并据此说明 SEDD 在合适的初始化与离散化下可达到近最优的 minimax 样本复杂度。
Motivation: 此前离散扩散的理论工作多假设 score 估计误差很小，只关注采样效率；近期才开始考察 score 估计本身的有限样本性质。本文转向 concrete score 估计的基本统计极限，填补这一理论空白。
Method: 在 score-entropy 损失下建立 minimax 下界，并提出一个基于 MLE 的阈值化估计器（MLE-based thresholding estimator），其误差依赖相邻密度比；随后证明 uniform 与 masking 离散扩散对任意目标分布都能自然控制该密度比，从而得到匹配的上下界。
Result: 摘要报告了聚合 score 估计误差的近似匹配 minimax 上下界，并表明在适当的初始化和离散化条件下，SEDD 以 KL 散度衡量可实现近最优的 minimax 样本复杂度。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在 uniform 与 masking 扩散模型下 SEDD 的理论样本复杂度接近最优；该结论局限于这两类扩散模型及 score-entropy 损失框架。

papers.title: AgentMercury: Your Agent Can Synthesize Verifiable Environments for Business Scenarios at scale
papers.abstract_en: Agents learn to act through interaction with environments, yet the environments used for training are often manually constructed or synthesized around predefined tasks and benchmarks. This task-centric paradigm makes it difficult to scale environments that reflect realistic and evolving workflows where diverse tasks can naturally emerge from the underlying world. We introduce AgentMercury, a scalable framework for synthesizing executable environments from high-level business scenarios. Rather than constructing an environment for a specific task, AgentMercury first instantiates a persistent world with entities, services, tools, state, and executable cross-service invariants, from which diverse tasks and interaction trajectories can subsequently emerge. We construct 4,783 executable environments spanning 14 industries and 50 countries, and use them as training substrates for reinforcement learning. Despite being generated without targeting the evaluation benchmarks, policies trained on these business-oriented environments improve substantially on both enterprise workflows and out-of-domain benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, scientific computing, and tool use. In our experiments, Qwen3.5-4B improves from 12.3 to 15.7 on EnterpriseOps-GYM and from 45.9 to 56.0 on AIME26 after training on AgentMercury environments. We further show that the construction process itself can be learned: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on construction traces increases executable-world authoring success from 3.3% to 83.3% on held-out business scenarios. These results show that scenario-grounded environments can provide useful and generalizable learning signals beyond benchmark-specific training, while their construction can itself become a learnable capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentMercury，一个从高层业务场景合成可执行环境的规模化框架。与围绕特定任务构建环境不同，该方法先实例化包含实体、服务、工具、状态与可执行跨服务不变量的持久世界，再让多样任务与交互轨迹从中涌现。研究者构建了覆盖 14 个行业、50 个国家的 4,783 个可执行环境，并用它们作为强化学习训练基板；摘要报告训练出的策略在未见过的基准上也有提升。
Motivation: 现有智能体训练环境多为手工构建或围绕预定义任务与基准合成，这种以任务为中心的范式难以扩展出反映真实且不断演化的业务工作流的环境，而多样化任务本应从底层世界中自然涌现。
Method: AgentMercury 先构建持久世界（entities、services、tools、state 以及可执行的跨服务 invariants），再从中产生任务与交互轨迹；该过程被用作强化学习的训练基板，并且环境构建过程本身也可通过学习获得——通过对构建轨迹做微调来提升可执行世界的创作成功率。
Result: 在没有针对评估基准生成环境的情况下，训练出的策略在多个领域显著提升：Qwen3.5-4B 在 EnterpriseOps-GYM 上从 12.3 提升到 15.7，在 AIME26 上从 45.9 提升到 56.0；对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在构建轨迹上微调后，留出业务场景的可执行世界创作成功率从 3.3% 提升到 83.3%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基于场景的环境能提供超越基准特定训练的通用学习信号，且环境构建本身可以成为一种可学习的能力。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: AgentMercury 先构建持久世界（entities、services、tools、state 以及可执行的跨服务 invariants），再从中产生任务与交互轨迹；该过程被用作强化学习的训练基板，并且环境构建过程本身也可通过学习获得——通过对构建轨迹做微调来提升可执行世界的创作成功率。
summary_sections.result: 在没有针对评估基准生成环境的情况下，训练出的策略在多个领域显著提升：Qwen3.5-4B 在 EnterpriseOps-GYM 上从 12.3 提升到 15.7，在 AIME26 上从 45.9 提升到 56.0；对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在构建轨迹上微调后，留出业务场景的可执行世界创作成功率从 3.3% 提升到 83.3%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，基于场景的环境能提供超越基准特定训练的通用学习信号，且环境构建本身可以成为一种可学习的能力。

papers.title: Weighted Memory Tree: Remembering What Matters for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated the ability to solve multi-step tasks requiring planning, tool use, and external information access, yet growing execution histories increase inference cost and expose reasoning to outdated, irrelevant, or misleading information, potentially degrading reasoning quality. Existing memory approaches organize or compress execution histories but provide limited mechanisms for deciding which memories remain active. We introduce the, a hierarchical memory system that organizes execution into tasks, subtasks, and actions while assigning each memory a dynamic retention score. Event-based updates and selection-based decay revise these scores, allowing WMT to preserve useful information, fold completed trajectories, suppress low-utility content, and retain access to folded context. We evaluate WMT on GAIA-Text using Qwen3-8B, Gemma 4 E4B, and Llama-3.1-8B, with ablations and memory-poisoning experiments. Relative to linear memory, WMT improves accuracy by an average of 9.97 percentage points while reducing prompt-token usage by 32.8%. Memory-poisoning experiments show that WMT limits the persistence and propagation of unreliable information. Our results suggest that effective long-horizon agent memory depends less on storing more information than on deciding which information should remain active.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出加权记忆树 (Weighted Memory Tree, WMT)，一种分层记忆系统，将 LLM agent 的执行历史组织为任务、子任务和动作的层级，并为每条记忆分配动态保留分数 (retention score)。事件驱动的更新与基于选择的衰减机制不断修正这些分数，从而保留有用信息、折叠已完成轨迹、抑制低效用内容并保留对被折叠上下文的访问。在 GAIA-Text 上以 Qwen3-8B、Gemma 4 E4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 评估，相对线性记忆平均提升准确率 9.97 个百分点，同时减少 32.8% 的 prompt token 用量；记忆投毒实验显示 WMT 能限制不可靠信息的持久化与传播。
Motivation: 长时程 LLM agent 的执行历史不断增长，增加推理成本，并可能引入过时、无关或误导信息而降低推理质量；现有记忆方法着重组织或压缩历史，但缺乏决定哪些记忆保持活跃的机制。
Method: 提出 WMT：将执行历史组织为任务、子任务、动作的层次结构，为每条记忆分配动态保留分数；通过事件驱动更新和基于选择的衰减来修订分数，从而保留有用信息、折叠已完成轨迹、抑制低效用内容，并保持对被折叠上下文的访问。
Result: 在 GAIA-Text 上对 Qwen3-8B、Gemma 4 E4B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 进行评估，并做了消融与记忆投毒实验；与线性记忆相比，平均准确率提升 9.97 个百分点，prompt token 用量减少 32.8%，且能限制不可靠信息的持久与传播。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是长时程 agent 记忆的有效性更多取决于决定哪些信息应保持活跃，而非存储更多信息。
