papers.title: SAGE: A Unified Algebra and Self-Adaptive Execution for AI Functions in SQL
papers.abstract_en: SQL systems increasingly expose AI functions for tasks such as classification, extraction, filtering, ranking, retrieval, joining, and summarization. Despite their diverse APIs, these functions play only three relational roles: transforming individual rows, aggregating groups, or generating relationships between row pairs. We present SAGE (Self-Adaptive Generative Execution), a unified logical and physical framework that captures these roles with three typed primitives, AI_SCALAR, AI_AGG, and AI_JOIN, and composes them naturally with standard relational operators. All primitives share a confidence-gated execution interface while supporting physical strategies tailored to their relational shape. The main challenge is AI_JOIN, where SAGE analyzes the predicate, decomposes compound conditions when possible, and uses a recipe card together with a small label-free probe to select among complete execution strategies. Across a broad audit of public AI operators and evaluations spanning scalar, aggregate, and join workloads, this formulation covers common AI functionality while consistently improving execution quality and efficiency. SAGE achieves the strongest overall SemBench performance and, on a representative factorable join, reduces pairwise model calls by more than two orders of magnitude, yielding a 358-fold measured cost reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAGE (Self-Adaptive Generative Execution)，一个统一的逻辑与物理框架，将 SQL 中的 AI 函数归纳为三种关系型原语 AI_SCALAR、AI_AGG 和 AI_JOIN，并与标准关系运算符组合。所有原语共享置信门控执行接口，针对 AI_JOIN 通过谓词分析、配方卡 (recipe card) 和无标签探针选择完整执行策略。实验显示 SAGE 在 SemBench 上取得最强整体性能，并在一个可分解连接上减少超过两个数量级的成对模型调用，实现 358 倍成本降低。
Motivation: SQL 系统越来越多地暴露 AI 函数（分类、抽取、过滤、排序、检索、连接、摘要等），但这些函数 API 各异，缺乏统一的逻辑和物理执行框架，导致难以优化和组合。
Method: 提出三种类型化原语 AI_SCALAR、AI_AGG、AI_JOIN 分别对应行变换、组聚合和行对关系生成；所有原语使用置信门控执行接口，并按关系形态定制物理策略。对于最难的 AI_JOIN，SAGE 分析谓词、分解复合条件，并利用配方卡与小规模无标签探针选择完整执行策略。
Result: 在对公开 AI 操作符的广泛审计及标量、聚合、连接负载上的评估中，SAGE 覆盖常见 AI 功能并持续提升执行质量与效率；在 SemBench 上取得最强整体性能，在一个代表性可分解连接任务上减少超过两个数量级的成对模型调用，实测成本降低 358 倍。
Conclusion: SAGE 表明 SQL 中的 AI 函数可统一为三种关系角色，并通过置信门控与自适应执行在保持功能覆盖的同时显著提升效率。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Swift-Image, a compact unified model for text-to-image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image editing. Our goal is to explore how far a relatively small visual generator can be pushed through systematic training engineering under a constrained computational budget. Swift-Image adopts an efficient 6B single-stream DiT and a progressive training pipeline that evolves from broad semantic coverage to higher resolution, stronger visual quality, and unified generation-editing supervision. For post-training, we employ parallel expert reinforcement learning followed by multi-teacher on-policy distillation to alleviate interference among heterogeneous objectives. We further decouple high-level reasoning from pixel-level rendering with a Prompt Enhancer that translates user requests into generator-aligned visual specifications. For efficient deployment, structural pruning and few-step distillation produce 3B and accelerated variants. Swift-Image achieves leading aggregate performance among evaluated open-source models with only 6B parameters and 243K GPU training hours; the compressed 3B model incurs nearly no loss, while few-step distillation further improves aggregate editing performance with substantially fewer sampling steps. Our study also summarizes practical lessons for architecture, data curriculum, post-training, prompt enhancement, and model compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Swift-Image，一个 6B 参数的紧凑统一图像生成模型，支持文生图、单图编辑和多图编辑。它采用单流 DiT 架构和渐进式训练流程，从广泛语义覆盖逐步演进到高分辨率、强视觉质量以及统一的生成-编辑监督；后训练阶段使用并行专家强化学习与多教师在线策略蒸馏。摘要报告该模型在 243K GPU 训练小时下达到评估开源模型中的领先聚合性能，3B 压缩变体几乎无性能损失，少步蒸馏进一步改善编辑性能并大幅减少采样步数。
Motivation: 在受限计算预算下，探索相对小的视觉生成器能通过系统化训练工程达到何种性能边界；同时需要缓解后训练中异构目标之间的相互干扰。
Method: 采用高效的 6B 单流 DiT，并设计从语义覆盖到高分辨率及统一生成-编辑监督的渐进式训练流程；后训练采用并行专家强化学习配合多教师在线策略蒸馏；引入 Prompt Enhancer 将用户请求翻译为生成器对齐的视觉规格，以解耦高层推理与像素级渲染；部署阶段通过结构剪枝和少步蒸馏得到 3B 与加速变体。
Result: Swift-Image 以 6B 参数和 243K GPU 训练小时在开源模型中取得领先的聚合性能；压缩后的 3B 模型几乎不损失性能，少步蒸馏以明显更少的采样步数进一步提升聚合编辑性能。
Conclusion: 摘要总结了架构、数据课程、后训练、提示增强和模型压缩方面的实用经验，表明紧凑统一生成模型在受控计算预算下仍可逼近性能前沿。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Learning When to Think: Adaptive Reasoning for Test-Time Compute Allocation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning language models trained with reinforcement learning typically operate under a fixed token budget rather than an explicitly adaptive one, which can lead to over-computation on easy problems and insufficient computation on difficult ones. We study whether a model can learn to allocate its own reasoning effort by choosing, as the first token of its response, one of three modes: \textsc{NoThink} (answer as quickly as possible), \textsc{Short} (brief reasoning), or \textsc{Long} (extended reasoning). The choice is learned inside Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with no separate router, through a shaped reward that makes each mode worthwhile at a different response length, together with hard per-mode token caps that keep the modes distinct. On a 1.5B distilled model trained on MATH, the three modes emerge without collapsing to a single choice, and the brief modes end up more accurate than \textsc{Long}, which shows that the router sorts problems by difficulty rather than at random. Averaged over three seeds, the resulting policy stays close to the base model's accuracy on the held-out MATH500 ($0.782$ vs.\ $0.796$) while cutting the mean response length from $4{,}796$ to $2{,}811$ tokens (a $41\%$ reduction). Interestingly, it also transfers to other benchmarks without retraining, with the largest savings where problems are easier, with for instance 76\% token reduction on GSM8K and at higher accuracy than the baselines at similar response length. In short, we build a reasoning model that adaptively chooses how much to reason for each problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究推理语言模型能否自适应分配测试期计算量，而不是使用固定 token 预算。模型在回复的第一个 token 上从 NoThink、Short、Long 三种模式中选择，该选择在 GRPO 内部通过整形奖励（shaped reward）和逐模式 token 上限学习，无需独立路由器。在 1.5B 蒸馏模型、MATH 训练上三种模式均出现且未坍缩，且短模式比 Long 更准确，说明路由器按难度而非随机划分问题。在 MATH500 上精度从 0.796 略降至 0.782，但平均回复长度从 4796 降到 2811 token（减少 41%），并在其他基准上零训练迁移，GSM8K 上 token 减少 76%。
Motivation: 现有经过强化学习训练的推理语言模型通常使用固定 token 预算，导致简单问题上过度计算、困难问题上计算不足；作者研究模型能否学习自主分配推理努力。
Method: 让模型在回复的第一个 token 选择 NoThink、Short 或 Long 三种推理模式；该选择通过 GRPO 学习，不使用独立路由器，而是依靠整形奖励使每种模式在不同回复长度下都有价值，并配合硬性逐模式 token 上限以保持模式区分。
Result: 在 1.5B 蒸馏模型、MATH 训练上三种模式均出现且未坍缩，短模式比 Long 更准确；MATH500 上精度 0.782 vs 基线 0.796，平均回复长度从 4796 降至 2811 token（41% 减少）；零训练迁移到其他基准，例如 GSM8K 上 token 减少 76%，且在相近回复长度下精度高于基线。
Conclusion: 作者构建了一个能针对每个问题自适应选择推理量的推理模型，表明无需显式路由器即可在保持精度的同时大幅降低计算开销。

papers.title: DECOWAM: Decoupled Whole-Body World-Action Model for Legged Mobile Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to predict how locomotion and arm motion jointly alter future observations and control. Existing world-action models, developed largely for fixed-base platforms, do not explicitly distinguish camera ego-motion from base and arm actions. Here we introduce DECOWAM, a whole-body world-action model that separates these factors through dedicated conditional interfaces. DECOWAM freezes an adapted FastWAM backbone and trains residual adapters, an action-equivalent future bottleneck distilled from privileged observations, adversarially separated base and arm latents, and base-velocity conditioning for video prediction. We further introduce ARMDOG, a real-robot dataset that synchronizes video, whole-body state and action, and language. On a fixed replay protocol, DECOWAM improved both future-video and action prediction over FastWAM, reducing action MSE by 21.7% with 25.95M trainable adaptation parameters. Across 79 closed-loop trials per method, it achieved the highest observed whole-body coordination and base-displacement robustness among the compared systems, while task completion remained comparable to the strongest baseline. These results show that embodiment-aware factorization can support parameter-efficient joint visual prediction and whole-body control under moving viewpoints.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Introduces DECOWAM, a decoupled whole-body world-action model for legged mobile manipulation, and the ARMDOG real-robot dataset
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DECOWAM，一种解耦的全身世界-动作模型 (decoupled whole-body world-action model)，面向腿式移动操作任务。它将相机自身运动与基座和手臂动作分离，通过冻结适配后的 FastWAM 骨干并结合残差适配器、动作等价未来瓶颈、对抗分离的基座/手臂潜在变量以及基座速度条件化，实现移动视角下的视频与动作预测。作者还引入 ARMDOG 真实机器人数据集，同步视频、全身状态、动作和语言。在固定重放协议下，DECOWAM 相比 FastWAM 将动作 MSE 降低 21.7%，仅增加 25.95M 可训练适配参数。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型主要面向固定基座平台，没有显式区分相机自身运动与基座、手臂动作，难以应对腿式移动操作中移动视角带来的全身协调预测与控制问题。
Method: DECOWAM 通过专用条件接口分离相机自身运动与基座/手臂动作：冻结适配后的 FastWAM 骨干并训练残差适配器，从特权观测中蒸馏出动作等价未来瓶颈，用对抗方式分离基座与手臂潜在变量，并以基座速度作为视频预测的条件输入。同时构建 ARMDOG 真实机器人数据集，同步采集视频、全身状态、动作和语言标注。
Result: 在固定重放协议上，DECOWAM 同时改善未来视频和动作预测，将动作 MSE 降低 21.7%（训练参数 25.95M）；在每种方法 79 次闭环试验中，它取得所比较系统中最高的全身协调和基座位移鲁棒性，任务完成率与最强基线相当。
Conclusion: 结果表明，体现感知的因子分解 (embodiment-aware factorization) 能够在移动视角下以参数高效的方式支持联合视觉预测与全身控制，为腿式移动操作的世界-动作建模提供了可行方向。

papers.title: Green BOA: Determining the environmental break-even point for ML-based data compression
papers.abstract_en: We summarise the outcome of two summer internship projects based at the University of Manchester, focused on the break-even point in terms of environmental sustainability for ML-based data compression algorithms. Using the example of a ML-based lossless compression algorithm, we compare estimates for the carbon-equivalent of the infrastructure needed for ML training and inference with the carbon-equivalent savings from reduced disk storage requirements, and discuss their break-even point.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 1 figure. Accepted as a lightning-talk contribution at the 2nd International Workshop on Low Carbon Computing (LOCO 2026), Lancaster University, United Kingdom, 10-11 September 2026. Part of the LOCO 2026 proceedings, arXiv:LOCO2026/L05
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文总结曼彻斯特大学两个暑期实习项目的结果，聚焦基于机器学习的数据压缩算法在环境可持续性方面的收支平衡点。以基于 ML 的无损压缩算法为例，作者比较 ML 训练与推理所需基础设施的碳当量估计，以及减少磁盘存储需求所节省的碳当量，并讨论二者的 break-even point。
Motivation: 评估 ML 数据压缩算法的环境可持续性需要弄清其碳排放收支平衡点，即训练和推理基础设施带来的碳成本何时能被存储空间节省所抵消。
Method: 以基于 ML 的无损压缩算法为案例，分别估算训练与推理基础设施的碳当量，以及因降低磁盘存储需求而节省的碳当量，并对二者进行比较以讨论平衡点。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，而是呈现对两类碳当量估计的比较，并围绕其收支平衡点展开讨论。
Conclusion: 作者强调在判断 ML 数据压缩是否环境友好时，需要同时考虑计算基础设施的碳成本与存储节省带来的碳收益，并明确二者达到平衡的条件。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Separating Covariate Shift from Mechanism Change with Two Discriminators: CJSD, a Conditional Discrepancy with an Exact Covariate-Concept Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: After the inputs X are known, how much additional information does the label Y carry about which dataset a sample came from? That single quantity -- estimable as the difference of two discriminators' held-out cross-entropies, D_CJS = CE(Z|X) - CE(Z|X,Y) -- is exactly the part of a dataset difference that covariate shift cannot explain. We propose the Conditional Jensen-Shannon Discrepancy (CJSD): with a task indicator Z, the chain rule I(Z;X,Y) = I(Z;X) + I(Z;Y|X) splits total task discrepancy exactly into a covariate axis and a functional axis, both estimable from two ordinary classifiers, with no task-specific predictors, generative models, or bootstrap surrogates. We prove a covariate-null property (the functional axis is exactly zero under pure covariate shift, however severe), a drift-mass law (D_CJS/ln2 equals the mass of the disagreement region for deterministic labels), a one-sided misspecification-control inequality (each direction of estimation error is bounded, unconditionally, by the excess risk of a single discriminator), and a fixed-measure metrization via an identifiability lemma. Empirically, on a ten-measure battery over 202 dataset pairs (synthetic, Electricity, Covertype), only the two conditional-information estimators -- CJSD and a kNN plug-in for the same estimand -- separate concept from covariate shift with AUC 1.0; the case for CJSD is the estimator: under controlled dimensionality scaling the kNN plug-in fails from d=64 while the discriminator route holds to d=256 with a swappable classifier, and it alone yields paired confidence intervals and sequential extensions from the same learned object. The same estimator audits the conditional fidelity of synthetic-data generators that marginal and joint QA metrics pass, detects annotation-guideline changes invisible to input-space monitors, and supports null-calibrated fairness audits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件Jensen-Shannon散度（Conditional Jensen-Shannon Discrepancy, CJSD），将数据集的总体差异通过链式法则精确分解为协变量轴（covariate axis）与函数轴（functional axis），并用两个普通判别器的留出交叉熵之差进行估计。理论部分证明了协变量零性质、漂移质量定律、单边误设定控制不等式与固定测度度量；实验在202个数据集对上仅条件信息类估计器能以AUC 1.0区分概念漂移与协变量漂移。
Motivation: 区分协变量漂移（covariate shift）与机制变化/概念漂移是数据集偏移研究的核心问题，而现有方法往往依赖任务特定的预测器、生成模型或自举代理，估计过程复杂且缺乏精确的分解保证。
Method: 定义CJSD为CE(Z|X) - CE(Z|X,Y)，其中Z是任务指示变量；利用互信息链式法则I(Z;X,Y)=I(Z;X)+I(Z;Y|X)将总差异分解为协变量轴与函数轴，二者都可由两个普通分类器估计。作者证明协变量零性质（纯协变量漂移下函数轴精确为零）、漂移质量定律、单边误设定控制不等式，以及基于可辨识性引理的固定测度度量。
Result: 在涵盖合成数据、Electricity、Covertype的202个数据集对、十项指标评估中，只有CJSD和同一估计目标的kNN插件估计器以AUC 1.0分离概念漂移与协变量漂移；在维度缩放下kNN从d=64开始失效，而判别器路线在d=256仍可工作且分类器可替换。该方法还用于审计生成式合成数据器的条件保真度（边际和联合QA指标无法发现的问题）、检测输入空间监控不可见的标注指南变化，并支持零校准公平性审计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CJSD无需任务特定预测器、生成模型或自举代理即可精确分解数据集差异，且其判别器形式的估计器在可替换分类器、配对置信区间和序贯扩展等方面具有实际优势。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: CoToGrasp: Contact-Topology-Conditioned Dexterous Grasp Synthesis via Canonical Workspace Learning
papers.abstract_en: Current dexterous grasp planners primarily optimize for physical stability, focusing on whether an object can be grasped rather than how it should be grasped to support downstream functional tasks. However, conditioning grasp synthesis on specific human grasp taxonomies typically requires prohibitively expensive, object-annotated datasets. To address these limitations, we propose CoToGrasp, a novel generative framework that synthesizes diverse, stable grasps strictly conditioned on specific contact topologies. To bypass the data collection bottleneck, CoToGrasp is trained entirely in an object-agnostic manner. We introduce a feature-based canonical workspace that projects local object features into a unified gripper-centric domain, effectively decoupling the semantic functional intent from the arbitrary object geometry. By learning the intrinsic contact manifold of the gripper within this workspace, our model achieves zero-shot generalization to unseen objects at inference. Extensive evaluations on the large-scale DexGraspNet dataset demonstrate that CoToGrasp achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing taxonomy-guided planners. Finally, we demonstrate the physical viability and kinematic feasibility of our synthesized contact topologies on a physical robot platform. Code is available on our project website at https://cea-list.github.io/cotograspweb/ .
papers.journal_ref: 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoToGrasp，一个以接触拓扑（contact topology）为条件、生成多样且稳定灵巧抓取（dexterous grasp）的生成式框架。其核心创新是完全在物体无关（object-agnostic）方式下训练，通过规范工作空间（canonical workspace）将局部物体特征投影到统一的夹爪中心域，从而在推断时对未见物体实现零样本泛化。论文在 DexGraspNet 数据集上报告了优于现有 taxonomy-guided 规划器的结果，并在物理机器人平台上验证了合成接触拓扑的可行性。
Motivation: 现有灵巧抓取规划器主要针对物理稳定性进行优化，关注物体能否被抓住，而不是如何抓取以支持下游功能任务。按人类抓取分类法进行条件化生成通常需要昂贵且逐物体标注的数据集，存在严重的数据瓶颈。
Method: CoToGrasp 使用基于特征的规范工作空间，将局部物体特征解耦到统一的夹爪中心坐标域，从而将语义功能意图与任意物体几何分离。模型在该工作空间中学习夹爪的内在接触流形（contact manifold），完全以物体无关方式训练，并在推理时直接泛化到新物体。
Result: 在大型基准 DexGraspNet 上的评估表明，CoToGrasp 取得最先进性能，优于现有的 taxonomy-guided 抓取规划器。此外，论文在实体机器人平台上证明了所合成接触拓扑的物理可行性与运动学可行性。
Conclusion: 作者强调，物体无关训练配合规范工作空间可以绕过逐物体标注瓶颈，实现对新物体接触拓扑条件的零样本泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Block3D: Efficient Text-to-3D Generation via Block-Wise Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: While text-to-3D generation has advanced rapidly, achieving high geometric fidelity at low inference cost remains challenging. Existing text-to-3D methods either decode discrete shape tokens autoregressively or iteratively refine global 3D representations with diffusion or flow models. However, autoregressive decoding is sequential and cannot revise errors, whereas diffusion and flow-matching models repeatedly process the full representation, making high-quality generation increasingly expensive. In this paper, we propose Block3D, a block-wise diffusion framework that partitions the discrete shape-token sequence into contiguous blocks, generates the blocks autoregressively, and jointly denoises all tokens within the current block. To alleviate error accumulation, we introduce confidence-guided intra-block correction, which revises low-confidence tokens before each block is finalized. On a held-out set from TRELLIS-500K, Block3D reduces mean end-to-end generation time from 25.71 seconds to 4.99 seconds, achieving a $5.15\times$ speedup over the fine-tuned autoregressive baseline without sacrificing geometric fidelity.
papers.comment: Code is not ready for publication
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Block3D，一种用于文本到 3D 生成的块级扩散 (block-wise diffusion) 框架。它将离散形状 token 序列划分为连续块，按块自回归生成，并对当前块内所有 token 进行联合去噪；同时引入置信度引导的块内修正 (confidence-guided intra-block correction) 来减轻误差累积。在 TRELLIS-500K 的留出集上，端到端平均生成时间从 25.71 秒降至 4.99 秒，相对微调后的自回归基线取得 5.15 倍加速，且未牺牲几何保真度。
Motivation: 现有文本到 3D 方法要么使用自回归解码离散形状 token，但解码是串行的且无法修正错误；要么用扩散或流模型迭代地精化全局 3D 表示，但会反复处理完整表示，导致高质量生成成本越来越高。
Method: 提出块级扩散框架，将离散形状 token 序列划分成连续块，以自回归方式逐块生成，并对当前块内的所有 token 联合去噪；在每块定稿前引入基于置信度的块内修正，用于修订低置信度 token 以缓解误差累积。
Result: 在 TRELLIS-500K 的留出集上，端到端平均生成时间从 25.71 秒降低到 4.99 秒，较微调的自回归基线获得 5.15 倍加速，同时几何保真度没有损失。
Conclusion: 摘要表明块级生成配合置信度引导修正在不牺牲几何保真度的前提下可显著降低推理成本；arXiv 注释提到代码暂未公开。

papers.title: Agentic ESOpt: Fine-Tuning Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Minimal GPU Requirements
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been promising in single-turn LLM fine-tuning. However, long-horizon agentic reasoning introduces increasingly branching interactions and sparse rewards, exposing several limitations of RL: its heavyweight backpropagation-based training stack makes it impractical to fine-tune larger LLMs, and longer-horizon trajectories make credit assignment in RL substantially harder. This paper argues that evolution strategies (ES) can be a better choice for fine-tuning long-horizon LLM agents. Compared with agentic RL, ES offers three key advantages: 1) Model Scalability: ES enables full-parameter optimization with only minimal, inference-level GPU memory, making it possible to fine-tune large LLMs. 2) Flexibility: its lightweight, black-box feedback interface makes ES fine-tuning easy to compose with prompt-space evolution (e.g., skill optimization & test-time compute); and 3) Long-Horizon Scalability: ES performs trajectory-level parameter attribution without decomposing rewards across horizons, yielding better scalability than Agentic RL as the horizon length grows. Based on this insight, we propose Agentic ESOpt, a full-parameter agentic fine-tuning framework tailored to flexible parameter--context co-evolution. At each step, Agentic ESOpt samples perturbations around the current LLM parameters, evaluates the resulting agents with rewards, and applies an online reward-weighted update. To improve the exploration--adaptation trade-off, Agentic ESOpt further introduces a cosine decay schedule of the perturbation scale $σ$. On WebArena-Lite, full-parameter optimization of Qwen-3.5-27B improves the No Skill baseline by 6.69%. In test-time automatic heuristic design, Agentic ESOpt performs online prompt--parameter co-evolution, improving its matched baseline in 28 of 36 settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Agentic ESOpt，一种基于进化策略 (evolution strategies, ES) 的全参数智能体微调框架，用于长视野 (long-horizon) LLM 智能体，仅需推理级 GPU 内存。该方法在每一步围绕当前参数采样扰动、评估奖励并做在线奖励加权更新，并引入扰动尺度 σ 的余弦衰减调度。在 WebArena-Lite 上，对 Qwen-3.5-27B 的全参数优化比 No Skill 基线提升 6.69%；在测试时自动启发式设计中，其在 36 个设置中的 28 个优于匹配基线。
Motivation: RL 在单轮 LLM 微调中表现良好，但长视野智能体推理存在分支交互和稀疏奖励，RL 的基于反向传播的训练栈开销大、难以微调更大模型，且长轨迹使信用分配更难。论文认为进化策略在这些场景下是更优的选择。
Method: 提出 Agentic ESOpt 框架，支持参数与上下文 (prompt-space) 的共同进化。每一步在 LLM 参数附近采样扰动，用奖励评估扰动后的智能体，并执行在线奖励加权参数更新；同时引入余弦衰减的扰动尺度 σ 以平衡探索与适应。
Result: 在 WebArena-Lite 上，全参数优化 Qwen-3.5-27B 比 No Skill 基线提升 6.69%。在测试时自动启发式设计中，在线提示-参数共同进化在 36 个设置中的 28 个优于匹配基线。
Conclusion: 论文强调 ES 相比智能体 RL 的三大优势：模型可扩展性、灵活性和长视野可扩展性；Agentic ESOpt 作为全参数微调框架在这些场景下有效，并支持灵活的参数-上下文共同进化。

papers.title: Mint-Agent: Introducing Finance-Native Agentic Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Financial agents must do more than recall domain knowledge: they must be both reliable, executing precise operations over grounded evidence, and executive, sustaining long-horizon research whose conclusions remain auditable. We present Mint-Agent, a family of finance-native agentic models designed around these two scales of financial intelligence. Mint-Agent is built upon three pillars: data, harness, and algorithm. Our data engine constructs clean, specialized tasks for atomic financial capabilities and long-horizon agentic execution from real-world financial sources. MintHarness enables stable interaction with open-ended environments and maintains auditable evidence trails across extended research trajectories. Our training recipe combines SFT, critical-step OPD, and RLVR to develop separate financial reasoning and agentic execution experts, which are then unified through model merging and multi-teacher on-policy distillation into compact, general-purpose financial agents. This pipeline yields two flagship models, Mint-Cu (9B) and Mint-Ag (27B). Across professional financial benchmarks, our models demonstrate two defining strengths: (1) Reliability: Mint-Ag achieves 98.33% on RFC-Bench, surpassing GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-4.8 by 3.66 and 3.00 points; and (2) Executability: Mint-Cu reaches 69.86% on FinSearchComp T2, outperforming Agents-A1-35B and Nex-N2-mini by 22.83 and 12.78 points, while Mint-Ag achieves 76.00% and 60.49% on FinanceAgentBench v1.1 and v2, respectively. These results establish a path toward trustworthy financial intelligence in which domain expertise, long-horizon execution, and auditable evidence are jointly engineered as a unified foundation for frontier agentic models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mint-Agent，一个面向金融的原生智能体模型家族，旨在同时具备可靠性与可执行性：既能在有依据的证据上执行精确操作，又能维持长周期可审计的研究过程。模型基于数据引擎、MintHarness 环境交互框架和训练配方（SFT、关键步骤 OPD、RLVR）三根支柱构建，并通过模型合并与多教师在线策略蒸馏整合为紧凑的通用金融智能体，产出 Mint-Cu (9B) 和 Mint-Ag (27B) 两个旗舰模型。摘要报告其在 RFC-Bench、FinSearchComp T2、FinanceAgentBench 等基准上超过对比模型。
Motivation: 金融智能体不能只记忆领域知识，还需要既可靠（对基于证据的信息执行精确操作）又具备执行力（维持长周期研究并保持结论可审计）。现有模型在这两个尺度上有所欠缺，需要专门设计。
Method: 构建三个支柱：数据引擎从真实金融来源构造原子金融能力和长周期智能体执行任务；MintHarness 支持与开放环境稳定交互并维护可审计的证据轨迹；训练配方结合 SFT、关键步骤 OPD 和 RLVR，训练分离的金融推理与智能体执行专家，再通过模型合并和多教师在线策略蒸馏统一为紧凑通用金融智能体。
Result: Mint-Ag 在 RFC-Bench 上达到 98.33%，超过 GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Claude-Opus-4.8 分别 3.66 和 3.00 点；Mint-Cu 在 FinSearchComp T2 上达到 69.86%，超过 Agents-A1-35B 和 Nex-N2-mini 分别 22.83 和 12.78 点；Mint-Ag 在 FinanceAgentBench v1.1 和 v2 上分别达到 76.00% 和 60.49%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果展示了将领域专长、长周期执行和可审计证据联合工程化为统一基础，是迈向可信金融智能的一条路径。

papers.title: Information Geometry of Message Passing
papers.abstract_en: We show that the natural-gradient stationary condition of variational inference has an edge-local form on a Forney-style factor graph. We start from the Bethe free energy and constrain a selected edge marginal to an exponential family. At a stationary point, the natural parameter of that edge equals the sum of two projected messages, one from each incident factor. Each projected message is the natural-gradient projection of the exact belief-propagation log-message at the current receiving marginal, or equivalently, the gradient of its expectation in the so-called mean coordinates. We call the resulting scheme natural-gradient message passing (NGMP). The rule is local; each edge may carry its own exponential family, and the message a factor sends depends on the marginal that receives it. Compared with variational message passing, NGMP keeps the part of the exact message that the receiving family can represent instead of averaging the factor under the neighboring beliefs. The two coincide when the uncertainty on the edges entering a non-conjugate factor vanishes, and NGMP is more accurate when that uncertainty persists, for example, along a partially observed latent chain or when parameters are filtered through successive data batches. Experiments on Poisson smoothing, heteroskedastic regression, and hourly ETTh forecasting confirm this and show that the gain appears mainly in uncertainty calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从 Bethe 自由能出发，在 Forney 风格因子图上推导变分推断的自然梯度平稳条件，得到边局域形式：在平稳点，某条边的自然参数等于其两个关联因子各自投影消息之和。作者将该规则称为自然梯度消息传递 (NGMP)，并在 Poisson 平滑、异方差回归和小时级 ETTh 预测等任务上验证其不确定性校准优势。
Motivation: 变分消息传递 (variational message passing) 在非共轭因子下用相邻信念对因子做平均，会丢失接收族无法表示的那部分精确消息；论文旨在构造一种保留可表示部分的局域消息传递规则。
Method: 从 Bethe 自由能出发，将选定边边缘约束到指数族，证明平稳点处该边自然参数等于两个投影消息之和；每个投影消息是精确 belief-propagation 对数消息在当前接收边缘上的自然梯度投影，等价于其均值坐标期望的梯度。NGMP 允许每条边携带自己的指数族，且因子发出的消息取决于接收它的边缘。
Result: 在 Poisson 平滑、异方差回归、小时级 ETTh 预测上的实验表明，当部分观测隐链或连续数据批次滤波导致进入非共轭因子的不确定性持续存在时，NGMP 比 VMP 更准确；收益主要体现在不确定性校准上。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 NGMP 的局域性以及它对精确消息中可表示部分的保留；其优势与不确定性是否持续相关，实验主要关注校准质量而非点预测精度。

papers.title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConceptFormer，一个面向视觉文档检索的潜在概念表示学习框架。它将查询相关的证据建模为连续的、由查询条件化的潜在概念 (latent concepts)，用于连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，无需文本中间表示或直接依赖原始视觉标注。在多个视觉文档检索基准上，其平均 NDCG@10 相对最强视觉检索基线和最强 OCR 文本检索基线分别提升 16.7% 和 22.1%。
Motivation: 现有细粒度监督主要依赖文本描述或局部视觉区域作为证据代理，但这些信号可能遗漏复杂的视觉结构，或提供不完整、不准确的表征，从而限制查询-文档对齐的效果。
Method: ConceptFormer 在训练时使用强视觉语言模型动态确定潜在概念 token 的数量，并将这些概念作为中间表示来弥合查询与文档之间的语义差距，进而引导嵌入空间的学习。
Result: 在多种视觉文档检索基准上，ConceptFormer 的平均 NDCG@10 相对最强视觉检索基线和最强 OCR 文本检索基线分别取得 16.7% 和 22.1% 的相对提升。
Conclusion: 分析表明潜在概念能有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，使检索器同时捕捉细粒度文本线索和复杂文档级视觉结构，同时保持较强的检索对齐；代码与数据已公开。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 ConceptFormer，一个面向视觉文档检索的潜在概念表示学习框架。它将查询相关的证据建模为连续的、由查询条件化的潜在概念 (latent concepts)，用于连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性，无需文本中间表示或直接依赖原始视觉标注。在多个视觉文档检索基准上，其平均 NDCG@10 相对最强视觉检索基线和最强 OCR 文本检索基线分别提升 16.7% 和 22.1%。

papers.title: LongRCA Bench: Diagnosing Responsible Roles and Root Causes in Long-Horizon Agent Failures
papers.abstract_en: When a long-horizon agent execution fails, outcome-level evaluation reveals the unsuccessful result but not where the decisive error entered the trajectory. Developers must then inspect the full execution to identify the responsible role and localize the earliest decisive root-cause step. Existing failure-attribution benchmarks largely focus on shorter traces, leaving diagnosis across hundreds of recorded steps underexplored. We introduce LongRCA Bench, comprising 1,140 failed trajectories across five domains without injected errors. It provides independently scored human labels for the responsible role and earliest decisive root-cause step. The median trajectory contains 145 steps, and the strongest baseline reaches only 13.2% exact root-step accuracy. We further present Root-Cause Trajectory Attribution (RCTA), a training-free method that retrieves candidate error steps from segment summaries and traces them to available earlier handoff instructions. Using the same backbone, benchmark instances, and scoring protocol, RCTA reaches 51.1% responsible-role accuracy and 24.1% exact root-step accuracy. These results highlight the need to evaluate responsible-role attribution and exact root-step localization as separate targets in long-trajectory failure diagnosis.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Yunfei Zhang and Boyu Feng contributed equally. Changhua Pei is the corresponding author
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LongRCA Bench，一个包含 1,140 条失败轨迹、覆盖五个领域且无注入错误的长时程智能体故障归因基准，并分别提供人工标注的责任角色 (responsible role) 与最早决定性根因步骤 (earliest decisive root-step)。轨迹中位数为 145 步，最强基线在精确根因步骤上的准确率仅为 13.2%。作者还提出无需训练的方法 RCTA，通过从分段摘要检索候选错误步骤并回溯早期交接指令，在相同后端和评测协议下达到 51.1% 的责任角色准确率与 24.1% 的精确根因步骤准确率。

Result: 在 LongRCA Bench 上，最强基线仅达到 13.2% 的精确根因步骤准确率；RCTA 在同一评测协议下达到 51.1% 的责任角色准确率和 24.1% 的精确根因步骤准确率。
Conclusion: 这些结果表明，在长轨迹故障诊断中，应将责任角色归因与精确根因步骤定位作为两个独立的评测目标来评估。

papers.title: Instruction-Based Video Editing by Repurposing an Image Editing Model
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based video editing is commonly built on video-pretrained generative backbones: a video diffusion transformer is adapted, at considerable cost, to condition on a source video and an editing instruction. In this report we explore a different route and show that a strong instruction-based image editing model can edit videos by operating directly on video-VAE latents. Starting from Qwen-Image-Edit, we arrange the latent frames of a Wan~2.1 video VAE as tiles of one large virtual image, reuse the editor's image positional encoding for every tile, and bridge the two latent spaces with a pair of lightweight input/output projections warm-started from the editor's own patchify and unpatchify layers, so that at initialization a (static) video is embedded exactly as an image the model already understands. The whole system is then fine-tuned on the public Ditto-1M editing triplets, and a few denoising steps of Wan~2.2 serve as an optional temporal enhancer. We motivate the design with a chain of zero-training observations: the stock image editor already edits a video presented as a contact sheet; it is indifferent to whether the sheet's tokens come from one joint encode or from per-frame encodes stitched in latent space; and it even edits genuine video latents zero-shot to a clearly recognizable degree, leaving fine-tuning only a fidelity gap to close. Our results suggest that, despite the large investment in training video latent spaces, per-frame video latents remain close enough to the image domain that mature image editing priors transfer with minimal adaptation. Project Page: https://yunpeng1998.github.io/Qwen-Video-Edit-Page Code: https://github.com/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit Model: https://huggingface.co/yunpeng1998/Qwen-Video-Edit
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究把指令式图像编辑模型直接用于视频编辑，以避免基于视频预训练生成骨干的高昂适配成本。作者以 Qwen-Image-Edit 为基础，将 Wan 2.1 视频 VAE 的潜在帧排列成一张大型虚拟图像的瓦片，复用图像位置编码，并用从编辑器 patchify/unpatchify 层热启的轻量投影桥接两个潜在空间，随后在 Ditto-1M 编辑三元组上微调。摘要通过一系列零训练观察说明逐帧视频潜在表示与图像域足够接近，成熟图像编辑先验可以最小适配地迁移到视频编辑。
Motivation: 常见指令式视频编辑依赖视频预训练生成骨干，需要以可观成本适配视频扩散 Transformer 来条件化源视频和编辑指令。作者想探索另一条路线，验证强指令图像编辑模型能否直接操作视频 VAE 潜在表示，从而显著降低视频编辑的开发成本。
Method: 将 Wan 2.1 视频 VAE 的潜在帧排列成一张大虚拟图像的瓦片，对每个瓦片复用编辑器的图像位置编码，并用从编辑器自身 patchify 和 unpatchify 层热启的轻量输入/输出投影桥接两个潜在空间，使初始化时静态视频被嵌入为模型已理解的图像。整个系统在公开的 Ditto-1M 编辑三元组上微调，并以 Wan 2.2 的少量去噪步作为可选的时序增强器。
Result: 摘要报告一系列零训练观察：现成图像编辑器已能编辑以 contact sheet 形式呈现的视频；它对来自联合编码或逐帧编码拼接的 token 不敏感；甚至能零样本编辑真实视频潜在表示到可识别程度，微调只用于弥合保真度差距。摘要未给出定量指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果表明，尽管视频潜在空间训练投入巨大，逐帧视频潜在表示仍与图像域足够接近，使成熟图像编辑先验能以最小适配迁移，为低成本视频编辑提供了替代路线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Non-Shattering at and Above the Dynamical Temperature in the Spherical Pure p-Spin Model
papers.abstract_en: We consider the notion of shattering introduced by Ben Arous and Jagannath for spherical pure $p$-spin glasses with overlap $q$. For every $p\geq 3$ and $0<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$, we rule out shattering whenever $q\leq2^{-1/2}$ or $q>\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$. The proof combines a deterministic $N+1$ bound for disjoint bands in the first range with a general-$p$ sign law showing that their total marked weight has subdominant free energy in the second. A spherical-code bound and Hölder's inequality give an additional $q$-dependent obstruction; in particular, they rule out every fixed overlap for $0<β\leq\sqrt{\log2}$. For $p=3$, the first two ranges already exhaust every fixed $q\in(0,1)$, so the landscape is not shattered at any $T\geq T_{\mathrm{sh}}$. For $p\geq4$, the cases not covered by our criteria are confined to $2^{-1/2}<q\leq\sqrt{(p-2)/(p-1)}$ and $\sqrt{\log2}<β\leqβ_{\mathrm{sh}}(p)$. In particular, this paper partially resolves Conjecture 1 of the paper above and also suggests new methods to show non-shattering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究球面纯 p-自旋玻璃模型中 Ben Arous 与 Jagannath 引入的破碎 (shattering) 概念。作者证明对任意 p≥3 且 0<β≤β_sh(p)，当重叠 q≤2^{-1/2} 或 q>√((p-2)/(p-1)) 时不存在破碎现象；对 p=3，这些条件已覆盖所有固定 q∈(0,1)。该结果部分解决了所引论文中的猜想 1，并提出了证明非破碎的新方法。
Motivation: 自旋玻璃相变中破碎现象是否发生、发生在哪些重叠和温度范围仍是开放问题；该工作旨在系统排除若干温度-重叠区域内的破碎，并推进相关猜想。
Method: 将证明分为两段：对 q≤2^{-1/2} 的区间使用不相交波带的确定性 N+1 界；对 q>√((p-2)/(p-1)) 的区间使用一般 p 的符号律，说明其总标记自由能 (marked free energy) 是次主导的。此外，利用球面码界与 Hölder 不等式得到额外的 q 依赖约束，从而排除 0<β≤√log2 时任意固定重叠的破碎。
Result: 摘要报告：对 p=3，所有固定 q∈(0,1) 在 T≥T_sh 时均不破碎；对 p≥4，未被准则覆盖的情况仅限于 2^{-1/2}<q≤√((p-2)/(p-1)) 且 √log2<β≤β_sh(p)。
Conclusion: 本文部分解决了 Conjecture 1，并给出证明非破碎的新技术；作者也指出该证明方法可能推广到其他情形。

papers.title: Attributing Preprocessing Invariance in Spectral Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Preprocessing invariance is an appealing goal for spectral foundation models: a frozen model should remain useful when laboratories preprocess spectra differently. It is usually measured by training a classifier under one preprocessing pipeline and testing it under another, with preserved accuracy read as evidence of learning. We revisit that reading, using a Raman foundation model as a case study. Such models normalize their inputs before any learned parameter is applied. If that normalization maps two differently preprocessed spectra to the same vector, the encoder receives identical inputs, so the invariance cannot be attributed to learning. For a normalization that uses each spectrum's own statistics, this happens exactly when one spectrum is a positive multiple of the other plus a constant. Several standard preprocessing operations take that form. The encoder should therefore be measured against the normalization alone, which has no learned parameters. On six Raman evaluation datasets, the model does not measurably outperform its own normalization. It improves on raw spectra, but so does the normalization alone. Training does improve the encoder over random initialization, and a controlled experiment shows that it learns to ignore a transformation only when that transformation reaches it. A numerical test settles which transformations a given normalization removes. Across released systems in five modalities, most normalizations already remove transformations of that form, and several of those systems claim that invariance as learned. Replicating the comparison on two of them shows no gain either.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文重新审视谱系基础模型（spectral foundation models）中预处理不变性的度量方式，以 Raman 基础模型为案例。作者指出这类模型在可学习参数之前先做输入归一化；若归一化把两种不同预处理得到的谱映射到同一向量，编码器输入就完全相同，所谓不变性不能被归因于学习。在六个 Raman 评估数据集上，模型并未可测量地优于其自身的归一化；跨五种模态的多个已发布系统中，多数归一化已经移除了该类变换，部分系统却将这种不变性宣称为学习所得。
Motivation: 现有做法用“一个预处理训练、另一个预处理测试时准确率保持”来证明模型学到了预处理不变性，但这一读法可能错误归因，因为无参数归一化本身就能消除某些预处理差异。研究旨在厘清不变性究竟来自可学习编码器还是来自输入归一化。
Method: 以 Raman 基础模型为案例，形式化分析使用各谱自身统计量的归一化，证明当且仅当一个谱是另一个谱的正倍数加常数时，两种不同预处理的谱会被映射到相同向量；并给出数值测试判定给定归一化移除哪些变换。作者还将模型与无参数归一化基线对比，并做控制实验检验变换是否实际到达编码器。
Result: 在六个 Raman 评估数据集上，模型没有可测量的优于其归一化本身的性能；模型相对原始谱有提升，但归一化单独也能带来同样提升。训练确实使编码器优于随机初始化，控制实验表明编码器只在变换到达它时才学习忽略该变换；复查五种模态的已发布系统，多数归一化已移除该类变换，且对两个系统的复现对比也未发现增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为谱基础模型中报告的预处理不变性可能主要来自无参数的输入归一化而非可学习过程，因此应将编码器与归一化基线对照后再做归因。结论限于谱基础模型以及正倍数加常数这类变换形式。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有做法用“一个预处理训练、另一个预处理测试时准确率保持”来证明模型学到了预处理不变性，但这一读法可能错误归因，因为无参数归一化本身就能消除某些预处理差异。研究旨在厘清不变性究竟来自可学习编码器还是来自输入归一化。
summary_sections.method: 以 Raman 基础模型为案例，形式化分析使用各谱自身统计量的归一化，证明当且仅当一个谱是另一个谱的正倍数加常数时，两种不同预处理的谱会被映射到相同向量；并给出数值测试判定给定归一化移除哪些变换。作者还将模型与无参数归一化基线对比，并做控制实验检验变换是否实际到达编码器。
summary_sections.result: 在六个 Raman 评估数据集上，模型没有可测量的优于其归一化本身的性能；模型相对原始谱有提升，但归一化单独也能带来同样提升。训练确实使编码器优于随机初始化，控制实验表明编码器只在变换到达它时才学习忽略该变换；复查五种模态的已发布系统，多数归一化已移除该类变换，且对两个系统的复现对比也未发现增益。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为谱基础模型中报告的预处理不变性可能主要来自无参数的输入归一化而非可学习过程，因此应将编码器与归一化基线对照后再做归因。结论限于谱基础模型以及正倍数加常数这类变换形式。

papers.title: Towards Truly Unsupervised Evaluation of Feature Selection
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is one of the most important and fundamental tasks in data mining, tackled by a family of methods with an established set of evaluation techniques to measure the quality of a specific method. Most of the methods commonly used for the unsupervised evaluation of feature selection algorithms suffer from critical design flaws which question their unsupervised nature. In this paper, we provide a critical discussion on the established allegedly unsupervised evaluation techniques, and shed light on the reasons why they are not truly unsupervised but, at best, supervised evaluation under an unsupervised downstream task. We also propose a novel, truly unsupervised evaluation framework to measure the quality of the feature selection algorithms without any form of information about the labels. The proposed framework utilizes unsupervised Principal Component Analysis, and optimal transport to measure the quality of the feature selection methods in a truly unsupervised manner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对特征选择（feature selection）中所谓“无监督评估”的常用方法提出批判性讨论，认为这些方法并非真正的无监督，至多是下游任务为无监督的监督评估。作者提出一种新的真正无监督评估框架，利用无监督主成分分析（PCA）和最优传输（optimal transport），在不使用任何标签信息的情况下衡量特征选择算法的质量。
Motivation: 现有用于无监督评估特征选择算法的大多数方法存在关键设计缺陷，其“无监督”属性值得质疑；该问题影响评估结果的可信度，而目前缺乏真正无监督的评估手段。
Method: 提出一种全新的、真正无监督的评估框架，完全不借助任何标签信息；框架利用无监督主成分分析（PCA）与最优传输（optimal transport）来度量特征选择方法的输出质量。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有所谓无监督评估技术本质上仍属于监督评估，并提出一种不依赖标签的替代框架；摘要未报告实验验证或定量结果，其有效性仍需后续研究检验。

papers.title: Cloak of Invisibility: Real-Time Privacy-Preserving Volumetric Video Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Volumetric video streaming turns privacy into a 3D, multi-view problem. Unlike ordinary video, where sensitive content can often be redacted frame by frame, RGB-D volumetric pipelines capture people, rooms, and personal objects from multiple cameras and fuse them into a shared 3D representation. A private object missed in one view, or only partially removed before fusion, can therefore reappear in the reconstructed scene. This creates a privacy challenge for 3D telepresence, education, entertainment, and immersive applications: private content should be removed before raw visual and geometric data leave the camera side, while the public part of the scene should remain useful for real-time reconstruction. Existing volumetric streaming systems mainly optimize reconstruction, data movement, and latency, while privacy-preserving vision methods are designed for single-camera, single-frame images and do not directly address calibrated multi-view RGB-D fusion. We present InViStream, a real-time "privacy-from-source" system designed for this setting. InViStream addresses three challenges in volumetric capture: private objects may appear differently across views, RGB masking alone can leave geometric privacy leakage in depth, and public/private instances of the same class must be separated consistently before cloud-side fusion. To address these challenges, InViStream combines object detection with depth-aware masking, propagates public/private decisions across calibrated views, and fuses only sanitized point clouds. We evaluate InViStream on synthetic and real RGB-D scenes, including offices, conference rooms, living rooms, and settings with multiple public and private people and objects. InViStream achieves synthetic Dice/Recall of 0.799/0.891 and real Dice/Recall of 0.792/0.908, with synthetic SSIM above 0.98 and real-time streaming above 30 FPS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InViStream，一个面向 RGB-D 体积视频流的实时“源头隐私”(privacy-from-source) 系统。其核心思路是在多相机数据离开摄像头端之前移除私有内容，仅将消毒后的点云上传用于云端重建，从而避免私有物体在融合后的 3D 场景中重现。摘要报告在合成与真实 RGB-D 场景（办公室、会议室、客厅、多人多物体场景）上取得合成 Dice/Recall 0.799/0.891、真实 0.792/0.908，SSIM 高于 0.98，并支持超过 30 FPS 的实时流式处理。
Motivation: 体积视频流把隐私问题变成三维多视图问题：与普通逐帧可遮挡的二维视频不同，RGB-D 流水线从多个相机采集并融合共享 3D 表示，单个视图中遗漏或未完全移除的私有物体会在重建场景中重现。现有体积流系统主要优化重建、数据传输和延迟，而隐私保护的视觉方法多为单相机、单帧设计，无法直接处理已标定的多视图 RGB-D 融合。
Method: InViStream 结合目标检测与深度感知掩蔽 (depth-aware masking)，解决私有物体在不同视角外观差异和 RGB 掩蔽无法覆盖深度几何泄漏的问题；它还在已标定视图间传播公共/私有判定，保证云端融合前同一类别的公共与私有实例被一致区分，并且只融合经过消毒的点云。
Result: 合成场景上 Dice/Recall 为 0.799/0.891，真实场景为 0.792/0.908；合成 SSIM 高于 0.98，且系统在超过 30 FPS 下保持实时流式性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明从源头（相机端）进行隐私消毒可以在保持实时重建质量的同时有效防止私有内容泄漏到融合后的 3D 场景中；实验覆盖合成与真实 RGB-D 场景，但摘要未说明方法在更复杂或更大规模部署下的局限。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM Verification: Evidence Structure, Uncertainty, and Selective Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often rely on shortcuts rather than systematic reasoning, raising safety concerns in medical applications. Allowing models to abstain when uncertain improves reliability but introduces a coverage accuracy tradeoff. We propose a two-stage framework for medical hypothesis verification in multiple-choice settings that manages this tradeoff through targeted ontology grounding, applied only when the model abstains. We show that abstention is not random but reflects genuine uncertainty, with abstained predictions associated with lower confidence. Across two frontier models (GPT-5.5, accessed via the Azure OpenAI API, and DeepSeek-R1), the proposed framework improves question-level accuracy by 9.6 percentage points (82.9% to 92.5%) and hypothesis-level accuracy by 4.2 percentage points (92.0% to 96.2%). Our experiments conducted on MedReason and MedQA show that abstention can be repurposed as a control signal for selective reasoning refinement, achieving knowledge-graph-level performance without explicit knowledge graph construction.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors due to premature submission before final review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，用于多选设定下的医学假设验证。该框架仅在模型弃权（abstain）时进行有针对性的本体接地（ontology grounding），以管理覆盖率与准确率之间的权衡。实验表明弃权并非随机，而是反映了真实的不确定性。在GPT-5.5（经Azure OpenAI API访问）和DeepSeek-R1两个前沿模型上，该方法在MedReason和MedQA上分别将问题级准确率从82.9%提升至92.5%、假设级准确率从92.0%提升至96.2%。作者指出弃权可被重新用作选择性推理细化的控制信号，无需显式构建知识图谱即可达到知识图谱级性能。注意：该论文已被作者撤回，原因是最终审稿前过早提交。
Motivation: LLM在医学应用中常依赖捷径而非系统推理，存在安全隐患。允许模型在不确定时弃权可提升可靠性，但会引入覆盖率与准确率之间的权衡，论文旨在管理这一权衡。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：模型先尝试作答，仅在弃权时应用目标本体接地来细化推理，从而在不降低覆盖率的情况下针对性提升可靠性。
Result: 在两个前沿模型上，问题级准确率提升9.6个百分点（82.9%至92.5%），假设级准确率提升4.2个百分点（92.0%至96.2%）；实验在MedReason和MedQA上完成，并发现弃权预测对应更低的置信度。
Conclusion: 弃权可以被重新用作选择性推理细化的控制信号，使系统在不显式构建知识图谱的情况下达到知识图谱级性能。论文本身因过早提交被作者撤回。

papers.title: When Does Forecasting Reveal Temporal Structure? A Stability Analysis of Time-Series Structural Selection
papers.abstract_en: Forecast accuracy is often used as a proxy for temporal structure discovery, but predictive performance and structural identifiability are not equivalent. Different temporal mechanisms can achieve similar forecast errors, while small forecast differences may still contain sufficient information for recovery. In this work, we study when forecast-only structural selection can be trusted. We show that a vanishing forecast margin does not necessarily imply structural ambiguity, and establish a stability perspective that evaluates structural separation relative to uncertainty in the selection objective. This perspective provides both a sufficient condition for reliable selection and a continuous measure of selection difficulty. Experiments across controlled and end-to-end settings demonstrate that forecast margin alone is insufficient, while the proposed stability measure better characterizes when forecast-based structural selection succeeds or fails. Our results suggest that predictive accuracy should be treated as evidence for structure discovery only when its separation is sufficiently robust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅凭预测精度进行时间序列结构选择是否可靠的问题。作者指出预测性能与结构可辨识性并不等价，并提出一种基于稳定性的视角，将结构分离度相对于选择目标的不确定性进行评估。实验表明仅靠预测间隔（forecast margin）不足，而所提稳定性度量能更好刻画结构选择何时成功或失败。
Motivation: 预测精度常被用作发现时间序列结构的代理指标，但预测性能与结构可辨识性并不等价，不同时间机制可能产生相似的预测误差，因此需要研究何时可以信任仅基于预测的结构选择。
Method: 作者建立稳定性视角，评估结构分离相对于选择目标不确定性的程度；该框架同时给出可靠选择的充分条件以及一个连续的选择难度度量。
Result: 在受控和端到端实验中发现，预测间隔本身不足以判断结构选择是否可靠，而提出的稳定性度量能更好地刻画选择成功或失败的条件。
Conclusion: 预测精度只有在其分离度足够稳健时，才应作为结构发现的证据。

papers.title: Defining Decentralization: An Ontological Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Decentralization as a concept in computer science has existed for over half a century. Despite its fundamental role across domains such as security, distributed computing, artificial intelligence, cloud infrastructures, and Internet of Things (IoT) architectures, there remains no universally accepted definition of decentralization applicable across computer communication systems. This has become increasingly problematic with the emergence of decentralized AI and machine learning paradigms, including collaborative training, distributed inference, blockchain-based, and agentic AI, where decentralization is often treated as a core design objective. Meanwhile, existing approaches frequently conflate decentralization with related notions such as distribution of trust or specific implementation paradigms. Such ambiguity creates inconsistencies in system analysis, limits comparability between works, and weakens the rigor of formal reasoning surrounding communication architectures and protocol design. In this work, we define this research gap as the Decentralization Problem. We analyze the formal-semantic, epistemological, and pragmatic foundations of decentralization and introduce a graph-based ontology defining it as both relational and subject-specific property of computer communication systems. The framework formally distinguishes decentralization from distribution and supports evaluation through two novel metrics: Void Tolerance and Imperviousness. We also provide a browser-based implementation that enables automated classification and metric computation of arbitrary systems. Instantiations to federated learning and blockchain architectures show consistent, comparable assessments where existing definitions produce incomplete or contradictory conclusions, providing a domain-independent foundation for analysing decentralization across heterogeneous systems.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 6 figures, preparing for submission, strengthened the formalisms behind ontological claims
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算机通信系统中 decentralization（去中心化）缺乏统一可接受定义的问题，从本体论视角提出一个基于图的本体（graph-based ontology），将去中心化定义为系统的关系性（relational）且主体特定（subject-specific）属性，并形式化区分去中心化与分布（distribution）。作者提出两个新度量 Void Tolerance 和 Imperviousness，并提供基于浏览器的实现用于自动化分类和度量计算；在联邦学习与区块链架构上的实例化得到一致、可比较的评估结果。
Motivation: 去中心化概念在安全、分布式计算、AI、云和 IoT 等领域使用超过半个世纪，但缺乏适用于计算机通信系统的普适定义；现有工作常将其与信任分布或特定实现范式混淆，随着去中心化 AI 与机器学习范式兴起，这种歧义导致系统分析不一致、工作间可比性差，并削弱形式推理的严谨性。作者将这一研究缺口命名为 Decentralization Problem。
Method: 分析去中心化的形式语义（formal-semantic）、认识论（epistemological）和实用主义（pragmatic）基础，引入图基本体，将去中心化建模为关系性和主体特定属性；形式化区分去中心化与分布，提出两个新度量 Void Tolerance 与 Imperviousness，并给出基于浏览器的实现以支持任意系统的自动分类与度量计算。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在联邦学习（federated learning）和区块链（blockchain）架构上的实例化产生一致、可比较的评估，而现有定义在这些实例上会得出不完整或相互矛盾的结论，表明其可作为跨异构系统的领域无关（domain-independent）分析基础。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为跨异构系统分析去中心化提供了领域无关的形式化基础，并说明论文正在准备投稿，且已加强本体主张背后的形式化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE-Memory: Public-Conditioned Retrieval and Utility-Aware Evidence Admission for Personalized Generation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized generation systems retrieve user history by request--memory relevance and inject it into the model context. Yet relevant history may concern the wrong preference aspect, duplicate public information, or provide insufficient support. We argue that personal memory should be used only when it adds utility beyond a public-only response. We propose TRACE-Memory, a two-stage framework for selective personalization. Stage 1 queries for user-specific information missing from the request and public context, then retrieves a coverage-oriented candidate pool. Stage 2 admits a compact subset of source-traceable evidence units, or the empty set, according to response-level incremental utility. We progressively train the query-generation and evidence-admission policies through structured SFT initialization, reduced-space stage-wise GRPO warm-up, and nested multi-sample Joint GRPO. Across 4,500 Controlled and Natural tasks from Goodreads, Amazon Reviews, and Reddit, TRACE-Memory consistently outperforms random and lexical memory use, improves over semantic retrieval, remains competitive with frontier-LLM memory pipelines as local generator capacity increases, and conditions evidence admission on public-context sufficiency, supporting selective rather than default personalization.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, and 6 tables. Submitted to the 41st AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE-Memory，一个面向个性化生成的两阶段选择性记忆框架。第一阶段生成查询并检索覆盖用户特有信息的候选池，第二阶段根据响应级增量效用决定是否采纳紧凑的、可溯源证据子集或空集。在 Goodreads、Amazon Reviews 和 Reddit 的 4,500 个 Controlled 与 Natural 任务上，该方法优于随机和词汇记忆使用，改善语义检索，并在本地生成器容量增大时与前沿大模型记忆流水线竞争。
Motivation: 个性化生成系统按请求与记忆的相关性检索用户历史并注入上下文，但相关历史可能涉及错误偏好、重复公开信息或支持不足；作者认为个人记忆仅在能提供超出纯公开响应的效用时才应被使用。
Method: TRACE-Memory 是两阶段框架：阶段 1 查询请求和公开上下文中缺失的用户特有信息，检索覆盖导向的候选池；阶段 2 根据响应级增量效用采纳紧凑的、可溯源证据单元子集或空集。训练采用结构化 SFT 初始化、降维分阶段 GRPO 预热和嵌套多样本 Joint GRPO，逐步训练查询生成与证据采纳策略。
Result: 在 Goodreads、Amazon Reviews 和 Reddit 的 4,500 个 Controlled 和 Natural 任务上，TRACE-Memory 一致优于随机和词汇记忆使用，改进语义检索，并在本地生成器容量增大时与前沿大模型记忆流水线保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 证据采纳取决于公开上下文充足性，支持选择性而非默认的个性化。

papers.title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
papers.abstract_en: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Alcmaeon，一个三维脑 MRI 基础模型（foundation model），在超过 425,000 个体积及衍生影像图上无需人工标注预训练，并支持跨临床领域顺序扩展。通过结合体素编码（volumetric encoding）、潜在扩散生成（latent diffusion generation）与 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP)，模型在从健康衰老、神经退行扩展到发育、精神及肿瘤影像时，相比顺序适应和弹性权重巩固（elastic weight consolidation）表现出更少的遗忘。摘要还报告蓝图为模型容量保护与复用提供了可检查记录，且不同模型层级的表征支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测。
Motivation: 脑 MRI 模型通常针对单一疾病、人群或成像协议开发；现有基础模型往往只预训练一次，用新数据更新时会丢失早期能力。作者旨在构建能随新出现数据持续扩展且保持旧能力的脑 MRI 基础模型。
Method: 提出 Alcmaeon，结合三维体素编码与潜在扩散生成，并引入 Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP) 来保护对早期领域重要的网络模块，同时让其余容量保持可训练，从而在顺序扩展到新临床领域时减少灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在从健康衰老和神经退行扩展到发育、精神及肿瘤影像的过程中，GBP 在体素级重建指标上比顺序适应和 elastic weight consolidation 遗忘更少，最大优势出现在适应肿瘤影像之后。不同模型层级的表征在图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模和术后预测上有支持作用，但没有单一表征对所有任务最优。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些发现为能够随新兴数据增长并保留既有能力的脑 MRI 基础模型提供了路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
papers.abstract_en: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, memory-augmented agents improve downstream success over an SFT-trained world-model agent, with up to a 65.4% relative gain. Sensitivity analyses further show that retrieved memory improves task success and efficiency under different memory and action-budget settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemWM，一种记忆增强的文本世界模型，利用世界记忆 (world memory) 存放转移规则、状态缓存和难预测事实，并以此条件化下一状态想象。在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上评估，较 SFT 训练的 world-model agent 提升下游成功率；事实状态保持用 Structured State Fidelity (SSF) 衡量，摘要报告 SSF 相对提升最高 206.3%。
Motivation: 现有文本世界模型生成的下一状态虽然流畅，但可能遗漏任务关键事实、破坏产品属性或应用错误的转移规则，造成系统性预测错误，进而损害基于世界模型想象的规划能力。
Method: MemWM 构建并检索世界记忆（转移规则、状态缓存、难预测事实）来条件化下一状态生成；在完整规划设置中冻结策略模型，提供策略侧 world skill，包括检索到的任务级技能和逐步骤纠偏指导，用于动作选择。
Result: 与 SFT 相比，记忆增强训练使 SSF 最高提升 206.3%；在 ALFWorld、WebShop、ScienceWorld 上，记忆增强 agent 相对 SFT 训练的 world-model agent 的下游成功率最高获得 65.4% 的相对提升。敏感性分析显示，检索记忆在不同记忆和动作预算设置下均提升任务成功率与效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式世界记忆的条件化想象能够缓解文本世界模型的系统性预测错误，并提升下游任务规划表现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Scalable High-Fidelity Macromolecular Docking for GPU-Accelerated Supercomputers
papers.abstract_en: Flexible macromolecular docking offers high-fidelity predictions of biomolecular interactions, but remains prohibitively expensive at scale. Among existing approaches, LightDock leverages Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) for accuracy, yet suffers from limited parallelism, irregular computation, and severe load imbalance, preventing efficient execution on GPU supercomputers. We present SparkleDock, a scalable GSO-based docking framework enabling near-real-time flexible docking. We redesign GSO to expose massive fine-grained parallelism at the glowworm-agent level, and restructure the dominant energy scoring computation into a Tensor Core-compatible formulation, enabling efficient execution of irregular pairwise interactions through structured matrix operations. We further introduce a performance-model-driven scheduling for load balancing and out-of-core scaling across GPUs. SparkleDock achieves 9.7 $\times$ and 18.9 $\times$ speedups over LightDock on single A100 and H100 GPU, and delivers over two orders of magnitude acceleration at scale. On 512 GPUs, it reduces docking time from hours to seconds, enabling large-scale, high-fidelity virtual screening previously impractical with flexible docking.
papers.comment: Accepted in the International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis(SC'26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparkleDock，一个基于 Glowworm Swarm Optimization (GSO) 的可扩展柔性大分子对接框架，面向 GPU 加速超算实现近实时柔性对接。作者将 GSO 重新设计为萤火虫智能体级别的细粒度并行，并把主要能量打分计算改造为 Tensor Core 兼容的矩阵运算，同时引入基于性能模型的调度实现负载均衡与跨 GPU 的 out-of-core 扩展。摘要报告其在单卡 A100/H100 上分别比 LightDock 快 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍，在 512 GPU 规模下将对接时间从小时级降至秒级。
Motivation: 柔性大分子对接能提供高保真的生物分子相互作用预测，但规模化计算代价过高；现有方法 LightDock 虽借助 GSO 获得准确性，却受限于并行度低、计算不规则和严重负载不均衡，难以在 GPU 超算上高效执行。
Method: 该方法重新设计 GSO 以暴露萤火虫智能体级别的海量细粒度并行，将能量打分计算重构为 Tensor Core 兼容的稀疏成对交互矩阵运算，并采用性能模型驱动的调度实现负载均衡以及跨 GPU 的 out-of-core 扩展。
Result: 摘要报告 SparkleDock 在单块 A100 和 H100 GPU 上分别取得相对 LightDock 的 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍加速，在大规模并行时实现超过两个数量级的加速；在 512 GPU 上把对接时间从小时级缩短到秒级。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作使大规模高保真虚拟筛选 (virtual screening) 成为可能，而这些筛选此前因柔性对接的计算代价而难以实践；其适用范围是 GPU 加速超算上的柔性大分子对接场景。

summary_sections.motivation: 柔性大分子对接能提供高保真的生物分子相互作用预测，但规模化计算代价过高；现有方法 LightDock 虽借助 GSO 获得准确性，却受限于并行度低、计算不规则和严重负载不均衡，难以在 GPU 超算上高效执行。
summary_sections.method: 该方法重新设计 GSO 以暴露萤火虫智能体级别的海量细粒度并行，将能量打分计算重构为 Tensor Core 兼容的稀疏成对交互矩阵运算，并采用性能模型驱动的调度实现负载均衡以及跨 GPU 的 out-of-core 扩展。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 SparkleDock 在单块 A100 和 H100 GPU 上分别取得相对 LightDock 的 9.7 倍和 18.9 倍加速，在大规模并行时实现超过两个数量级的加速；在 512 GPU 上把对接时间从小时级缩短到秒级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该工作使大规模高保真虚拟筛选 (virtual screening) 成为可能，而这些筛选此前因柔性对接的计算代价而难以实践；其适用范围是 GPU 加速超算上的柔性大分子对接场景。

papers.title: Generative Embedding Benchmark: How Much Information Survives in a Dense Embedding?
papers.abstract_en: Embeddings have emerged as a standard representational interface linking foundation models with downstream systems. Most embedding benchmarks assess representations through discriminative tasks or geometric criteria centered on separability in embedding space. However, strong performance on such evaluations does not establish whether content compressed into an embedding remains accessible to a downstream generator. To address this gap, we introduce the Generative Embedding Benchmark (GEB), in which a decoder answers questions using only a frozen embedding and question text, without access to the original image or intermediate visual features. Answer quality under this readout measures generative information: the answer-relevant content recoverable from an embedding. GEB includes a curated visual-question-answering dataset with a 1,800-item development split and a held-out 900-item test split covering natural images, scene text, and visual documents. Using a common decoder and training recipe, we evaluate seven public embedding models in visual-only and vision-language joint modes. On the test set, visual-only scores range from 28.25 to 33.21; with image-question joint encoding, all five VLM-based embedding models score higher, and the best reaches 65.56. Matched embeddings also outperform text-only inputs, zero embeddings, and shuffled embeddings. Natural-image information is much easier to recover than scene text or visual-document information, while a Qwen3-VL-2B reference with access to the original image reaches 84.30. Together, these results show that generative readout exposes information bottlenecks that separability-based evaluation does not capture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出生成式嵌入基准 (Generative Embedding Benchmark, GEB)，用于衡量密集嵌入中保留的可生成信息。GEB 让解码器仅基于冻结嵌入和问题文本作答，构建了 1,800 项开发集和 900 项测试集的视觉问答数据，覆盖自然图像、场景文本和视觉文档。在七个公开嵌入模型上的结果表明，生成式读取 (generative readout) 能暴露基于可分性评估无法捕捉的信息瓶颈。
Motivation: 现有嵌入基准多通过判别式任务或基于嵌入空间可分性的几何准则来评测，但这些指标无法回答一个关键问题：压缩进嵌入的内容是否仍能被下游生成器获取。
Method: 提出 GEB：解码器只使用冻结嵌入与问题文本回答问题，不访问原始图像或中间视觉特征，以回答质量度量生成信息量。数据集包含 1,800 项开发集和 900 项测试集，评估七个公开嵌入模型，涵盖纯视觉模式和视觉-语言联合编码模式。
Result: 测试集上纯视觉模式得分范围 28.25 至 33.21；图像-问题联合编码下，五个基于 VLM 的嵌入模型均得分更高，最高达 65.56。匹配嵌入优于纯文本输入、零嵌入和打乱嵌入，自然图像信息远易于场景文本和视觉文档；可访问原始图像的 Qwen3-VL-2B 参考模型达到 84.30。
Conclusion: 生成式读取能够揭示嵌入中的信息瓶颈，这类问题基于可分性的评估无法展示，说明现有评测对生成式下游任务的信息可用性覆盖不足。

papers.title: SMOPD: Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning via Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: We aim to improve model performance in multi-reward reinforcement learning training process. Existing Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) has mitigated the issue of reward signals masking one another during direct scalarization by normalizing each reward dimension separately before aggregation. However, our experiments show that GDPO still struggles to balance reward signals with different granularities. Specifically, in some particular training tasks, the model may receive a dense reward that assigns fine-grained scores ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, together with a sparse reward that provides only binary feedback of either 0 or 1. In such cases, we find that the sparse reward may provide an insufficient optimization signal, preventing its corresponding capability from being effectively reinforced. Therefore, how can we strengthen the optimization signal from the sparse reward without sacrificing the capability already learned from the fine-grained reward? To overcome this limitation, we propose Specialize-and-Merge Online Policy Distillation (SMOPD), a two-stage training method for multi-reward optimization. Stage1-Specialize: SMOPD first employs reward-priority configurations to train multiple reward-specialized teachers, allowing each reward to be learned under conditions where its signal can effectively drive optimization. Stage2-Merge: SMOPD then utilizes online policy distillation to combine the reward-specialized capabilities of these teachers into a single student policy, while maintaining balanced task-level optimization. To validate our method, we conduct experiments on two multi-reward settings: complementary rewards(tool-calling accuracy and format) and conflicting rewards (helpful and harmless rewards). Based on above settings, SMOPD outperforms GDPO across 1.5B, 3B and 7B backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SMOPD，一种用于多奖励强化学习的两阶段训练方法，针对 GDPO 在每个奖励维度分别归一化后聚合仍难以平衡稠密奖励（例如 0.1-1.0 的细粒度评分）与二值稀疏奖励（0/1）的问题。第一阶段通过奖励优先级配置训练多个奖励专门的 teacher，第二阶段用在线策略蒸馏 (online policy distillation) 将这些能力合并到单一 student 策略；在互补奖励（工具调用准确率与格式）和冲突奖励（helpful 与 harmless）两类设置下，1.5B/3B/7B 骨干模型上均优于 GDPO。
Motivation: 现有 GDPO 通过逐维度归一化缓解了奖励信号互相掩盖的问题，但当稠密奖励与稀疏奖励并存时，稀疏奖励的优化信号不足，其对应能力难以被有效强化。作者希望在不牺牲已从细粒度奖励中学到的能力的前提下增强稀疏奖励的优化信号。
Method: 两阶段训练：Stage1-Specialize 使用 reward-priority 配置分别训练多个奖励专门的 teacher，使每个奖励在能有效驱动优化的条件下被学习；Stage2-Merge 利用在线策略蒸馏把这些 teacher 的专门能力合并进一个 student 策略，并维持任务级优化平衡。
Result: 在互补奖励（工具调用准确率与格式）和冲突奖励（helpful 与 harmless）两种多奖励设置上，SMOPD 在 1.5B、3B、7B 三种骨干模型上均优于 GDPO。
Conclusion: 作者认为该 specialize-and-merge 两阶段流程能克服 GDPO 对奖励粒度差异的敏感性；摘要未提供消融或更广泛场景的细节。

papers.title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
papers.abstract_en: In laparoscopy, surgeon gaze tracks where the instruments will act; easing this demand through visual attention modeling requires dense labels of those interaction loci. These encode tacit knowledge: experts converge on consensus loci yet struggle to state the rules. Here we show that such labels can be recovered from completed actions in surgical videos, in which recorded instrument trajectories are converted into dense, continuous supervision. DiffeoAfford grounds tissue affordance by attaching instrument tips to the tissue and transporting them through deformation using diffeomorphism-constrained tracking, matching context-informed annotators' accuracy. Trained on these labels and never on gaze, a real-time model aligns with surgeon gaze more closely in space and time than does camera-assistant gaze. The framework also transfers across procedures: on hysterectomy videos, a separately trained predictor reaches 95.16% directional consistency with subsequent camera motion. In 12 paired cholecystectomies (24 procedures), the auto-framing application AffordView, which proactively centers predicted targets in view, lowered surgeon cognitive workload on converging subjective, physiological, and behavioral measures, including a reduced number of verbal instructions to the camera assistant. Deriving supervision from action rather than manual annotation offers a scalable route to anticipatory assistance.
papers.comment: Preprint. 59 pages, including supplementary information and 8 main figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从腹腔镜手术视频中已完成的器械轨迹提取密集组织可供性 (tissue affordance) 标签的方法 DiffeoAfford，通过微分同胚约束跟踪将器械尖端附着于组织并随形变传递监督信号，并基于这些标签训练实时模型预测外科医生视线，进而构建自动取景应用 AffordView。摘要报告该模型在空间和时间上比相机助手的视线更接近外科医生视线，在子宫切除术视频上方向一致性达 95.16%，并在 12 对胆囊切除术中降低外科医生认知负荷。
Motivation: 腹腔镜手术中外科医生视线会追踪器械将要作用的组织位置，但这类交互位点的密集标注依赖专家共识且难以用规则显式描述，人工标注不具备可扩展性，因此需要从已完成动作而非人工标注中获取监督。
Method: 提出 DiffeoAfford：将器械尖端附着到组织上，利用微分同胚约束的跟踪将器械轨迹转化为密集、连续的组织可供性监督标签；用这些标签（而非注视数据）训练实时视线预测模型，并构建自动取景应用 AffordView 主动将预测目标居中。
Result: 摘要报告：实时模型在空间和时间上比相机助手视线更接近外科医生视线；跨术式迁移时，在子宫切除术视频上单独训练的预测器与后续相机运动的方向一致性达 95.16%；在 12 对胆囊切除术（24 例手术）中，AffordView 在主观、生理和行为指标上均降低认知负荷，包括减少对相机助手的口头指令数量。
Conclusion: 从动作而非人工标注中推导监督信号，为腹腔镜手术中的预期性辅助提供可扩展路径；作者强调该方法无需注视数据即可训练，并具备跨术式迁移能力。

papers.title: Latent Softmax for Data-Efficient Phoneme-Based Multilingual ASR Across Tonal and Non-Tonal Languages
papers.abstract_en: Phoneme-based multilingual automatic speech recognition (ASR) can share acoustic evidence across languages more directly than language-specific subword modeling. When tonal and non-tonal languages are jointly trained, however, their supervision granularity does not match: tonal languages annotate tone-marked vowels, whereas non-tonal languages typically provide only base-vowel labels. A standard softmax either treats the two as unrelated classes, weakening cross-lingual sharing, or collapses tones, losing distinctions required by tonal languages. We propose Latent Softmax, a connectionist temporal classification (CTC)-compatible output layer that models tone-marked vowels as subclasses and base vowels as major classes, while consonants and the CTC blank remain singleton labels. When only a base-vowel major-class label is observed, the tone-marked vowel subclass is treated as latent and marginalized out. Multilingual experiments on AISHELL-1 Mandarin and LibriSpeech English show that Latent Softmax reduces speech-to-phoneme (S2P) phoneme error rates over a standard softmax multilingual baseline by 8.4% on AISHELL-1, 17.5% on LibriSpeech test-clean, and 12.6% on test-other. The improved speech-to-phoneme encoders also yield consistent word error rate gains for both large-language-model phoneme-to-grapheme conversion (LLM-P2G) and projector-based interfaces. After code-switching adaptation in the evaluated Mandarin--English setting, Latent Softmax reduces projector-based mixed error rate by 2.6% on ASRU2019 and 9.5% on CS-Dialogue, whereas the LLM-P2G results do not establish a consistent advantage.
papers.comment: Add Proof of Equations for CTC Likelihood with Latent Softmax
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音素级多语言语音识别（ASR）中声调语言与非声调语言的监督粒度不匹配问题，提出 Latent Softmax：一种兼容 CTC 的输出层，将带声调元音建模为子类、基础元音建模为主类，并在仅观察到基础元音标签时对隐状态子类做边缘化。AISHELL-1 中文和 LibriSpeech 英文实验表明，相比标准 softmax 多语言基线，音素错误率（S2P PER）在 AISHELL-1 上降低 8.4%、LibriSpeech test-clean 降低 17.5%、test-other 降低 12.6%；改进的编码器也带来 LLM-P2G 与 projector 两种接口词错误率的一致提升。
Motivation: 音素级多语言 ASR 比语言专属子词建模更能直接跨语言共享声学证据，但声调语言标注带声调元音、非声调语言只提供基础元音标签，二者监督粒度不匹配；标准 softmax 要么把两者当作无关类别而削弱跨语言共享，要么合并声调而丢失声调语言所需的区分。
Method: 提出 Latent Softmax，一种 CTC 兼容的输出层：将带声调元音作为子类（subclass）、基础元音作为主类（major class），辅音和 CTC blank 保持单例标签；当观测到的是基础元音主类标签时，将带声调元音子类视为隐变量并边缘化掉。arXiv 注释还说明加入了 Latent Softmax 下 CTC 似然的方程证明。
Result: 摘要报告在多语言实验中，Latent Softmax 相对标准 softmax 基线将 S2P 音素错误率在 AISHELL-1 上降低 8.4%、LibriSpeech test-clean 降低 17.5%、test-other 降低 12.6%；改进的 speech-to-phoneme 编码器在 LLM-P2G 和 projector 式接口上都带来一致的词错误率收益。在中文-英语代码切换适应评估中，projector 接口的混合错误率在 ASRU2019 上降低 2.6%、在 CS-Dialogue 上降低 9.5%，而 LLM-P2G 结果未呈现一致优势。
Conclusion: Latent Softmax 通过子类-主类建模与隐变量边缘化，缓解了声调与非声调语言联合训练中的监督粒度冲突，并在音素错误率和下游接口上带来稳定收益；但代码切换场景下其对 LLM-P2G 的优势尚不明确。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对音素级多语言语音识别（ASR）中声调语言与非声调语言的监督粒度不匹配问题，提出 Latent Softmax：一种兼容 CTC 的输出层，将带声调元音建模为子类、基础元音建模为主类，并在仅观察到基础元音标签时对隐状态子类做边缘化。AISHELL-1 中文和 LibriSpeech 英文实验表明，相比标准 softmax 多语言基线，音素错误率（S2P PER）在 AISHELL-1 上降低 8.4%、LibriSpeech test-clean 降低 17.5%、test-other 降低 12.6%；改进的编码器也带来 LLM-P2G 与 projector 两种接口词错误率的一致提升。

summary_sections.method: 提出 Latent Softmax，一种 CTC 兼容的输出层：将带声调元音作为子类（subclass）、基础元音作为主类（major class），辅音和 CTC blank 保持单例标签；当观测到的是基础元音主类标签时，将带声调元音子类视为隐变量并边缘化掉。arXiv 注释还说明加入了 Latent Softmax 下 CTC 似然的方程证明。

papers.title: Towards Query-Agnostic RAG Evaluation via Query Coverage and Claim Verifiability
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in retrieved evidence, yet existing evaluation frameworks struggle to provide consistent, fine-grained diagnostics across the diverse spectrum of user queries, ranging from close-ended fact-seeking to open-ended explanatory requests. We propose Q-CARE, a query-agnostic and fully reference-free framework that enables fine-grained assessment by decomposing queries into sub-queries and answers into atomic claims. Q-CARE establishes a unified evaluation principle based on query coverage and claim verifiability, yielding coverage-aware retriever metrics (C-Prec@k, C-nDCG@k) and claim-level generator metrics (Completeness, Conciseness, and Verifiableness). On a human-annotated benchmark spanning eight datasets, Q-CARE achieves higher correlation with human judgments than four existing RAG evaluation metrics, including RAGEval and RAGChecker, proving its effectiveness as a reliable, automated evaluation framework. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/DISL-Lab/Q-CaRE-COLM-26.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Q-CARE，一个查询无关且完全无需参考答案 (reference-free) 的检索增强生成 (RAG) 评估框架。它将查询分解为子查询、将答案分解为原子声明 (atomic claims)，并基于查询覆盖度 (query coverage) 与声明可验证性 (claim verifiability) 建立统一评估原则，据此设计覆盖感知的检索器指标 (C-Prec@k, C-nDCG@k) 和声明级生成器指标 (Completeness, Conciseness, Verifiableness)。在覆盖八个数据集的人工标注基准上，Q-CARE 与人类判断的相关性高于 RAGEval、RAGChecker 等四种现有 RAG 评估指标。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 评估框架难以在从封闭式事实查询到开放式解释性请求的多样化用户查询上提供一致且细粒度的诊断，且多依赖参考答案，缺乏通用性。
Method: 提出 Q-CARE：将查询分解为子查询、答案分解为原子声明，以查询覆盖度和声明可验证性为统一原则，推导出覆盖感知的检索指标 C-Prec@k、C-nDCG@k 以及声明级生成指标 Completeness、Conciseness、Verifiableness，实现完全参考无关的细粒度自动评估。
Result: 在一个覆盖八个数据集的人工标注基准上，Q-CARE 与人类判断的相关性高于四种现有 RAG 评估指标，包括 RAGEval 和 RAGChecker，表明其作为可靠自动评估框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要将 Q-CARE 定位为可靠、自动化且查询无关的 RAG 评估框架，代码和数据已公开；摘要未提及明显局限性。

papers.title: Fragility of Value under Imperfect Alignment
papers.abstract_en: As more responsibility is placed upon AI systems, it becomes increasingly important to guarantee that these systems are aligned with humanity. A common fear in AI safety is that human value is fragile -- that is, optimizing too heavily for an imperfect proxy to human values will lead to a catastrophic outcome. In this paper, we present a model of the alignment problem where an agent undergoes idealized alignment training that guarantees its value function satisfies a proxy condition before optimizing the world. Our primary results identify conditions on the human value function and the accuracy of several proxy conditions under which an agent with an $η$-catastrophic value function, one that is guaranteed to take the expectation of human value below $η$ in the limit of optimizing power, would be deployed. Our results highlight the danger of overoptimization and motivate AI designs that limit optimization pressure, such as quantilizers, rather than relying solely on pre-deployment training.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 7 figures. Expanded the contribution statements and added three researchers as coauthors. Made small text improvements
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 AI 对齐中的价值脆弱性问题提出一个形式化模型：智能体先经过理想化的对齐训练，使其价值函数满足某种代理条件，然后再对世界进行优化。主要结果给出人类价值函数与多种代理条件精度应满足的条件，在这些条件下，具有 η-灾难性价值函数（即在优化能力极限下保证将人类价值期望压低到 η 以下）的智能体会被部署。
Motivation: AI 安全领域普遍担忧人类价值是脆弱的：过度优化不完美的人类价值代理可能导致灾难性后果，因此需要形式化刻画这种风险何时发生。
Method: 构建对齐问题的数学模型，假设智能体在优化世界之前经历理想化对齐训练以保证其价值函数满足代理条件；在此基础上分析人类价值函数特性及代理条件精度对部署决策的影响。
Result: 识别出若干关于人类价值函数和代理条件精度的条件，在这些条件下，保证在优化能力极限内使人类价值期望低于 η 的 η-灾难性价值函数智能体仍会被部署。
Conclusion: 结果强调过度优化（overoptimization）的危险，并支持采用限制优化压力的设计（如 quantilizers）而非仅依赖部署前训练。

papers.title: Share the Judge, Learn the Deferral: Where Specialization Helps LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic systems generate outputs faster than human review. We contrast two LLM evaluator specialization strategies: specialized judge weights, or rule-based deferral policies for safe judgment acceptance. On 99,952 rubric-conditioned samples, correct rubrics improve accuracy by 2.11 points, while incorrect rubrics reduce performance by 2.66 points. Splitting training data across eight criterion-specific LoRA experts lowers accuracy by 10.05 points and reduces 5% error-bound coverage from 24.44% to 5.43%. This loss is independent of model size and training settings, with most performance recoverable by warm-starting experts from a unified judge. Sweeping data budgets confirms scratch expert specialization yields no empirical gains. Warm-started splits appear competitive with unified models, yet under limited data, unified training outperforms split training, with specialization beneficial only after unified training plateaus. Results hold on HealthBench, where physician rubrics improve accuracy while flawed rubrics degrade performance. Unlike weight specialization, deferral policies enable efficient evaluation. On RewardBench 2, lightweight deferral heads form a 0.6B-4B-8B reward cascade with no core scoring modification. Across 20 splits, the cascade achieves 89.40% accuracy versus 84.75% for a standalone 8B judge at 41.5% compute, satisfying 95% risk constraints. Margin-based deferral matches accuracy at far higher compute cost. The design generalizes across models, improving Tulu-3-8B and Skywork-8B performance with a lightweight DeBERTa frontend. We derive simple, robust evaluator design rules: unify judgment training or warm-start split models, and use audited deferral cascades for low-cost, reliable LLM evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对比了 LLM 评估器（evaluator）的两种专业化策略：专用 judge 权重（specialized judge weights）与基于规则的 deferral 策略（rule-based deferral policies）。在 99,952 个 rubric-conditioned 样本上，正确 rubric 可提升准确率 2.11 点，错误 rubric 则降低 2.66 点；将训练数据切分给八个 criterion-specific LoRA experts 会使准确率下降 10.05 点，5% error-bound coverage 从 24.44% 降至 5.43%。相反，在 RewardBench 2 上，轻量 deferral heads 构成的 reward cascade 以仅 41.5% 的计算开销达到 89.40% 的准确率，胜过独立 8B judge 的 84.75%，且该设计可泛化到 Tulu-3-8B 和 Skywork-8B。
Motivation: Agentic 系统产出结果的速度远超人工审核，需要低成本且可靠的 LLM 自动评估；关键问题是评估器专业化（权重专业化或 deferral 策略）究竟能否带来收益。
Method: 系统比较权重专业化与 deferral 两种路线：前者包括在八个标准上的 LoRA experts 切分训练，以及从统一 judge 热启动（warm-start）的分割模型；后者使用可审计的 deferral cascade，在 0.6B-4B-8B 规模上叠加轻量 deferral heads，不修改核心评分，并验证了 margin-based deferral 与 DeBERTa 前端在不同基座模型上的泛化性。
Result: 从头训练（scratch）的专家切分在数据预算扫描下无任何经验收益，且损失独立于模型大小与训练设置，但统一 judge 热启动可恢复大部分性能；在有限数据下统一训练优于切分训练，专业化仅在统一训练平台期后才有益。RewardBench 2 上 cascade 达到 89.40% 准确率，而独立 8B judge 为 84.75%，前者仅消耗 41.5% 计算量并满足 95% 风险约束；margin-based deferral 在更高计算成本下才能达到同等的准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要给出稳健的评估器设计规则：统一 judgment 训练或对分割模型做热启动，并使用经审计的 deferral cascades 以实现低成本、可靠的 LLM 评估。

papers.title: A Distributional Robustness Margin For Pathology Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Pathology foundation models encode non-biological variation introduced by tissue preparation, staining and scanning, enabling shortcut learning that undermines generalisation across institutions. The Robustness Index (RI) was proposed to assess whether local representation geometry is dominated by biological or non-biological variation. However, its construction suffers from structural limitations that make cross-model comparison unreliable, calling for a more principled metric. We introduce the Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa), a signed, per-sample margin that measures whether samples sharing the same biology but different confounder lie closer than samples sharing the same confounder but different biology. It is defined for every sample, allowing models to be compared on the same cohort and robustness to be analysed as a distribution rather than reduced to a single pooled score. We evaluated CRoMa across 20 tile-level encoders on three benchmarks. Rankings by median CRoMa were highly consistent across benchmarks (Spearman rho ~ 0.90), yet every encoder retained confounder-dominated samples, whose prevalence and severity varied markedly. Similar patterns emerged for four slide-level encoders evaluated on a separate benchmark, extending the analysis beyond tile-level representations. Higher median CRoMa was associated with smaller shortcut-induced performance losses in downstream linear probes, supporting its use as a representation-level indicator of shortcut susceptibility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Cross-confounder Robustness Margin (CRoMa)，一个逐样本的有符号余量，用于衡量病理学基础模型表示中生物信息与非生物混杂因素（组织制备、染色、扫描）之间的鲁棒性。作者在三个基准上对 20 个 tile 级编码器进行评估，发现按中位 CRoMa 的排名跨基准高度一致（Spearman rho ~0.90），但每个编码器仍保留混杂因素主导的样本，且其占比与严重程度差异明显；四个 slide 级编码器在独立基准上也呈现类似模式。
Motivation: 此前提出的 Robustness Index (RI) 试图判断局部表示几何由生物变异还是非生物变异主导，但其构造存在结构性局限，导致跨模型比较不可靠，因此需要更规范的鲁棒性度量。
Method: 引入 CRoMa，一个定义在每个样本上的有符号余量，比较“共享相同生物信息但混杂因素不同”的样本对与“共享相同混杂因素但生物信息不同”的样本对之间的相对距离；这使得模型可在同一队列上比较，并将鲁棒性作为分布而非单一汇总分数来分析。
Result: 在三个基准上评估 20 个 tile 级编码器，中位 CRoMa 排名高度一致（Spearman rho ~0.90），但所有编码器都存在混杂因素主导的样本，且其普遍性与严重程度变化显著；四个 slide 级编码器的独立基准也呈现相似模式。较高的中位 CRoMa 与下游线性探针 (linear probes) 中更小的捷径学习 (shortcut) 性能损失相关。
Conclusion: CRoMa 可作为表示层面的捷径易感性指标，并将鲁棒性分析从 tile 级表示扩展到 slide 级表示。
