summary_sections.result: 在三个基准上评估 20 个 tile 级编码器，中位 CRoMa 排名高度一致（Spearman rho ~0.90），但所有编码器都存在混杂因素主导的样本，且其普遍性与严重程度变化显著；四个 slide 级编码器的独立基准也呈现相似模式。较高的中位 CRoMa 与下游线性探针 (linear probes) 中更小的捷径学习 (shortcut) 性能损失相关。
summary_sections.conclusion: CRoMa 可作为表示层面的捷径易感性指标，并将鲁棒性分析从 tile 级表示扩展到 slide 级表示。

papers.title: Identification and Honest Recovery from Semantic Observation Kernels: Operator Error, Coarsening, and Stability
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic text generators, such as large language models, assign probabilities to phrases, but consequential decisions require posterior uncertainty over meaningful states. These are not interchangeable: language probabilities depend on the prompt, may be incomplete and need not reliably identify state uncertainty. Without a statistical bridge, fluent responses and numerical confidence are insufficient for inference or governance. We formulate recovery of the target posterior as a semiparametric inverse problem and develop honest recovery guarantees that account jointly for calibration error, measurement noise, incomplete probabilities and weak identification. Simulations demonstrate the predicted coverage and stability behaviour, while two frozen language-model studies demonstrate held-out recovery. The resulting method determines when a semantic measurement can be trusted for inference and when use, review, recalibration or abstention is warranted, providing a statistical foundation for runtime AI governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把从概率文本生成器（如大语言模型）中恢复目标状态后验不确定性的问题，形式化为一个半参数反问题（semiparametric inverse problem），并发展出同时考虑校准误差、测量噪声、概率不完整和弱识别（weak identification）的诚实恢复保证。模拟实验验证了预测的覆盖率和稳定性行为，两个冻结语言模型研究展示了留出恢复（held-out recovery）效果，最终给出语义测量何时可用于推断的判断准则。
Motivation: 大语言模型给短语赋概率，但关键决策需要关于有意义状态的后验不确定性；二者不可互换，语言概率依赖提示词、可能不完整且未必能可靠识别状态不确定性。缺少统计桥梁时，流畅回答和数值置信度不足以支撑推断或治理。
Method: 将目标后验的恢复建模为半参数反问题，构造同时处理校准误差、测量噪声、不完整概率和弱识别的诚实恢复保证，并据此判断语义测量是否可用于推断。
Result: 模拟实验展示了所预测的覆盖率与稳定性行为；两个冻结语言模型研究验证了留出恢复效果。
Conclusion: 该方法可判定语义测量在何时可被信任用于推断，以及在何时应采用、审查、重新校准或弃权（abstention），为运行时 AI 治理提供统计基础。

papers.title: An Introduction to Bayesian and Frequentist Simulation-Based Inference with Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-based inference (SBI) with machine learning is an increasingly important tool for solving inverse problems in science and engineering, including parameter inference and the inversion of detector effects. We provide an overview of the Bayesian and frequentist statistical frameworks, describe how machine-learning-based SBI methods, such as neural posterior estimation and neural likelihood estimation, can be used for parameter estimation within these frameworks, and show that the same methods can also be applied to Empirical Bayes or unfolding tasks. We also discuss how to validate inference results and the limitations of SBI with machine learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇面向科学与工程中逆问题的综述性导论，系统梳理贝叶斯与频率派统计框架下的基于机器学习的模拟推断 (simulation-based inference, SBI)。摘要重点介绍 neural posterior estimation、neural likelihood estimation 等方法如何用于参数估计，并说明同一类方法也可用于 Empirical Bayes 或展开 (unfolding) 任务，同时讨论推断结果的验证方式与 SBI 的局限。全文 39 页，含 13 幅图。
Motivation: 参数推断和检测器效应反演等逆问题在科学与工程中广泛存在，而许多情况下似然函数只能通过模拟器隐式获得，难以直接计算；因此需要从统计框架层面梳理基于机器学习的 SBI 方法如何填补这一空白。
Method: 作者以导论方式给出贝叶斯和频率派统计框架的概览，说明机器学习 SBI 方法在这两种框架下均可用于参数估计；方法叙述还覆盖 Empirical Bayes 和展开任务，并讨论推断结果的验证策略以及 SBI 与机器学习结合的局限性。
Result: 作为导论性综述，摘要未报告具体的数值实验或基准结果；其内容贡献在于建立统计推断框架、机器学习 SBI 方法与展开/经验贝叶斯任务之间的系统对应关系，并给出验证推断结果的一般性讨论。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于机器学习的 SBI 是解决科学和工程中逆问题日益重要的工具，同时强调必须关注推断结果的验证以及这类方法固有的局限。

papers.title: SubSplat: High-Resolution Pixel-aligned 3DGS via Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterization
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-aligned Gaussian splatting enables efficient and generalizable novel-view synthesis. However, high-resolution rendering faces a critical trade-off where increasing input resolution improves detail at the expense of quadratically rising network computational cost. Conversely, maintaining low-resolution inputs stabilizes this cost but results in insufficient Gaussian density and artifacts. To address this, we propose SubSplat, which introduces Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterizer(SPGR) to subdivide primary Gaussians into fine-grained primitives, restoring structural density directly from low-resolution features. We further enhance the reparameterization quality through feature aggregation, which effectively captures high-frequency details across multiple views. Experiments on RealEstate10K and ACID demonstrate that SubSplat achieves high-fidelity rendering with superior efficiency. Our results validate that the proposed framework successfully resolves the trade-off between reparameterization fidelity and network computational cost inherent in pixel-aligned Gaussian Splatting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SubSplat，一种面向像素对齐 3D 高斯泼溅 (pixel-aligned Gaussian splatting) 的高分辨率渲染方法。核心思路是用 Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterizer (SPGR) 将主高斯细分为更细粒度的子高斯，直接从低分辨率特征恢复结构密度，并借助多视图特征聚合增强高频细节。在 RealEstate10K 和 ACID 上的实验表明，该方法在保持高保真渲染的同时显著降低网络计算成本。
Motivation: 像素对齐的高斯泼溅在高分辨率新颖视图合成中存在根本性权衡：提高输入分辨率能增强细节，但网络计算成本呈平方增长；保持低分辨率输入可稳定成本，却导致高斯密度不足和伪影。
Method: 提出 SubSplat，包含 Sub-pixel Gaussian Reparameterizer (SPGR)，将主高斯细分为细粒度原语 (fine-grained primitives)，直接从低分辨率特征恢复结构密度；同时通过特征聚合 (feature aggregation) 跨多个视图捕获高频细节，以提升重参数化质量。
Result: 在 RealEstate10K 和 ACID 数据集上的实验表明，SubSplat 实现了高保真渲染，同时具备更高的效率，验证了其能够解决重参数化保真度与网络计算成本之间的权衡。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架成功解决了像素对齐高斯泼溅中固有的重参数化保真度与计算成本之间的权衡问题。

papers.title: Skillware: A Software Ontology and Engineering Lifecycle for Persistent Behavioral Artifacts
papers.abstract_en: Agent Skills have become persistent behavioral artifacts across independent AI agent systems. They combine natural-language task specifications with metadata and optional references, scripts, assets, hooks, package manifests, tests, and companion interfaces. Existing studies explain how Skills are specified, executed, maintained, and evolved, but lack an ontology that defines these artifacts as independent software objects. This paper introduces Skillware as the software abstraction that extends software engineering to persistent Behavioral Artifacts in agent systems. A Skill Artifact specifies reusable task behavior; a Skillware Unit manages that artifact as software through an independent identity and lifecycle. A compatible Agent Host activates the unit for runtime interpretation. Three necessary conditions operationalize category membership: behavioral primacy, independent software identity, and an Agent Host execution relationship. Lifecycle Continuity records whether the same unit identity persists through update, maintenance, rollback, and removal as a separate software-grade property. Evidence combines the Agent Skills specification, a frozen corpus of 138,133 content-deduplicated SKILL.md records associated with 20,556 repository identifiers, independent empirical studies, 15 category-boundary cases, and 13 fixed-revision engineering implementations. The evidence establishes a recurring artifact envelope, separable software identities, documented or reconstructed activation paths, and lifecycle engineering pressure. Skillware provides the software ontology and engineering lifecycle through which agent capabilities can become identifiable, composable, and maintainable software artifacts with an explicit basis for future evolution. Public design-pattern and evidence materials are available at https://github.com/MetaInFLow/skillware-patterns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Skillware，将 Agent Skills 从跨系统持久行为制品（persistent behavioral artifacts）提升为具有独立软件身份的生命周期对象。作者定义了 Skill Artifact、Skillware Unit 与 Agent Host 三层抽象，并用三个必要条件划分类别成员资格，同时引入 Lifecycle Continuity 来记录同一单元身份在更新、回滚等操作中的存续。证据包括 Agent Skills 规范、138,133 条去重后的 SKILL.md 记录、既有实证研究、15 个类别边界案例和 13 个固定修订工程实现。
Motivation: 现有研究解释了 Agent Skills 如何被规范、执行、维护和演化，但缺少一个把这类制品当作独立软件对象来定义的本体论，导致其难以被识别、组合和持续管理。
Method: 提出 Skillware 软件抽象：Skill Artifact 规定可复用任务行为，Skillware Unit 以独立身份和生命周期管理该制品，兼容的 Agent Host 负责运行时解释。用三个必要条件（行为主导性、独立软件身份、与 Agent Host 的执行关系）操作化类别成员资格，并把生命周期连续性作为独立软件属性记录。
Result: 基于大规模 SKILL.md 语料和工程案例，摘要报告证据支持存在重复出现的制品包络、可分离的软件身份、可记录或可重构的激活路径，以及生命周期工程压力。
Conclusion: Skillware 为 agent 能力提供了软件本体论与工程生命周期，使其成为可识别、可组合、可维护的软件制品，并明确未来演化基础。

papers.title: When Words Are Safe But Actions Kill: Probing Physical Jailbreak Beyond Textual Jailbreak in Hidden-State Risk Space
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as high-level planners for embodied agents, where linguistically benign instructions can become unsafe once grounded in the physical world. We study whether this physically grounded jailbreak is the same safety problem as ordinary textual jailbreak. Through hidden-state direction analysis and random-split null tests, we show that textual jailbreak (TJ) and physical jailbreak (PJ) form separable signals in LLM representations across Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B/32B, Phi-3.5 and SmolLM2. Building on this separability, we propose PRISM, a single-layer L2-regularized logistic probe over full hidden states. PRISM achieves 86.2--87.7\% accuracy on SafeAgentBench with 11.7--13.7\% false-positive rates (FPRs), while same-scale LLM judges over-block safe tasks at 24.7--39.0\% FPR. To test whether the result survives lexical-shortcut controls, we introduce an interaction-balanced revision of PhysicalJailbreakBench-2K (PJB-2K): a fixed 2{,}000-row comparison set sampled by label and physical mechanism from a larger object--site construction. On the underlying 10{,}000-row pool, word-TFIDF and the embedding layer remain at chance (AUC 0.497 and 0.500). At layer 25, selected by an i.i.d. sweep, cell-grouped cross-validation gives PRISM 0.718 AUC, compared with 0.398 for a physics-free label control under the same protocol. On the identical 2{,}000 comparison rows, these PRISM predictions obtain 0.671 balanced accuracy, while Qwen2.5 judges from 3B to 72B obtain 0.538--0.577 and exhibit high FPR. These results support hidden-state probing as a representation-level method for physical safety beyond text moderation, without relying on the near-perfect scores of shortcut-prone paired templates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 作为具身智能体高层规划器时，语言上无害的指令在地理环境中落地后可能变危险的问题，即物理性越狱 (physical jailbreak, PJ) 是否与普通文本越狱 (textual jailbreak, TJ) 属于同一安全挑战。作者通过隐状态方向分析和随机分割零检验，发现 TJ 与 PJ 在 Qwen2.5-3B/7B/14B/32B、Phi-3.5 和 SmolLM2 的表示中形成可分离信号，并提出基于全隐状态的单层 L2 正则逻辑回归探针 PRISM。PRISM 在 SafeAgentBench 上达到 86.2–87.7% 准确率、11.7–13.7% 误报率，优于同规模 LLM 裁判；在重设计的交互平衡 PJB-2K 比较集上也有明显优势。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地充当具身智能体的高层规划器，语言层面安全的指令一旦在物理世界中得到执行可能造成伤害；作者希望厘清这种物理性越狱是否只是普通文本越狱的另一种表现，以及能否从表示层面区分两者。
Method: 先通过隐状态方向分析和随机分割零检验证明 TJ 与 PJ 在模型表示中可分离；随后提出 PRISM，一个作用于完整隐状态上的单层 L2 正则化逻辑回归探针。为排除词法捷径，作者还构造了交互平衡的 PhysicalJailbreakBench-2K (PJB-2K) 修订版，按标签和物理机制从 10,000 行对象—地点构造池中固定抽样 2,000 行比较集。

papers.title: MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces diverse, visually grounded scenarios through information-flow-guided planning and multi-stage quality filtering, yielding 258 human-verified nominal scenarios and 50 variants targeting interactive UI applications. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art models, from 4B open-weight to frontier proprietary systems, shows that current models still lack robust visual tool-calling capability: even the best model achieves below 50% success rate. Our failure analysis further reveals that visual precision, not only planning, is a primary bottleneck for capable models: 53% of failures stem from incorrect information extraction from images despite otherwise correct task workflows. A planning-to-precision crossover emerges with scale: smaller models fail at deciding what to do, while larger models fail at perceiving what they see, suggesting fundamentally different research directions for improving models at different capability levels. The framework and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MM-ToolSandBox，一个面向视觉工具调用智能体的统一评测框架与基准。框架提供包含 500+ 工具、覆盖 16 个应用域的有状态执行环境，支持多图像、多轮任务，并要求智能体在目标修订、错误纠正与状态变更等对话现象中，将逐步到达的视觉输入落地为可执行工具调用。基准包含 258 个经人工验证的常规场景与 50 个交互式 UI 变体，并评估了 12 个模型。
Motivation: 现有工具调用智能体评测多偏重文本或单轮交互，缺少对视觉输入逐步到达、多轮对话与有状态环境相结合的系统性评测，因此难以刻画视觉工具调用能力的真实瓶颈。
Method: 构建自动化场景生成流水线，通过信息流引导的规划 (information-flow-guided planning) 与多阶段质量过滤生成多样化视觉场景；同时提供有状态执行环境，使评测覆盖多图像、多轮工具调用以及现实对话现象。
Result: 对 12 个模型（从 4B 开源权重模型到前沿专有系统）的评估显示，即便最优模型成功率也低于 50%；失败分析表明，视觉精度是能力较强模型的主要瓶颈，53% 的失败源于从图像中错误提取信息而任务流程本身正确。此外，随着规模增大出现从规划到精度的转变：较小模型难以决定该做什么，较大模型则难以感知所看到的内容。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前视觉工具调用能力仍不稳健，并指出不同能力水平的模型面临本质不同的改进方向：小模型需提升决策规划，大模型需提升视觉感知精度。框架与基准已公开。

papers.title: comprisk: A scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit for competing-risks survival analysis
papers.abstract_en: Medical time-to-event data are frequently subject to competing risks, where the occurrence of one terminal event precludes the others and standard survival methods that treat competing events as censoring yield biased absolute-risk estimates. Valid analysis instead targets the cause-specific cumulative incidence function (CIF). This methodology has been available to applied researchers almost exclusively through R packages, forcing Python-based machine-learning workflows into a Python-to-R round trip. We present comprisk, a scikit-learn-compatible Python toolkit that puts the canonical competing-risks methods behind one API: a scalable competing-risks random survival forest, Fine-Gray subdistribution-hazard regression and a penalized variant, cause-specific Cox regression, the Aalen-Johansen CIF estimator, and Gray's K-sample test, together with competing-risks-aware model evaluation. Every estimator is validated numerically against its R reference implementation. The forest uses a histogram-based, numba-compiled split kernel that fits 10-22x faster than randomForestSRC at comparable discrimination on real clinical cohorts and scales to n = 10^6 on a consumer CPU. comprisk is distributed on PyPI and lets applied researchers run correct, scalable competing-risks analysis without leaving the Python scientific stack.
papers.comment: 5 pages. Software paper; package available on PyPI (pip install comprisk). Code archived on Zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.19876282
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 comprisk，一个兼容 scikit-learn 的 Python 工具包，用于竞争风险生存分析。该工具将随机生存森林、Fine-Gray 亚分布风险回归及其惩罚变体、原因别 Cox 回归、Aalen-Johansen CIF 估计和 Gray's K 样本检验整合到统一 API，并提供面向竞争风险的模型评估。摘要称所有估计器都与 R 参考实现进行了数值验证，其中直方图驱动的 numba 编译森林在真实临床队列上比 randomForestSRC 快 10-22 倍，且可在消费级 CPU 上扩展到 n=10^6。
Motivation: 医学时间-事件数据常受竞争风险影响，将竞争事件视为删失的标准生存方法会得到有偏的绝对风险估计。该方法论几乎只在 R 包中可用，迫使基于 Python 的机器学习流程进行 Python 到 R 的往返。
Method: 提出统一 API，包含大规模竞争风险随机生存森林（直方图驱动、numba 编译的分裂核）、Fine-Gray 亚分布风险回归及惩罚变体、原因别 Cox 回归、Aalen-Johansen CIF 估计和 Gray's K 样本检验，并集成竞争风险感知的模型评估；通过 PyPI 分发。
Result: 摘要报告每个估计器均与 R 参考实现进行数值验证；森林在真实临床队列上拟合速度比 randomForestSRC 快 10-22 倍且判别性能相当，并可在消费级 CPU 上扩展到 n=10^6。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 comprisk 让应用研究者无需离开 Python 科学计算栈即可进行正确、可扩展的竞争风险分析，工具包已发布在 PyPI 上。

papers.title: The Illusion of Equivalency: Statistical Characterization of Quantization Effects in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Post-Training Quantization has become widely used to compress large language models to make them deployable on resource-constrained devices. However, the evaluation of quantization methods mainly uses accuracy and perplexity, which cannot capture the behavioral changes in the quantized variants. In this work, we propose Correctness Agreement, a decision-level metric that can measure the intersection of correct predictions between the base model and its quantized variant. We use this metric across multiple models and quantization bit levels (8-bit to 2-bit), and we find that the base and quantized variants usually have a shift in behavior even when accuracy and perplexity are preserved. In order to explain this effect, we study the effect of quantization on the structure of the attention weights using statistical and distributional measures. The results reveal a breakpoint at low bit widths and show that query and key projections are more sensitive to quantization than the value and output projections. These results prove the illusion of equivalency between the base and quantized models and inspire behavioral evaluation beyond perplexity and accuracy for quantization methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出决策级指标 Correctness Agreement，用于衡量基座 LLM 与其量化变体在正确预测集合上的交集，从而刻画量化带来的行为变化。作者在多个模型和 8-bit 到 2-bit 的量化位宽下测试该指标，发现即使准确率和困惑度保持不变，基座与量化模型的行为也常发生偏移。进一步的注意力权重结构分析显示低比特位宽存在断点，且 query 与 key 投影比 value 与 output 投影对量化更敏感。
Motivation: 现有后训练量化 (Post-Training Quantization) 的评估主要依赖准确率和困惑度，无法捕捉量化模型与原始模型的行为差异，导致量化变体被误认为与原模型等价。
Method: 提出 Correctness Agreement，一种决策级指标，通过计算基座模型与其量化变体正确预测的交集来衡量行为一致性；同时采用统计和分布度量分析量化对注意力权重结构的影响。
Result: 实验发现即使在准确率和困惑度保持的情况下，量化变体与基座模型的行为仍通常发生偏移；低比特位宽下存在断点，且 query 和 key 投影对量化更敏感，而 value 与 output 投影相对稳健。
Conclusion: 结果表明基座与量化模型之间存在等价性幻觉 (illusion of equivalency)，量化方法的评估需要超越困惑度和准确率的行为级指标。

papers.title: The Dual Nature of LLM Persona: Aggregated Tendencies and Frame-Dependent Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Evaluations of LLM personas via psychometric questionnaires typically rely on aggregate scores, discarding within-instance correlation structure. We test whether this geometric structure is intrinsic or frame-dependent. Constructing within-instance correlation matrices from IPIP-50 responses, we analyze geometry on SPD manifolds under manipulated question orderings in GPT-4o simulating American and Chinese-American personas. We find that persona expression comprises two dissociable components: aggregated features (Big Five scores) degrade under randomization (21% drop) but are frame-robust; geometric features (SPD manifold) collapse under frame misalignment (42% drop) but recover substantially (to 84%) under shared frames, surpassing aggregated features (76%). This collapse-recovery pattern reveals that persona geometry is not intrinsic but a frame-dependent coordination pattern encoding information invisible to aggregation. Our findings establish a dual-nature framework for LLM personas, frame-dependent geometry versus frame-robust aggregates, necessitating frame-aware evaluation and challenging static trait conceptions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 人格评估中聚合分数与几何结构的差异。作者利用 GPT-4o 在模拟美国人和华裔美国人身份时回答 IPIP-50 问卷，通过操纵问题顺序构建实例内相关矩阵，并在 SPD 流形上分析其几何。结果显示聚合特征（Big Five 分数）对框架变化稳健，而几何特征（SPD 流形）在框架错位时大幅下降、在共享框架下恢复，说明人格几何是框架依赖的协调模式而非内在属性。
Motivation: 现有通过心理测量问卷评估 LLM 人格的方式通常只使用聚合分数，丢弃了实例内的相关结构；作者希望检验这种几何结构究竟是内在的、还是随问题框架（frame）变化而改变。
Method: 从 IPIP-50 问卷响应构造实例内相关矩阵，在 SPD 流形上分析几何；利用 GPT-4o 模拟美国人和华裔美国人身份，并在不同问题排序条件下进行对照实验。
Result: 随机化问题排序导致聚合特征（Big Five 分数）下降 21% 但仍保持框架稳健；框架错位使几何特征（SPD 流形表现）下降 42%，而在共享框架下恢复至 84%，超过聚合特征的 76%。
Conclusion: 作者提出 LLM 人格的双重本质框架：聚合倾向是框架稳健的，而几何结构是框架依赖的协调模式，编码了聚合无法捕捉的信息；这要求框架感知的评估方法，并挑战了静态人格特质的观念。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.method: 从 IPIP-50 问卷响应构造实例内相关矩阵，在 SPD 流形上分析几何；利用 GPT-4o 模拟美国人和华裔美国人身份，并在不同问题排序条件下进行对照实验。
summary_sections.result: 随机化问题排序导致聚合特征（Big Five 分数）下降 21% 但仍保持框架稳健；框架错位使几何特征（SPD 流形表现）下降 42%，而在共享框架下恢复至 84%，超过聚合特征的 76%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提出 LLM 人格的双重本质框架：聚合倾向是框架稳健的，而几何结构是框架依赖的协调模式，编码了聚合无法捕捉的信息；这要求框架感知的评估方法，并挑战了静态人格特质的观念。

papers.title: A Dual-domain Refinement Network with FBP-based Jacobian Learning for Sparse-view Dual-Energy CT Material Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Dual-energy CT (DECT) exploits attenuation differences across different X-ray spectra to provide richer material information and has been widely used in medical imaging. While sparse-view acquisition can lower radiation exposure, it makes DECT material decomposition even more challenging, as the problem is nonlinear and ill-posed. Existing deep unrolling approaches generally do not explicitly incorporate the Jacobian operator induced by the nonlinear forward model, and their sparsity priors are still mainly built on conventional convolutions, which are insufficient for modeling global structural information. This study addresses the challenge of DECT multi-material decomposition in sparse-view settings by representing it as a sparse-regularized nonlinear least-squares problem. To solve it, we propose an iterative dual-domain refinement network (DECT-DRNet). In each iteration, the filtered back-projection (FBP)-based Jacobian approximation module is used first to generate an intermediate material decomposition result. Here, we characterize the forward process of material decomposition using a nonlinear operator, and then construct a theoretically grounded learnable approximation of the adjoint Jacobian operator by integrating the FBP algorithm with a U-Net into the backward process. In addition, to address the limitation of existing deep learning-based decomposition methods in globally suppressing noise and artifacts, we introduce a learnable sparse dual domain regularization term that incorporates Fourier convolutional residual blocks. This refinement block combines geometric feature extraction in the image domain with noise suppression in the frequency domain, allowing the model to capture both global and local features while maintaining structural details. DECT-DRNet demonstrates its ability to achieve more accurate material decomposition under sparse-view conditions.
papers.comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging, 16 pages
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging, Aug. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏视角双能CT（DECT）多材料分解这一非线性且不适定的问题，将其建模为稀疏正则化的非线性最小二乘问题，并提出迭代式双域精化网络DECT-DRNet。其核心包括基于滤波反投影（FBP）的雅可比近似模块（将FBP与U-Net结合以学习非线性正演算子伴随雅可比的近似）以及引入傅里叶卷积残差块的可学习稀疏双域正则项。摘要称该方法在稀疏视角条件下能实现更准确的材料分解。
Motivation: 现有深度展开（deep unrolling）方法未显式利用非线性正演模型诱导的雅可比算子，且其稀疏先验多建立在传统卷积上，难以建模全局结构信息，导致稀疏视角DECT材料分解精度不足。
Method: 将DECT材料分解表示为稀疏正则化非线性最小二乘问题；每次迭代先用FBP-based雅可比近似模块生成中间分解结果，将材料分解正演过程表征为非线性算子并结合FBP与U-Net构造伴随雅可比的可学习近似；再引入含傅里叶卷积残差块的可学习稀疏双域正则项，在图像域提取几何特征并在频域抑制噪声，兼顾全局与局部特征。
Result: 摘要报告DECT-DRNet在稀疏视角条件下能够实现更准确的材料分解；未提供具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式引入由非线性正演模型诱导的雅可比算子并结合图像域与频域的正则化，可以有效改善稀疏视角下的DECT多材料分解性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MatMMExtract: An Open-Source Pipeline for Panel-Level Extraction of Grounded Image-Text Pairs from Materials Science Literature
papers.abstract_en: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. To enable accurate panel localisation, we introduce MaterialScope, a domain-specific detection dataset of 2,811 manually annotated materials science figures, on which a fine-tuned YOLO12-m detector achieves mAP_50 of 0.9227. Among six benchmarked language models, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite delivers the best cost-quality trade-off for annotation generation, with 82% of outputs rated good and a hallucination rate of 4.8%. A dual-encoder retrieval baseline on MatSciFig achieves a 4.4 times improvement in R@1 over zero-shot CLIP, demonstrating the dataset's immediate utility for vision-language learning. All resources are released openly to the community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MatMMExtract，一个端到端开源流水线，用于从材料科学文献中分解复合图并为子面板生成带 grounded 的图文对。基于 14,810 篇开放获取文章，作者构建了包含 391,606 个面板级图文对的 MatSciFig 数据集，并引入 MaterialScope 检测数据集与微调 YOLO12-m 实现面板定位（mAP_50 0.9227）。此外，作者比较了六个语言模型，其中 Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 在成本与质量间取得最佳平衡（82% 输出被评为好，幻觉率 4.8%），并展示了 MatSciFig 对双编码器检索基线相比零样本 CLIP 的 R@1 提升 4.4 倍。
Motivation: 材料科学文献中的图像承载大量实验知识，但大多仍无法被 AI 规模化访问。其核心困难在于大多数科学图形是复合图，一个标题同时描述多个子面板，导致直接的图文配对不可靠。
Method: 通过将复合图分解为独立子面板，并利用由材料科学分类学引导的大语言模型生成结构化、grounded 的标注。还引入 MaterialScope（2,811 张人工标注的材料科学图形检测数据集）用于面板定位，并在其上微调 YOLO12-m 检测器。
Result: 在 180,571 张图形上生成 391,606 个面板级图文对；YOLO12-m 达到 mAP_50 0.9227；Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite 的标注质量最好（82% 好，幻觉率 4.8%）；MatSciFig 上的双编码器检索基线相比零样本 CLIP 在 R@1 上提升 4.4 倍。
Conclusion: 作者强调该流水线与数据集的即时实用性，并称所有资源已向社区开放。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MeshFlow: Mesh Generation with Equivariant Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Meshes are among the most common 3D scene representations, but directly generating meshes is challenging because the representation contains important symmetries, including permutation invariance of faces and vertices. MeshFlow learns to generate triangle meshes directly as triangle soups, avoiding the need to serialize meshes into long autoregressive sequences. We adopt equivariant optimal-transport flow matching models that respect the key symmetries of triangle soups: arbitrary permutations of faces and permutations of the vertices within each face. Toward this goal, we propose a simple yet effective modification to the Diffusion Transformer architecture, resulting in a scalable network capable of modeling a velocity field while maintaining the desired equivariance. We further introduce an optimal-transport-based training objective that improves convergence by eliminating supervision signals that violate these symmetries. MeshFlow achieves mesh quality comparable to state-of-the-art autoregressive mesh generators while providing about an 18$\times$ speedup during inference. Project page is at https://qiisun.github.io/MeshFlow/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MeshFlow 提出直接用等变最优传输流匹配 (equivariant optimal-transport flow matching) 以三角形汤 (triangle soups) 形式生成三角网格，避免将网格序列化为长自回归序列。方法通过修改 Diffusion Transformer 架构来建模保持所需等变性的速度场，并引入基于最优传输的训练目标以消除违反对称性的监督信号。摘要报告其网格质量与先进自回归网格生成器相当，同时推理速度提升约 18 倍。
Motivation: 网格是常见的 3D 场景表示，但直接生成网格具有挑战性，因为表示中包含重要的对称性，包括面和顶点排列的置换不变性 (permutation invariance)。现有方法常需将网格序列化为长自回归序列，效率较低。
Method: 采用等变最优传输流匹配模型，尊重三角形汤的两类关键对称性：面的任意置换以及每个面内顶点的置换。为此对 Diffusion Transformer 架构做简单有效的修改，使其能建模速度场并保持所需的等变性；同时提出基于最优传输的训练目标，通过消除违反这些对称性的监督信号来改善收敛。
Result: 摘要报告 MeshFlow 生成的网格质量与最先进的自回归网格生成器相当，并在推理时提供约 18 倍的加速。
Conclusion: 摘要表明直接以三角形汤形式生成网格并结合等变流匹配是可扩展且高效的方案，能够兼顾网格质量与推理速度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: FeLoG: Scalable and Efficient Distributed Graph Embedding with Feedback Loop Mechanism
papers.abstract_en: Graph embedding maps graph nodes into low-dimensional vectors to support applications such as recommendation, fraud detection, and graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG). As graphs scale to billions of edges, scalable and efficient graph embedding has become increasingly important. Existing frameworks commonly adopt a sampling-training paradigm, in which mini-batches are constructed by sampling nodes and their neighbors. However, sampling is typically decoupled from evolving embedding quality, causing redundant exploration of well-trained regions while under-sampling undertrained nodes. At the system level, such decoupling further leads to excessive communication, serialized execution, and low resource utilization in distributed environments. We present FeLoG, a feedback loop-driven system for scalable distributed graph embedding. (1) FeLoG introduces feedback-coupled sampling and training, dynamically prioritizing undertrained nodes according to real-time embedding-quality feedback, thereby reducing redundant computation and accelerating convergence. (2) It employs activity-aware communication that compresses frequently occurring node sequences to reduce intra-machine PCIe traffic and selectively synchronizes frequently updated embeddings to reduce inter-machine communication. (3) It adopts a round-interleaved pipeline that overlaps next-round sampling with current-round training to improve CPU-GPU utilization. Experiments against six state-of-the-art baselines on large-scale graphs show that FeLoG achieves an average speedup of 27.9x, reduces communication cost by more than 53.1%, and sustains over 80% CPU-GPU utilization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FeLoG，一个反馈循环驱动的分布式图嵌入系统。系统引入反馈耦合的采样与训练，根据实时嵌入质量动态优先采样未训练充分的节点；还采用活动感知通信压缩节点序列、减少 PCIe 与机器间通信，并使用轮次交错流水线重叠下一轮采样与当前轮训练。实验表明，在大型图上相比六个基线平均加速 27.9 倍，通信成本降低超过 53.1%，CPU-GPU 利用率维持 80% 以上。
Motivation: 大规模图嵌入中，现有采样-训练框架的解耦采样与动态嵌入质量脱节，导致对已训练区域冗余探索、对未训练节点欠采样，并在分布式环境下引发过多通信、串行执行和低资源利用率。
Method: FeLoG 采用三类系统级技术：反馈耦合采样与训练，依据实时嵌入质量优先处理未训练充分的节点；活动感知通信，压缩频繁出现的节点序列并选择性同步高频更新的嵌入；轮次交错流水线，使下一轮采样与当前轮训练重叠以提升 CPU-GPU 利用率。
Result: 在大型图数据集上，FeLoG 相比六个最新基线平均获得 27.9 倍加速，通信成本降低超过 53.1%，并维持 80% 以上的 CPU-GPU 利用率。
Conclusion: 摘要突出反馈循环机制与系统级优化相结合能够显著提升分布式图上嵌入训练的扩展性与效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WorldLines: Benchmarking and Modeling Long-Horizon Stateful Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: To assist humans over extended periods in real homes, embodied agents must remember user routines, world states, and past interactions. Existing long-term memory benchmarks mainly evaluate language-centric retrieval and question answering, while embodied benchmarks often focus on short-horizon task execution without testing long-term memory use in dynamic environments. We introduce WorldLines, a project-driven benchmark for long-horizon embodied household assistance. It constructs temporally extended household traces with dialogues, actions, execution feedback, object and device state changes, and converts them into evidence-linked samples for Memory QA and Embodied Task Planning. We further propose ObsMem, an observer-grounded memory framework that maintains visibility-aware memories and action-native state trails for state-aware decisions. Experiments reveal persistent challenges in partial observability, overwritten world states, and translating long-term memory into embodied plans, while ObsMem offers a stronger reference architecture for this setting.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Future Dynamic 3D Reconstruction: Toward 3D World Modeling with Disentangled Ego-Motion
papers.abstract_en: Forecasting the evolution of dynamic environments is crucial for autonomous agents. While generative world models have achieved high photorealism in 2D video synthesis by mixing ego-motion and environmental dynamics within the image plane, they exhibit physical inconsistencies, such as morphing or vanishing objects, especially over long time horizons. In this paper, we propose FR3D, a world-modeling approach that predicts a persistent 3D latent representation for future dynamic 3D reconstruction. Unlike prior works that treat the world as a sequence of image-based features, FR3D explicitly decouples the 3D evolution of the scene from the agent's trajectory, treating the inferred ego-motion as a latent proxy for action. This disentanglement resolves ambiguities between self-motion and world-motion, ensuring geometric consistency into the future. Furthermore, we introduce a teacher-student distillation strategy that leverages the spatial "common sense" of off-the-shelf foundation models, leading to robust zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate FR3D's strong performance for future dynamic 3D reconstruction from monocular observations across multiple datasets, even 2 seconds into the future. Project page: https://fr3d-wm.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FR3D，一种面向未来动态三维重建的世界建模方法，从单目观测预测持久的 3D 潜在表示。FR3D 显式解耦场景的 3D 演化与智能体轨迹，将推断的 ego-motion 视为动作的潜在代理，并引入教师-学生蒸馏策略利用现成基础模型的空间常识。实验显示该方法在多个数据集上对未来 2 秒的动态三维重建表现强劲。
Motivation: 现有生成式世界模型通过混合 ego-motion 与环境动态实现高逼真的 2D 视频合成，但存在物理不一致性，如物体形变或消失，尤其在长时间跨度下。作者指出自运动与世界运动之间的歧义是导致几何不一致的关键问题，对自主智能体而言至关重要。
Method: FR3D 预测持久的 3D 潜在表示，将场景的 3D 演化与智能体轨迹显式解耦，并把推断的 ego-motion 作为动作的潜在代理以消除自运动与世界运动的歧义。此外，采用教师-学生蒸馏策略，借用现成基础模型的空间常识来获得鲁棒的零样本泛化能力。
Result: 摘要报告 FR3D 在多个数据集上从单目观测进行未来动态三维重建时表现强劲，并能泛化到 2 秒之后的未来时刻。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦 ego-motion 与场景动态可确保未来几何一致性，结合基础模型蒸馏可实现零样本泛化。未提及具体局限性。

papers.title: CogCanvas: A Benchmark for Evaluating Multi-Subject Reference-Based Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-subject reference-based image generation requires jointly preserving multiple human identities, binding per-person objects and fashion items, and respecting a specified background scene, a regime where current diffusion models remain brittle. Existing benchmarks evaluate only one axis at a time and none jointly captures multi-identity composition with human-object interaction, background grounding, and spatial plausibility. We introduce CogCanvas, a benchmark of 1,952 curated reference images spanning 100 celebrity identities, 115 distinctive objects and fashion items, and 29 real-world background scenes including landmarks, from which we construct 1,361 compositional prompts covering 2-5 person group sizes. The curation pipeline combines DINOv2-based deduplication, two-stage aesthetic filtering, and automated derivation of structured interaction and position graphs that serve as ground-truth supervision. CogCanvas supports three tasks, reference-based multi-human-object generation (primary), text-to-image compositional generation, and reference retrieval, under a unified six-axis evaluation protocol. We introduce two metrics tailored to the multi-reference setting: BG-Sim, which scores background fidelity on SAM 3-masked regions via DINOv3 feature similarity, and Attr-VQA, which uses a multimodal LLM to verify per-subject attribute binding and inter-person interactions against the structured graphs. Benchmarking five SOTA methods reveals that every model degrades substantially as group size grows from 2 to 5, with near-complete failure on object/fashion binding beyond three subjects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CogCanvas，一个面向多主体参考图像生成（multi-subject reference-based image generation）的基准，旨在同时检验多身份保持、每人绑定物体与时尚物品以及背景场景一致性。基准包含 1,952 张精选参考图、1,361 条组合提示（覆盖 2-5 人群组），并提供三个任务和统一六轴评估协议，其中引入 BG-Sim 与 Attr-VQA 两个新指标。作者对五个 SOTA 方法的评测显示，随群组规模增长模型性能显著下降，超过三人时物体/时尚绑定几乎完全失败。
Motivation: 现有基准每次只评估单一维度，无法联合刻画多身份组合、人-物交互、背景接地（background grounding）和空间合理性，而当前扩散模型在这些场景下仍然脆弱，缺少能暴露其失败的统一测试平台。
Method: 构建包含 100 个名人身份、115 个独特物体/时尚物品、29 个真实背景场景（含地标）的参考图集，通过 DINOv2 去重、两阶段美学过滤和自动推导结构化交互与位置图来生成带监督的提示集；设定参考多人物-物体生成（主任务）、文生图组合生成和参考检索三个任务，并提出 BG-Sim（基于 DINOv3 特征相似度评估 SAM 3-masked 区域背景保真度）与 Attr-VQA（用多模态 LLM 校验逐主体属性绑定和人际交互）两个指标。
Result: 摘要报告：在五个 SOTA 方法上，所有模型在群组规模从 2 人增至 5 人时均大幅退化，超过三个主体时物体/时尚绑定几乎完全失败，表明现有方法难以处理多主体组合场景。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CogCanvas 为多主体参考生成提供了首个联合覆盖身份、交互、背景和空间合理性的评测基准，其定制指标能有效暴露当前扩散模型在多主体场景下的系统性缺陷。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning to Orchestrate Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Dense Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models (VFMs) exhibit complementary strengths shaped by their pretraining objectives. Yet prevailing methods for multi-task dense prediction still train an entire backbone, either by fine-tuning it under multi-task supervision or by distilling multiple VFMs in an additional stage. We ask whether downstream learning can instead compose the frozen representations already available in foundation models. Dense tasks require composite representations that no individual expert provides alone. Realizing them is difficult: simple fusion yields only marginal gains over the best single expert, while learned routing tends to collapse toward candidates that are strong at initialization, starving newly initialized composers of training signal. We present COVE, which constructs pairwise composite candidates through Synergy Composers and routes among raw and composite candidates with a Task-Conditioned Router. To prevent this collapse, COVE combines Gaussian logit perturbation for exploration with counterfactual supervision that selectively increases under-credited routing allocations. On NYUD-v2 and PASCAL-Context, COVE matches or surpasses ViT-L-based methods on most tasks using a smaller frozen encoder pool and roughly half the computation of recent VFM-based competitors, while exceeding the best single frozen expert on every task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COVE，一种无需微调整个骨干、直接组合冻结视觉基础模型 (VFM) 表示的多任务密集预测方法。COVE 通过 Synergy Composers 构造成对复合候选，并用 Task-Conditioned Router 在原始与复合候选中路由，同时引入高斯 logit 扰动和反事实监督以避免路由塌缩。在 NYUD-v2 和 PASCAL-Context 上，COVE 在大多数任务上匹配或超越基于 ViT-L 的方法，且计算量约为近期 VFM 竞争者的一半。
Motivation: 现有多任务密集预测方法要么微调整个骨干，要么在额外阶段蒸馏多个 VFM，而本文关注能否直接组合冻结表示。简单融合收益有限，学习路由容易塌缩到初始化时较强的候选，导致新初始化的 composer 缺乏训练信号。
Method: 提出 COVE 框架：用 Synergy Composers 构造成对复合候选，由 Task-Conditioned Router 在原始与复合候选中进行路由；结合高斯 logit 扰动进行探索，并用反事实监督选择性提升被低估的路由分配，以缓解路由塌缩。
Result: 在 NYUD-v2 和 PASCAL-Context 上，COVE 使用更小的冻结编码器池，在大多数任务上匹配或超过基于 ViT-L 的方法，计算量约为近期 VFM 竞争对手的一半，并在每个任务上优于最佳单一冻结专家。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过精心设计的候选构造与路由训练，冻结 VFM 的组合表示可以替代全骨干微调，且探索与反事实监督是防止路由塌缩的关键。

papers.title: Prompt2Effect: Training-Free Image-to-Video Model Specialization via LoRA Generation
papers.abstract_en: While personalizing Image-to-Video (I2V) diffusion models with specific visual effects is increasingly demanded for high-end generation, current practice requires training a separate Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) module for each effect, incurring substantial data curation and iterative optimization costs that hinder interactive control. We present Prompt2Effect, a weight-driven hypernetwork that amortizes per-effect training by directly synthesizing effect-specific LoRA weights in a single forward pass. Unlike prior hypernetworks that regress adapter weights purely from semantics, Prompt2Effect is explicitly conditioned on the frozen base model weights, grounding prediction in the structural geometry of each layer. Furthermore, instead of predicting raw LoRA matrices, we introduce an SVD-canonicalized parameterization that resolves factorization ambiguity and stabilizes large-scale synthesis. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Prompt2Effect achieves on-par or superior video quality and effect alignment compared to conventional LoRA fine-tuning, while reducing the computational cost from 56 GPU training hours to 3.3 seconds of hypernetwork inference. When used as initialization for subsequent fine-tuning, our predicted weights further improve final performance and accelerate optimization by approximately 10x.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prompt2Effect，一种由权重驱动的超网络 (weight-driven hypernetwork)，用于图像到视频 (I2V) 扩散模型的视觉特效个性化。它通过一次前向传播直接生成效果专属的 LoRA 权重，并以冻结的基座模型权重为条件，同时引入 SVD 规范化参数化来消除分解歧义。摘要报告该方法在视频质量和效果对齐上与常规 LoRA 微调相当或更优，同时将计算成本从 56 GPU 小时降至 3.3 秒超网络推理；若作为后续微调初始化，还能提升最终性能并约加速 10 倍优化。
Motivation: 为 I2V 扩散模型添加特定视觉效果的个性化需求日益增长，但现有做法需要为每个效果单独训练 LoRA 模块，带来大量数据整理和迭代优化成本，难以支持交互式控制。
Method: 提出基于基座模型冻结权重显式条件化的超网络，直接从权重结构预测效果专属 LoRA 权重，而非仅从语义回归适配器权重；并采用 SVD 规范化的参数化方式，解决低秩分解中的因子歧义并稳定大规模权重合成。
Result: 实验表明 Prompt2Effect 在视频质量和效果对齐上达到或超过传统 LoRA 微调，训练成本从 56 GPU 小时降低到 3.3 秒推理；预测权重作为初始化时进一步改善最终性能并将优化加速约 10 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种权重驱动超网络能够摊销逐效果的 LoRA 训练开销，使 I2V 模型的特效个性化具备交互式可控性。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这种权重驱动超网络能够摊销逐效果的 LoRA 训练开销，使 I2V 模型的特效个性化具备交互式可控性。

papers.title: Crypto x AI, AI x Crypto: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: The intersection of crypto x AI is spawning papers, products, online posts, and companies. All the surrounding buzz, though, obscures what exactly has been done, what the opportunities and challenges are, and what open questions deserve attention. This survey paper asks what AI can do for blockchain-based technologies (broadly construed as "crypto") (crypto x AI), and vice versa (AI x crypto). We systematize existing work, summarize key takeaways, highlight open research questions, and offer a perspective on pervasive industry misconceptions, concluding that AI and crypto are still in the very early stages of meaningful integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于加密技术（crypto）与人工智能（AI）交叉领域的综述，分别梳理 AI 能为区块链技术做什么（crypto x AI）以及区块链能为 AI 做什么（AI x crypto）。作者系统化整理了现有工作、总结了关键结论、指出了开放研究问题，并讨论了行业中普遍存在的误解，最终认为 AI 与加密技术的实质性整合仍处于非常早期阶段。
Motivation: 围绕 crypto x AI 的热潮掩盖了该领域究竟已完成什么、存在哪些机会与挑战、哪些开放问题值得关注，因此需要一篇系统化的综述来厘清现状。
Method: 采用综述方法，从两个方向（crypto x AI 与 AI x crypto）系统化梳理已有工作，归纳关键要点，列出开放研究问题，并给出对行业普遍误解的观点。
Result: 摘要的核心结论是 AI 与加密技术尚未实现有意义的深度整合，仍处于非常早期阶段；同时指出了若干开放研究问题与行业误解。
Conclusion: 作者认为该交叉领域尚处早期，并提供了对现有工作的系统化整理与未来研究方向的视角；摘要未涉及具体实验或定量结果。

papers.title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
papers.abstract_en: There is a proliferation of work arguing for the use of synthetic data in scientific research. For example, social scientists are arguing for the use of LLM-generated "silicon samples" in pilot studies; AI evaluations increasingly rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" outputs; and proteomics research is accelerated by generative models that produce synthetic protein structures. These developments raise an intriguing possibility: synthetic data may help researchers ask more questions, run more studies, and accelerate discovery. But they also raise a fundamental concern: synthetic data can be biased, noisy, and misspecified. In this work, we propose statistical principles for using synthetic data in scientific research with provable validity guarantees. The key insight is a new technical condition that we call task exchangeability. Informally, this is a requirement that the researcher can identify historical tasks, for which real data is available, such that their current task of interest is exchangeable with the historical tasks in an appropriate mathematical sense. We develop methods for valid inference under task exchangeability, together with extensions that provide guarantees even beyond exchangeability. We demonstrate the framework on public opinion surveys with silicon samples and AI evaluation with autoraters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在科学研究中使用合成数据（如 LLM 生成的 "silicon samples"、LLM-as-a-judge 输出、生成式蛋白质结构）时保证统计推断有效性的原则。核心是引入一个新的技术条件 task exchangeability，要求研究者能找到有真实数据的历史任务，使当前任务与历史任务在数学意义下可交换。作者基于该条件发展出有效的推断方法，并扩展到可交换性不成立的情形，在公众意见调查的 silicon samples 和 AI 评估的 autoraters 上展示了框架。
Motivation: 合成数据在科学研究中日益普及，但其可能带有偏差、噪声和模型设定错误，使得基于合成数据的推断缺乏有效性保证。需要统计原则来确保使用合成数据得到的结论可信。
Method: 提出 task exchangeability 条件，即当前任务与存在真实数据的历史任务在适当数学意义下可交换；在此条件下构建有效的统计推断方法，并进一步给出超越可交换性的扩展以保证。
Result: 摘要报告框架在两类应用上得到验证：使用 silicon samples 的公众意见调查，以及使用 autoraters 的 AI 评估。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 task exchangeability 为合成数据在科学研究中的有效使用提供了可证明的保障，并指出扩展方法可在可交换性之外提供额外保证。

papers.title: From Simulation to the Real-World: An In-Field 6D Pose Dataset and Baseline for Robotic Strawberry Harvesting
authors: Yan Gu (4) ((1) Department of Agricultural and Biological Engineering
(2) Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Robotic strawberry harvesting requires precise 6D pose estimation; however, collecting 6D pose ground truth in real agricultural fields is inherently challenging. Existing strawberry 6D pose estimation studies have therefore relied mainly on synthetic data, leaving their in-field performance unquantified. In this work, we obtain ground truth indirectly, by recovering camera poses via PnP, reconstructing each scene at metric scale, and annotating a single 3D bounding box per strawberry that is propagated across all frames, yielding, to the best of our knowledge, the first real world 6D pose ground truth dataset of red-stage strawberries collected at an actual strawberry farm (12,040 images). We also introduce a synthetic dataset rendered in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, featuring scene-level realism and domainrandomization. Despite this improved simulation setup, models trained on synthetic data alone fail to transfer to in-field images, while introducing a small amount of real data improves both translation and rotation accuracy across all backbones. Under the monocular RGB setting evaluated here, rotation is largely recovered once real data is used, and depth is what limits pose accuracy. These baselines across backbone encoders serve as a reference for future work. The real-world dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/WoojungSon/F ieldStraw6D, and the data-collection pipeline is available at https://github.com/wjson2435/FieldStraw6D-pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出草莓采摘机器人领域的首个真实田间 6D 位姿真值数据集 FieldStraw6D，包含 12,040 张红熟期草莓图像，通过 PnP 恢复相机位姿、以度量尺度重建场景，并为每个草莓标注单个 3D 包围盒后传播到所有帧来间接获取真值；同时用 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 构建具备场景级真实感和域随机化的合成数据集。摘要报告仅用合成数据训练的模型无法迁移到田间图像，加入少量真实数据后各骨干网络的平移与旋转精度均提升；在单目 RGB 设置下，旋转基本可恢复，深度成为限制位姿精度的主要因素。
Motivation: 机器人草莓采摘依赖精确的 6D 位姿估计，但真实农业田间采集 6D 位姿真值非常困难，已有研究主要依赖合成数据，导致其田间性能未被量化。
Method: 通过 PnP 恢复相机位姿并重建每帧场景的度量尺度，再为每个草莓标注单个 3D 包围盒并跨帧传播，从而间接获得真实 6D 标注；此外在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中渲染合成数据集，并引入场景级真实感与域随机化。
Result: 摘要报告模型仅用合成数据训练时无法迁移到田间图像，而加入少量真实数据可提升所有骨干网络的平移和旋转精度；在单目 RGB 条件下，引入真实数据后旋转基本可恢复，深度估计是位姿精度的主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 论文给出跨骨干编码器的基线作为后续工作的参考，并公开真实世界数据集与数据采集管线；核心结论是田间真实数据对领域迁移至关重要，单目设置下深度是主要限制因素。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers from a pool of unstructured, automatically collected documents, and a Solver that improves by training on them. The solver is trained with standard correctness rewards against the generator-provided answers, while the generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score that measures whether each proposed question would actually improve the solver on the target distribution. Because this continuous, noisy influence score is poorly served by standard GRPO, we propose DuGRPO, a dual-normalized variant of GRPO, for generator training. Together, these turn the document pool into an adaptive curriculum that favors questions useful to the current solver, not just hard ones. On Qwen3-8B-Base, INFUSER outperforms strong self-evolution baselines with over 20% relative improvement on Olympiad and SuperGPQA benchmarks, and an 8B INFUSER co-evolving generator outperforms a frozen 32B thinking generator on math and coding. Ablations confirm each design choice is necessary, and two extensions, applying INFUSER to an instruction-finetuned anchor and augmenting it with rule-verifiable RLVR data, further demonstrate the flexibility and generalizability of the framework. Code is available at https://github.com/FFishy-git/INFUSER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INFUSER，一个基于影响力引导的自进化迭代协同训练框架，包含 Generator 与 Solver 两个协同演化的角色。Generator 从非结构化的自动收集文档池中出题并生成参考黄金答案，Solver 以标准正确性奖励在这些数据上训练；Generator 则依据一个优化器感知的影响力分数（influence score）获得奖励，该分数衡量每个题目是否真能改进 Solver 在目标分布上的表现。为适配这种连续且有噪声的奖励，作者提出 GRPO 的双归一化变体 DuGRPO 来训练 Generator。在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，INFUSER 在 Olympiad 和 SuperGPQA 基准上相对强自进化基线取得超过 20% 的提升，8B 的协同进化 Generator 在数学和代码任务上优于冻结的 32B thinking Generator。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法要么依赖大规模人工精选或教师生成的数据，要么在无监督生成时用难度启发式作为奖励，而这种难度信号并不必然带来求解能力的提升。论文希望用极少量外部监督，通过自动收集的文档池实现可扩展的推理能力自进化。
Method: 提出基于两个角色迭代协同训练的框架：Generator 从自动收集的文档池生成问题和参考答案，Solver 以标准正确性奖励在这些数据上训练；Generator 的奖励改为优化器感知的影响力分数，评估题目对 Solver 在目标分布上的实际增益。针对该连续、有噪声的奖励，提出双归一化 GRPO 变体 DuGRPO 用于 Generator 训练，使文档池转化为偏向当前 Solver 有用题目的自适应课程。
Result: 在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，INFUSER 在 Olympiad 和 SuperGPQA 基准上相对强自进化基线实现超过 20% 的相对提升；8B 的协同进化 Generator 在数学和代码任务上超过冻结的 32B thinking Generator。消融实验确认各设计选择均必要，两个扩展实验（应用于指令微调锚点模型、加入规则可验证的 RLVR 数据）展示了框架的灵活性与泛化性。
Conclusion: 作者的核心观点是，用影响力而不是难度来引导生成数据，可以把自动收集的文档池转化为对当前求解器有用的自适应课程，从而仅凭少量外部监督实现更强的推理自进化。消融实验支持每个模块的贡献，扩展实验说明该方法不局限于基础模型，也能与指令微调及规则可验证数据结合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PROBE-Web: An Interactive System for Probing Evaluation Landscapes of Knowledge Graph Completion Models
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge graph completion (KGC) models are commonly evaluated using rank-based metrics such as MRR and Hits@K, despite different users often requiring different evaluation perspectives. In this demo, we present PROBE-Web, an interactive system for probing diverse evaluation landscapes for KGC models. PROBE-Web enables users to flexibly evaluate KGC models by adjusting two critical perspectives: (P1) predictive sharpness and (P2) popularity-bias robustness. Through a user-friendly GUI, users easily evaluate multiple KGC models and analyze their strengths and weaknesses. PROBE-Web provides four key functionalities: (1) conventional evaluation toolkit, (2) flexible perspective-aware evaluation, (3) explainable case studies, and (4) evaluation landscape exploration. We believe that PROBE-Web can help users better understand KGC models aligning with their objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 PROBE-Web，一个用于探测知识图谱补全（KGC）模型评估景观的交互式演示系统。用户可通过图形界面调整两个关键视角：预测尖锐度（predictive sharpness）和流行度偏差鲁棒性（popularity-bias robustness），从而灵活评估多个 KGC 模型并分析其优缺点。系统提供四类功能：常规评估工具包、灵活的视角感知评估、可解释案例研究和评估景观探索。
Motivation: 现有 KGC 模型通常只用 MRR、Hits@K 等基于排序的指标评估，但不同用户往往需要不同的评估视角，现有工具难以支持这种灵活且可解释的多视角评估。
Method: PROBE-Web 提供用户友好的 GUI，让用户通过调整 (P1) 预测尖锐度和 (P2) 流行度偏差鲁棒性两个视角来评估多个 KGC 模型；系统集成了常规评估工具包、视角感知评估、可解释案例研究以及评估景观探索四项核心功能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 PROBE-Web 能帮助用户结合自身目标更好地理解 KGC 模型；本文是 CIKM 2026 的演示论文，展示系统设计而非具体实验结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Wasserstein Exponential Smoothing for Distributional Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Distributional time series arise when each temporal observation is a probability distribution rather than a scalar. We propose Wasserstein exponential smoothing (WES), a one-parameter recursive forecasting method for distributional time series on $\mathbb{R}$. The method adapts the practical logic of classical exponential smoothing to probability distributions by updating forecast distributions along Wasserstein geodesics. This yields a simple filter that can be applied directly to empirical distributions without parametric density modeling. We estimate the smoothing parameter by minimizing an in-sample Wasserstein prediction loss and establish consistency under a distributional local-level data-generating process. In applications to high-frequency equity-index return distributions and household electricity-demand distributions, WES attains the lowest one-step-ahead Wasserstein prediction error among existing distributional autoregressive and regression-based benchmarks for all $20$ series considered, and is retained in the $90\%$ model confidence set in every case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Wasserstein 指数平滑 (WES)，一种用于实数轴上分布时间序列的单参数递归预测方法。该方法将经典指数平滑的逻辑沿 Wasserstein 测地线推广到概率分布，可直接应用于经验分布而无需参数化密度建模。作者证明了在分布局部水平数据生成过程下平滑参数估计的一致性，并在高频股指收益分布与家庭电力需求分布上验证了方法性能。
Motivation: 分布时间序列中每个时间观测都是一个概率分布而非标量，现有方法往往依赖参数化密度模型或复杂的回归框架，缺少简单、可递归更新且无需分布假设的预测手段。
Method: 提出 WES，通过沿 Wasserstein 测地线更新预测分布来递归预测下一时刻分布；平滑参数通过最小化样本内 Wasserstein 预测损失估计，并在分布局部水平数据生成过程下建立一致性。
Result: 在高频股指收益分布和家庭电力需求分布两类应用中，WES 在全部 20 个序列上取得最低的一步前 Wasserstein 预测误差，优于现有的分布自回归与基于回归的基准方法，并且在每种情况下都保留在 90% 模型置信集 (model confidence set) 中。
Conclusion: 作者认为 WES 提供了一种简单、无需参数化密度建模的分布时间序列过滤与预测工具，并具备理论一致性保证；其经验优势体现在所考察的金融与电力需求序列上。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Marginally Useful: An Information-Gap Identity in Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction has been touted as a more formal, rigorous approach to adding uncertainty to a forecast. The sole objective of this note is to point out that rigor cuts both ways in the case of residual pooling, the technique used in the vast majority of conformal prediction applications. The fact that unconditional guarantee of coverage is provided is not in question, but we make clear, we believe for the first time, that there is an opposing guarantee too: a permanent gambit of logarithmic-score regret which no amount of data or tuning can subsequently reduce. We give the exact size of the sacrifice, and a financial reading of it as the growth rate of an oracle adversary betting against odds set by someone using residual pooling.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 7 figures. Interactive demonstrations and code at https://conformalprediction.net
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇理论性短论，针对 conformal prediction 中最常用的残差池化 (residual pooling) 技术提出批判性分析。作者指出，在无条件覆盖 (unconditional coverage) 保证之外，残差池化还伴随一个相反的保证：一个无法通过更多数据或调参消除的永久性 logarithmic-score regret。论文给出了该损失的精确大小，并将其解释为一位 oracle 对手在针对残差池化使用者所设赔率下注时的增长率。
Motivation: 现有文献常把 conformal prediction 描述为给预测添加不确定性的更严格、更正式的方法，但作者认为严谨性是有代价的，尤其是在广泛使用的残差池化场景中。本文旨在首次明确指出：无条件覆盖保证的另一面是必然存在的评分损失，这一权衡此前未被阐明。
Method: 论文采用一个信息缺口恒等式 (information-gap identity) 作为理论工具，对残差池化下的预测评估进行分析，推导出 logarithmic-score regret 的精确表达式，并给出其金融学解读，即一个 oracle 对手针对残差池化使用者设定的赔率进行下注时的增长率。
Result: 摘要报告，残差池化虽然能提供无条件覆盖保证，但同时也带有一种永久性的 logarithmic-score regret，其大小可被精确刻画；任何数量的数据或调参都无法减少这一损失。作者将该损失的规模量化为 oracle 对手的增长率。
Conclusion: 作者强调，在追求 conformal prediction 的覆盖保证时不应忽视其对应的信息论代价；残差池化在边际意义上存在不可消除的评分损失。本文属于概念性短论，并配有交互式演示与代码。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Audio Interaction Model
papers.abstract_en: Audio is continuous and interactive, yet most Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) remain offline and streaming systems usually specialize in ASR or spoken dialogue. We formalize the Audio Interaction Model, an always-on perceive--decide--respond paradigm that tracks context, decides whether intervention is warranted, and responds without stopping listening. We instantiate it with Audio-Interaction and introduce SoundFlow, coupling streaming-native data construction, comprehension-aware silence/response supervision, dual-loss training, and asynchronous FIFO inference. We also construct textsc{StreamAudio-2M, a 2.6M-item, 302k-hour corpus spanning 7 capability families and 28 sub-tasks, together with Proactive-Sound-Bench. Across 8 benchmarks, Audio-Interaction remains competitive on mainstream audio tasks while enabling spoken-instruction robustness, long-stream interaction, and proactive intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Audio Interaction Model 范式，把大型音频语言模型（LALM）重新定义为始终在线（always-on）的感知-决策-回应（perceive–decide–respond）系统，在持续聆听的同时判断是否需要干预并作出响应。作者用 Audio-Interaction 模型实例化该范式，并引入 SoundFlow 框架，包含流式原生数据构建、理解感知的静默/响应监督、双损失训练与异步 FIFO 推理；还构建了 2.6M 条目、302k 小时的 StreamAudio-2M 语料以及 Proactive-Sound-Bench 基准。在 8 个基准上，Audio-Interaction 在主流音频任务上保持竞争力，同时支持口语指令鲁棒性、长流交互与主动干预。
Motivation: 现有 LALM 大多是离线系统，而流式系统通常只专攻 ASR 或口语对话；音频本身是连续且交互式的，需要能够边听边判断何时干预、何时回应的在线交互机制。
Method: 形式化始终在线的 perceive–decide–respond 交互范式，并以 Audio-Interaction 模型实现；配套 SoundFlow 框架结合流式原生数据构建、理解感知的静默/响应监督、双损失训练和异步 FIFO 推理。作者还构建 StreamAudio-2M 语料（覆盖 7 个能力族、28 个子任务）与 Proactive-Sound-Bench 基准。
Result: 在 8 个基准上，Audio-Interaction 在主流音频任务上保持竞争力，并实现口语指令鲁棒性、长流交互与主动干预能力。
Conclusion: 摘要将这一工作定位为下一代 LALM（next generation of LALMs），强调音频模型应从离线或任务专用的流式系统转向支持连续交互与主动决策的通用框架。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Adaptive Inference for Resource-Constrained Dynamic Pricing
papers.abstract_en: We study resource-constrained dynamic pricing when the seller seeks revenue and valid inference about demand at a price fixed before the selling season. Depletion can remove every feasible price near the target, so randomization over the remaining prices need not preserve identification. We propose an inference-aware re-solving policy that checks target support before observing the current covariates and implements the fluid target load with a logged pricing mixture. In an affine binding-capacity family, target mass $t^{-γ}$ yields information $T^{1-γ}$, interval radius $T^{-(1-γ)/2}$, and regret $O(\log T+T^{1-γ})$ against the initial fluid optimum. In the same affine family, learned barycentric re-solving retains a target-local component of constant mass and, with polynomial error spending of exponent greater than one, achieves a linear information clock and $O(\log T)$ regret; slack-capacity local pricing gives the same orders. An exact-input smooth-frontier extension gives root-$T$ inference and $O(\log^2T)$ regret. Physical exclusion rules out uniformly shrinking intervals, while target mass of order $1/t$ alone yields bounded information. The policy reports an interval only after its prespecified support and information checks pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究资源受限的动态定价问题，卖家在销售季前固定价格，并在追求收益的同时希望对该价格下的需求做出有效推断。作者提出一种推断感知的重求解策略（inference-aware re-solving policy），在观察协变量前检查目标价格是否仍在可行集合内，并用记录的价格混合（logged pricing mixture）实现流体目标加载。在仿射约束容量族中，论文刻画了目标质量、信息量、置信区间半径与遗憾之间的权衡关系。
Motivation: 库存耗尽可能使目标价格附近的所有可行价格被移除，此时仅对剩余价格随机化未必能保持识别性（identification），因此卖家无法在追求收益的同时获得目标价格处的有效推断。
Method: 提出推断感知的重求解策略：先检查目标价格支撑，再观察当前协变量，并通过记录的价格混合实现流体目标加载。论文在仿射约束容量族中分析该策略，并进一步给出学习到的重心重求解（learned barycentric re-solving）以及精确输入的光滑前沿（smooth-frontier）扩展版本。
Result: 摘要报告：目标质量 t^{-γ} 对应信息量 T^{1-γ}、区间半径 T^{-(1-γ)/2} 和遗憾 O(log T + T^{1-γ})；学习到的重心重求解在多项式误差支出（指数大于 1）下实现线性信息时钟和 O(log T) 遗憾；精确输入的光滑前沿扩展给出根号 T 推断和 O(log^2 T) 遗憾。物理排除规则排除了均匀收缩区间，仅 1/t 量级的目标质量给出有界信息。
Conclusion: 策略只在预设的支撑检查和信息检查通过后才报告置信区间；整体上，论文刻画了资源受限动态定价中收益与推断精度之间可达到的权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values often degrades their general capabilities, termed the alignment tax. Existing methods mitigate this by balancing dual objectives, which heavily rely on massive general-purpose data or auxiliary reward models. In this paper, we argue that, because safety features are inherently sparse within the output distribution, alignment requires localized modifications rather than global trade-offs. To this end, we propose SafeSteer, which performs on-policy distillation confined to safety tokens. First, we construct a safety teacher via activation steering. Based on this teacher, we develop a safety token selection algorithm. Consequently, SafeSteer restricts the reverse KL penalty to these tokens during training to preserve general capabilities. Experimental results across diverse models show that our SafeSteer achieves a superior trade-off between safety and general capability compared with existing methods, attaining strong safety performance on seven safety benchmarks with only minimal degradation on five general capability benchmarks. Notably, SafeSteer requires only 100 harmful samples without using any general-purpose data, less than 1% of what previous baselines used, considerably reducing alignment cost. More details are on our project page at https://anjingkun.github.io/SafeSteer.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeSteer，一种面向大语言模型安全对齐的局部化 on-policy 蒸馏方法。其核心思路是安全特征在输出分布中稀疏，因此只需对安全 token 施加反向 KL 惩罚，而非做全局权衡。基于激活编辑 (activation steering) 构建安全教师，再设计安全 token 选择算法，仅在训练时约束这些 token。实验显示在七个安全基准上取得强安全性能，同时仅轻微损失五个通用能力基准上的表现，且只需 100 个有害样本、不使用通用数据，对齐成本显著低于基线。
Motivation: 对齐大语言模型时通常产生对齐税 (alignment tax)，即通用能力下降；现有方法通过平衡双目标缓解，但依赖大量通用数据或辅助奖励模型。作者论证安全特征在输出分布中天然稀疏，因此对齐应做局部修改而非全局权衡。
Method: 先通过激活编辑构造安全教师 (safety teacher)，再基于该教师设计安全 token 选择算法；训练时将反向 KL 惩罚限制在安全 token 上，以保留通用能力。
Result: 在多种模型上的实验表明，SafeSteer 相比现有方法取得更好的安全性与通用能力权衡：在七个安全基准上表现强，在五个通用能力基准上仅有极小下降；仅需 100 个有害样本且不使用任何通用数据，数据量不到此前基线的 1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为将 on-policy 蒸馏局部化到安全 token 可以在明显降低对齐成本的同时保持通用能力，支持了安全对齐无需全局权衡的观点。

papers.title: Towards Automated Discovery: A Review of Generative Models, Multimodal Learning and Closed-Loop Workflows in Inverse Materials Design
papers.abstract_en: Inverse materials design is shifting materials discovery from forward prediction toward targeted proposal of candidates that satisfy objectives under physical constraints. Here, we review advances in generative crystal structure modeling, multimodal learning, and closed-loop design pipelines for crystalline solids. We survey how generators learn chemical-structural priors from databases to enable controllable sampling of periodic structures, comparing variational autoencoders, normalizing flows, autoregressive models, and diffusion models. Across these families, we examine where feasibility constraints and physical priors enter, from representations and training objectives to sampling-time guidance, screening, and relaxation. We also discuss multimodal learning combining crystal structures, thermodynamic and electronic information, microscopy, spectroscopy, processing context, and scientific text to construct materials representations. Inverse-design strategies integrating conditional generation with latent optimization, Bayesian optimization, reinforcement learning, and active learning are also examined. We highlight recurring failure modes, including surrogate exploitation, diversity collapse, distribution shift, and the stability-synthesizability gap, and outline evaluation based on validity, novelty, uniqueness, stability, and cost. To support credible claims, we define a nine-rung discovery-credibility ladder and propose a minimum reporting standard: declared matching tolerances and database snapshots; separate reporting of uniqueness, training-set memorization, and external rediscovery; novelty as a continuous distance distribution; energy-above-hull distributions with functional and hull version; relaxation-survival and dynamical stability rates; and validation cost per credible hit. Headline validity or S.U.N. rates without these disclosures should be treated as uninformative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于逆材料设计（inverse materials design）的综述，回顾生成晶体结构建模、多模态学习以及闭环设计流水线的最新进展。作者比较了变分自编码器、normalizing flows、自回归模型和扩散模型等生成模型，讨论可行性约束与物理先验从表示、训练目标到采样引导、筛选和弛豫等各环节的引入方式。综述还提出一个九级发现可信度阶梯和最低报告标准，并主张缺少必要披露的 S.U.N. 指标应被视为无信息。
Motivation: 逆材料设计正从正向预测转向在物理约束下定向提出候选材料，但生成模型的结果评估与报告方式缺乏统一标准，导致可信度存疑。
Method: 作为综述，系统梳理生成晶体结构模型家族，考察其如何从数据库学习化学-结构先验以控制周期结构采样；并涵盖融合晶体结构、热力学、电子信息、显微、光谱、加工背景和科学文本的多模态学习，以及条件生成与潜在优化、贝叶斯优化、强化学习、主动学习结合的逆向设计策略。
Result: 文章总结常见失效模式，包括代理模型被利用（surrogate exploitation）、多样性崩溃、分布漂移和稳定性-可合成性差距；并提出最低报告标准，如声明匹配容差与数据库快照、分别报告唯一性/训练集记忆/外部再发现、以连续距离分布表达新颖性、给出能量-凸包分布及弛豫存活率和动力学稳定性等。
Conclusion: 作者认为，未披露上述细节的头条有效性或 S.U.N. 指标应视为无信息；需要更严格、更透明的报告标准来支撑可信的材料发现声明。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: Reason-Then-Retrieve for CoVR-R with Structured Edit Prompts and Dense-Sparse Fusion
papers.abstract_en: CoVR-R studies reason-aware composed video retrieval: given a reference video and an edit instruction, the system must retrieve the target video that satisfies the edit. The main difficulty is that the target is not described directly; it must be inferred from fine-grained changes in object identity, action order, final state, hand interaction, and scene transition. We build a zero-shot reason-then-retrieve pipeline around Qwen3.5-27B. For each gallery video, the model generates a retrieval-oriented structured description and a dense embedding by pooling generated-token hidden states with token-dependent weights. For each query, the model first performs edit reasoning over the reference video and instruction, then generates a target-video description whose hidden states serve as the query embedding. We complement dense retrieval with a TF-IDF branch over the generated texts and fuse the two rankings with split-specific weights. On validation, the current best submission reaches 80.81 at R@1, 94.86 at R@5, 97.11 at R@10, and 98.59 at R@50. On the blind test split, it reaches 89.73 at R@1, 95.79 at R@5, 96.63 at R@10, and 97.98 at R@50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 CoVR-R 任务（reason-aware composed video retrieval），提出一个基于 Qwen3.5-27B 的零样本 reason-then-retrieve 流水线：对每个候选视频生成检索导向的结构化描述与稠密 embedding，对查询先做编辑推理再生成目标视频描述作为查询 embedding，并用 TF-IDF 分支与稠密检索融合排序。验证集上 R@1 达到 80.81，盲测集上 R@1 达到 89.73。
Motivation: CoVR-R 的难点在于目标视频不是被直接描述的，而需要从参考视频与编辑指令中推断出对象身份、动作顺序、最终状态、手部交互和场景转换等细粒度变化。
Method: 方法包含两个阶段：针对候选库视频，模型生成检索导向的结构化描述，并通过按 token 权重池化生成 token 的隐藏状态得到稠密 embedding；针对查询，模型先对参考视频和指令进行编辑推理，再生成目标视频描述，其隐藏状态作为查询 embedding。稠密检索与基于生成文本的 TF-IDF 分支按 split 特定权重融合排序。
Result: 当前最佳提交在验证集上达到 R@1 80.81、R@5 94.86、R@10 97.11、R@50 98.59；在盲测集上达到 R@1 89.73、R@5 95.79、R@10 96.63、R@50 97.98。
Conclusion: 摘要显示，将生成式描述与稠密/稀疏检索融合的零样本流水线能在 CoVR-R 上取得较高检索精度。

papers.title: Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science: A Categorical Framework for Agentic Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Scientific discovery is not only answer generation but revision of the representational regime in which evidence, artifacts, operations, and verifiers are typed. We develop a category-theoretic account of agentic discovery for materials science. In a fixed regime b with schema category S_b, the system state is a copresheaf I_t: S_b -> Set, and provenance is the category of elements \int_{S_b} I_t. Fixed-regime operation is an update on such states, endofunctorial only when provenance-preserving refinements are specified and preserved. Discovery is instead a verified regime transition u: S_b -> S_b': old artifacts are preserved, transported by the left Kan extension Lan_u I_t, and compared with the post-transition state to identify residual content beyond functorial transport. This separates retrieval, search, and discovery without subjective novelty. We instantiate the framework in two systems. In Builder/Breaker, a protein-mechanics world model is revised under a Minimum Description Length gate; the accepted law expresses within-chain flexibility as all-mode elastic compliance conditioned by slow collective-mode participation, or mode-conditioned compliance. In CategoryScienceClaw, typed skills, artifacts, open needs, workflow mutation, gates, stress tests, and public discourse become a proof-carrying knowledge-computation graph. A fiber-network example records candidate models, rejected alternatives, an AIC gate, perturbation tests, and an accepted orientation-tensor anisotropic stiffness surrogate over an isotropic fiber-count descriptor. Together, the cases show how category theory can be both a mathematical language for discovery and an engineering specification for self-revising AI discovery systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于范畴论（category theory）的框架，将科学发现建模为可验证的表征体系（representational regime）更替，而不仅仅是答案生成。系统状态被形式化为 copresheaf，固定体系内的操作是保持 provenance 的更新，跨体系的发现则由 left Kan extension 传输旧产物并与新状态比较。作者在材料科学中实现了 Builder/Breaker 和 CategoryScienceClaw 两个系统，展示该框架既可作为发现的数学语言，也可作为自修正 AI 发现系统的工程规范。
Motivation: 现有科学发现 AI 多关注答案生成，而真正重要的在于修订证据、人工制品、操作和验证器所依赖的整个表征体系；同时检索、搜索与发现缺乏客观的形式化区分。
Method: 在固定 schema 范畴 S_b 上，将系统状态定义为 copresheaf I_t: S_b -> Set，并用元素范畴刻画 provenance；固定体系的更新在保留 provenance 的精化下是 endofunctorial 的。发现则定义为经过验证的体系更替 u: S_b -> S_b'，旧产物通过 left Kan extension Lan_u I_t 被保持和搬运，再与更替后状态比较以识别超出函子搬运的残余内容。
Result: Builder/Breaker 在 Minimum Description Length 门控下修正蛋白力学世界模型，接受定律将以全模态弹性柔度表达链内柔性并受慢集体模式参与条件化；CategoryScienceClaw 将类型化技能、人工制品、开放需求、工作流突变、门控、压力测试和公共讨论组织为 proof-carrying 知识计算图，纤维网络示例记录了候选模型、被拒备选、AIC 门控、扰动测试及最终接受的各向异性刚度代理模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作表明范畴论既能作为发现的数学语言，也能作为自修正 AI 发现系统的工程规范；示例集中在材料科学与蛋白力学领域。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Looks Right, Works Right: A Project-Level Benchmark for Multi-Screen Mobile App Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models can convert visual designs directly into executable code, but real mobile products require multiple screenshots to become a buildable codebase with shared components and working navigation. This project-level setting exposes three limits of existing design-to-code benchmarks: they focus on single-page generation rather than complete codebases, cannot evaluate cross-page navigation, and do not measure project-wide maintainability. We introduce MobileForge, the first benchmark for project-level multi-screen mobile app generation, comprising real mobile apps, human-reviewed screens, structured page-relationship annotations, and navigation test specifications. MobileForge supports five-axis evaluation of build, navigation, visual fidelity, code maintainability, and efficiency. We also propose state-isolated navigation testing to avoid cascading failures in navigation evaluation and an anchor-referenced list-wise visual evaluation protocol to improve visual-judge reliability. Across end-to-end runs on six frontier multimodal LLMs, current models can build mobile-app projects that compile and reach the correct pages, but interactive navigation remains unreliable and visual fidelity and maintainability still lag. The benchmark and supporting materials are available at https://github.com/anoa12159-hue/mobileforge_eval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MobileForge，据称是第一个面向项目级多屏移动应用生成的基准，针对现有设计到代码（design-to-code）基准只做单页生成、无法评估跨页导航和项目级可维护性的问题。基准包含真实移动应用、人工审核的屏幕、结构化页面关系标注和导航测试规范，并支持构建、导航、视觉保真度、代码可维护性和效率五个维度的评估。作者还提出状态隔离的导航测试和锚点参照的列表式视觉评估协议。在六个前沿多模态大语言模型上的端到端运行显示，模型能构建可编译并到达正确页面的项目，但交互式导航仍不可靠，视觉保真度和可维护性也落后。
Motivation: 真实移动产品需要多张截图转化为可构建的代码库并包含共享组件和可用导航，而现有设计到代码基准局限于单页生成，既不能评估跨页导航，也不衡量项目级可维护性。
Method: 构建 MobileForge 基准，包含真实移动应用、人工审核屏幕、页面关系标注和导航测试规范；提出状态隔离的导航测试以避免级联失败，以及锚点参照的列表式视觉评估协议来提高视觉评判可靠性，并设计五轴评估体系。
Result: 在六个前沿多模态 LLM 的端到端评估中，现有模型可以生成能编译并导航到正确页面的移动应用项目，但交互式导航仍然不可靠，视觉保真度和代码可维护性表现滞后。
Conclusion: 摘要指出项目级多屏移动应用生成仍需改进交互导航、视觉保真度和可维护性，并公开了基准与支持材料。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 MobileForge，据称是第一个面向项目级多屏移动应用生成的基准，针对现有设计到代码（design-to-code）基准只做单页生成、无法评估跨页导航和项目级可维护性的问题。基准包含真实移动应用、人工审核的屏幕、结构化页面关系标注和导航测试规范，并支持构建、导航、视觉保真度、代码可维护性和效率五个维度的评估。作者还提出状态隔离的导航测试和锚点参照的列表式视觉评估协议。在六个前沿多模态大语言模型上的端到端运行显示，模型能构建可编译并到达正确页面的项目，但交互式导航仍不可靠，视觉保真度和可维护性也落后。

papers.title: Weak Critics Make Strong Learners: On-Policy Critique Distillation for Scalable Oversight
papers.abstract_en: As large language models become stronger, weak supervisors may fail to provide reliable labels, preferences, or final judgments for complex outputs, limiting both weak-to-strong generalization and scalable oversight. We study a more tractable form of weak supervision: using a weak model as a critic rather than as a labeler or judge. Instead of solving the task or selecting the correct answer, the weak critic only needs to provide a non-misleading revision direction that helps the strong model better use its own knowledge. We call this setting *weak-critic strong oversight*. We first show that weak critiques can improve frozen strong models at inference time, and that critique quality is key to this improvement. We then propose progressive on-policy critique distillation (**OPCD**), which filters high-quality critiques and distills critic-guided behavior into the strong model through adaptive self-teacher signals. Experiments on reasoning and alignment benchmarks show that our method improves strong models over training epochs, suggesting an effective path for scalable oversight with weak supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型中的弱监督与可扩展监督问题，提出"弱批评者-强监督"(weak-critic strong oversight) 设置：弱模型不作为标注者或裁判，而只提供非误导的修订方向，帮助强模型更好地利用自身知识。作者提出渐进式在策略批评蒸馏 (OPCD)，通过过滤高质量批评并用自适应自教师信号将批评引导的行为蒸馏进强模型。在推理与对齐基准上的实验显示该方法能跨训练轮次改进强模型。
Motivation: 当大语言模型变得更强时，弱监督者可能无法为复杂输出提供可靠标签、偏好或最终判断，这限制了弱到强泛化 (weak-to-strong generalization) 与可扩展监督 (scalable oversight)。本文试图寻找一种更易处理的弱监督形式，即让弱模型只提供修订方向而非直接求解任务。
Method: 提出"弱批评者-强监督"框架，弱批评者只需给出非误导的批评或修订方向；在此基础上提出渐进式在策略批评蒸馏 (OPCD)，筛选高质量批评，并通过自适应自教师信号将批评引导的行为蒸馏进强模型。
Result: 摘要报告弱批评可以在推理时改进冻结的强模型，且批评质量是关键因素；在推理与对齐基准上的实验表明该方法能随训练轮次持续改进强模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为使用弱监督实现可扩展监督提供了一条有效路径。

papers.title: Chatterbox-Flash: Prior-Calibrated Block Diffusion for Streaming Zero-Shot TTS
papers.abstract_en: We present Chatterbox-Flash, a zero-shot text-to-speech model obtained by fine-tuning a pretrained autoregressive TTS decoder into a block-diffusion decoder, enabling parallel token generation within each block while retaining block-by-block streaming. We find that naively transferring mainstream block-diffusion decoding to discrete speech tokens degrades quality, as a long-tail token distribution biases parallel position selection toward a few high-frequency tokens. To mitigate this without architectural modification, we introduce two inference-time techniques: prior-calibrated scoring, which subtracts the block-level marginal token distribution, and an early-decoding schedule, which adaptively terminates iteration based on calibrated confidence. On standard zero-shot TTS benchmarks, Chatterbox-Flash attains high-fidelity synthesis comparable to strong autoregressive and non-autoregressive baselines, while supporting streaming inference with time-to-first-packet on par with streaming AR systems and substantially lower real-time factor. Code and audio samples are available at https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox-flash.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chatterbox-Flash，一种通过对预训练自回归 TTS 解码器进行微调、将其转换为块扩散解码器（block-diffusion decoder）的零样本语音合成模型，在保持逐块流式生成的同时实现块内并行 token 生成。作者发现直接将主流块扩散解码迁移到离散语音 token 会因长尾 token 分布导致质量下降，因此提出两种推理时技术：先验校准评分（prior-calibrated scoring）和早期解码调度（early-decoding schedule）。在标准零样本 TTS 基准上，该模型达到与强自回归和非自回归基线相当的高保真合成质量，并支持流式推理。
Motivation: 现有零样本 TTS 模型在流式推理与并行生成之间存在权衡，将块扩散解码应用于离散语音 token 时，长尾 token 分布会使并行位置选择偏向少数高频 token，导致合成质量下降。
Method: 在预训练自回归 TTS 解码器上微调得到块扩散解码器，实现块内并行、块间流式生成；并引入两种无需修改架构的推理时技术：基于块级边际 token 分布减除的先验校准评分，以及根据校准置信度自适应终止迭代的早期解码调度。
Result: 在标准零样本 TTS 基准上，Chatterbox-Flash 达到与强自回归和非自回归基线相当的高保真合成质量；其流式推理的首包时间（time-to-first-packet）与流式自回归系统相当，实时因子（real-time factor）显著更低。
Conclusion: 作者表明结合先验校准与早期解码调度可以有效缓解块扩散解码在离散语音 token 上的质量退化，为并行流式零样本 TTS 提供可行方案。

papers.title: GRASP: Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer for Self-Improving LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents acting in structured environments fail in operational rather than conversational ways, and reliability depends on procedural knowledge of the environment. Prior self-improvement methods accumulate natural-language guidance without checking that each new item preserves previously correct behavior, so a note that fixes one trajectory can silently regress another. We introduce GRASP (Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer), which treats agent improvement as a sequence of edits to a bounded skill library, admitting each candidate only if it produces a net improvement on a balanced held-out probe under a hard regression budget. We evaluate GRASP across five base models on two FHIR-based clinical benchmarks, which score procedural reliability against FHIR state rather than clinical correctness or patient outcomes. On MedAgentBench, GRASP lifts gpt-oss-120b from 40.6% to 88.8%, exceeds the strongest of five self-improvement baselines by 21.0 points, and improves every other base model by 17.2 to 40.3 points. Ablations attribute the gain to comparative proposal generation, the acceptance gate, and the hard regression budget rather than to skill writing itself, which without validation is no better than using no skills. Granting the same acceptance gate to all five baselines lifts each of them in-domain and none of them out of distribution, isolating the gain to the gate applied to a bounded, editable library rather than to held-out validation itself. The mechanism helps in non-clinical environments where tasks recur with verifiable structure and is flat where the action space is open-ended. Frozen libraries transfer across models and across benchmarks that share a tool-calling convention and degrade under interface mismatch.
papers.comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). Code and data: https://github.com/jomoll/GRASP
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRASP（Gated Regression-Aware Skill Proposer），把 LLM 智能体的自我改进建模为对受限技能库（bounded skill library）的序列编辑，只有通过平衡留出探针（balanced held-out probe）且满足硬回归预算（hard regression budget）的候选技能才被接纳。作者在五个基础模型和两个基于 FHIR 的临床基准上评估，称在 MedAgentBench 上把 gpt-oss-120b 从 40.6% 提升到 88.8%，并超过最强自改进基线 21.0 个百分点。消融显示收益来自比较式候选生成、接纳门控和硬回归预算，而非技能写作本身。
Motivation: 现有自改进方法不断累积自然语言指导，却不检查每条新内容是否破坏先前正确行为，导致修复一条轨迹可能静默回归另一条。在结构化环境中，LLM 智能体的失败往往源于操作层而非对话层，可靠性取决于对环境的程序性知识。
Method: GRASP 将智能体改进视为对受限可编辑技能库的一系列编辑，通过比较式候选生成（comparative proposal generation）提出新技能，并设置接纳门控，要求候选在平衡留出探针上带来净改进且不超过硬性回归预算。
Result: 在 MedAgentBench 上 GRASP 将 gpt-oss-120b 从 40.6% 升至 88.8%，比五个自改进基线中最强者高 21.0 个百分点，其他基础模型的提升范围为 17.2 到 40.3 个百分点；消融表明增益归因于比较式候选生成、接纳门控和硬回归预算，而未经验证的技能写作并不优于不使用技能。
Conclusion: 作者强调增益来自应用于受限可编辑技能库的接纳门控，而非留出验证本身；将同一门控授予所有基线仅提升域内性能而不提升分布外性能。该方法在任务可复现且结构可验证的非临床环境中有效，在动作空间开放式的场景中无效；冻结技能库可跨模型和共享工具调用约定的基准迁移，但在接口不匹配时性能下降。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-aware Multi-fidelity Closure via Conditional Normalizing Flows
papers.abstract_en: Reduced-order models (ROMs) provide efficient surrogates for complex multiscale systems, but their predictive accuracy is often compromised by truncation errors and the inadequate representation of interactions between resolved and unresolved scales. The missing effect of truncated (unresolved) scales on ROM (resolved) scales is often denoted as the closure problem. In this work, we formulate ROM closure modeling as a multi-fidelity (MF) learning problem and propose an uncertainty-aware MF framework based on conditional normalizing flows to enhance ROM predictive accuracy. The proposed approach learns a probabilistic mapping from low-fidelity (LF) ROM coefficients to high-fidelity (HF) coefficients, thereby improving predictive fidelity while quantifying the uncertainty associated with the learned closure. Two correction strategies are investigated: direct learning, in which HF coefficients are predicted directly from LF inputs, and residual learning, which learns the discrepancy between LF and HF coefficients. The framework is demonstrated on a double shear layer and vortex merging problems governed by the two-dimensional NavierStokes equations. Results show that both correction strategies improve ROM accuracy over uncorrected ROM, with residual learning achieving consistently better performance than direct learning. Moreover, the two proposed deep generative model-based strategies provide uncertainty quantification for the corrected ROM coefficients, which is critical for assessing prediction confidence and supporting the reliable use of ROMs in practical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把降阶模型 (ROM) 中的闭合问题 (closure problem) 重新表述为多保真度 (multi-fidelity) 学习问题，提出基于条件归一化流 (conditional normalizing flows) 的不确定性感知框架，学习从低保真 ROM 系数到高保真系数的概率映射。在二维 Navier-Stokes 方程控制的双剪切层和涡合并问题上，两种修正策略均提升了 ROM 精度，其中残差学习策略一致优于直接学习策略。
Motivation: ROM 的预测精度常受截断误差以及已解析尺度与未解析尺度之间相互作用刻画不足的影响，缺失的未解析尺度对已解析尺度的作用即闭合问题，需要被有效建模以提高预测可靠性。
Method: 提出一个不确定性感知的多保真框架，用条件归一化流学习从低保真 (low-fidelity) ROM 系数到高保真 (high-fidelity) 系数的概率映射；考察两种修正策略：直接学习 (direct learning) 直接预测高保真系数，残差学习 (residual learning) 学习低保真与高保真系数之间的差异。
Result: 在二维 Navier-Stokes 的双剪切层和涡合并数值实验中，两种修正策略都改善了未修正 ROM 的精度，且残差学习一致优于直接学习；两种深度生成式策略还为修正后的 ROM 系数提供了不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在提升 ROM 预测精度的同时提供预测置信度评估，对可靠使用 ROM 于实际应用至关重要；摘要未讨论该方法在其他系统或更高维度问题上的外推范围。
Relevance: 5
