summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在提升 ROM 预测精度的同时提供预测置信度评估，对可靠使用 ROM 于实际应用至关重要；摘要未讨论该方法在其他系统或更高维度问题上的外推范围。

papers.title: Lost in Sampling: Assessing Lexical Reachability in LLMs via the Word Coverage Score (WCS)
papers.abstract_en: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) are often criticized for producing repetitive and homogeneous text, despite possessing vast latent vocabularies. While previous research has focused on model knowledge and training data, we investigate the role of decoding mechanics in suppressing linguistic diversity. We introduce the Word Coverage Score (WCS), a metric that quantifies the extent to which contextually appropriate human vocabulary is mathematically pruned by standard sampling filters (e.g., Top-$p$, Top-$k$, and Min-$p$). Rather than assessing static knowledge, the WCS measures the lexical survival rate of low-frequency, high-information human words as a function of sampling parameters. By auditing open-weight models on human-authored corpus fragments, we identify which logical lexical choices are rendered unreachable by the decoder, even when they reside within the probability space. Our results provide quantitative evidence that industry-standard sampling defaults act as unintended censorship mechanisms, smoothing the unique textures of human expression into a homogenized discourse. The WCS offers a rigorous framework for optimizing the trade-off between text coherence and lexical richness, providing a diagnostic tool for preserving the diversity of human language in generative models.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Word Coverage Score (WCS)，用于量化 LLM 解码采样过滤器（如 Top-p、Top-k、Min-p）在数学上剪除上下文适当人类词汇的程度。作者在人类撰写的语料片段上审计开源权重模型，发现低频、高信息量的词汇即使位于概率空间内，也可能被解码器判定为不可达。WCS 提供了一个诊断工具，用于权衡文本连贯性与词汇丰富性。
Motivation: 现有研究多从模型知识和训练数据角度解释 LLM 输出重复、同质化的问题，但本文关注解码机制本身如何抑制语言多样性，即标准采样过滤器是否系统性排除了合法的人类词汇选择。
Method: 提出 Word Coverage Score (WCS)，通过测量低频率、高信息量人类词汇在给定采样参数下的词汇存活率（lexical survival rate），在人类撰写的语料片段上审计开源权重模型，从而识别逻辑上合理却被解码器排除的词汇选择。
Result: 摘要给出定量证据表明，行业标准的采样默认设置会充当非故意的审查机制，将人类表达的独有纹理平滑为同质化话语。
Conclusion: WCS 为优化文本连贯性与词汇丰富性之间的权衡提供了严格框架，可作为在生成模型中保留人类语言多样性的诊断工具。

papers.title: CIRCLED: A Multi-turn CIR Dataset with Consistent Dialogues across Domains
papers.abstract_en: Existing Multi-Turn Composed Image Retrieval (MTCIR) datasets lack dialogue-historyconsistency and are restricted to the fashion domain. To address these limitations, we construct CIRCLED by extending FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO. In CIRCLED, the query ateach turn progressively approaches the target image. Data are generated via a CIReVLbased retrieval pipeline and curated with multiple filters on retrieval success, turn length, consistency, and information redundancy to ensure quality. In total, we collect 22,608 multiturn sessions across nine subsets, substantially exceeding Multi-turn FashionIQ (11,505 sessions) in both scale and generality. We further apply multiple baseline methods and quantitatively assess retrieval accuracy on CIRCLED. Our work provides a practical, highquality benchmark to facilitate future research on multi-turn CIR. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/tk1441/CIRCLED, and the code at https://github.com/mti-lab/circled.
papers.comment: Accepted at DMLR (Journal of Data-centric Machine Learning Research). Published 19 August 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CIRCLED，一个跨领域多轮组合图像检索 (Multi-Turn Composed Image Retrieval, MTCIR) 数据集，通过扩展 FashionIQ、CIRR 和 CIRCO 构建，解决了现有 MTCIR 数据集缺乏对话历史一致性且局限于时尚领域的问题。数据集由基于 CIReVL 的检索流水线生成，并经过多重过滤以保证质量，共包含 22,608 个多轮会话，分为九个子集。作者在 CIRCLED 上评估了多种基线方法的检索准确率，并公开了数据集与代码。
Motivation: 现有 MTCIR 数据集缺乏对话历史一致性，且仅限于时尚领域，无法充分支撑跨领域多轮组合图像检索的研究。
Method: 通过扩展 FashionIQ、CIRR 和 CIRCO 构建 CIRCLED，使用基于 CIReVL 的检索流水线生成数据，使每一轮的查询逐步逼近目标图像，并采用检索成功率、轮次长度、一致性和信息冗余等多重过滤来保证数据质量。
Result: 共收集 22,608 个多轮会话，覆盖九个子集，在规模和通用性上明显超过 Multi-turn FashionIQ 的 11,505 个会话；并应用多种基线方法定量评估了检索准确率。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个实用且高质量的跨领域多轮 CIR 基准，以促进未来多轮组合图像检索研究。

papers.title: Can LLMs Introspect? A Reality Check
papers.abstract_en: Can large language models detect and report their own internal states? A number of recent studies have argued that they can. Drawing on lessons from human metacognition research, we argue that this conclusion may be premature. We identify two conditions that a paradigm needs to meet in order to establish introspection. First, the test needs to require privileged access: it should not be solvable using cues available in the input. Second, it needs to require second-order computation: second-order, meta-representations of first-order, task-related representations. This condition cannot be satisfied by task performance alone: it requires designs under which second-order and first-order accounts make divergent predictions. We re-examine two paradigms that have been used to argue for model introspection in light of these conditions. In the first, models must predict labels derived from their own hidden states; we find that classifiers that can only access the input match the models' in-context predictions, indicating that the original results do not demonstrate privileged access to internal representations. In the second paradigm, models must detect whether their internal states have been tampered with; we find they cannot reliably distinguish such interventions from manipulations of the input, suggesting that their success reflects generic anomaly detection rather than sensitivity to internal interventions in particular. We conclude that current evidence is insufficient to establish metacognitive monitoring in LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对“LLM 能否探测并报告自身内部状态”这一近期论断提出方法论层面的质疑。作者借鉴人类元认知研究，提出验证内省 (introspection) 需要满足两个条件：测试必须依赖特权访问 (privileged access)，且必须要求二阶计算 (second-order computation)。作者据此重新检验了两个曾被用于论证模型内省的实验范式，发现现有证据并不足以支持 LLM 具备元认知监控能力。
Motivation: 近期多项研究声称大语言模型能够检测并报告自身内部状态，但作者认为这一结论可能为时过早。现有范式未能区分基于输入线索的求解与真正的内部状态访问，也未能区分二阶元表征与一阶任务表现。
Method: 作者提出两个必要条件来建立内省：一是测试需要特权访问，即无法仅凭输入中的线索求解；二是需要二阶计算，即对一阶任务表征的元表征，并要求实验设计能让二阶解释与一阶解释产生不同预测。随后用这两个条件重新审视两种已有实验范式。
Result: 在第一个范式中，仅能访问输入的分类器能够匹配模型基于上下文 (in-context) 的预测，说明原结果并未证明模型对内部表征具备特权访问；在第二个范式中，模型无法可靠区分内部状态被篡改与输入被操纵，说明其成功表现可能来自通用异常检测而非对内部干预的特定敏感性。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有证据不足以确证 LLM 具备元认知监控能力；要论证模型内省，未来实验需要同时满足特权访问与二阶计算两个条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RouteScan: A Non-Intrusive Approach to Auditing MoE LLMs Safety via Expert Routing Telemetry
papers.abstract_en: As Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures are increasingly adopted for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), safety auditing becomes necessary to verify whether these models produce or facilitate harmful behaviors during operation. However, existing content-based auditing methods typically require access to user prompts, model internals, or outputs, potentially exposing sensitive user information and creating a tension between LLM safety and user privacy. On the other hand, we observe that, in MoE models, different inputs induce different sparse expert-routing patterns, which produce measurable footprints in low-level GPU execution telemetry. We refer to these hardware-observable signals induced by expert-routing decisions as expert routing telemetry; they are derived from GPU execution rather than from router logits or token-level routing assignments. Inspired by this observation, we propose RouteScan, a non-intrusive auditing framework for detecting harmful behaviors through such routing-induced GPU telemetry. Specifically, RouteScan utilizes the number of active GPU threads allocated to expert modules during the prefilling phase as a discriminative micro-architectural fingerprint, and builds a lightweight detection pipeline that isolates cross-domain invariant risk indicators for the precise identification of malicious prompts. Comprehensive evaluations on four open-source MoE LLMs with distinct routing designs demonstrate that RouteScan achieves strong generalization, with an AUROC exceeding 0.91 on unseen harmful domains. Moreover, privacy stress tests show that, although aggregated execution telemetry retains input-related attribute information, full prompts and exact sensitive fields cannot be reliably recovered under the evaluated attacks.
papers.comment: 11 pages. Revised manuscript with expanded experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RouteScan，一种非侵入式 (non-intrusive) 的 MoE 大语言模型安全审计框架，通过 GPU 执行遥测中的专家路由模式检测有害行为，无需访问用户提示、模型内部或输出。方法利用预填充阶段分配给专家模块的活动 GPU 线程数作为微架构指纹，构建轻量检测流水线以隔离跨域不变风险指标。在四个开源 MoE LLM 上，RouteScan 在未见危害域上的 AUROC 超过 0.91；隐私压力测试表明，聚合执行遥测虽保留输入相关属性信息，但无法可靠恢复完整提示或精确敏感字段。
Motivation: 现有基于内容的安全审计方法通常需要访问用户提示、模型内部或输出，可能暴露敏感用户信息，造成 LLM 安全性与用户隐私之间的张力。作者观察到 MoE 模型中不同输入会产生不同的稀疏专家路由模式，并在底层 GPU 执行遥测中留下可测量的足迹，因而希望利用这类信号实现非侵入式有害行为检测。
Method: RouteScan 将预填充阶段专家模块分配的活动 GPU 线程数作为判别性微架构指纹 (micro-architectural fingerprint)，构建一个轻量检测流水线，隔离跨域不变的风险指标 (cross-domain invariant risk indicators)，用于精确识别恶意提示。
Result: 在四个具有不同路由设计的开源 MoE LLM 上，RouteScan 在未见有害域上实现强泛化，AUROC 超过 0.91。隐私压力测试显示，尽管聚合执行遥测保留了输入相关属性信息，但在所评估的攻击下无法可靠恢复完整提示和精确敏感字段。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 RouteScan 展示了通过硬件可观测的路由遥测进行非侵入式安全审计的可行性，在 LLM 安全检测与用户隐私之间提供了新的平衡；同时指出聚合遥测仍含输入属性信息，提示隐私泄露风险并未完全消除。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Behavior-Consistent Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) often exhibits high variance across training runs, leading to unreliable performance and posing a major challenge to deployment in real-world domains. In this work, we address the challenge of cross-run policy divergence by formalizing the problem of behavior-consistent RL, where the objective is to obtain policies that are both high-performing and distributionally similar across training runs. Our key observation is that maximum-entropy RL provides a direct mechanism for controlling behavioral divergence by anchoring runs to a common (uniform) prior. We prove that, for Boltzmann policies, choosing the temperature proportional to $Q$-function disagreement bounds the pairwise KL divergence between the induced policies. However, we also show that naïvely increasing entropy might impair policy optimization while amplifying off-policy error. Building upon these observations, we propose $Q$-value Expectile Disagreement (QED), a state-dependent temperature schedule that uses double-critic disagreement as a single-run proxy for cross-run disagreement. Empirically, we demonstrate that across 18 continuous-control tasks, QED reduces across-run divergence by two orders of magnitude without sacrificing performance, resulting in a considerable reduction in return variance at modest sample-efficiency costs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习 (RL) 跨训练运行高方差、策略发散的问题，形式化了行为一致性 RL (behavior-consistent RL) 的目标：获得既高性能又在多次训练间分布相似 (distributionally similar) 的策略。作者证明对于 Boltzmann 策略，将温度设为与 Q 函数不一致性 (Q-function disagreement) 成比例可以约束策略间的成对 KL 散度，但单纯提高熵可能损害策略优化并放大 off-policy 误差。基于此提出 Q-value Expectile Disagreement (QED)，一种利用 double-critic 不一致性作为跨运行不一致单轮代理的状态相关温度调度。实验表明，在 18 个连续控制任务上 QED 将跨运行发散降低两个数量级且不牺牲性能。
Motivation: RL 在多次训练运行间常表现出高方差，导致性能不可靠，是实际部署中的主要挑战；现有方法缺少对跨运行策略发散 (cross-run policy divergence) 的系统化控制。
Method: 将行为一致性形式化，利用最大熵 RL 将各次运行锚定到共同 (均匀) 先验来控制行为差异；证明 Boltzmann 策略下温度与 Q 函数不一致成正比例时可约束策略间 KL 散度，并据此提出状态相关温度调度 QED，用 double-critic 不一致作为单轮运行的代理指标。
Result: 在 18 个连续控制任务上，QED 将跨运行发散降低两个数量级，同时不牺牲性能，并以适度的样本效率代价显著降低了回报方差 (return variance)。

papers.title: Component-Aware Structure-Preserving Style Transfer for Satellite Visual Sim2Real Data Construction
papers.abstract_en: For camera-based satellite visual sensing, Sim2Real data construction requires images that approach real-domain sensor appearance while retaining the annotations inherited from simulation. Real sensor images of satellite targets with reliable pose labels and component-level masks are difficult to acquire at scale, whereas synthetic rendering provides exact geometric annotations but suffers from a visible appearance gap. This paper presents a component-aware structure-preserving style transfer framework for satellite visual synthetic-to-real data construction. The method builds weakly paired real--synthetic samples from calibrated real acquisition, ArUco-based camera-pose measurement, CAD rendering, and component masks. It then extracts part-wise real-domain style codes from unlabeled real images and injects them into corresponding synthetic satellite regions through mask-aligned modulation. To keep the generated images usable for downstream sensor-data supervision, adversarial training is combined with local contrastive consistency, self-regularization, and edge-preserving constraints. Experiments are conducted on 5,000 rendered satellite images and 100 real images captured in a calibrated setup. The real images provide target-domain appearance references and final evaluation images, while the downstream GDRNet pose estimator is trained only on synthetic or translated synthetic images. Compared with representative image-translation baselines, the proposed method achieves the lowest image distribution discrepancy, with an FID of 54.32 and a KID of 0.048. When the translated data are used to train GDRNet in this target-domain adaptation setting, the ADD pass rate improves to 0.260 and the AUC improves to 0.611. These results indicate that component-level appearance transfer can improve annotation-preserving satellite visual Sim2Real data generation in the considered calibrated setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种组件感知、结构保持的风格迁移框架，用于卫星视觉的 Sim2Real 数据构建。方法利用标定采集、ArUco 姿态测量、CAD 渲染和组件掩码构造弱配对的真实-合成样本，再将无标注真实图像中提取的分部件风格码注入到对应合成卫星区域。在 5,000 张渲染图像和 100 张真实图像上，该方法相对代表性图像翻译基线取得最低分布差异（FID 54.32，KID 0.048），并用翻译数据训练 GDRNet 位姿估计器获得 ADD 通过率 0.260、AUC 0.611。
Motivation: 基于相机的卫星视觉感知需要既接近真实域传感器外观又保留仿真标注的 Sim2Real 数据；真实卫星图像难以大规模获取可靠的姿态标签和部件级掩码，而合成渲染虽有精确几何标注却存在明显外观差距。
Method: 构建弱配对的真实-合成样本，并从无标注真实图像提取部件级（part-wise）真实域风格码，通过掩码对齐调制注入到合成卫星图像对应区域；同时结合对抗训练、局部对比一致性（local contrastive consistency）、自正则化与边缘保持约束以保持生成图像可用于下游传感器数据监督。
Result: 在标定设置下，与代表性图像翻译基线相比，该方法取得最低图像分布差异，FID 为 54.32、KID 为 0.048；使用翻译数据训练 GDRNet 时，ADD 通过率提升至 0.260，AUC 提升至 0.611。
Conclusion: 摘要认为在该标定设置下，部件级外观迁移能够改善保持标注的卫星视觉 Sim2Real 数据生成。

papers.title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity
papers.abstract_en: The quadratic complexity of attention imposes severe memory and computational bottlenecks on Large Language Model (LLM) inference. This challenge is particularly acute for emerging agentic applications that require processing multi-million token sequences. We propose STS, a sparse attention mechanism that requires no model retraining. STS leverages the key insight that tokens identified as important by a smaller draft model are highly predictive of important tokens for a larger target model. By integrating into speculative decoding frameworks, STS repurposes the draft model's attention scores to dynamically construct a token-and-head-wise sparsity mask. This mask effectively prunes the expensive attention computation in the target LLM. Our evaluation shows that STS achieves a 2.67x speedup operating at approximately 90% sparsity on representative benchmark NarrativeQA, maintaining negligible accuracy degradation compared to dense attention. STS establishes a new state-of-the-art on the sparsity-accuracy trade-off, outperforming prior techniques by enabling higher sparsity levels for a given accuracy budget.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STS，一种无需重训练的稀疏注意力 (sparse attention) 机制，用于加速大语言模型 (LLM) 推理。核心思路是利用投机解码 (speculative decoding) 中较小 draft model 的注意力分数来预测目标大模型的重要 token，并据此动态构造 token 和 head 级别的稀疏掩码，剪枝目标模型的注意力计算。在 NarrativeQA 上，STS 以约 90% 的稀疏度实现 2.67 倍加速，且相对稠密注意力仅有可忽略的精度损失，据称在稀疏度-精度权衡上达到新最优。
Motivation: 注意力机制的二次方复杂度给 LLM 推理带来严重的内存和计算瓶颈，尤其对于需要处理数百万 token 序列的新兴智能体 (agentic) 应用，该问题更加突出。
Method: STS 将稀疏注意力集成进投机解码框架，复用 draft model 的注意力分数来动态构建 token-and-head 级别的稀疏掩码，从而剪枝目标 LLM 中昂贵的注意力计算；整个方法无需对模型进行重训练。
Result: 在代表性基准 NarrativeQA 上，STS 在约 90% 稀疏度下实现 2.67 倍加速，相比稠密注意力仅出现可忽略的精度下降，并在给定精度预算下支持更高稀疏度，优于此前技术。
Conclusion: 作者认为 STS 在稀疏度-精度权衡上建立了新的最优水平，能够在无需重训练的前提下以更高稀疏度加速 LLM 推理。

papers.title: Counterfactual Stress Testing for Image Classification Models
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models in medical imaging often fail when deployed in new clinical environments due to distribution shifts in demographics, scanner hardware, or acquisition protocols. A central challenge is underspecification, where models with similar validation performance exhibit divergent real-world failure modes. Although stress testing has emerged as a tool to assess this, current methods typically rely on simple, uninformed perturbations (e.g., brightness or contrast changes), which fail to capture clinically realistic variation and can overestimate robustness. In this work, we introduce a counterfactual stress testing framework based on causal generative models that create realistic "what if" images by intervening on attributes such as scanner type and recorded sex while largely preserving anatomical identity, enabling controlled and semantically meaningful evaluation under targeted distribution shifts. Across two imaging modalities (chest X-ray and mammography), three model architectures, and multiple shift scenarios, we show that counterfactual stress tests provide a substantially more accurate proxy for real out-of-distribution performance than classical perturbations, capturing the direction and relative magnitude of performance changes and showing stronger overall rank agreement. These results suggest that causal generative models can provide informative synthetic stress tests for assessing robustness under targeted distribution shifts prior to deployment.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the MICCAI 2026 Joint FAIMI-BRIDGE-EPIMI Workshop. To appear in Springer LNCS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于因果生成模型的反事实压力测试框架，用于评估医学图像分类模型在目标分布偏移下的鲁棒性。通过干预扫描仪类型和记录性别等属性生成保留解剖身份的真实"what if"图像，作者在胸部X光和乳腺摄影两种模态、三种模型架构和多个偏移场景下验证该方法。结果表明反事实压力测试比传统简单扰动更准确地代理真实 out-of-distribution 性能，能捕捉性能变化的方向和相对幅度，并具有更强的排序一致性。
Motivation: 医学图像模型在部署到新临床环境时因分布偏移而失败，核心问题是欠规格化（underspecification）：验证性能相近的模型可能具有不同的真实失败模式。现有压力测试依赖亮度、对比度等无信息扰动，无法刻画临床真实变化且可能高估鲁棒性。
Method: 提出基于因果生成模型的反事实压力测试框架，对扫描仪类型、记录性别等属性进行干预，生成保留个体解剖身份的合成"what if"图像，以实现受控且语义有意义的分布偏移评估。
Result: 在胸部X光与乳腺摄影、三种模型架构和多种偏移场景下，反事实压力测试相比经典扰动显著更准确地预测真实 out-of-distribution 性能，能反映性能变化的方向与相对幅度，并展现更强的整体排序一致性。
Conclusion: 作者认为因果生成模型可作为部署前评估模型在目标分布偏移下鲁棒性的有效合成压力测试工具。该论文为 MICCAI 2026 联合研讨会论文，篇幅较短，属于医学影像鲁棒性评估方向。

papers.title: Learning Minimal-Deviation Corrections for Multi-Dimensional Mismodelling in HEP Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Accurate Monte Carlo (MC) modelling in high-energy physics is challenging, particularly in complex scenarios where simulations fail to reproduce observed data. In practice, experimental information is often limited to one-dimensional (1D) distributions, while mismodelling arises in a multidimensional feature space. This restricts traditional correction methods, as one-dimensional reweighting ignores correlations and fully multidimensional approaches require large target datasets. We propose a neural network-based method that operates under these constraints by learning a transformation of simulated events that reproduces the available 1D target distributions while remaining close to the original simulation. This minimal-deviation principle preserves the global correlation structure of the baseline model while enabling targeted corrections of mismodelled features. Using controlled studies with simulated pseudo-data, we show that the method improves agreement with target distributions and maintains a consistent multidimensional structure. The approach is designed for complex, high-dimensional analyses where traditional techniques are insufficient, providing a scalable way to enhance MC modelling under limited information.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经网络的方法，用于在高能物理模拟中修正多维失配问题，在仅提供一维目标分布的条件下学习模拟事件的最小偏差变换。该方法通过让变换后的模拟尽量接近原始模拟来保留全局相关结构，同时复现目标的一维分布。受控伪数据研究显示，该方法能改善与目标分布的一致性并维持一致的多维结构。
Motivation: 高能物理中的蒙特卡罗模拟常在多维特征空间出现失配，但实验信息通常限于一维分布，传统一维重加权忽略特征间相关性，而完全多维的方法又需要大量目标数据。
Method: 提出一个神经网络方法，学习模拟事件的变换，使其匹配可用的目标一维分布，同时保持与原始模拟的最小偏差；该最小偏差原则用于保留基线模型的全局相关结构。
Result: 在受控伪数据研究中，该方法改善了与目标分布的一致性，并保持了稳定的多维结构。
Conclusion: 该方法面向复杂高维分析，在实验信息有限的情况下提供了一种可扩展的蒙特卡罗建模修正途径。

papers.title: GRALIS: Fusing Coalition and Gradient Attribution with Closed-Form Conservation Error and Finite-Sample Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: The main post-hoc XAI methods for deep networks -- GradCAM, SHAP, LIME, Integrated Gradients -- originate from heterogeneous theoretical foundations and are not naturally comparable within a single representation. A recent benchmark also finds their coalition-based members (GradCAM, KernelSHAP, LIME) and gradient-based members (Integrated Gradients and variants) empirically complementary, each outperforming the other on different faithfulness metrics, with method selection as the only proposed remedy (Gevaert et al., 2022). This work presents GRALIS (Gradient-Riesz Averaged Locally-Integrated Shapley), which fuses these two mechanisms -- a Shapley coalition weight and locality kernel, and a continuous Integrated-Gradients-style conditioned path -- into a single estimator, and equips it with two certified guarantees neither mechanism supplies alone: an exact, closed-form completeness deficit (an order-d interaction is attributed at a factor 1/d of its true value under Shapley weights and a multilinear F) and a finite-sample bound, O(1/sqrt(m)) + O(1/k^2), for the actual self-normalized ratio the algorithm returns. This fusion is underpinned by a representation-theoretic result: every additive, linear, continuous attribution functional admits a unique canonical representation via the Riesz Representation Theorem, proved componentwise (feature by feature) rather than as one form shared across features or methods. This class includes SHAP, IG and LIME, but not nonlinear functionals such as standard GradCAM or attention maps. Seven theorems further establish an exact correspondence with Shapley Interaction Values, affine-regime correspondences with the Hoeffding/Sobol decomposition, and a minimum-variance multi-scale extension. A preliminary experimental illustration on breast histology imaging is included; extended validation is in a companion paper (Fanale, 2026).

papers.title: Preference-Based Self-Distillation: Beyond KL Matching via Reward Regularization
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation is an efficient alternative to reinforcement learning, offering dense token-level training signals. However, its reliance on a stronger external teacher has driven recent work on on-policy self-distillation, where the same model serves as both teacher and student under different prompt contexts. Yet, existing self-distillation methods largely reduce learning to KL matching toward the context-augmented teacher model. This approach often suffers from training instability and can degrade reasoning performance over time. Moreover, self-distillation from the same model with prompt augmentation lacks the exploratory diversity provided by a genuine external teacher. To address these limitations, we move beyond fixed-teacher KL matching and propose \textbf{P}reference-\textbf{B}ased \textbf{S}elf-\textbf{D}istillation (\textbf{PBSD}), which revisits on-policy self-distillation through a reward-regularized perspective. Instead of directly matching the teacher distribution, we derive a reward-regularized objective whose analytic optimum is a reward-reweighted teacher distribution, yielding a target policy provably superior to the original teacher under this objective. Practically, PBSD optimizes preference gaps between teacher and student samples while maintaining on-policy student sampling. We support this framework with a statistical analysis of the induced preference-learning problem, formally establishing when on policy self-distillation is preferable to learning from an external teacher in our setting. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and tool-use benchmarks across multiple model scales demonstrate that PBSD consistently achieves the strongest average performance among comparable baselines, showing improved training stability over prior self-distillation baselines while preserving token efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于偏好的自蒸馏方法 PBSD（Preference-Based Self-Distillation），将同策略自蒸馏 (on-policy self-distillation) 重新表述为带奖励正则化的目标，其解析最优解是奖励加权后的教师分布，并声称该目标下的策略理论上优于原教师。实验覆盖数学推理和工具使用基准的多模型规模，显示在平均性能、训练稳定性和 token 效率上优于既有自蒸馏基线。
Motivation: 现有同策略自蒸馏依赖对上下文增强教师模型的 KL 匹配，存在训练不稳定和推理性能随训练退化的问题；同时同一模型的自蒸馏缺乏真实外部教师带来的探索多样性。
Method: 推导一个奖励正则化目标，其最优解为奖励重加权的教师分布，而非直接匹配教师分布；实际优化中在保持同策略学生采样的同时，优化教师与学生样本之间的偏好差距 (preference gap)，并给出该偏好学习问题的统计分析。
Result: 摘要称在数学推理和工具使用基准上，跨多个模型规模，PBSD 在可比较基线中取得最强平均性能，较此前自蒸馏基线有更好的训练稳定性，同时保留 token 效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为超越固定教师 KL 匹配、采用奖励正则化视角可以改进自蒸馏的稳定性与性能；该框架还从统计上刻画了同策略自蒸馏何时优于外部教师学习。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: S-AI-Recursive: Convergent Recursive Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: This article introduces S-AI-Recursive, a bio-inspired Sparse Artificial Intelligence architecture in which reasoning is implemented as a hormonally regulated closed-loop iteration rather than a single feed-forward pass. The Recursive Reasoning Cycle (RRC) is governed by two recursive hormones: Clarifine, a convergence signal, and Confusionin, a residual-uncertainty signal. Their antagonistic interaction regulates state refinement, stopping, resource allocation, and recursive-engram retrieval. The revised framework distinguishes hormonal-subsystem stability from joint cognitive state-hormone convergence and gives explicit sufficient conditions for coupled contraction on fixed-point-structured tasks. It also includes Lyapunov analysis, conditional entropic contraction, multi-signal stopping, Euler-Maruyama discretization with projection, constrained agent selection, and warm-start memory. Experimental evaluation combines controlled SAI-UT+ simulations with exactly verifiable task-level tests. On convergent Maze instances, adaptive stopping reduces mean depth from 20.00 to 11.31 iterations at unchanged resolution, a 43.4 percent reduction. On compatible recurring Sudoku instances, warm-start reduces mean depth from 18.39 to 2.00 cycles, saving 16.39 cycles at unchanged resolution. ARC-style tasks are used to assess operator portability rather than full benchmark performance. Robustness tests show an advantage over residual-only stopping on deceptive plateaus, but not under homogeneous Gaussian noise. These results support adaptive temporal parsimony, memory-assisted acceleration, and selected robustness under stated conditions, without establishing superiority over independently trained external architectures.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 S-AI-Recursive，一种受生物启发的稀疏人工智能架构，将推理实现为激素调节的闭环迭代（Recursive Reasoning Cycle），而非单次前向传播。两个递归激素 Clarifine（收敛信号）与 Confusionin（残差不确定性信号）的拮抗相互作用控制状态精化、停止、资源分配与递归记忆检索。框架还给出耦合收缩的充分条件、Lyapunov 分析、条件熵收缩、多信号停止、Euler-Maruyama 离散化与投影、约束智能体选择及暖启动记忆。实验表明在收敛型 Maze 实例上自适应停止将平均深度从 20.00 降至 11.31 次迭代（-43.4%），在兼容的递归 Sudoku 实例上暖启动将平均深度从 18.39 降至 2.00 个周期。
Motivation: 现有推理架构多采用单次前馈过程，缺乏显式的收敛控制与记忆辅助机制；作者希望用激素式闭环调节来改进状态精化、停止决策和资源分配。
Method: 引入由 Clarifine 与 Confusionin 两种递归激素调控的 S-AI-Recursive 架构，包含激素子系统稳定性与联合认知状态-激素收敛的区分、耦合收缩充分条件、Lyapunov 分析、条件熵收缩、多信号停止、Euler-Maruyama 离散化与投影、约束智能体选择以及暖启动记忆。
Result: 在收敛型 Maze 实例上，自适应停止将平均深度从 20.00 降至 11.31 次迭代（43.4% 减少）；在兼容的递归 Sudoku 实例上，暖启动将平均深度从 18.39 降至 2.00 个周期（节省 16.39 个周期）。ARC 风格任务用于评估算子可移植性而非完整基准性能；鲁棒性测试显示在欺骗性平台上优于仅残差停止，但在均匀高斯噪声下无优势。
Conclusion: 结果支持自适应时间节俭、记忆辅助加速以及限定条件下的鲁棒性，但作者明确表示并未建立对独立训练的外部架构的总体优越性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RefusalGuard: Geometry-Preserving Fine-Tuning for Safety in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning safety-aligned language models for downstream tasks often leads to substantial degradation of refusal behavior, making models vulnerable to adversarial misuse. While prior work has shown that safety-relevant features are encoded in structured representations within the model's activation space, how these representations change during fine-tuning and why alignment degrades remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the representation-level mechanisms underlying alignment degradation. Our analysis shows that standard fine-tuning induces systematic drift in safety-relevant representations, distorts their geometric structure, and introduces interference between task optimization and safety features. These effects collectively lead to increased harmful compliance. Motivated by these findings, we introduce REFUSALGUARD, a representation-level fine-tuning framework that preserves safety-relevant structure during model adaptation. Our approach constrains updates in hidden representation space, ensuring that safety-mediating components remain stable while allowing task-specific learning in complementary directions. We evaluate REFUSALGUARD across multiple model families, including LLaMA, Gemma, and Qwen, on adversarial safety benchmarks such as AdvBench, DirectHarm4, and JailbreakBench, as well as downstream utility tasks. Our approach achieves attack success rates comparable to base safety-aligned models while maintaining competitive task performance, significantly outperforming baselines.
papers.journal_ref: Conference of Languge Modeling, COLM 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究安全对齐的大语言模型在微调过程中拒绝行为退化的表征级机制，发现标准微调会导致安全相关表征发生系统性漂移、几何结构扭曲，并引入任务优化与安全特征的干扰。基于这些发现，作者提出 REFUSALGUARD，一种在隐藏表征空间约束更新的表征级微调框架，在保持安全中介组件稳定的同时允许任务特定学习。作者在 LLaMA、Gemma、Qwen 等多个模型家族上评估，显示攻击成功率与基础安全对齐模型相当，同时保持有竞争力的任务性能。
Motivation: 安全对齐模型在下游任务微调时拒绝行为会显著退化，容易受到对抗性滥用；已有研究虽表明安全特征编码在激活空间的结构化表征中，但这些表征在微调中的变化机制和失准原因仍不清晰。
Method: 提出 REFUSALGUARD，一种表征级微调框架，通过在隐藏表征空间约束更新来保持安全相关结构，使安全中介组件保持稳定，同时允许在互补方向进行任务特定学习。
Result: 在 LLaMA、Gemma、Qwen 等多模型家族以及 AdvBench、DirectHarm4、JailbreakBench 等对抗安全基准上，该方法取得与基础安全对齐模型相当的攻击成功率，同时保持有竞争力的下游任务性能，显著优于基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调安全相关表征的几何结构在微调中可被保留，从而在任务适应与安全性能之间取得平衡。

papers.title: Know2Guess: A Contamination-Aware Multi-Zone Benchmark for Knowledge-Boundary Evaluation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Reliable evaluation of large language models should separate supported answering from unsupported guessing without conflating either with data contamination, prompt idiosyncrasy, or generic refusal behavior. We present a contamination-aware, multi-zone benchmark for measuring the transition from answerable knowledge to abstention-expected unknowns under frozen build-time labels. The benchmark contains 1,200 items across five domains, explicit abstention expectations, contamination-risk metadata, and dual parsing with an official strict parser plus a normalized robustness parser. We evaluate FLAN-T5, Qwen2.5-Instruct, and Llama-3-Instruct models under locked answer-or-abstain prompts, answer-only controls, and prompt-template variants. The benchmark is not solved by generic non-answer behavior: FLAN baselines remain weak on productive abstention, while stronger instruction-tuned models expose a selective but incomplete transition from answering to abstaining. Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct achieves the best overall reliability, but answer-expected zones remain difficult, calibration remains poor, and benign-item refusal persists. Prompt and parser robustness analyses preserve the main ranking and qualitative conclusions. The benchmark therefore provides a reproducible protocol for auditing answerability, abstention, refusal, and contamination as distinct but interacting dimensions of LLM reliability.The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/renweimeng/Know2Guess-A-Contamination-Aware-Multi-Zone-Benchmark.

TL;DR: 本文提出 Know2Guess，一个考虑数据污染 (contamination) 的多区域基准，用于评测 LLM 从可回答知识到应弃权未知的过渡。基准含 1,200 个条目、覆盖五个领域，使用固定的构建期标签，并提供显式弃权期望、污染风险元数据以及官方严格解析器加归一化鲁棒解析器的双解析方案。作者在 FLAN-T5、Qwen2.5-Instruct、Llama-3-Instruct 上评估，发现更强指令微调模型表现出选择性但不完整的作答到弃权过渡，其中 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 总体可靠性最佳。
Motivation: 现有评测常把数据污染、提示词特异性和通用拒答行为与模型真正能否作答或应否弃权混为一谈；需要一个在固定标签下将可回答知识与应拒绝的未知区分开、并把弃权和污染作为独立维度的评测协议。
Method: 构建多区域基准 Know2Guess：1,200 个条目覆盖五个领域，带显式弃权期望和污染风险元数据，采用官方严格解析器与归一化鲁棒解析器进行双解析；评测在锁定作答或弃权提示、仅作答对照以及提示模板变体下进行。
Result: 摘要报告该基准无法被通用非作答行为解决：FLAN 基线在有效弃权 (productive abstention) 上能力弱，而更强的指令微调模型表现出选择性但不完整的作答到弃权过渡。Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 取得最佳总体可靠性，但答案预期区域仍然困难、校准较差，且良性的拒绝 (benign-item refusal) 持续存在；提示与解析器鲁棒性分析保持主要排序和定性结论。
Conclusion: 作者将 Know2Guess 定位为可复现的评测协议，用于审计可作答性、弃权、拒答和污染这些独立但交互的 LLM 可靠性维度，并公开了数据集。

papers.title: Dynamics of East Atlantic seed vortex populations in global km-scale models
papers.abstract_en: Africa is the primary source of cyclonic vortices over the tropical Atlantic. Over both land and sea, these vortices are entwined with deep convective activity, with the majority being African Easterly Wave troughs. Their convective interactions have downstream impacts, since the same vortices provide the seed population for Atlantic basin tropical cyclone (TC) genesis. Understanding the dynamics of East Atlantic seed populations, particularly the processes that distinguish vortices which undergo cyclogenesis, is crucial for understanding the formation of Atlantic hurricanes and model representations of their populations. Here we investigate these questions in three one-year, atmosphere-land global km-scale Met Office Unified Model simulations. We use objective tracking algorithms to independently identify seed vortices, easterly waves, TCs, and Mesoscale Convective Systems (MCSs), benchmarking against reanalysis and satellite observations. The simulations display equivalent continental and offshore seed vortex frequencies, however the high-resolution, explicit convection simulation produces fewer, weaker hurricanes. Parameterised convection counterparts show stronger vortex amplification of seeds crossing the West African coastline, and more hurricanes form offshore. In the explicit simulation, we identify a failure to maintain strong vertical mass flux profiles experienced by seeds as the primary cause of weak vortex development, finding no low-level circulation development offshore about seed vortices. Using MCS tracks, we show that systematic differences in convective organisation between the simulations can explain the differences in mass flux profiles, and thus vortex evolution. Deficiencies in the explicit simulation stem primarily from underestimation of MCS anvils and stratiform rainfall, a long-standing systematic bias common amongst explicit convection models.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用三组为期一年、全球公里尺度的 Met Office Unified Model 大气-陆地模拟，研究东大西洋热带气旋(TC)种子涡旋的动力学。作者用客观追踪算法分别识别种子涡旋、东风波、TC 与中尺度对流系统(MCS)，并以再分析和卫星观测为基准。结果显示显式对流模拟产生更少且更弱的飓风，而参数化对流模拟在种子跨越西非海岸时出现更强的涡旋增强和更多离岸飓风。
Motivation: 非洲是热带大西洋气旋涡旋的主要源地，这些涡旋与深对流活动交织，为 Atlantic basin 的 TC 生成提供种子群体。理解东大西洋种子群体的动力学，尤其是区分哪些涡旋会发生气旋生成的过程，对理解大西洋飓风形成及模式对种子群体的刻画至关重要。
Method: 使用三个一年期全球公里尺度 Met Office Unified Model 模拟，分别采用显式对流和参数化对流方案；通过客观追踪算法独立识别种子涡旋、东风波、TC 和 MCS，并与再分析和卫星观测进行对比验证。
Result: 模拟显示陆上与离岸种子涡旋频率相当，但显式对流模拟生成的飓风数量更少且强度更弱。显式模拟中，种子涡旋未能维持强垂直质量通量廓线，离岸也没有发展出低层环流；基于 MCS 轨迹发现，模拟间对流组织的系统性差异可解释质量通量廓线差异，进而解释涡旋演变差异。
Conclusion: 显式对流模拟的不足主要源于对 MCS 砧状云和层状降水( stratiform rainfall)的低估，这是显式对流模式中一个长期存在的系统性偏差。

papers.title: Complete Cyclic Subtask Graphs for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Flexibility, Cost, and Bottlenecks in Long-Horizon Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tool-using tasks sometimes benefit from revisiting earlier subtasks, but explicit revisitation also adds routing, coordination, and token cost. We study complete cyclic subtask graphs for large language model (LLM) agents: a workflow controller in which executable subtasks are fully connected and a unified state-analysis-and-routing agent selects transitions from natural-language criteria. We evaluate task-specific (Spec-Cyc) and benchmark-generic (Gen-Cyc) cyclic graphs on TextCraft, ALFWorld, and Finance-Agent against ReAct and dependency-directed workflows. Our main dependency-directed controller is DepDAG, which permits same-subtask retry while preserving forward dependency constraints. The evaluated case studies suggest three workflow signatures rather than a universal architecture ranking. TextCraft behaves like a prerequisite-chain setting, where cyclic routing often adds overhead. ALFWorld behaves like a partially observable recovery setting, where explicit revisitation improves exploration and success. Finance-Agent behaves like an open-ended evidence-synthesis setting, where workflow control alone is insufficient without stronger retrieval, grounding, and verification mechanisms. We add a qualified workflow-signature matrix, fault-injection robustness analysis, token-cost accounting, graph-stability reporting, transition-audit checks for DepDAG, and failure-mode structure for trajectory analysis. Overall, complete cyclic subtask graphs are best understood as a diagnostic workflow-control tool: they expose when flexible backtracking is worth its cost and when simpler, locally retrying, or sparsified controllers are preferable.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长时程工具使用型 LLM 智能体中的完全循环子任务图（complete cyclic subtask graphs），其控制器将可执行子任务全连接，由统一的状态分析-路由智能体依据自然语言标准选择转移。作者在 TextCraft、ALFWorld 和 Finance-Agent 上对比了任务特定/基准通用的循环图（Spec-Cyc、Gen-Cyc）、ReAct 与依赖导向的 DepDAG，发现不存在普适的最优架构，而是呈现三种工作流特征（workflow signature）。整体上，完全循环子任务图更适合作为诊断性工作流控制工具，而非通用解决方案。
Motivation: 长时程工具使用任务有时需要重访较早的子任务，但显式重访会引入路由、协调和 token 成本；现有工作缺少对何时值得回溯、何时应用更简单控制器的系统理解。
Method: 提出完全连接的循环子任务图工作流控制器，由统一的状态分析-路由智能体根据自然语言标准选择子任务转移；主依赖导向控制器 DepDAG 允许同一子任务重试，同时保留前向依赖约束。论文还提供工作流特征矩阵、故障注入鲁棒性分析、token 成本核算、图稳定性报告、DepDAG 转移审计检查以及失败模式结构分析。
Result: 案例研究呈现三种特征：TextCraft 类似前置链（prerequisite-chain）场景，循环路由常带来额外开销；ALFWorld 类似部分可观测恢复场景，显式重访提升探索与成功率；Finance-Agent 类似开放式证据综合场景，仅靠工作流控制不足，需更强的检索、接地和验证机制。
Conclusion: 作者认为完全循环子任务图最好被理解为一种诊断性工作流控制工具，能揭示灵活回溯何时值得其成本，以及何时更宜采用更简单、局部重试或稀疏化控制器；结论基于案例研究，而非统一架构排名。

papers.title: Calibrate-Then-Delegate: Safety Monitoring with Risk and Budget Guarantees via Model Cascades
papers.abstract_en: Monitoring LLM safety at scale requires balancing cost and accuracy: a cheap latent-space probe can screen every input, but hard cases should be escalated to a more expensive expert. Existing cascades delegate based on probe uncertainty, but uncertainty is a poor proxy for the utility of an expert call, as it ignores whether the expert would actually improve the prediction. To address this problem, we introduce Calibrate-Then-Delegate (CTD), a model-cascade approach that provides probabilistic guarantees on either computation cost or safety performance while enabling instance-level (streaming) decisions. CTD builds on a novel delegation value (DV) probe, a lightweight model operating on the same internal representations as the safety probe that predicts the benefit of replacing the probe score with the expert score after an expert call. CTD calibrates a threshold on the DV signal using held-out data and multiple hypothesis testing, yielding finite-sample guarantees while optimising the complementary objective. Evaluated on four safety datasets using learned-attention probes, CTD improves over uncertainty-based delegation over much of the budget range, avoids unnecessary expert calls, and extracts positive-value subsets even from groups where the expert score is worse than the probe score on average. Ablations across four probe architectures show that these findings are not specific to any particular architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Calibrate-Then-Delegate (CTD)，一种面向 LLM 安全监控的模型级联方法，能在计算成本或安全性能上提供概率保证，并支持实例级（流式）决策。CTD 使用一个基于内部表示训练的轻量级 delegation value (DV) 探针来预测专家调用带来的分数改善，再通过保留数据和多重假设检验校准阈值，从而获得有限样本保证。在四个安全数据集上的实验显示，CTD 在大部分预算区间优于基于不确定性的委托策略，减少不必要的专家调用，并能从专家平均表现更差的子群中提取正价值子集。
Motivation: 现有级联方法依据探针的不确定性决定是否升级到专家，但不确定性并不能衡量专家调用的效用，因为忽略了专家是否真的能改进预测。在大规模 LLM 安全监控中，需要在成本和准确性之间取得平衡，因此需要一种直接预测专家调用价值的委托机制。
Method: CTD 在安全探针的同一内部表示上训练一个轻量级 DV 探针，用于预测用专家分数替换探针分数后的收益。基于 DV 信号，利用保留数据与多重假设检验校准决策阈值，在优化互补目标的同时提供有限样本的概率保证，并支持流式逐实例决策。
Result: 在四个安全数据集上使用 learned-attention 探针的评估中，CTD 在大部分预算范围内优于基于不确定性的委托，避免了不必要的专家调用，并能从专家分数平均劣于探针分数的子群中提取正价值子集。对四种探针架构的消融实验表明这些发现不依赖于特定架构。
Conclusion: 作者强调 CTD 通过以委托价值而非不确定性作为决策依据，能够在成本或安全指标上提供有限样本保证，并在成本与安全性能之间取得更好的权衡，同时保持流式决策能力。

papers.title: DF3DV-1K: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Distractor-Free Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Advances in radiance fields have enabled photorealistic novel view synthesis. In several domains, large-scale real-world datasets have been developed to support comprehensive benchmarking and to facilitate progress beyond scene-specific reconstruction. However, for distractor-free radiance fields, a large-scale dataset with clean and cluttered images per scene remains lacking, limiting the development. To address this gap, we introduce DF3DV-1K, a large-scale real-world dataset comprising 1,048 scenes, each providing clean and cluttered image sets for benchmarking. In total, the dataset contains 89,924 images captured using consumer cameras to mimic casual capture, spanning 128 distractor types and 161 scene themes across indoor and outdoor environments. A curated subset of 41 scenes, DF3DV-41, is systematically designed to evaluate the robustness of distractor-free radiance field methods under challenging scenarios. Using DF3DV-1K, we benchmark nine recent distractor-free radiance field methods and 3D Gaussian Splatting, identifying the most robust methods and the most challenging scenarios. Beyond benchmarking, we demonstrate an application of DF3DV-1K by fine-tuning a diffusion-based 2D enhancer to improve radiance field methods, achieving average improvements of 0.96 dB PSNR and 0.057 LPIPS on the held-out set (e.g., DF3DV-41) and the On-the-go dataset. We hope DF3DV-1K facilitates the development of distractor-free vision and promotes progress beyond scene-specific approaches. The dataset and leaderboard are available at https://johnnylu305.github.io/df3dv1k_web/.

papers.title: ProtoFlow: Mitigating Forgetting in Class-Incremental Remote Sensing Segmentation via Low-Curvature Prototype Flow
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing segmentation in real deployment is inherently continual: new semantic categories emerge, and acquisition conditions shift across seasons, cities, and sensors. Despite recent progress, many incremental approaches still treat training steps as isolated updates, which leaves representation drift and forgetting insufficiently controlled. We present ProtoFlow, a time-aware prototype dynamics framework that models class prototypes as trajectories and learns their evolution with an explicit temporal vector field. By jointly enforcing low-curvature motion and inter-class separation, ProtoFlow stabilizes prototype geometry throughout incremental learning. Experiments on standard class- and domain-incremental remote sensing benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, including up to 1.5-2.0 points improvement in mIoUall, together with reduced forgetting. These results suggest that explicitly modeling temporal prototype evolution is a practical and interpretable strategy for robust continual remote sensing segmentation. Open-source code:https://github.com/dudududke/protoflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProtoFlow，一个面向类增量遥感分割的时序感知原型动态框架。该方法把类别原型建模为轨迹，并用显式时间向量场学习其演化，同时约束低曲率运动与类间分离，以稳定增量学习过程中的原型几何。实验在标准类增量与域增量遥感基准上相对强基线提升 mIoUall 约 1.5–2.0 个百分点，并降低遗忘。作者认为显式建模原型时序演化是稳健持续遥感分割的一种实用且可解释的策略。
Motivation: 遥感分割在实际部署中具有持续学习特性，新语义类别不断出现，且采集条件随季节、城市和传感器变化。现有增量方法往往把训练步骤视为孤立更新，对表示漂移（representation drift）和遗忘的控制不足。
Method: 提出 ProtoFlow，将类原型视为轨迹，通过显式时间向量场学习其演化；联合施加低曲率运动约束和类间分离约束，以稳定增量学习中的原型几何。
Result: 在标准类增量和域增量遥感分割基准上，相对强基线获得一致提升，包括 mIoUall 最高提升 1.5–2.0 个百分点，并减少遗忘。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模原型时序演化是稳健持续遥感分割的一种实用、可解释策略，代码已开源。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: RecGen3D: Reconstruction-Guided 3D Generation in a Shared Canonical Space
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view 3D modeling represents a fundamental tension between reconstruction fidelity and generative plausibility. While feed-forward reconstruction excels in efficiency and input alignment, it often lacks the global priors needed for structural completeness. Conversely, diffusion-based generation provides rich geometric details but struggles with multi-view consistency. We present RecGen3D, a framework that combines these two paradigms into a cooperative system. To overcome inherent conflicts in coordinate spaces, 3D representations, and training objectives, we align both models within a shared canonical space. We employ decoupled cooperative learning, which maintains stable training while enabling seamless collaboration during inference. Specifically, the reconstruction module is adapted to provide canonical geometric anchors, while the diffusion generator leverages latent-augmented conditioning to refine and complete the geometric structure. Experimental results demonstrate that RecGen3D achieves superior fidelity and robustness, outperforming existing methods in creating complete and consistent 3D models from sparse observations.
papers.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 (Conference Papers). 21 pages including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/zsh523/RecGen3D
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RecGen3D 提出将前馈稀疏视图重建与扩散生成结合为协作框架，在共享规范空间中统一两者的坐标、表征与训练目标，以同时获得重建的输入对齐能力和生成的结构完整性。摘要报告其在稀疏观测下生成完整且一致的 3D 模型方面优于现有方法。
Motivation: 稀疏视图 3D 建模面临重建保真度与生成合理性之间的张力：前馈重建效率高且对齐输入，但缺乏全局先验；扩散生成细节丰富，但多视图一致性差。
Method: 将重建模块与扩散生成器对齐到共享规范空间，采用解耦协作学习以稳定训练并支持推理时协作；重建模块提供规范几何锚点，扩散生成器使用潜在增强条件来细化并补全几何结构。
Result: 实验表明 RecGen3D 在从稀疏观测创建完整一致的 3D 模型上优于现有方法，具有更好的保真度和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过共享规范空间与解耦协作学习可以有效融合重建和生成两种范式，解决其固有的空间、表征与目标冲突。

papers.title: Optimistic Online LQR via Intrinsic Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Optimism in the face of uncertainty is a popular approach to balance exploration and exploitation in reinforcement learning. Here, we consider the online linear quadratic regulator (LQR) problem, i.e., to learn the LQR corresponding to an unknown linear dynamical system by adapting the control policy online based on closed-loop data collected during operation. In this work, we propose Intrinsic Rewards LQR (IR-LQR), an optimistic online LQR algorithm that applies the idea of intrinsic rewards originating from reinforcement learning and the concept of variance regularization to promote uncertainty-driven exploration. IR-LQR typically retains the structure of a standard LQR synthesis problem by only modifying the cost function, resulting in an intuitively pleasing, simple, computationally cheap, and efficient algorithm. This is in contrast to existing optimistic online LQR formulations that rely on more complicated iterative search algorithms or solve computationally demanding optimization problems. We show that IR-LQR achieves the optimal worst-case regret rate of $\sqrt{T}$, and compare it to various state-of-the-art online LQR algorithms via numerical experiments carried out on an aircraft pitch angle control and an unmanned aerial vehicle example.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线线性二次调节器（online LQR）问题，提出一种名为 Intrinsic Rewards LQR（IR-LQR）的乐观在线控制算法。该方法把强化学习中的内在奖励（intrinsic rewards）思想与方差正则化（variance regularization）结合，通过仅修改代价函数来鼓励不确定性驱动的探索，从而保留标准 LQR 综合问题的结构。摘要称 IR-LQR 达到最优的最坏情况遗憾率 √T，并在飞机俯仰角控制和无人机两个数值算例中与多种现有在线 LQR 算法进行了比较。
Motivation: 在线 LQR 需要在未知线性动态系统上同时进行探索与利用，而现有乐观在线 LQR 方法通常依赖复杂的迭代搜索或计算代价很高的优化问题，缺少简单高效的替代方案。
Method: 提出 IR-LQR：借鉴强化学习的内在奖励和方差正则化思想，以不确定性驱动的形式修改 LQR 代价函数，使算法在保留标准 LQR 综合结构的同时实现乐观探索，因而计算便宜、实现简单。
Result: 摘要理论结果表明 IR-LQR 取得最优的最坏情况遗憾率 √T；数值实验中，在飞机俯仰角控制和无人机算例上与其列出的多种现有在线 LQR 算法进行了比较。
Conclusion: 作者强调 IR-LQR 相对于已有乐观在线 LQR 方法的主要优势是直观、简单、计算成本低且高效，同时仍具备最优的遗憾率保证。

papers.title: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Closed-loop Guidance of Fish Schools via Virtual Agents
papers.abstract_en: Guiding collective motion in biological groups is a fundamental challenge in understanding social interaction rules. In this study, we propose a deep reinforcement learning (RL) framework for closed-loop guidance of fish schools using virtual agents. These agents are controlled by policies trained via Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) in simulation and deployed in physical experiments with rummy-nose tetras (Petitella bleheri), enabling real-time interaction between artificial agents and live individuals. To cope with the stochastic behavior of live individuals, we designed a composite reward function that balances directional guidance with cohesion, providing a form of functional biomimicry at the level of the control objective. Our systematic evaluation of visual parameters showed that a white background and larger stimulus sizes produced the highest guidance efficacy among the tested conditions in physical trials. Furthermore, evaluation across group sizes and agent configurations indicated that guidance efficacy decreased as the group size increased from five to eight individuals, and that using multiple independently controlled agents did not improve guidance. Analysis of agent motion in the physical trials indicated that, under the learned policy, the agent moved toward the target while remaining close to the school and re-approached the school after advancing too far ahead. This study highlights the potential of deep RL for closed-loop guidance of fish schools and identifies challenges in maintaining artificial influence in larger groups.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 10 figures. Revised version with additional statistical and agent-behavior analyses. Corrections and improvements throughout
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于深度强化学习 (deep RL) 的闭环引导鱼群框架：在仿真中用 Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) 训练虚拟代理 (virtual agents) 的控制策略，再部署到红鼻剪刀鱼 (Petitella bleheri) 的实际实验中，实现人工代理与活体个体的实时交互。为应对活体个体行为的随机性，作者设计了兼顾方向引导与凝聚力的复合奖励函数。物理实验显示白色背景和较大刺激尺寸引导效果最佳，群体规模从五条增加到八条时引导效能下降，且多个独立控制的代理并未改善引导。代理运动分析表明，学习到的策略会使代理在贴近鱼群的同时向目标移动，并在超前过远时重新靠近鱼群。
Motivation: 引导生物群体的集体运动是理解社会交互规则的基础挑战，且需要与活体个体实时交互并适应其随机行为，现有方法难以满足这种闭环控制需求。
Method: 提出一种深度 RL 引导框架：虚拟代理的策略在仿真环境中通过 PPO 训练，随后部署到真实鱼群实验中；设计了平衡方向引导与凝聚力的复合奖励函数，并系统评估了视觉参数、群体规模和代理配置对引导效能的影响。
Result: 物理试验中，白色背景和更大的刺激尺寸产生最高的引导效能；当群体规模从五条增至八条时引导效能下降；使用多个独立控制的代理未带来改善。代理行为分析显示其会朝目标移动、保持贴近鱼群，并在过于超前时重新接近鱼群。
Conclusion: 研究展示了深度 RL 在鱼群闭环引导中的潜力，同时指出在更大群体中维持人工影响的挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: InverFill: One-Step Inversion for Enhanced Few-Step Diffusion Inpainting
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion-based models achieve photorealism in image inpainting but require many sampling steps, limiting practical use. Few-step text-to-image models offer faster generation, but naively applying them to inpainting yields poor harmonization and artifacts between the background and inpainted region. We trace this cause to random Gaussian noise initialization, which under low function evaluations causes semantic misalignment and reduced fidelity. To overcome this, we propose InverFill, a one-step inversion method tailored for inpainting that injects semantic information from the input masked image into the initial noise, enabling high-fidelity few-step inpainting. Instead of training inpainting models, InverFill leverages few-step text-to-image models in a blended sampling pipeline with semantically aligned noise as input, significantly improving vanilla blended sampling and even matching specialized inpainting models at low NFEs. Moreover, InverFill does not require real-image supervision and only adds minimal inference overhead. Extensive experiments show that InverFill consistently boosts baseline few-step models, improving image quality and text coherence without costly retraining or heavy iterative optimization.

TL;DR: 本文提出 InverFill，一种面向少步扩散修复 (few-step diffusion inpainting) 的一步反演方法，将带掩码输入图像的语义信息注入初始噪声，从而在低函数评估次数下改善背景与修复区域之间的协调性和保真度。该方法无需训练专用修复模型，也不要求真实图像监督，仅增加很小的推理开销。实验表明 InverFill 能持续提升基线少步模型的质量与文本一致性，并在低 NFE 下匹配专用修复模型。
Motivation: 少步文生图模型直接用于修复时会出现背景与修复区域协调差、伪影明显的问题，原因被归结为随机高斯噪声初始化在低函数评估次数下造成语义错位和保真度下降。
Method: InverFill 是为修复定制的一步反演方法，从输入掩码图像中提取语义信息并注入初始噪声，再将语义对齐的噪声输入到基于少步文生图模型的混合采样 (blended sampling) 流程中，从而替代随机噪声初始化。
Result: 摘要报告 InverFill 显著优于普通混合采样，在低 NFE 下可与专用修复模型相当，并能一致提升多种少步基线模型的图像质量和文本一致性。
Conclusion: InverFill 提供了一种轻量、免训练的思路来增强少步扩散修复，避免昂贵的重训练和繁重的迭代优化，但其结论主要限于少步文生图模型的修复场景。

papers.title: Radiometric fingerprinting of object surfaces using mobile laser scanning and semantic 3D road space models
papers.abstract_en: Although semantic 3D city models are internationally available and becoming increasingly detailed, the incorporation of material information remains largely untapped. However, a structured representation of materials and their physical properties could substantially broaden the application spectrum and analytical capabilities for urban digital twins. At the same time, the growing number of repeated mobile laser scans of cities and their street spaces yields a wealth of observations influenced by the material characteristics of the corresponding surfaces. To leverage this information, we propose radiometric fingerprints of object surfaces by grouping LiDAR observations reflected from the same semantic object under varying distances, incident angles, environmental conditions, sensors, and scanning campaigns. Our study demonstrates how 312.4 million individual beams acquired across four campaigns using five LiDAR sensors on the Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset (A2D2) vehicle can be automatically associated with 6368 individual objects of the semantic 3D city model. The model comprises a comprehensive and semantic representation of four inner-city streets at Level of Detail (LOD) 3 with centimeter-level accuracy. It is based on the CityGML 3.0 standard and enables fine-grained sub-differentiation of objects. The extracted radiometric fingerprints for object surfaces reveal recurring intra-class patterns that indicate class-dominant materials. The semantic model, the method implementations, and the developed geodatabase solution 3DSensorDB are released under: https://github.com/tum-gis/sensordb
papers.journal_ref: Schwab, B., Kolbe, T.H., 2026. Radiometric fingerprinting of object surfaces using mobile laser scanning and semantic 3D road space models. International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation 153, 105533
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用移动激光扫描点云为城市对象表面构建辐射指纹 (radiometric fingerprint)，方法是将来自同一语义对象的 LiDAR 观测按距离、入射角、环境条件、传感器和扫描批次分组。研究在 Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset (A2D2) 车辆采集的四次扫描、五个 LiDAR 传感器的 312.4 百万条光束上，将其自动关联到 CityGML 3.0 标准的 Level of Detail (LOD) 3 语义 3D 城市模型中的 6368 个对象。提取的辐射指纹显示出可重复的类内模式，表明存在类别主导性材质。
Motivation: 语义 3D 城市模型虽已广泛可用且日益精细，但材质信息的纳入仍未被充分利用；而重复的城市移动激光扫描数据中蕴含受表面材质影响的丰富观测。结构化的材质及其物理属性表示有望显著扩展城市数字孪生的应用范围与分析能力。
Method: 提出辐射指纹方法，将同一语义对象在不同距离、入射角、环境条件、传感器和扫描批次下反射的 LiDAR 观测分组，并与基于 CityGML 3.0 的语义 3D 道路空间模型自动关联，实现对对象的细粒度子区分。作者还开发了地理数据库解决方案 3DSensorDB。
Result: 摘要报告四个扫描活动、五个 LiDAR 传感器的 312.4 百万条光束被自动关联到 6368 个语义 3D 城市模型对象，模型覆盖四条内城街道，达到厘米级精度的 LOD3。提取的辐射指纹显示反复出现的类内模式，指示类主导性材质。
Conclusion: 作者在 GitHub 上发布了语义模型、方法实现和 3DSensorDB，展示了利用重复移动激光扫描构建城市对象表面结构化材质表示的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Fréchet regression of multivariate distributions with nonparanormal transport
papers.abstract_en: Regression with distribution-valued responses and Euclidean predictors has gained increasing scientific relevance. While methodology for univariate distributional data has advanced rapidly in recent years, multivariate distributions, which additionally encode dependence across univariate marginals, have received less attention and pose computational and statistical challenges. In this work, we address these challenges with a new regression approach for multivariate distributional responses, in which distributions are modeled within the semiparametric nonparanormal family. By incorporating the nonparanormal transport (NPT) metric -- an efficient closed-form surrogate for the Wasserstein distance -- into the Fréchet regression framework, our approach decomposes the problem into separate regressions of marginal distributions and their dependence structure, facilitating both efficient estimation and granular interpretation of predictor effects. We provide theoretical justification for NPT, establishing its bi-Lipschitz equivalence to the Wasserstein distance and proving that it mitigates the curse of dimensionality. We further prove uniform convergence guarantees for regression estimators, both when distributional responses are fully observed and when they are estimated from empirical samples, attaining fast convergence rates comparable to the univariate case. The utility of our method is demonstrated via simulations and an application to continuous glucose monitoring data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对具有多元分布值响应和欧氏预测变量的回归问题，提出一种基于半参数非参数正态族（nonparanormal family）的建模方法，将非参数正态传输（NPT）度量嵌入Fréchet回归框架，从而把问题分解为边缘分布回归与依赖结构回归。理论上证明了NPT与Wasserstein距离的双Lipschitz等价性并缓解维数灾难，同时给出回归估计量的一致收敛保证。模拟与连续血糖监测数据应用展示了方法的实用性。
Motivation: 多元分布值响应相比一元分布数据研究较少，且需要额外编码边缘分布之间的依赖关系，带来计算和统计上的挑战。
Method: 将非参数正态传输（NPT）度量——一种Wasserstein距离的高效闭式替代——引入Fréchet回归框架，将多元分布分解为边缘分布与依赖结构分别回归，以实现高效估计和可解释的预测效应。
Result: 摘要证明NPT与Wasserstein距离是双Lipschitz等价的，能缓解维数灾难；对完全观测和由经验样本估计的分布响应，回归估计量均获得一致收敛保证，且收敛速度与一元情形相当；模拟和连续血糖监测数据实验验证了方法的效用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法的优势在于将多元分布回归分解为边缘和依赖结构两部分，兼顾估计效率与解释性，且NPT的理论性质保证了其在高维场景下的可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Self-Evaluation for Diffusion Language Models via Sequence Regeneration
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently attracted significant attention for their ability to enhance diversity, controllability, and parallelism. However, their non-sequential, bidirectionally masked generation makes quality assessment difficult, underscoring the need for effective self-evaluation. In this work, we propose DiSE, a simple yet effective self-evaluation confidence quantification method for dLLMs. DiSE quantifies confidence by computing the probability of regenerating the tokens in the entire generated sequence, given the full context. This method enables more efficient and reliable quality assessment by leveraging token regeneration probabilities, facilitating both likelihood estimation and robust uncertainty quantification. Building upon DiSE, we further introduce a flexible-length generation framework, which adaptively controls the sequence length based on the model's self-assessment of its own output. We analyze and validate the feasibility of DiSE from the perspective of dLLM generalization, and empirically demonstrate that DiSE is positively correlated with both semantic coherence and answer accuracy. Extensive experiments on likelihood evaluation, uncertainty quantification, and flexible-length generation further confirm the effectiveness of the proposed DiSE. Project page: https://zhongzero.github.io/DiSE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiSE，一种面向扩散大语言模型 (dLLM) 的简单有效的自评估置信度量化方法：通过计算在完整上下文条件下重新生成整条生成序列中所有 token 的概率来衡量模型置信度。作者从 dLLM 泛化角度分析并验证了 DiSE 的可行性，并将其进一步用于灵活长度生成框架，根据模型对自身输出的评估自适应控制序列长度。实验在似然评估、不确定性量化和灵活长度生成上验证了方法有效性。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型采用非顺序、双向掩码生成，导致生成质量的评估变得困难，因此需要有效的自评估机制来支持质量判断。
Method: 提出 DiSE，通过计算给定完整上下文时整条生成序列 token 的重生成概率来量化置信度，既用于似然估计也用于不确定性量化；并基于 DiSE 构建灵活长度生成框架，依据模型自评估结果自适应调整生成序列长度。
Result: 摘要报告 DiSE 与语义连贯性和答案正确性均呈正相关，且在似然评估、不确定性量化和灵活长度生成等任务上的大量实验进一步确认了其有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于 token 重生成概率的 DiSE 能为 dLLM 提供更高效可靠的生成质量评估，同时支持似然估计和鲁棒的不确定性量化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PhotoBench: Beyond Visual Matching Towards Personalized Intent-Driven Photo Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Personal photo albums are not merely collections of static images but living, ecological archives defined by temporal continuity, social entanglement, and rich metadata, which makes the personalized photo retrieval non-trivial. However, existing retrieval benchmarks rely heavily on context-isolated web snapshots, failing to capture the multi-source reasoning required to resolve authentic, intent-driven user queries. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhotoBench, the first benchmark constructed from authentic, personal albums. It is designed to shift the paradigm from visual matching to personalized multi-source intent-driven reasoning. Based on a rigorous multi-source profiling framework, which integrates visual semantics, spatial-temporal metadata, social identity, and temporal events for each image, we synthesize complex intent-driven queries rooted in users' life trajectories. Extensive evaluation on PhotoBench exposes two critical limitations: the modality gap, where unified embedding models collapse on non-visual constraints, and the source fusion paradox, where agentic systems perform poor tool orchestration. These findings indicate that the next frontier in personal multimodal retrieval lies beyond unified embeddings, necessitating robust agentic reasoning systems capable of precise constraint satisfaction and multi-source fusion. Our PhotoBench is available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhotoBench，据称是第一个基于真实个人相册构建的照片检索基准，目的是把范式从视觉匹配转向个性化的多源意图驱动推理。作者通过一个多源画像框架整合每张图像的视觉语义、时空元数据、社交身份和时间事件，并合成源于用户生活轨迹的复杂意图查询。广泛的评估暴露出模态差距和源融合悖论两个关键局限。
Motivation: 现有检索基准依赖上下文孤立的网络快照，无法捕捉解决真实、意图驱动用户查询所需的多源推理。个人相册具有时间连续性、社交纠缠和丰富元数据，使个性化照片检索变得非平凡，而现有基准未覆盖这一点。
Method: 提出 PhotoBench 基准，基于真实个人相册构建；采用严格的多源画像框架，整合视觉语义、空间-时间元数据、社交身份和时间事件，并据此合成复杂意图驱动查询。
Result: 大量评估显示两个关键局限：模态差距——统一嵌入模型在非视觉约束上崩溃；源融合悖论——agentic 系统在工具编排上表现不佳。
Conclusion: 作者认为个人多模态检索的下一个前沿不在于统一嵌入，而在于能够精确约束满足和多源融合的强健 agentic 推理系统；PhotoBench 已公开可用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mind the Style: Impact of Communication Style on Human-Chatbot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Conversational agents increasingly mediate everyday digital interactions, yet the effects of their communication style on user experience and task success remain insufficiently understood. Addressing this gap, we report a between-subject user study in which participants interacted with one of two versions of a chatbot called NAVI, which assisted them in an interactive map-based 2D navigation task. The two chatbot versions were designed to differ primarily in communication style: one used a friendly and supportive tone, while the other used a direct and task-focused tone. We also included a control condition where participants did not interact with a chatbot but received the step-by-step navigation instructions. The friendly chatbot significantly increased users' communication satisfaction and was associated with higher task success than the direct chatbot. However, participants in the control condition achieved the highest task success overall, suggesting that chatbot interaction may introduce overhead in tasks that can be completed effectively using straightforward instructions. We did not find significant evidence that gender moderated the effects of communication style, although exploratory gender-stratified analyses suggested patterns that warrant further investigation. Finally, we found limited evidence of global linguistic accommodation, with only selective feature-level alignment. These findings suggest that chatbot communication style influences users' perceptions of conversational agents and may improve performance relative to less supportive chatbot designs, but the overall value of chatbot interaction depends on the task context. The study highlights the need for task-sensitive, transparent and carefully evaluated communication-style choices in conversational-agent design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一项被试间用户研究，考察聊天机器人的沟通风格如何影响用户体验与任务成功。参与者使用名为 NAVI 的聊天机器人完成基于地图的二维导航任务，机器人分为友好支持型与直接任务型两种风格，另设无聊天机器人的纯指令控制条件。结果显示友好型机器人显著提升沟通满意度，且任务成功率高于直接型机器人，但控制条件的任务成功率最高。
Motivation: 对话代理日益介入日常数字交互，但其沟通风格对用户体验和任务成功的影响仍缺乏充分理解，该文针对这一空白开展实证研究。
Method: 采用被试间设计，参与者分别与友好型或直接型 NAVI 聊天机器人交互以完成导航任务，并设置接收逐步指令的无机器人控制条件；同时记录性别变量并分析语言顺应（linguistic accommodation）现象。
Result: 友好型机器人显著提高用户的沟通满意度，并比直接型机器人带来更高的任务成功率；然而控制条件（无聊天机器人）的任务成功率总体最高，表明聊天机器人交互可能给本可凭简明指令完成的任务引入额外开销。未发现性别对沟通风格效应的显著调节作用，探索性分层分析提示值得进一步研究的模式；全局语言顺应证据有限，仅存在选择性的特征级对齐。
Conclusion: 聊天机器人沟通风格会影响用户对对话代理的感知，并可能相对于支持性较差的机器人设计提升表现，但聊天机器人交互的总体价值取决于任务情境；研究强调对话代理设计中需要任务敏感、透明且经过仔细评估的沟通风格选择。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Investigating Target Class Influence on Neural Network Compressibility for Energy-Autonomous Avian Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Biodiversity loss poses a significant threat to humanity, making wildlife monitoring essential for assessing ecosystem health. Avian species are ideal subjects for this due to their popularity and the ease of identifying them through their distinctive songs. Traditionalavian monitoring methods require manual counting and are therefore costly and inefficient. In passive acoustic monitoring, soundscapes are recorded over long periods of time. The recordings are analyzed to identify bird species afterwards. Machine learning methods have greatly expedited this process in a wide range of species and environments, however, existing solutions require complex models and substantial computational resources. Instead, we propose running machine learning models on inexpensive microcontroller units (MCUs) directly in the field. Due to the resulting hardware and energy constraints, efficient artificial intelligence (AI) architecture is required. In this paper, we present our method for avian monitoring on MCUs. We trained and compressed models for various numbers of target classes to assess the detection of multiple bird species on edge devices and evaluate the influence of the number of species on the compressibility of neural networks. Our results demonstrate significant compression rates with minimal performance loss. We also provide benchmarking results for different hardware platforms and evaluate the feasibility of deploying energy-autonomous devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在微控制器单元（MCU）上部署鸟类声学监测模型，并探讨目标类别数量对神经网络可压缩性的影响。作者针对不同目标类别数训练并压缩模型，摘要报告实现了显著压缩率且性能损失极小，同时提供了多种硬件平台的基准测试结果，并评估了能量自主（energy-autonomous）设备部署的可行性。
Motivation: 传统鸟类监测依赖人工计数，成本高且效率低；现有机器学习方案需要复杂模型和大量计算资源，难以胜任野外长期被动声学监测。作者希望将模型直接部署在廉价的MCU上，以降低硬件和能耗约束。
Method: 提出在MCU上运行机器学习模型进行鸟类监测的方法：针对不同目标类别数量训练并压缩神经网络，评估物种数量对模型可压缩性的影响，并在不同硬件平台上进行基准测试，以判断能量自主设备部署的可行性。
Result: 结果显示可获得显著的压缩率，同时性能损失很小；摘要还提供了不同硬件平台的基准结果，并评估了部署能量自主设备的可行性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为在MCU上进行高效鸟类监测可行，压缩效果与目标类别数量相关，且适用于能量自主的野外部署场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Interpretable clustering via optimal multi-way decision trees
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is a fundamental unsupervised learning technique for uncovering data structures to facilitate knowledge discovery and decision-making. While clustering accuracy is crucial, interpretability significantly impacts the practical value of clustering results, particularly in high-risk decision-making contexts. Although decision-tree-based clustering methods offer high interpretability through explicit splitting rules, existing approaches often rely on local greedy search or require expensive computational costs limited to binary splits, resulting in deeper, less interpretable trees. To overcome these limitations, we establish a high-performance computational framework named Interpretable Clustering via Optimal Multi-way Trees (ICOMT). We make three primary contributions. First, we propose a new discretization method for numerical features using one-dimensional K-means clustering to capture data distributions. Second, we formulate a binary linear optimization (BLO) problem to guarantee tree optimality. Third, extensive validation on four public datasets demonstrates that our ICOMT method outperforms existing baselines, achieving superior clustering accuracy while maintaining shallow, concise tree structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为 ICOMIT（Interpretable Clustering via Optimal Multi-way Trees）的计算框架，利用最优多叉决策树实现可解释聚类。方法通过一维 K-means 对数值特征进行离散化，并将树的结构最优性建模为二元线性优化（BLO）问题。在四个公开数据集上的实验显示，相比现有基线，ICOMIT 在保持浅层简洁树结构的同时获得更优的聚类精度。
Motivation: 现有基于决策树的聚类方法虽然具有显式分裂规则的高可解释性，但常依赖局部贪心搜索或受限于二元分裂导致较深且可解释性下降。作者希望在不牺牲计算可行性的前提下，直接优化多叉树结构以同时保证聚类精度与树的可解释性。
Method: 提出两阶段方案：首先用一维 K-means 聚类对数值特征进行离散化以捕捉数据分布；随后将其嵌入二元线性优化问题，对多叉决策树的整体结构进行全局最优求解，从而替代贪心生长和二元分裂限制。
Result: 在四个公开数据集上的实验表明，ICOMIT 优于现有基线方法，在获得更好聚类精度的同时保持了浅层、简洁的树结构。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过全局最优的多叉树求解，可以在聚类任务中同时获得高精度与高可解释性，为高风险的决策场景提供更具实用价值的聚类结果。

papers.title: Degree-Mass Message Passing for Betweenness Ranking in Directed and Undirected Networks
papers.abstract_en: Computing the importance of nodes in networks is a long-standing fundamental problem that has driven extensive study of various centrality measures. A particularly well-known centrality measure is betweenness centrality, whose exact computation becomes prohibitive on large-scale networks. Graph Neural Network (GNN) models have thus been proposed to predict the ranking of nodes by betweenness centrality. However, existing GNN-based methods either have graph-size-dependent parameter counts or are limited to undirected graphs. We propose a lightweight GNN architecture that exploits the empirically observed relationship between betweenness centrality and multi-hop degree mass. This motivates the use of degree masses as size-invariant node features. To improve generalization, we train on synthetic graphs whose degree distributions more closely match those of real-world networks, including directed and undirected scale-free graphs and uniformly directed hyperbolic random graphs. We evaluate our model on 14 real-world networks spanning eight domains, including social, email, and citation networks, across both directed and undirected regimes. The experiments show that our model improves the Kendall $τ_b$ correlation by up to 24.6\% on undirected and 10.9\% on directed graphs, while using 56$\times$ fewer parameters than the lightest competing GNN baseline and achieving competitive inference time, with up to a 24.5$\times$ speedup on selected directed graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个轻量级图神经网络 (GNN) 架构，用于预测节点介数中心性 (betweenness centrality) 的排序，适用于有向和无向网络。模型利用介数中心性与多跳度质量 (degree mass) 之间的经验关系，采用大小不变的特征，并在度分布匹配真实网络的合成图上训练。在 14 个真实网络上的实验显示，该方法在 Kendall τ_b 相关性上最高提升 24.6%（无向图）和 10.9%（有向图），同时参数量比最轻的 GNN 基线少 56 倍，并在部分有向图上获得最高 24.5 倍的推理加速。
Motivation: 介数中心性在大规模网络上的精确计算代价高昂，现有基于 GNN 的预测方法要么参数数量依赖图规模，要么只能处理无向图。
Method: 提出轻量级 GNN 架构，利用介数中心性与多跳度质量的关系，将度质量作为大小不变节点特征；训练数据使用度分布接近真实网络的合成图，包括有向和无向无标度图以及均匀有向双曲随机图。
Result: 在覆盖 8 个领域、14 个真实有向和无向网络上，模型将 Kendall τ_b 相关性最多提高 24.6%（无向）和 10.9%（有向），参数量比最轻的 GNN 基线少 56 倍，推理时间在选定有向图上最高加速 24.5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用度质量作为不变特征并配合匹配真实度分布的合成训练图，可以在有向和无向网络上实现高效且可泛化的介数中心性排序预测。

papers.title: Infinite-dimensional generative diffusions via Doob's h-transform
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces a rigorous framework for defining generative diffusion models in infinite dimensions via Doob's h-transform. Rather than relying on time reversal of a noising process, a reference diffusion is forced towards the target distribution by an exponential change of measure. Compared to existing methodology, this approach readily generalises to the infinite-dimensional setting, hence offering greater flexibility in the diffusion model. The construction is derived rigorously under verifiable conditions, and bounds with respect to the target measure are established. We show that the forced process under the changed measure can be approximated by minimising a score-matching objective and validate our method on both synthetic and real data.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在无限维空间中定义生成扩散模型的严谨框架，利用 Doob's h-transform 通过指数测度变化将参考扩散强制推向目标分布，而非依赖加噪过程的时间反转。作者在可验证条件下给出了构造的严格推导，并建立了相对目标测度的界限，证明该强制过程可通过最小化分数匹配目标来近似，并在合成与真实数据上验证了方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型框架主要依赖时间反转来构造生成过程，在无限维推广上存在灵活性不足的问题，而许多科学应用（如函数空间中的数据）需要无限维生成模型。
Method: 使用 Doob's h-transform 对参考扩散施加指数测度变化，强迫过程收敛于目标分布；推导在可验证条件下完成，并证明可以通过最小化 score-matching 目标来近似该强制过程。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在合成数据和真实数据上均得到验证，并建立了相对于目标测度的误差界。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法能自然推广到无限维设置，为生成扩散模型提供更大的灵活性，但摘要未讨论具体应用领域的局限。

papers.title: Driving with DINO: Vision Foundation Features as a Unified Bridge for Sim-to-Real Generation in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the emergence of Controllable Video Diffusion, existing Sim2Real methods for autonomous driving video generation typically rely on explicit intermediate representations to bridge the domain gap. However, these modalities face a fundamental Consistency-Realism Dilemma. Low-level signals (e.g., edges, blurred images) ensure precise control but compromise realism by "baking in" synthetic artifacts, whereas high-level priors (e.g., depth, semantics, HDMaps) facilitate photorealism but lack the structural detail required for consistent guidance. In this work, we present Driving with DINO (DwD), a novel framework that leverages Vision Foundation Module (VFM) features as a unified bridge between the simulation and real-world domains. We first identify that these features encode a spectrum of information, from high-level semantics to fine-grained structure. To effectively utilize this, we employ Principal Subspace Projection to discard the high-frequency elements responsible for "texture baking," while concurrently introducing Random Channel Tail Drop to mitigate the structural loss inherent in rigid dimensionality reduction, thereby reconciling realism with control consistency. Furthermore, to fully leverage DINOv3's high-resolution capabilities for enhancing control precision, we introduce a learnable Spatial Alignment Module that adapts these high-resolution features to the diffusion backbone. Finally, we propose a Causal Temporal Aggregator employing causal convolutions to explicitly preserve historical motion context when integrating frame-wise DINO features, which effectively mitigates motion blur and guarantees temporal stability. Project page: https://albertchen98.github.io/DwD-project/

Motivation: 现有基于可控视频扩散的 Sim2Real 方法依赖显式中间表示，但低层信号（如边缘、模糊图像）虽能精确控制却会烘焙仿真伪影，高层先验（如深度、语义、HDMap）虽更真实却缺乏细粒度结构，难以同时满足一致性与真实感。

Result: 摘要定性地报告该方法能调和真实感与控制一致性、缓解运动模糊并保证时间稳定性，但未报告具体数据集指标或数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 VFM 特征可以作为仿真与真实域之间的统一桥梁，且其提出的多组件设计能同时改善纹理真实性与时序一致性。

papers.title: Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is the method of choice for training models in setups where the objective function can only be evaluated by sampling from the model. Our key observation is that when the feedback is terminal and binary, models implicitly induce a likelihood over correct rollouts. Maximum likelihood would be the natural framework in such settings, but RL is used instead as a workaround to the non-differentiability. We prove that the standard, expected-reward RL formulation is only a first-order approximation of the likelihood. To remedy this mismatch, we introduce Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL), a compute-indexed family of sample-based objectives that interpolate between expected-reward RL and maximum likelihood as sampling compute is scaled. The resulting objective is a one-line change to standard RL implementations. MaxRL Pareto-dominates existing methods in all tested models and tasks, achieves up to $20\times$ gains in test-time scaling efficiency over GRPO, and scales more favorably with additional training data and compute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Maximum Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (MaxRL)，一种以计算量为索引的样本目标族，在期望奖励强化学习与最大似然之间插值。作者证明标准期望奖励 RL 只是似然的一阶近似，而 MaxRL 只需对标准 RL 实现做一行修改。实验显示 MaxRL 在测试的模型和任务上帕累托优于现有方法，在测试时扩展效率上比 GRPO 最高提升 20 倍，并随训练数据和计算量的增加扩展更有利。
Motivation: 当反馈是终端且二值的，模型隐式地对正确轨迹诱导出似然，此时最大似然是自然框架，但非可微性使人们转而使用 RL。作者证明标准期望奖励 RL 公式只是似然的一阶近似，存在不匹配。
Method: 引入 MaxRL，一个 compute-indexed 的样本目标族，通过缩放采样计算量在期望奖励 RL 与最大似然之间插值；该目标是对标准 RL 实现的一行更改。
Result: 摘要报告 MaxRL 在所有测试模型和任务上帕累托支配现有方法，测试时扩展效率相对 GRPO 最高提升 20 倍，并且随额外训练数据和计算量扩展更有利。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MaxRL 弥合了期望奖励 RL 与最大似然之间的差距，为终端二值反馈场景提供更优的样本目标。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Generalization Measures under Controlled Covariate Shift: A Regime-Aware Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Predicting generalization from quantities available before target-test evaluation remains a central challenge in deep learning. The systematic benchmark of Jiang et al. (2020) evaluated many generalization measures, but it focused on independent and identically distributed (IID) settings. We revisit this problem for image classifiers evaluated under controlled corruptions and perturbations. Our study uses CIFAR-10-C/P, where the label space and task remain fixed while the input images are degraded or perturbed. This setting also allows us to revisit the robustness concerns raised by Dziugaite et al. (2020), who showed that the apparent reliability of generalization measures can depend strongly on experimental conditions. Our experiments show that the usefulness of generalization measures is strongly regime-dependent. In our exploratory decision analysis across three CNN-style architectures, sharpness- and input-gradient-based measures are among the leading individual signals, whereas family results are close and architecture dependent. Optimization-based measures, Information Criteria, and Sharpness-based measures provide additional regime-dependent signals in correlation or local-reliability analyses. Together, these findings suggest that model selection should not rely only on measures favored by IID evaluation. Instead, within the evaluated CIFAR-10-C/P setting and architectures, generalization measures should be treated as regime-dependent ranking signals whose utility must be evaluated for the intended corruption or perturbation setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控协变量偏移（controlled covariate shift）下重新审视深度学习泛化度量的可靠性，使用 CIFAR-10-C/P 图像分类基准，在标签空间和任务不变、仅输入图像退化或扰动的条件下评估多种泛化度量。摘要报告称，泛化度量的有效性强烈依赖于具体机制（regime）；在三种 CNN 架构的探索性决策分析中，sharpness 和输入梯度类度量是较领先的单一信号，但结果接近且依赖架构。作者认为模型选择不应仅依赖 IID 评估中表现好的度量，而应将泛化度量视为机制依赖的排序信号。
Motivation: Jiang et al. (2020) 的系统基准主要关注独立同分布（IID）设置，而实际场景常出现协变量偏移；Dziugaite et al. (2020) 也指出泛化度量的表观可靠性可能强烈依赖实验条件。因此需要在受控退化与扰动下重新评估这些度量。
Method: 使用 CIFAR-10-C/P 设置，固定标签空间和任务但对输入图像施加受控退化或扰动；在三种 CNN 风格架构上开展探索性决策分析，比较 sharpness、输入梯度、优化类度量、信息准则等，并结合相关性与局部可靠性分析评估其效用。
Result: 摘要报告称泛化度量的实用性强烈依赖实验机制；sharpness 和 input-gradient 类度量是领先的单个信号，但各度量族（family）结果接近且架构依赖；优化类度量、信息准则和 sharpness 类度量在相关性或局部可靠性分析中提供额外的机制依赖信号。
Conclusion: 在评估的 CIFAR-10-C/P 设置和架构内，模型选择不应只依赖 IID 评估下受青睐的度量；泛化度量应视为依赖目标损坏或扰动机制的排序信号，其效用需要针对预期设置进行评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SEISMO: Explanation-Aware, Trajectory-Conditioned LLM Agents for Sample-Efficient Molecular Optimisation
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing molecules to achieve desired properties is a central bottleneck across the chemical sciences, particularly in the pharmaceutical industry, where it underlies the discovery of new drugs. Since molecular property evaluation often relies on costly and rate-limited oracles, such as experimental assays, molecular optimization must be highly sample-efficient. To address this, we introduce SEISMO, an LLM agent for inference-time molecular optimisation that turns information routinely available alongside the oracle score, but discarded by existing methods, into an explicit guidance signal. Rather than treating the oracle as a scalar black box, SEISMO conditions each proposal on a natural-language task description, the full optimization trajectory, and machine-readable feedback derived from post-hoc explainability methods and sub-score decompositions. Across a wide range of drug-discovery-relevant tasks, this consistently improves sample efficiency over existing optimisers as well as zero-shot LLM generation, with gains growing as explanatory feedback is enriched. In practice, medicinal chemists can inspect the agent's reasoning and intervene to steer generation in natural language, keeping them central to molecular optimisation projects.
papers.comment: Fabian P. Krüger and Andrea Hunklinger contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SEISMO，一个面向推理时分子优化的 LLM agent，将或acles 返回的标量分数之外的信息（自然语言任务描述、完整优化轨迹、由事后可解释性方法与子分数分解得到的机器可读反馈）转化为显式引导信号，以提高分子优化的样本效率。在多种药物发现相关任务上，该方法一致优于现有优化器和零样本 LLM 生成，且反馈越丰富增益越大。
Motivation: 分子性质评估常依赖昂贵且受限的 oracles（如实验测定），现有方法只把 oracle 当作标量黑盒，丢弃了顺带可得的信息，导致样本效率不足，制约药物发现中的分子优化。
Method: SEISMO 在每次提案时同时以自然语言任务描述、完整优化轨迹和由事后可解释性方法（post-hoc explainability）与子分数分解（sub-score decompositions）生成的机器可读反馈为条件，替代单纯的黑盒标量 oracle 建模。
Result: 在广泛的药物发现相关任务上，SEISMO 相对现有优化器与零样本 LLM 生成持续提升样本效率，且随着解释性反馈的丰富程度增加，增益进一步扩大。
Conclusion: 该方法使药物化学家能够检查 agent 的推理过程并通过自然语言干预生成方向，将人类保持在分子优化项目的核心位置；摘要未提及具体数值或消融细节。
