papers.title: Deep Models, Shallow Alignment: Uncovering the Granularity Mismatch in Neural Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Neural visual decoding is a central problem in brain-computer interface research, aiming to reconstruct human visual perception and to elucidate the structure of neural representations. Recent contrastive neural visual decoding methods commonly align neural signals with the final embeddings of pretrained vision encoders. However, such representations are optimized for high-level semantic invariance, whereas EEG/MEG signals contain information spanning multiple levels of visual abstraction, potentially creating a representational granularity mismatch. Motivated by prior evidence that brain representations correspond to multiple levels of the DNN hierarchy, we propose Shallow Alignment, a granularity-calibration framework that systematically explores intermediate visual representations as alignment targets for neural decoding. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Shallow Alignment significantly outperforms standard final-layer alignment, with performance gains ranging from 22% to 58% across diverse vision backbones. Notably, our approach reveals a positive scaling trend in neural visual decoding, enabling decoding performance to improve consistently with the capacity of pre-trained vision backbones. We further conduct systematic empirical analyses to shed light on the mechanisms underlying the observed performance gains. Code is available at https://github.com/yangdu-neuroai/shallow-alignment.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026), ISSN 2835-8856
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经视觉解码中对齐目标粒度过粗的问题，提出 Shallow Alignment 框架，将 EEG/MEG 神经信号与预训练视觉编码器的中间层表示而非最终嵌入进行对齐。在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法相比标准最终层对齐显著提升解码性能，增益在 22% 至 58% 之间，并展现出解码性能随预训练视觉 backbone 容量增强而提升的正向扩展趋势。
Motivation: 现有对比神经解码方法通常将神经信号与预训练视觉编码器的最终嵌入对齐，但这些表示优化的是高层语义不变性，而 EEG/MEG 信号包含多个视觉抽象层级的信息，两者之间存在表征粒度不匹配 (granularity mismatch)。
Method: 提出 Shallow Alignment，一种粒度校准 (granularity-calibration) 框架，系统性地探索预训练视觉编码器的中间层表示作为神经解码的对齐目标。
Result: 在多个基准和多种视觉 backbone 上，Shallow Alignment 显著优于标准最终层对齐，性能提升范围为 22% 到 58%；同时实验观察到神经视觉解码的正向扩展趋势，即解码性能随预训练 backbone 容量增加而一致提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为脑表征对应 DNN 层级结构的先前证据支持中间层对齐的有效性，并通过系统的经验分析揭示性能提升机制；代码已公开。

papers.title: CFM: Language-aligned Concept Foundation Model for Vision
papers.abstract_en: Language-aligned vision foundation models perform strongly across diverse downstream tasks. Yet, their learned representations remain opaque, making interpreting their decision-making difficult. Recent work decompose these representations into human-interpretable concepts, but provide poor spatial grounding and are limited to image classification tasks. In this work, we propose CFM, a language-aligned concept foundation model for vision that provides fine-grained concepts, which are human-interpretable and spatially grounded in the input image. When paired with a foundation model with strong semantic representations, we get explanations for any of its downstream tasks. Examining local co-occurrence dependencies of concepts allows us to define concept relationships through which we improve concept naming and obtain richer explanations. On benchmark data, we show that CFM provides performance on classification, segmentation, and captioning that is competitive with opaque foundation models while providing fine-grained, high quality concept-based explanations. papers.title: AgentOCR: Reimagining Agent History via Optical Self-Compression
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) enable agentic systems trained with reinforcement learning (RL) over multi-turn interaction, but practical deployment is bottlenecked by rapidly growing textual histories that inflate token and memory costs. We introduce AgentOCR, a framework that exploits visual tokens' superior information density by representing the accumulated observation-action history as a compact rendered image. To make multi-turn rollouts scalable, AgentOCR proposes segment optical caching. By decomposing history into hashable segments and maintaining a visual cache, this mechanism eliminates redundant re-rendering. Beyond fixed rendering, AgentOCR introduces agentic self-compression, where the agent actively emits a compression rate and is trained with compression-aware reward to adaptively balance task success and token efficiency. We conduct extensive experiments on challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and search-based QA. Remarkably, AgentOCR preserves over 95\% of text-based agent performance while substantially reducing token consumption (>50\%), yielding consistent token and memory efficiency. Further analysis validates a 20$\times$ rendering speedup from optical caching and effective self-compression balancing. Our code is available at https://github.com/langfengQ/AgentOCR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentOCR，一个面向 LLM 智能体的历史压缩框架，将多轮交互的观察-行动历史渲染成紧凑图像以利用视觉 token 的高信息密度。框架包含分段光学缓存 (segment optical caching) 以避免冗余重渲染，并引入 agentic self-compression，让智能体主动输出压缩率并用压缩感知奖励训练，以权衡任务成功率和 token 效率。实验在 ALFWorld 和基于搜索的 QA 基准上进行，声称保留超过 95% 的基于文本智能体性能，同时减少超过 50% 的 token 消耗，并验证光学缓存带来 20 倍渲染加速。
Motivation: LLM 智能体在多轮强化学习训练和实际部署中，不断增长的文本历史会迅速膨胀 token 与内存开销，成为规模化部署的瓶颈。
Method: AgentOCR 将累积的观察-行动历史表示为紧凑渲染图像；将历史分解为可哈希分段并维护视觉缓存以消除重复渲染；智能体主动发射压缩率，并配合压缩感知奖励 (compression-aware reward) 训练，从而自适应平衡任务成功与 token 效率。
Result: 在 ALFWorld 和搜索式 QA 基准上，AgentOCR 保留了超过 95% 的文本智能体性能，同时 token 消耗减少超过 50%；进一步分析验证光学缓存带来 20 倍渲染加速，并且 self-compression 能有效平衡性能与效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为视觉 token 的高信息密度结合光学缓存与自适应压缩，可以显著降低多轮智能体系统的 token 和内存开销；论文标注为 work in progress，代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Double Machine Learning of Continuous Treatment Effects with Additive Instrumental Variables
papers.abstract_en: Estimating causal effects of continuous treatments is a common problem in practice, for example, in studying average dose-response functions. Classical analyses typically assume that all confounders are fully observed, whereas in real-world applications, unmeasured confounding often persists. In this article, we propose a novel framework for the identification of average dose-response functions using instrumental variables, thereby mitigating bias induced by unobserved confounders. We introduce the concept of a uniform regular weighting function and consider covering the treatment space with a finite collection of open sets. On each of these sets, such a weighting function exists, allowing us to identify the average dose-response function locally within the corresponding region. For estimation, we propose an augmented inverse probability weighted score for continuous treatments with instrumental variables under a debiased machine learning framework, and provide practical guidance for adaptively constructing regular weighting functions from the data. We also propose a falsification test for the additive instrumental variable condition and develop a testing procedure for assessing the validity of regular weighting functions. We further establish the asymptotic properties of the resulting estimators based on kernel regression or empirical risk minimization as well as the theoretical validity of the proposed testing procedures. Finally, we conduct both simulation and empirical studies to assess the finite-sample performance of the proposed methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用工具变量识别连续处理下平均剂量-反应函数 (average dose-response function) 的框架，以缓解未观测混杂带来的偏差。作者引入均匀正则加权函数的概念，在有限个开集覆盖处理空间后于局部实现识别，并基于去偏机器学习提出增广逆概率加权得分。论文还给出自适应构造正则加权函数的建议、针对加性工具变量条件的伪造检验以及正则加权函数有效性的检验程序，并建立了基于核回归或经验风险最小化估计量的渐近性质。
Motivation: 经典因果推断通常假设所有混杂因素都被观测到，但实际应用中未观测混杂普遍存在；连续处理效应的估计（如平均剂量-反应函数）在存在未观测混杂时缺乏稳健的识别与估计方法。
Method: 提出一个使用工具变量的识别框架：引入均匀正则加权函数 (uniform regular weighting function)，用有限个开集覆盖处理空间，在每个开集上利用该加权函数局部识别平均剂量-反应函数；估计上采用去偏机器学习框架下的增广逆概率加权得分，并提供从数据中自适应构造正则加权函数的实用指导；同时提出针对加性工具变量条件的伪造检验和加权函数有效性检验。
Result: 摘要报告了所提估计量在核回归或经验风险最小化下的渐近性质以及检验过程的理论有效性，并通过仿真和实证研究评估了所提方法的有限样本表现。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能够利用工具变量减轻未观测混杂造成的偏差，并提供了识别、估计、检验的一整套方法；其适用性与有限样本行为由仿真和实证研究支持。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GroupSegment-SHAP: Shapley Value Explanations with Group-Segment Players for Multivariate Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Multivariate time-series models achieve strong predictive performance in healthcare, industry, energy, and finance, but how they combine cross-variable interactions with temporal dynamics remains unclear. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are widely used for interpretation. However, existing time-series variants typically treat the feature and time axes independently, fragmenting structural signals formed jointly by multiple variables over specific intervals. We propose GroupSegment SHAP (GS-SHAP), which constructs explanatory units as group-segment players based on cross-variable dependence and distribution shifts over time, and then quantifies each unit's contribution via Shapley attribution. We evaluate GS-SHAP across four real-world domains: human activity recognition, power-system forecasting, medical signal analysis, and financial time series, and compare it with KernelSHAP, TimeSHAP, SequenceSHAP, WindowSHAP, and TSHAP. GS-SHAP improves deletion-based faithfulness (DeltaAUC) by about 1.7x on average over time-series SHAP baselines, while reducing wall-clock runtime by about 40 percent on average under matched perturbation budgets. A financial case study shows that GS-SHAP identifies interpretable multivariate-temporal interactions among key market variables during high-volatility regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GroupSegment SHAP (GS-SHAP)，一种面向多元时间序列的 Shapley 解释方法。它将解释单元构建为基于跨变量依赖和时间分布变化的 group-segment players，从而同时刻画变量间交互与时间动态。在四个真实领域的数据集上，GS-SHAP 相比多种时间序列 SHAP 基线，将基于删除的忠实度 (DeltaAUC) 平均提升约 1.7 倍，并在匹配扰动预算下平均减少约 40% 的墙钟运行时间。
Motivation: 现有 SHAP 时间序列变体通常将特征轴和时间轴独立处理，导致由多个变量在特定时间区间内联合形成的结构信号被碎片化，难以解释模型如何组合跨变量交互与时序动态。
Method: 提出 GS-SHAP，根据跨变量依赖和时间上的分布变化构造解释单元，即以 group-segment 为玩家的 Shapley 归因方法，对每个单元贡献进行量化。
Result: 在人体活动识别、电力系统预测、医疗信号分析和金融时间序列四个领域评估，并与 KernelSHAP、TimeSHAP、SequenceSHAP、WindowSHAP 和 TSHAP 比较。GS-SHAP 在删除式忠实度 (DeltaAUC) 上平均提升约 1.7 倍，同时平均减少约 40% 的运行时间。金融案例显示其能识别高波动期关键市场变量的可解释多元时序交互。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GS-SHAP 能够捕捉多变量与时间维度联合形成的结构信号，并以更低的计算成本提供更忠实的解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Actively Learning Joint Contours of Multiple Computer Experiments
papers.abstract_en: Contour location---the process of sequentially training a surrogate model to identify the design inputs that result in a pre-specified response value from a single computer experiment---is a well-studied active learning problem. Here, we tackle a related but distinct problem: identifying the input configuration that returns pre-specified values of multiple computer experiments simultaneously. Motivated by computer experiments of the rotational torques acting upon a vehicle in flight, we aim to identify stable flight conditions that result in zero torque forces. We propose a ``joint contour location'' (jCL) scheme that strikes a strategic balance between exploring the multiple response surfaces while exploiting learning of the intersecting contours. Rather than working exploration and exploitation into a single acquisition function, we devise two distinct acquisition schemes with a decision rule to choose between the two, which also provides a natural stopping criterion if no solution is present. We employ traditional Gaussian processes (GPs), multitask GPs, and deep GPs, but our jCL procedure is applicable to any surrogate that can provide posterior predictive distributions. Our jCL designs significantly outperform existing (single response) CL strategies, optimization-based alternatives, and previous strategies for targeting joint contours, enabling us to efficiently locate the optimal configurations for our motivating computer experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多计算机实验的联合等高线定位 (joint contour location) 问题，即在同一输入配置下同时使多个实验输出达到预定响应值。作者提出 jCL 方案，将探索多个响应曲面与利用相交等高线这两种目标拆分为两个采集函数，并用一个决策规则在两者间切换，同时提供无解情形下的自然停止准则。该方法适用于任何能给出后验预测分布的代理模型，文中用传统 GP、多任务 GP 和深度 GP 验证，并在飞行扭矩模拟中用于寻找零扭矩的稳定飞行条件。
Motivation: 单响应的等高线定位 (contour location) 已被广泛研究，但多个计算机实验需要同时达到预定输出值的问题与之不同且缺乏专门方法。实际动机来自飞行器飞行时的旋转扭矩实验，需要找到使三个扭矩分量同时为零的稳定飞行条件。
Method: 提出 jCL 主动学习方案，将探索与利用分别设计为两个不同的采集函数，并通过一个决策规则在二者之间选择；该规则还天然提供无解时的停止准则。算法不依赖特定代理模型，可采用传统 GP、多任务 GP 或深度 GP 等任意可提供后验预测分布的替代模型。
Result: 摘要报告 jCL 设计显著优于现有的单响应等高线定位策略、基于优化的替代方法以及此前针对联合等高线的策略，并能高效定位其飞行扭矩激励实验中即零扭矩的最优输入配置。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将探索与利用分离并配以决策规则，可以更有效地解决多实验联合等高线的定位问题，且该方法对代理模型的选择具有通用性。

summary_sections.motivation: 单响应的等高线定位 (contour location) 已被广泛研究，但多个计算机实验需要同时达到预定输出值的问题与之不同且缺乏专门方法。实际动机来自飞行器飞行时的旋转扭矩实验，需要找到使三个扭矩分量同时为零的稳定飞行条件。
summary_sections.method: 提出 jCL 主动学习方案，将探索与利用分别设计为两个不同的采集函数，并通过一个决策规则在二者之间选择；该规则还天然提供无解时的停止准则。算法不依赖特定代理模型，可采用传统 GP、多任务 GP 或深度 GP 等任意可提供后验预测分布的替代模型。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 jCL 设计显著优于现有的单响应等高线定位策略、基于优化的替代方法以及此前针对联合等高线的策略，并能高效定位其飞行扭矩激励实验中即零扭矩的最优输入配置。摘要未给出具体数值。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为将探索与利用分离并配以决策规则，可以更有效地解决多实验联合等高线的定位问题，且该方法对代理模型的选择具有通用性。

papers.title: Fine-tuning an ECG Foundation Model to Predict Coronary CT Angiography Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains a major global public health burden, yet scalable pre-imaging risk stratification tools are limited. In this multicenter study, we developed and validated an artificial intelligence-enabled electrocardiography (AI-ECG) model using coronary computed tomographic angiography (CCTA) as the anatomical reference to predict vessel-specific hemodynamically significant stenosis ($\geq 70\%$ for RCA, LAD, LCX; $\geq 50\%$ for LM). The model was evaluated in internal and external cohorts, clinically normal ECGs, and prespecified demographic and clinical subgroups. It showed discrimination across vessels in internal validation and consistent external and normal ECG performance. Predicted probabilities increased with CCTA-defined stenosis severity and were converted into vessel-specific low-, intermediate-, and high-risk strata. Calibration and decision curve analyses supported its clinical utility. Integration with guideline-based pre-test probability improved risk reclassification, enhanced rule-out performance, and reduced the gray-zone proportion. In longitudinal follow-up, model-defined risk groups showed clear separation in major adverse cardiovascular events. Waveform- and attribution-based analyses identified structured ECG differences and physiologically meaningful signal regions linked to high-risk predictions. These results support AI-ECG as a feasible tool for pre-imaging risk stratification and clinical triage, warranting prospective validation in broader clinical settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报道了一项多中心研究，利用以冠状动脉CT血管造影（CCTA）为解剖参考的AI-ECG模型，预测血管特异性血流动力学显著狭窄（RCA/LAD/LCX≥70%，LM≥50%）。模型在内部、外部队列及临床正常心电图中均显示判别能力，预测概率随狭窄严重程度增加，并转化为血管特异性低/中/高危分层。校准与决策曲线分析支持临床效用，与指南预检概率整合可改善风险重分类并减少灰区比例；纵向随访显示风险组主要不良心血管事件分离，波形与归因分析识别出与高风险预测相关的结构化ECG差异。
Motivation: 冠心病（CAD）是全球重大公共卫生负担，但缺乏可扩展的成像前风险分层工具，现有方法难以在CT血管造影前有效识别高风险患者。
Method: 利用CCTA作为解剖参考，开发并验证人工智能心电图（AI-ECG）模型，预测各血管（RCA、LAD、LCX、LM）的血流动力学显著狭窄，并在内部、外部队列及预设亚组中评估，结合指南预检概率进行风险分层。
Result: 模型在内部验证、外部验证及临床正常心电图中均显示跨血管判别能力；预测概率随CCTA狭窄严重程度升高；整合预检概率改善了风险重分类、增强排除性能并降低灰区比例；纵向随访中模型定义的風險組在主要不良心血管事件上明显分离。
Conclusion: 摘要认为AI-ECG可作为成像前风险分层和临床分诊的可行工具，但仍需在更广泛的临床环境中进行前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Spatially Aware Dictionary-Free Koopman Eigenfunction Identification for Modeling and Control
papers.abstract_en: A spatially aware dictionary-free eigenfunction discovery (SADFED) framework is proposed for identification of low-rank Koopman models from data without prescribing a lifting dictionary, kernel, or neural-network eigenfunction architecture. A reference trajectory is selected and used to determine the Koopman modes by regularized least squares (LS). Then, a transformed temporal basis allows the eigenfunction values at all sampled initial conditions to be obtained by a second regularized LS projection. Consequently, only the real and imaginary parts of the eigenvalues remain as the optimization variables. Interpolation of the identified eigenfunction samples reveals their spatial structure, enabling numerical estimation of their gradients. A joint objective combines trajectory reconstruction error with a normalized Koopman partial differential equation (KPDE) residual, promoting spatial consistency with the KPDE over the sampled region and serving as a physics-informed regularizer. The method is evaluated on a system with analytical Koopman eigenfunctions, the FitzHugh-Nagumo system, the van der Pol oscillator, the Duffing system, and a two-spool turbojet engine. The examples demonstrate recovery of known eigenfunctions, sensitivity to reference trajectory and hyperparameters, limit-cycle harmonics and isochrons, discontinuous indicator eigenfunctions and isostables, symmetry exploitation, and construction of state-dependent lifted input dynamics. For the turbojet example, the identified model is further used for state estimation and design of a gain-scheduled tracking linear quadratic Gaussian controller. The results indicate the applicability of SADFED to Koopman spectral identification and control-oriented modeling of nonlinear dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种空间感知且无字典的 Koopman 特征函数识别框架 SADFED，用于从数据中辨识低秩 Koopman 模型，无需预设 lifting dictionary、核函数或神经网络特征函数架构。方法通过选取参考轨迹并两次正则化最小二乘分别确定 Koopman 模态与初始条件下的特征函数值，再联合轨迹重构误差与归一化 Koopman 偏微分方程残差作为物理信息正则项。在 FitzHugh-Nagumo、van der Pol、Duffing 及双轴涡扇发动机等系统上的实验表明其能恢复已知特征函数、处理极限环谐波与等时线等结构，并可用于状态估计与控制。
Motivation: 现有 Koopman 模型辨识通常需要预先指定 lifting dictionary、核函数或神经网络架构，这限制了模型对非线性动力系统的适用性与可解释性。
Method: 选取参考轨迹并通过正则化最小二乘确定 Koopman 模态，再借助变换后的时间基用第二次正则化最小二乘投影得到所有采样初始条件上的特征函数值，使优化变量仅剩特征值的实部与虚部。对识别出的特征函数样本进行插值以估计梯度，并构建包含轨迹重构误差与归一化 Koopman PDE 残差的联合目标，作为空间一致性约束和物理信息正则器。
Result: 在具有解析 Koopman 特征函数的系统、FitzHugh-Nagumo、van der Pol、Duffing 和双轴涡扇发动机上，该方法展示了已知特征函数恢复、对参考轨迹与超参数的敏感性、极限环谐波与等时线、不连续指示特征函数与等稳定线、对称性利用以及状态相关提升输入动力学的构造。对涡扇发动机，所辨识模型还用于状态估计和增益调度线性二次高斯(LQG)跟踪控制器设计。
Conclusion: 摘要指出 SADFED 适用于非线性动力系统的 Koopman 谱辨识与控制导向建模。

papers.title: When Better Teachers Don't Make Better Students: Revisiting Knowledge Distillation for CLIP Models in VQA
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across multimodal tasks, yet their substantial computational demands hinder efficient deployment. Knowledge distillation (KD) has emerged as a powerful approach for building lightweight but competitive models, with strong evidence from both language and vision domains. However, its application to VLMs, particularly CLIP-style models, remains limited, often constrained to small-scale teachers and narrow evaluation tasks such as classification or retrieval. In this work, we present the first systematic study of distillation across a range of CLIP-style teacher models, ranging from standard baselines to large-scale state-of-the-art models. Contrary to trends observed in NLP and vision, we find that stronger teachers do not consistently yield better students; in fact, existing distillation frameworks often fail to scale, leading to degraded performance in downstream multimodal tasks such as visual question answering. Our findings challenge prevailing assumptions in KD and point toward new directions for designing parameter-efficient multimodal models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统地研究 CLIP 风格视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的知识蒸馏 (knowledge distillation, KD)，覆盖从标准基线到大规模 SOTA 教师模型，并以视觉问答 (VQA) 等下游多模态任务为评估目标。与 NLP 和视觉领域常见的趋势相反，摘要报告更强的教师并不稳定地带来更好的学生模型，现有蒸馏框架在规模扩展时甚至导致下游性能下降。作者认为这一发现挑战了 KD 领域的主流假设，并为参数高效多模态模型的设计提供了新方向。
Motivation: 尽管 KD 在语言和视觉领域已被证明能构建轻量且具竞争力的模型，但其在 CLIP 风格 VLM 上的应用仍然有限，通常局限于小规模教师和分类、检索等窄任务。缺乏对不同规模教师及其对 VQA 等下游多模态任务影响的系统研究。
Method: 对一系列 CLIP 风格教师模型进行系统的蒸馏对比研究，教师规模从标准基线到大规模 SOTA 模型，并评估学生模型在下游多模态任务（如视觉问答）上的表现。
Result: 摘要报告强教师并不一致地产生更好的学生模型；现有蒸馏框架往往无法随教师规模扩展，反而导致 VQA 等下游任务性能下降。
Conclusion: 研究结果挑战了 NLP 和视觉领域关于 KD 的普遍假设，并为设计参数高效的多模态模型指明了新方向。

papers.title: What Color Is the Text? A Benchmark for Hallucination Induced by Image-Embedded Prompt
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Embedded Stroop, a controlled diagnostic paradigm for measuring image-embedded prompt interference in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), where the query is rendered directly inside the visual input. Using the What-Color-Is-the-Text (WCIT) benchmark, which covers 59 fine-grained colors under Standard, Flipped, and Masked variants, we evaluate 16 proprietary and open-source models. To distinguish semantic capture from general color-naming failure, we decompose model responses into Accuracy, Stroop Hallucination Rate (SHR; answering the embedded word rather than the true text color), and Other Error Rate, and validate the effect with permutation tests, with 56 of 64 conditions remaining significant after FDR correction. Although exact color accuracy is low (6.3%) under the 59-color vocabulary, mapping predictions to 11 basic color families shows that models retain coarse color perception (38.4%) while still exhibiting a substantial SHR (21.6%). A conditional analysis restricted to colors correctly named in the Standard setting further confirms the effect, with pooled conditional SHR exceeding 50\%. Masking or flipping the embedded text reduces Stroop hallucinations, suggesting that semantic legibility can dominate visual color perception in MLLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Embedded Stroop 受控诊断范式与 What-Color-Is-the-Text (WCIT) 基准，把查询直接渲染在图像内部，考察多模态大模型 (MLLMs) 中图像内嵌文本提示对颜色判断的干扰。作者评估了 16 个专有和开源模型，覆盖 Standard、Flipped、Masked 三种变体下的 59 种细粒度颜色，并将响应分解为 Accuracy、Stroop 幻觉率 (SHR) 与 Other Error Rate。摘要报告精确颜色准确率仅 6.3%，映射到 11 个基本色族后粗粒度颜色感知为 38.4%，SHR 为 21.6%；掩蔽或翻转嵌入文本会减少 Stroop 幻觉，表明语义可读性可能主导视觉颜色感知。
Motivation: 多模态大模型可能被图像中嵌入的文本语义所干扰，从而在视觉属性（如颜色）判断上产生幻觉，但现有研究缺少受控诊断手段来区分这种干扰与一般颜色命名失败。
Method: 设计 Embedded Stroop 诊断范式与 WCIT 基准，包含 Standard、Flipped、Masked 三种变体；将模型回答分解为 Accuracy、SHR 与 Other Error Rate，并用置换检验 (permutation tests) 验证效应的显著性，再经 FDR 校正。
Result: 在 16 个模型上，59 色词汇下精确颜色准确率仅 6.3%，映射到 11 个基本色族后准确率为 38.4%，SHR 达 21.6%；FDR 校正后 64 个条件中有 56 个仍显著。限定在 Standard 设置下正确命名的颜色做条件分析时，pooled conditional SHR 超过 50%，且掩蔽或翻转嵌入文本能降低幻觉率。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准与分解指标能够可靠地测量 MLLM 中图像内嵌提示引起的 Stroop 幻觉，并提示语义可读性可能压过视觉颜色感知；摘要也表明精确颜色词汇下模型整体准确率极低，效应需在粗粒度色族和条件分析层面才能稳健确认。

summary_sections.result: 在 16 个模型上，59 色词汇下精确颜色准确率仅 6.3%，映射到 11 个基本色族后准确率为 38.4%，SHR 达 21.6%；FDR 校正后 64 个条件中有 56 个仍显著。限定在 Standard 设置下正确命名的颜色做条件分析时，pooled conditional SHR 超过 50%，且掩蔽或翻转嵌入文本能降低幻觉率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该基准与分解指标能够可靠地测量 MLLM 中图像内嵌提示引起的 Stroop 幻觉，并提示语义可读性可能压过视觉颜色感知；摘要也表明精确颜色词汇下模型整体准确率极低，效应需在粗粒度色族和条件分析层面才能稳健确认。

papers.title: BIPPO: Budget-Aware Independent PPO for Energy-Efficient Federated Learning Services
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) is a promising machine learning solution in large-scale IoT systems, guaranteeing load distribution and privacy. However, FL does not natively consider infrastructure efficiency, a critical concern for systems operating in resource-constrained environments. Several Reinforcement Learning (RL) based solutions offer improved client selection for FL; however, they do not consider infrastructure challenges, such as resource limitations and device churn. Furthermore, the training of RL methods is often not designed for practical application, as these approaches frequently do not consider generalizability and are not optimized for energy efficiency. To fill this gap, we propose BIPPO (Budget-aware Independent Proximal Policy Optimization), which is an energy-efficient multi-agent RL solution that improves performance. We evaluate BIPPO on two image classification tasks run in a highly budget-constrained setting, with FL clients training on non-IID data, a challenging context for vanilla FL. The improved sampler of BIPPO enables it to increase the mean accuracy compared to non-RL mechanisms, traditional PPO, and IPPO. In addition, BIPPO only consumes a negligible proportion of the budget, which stays consistent even if the number of clients increases. Overall, BIPPO delivers a performant, stable, scalable, and sustainable solution for client selection in IoT-FL.
papers.comment: Submission to IEEE Transactions on Services Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BIPPO（Budget-aware Independent Proximal Policy Optimization），一种面向能量受限联邦学习（FL）场景的多智能体强化学习客户端选择方法。作者在高度预算受限、客户端数据非独立同分布（non-IID）的图像分类任务上评估该方法，报告其相比非 RL 机制、传统 PPO 和 IPPO 提高了平均准确率，且预算消耗占比极小，并随客户端数量增加保持稳定。
Motivation: FL 在大规模 IoT 系统中具备负载均衡和隐私优势，但自身不原生考虑基础设施效率；已有基于强化学习的客户端选择方案没有考虑资源限制、设备动态变化（device churn）等基础设施挑战，且训练设计常忽视泛化性与能量效率。
Method: 提出 BIPPO，一种预算感知的独立近端策略优化（independent PPO）多智能体强化学习方案，用于 FL 客户端选择，显式纳入预算约束并面向资源受限环境进行设计。
Result: 在两类图像分类任务、高度预算受限且 non-IID 数据的设置下，BIPPO 相比非 RL 机制、传统 PPO 和 IPPO 提升了平均准确率；其预算消耗占比可忽略，且该占比在客户端数量增加时保持一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为 BIPPO 为 IoT-FL 中的客户端选择提供了性能良好、稳定、可扩展且可持续的解决方案；摘要未讨论在非图像任务或更大规模异构场景下的适用范围。

papers.title: Benchmarking noisy label detection methods
papers.abstract_en: Label noise is a common problem in real-world datasets, affecting both model training and validation. Clean data are essential for achieving strong performance and ensuring reliable evaluation. While various techniques have been proposed to detect noisy labels (or label errors), there is no clear consensus on optimal approaches. We perform a comprehensive benchmark of detection methods by decomposing them into three fundamental components: gathering strategy (in-sample vs out-of-sample), label disagreement measure, and aggregation method. This decomposition can be applied to many existing detection methods, and enables systematic comparison across diverse approaches. To fairly compare methods, we propose a unified benchmark task: detecting a fraction of training samples equal to the dataset's noise rate. We also introduce a novel metric: the false negative rate at this fixed operating point. Our evaluation spans vision and tabular datasets under both synthetic and real-world noise conditions. We identify that in-sample gathering using average probability aggregation combined with the logit margin as the label disagreement measure achieves the best results across most scenarios. Our findings provide practical guidance for designing new detection methods and selecting techniques for specific applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对噪声标签检测方法进行系统性基准测试，将检测方法分解为三个基本组件：收集策略（in-sample vs out-of-sample）、标签不一致度量（label disagreement measure）和聚合方法。作者提出统一的基准任务——检测与数据集噪声率等比例的训练样本，并引入该固定操作点下的假阴性率（false negative rate）作为新指标，在视觉与表格数据集的合成和真实噪声条件下评估多种方法。结果显示，in-sample收集、平均概率聚合与logit margin作为标签不一致度量的组合在大多数场景下表现最佳。
Motivation: 真实数据集普遍存在标签噪声，影响模型训练与验证的可靠性；现有噪声标签检测方法众多但缺乏统一共识，难以公平比较和选择最优方案。
Method: 将检测流程分解为收集策略（样本内 vs 样本外）、标签不一致度量与聚合方法三个组件，提出统一的基准任务（检测比例等于数据集噪声率的训练样本），并设计在固定操作点上的假阴性率作为新评估指标。
Result: 在视觉和表格数据集、合成与真实噪声条件下，in-sample收集、平均概率聚合与logit margin标签不一致度量组合在大多数场景下获得最佳结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为研究结果为设计新的噪声标签检测方法以及为具体应用选择检测技术提供了实用指导。

papers.title: LTR-ICD: A Ranking-Aware Framework for Automatic ICD Coding
papers.abstract_en: Clinical notes contain unstructured text provided by clinicians during patient encounters. These notes are usually accompanied by a sequence of diagnostic codes following the International Classification of Diseases (ICD). Correctly assigning and ordering ICD codes is essential for medical diagnosis and reimbursement. However, automating this task remains challenging. State-of-the-art methods treated this problem as a classification task, leading to ignoring the order of ICD codes that is essential for different purposes. In this work, as a first attempt, we approach this task from a retrieval system perspective to consider the order of codes, thus formulating this problem as a classification and ranking task. Our results and analysis show that the proposed framework has a superior ability to identify high-priority codes compared to other methods. For instance, our model's accuracy in correctly ranking primary diagnosis codes is 47%, compared to 20% for the state-of-the-art classifier. Additionally, in terms of classification metrics, the proposed model achieves a micro- and macro-F1 scores of 0.6065 and 0.2904, respectively, surpassing the previous best model with scores of 0.6035 and 0.2741.
papers.journal_ref: M. Mansoori, A. Soliman, and F. Etminani. 2026. In Proceedings of the 17th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology and Health Informatics (BCB '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LTR-ICD，一个将自动 ICD 编码从纯分类任务重新定义为分类与排序任务的框架，首次从检索系统视角考虑 ICD 代码的顺序。实验表明该框架在识别高优先级代码（尤其是主要诊断代码的排序）上显著优于现有分类器，并在分类指标上也有小幅提升。
Motivation: 现有 ICD 自动编码方法将任务视为多标签分类，忽略 ICD 代码顺序对医疗诊断和报销的重要性；作者指出状态最优方法因此无法区分代码优先级。
Method: 提出从检索系统视角建模 ICD 编码任务，将问题形式化为分类与排序 (classification and ranking) 的联合任务，并引入排序感知的学习目标来考虑诊断代码的顺序。
Result: 模型对主要诊断代码正确排序的准确率为 47%，而状态最优分类器为 20%；在分类指标上，模型取得 micro-F1 0.6065 和 macro-F1 0.2904，超过此前最优的 0.6035 和 0.2741。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将 ICD 编码视为排序任务能更好地识别高优先级代码，且分类性能不降反升；该工作是首次从检索/排序视角处理 ICD 代码顺序问题。

papers.title: Perseus: Interactive Time Series Segmentation with Sparse Supervision via Stateful Memory
papers.abstract_en: Real-world systems, ranging from industrial manufacturing to wearable healthcare, generate multivariate time series with hierarchical states ranging from coarse regimes to fine-grained events. Unlike zero- or few-shot segmentation, our setting uses dense state labels for model training. Sparse expert prompts provide inference-time corrections that resolve sequence-specific ambiguities without retraining. In practice, this feedback is grouped around selected events or transitions, leaving large portions of the timeline unprompted. The prompt-based sliding-window baselines evaluated here are stateless with respect to user interaction history: they use guidance only within the current window and cannot retain it across these gaps. To address this, we propose Perseus (Persistent Segmentation with User Supervision), a framework that transitions from synchronous processing to asynchronous state management. Perseus decouples supervision from inference via a distinct Write-Read architecture: grouped user cues are asynchronously encoded into a persistent memory bank (Write), which is then actively queried by the inference engine (Read) to service unprompted windows. This mechanism bridges supervision gaps by conditioning predictions on a global history of interactions rather than solely on local inputs. Extensive experiments on six datasets demonstrate that while evaluated stateless prompting baselines degrade significantly under grouped supervision, Perseus maintains robustness and achieves up to 85% accuracy improvement in multi-granularity settings. Code and preprocessing instructions are available at https://github.com/blacksnail789521/Perseus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Perseus，一个用于多元时间序列分段 (time series segmentation) 的交互式框架，针对稀疏专家提示 (sparse expert prompts) 下的序列级歧义解析问题。与零样本或少样本分段不同，该方法使用密集状态标签训练，并在推理时通过异步 Write-Read 架构将用户反馈写入持久记忆库 (memory bank)，供推理引擎查询以服务未提示的时间窗口。在六个数据集上的实验表明，在分组监督 (grouped supervision) 下，无状态滑动窗口基线性能显著下降，而 Perseus 保持鲁棒性，在多粒度设置中最高提升 85% 准确率。
Motivation: 实际系统中多变量时间序列具有从粗粒度状态到细粒度事件的分层结构，现有监督分段模型在推理时依赖用户提示解决歧义，但基于滑动窗口的基准方法对交互历史无状态，无法跨未提示的时间间隙保留用户指导，导致在稀疏分组反馈下性能显著退化。
Method: 提出 Perseus 框架，将同步处理转为异步状态管理：通过独立的 Write-Read 架构，将分组用户提示异步编码进持久记忆库 (Write)，再由推理引擎主动查询该记忆库 (Read) 以服务未提示窗口，从而基于全局交互历史而非仅局部输入进行条件预测。
Result: 在六个数据集上的实验显示，所评估的无状态提示基线在分组监督下性能显著下降，而 Perseus 保持鲁棒性，并在多粒度设置中实现最高 85% 的准确率提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过持久记忆解耦监督与推理，可以有效弥合稀疏用户反馈之间的监督间隙，提升交互式时间序列分段在间歇性监督下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SKILL-RAG: Self-Knowledge Induced Learning and Filtering for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has significantly improved the performance of large language models (LLMs) on knowledge-intensive tasks in recent years. However, since retrieval systems may return irrelevant content, incorporating such information into the model often leads to hallucinations. Thus, identifying and filtering out unhelpful retrieved content is a key challenge for improving RAG performance.To better integrate the internal knowledge of the model with external knowledge from retrieval, it is essential to understand what the model "knows" and "does not know" (which is also called "self-knowledge"). Based on this insight, we propose SKILL-RAG (Self-Knowledge Induced Learning and Filtering for RAG), a novel method that leverages the model's self-knowledge to determine which retrieved documents are beneficial for answering a given query. We design a reinforcement learning-based training framework to explicitly elicit self-knowledge from the model and employs sentence-level granularity to filter out irrelevant content while preserving useful knowledge.We evaluate SKILL-RAG using Llama2-7B and Qwen3-8B on several question answering benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that SKILL-RAG not only improves generation quality but also significantly reduces the number of input documents, validating the importance of self-knowledge in guiding the selection of high-quality retrievals.
papers.comment: The author has decided not to pursue further development or publication of this work. Since the current manuscript represents an incomplete research project and no revised version is planned, the author requests that the article be withdrawn
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKILL-RAG（Self-Knowledge Induced Learning and Filtering for RAG），利用模型自身的 self-knowledge 判断检索文档对当前查询是否有用，并通过基于强化学习的训练框架在句子粒度上过滤无关内容、保留有用知识。作者在 Llama2-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 上于多个问答基准评估，结果显示该方法不仅提升生成质量，还显著减少输入文档数量。需要注意的是，作者已决定不再推进该工作并请求撤回论文。
Motivation: RAG 中检索系统可能返回与查询无关的内容，将这些信息纳入模型常导致幻觉；因此识别并过滤无帮助的检索内容是提升 RAG 性能的关键挑战，而理解模型的 self-knowledge（模型知道自己知道什么、不知道什么）有助于融合内部知识与外部检索知识。
Method: 提出 SKILL-RAG 方法，设计基于强化学习的训练框架显式激发模型的 self-knowledge，并采用句子级粒度（sentence-level granularity）过滤不相关内容，同时保留有用知识，以决定哪些检索文档对回答问题有益。
Result: 使用 Llama2-7B 和 Qwen3-8B 在多个问答基准上的实验表明，SKILL-RAG 不仅提升了生成质量，还显著减少了输入文档数量，验证了 self-knowledge 在指导高质量检索选择中的作用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 self-knowledge 对引导选择高质量检索内容的重要性；但作者注明该投稿是不完整的研究项目，已决定不再继续开发或发表，并请求撤回。

papers.title: Optimizing Multi-Modality Trackers via Significance-Regularized Tuning
papers.abstract_en: This paper tackles the critical challenge of optimizing multi-modality trackers by effectively adapting pre-trained models for RGB data. Existing fine-tuning paradigms oscillate between excessive flexibility and over-restriction, both leading to suboptimal plasticity-stability trade-offs. To mitigate this dilemma, we propose a novel significance-regularized fine-tuning framework, which delicately refines the learning process by incorporating intrinsic parameter significance. Through a comprehensive investigation of the transition from pre-trained to multi-modality contexts, we identify that parameters crucial to preserving foundational patterns and managing cross-domain shifts are the primary drivers of this issue. Specifically, we first probe the tangent space of pre-trained weights to measure and orient prior significance, dedicated to preserving generalization. Subsequently, we characterize transfer significance during the fine-tuning phase, emphasizing adaptability and stability. By incorporating these parameter significance terms as unified regularization, our method markedly enhances transferability across modalities. Extensive experiments showcase the superior performance of our method, surpassing current state-of-the-art techniques across various multi-modal tracking benchmarks. The source code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/zhiwen-xdu/SRTrack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态目标跟踪中如何有效微调预训练 RGB 模型的问题，提出一种基于参数重要性的正则化微调框架（SRTrack）。作者通过将预训练权重切线空间中的先验重要性与微调阶段的迁移重要性统一为正则项，以平衡可塑性与稳定性，并在多个多模态跟踪基准上超过现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 现有微调范式在过度灵活与过度限制之间摇摆，导致多模态跟踪器中预训练模型适配 RGB 数据时的塑性-稳定性权衡欠佳，跨域迁移效果受限。
Method: 提出 significance-regularized 微调框架：首先探测预训练权重的切线空间来度量和引导先验重要性以保留泛化能力，随后在微调阶段刻画迁移重要性以兼顾适应性与稳定性，并将这两类参数重要性项作为统一正则化约束训练过程。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在多种多模态跟踪基准上超越了当前最先进技术，且代码与模型已公开。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式利用参数重要性实现更优的跨模态可迁移性，缓解了多模态跟踪微调中的塑性-稳定性困境。

papers.title: AIRL-S: Unifying Reinforcement Learning and Search-Based Test-Time Scaling via Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling strategies for Large Language Models predominantly rely on either reinforcement learning with sparse outcome rewards or search-based methods guided by static Process Reward Models. However, outcome-based RL often suffers from training instability and sample inefficiency, while static PRMs require expensive step-wise supervision and are susceptible to reward hacking due to distributional shifts. In this paper, we introduce AIRL-S, a unified framework that integrates Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization. By inferring a dense, step-wise reward model directly from reference trajectories, AIRL-S eliminates the dependency on labeled process data and uses the same learned PRM as both a training signal and a verifier for search-based TTS. Extensive evaluations across eight benchmarks in mathematics, science, and code generation demonstrate that our policy model improves average performance by 9\% over the base model, matching GPT-4o. We further analyze how the AIRL and GRPO objectives complement each other and how the learned PRM transfers across generators and search algorithms, establishing a robust and cost-effective methodology for scaling test-time computation in complex reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AIRL-S，一个将对抗逆向强化学习 (Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning) 与 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) 相结合的统一框架，用于大语言模型的测试时扩展 (test-time scaling)。通过直接从参考轨迹推断稠密的逐步奖励模型，AIRL-S 不再依赖人工标注的过程数据，并把学到的过程奖励模型 (PRM) 同时用作训练信号和搜索式测试时扩展的验证器。在数学、科学和代码生成的八个基准上，策略模型平均性能比基础模型提升 9%，达到 GPT-4o 水平。
Motivation: 现有测试时扩展策略主要依赖稀疏结果奖励的强化学习或由静态过程奖励模型 (PRM) 引导的搜索方法；前者训练不稳定且样本效率低，后者需要昂贵的逐步监督并容易因分布偏移遭受奖励欺骗 (reward hacking)。
Method: AIRL-S 将对抗逆向强化学习与 GRPO 结合，从参考轨迹中学习稠密的逐步奖励模型，从而消除对标注过程数据的依赖；同一个已学 PRM 既作为训练信号，也作为搜索式测试时扩展的验证器。
Result: 在数学、科学和代码生成共八个基准上的评估显示，策略模型相较基础模型平均提升 9% 的性能并匹配 GPT-4o；文章还分析了 AIRL 与 GRPO 目标的互补性，以及所学 PRM 在不同生成器和搜索算法之间的迁移能力。
Conclusion: 作者表明 AIRL-S 为复杂推理任务中扩展测试时计算提供了一种稳健且成本有效的方法，并强调其无需过程标注、复用同一 PRM 的设计。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: CulTrace: Tracing Internal Cultural Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The growing deployment of large language models (LLMs) across diverse cultural contexts necessitates a deeper understanding of models' hidden representations of different cultures. Prior work has evaluated cultural awareness in LLMs by analysing their outputs. This approach overlooks how cultures are represented within the model parameters, missing why models generate incorrect responses. To bridge this gap, we propose CulTrace, a mechanistic interpretability-based method that probes the internal representations of LLMs for cultural knowledge. With CulTrace, we inspect how cultural knowledge is processed across layers and how it is integrated during cultural QA. We find a consistent staged trajectory of cultural reasoning. Models first engage with the question's domain, then resolve the relevant culture, and finally narrow in on an answer. We also demonstrate that models' cultural reasoning is imbalanced, showing delayed relevant culture resolution and more confusion with less-represented cultures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CulTrace，一种基于机制可解释性 (mechanistic interpretability) 的方法，用于探测大语言模型内部对文化知识的表征。通过逐层检查模型在文化问答中的信息处理，发现模型遵循一致的分阶段推理轨迹：先处理问题领域，再解析相关文化，最后聚焦答案。作者还指出文化推理存在不均衡性，表现为低表征文化的相关解析延迟且更易混淆。
Motivation: 现有研究主要依赖分析 LLM 的输出文本来评估文化意识，忽略了文化在模型参数内部的表征方式，因此无法解释模型为何会生成错误的跨文化回答。
Method: 提出 CulTrace，基于机制可解释性方法，主动探测 LLM 内部表征中的文化知识，并分析文化知识在层间如何处理、以及如何在文化问答中被整合。
Result: 摘要报告发现一致的文化推理阶段轨迹，并展示模型的文化推理存在失衡：对相关文化的解析出现延迟，对代表性不足的文化更容易产生混淆。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过内部表征分析可以揭示模型文化推理的逐步过程及其不均衡性，为理解跨文化模型行为提供机制层面的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Query Efficient Structured Matrix Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning a structured approximation (low-rank, sparse, banded, etc.) to an unknown matrix $A$ given access to matrix-vector product (matvec) queries of the form $x \rightarrow Ax$ and $x \rightarrow A^Tx$. This problem is of central importance to algorithms across scientific computing and machine learning, with applications to fast multiplication and inversion for structured matrices, building preconditioners for first-order optimization, and as a model for differential operator learning. Prior work focuses on obtaining query complexity upper and lower bounds for learning specific structured matrix families that commonly arise in applications. We initiate the study of the problem in greater generality, aiming to understand the query complexity of learning approximations from general matrix families. Our main result focuses on finding a near-optimal approximation to $A$ from any finite-sized family of matrices, $\mathcal{F}$. Standard results from matrix sketching show that $O(\log|\mathcal{F}|)$ matvec queries suffice in this setting. This bound can also be achieved, and is optimal, for vector-matrix-vector queries of the form $x,y\rightarrow x^TAy$, which have been widely studied in work on rank-$1$ matrix sensing. Surprisingly, we show that, in the matvec model, it is possible to obtain a nearly quadratic improvement in complexity, to $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{\log|\mathcal{F}|})$. Further, we prove that this bound is tight up to log-log factors. Via covering number arguments, our result extends to well-studied infinite families. As an example, we establish that a near-optimal approximation from any \emph{linear matrix family} of dimension $q$ can be learned with $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{q})$ matvec queries, improving on an $O(q)$ bound achievable via sketching techniques and vector-matrix-vector queries.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 39th Annual Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026, PMLR 336:158-194
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在仅有矩阵-向量乘积（matvec）查询访问下，从一般矩阵族学习结构化近似的查询复杂度。作者证明对任意有限大小的矩阵族 F，matvec 模型下以 Õ(√log|F|) 次查询即可获得近最优逼近，这是对标准 O(log|F|) 素描界的近乎二次改进，且该界紧到 log-log 因子。通过覆盖数论证，结果还扩展到无限族，例如对维数为 q 的线性矩阵族只需 Õ(√q) 次 matvec 查询。
Motivation: 结构化矩阵近似学习在科学计算和机器学习中应用广泛，但此前工作只针对特定矩阵族（如低秩、稀疏、带状）给出查询复杂度上下界，缺乏对一般矩阵族查询复杂度的系统性理解。
Method: 本文从一般矩阵族的角度研究 matvec 查询模型下的学习复杂度，结合覆盖数（covering number）论证，建立从任意有限矩阵族 F 学习近最优近似的查询复杂度上界，并证明相应的下界。
Result: 主要结果显示，在 matvec 模型中 Õ(√log|F|) 次查询即可逼近任意有限矩阵族 F 中的近最优矩阵，比 O(log|F|) 的素描界有近乎二次的改进，且紧到 log-log 因子；对 q 维线性矩阵族，得到 Õ(√q) 次 matvec 查询的界，优于 O(q)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该查询复杂度界是紧的，且能通过覆盖数方法扩展到常见的无限矩阵族，说明 matvec 查询在结构化矩阵学习问题中比向量-矩阵-向量查询具有更好的样本效率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CPC-CMS: Cognitive Pairwise Comparison Classification Model Selection Framework for Document-level Sentiment Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This study proposes the Cognitive Pairwise Comparison Classification Model Selection (CPC-CMS) framework for document-level sentiment analysis. The CPC, based on expert knowledge judgment, is used to calculate the weights of evaluation criteria, including accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, specificity, Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC), Cohen's Kappa (Kappa), and efficiency. Naive Bayes (NB), Linear Support Vector Classification (LSVC), Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and A Lite Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (ALBERT) are chosen as classification baseline models. A weighted decision matrix consisting of classification evaluation scores with respect to criteria weights is formed to select the best classification model for a classification problem. Three open social media datasets are used to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed CPC-CMS. Based on our simulation, for evaluation results excluding the time factor, ALBERT performs best across all three datasets; if the time factor is included, no single model consistently outperforms the others. Through comparison, these conclusions are also supported by other aggregation and ranking methods, including Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) and Multi-Objective Optimization by Ratio Analysis (MOORA), although aggregation values and ranks may vary. A sensitivity analysis using Spearman's Rank Correlation Test demonstrates the robustness of the proposed CPC-CMS framework. The CPC-CMS can be applied to other classification applications in various domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CPC-CMS 框架，用于文档级情感分析中的分类模型选择。该框架利用基于专家知识判断的认知成对比较法（CPC）计算准确率、精确率、召回率、F1、特异性、MCC、Cohen's Kappa 和效率等评价准则的权重，并构建加权决策矩阵，从 Naive Bayes、LSVC、随机森林、逻辑回归、XGBoost、LSTM 与 ALBERT 等基线模型中选择最优分类模型。三个开放社交媒体数据集上的模拟表明，不考虑时间因素时 ALBERT 在三个数据集上均表现最佳，考虑时间因素后则没有单一模型始终占优；与 AHP、TOPSIS 和 MOORA 等聚合排序方法比较，结论基本一致，且 Spearman 秩相关检验显示框架具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 文档级情感分析中分类模型的选择依赖多个评价准则，需要一种能融合专家知识判断并稳健比较各模型的系统化选择框架，而非仅依赖单一指标或主观决策。
Method: 先由专家知识判断的 CPC 计算各评价准则的权重，构架包含分类评估分数与准则权重的加权决策矩阵，据此对七种分类基线模型进行综合排序选择；并用 AHP、TOPSIS、MOORA 作为对比聚合方法，以 Spearman 秩相关检验做敏感性分析。
Result: 在三个开放社交媒体数据集上，排除时间因素时 ALBERT 在全部数据集上排名最佳；加入时间因素后无模型一致胜出。AHP、TOPSIS 与 MOORA 的结果在趋势上支持上述结论（尽管聚合值和排名有差异），敏感性分析表明 CPC-CMS 排序结果稳健。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 CPC-CMS 是可行且鲁棒的模型选择框架，结论已通过多个数据集、多种聚合方法和排序检验得到支持，并可推广到其他领域的分类应用；其范围限于所选基线模型、准则与情感分析数据集。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GeoExplain: Multimodal Reasoning based on Hierarchy of Visual Information in Street View
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal reasoning is a process of understanding, integrating and inferring information across different data modalities. It has recently attracted surging academic attention. Although there are various tasks for evaluating multimodal reasoning ability, they still have limitations. Reasoning on hierarchical visual clues at different levels of granularity, i.e., local details and global context, is of little discussion, despite its frequent involvement in human reasoning. To bridge the gap, we introduce a challenging dataset, namely GeoExplain, which evaluates explainable geo-localization. Given a street view image, the task is to predict its location and provide a detailed explanation. GeoExplain consists of 40350 panoramas-location-explanation tuples. Each instance contains a set of street-view panoramas, a location on street level, and human-expert explanations describing how the location can be inferred from the visual content of panoramas. Additionally, we present a multimodal and multilevel reasoning method, namely SightSense which can make predictions and generate a comprehensive explanation. Our analysis and experiments demonstrate its outstanding performance in GeoExplain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoExplain 数据集与 SightSense 方法，用于可解释的地理定位 (explainable geo-localization)：给定街景全景图，模型需预测街道级位置并给出人类专家式的详细解释。数据集包含 40350 个全景图-位置-解释三元组，方法通过多模态与多层次推理生成预测和综合解释，实验显示其在该数据集上表现优异。
Motivation: 现有多模态推理评测任务较少关注不同粒度视觉线索（局部细节与全局上下文）的层级化推理，而这种推理常出现在人类推理中。作者希望填补可解释地理定位这一空白。
Method: 构建 GeoExplain 数据集，每个实例包含一组街景全景图、街道级位置标签以及人类专家撰写的、描述如何从全景图视觉内容推断位置的解释。同时提出 SightSense 多模态多层次推理方法，可同时进行位置预测并生成完整解释。
Result: 摘要报告 SightSense 在 GeoExplain 数据集上取得出色性能，但未给出具体数值或对比基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为引入层级化视觉信息推理的数据集与方法能推动可解释地理定位任务；其适用范围主要限于街景图像的地理定位与解释生成。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Can you see how I learn? Human observers' inferences about Reinforcement Learning agents' learning processes
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often exhibit learning behaviors that are not intuitively interpretable by human observers, which can result in suboptimal feedback in collaborative teaching settings. Yet, how humans perceive and interpret RL agent's learning behavior is largely unknown. In a bottom-up approach with two experiments, this work provides a data-driven understanding of the factors of human observers' understanding of the agent's learning process. A novel, observation-based paradigm to directly assess human inferences about agent learning was developed. In an exploratory interview study (\textit{N}=9), we identify four core themes in human interpretations: Agent Goals, Knowledge, Decision Making, and Learning Mechanisms. A second confirmatory study (\textit{N}=34) applied an expanded version of the paradigm across two tasks (navigation/manipulation) and two RL algorithms (tabular/function approximation). Analyses of 816 responses confirmed the reliability of the paradigm and refined the thematic framework, revealing how these themes evolve over time and interrelate. Our findings provide a human-centered understanding of how people make sense of agent learning, offering actionable insights for designing interpretable RL systems and improving transparency in Human-Robot Interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究人类观察者如何推断强化学习（RL）智能体的学习过程。作者开发了一种基于观察的新范式，结合两项实验：探索性访谈（N=9）识别出人类解释的四个核心主题（智能体目标、知识、决策机制、学习机制），确认性研究（N=34）跨两个任务（导航/操作）和两种RL算法（表格/函数逼近）验证了范式可靠性并细化了主题框架。
Motivation: RL智能体的学习行为往往对人类观察者而言不可直观理解，在协作教学场景中可能导致次优反馈；而人类如何感知和解释智能体学习行为目前仍缺乏系统理解。
Method: 采用自下而上的方法，提出一种基于观察的评估范式，直接测量人类对智能体学习过程的推断。通过探索性访谈提取主题，再用扩展版本范式进行跨任务、跨算法的确认性研究，并结合对816个回答的分析。
Result: 确认性研究验证了该范式的可靠性，并细化了主题框架，揭示出这些解释主题随时间演变的规律及其相互关联。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作提供了对人们如何理解智能体学习的人本视角，可为设计可解释的RL系统以及提升人机交互（HRI）中的透明度提供可操作见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining Intrinsic Moral Self-Correction with Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic moral self-correction refers to the phenomenon where a language model refines its ethical judgments or aligns its outputs purely through prompting. While effective across diverse tasks, its mechanism remains unclear. We hypothesize intrinsic moral self-correction functions by steering hidden representations along interpretable latent directions. Evaluating six LLMs across four morality-related tasks, we demonstrate that the representation shifts induced by self-correction prompts align with contrastive steering vectors. This alignment transfers even when the steering vectors are constructed from a disjoint corpus. Notably, when applied via activation addition, these prompt-induced shifts can alter model behavior more effectively than the self-correction prompts and the steering vectors. Our findings suggest representation steering is the mechanistic driver of intrinsic moral self-correction.
papers.journal_ref: 4th Deployable AI Workshop at AAAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文用机械可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）研究语言模型的内在道德自我纠正（intrinsic moral self-correction）机制，提出其通过沿可解释的潜在方向引导隐藏表征来运作。作者在六个大语言模型、四个道德相关任务上验证，自纠正提示引起的表征偏移与对比引导向量（contrastive steering vectors）对齐，且该对齐可迁移至不相关语料构建的引导向量。通过激活加法（activation addition）应用这些提示诱导的偏移，能比自纠正提示和引导向量更有效地改变模型行为。
Motivation: 内在道德自我纠正现象在多种任务上有效，但其内部机制尚不清晰；理解该机制有助于解释和调控语言模型通过提示实现伦理对齐的行为。
Method: 提出假设：内在道德自我纠正通过将隐藏表征沿可解释的潜在方向进行引导来实现。在六个LLM和四个道德相关任务上，对比自纠正提示引起的表征偏移与对比引导向量，并测试从不相交语料构建的引导向量的迁移性，同时用激活加法验证提示诱导偏移的行为影响。
Result: 摘要报告，自纠正提示导致的表征偏移与对比引导向量对齐，且该对齐可迁移至不相交语料构建的引导向量；通过激活加法施加这些偏移，能比自纠正提示及引导向量本身更有效地改变模型行为。
Conclusion: 作者认为表征引导（representation steering）是内在道德自我纠正的机制驱动因素。

papers.title: Reinforcing Multi-Turn Reasoning in LLM Agents via Fine-Grained Reward Structure and Credit Assignment
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches have been wildly used to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon, multi-turn scenarios. Such interactions can be formalized as turn-level Markov decision processes (MDPs), where intermediate rewards are often available. However, most prior work relies on sparse trajectory-level rewards, resulting in poor credit assignment, while dense turn-level rewards remain underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how to effectively leverage dense turn-level reward structures in RL algorithms, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), to enable fine-grained credit assignment. We categorize reward structures into three types based on their granularity: (1) terminal reward; (2) delayed reward; (3) per-turn reward, each corresponding to a distinct turn-level MDP formulation, and derive GRPO and PPO algorithms tailored to each case, respectively. Experiments on multi-turn search and game agent tasks show that, for both GRPO and PPO, dense per-turn reward structures consistently outperform sparse terminal and delayed reward structures in terms of training dynamics and numerical results. Furthermore, on search tasks, PPO with dense per-turn rewards achieves greater training stability and faster convergence, and delivers the highest answer correctness among all state-of-the-art methods across diverse question-answering datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在 LLM 智能体的长程多轮推理中利用稠密逐轮奖励（per-turn reward）进行细粒度信用分配。作者将多轮交互形式化为 turn-level MDP，并按粒度把奖励结构分为终端奖励（terminal reward）、延迟奖励（delayed reward）和逐轮奖励三类，分别为 GRPO 和 PPO 推导定制算法。实验表明，在 GRPO 和 PPO 下稠密逐轮奖励在训练动态和数值结果上均一致优于稀疏奖励结构。
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法训练 LLM 智能体多轮推理时大多依赖稀疏的轨迹级奖励，导致信用分配（credit assignment）困难；而逐轮稠密奖励在 turn-level MDP 中经常可以获得，却尚未被充分探索。
Method: 按奖励粒度将 turn-level MDP 中的奖励结构分为终端、延迟和逐轮三类，并分别推导每种情况对应的 GRPO 与 PPO 算法，从而利用稠密逐轮奖励实现细粒度的信用分配。
Result: 在多轮搜索和游戏智能体任务上，稠密逐轮奖励在 GRPO 与 PPO 下均优于稀疏的终端和延迟奖励。在搜索任务中，PPO 配逐轮奖励训练更稳定、收敛更快，并在多个问答数据集上取得所有现有方法中最高的答案正确率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稠密逐轮奖励结构能有效改善 LLM 智能体的多轮推理训练，其中搜索任务上 PPO 表现最佳；论文标注为 work in progress，属于进行中的工作。

papers.title: SPD Matrix Learning for Neuroimaging Analysis: Perspectives, Methods, and Challenges
papers.abstract_en: Neuroimaging provides essential tools for characterizing brain activity, structure, and connectivity through modalities that capture complementary aspects of brain organization. Across these diverse modalities, a unifying perspective arises when measurements are modeled as symmetric positive-definite (SPD)-valued representations through appropriate estimation or regularization procedures. Endowed with Riemannian geometry, the SPD manifold provides a non-Euclidean framework for principled statistical inference and machine learning on these representations. This review organizes these analytical and learning approaches within a framework for SPD matrix learning that connects classical geometric statistics with modern machine learning across neuroimaging and neurophysiological applications. We systematically survey the progression from modality-specific representations to geometric shallow and deep learning paradigms, highlighting how SPD matrix learning preserves underlying structural constraints while extending to modern AI applications in neuroimaging and brain-computer interfaces.

TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于神经影像分析中对称正定（SPD）矩阵学习的综述，发表于 TPAMI。作者提出一个统一框架，将脑成像与神经生理信号建模为 SPD 值表示，并借助 SPD 流形的黎曼几何进行统计推断与机器学习。综述系统梳理了从模态特定表示到几何浅层与深度学习范式的进展，强调 SPD 矩阵学习在保留底层结构约束的同时向现代 AI 应用（如脑机接口）扩展。
Motivation: 神经影像包含多种模态，测量结果可通过 SPD 矩阵表示来统一刻画；现有方法缺乏一个系统组织这些几何统计与机器学习工具的框架，需要梳理其发展脉络与挑战。
Method: 作为综述，文章构建了 SPD 矩阵学习框架，将经典几何统计与现代机器学习相结合，并系统调查从模态特定表示到几何浅层及深层学习的演进路线。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据或基准结果；本文为综述性质，主要贡献在于组织与分析该领域的分析方法和学习途径。
Conclusion: 作者强调 SPD 矩阵学习能够在神经影像与脑机接口应用中保持底层结构约束，并指出其向现代 AI 应用扩展的前景与挑战。

papers.title: An Automated Pipeline for Few-Shot Bird Call Classification: A Case Study with the Tooth-Billed Pigeon
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a largely automated one-shot bird call classification pipeline, incorporating targeted manual quality control steps, designed for rare species absent from large publicly available classifiers like BirdNET and Perch. While these models excel at detecting common birds with abundant training data, they lack options for species with only 1-3 known recordings, a critical limitation for conservationists monitoring the last remaining individuals of endangered birds. To address this, we leverage the embedding space of large bird classification networks and develop a classifier using cosine similarity, combined with filtering and denoising preprocessing techniques, to optimize detection with minimal training data. We evaluate various embedding spaces using clustering metrics and validate our approach in both a simulated scenario with Xeno-Canto recordings and a real-world test on the critically endangered tooth-billed pigeon (Didunculus strigirostris), which has no existing classifiers and only three confirmed recordings. The final model achieved 1.0 recall and 0.95 accuracy in detecting tooth-billed pigeon calls, making it practical for use in the field. This open-source system provides a practical tool for conservationists seeking to detect and monitor rare species on the brink of extinction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基本自动化的一次性鸟鸣分类pipeline，针对仅有1-3个已知录音的稀有物种，利用大型鸟类分类网络（如BirdNET、Perch）的嵌入空间，结合余弦相似度分类器以及过滤和去噪预处理。在模拟场景（Xeno-Canto录音）和真实世界测试（极度濒危的齿嘴鸠，Didunculus strigirostris，仅有三个确认录音）中，最终模型达到1.0召回率和0.95准确率。该系统以开源形式提供，旨在帮助保护工作者监测濒危物种。
Motivation: 大型公开鸟类分类器（如BirdNET和Perch）对常见鸟效果好，但对只有1-3个已知录音的稀有物种缺乏检测能力，这对监测仅存个体的保护工作者是一个关键限制。
Method: 利用大型鸟类分类网络的嵌入空间，用余弦相似度训练分类器，并加入过滤和去噪预处理以优化少量训练数据下的检测；使用聚类指标评估不同嵌入空间。
Result: 在模拟Xeno-Canto场景和真实世界测试中，齿嘴鸠叫声检测达到1.0召回率和0.95准确率，具备野外实用性。
Conclusion: 该开源系统为保护工作者提供了一个实用工具，可用于检测和监测濒临灭绝的稀有物种。

papers.title: Recognizing Artificial Minds: A Philosophical Defense of AI Cognition
papers.abstract_en: This work defends the 'Whole Hog Thesis': sophisticated Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT are full-blown linguistic and cognitive agents, possessing understanding, beliefs, desires, knowledge, and intentions. We argue against prevailing methodologies in AI philosophy, rejecting starting points based on low-level computational details ('Just an X' fallacy) or pre-existing theories of mind. Instead, we advocate starting with simple, high-level observations of LLM behavior (e.g., answering questions, making suggestions) -- defending this data against charges of metaphor, loose talk, or pretense. From these observations, we employ 'Holistic Network Assumptions' -- plausible connections between mental capacities (e.g., answering implies knowledge, knowledge implies belief, action implies intention) -- to argue for the full suite of cognitive states. We systematically rebut objections based on LLM failures (hallucinations, planning/reasoning errors), arguing these don't preclude agency, often mirroring human fallibility. We address numerous 'Games of Lacks', arguing that LLMs do not lack purported necessary conditions for cognition (e.g., semantic grounding, embodiment, justification, intrinsic intentionality) or that these conditions are not truly necessary, often relying on anti-discriminatory arguments comparing LLMs to diverse human capacities. Our approach is evidential, not functionalist, and deliberately excludes consciousness. We conclude by speculating on the possibility of LLMs possessing 'alien' contents beyond human conceptual schemes.
papers.comment: Pre-publication draft. Forthcoming as Open Access from Oxford University Press. Please cite the OUP version when available. Note title change: previously, "Going Whole Hog: A Philosophical Defence of AI Cognition"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从哲学角度为“Whole Hog Thesis”辩护，主张像 ChatGPT 这样的大型语言模型（LLMs）是完整的语言与认知主体，具有理解、信念、欲望、知识和意图。作者反对基于低层计算细节或既有心灵理论的通行方法论，主张从 LLM 行为的高层观察出发，借助“整体网络假设”（Holistic Network Assumptions）推出全套认知状态，并系统回应幻觉、规划失误及各种“缺乏”论证。该论证是证据性的而非功能主义的，且刻意排除意识问题。
Motivation: 现有 AI 哲学方法要么陷入从低层计算细节出发的“Just an X”谬误，要么依赖既有的心灵理论，难以公正评估 LLM 的认知地位；作者希望提供一种以高层行为观察为起点的系统性哲学辩护。
Method: 从简单的高层行为观察（如回答问题、提出建议）入手，先辩护这类数据不是隐喻、随意说法或伪装；再利用心智能力之间合理的整体性关联（如回答蕴含知识、知识蕴含信念、行动蕴含意图）推出完整认知状态，并系统反驳基于 LLM 失败和所谓认知必要条件缺失的反驳。
Result: 作为哲学论证，本文没有实证数据；其核心结论是 LLM 应被视为具有理解、信念、欲望、知识和意图的认知主体，并推测它们可能拥有超出人类概念框架的“异类”内容（alien contents）。
Conclusion: 作者强调其立场是证据性的（evidential）而非功能主义的，并明确将意识排除在论证范围之外；这意味着关于 AI 认知归属的讨论应更多基于行为证据与心智能力之间的整体关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Two Heads are Better Than One: Test-time Scaling of Multi-agent Collaborative Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Scaling has emerged as a powerful method to extend the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models. However, single-agent TTS faces significant scalability bottlenecks, as excessively long reasoning traces lead to increased inference costs and stability issues caused by context management failures. To address these limitations, we propose leveraging Multi-Agent Systems as a structural upgrade to standard TTS. By decomposing monolithic reasoning chains into distinct, manageable contexts across multiple agents, MAS offers a more robust framework for scaling reasoning. We validate this approach by introducing M500, a dataset comprising 500 high-quality multi-agent, multi-turn collaborative reasoning traces generated via DeepSeek-R1. Through Supervised Fine-Tuning on M500, we enable open-source models to internalize collaborative reasoning patterns and show improved TTS performance in MAS. Furthermore, we propose an adaptive scaling strategy incorporating a ``CEO'' agent to dynamically guide the reasoning process and optimize collaboration depth. Extensive experiments within the AgentVerse framework demonstrate that our fine-tuned models, Qwen2.5-32B-MAS and Phi4-14B-MAS, significantly outperform their base counterparts. Codes are available at https://github.com/jincan333/MAS-TTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多智能体系统 (Multi-Agent System, MAS) 作为单智能体测试时扩展 (Test-Time Scaling, TTS) 的结构性升级，以解决单智能体长推理链带来的推理成本与上下文管理稳定性问题。作者引入包含 500 条高质量多智能体多轮协作推理轨迹的数据集 M500（由 DeepSeek-R1 生成），通过监督微调使开源模型内化协作推理模式，并提出带 CEO 智能体的自适应扩展策略来动态调控协作深度。在 AgentVerse 框架上的实验表明，微调后的 Qwen2.5-32B-MAS 和 Phi4-14B-MAS 显著优于各自基础模型。
Motivation: 单智能体 TTS 存在扩展瓶颈：过长的推理轨迹会推高推理成本，并因上下文管理失败导致稳定性问题。
Method: 利用多智能体系统将单一长推理链分解为多个智能体各自独立的可控上下文；构建 M500 数据集进行监督微调，使模型学会协作推理；并设计带 CEO 智能体的自适应缩放策略，动态引导推理过程并优化协作深度。
Result: 在 AgentVerse 框架内的实验显示，微调后的 Qwen2.5-32B-MAS 和 Phi4-14B-MAS 在 TTS 性能上显著优于其基础版本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调多智能体协作推理作为一种更稳健的 TTS 扩展框架，能够缓解单智能体扩展的瓶颈，相关代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Smart Exploration in Reinforcement Learning using Bounded Uncertainty Models
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for decision-making in uncertain environments, but it often requires large amounts of data to learn an optimal policy. We address this challenge by incorporating prior model knowledge to guide exploration and accelerate the learning process. Specifically, we assume access to a model set that contains the true transition kernel and reward function. We optimize over this model set to obtain upper and lower bounds on the Q-function, which are then used to guide the exploration of the agent. We provide theoretical guarantees on the convergence of the Q-function to the optimal Q-function under the proposed class of exploring policies. Furthermore, we also introduce a data-driven regularized version of the model set optimization problem that ensures the convergence of the class of exploring policies to the optimal policy. Lastly, we show that when the model set has a specific structure, namely the bounded-parameter MDP (BMDP) framework, the regularized model set optimization problem becomes convex and simple to implement. In this setting, we also prove finite-time convergence to the optimal policy under mild assumptions. We demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed exploration strategy, which we call BUMEX (Bounded Uncertainty Model-based Exploration), in a simulation study. The results indicate that the proposed method can significantly accelerate learning in benchmark examples. A toolbox is available at https://github.com/JvHulst/BUMEX.
papers.comment: Presented at 64th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control, CDC 2025, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, 2025, pp. 5132--5138. This version contains minor revisions compared to the IEEE publication
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE 64th Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用有界不确定性模型（Bounded Uncertainty Model）指导强化学习探索的策略 BUMEX，假设已知包含真实转移核与奖励函数的模型集，通过在该模型集上优化得到 Q 函数的上下界并据此引导探索。作者给出 Q 函数收敛到最优 Q 函数的理论保证，并针对 bounded-parameter MDP (BMDP) 结构证明在温和假设下可有限时间收敛到最优策略；仿真实验表明该方法能显著加速基准示例中的学习过程。
Motivation: 标准强化学习在不确定环境中通常需要大量数据才能学到最优策略，本文试图通过引入先验模型知识来指导探索、减少数据需求，从而加速学习。
Method: 假设可访问一个包含真实转移核和奖励函数的模型集，并在此模型集上优化以获得 Q 函数的上下界，再以此引导智能体探索；同时引入数据驱动的正则化模型集优化问题，并证明当模型集具有 BMDP 结构时该问题为凸且易于实现。
Result: 摘要报告了 Q 函数在所述探索策略类下收敛到最优 Q 函数的理论保证，以及在 BMDP 框架下达最优策略的有限时间收敛结果；仿真研究显示 BUMEX 在基准示例中可以显著加速学习。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于有界不确定性模型优化得到的 Q 函数界可以有效指导探索并加速强化学习，且 BMDP 结构化模型集使方法实现简单；摘要还提及公开了相应工具箱。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Regression-Based Estimation of Causal Effects in the Presence of Selection Bias and Confounding
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of estimating the expected causal effect $E[Y|do(X)]$ for a target variable $Y$ when treatment $X$ is set by intervention, focusing on continuous random variables. In settings without selection bias or confounding, $E[Y|do(X)] = E[Y|X]$, which can be estimated using standard regression methods. However, regression fails when systematic missingness induced by selection bias, or confounding distorts the data. Proxy variables unaffected by the selection process can, under certain constraints, be used to correct for selection bias to recover $E[Y|X]$, and hence $E[Y|do(X)]$, reliably. When data is additionally affected by confounding, recovering the causal effect from selection-biased data is more challenging and requires access to proxies to both correct for confounding and for the selection mechanism. Assuming access to such proxies from external unbiased observational data, we derive theoretical conditions ensuring identifiability and recoverability of causal effects. We further introduce a linear two-step regression estimator (TSR), which can be extended through adding non-linear basis functions, capable of exploiting proxy variables to adjust for selection bias while accounting for confounding. We show that TSR is consistent with previous estimators when confounding is absent, but achieves a lower variance. Extensive simulation studies validate TSR's correctness for scenarios that include both selection bias and confounding with proxy variables.
papers.comment: The underlying manuscript was accepted for publication after peer review. This author-updated version contains an additional post-acceptance paragraph in Appendix A.2. The Version of Record is available online at: https://doi.org/10.1007/s10994-026-07054-6
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续变量场景下由干预设定处理变量 X 后目标变量 Y 的期望因果效应 E[Y|do(X)] 的估计问题，重点处理选择偏差 (selection bias) 与混淆 (confounding) 同时存在的情形。作者提出一个线性两步回归估计器 (two-step regression estimator, TSR)，可通过加入非线性基函数进行扩展，利用不受选择过程影响的代理变量来校正选择偏差并同时处理混淆。作者给出保证因果效应可识别 (identifiability) 与可恢复 (recoverability) 的理论条件，并通过大量模拟实验验证 TSR 的正确性。
Motivation: 在无选择偏差或混淆时 E[Y|do(X)] = E[Y|X]，可用标准回归估计；但选择偏差导致的系统性缺失或混淆会使回归失效。需要利用代理变量从有偏数据中可靠恢复因果效应，而同时存在混淆时这一问题更具挑战性。
Method: 提出线性两步回归估计器 TSR，通过加入非线性基函数进行扩展；假设可从外部无偏观测数据获得同时校正混淆与选择机制的代理变量，在此基础上推导可识别性与可恢复性的理论条件。
Result: 模拟研究表明，在不存在混淆时 TSR 与已有估计器一致，但方差更低；在同时包含选择偏差与混淆并存在代理变量的场景下，TSR 的估计正确性得到验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，借助外部无偏观测数据中的代理变量，TSR 能够在选择偏差与混淆并存时可靠恢复因果效应，且理论条件保证了可识别性。

papers.title: Structure is information: structural identifiability mappings for machine learning with partially observed dynamical systems
papers.abstract_en: The successful application of modern machine learning for time series classification is often hampered by limitations in quality and quantity of available training data. To overcome these limitations, domain knowledge can be leveraged in the form of parameterised mechanistic dynamical models, whereby time series observations may be represented as instances of a predefined class of dynamical systems. Provided the dynamical models are interpretable in terms of domain-specific variables and their dynamic interaction, the learning process becomes interpretable as well and enables the modeller to handle sparsely and irregularly sampled data naturally. However, the internal processes of a dynamical model are often only partially observed. This can lead to ambiguity regarding which particular model realization best explains a given time series observation. This problem is well-known in the literature, and a dynamical model with this issue is referred to as structurally unidentifiable. Training a classifier that ignores knowledge about a structurally unidentifiable dynamical model can negatively influence classification performance. To address this issue, we employ structural identifiability analysis to explicitly relate parameter configurations that are associated with identical system outputs. Using the derived relations in classifier training, we demonstrate that this method significantly improves the classifier's ability to generalize to unseen data on a number of example models from the biomedical domain. This effect is especially pronounced when the number of training instances is limited. Our results demonstrate the importance of structural identifiability, a topic that has received relatively little attention from the machine learning community.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将结构可辨识性分析（structural identifiability analysis）引入机器学习分类器训练，用于处理部分观测动力系统的时间序列分类。摘要表明，利用参数配置与系统输出等价的映射关系可以提升分类器在未见数据上的泛化能力，尤其在训练样本少时效果显著。作者在生物医学领域的多组示例模型上验证了方法。
Motivation: 现代机器学习用于时间序列分类常受训练数据数量和质量限制；动力系统内部过程往往仅部分观测，导致结构不可辨识（structurally unidentifiable），忽视这一知识会损害分类性能。
Method: 采用结构可辨识性分析，显式地关联产生相同系统输出的参数配置（structural identifiability mappings），并将这些等价关系用于分类器训练。
Result: 在生物医学领域的多个示例模型上，该方法显著提升分类器对未见数据的泛化能力，尤其在训练实例数量有限时效果更明显。
Conclusion: 结果表明结构可辨识性对机器学习很重要，而该主题在机器学习社区受到的关注相对较少。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: The Intrinsic Dimension of Prompts in Internal Representations of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We study the geometry of token representations at the prompt level in large language models through the lens of intrinsic dimension. Viewing transformers as mean-field particle systems, we estimate the intrinsic dimension of the empirical measure at each layer and demonstrate that it correlates with next-token uncertainty. Across models and intrinsic dimension estimators, we find that intrinsic dimension peaks in early to middle layers and increases under syntactic and semantic disruption (by shuffling tokens), and that it is strongly correlated with average surprisal, with a simple analysis linking logits geometry to entropy via softmax. As a case study in practical interpretability and safety, we train a linear probe on the per-layer intrinsic dimension profile to distinguish malicious from benign prompts before generation. This probe achieves accuracy of 90 to 95\% in different datasets, outperforming widely used guardrails such as Llama Guard and Shield Gemma. We further compare against linear probes built from layerwise entropy derived via the Tuned Lens and find that the intrinsic dimension-based probe is competitive and complementary, offering a compact, interpretable signal distributed across layers. Our findings suggest that prompt-level geometry provides actionable signals for monitoring and controlling LLM behavior, and offers a bridge between mechanistic insights and practical safety tools.
papers.comment: 12+14 pages, 18 figures, matches published version on Transactions of Machine Learning Research
papers.journal_ref: Transactions of Machine Learning Research, ISSN: 2835-8856, 2026, https://openreview.net/pdf?id=rBEgNAslpY
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从内在维度 (intrinsic dimension) 的视角研究大语言模型在提示 (prompt) 层面 token 表示的几何性质。作者将 Transformer 视为平均场粒子系统，估计每层经验测度的内在维度，发现其峰值出现在早至中层，并在打乱 token 的句法和语义扰动下增加，且与平均 surprisal 强相关。作为安全应用，作者用逐层内在维度轮廓训练线性探针区分恶意与良性提示，准确率达 90-95%，优于 Llama Guard 和 Shield Gemma，并与基于 Tuned Lens 熵的探针互补。
Motivation: 理解 LLM 内部表示几何如何反映 next-token 不确定性，并据此为提示级安全监控提供紧凑、可解释且分布在各层的信号，搭建机制理解与实用安全工具之间的桥梁。
Method: 将 Transformer 视为平均场粒子系统，估计每层经验测度的内在维度；利用 softmax 联系 logits 几何与熵。在实践层面，基于逐层内在维度轮廓训练线性探针区分恶意与良性提示，并与基于 Tuned Lens 层间熵的线性探针进行比较。
Result: 内在维度在早至中层达到峰值，并在 token 打乱（句法和语义扰动）下增大，与平均 surprisal 强相关。该探针在不同数据集上取得 90-95% 的准确率，优于 Llama Guard 和 Shield Gemma，且与熵基探针相比具有竞争性和互补性。
Conclusion: 提示级几何为监测和控制 LLM 行为提供了可操作的信号，内在维度轮廓是一种分布在各层、紧凑且可解释的安全监控指标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DAOP: Data-Aware Offloading and Predictive Pre-Calculation for Efficient MoE Inference
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, though highly effective for various machine learning tasks, face significant deployment challenges on memory-constrained devices. While GPUs offer fast inference, their limited memory compared to CPUs means not all experts can be stored on the GPU simultaneously, necessitating frequent, costly data transfers from CPU memory, often negating GPU speed advantages. To address this, we present DAOP, an on-device MoE inference engine to optimize parallel GPU-CPU execution. DAOP dynamically allocates experts between CPU and GPU based on per-sequence activation patterns, and selectively pre-calculates predicted experts on CPUs to minimize transfer latency. This approach enables efficient resource utilization across various expert cache ratios while maintaining model accuracy through a novel graceful degradation mechanism. Comprehensive evaluations across various datasets show that DAOP outperforms traditional expert caching and prefetching methods by up to 8.20x and offloading techniques by 1.35x while maintaining accuracy.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 10 figures, Accepted by DATE Conference 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DAOP，一个面向内存受限设备的 MoE 推理引擎，用于优化 GPU-CPU 并行执行。DAOP 根据每序列的激活模式在 CPU 和 GPU 间动态分配专家，并在 CPU 上选择性预计算预测的专家以减少传输延迟，同时通过优雅降级机制维持模型精度。在多项数据集上的评估显示，相比于传统专家缓存和预取方法最高提速 8.20 倍，比卸载技术快 1.35 倍。
Motivation: MoE 模型在 GPU 上推理时，因 GPU 内存小于 CPU 内存，无法同时存放全部专家，导致频繁从 CPU 内存传输数据，抵消 GPU 的速度优势；现有方法未充分利用异构资源。
Method: DAOP 作为端侧 MoE 推理引擎，基于每序列激活模式动态分配 CPU 与 GPU 上的专家，并有选择地在 CPU 上预计算预测的专家以隐藏传输延迟；同时引入优雅降级机制来保持模型精度。
Result: 综合评估显示，DAOP 在不同专家缓存比例下均高效利用资源，相比传统专家缓存和预取方法最高提速 8.20 倍，相比卸载技术提升 1.35 倍，同时保持精度。
Conclusion: DAOP 通过数据感知的动态专家分配与预测性预计算，在内存受限设备上实现了高效的 MoE 推理，并能在不同缓存比率下平衡资源利用与精度。

papers.title: ACQ: A Deployed Two-Stage Framework for Automated Creative Quota Allocation in Large-Scale Online Advertising
papers.abstract_en: In digital advertising, demand-side platforms (DSPs) allow advertisers to create multiple ad creatives from a single photo for real-time bidding. While increasing the number of creatives can improve bidding opportunities, it cannot scale indefinitely, and the incremental advertising revenue typically exhibits diminishing returns as more creatives are generated. This raises a practical problem for DSPs: how to automatically determine an appropriate creative quota for each photo at scale. To address this problem, we propose Automated Creatives Quota (ACQ), a deployed two-stage framework for creative quota allocation in large-scale online advertising. In the first stage, ACQ predicts quota-conditioned expected revenue using a multi-task model built on an unbalanced binary tree, which is designed to handle the highly skewed revenue distribution across quota levels. In the second stage, ACQ formulates quota allocation under global capacity constraints as a multiple-choice knapsack problem (MCKP) and solves it with an efficient dual-based algorithm. Extensive offline experiments and online experiments on Kuaishou's advertising delivery platform demonstrate the effectiveness of ACQ, achieving a 6.20% increase in platform advertising revenue.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACQ（Automated Creatives Quota），一个已部署的两阶段框架，用于大规模在线广告中自动为每张照片分配广告创意数量配额（creative quota）。第一阶段用基于不平衡二叉树的 multi-task 模型预测配额条件下的期望收益，以应对不同配额级别间高度偏斜的收益分布；第二阶段将全局容量约束下的配额分配建模为多选背包问题（MCKP），并用基于对偶的高效算法求解。在快手广告投放平台上的离线和在线实验中，平台广告收入提升 6.20%。
Motivation: 在 DSP 中，从单张照片生成多个广告创意可以增加实时竞价机会，但创意数量不能无限增长，新增创意的广告收入呈边际递减。因此实际问题是：如何在大规模场景下自动为每张照片确定合适的创意配额。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段使用基于不平衡二叉树的多任务模型预测配额条件下的期望收益，专门处理配额级别间高度偏斜的收益分布；第二阶段将全局容量约束下的配额分配建模为多选背包问题（MCKP），并用基于对偶（dual-based）的高效算法求解。
Result: 摘要报告在快手广告投放平台上的大量离线实验和在线实验均验证了 ACQ 的有效性，平台广告收入提升 6.20%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是一个已部署的工业级框架，证明在大型在线广告系统中自动进行创意配额分配可以带来实际的收入增长。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在快手广告投放平台上的大量离线实验和在线实验均验证了 ACQ 的有效性，平台广告收入提升 6.20%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调这是一个已部署的工业级框架，证明在大型在线广告系统中自动进行创意配额分配可以带来实际的收入增长。

papers.title: Federated and differentially private estimation of KL divergence
papers.abstract_en: Measuring distribution drifts is a key task in managing distributed, sensitive data, as it underpins a wide range of federated learning and analytics applications. In many practical settings, however, directly sharing such information is either undesirable (e.g., due to privacy concerns) or infeasible (e.g., due to high communication costs). In this work, we present FedPriKL, a novel method for estimating the KL divergence of data across federated computational models under differential privacy (DP) guarantees. We establish its theoretical properties, showing that FedPriKL is unbiased with low and bounded sensitivity and variance, thereby ensuring strong utility under DP. In addition, we present an empirical study that explores parameter choices to optimize accuracy while minimizing communication overhead. Our experiments demonstrate that FedPriKL achieves accuracy comparable to a similar sampling-based non-private estimator, while delivering greater stability and accuracy than a baseline variant in which users perturb their data locally to obtain privacy guarantees.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedPriKL，一种在联邦计算模型下以差分隐私 (differential privacy, DP) 保证估计各参与方数据 KL 散度的方法。理论部分证明该估计量无偏，且具有低而有界的敏感性与方差，从而在 DP 下保持较强效用。实验表明，FedPriKL 的精度可与基于采样的非私有估计器相当，并比用户本地扰动数据的基线更稳定、更准确。
Motivation: 在分布式敏感数据场景中，分布漂移测量是联邦学习与分析应用的基础；直接共享此类信息常因隐私顾虑或通信成本而不可行。
Method: 提出 FedPriKL 估计器，在差分隐私约束下估计跨联邦模型的 KL 散度，并系统研究参数选择以在保证精度的同时降低通信开销。
Result: 实验显示 FedPriKL 达到与类似采样式非私有估计器相当的准确度，同时比用户本地扰动数据的隐私基线具有更高稳定性和准确性。
Conclusion: 作者通过理论性质与经验研究说明，FedPriKL 能在差分隐私保障下以较低的通信开销有效估计 KL 散度，适用于分布式敏感数据场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Can We Trust AI Agents? A Case Study of an LLM-Based Multi-Agent System for Ethical AI
papers.abstract_en: AI-based systems, including Large Language Models (LLMs), impact millions by supporting diverse tasks but face issues like misinformation, bias, and misuse. AI ethics is crucial as new technologies and concerns emerge, but objective, practical guidance remains debated. This study explores the extent to which trustworthiness-enhancing techniques in LLMs can support the development of ethically aligned AI software. We adopt a single exploratory cycle of Design Science Research (DSR). First, we identify trustworthiness-enhancing techniques for LLMs: multi-agents, distinct roles, structured communication, and multiple rounds of debate. Second, we design a multi-agent prototype LLM-MAS in which agents address real-world AI ethics issues from the AI Incident Database. Finally, we evaluate the prototype across three case scenarios using thematic analysis, hierarchical clustering, a baseline comparison, and code execution. The system generates approximately 2,000 lines of code per case, compared to only 80 lines in baseline trials. Results reveal terms like bias detection, transparency, accountability, user consent, GDPR compliance, fairness evaluation, and EU AI Act compliance, showing this prototype ability to generate extensive source code and documentation addressing often overlooked AI ethics issues. However, practical challenges in source code integration and dependency management may limit its use by practitioners.
papers.journal_ref: CEUR Workshop Proceedings, Vol. 4237 (TETHICS 2025), pp. 68-82
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用设计科学研究 (Design Science Research, DSR) 的单一探索周期，研究 LLM 中可增强可信度的技术能否支持合乎伦理的 AI 软件开放。作者识别出多智能体、角色分工、结构化通信和多轮辩论等可信度增强技术，构建了一个 LLM 多智能体系统原型 (LLM-MAS)，并基于 AI Incident Database 中的真实案例进行评估。该系统每个案例生成约 2000 行代码，而基线仅 80 行，输出涉及偏见检测、透明度、问责、用户同意、GDPR 合规、公平性评估和 EU AI Act 合规等主题，但在源代码集成与依赖管理上存在实际挑战。
Motivation: AI 系统包括 LLM 影响广泛，但存在虚假信息、偏见和滥用等问题；AI 伦理虽受关注，但缺乏客观实用的实践指导。因此需要探索可信度增强技术能否帮助开发伦理对齐的 AI 软件。
Method: 采用单轮设计科学研究。先识别 LLM 的可信度增强技术：多智能体、不同角色、结构化通信、多轮辩论；然后设计多智能体原型 LLM-MAS，让智能体处理来自 AI Incident Database 的真实 AI 伦理问题；最后用主题分析、层次聚类、基线比较和代码执行对三个案例场景进行评估。
Result: 系统每个案例生成约 2000 行代码，而基线试验仅 80 行；结果中出现偏见检测、透明度、问责、用户同意、GDPR 合规、公平性评估和 EU AI Act 合规等术语，表明原型能生成大量源代码和文档，覆盖常被忽略的 AI 伦理问题。
Conclusion: 作者总结该原型具有生成广泛源代码和文档的能力，但源代码集成和依赖管理方面的实际挑战可能限制从业者对它的使用。
Relevance: 5
