papers.title: Beyond Isolated Heads: Multi-Overlapped-Head Self-Attention for Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) is the cornerstone of Vision Transformers, allowing models to capture diverse feature representations by projecting tokens into independent subspaces. However, the standard MHSA strictly isolates these heads, preventing any information exchange during the attention computation itself. In this paper, we propose Multi-Overlapped-Head Self-Attention (MOHSA), a novel mechanism that replaces the hard division of attention heads with a soft, overlapping division. By allowing queries, keys, and values to partially overlap with those of adjacent heads, MOHSA fosters rich inter-head communication directly within the attention mechanism. We extensively investigate various overlap dimension scheduling strategies to identify optimal configurations. Comprehensive experiments in several Transformer architectures demonstrate that MOHSA outperforms standard MHSA on the CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet-1k datasets, offering a significant performance boost with negligible computational overhead. Code link: https://github.com/ZTX-100/MOHSA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-Overlapped-Head Self-Attention (MOHSA)，用软性重叠的头划分替代标准 Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) 的硬划分，允许相邻注意力头的查询、键、值部分重叠，从而在注意力计算内部实现头间通信。作者在多种 Transformer 架构上验证了该方法，在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 和 ImageNet-1k 数据集上均优于标准 MHSA，且计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 标准 MHSA 严格隔离各个注意力头，在注意力计算过程中不允许任何信息交换，这限制了模型利用头间交互表征的能力。
Method: MOHSA 以软重叠划分替代硬头划分，让查询、键、值向量与相邻头部分重叠，并系统研究了多种重叠维度调度策略以确定最优配置。
Result: 在多种 Transformer 架构上的实验表明，MOHSA 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet 和 ImageNet-1k 上均超过标准 MHSA，带来显著性能提升且额外计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 作者认为在注意力机制内部直接引入丰富的头间通信能够带来性能收益，并公开了代码链接。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Online design of dynamic networks
papers.abstract_en: Designing a network (e.g., a telecommunication or transport network) is mainly done offline, in a planning phase, prior to the operation of the network. On the other hand, a massive effort has been devoted to characterizing dynamic networks, i.e., those that evolve over time. The novelty of this paper is that we introduce a method for the online design of dynamic networks. The need to do so emerges when a network needs to operate in a dynamic and stochastic environment. In this case, one may wish to build a network over time, on the fly, in order to react to the changes of the environment and to keep certain performance targets. We tackle this online design problem with a rolling horizon optimization based on Monte Carlo Tree Search. The potential of online network design is showcased for the design of a futuristic dynamic public transport network, where bus lines are constructed on the fly to better adapt to a stochastic user demand. In such a scenario, we compare our results with state-of-the-art dynamic vehicle routing problem (VRP) resolution methods, simulating requests from a New York City taxi dataset. Differently from classic VRP methods, that extend vehicle trajectories in isolation, our method enables us to build a structured network of line buses, where complex user journeys are possible, thus increasing system performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于滚动时域优化 (rolling horizon optimization) 与蒙特卡洛树搜索 (Monte Carlo Tree Search, MCTS) 的动态网络在线设计方法，用于在随机动态环境中按需逐步构建网络。作者以未来动态公共交通网络为案例，在线构建公交线路以适配随机用户需求，并在纽约出租车数据集模拟请求上与动态车辆路径问题 (VRP) 求解方法进行比较，结果显示该方法能构建支持复杂用户出行的结构化线路网络。
Motivation: 传统网络设计通常在离线规划阶段完成，而动态网络研究多聚焦于刻画网络演化而非设计。在动态随机环境下，需要网络随环境变化在线构建以维持性能指标，但缺乏相应方法。
Method: 将在线网络设计建模为滚动时域优化问题，并用蒙特卡洛树搜索求解，在公交网络场景中动态构造公交线路来适应随机需求。
Result: 在纽约出租车数据集模拟请求下，与状态最优的动态VRP求解方法相比，该方法不再孤立延伸车辆轨迹，而是构建结构化公交线路网络，支持复杂用户出行，从而提升系统性能。
Conclusion: 论文展示了在线网络设计的潜力，尤其适用于随机动态环境下的公共交通网络设计，但实验仅限模拟场景，未涉及真实部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Within-class Variation Issue in Alzheimer's Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) detection commonly employs machine learning classification models to distinguish between individuals with AD and those without. Different from conventional classification tasks, AD detection involves substantial within-class variation, as individuals sharing the same diagnosis may exhibit different degrees of cognitive impairment. We formulate two aspects of this issue: within-class heterogeneity and instance-level imbalance. To model such variation under binary supervision, we estimate sample-specific AD class probabilities as sample scores and develop two corresponding methods: Soft Target Distillation (SoTD) and Instance-level Re-balancing (InRe). Experiments on the ADReSS and CU-MARVEL corpora show that the estimated scores align with independent cognitive assessments and that the proposed approaches improve AD detection performance. These findings provide insights for modeling within-class variation in speech-based AD detection.
papers.comment: Accepted by Interspeech 2025. This is an extended version of the conference paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）语音检测中的类别内变异问题，将其分解为类别内异质性（within-class heterogeneity）与实例级不平衡（instance-level imbalance）两个方面。作者提出软目标蒸馏（Soft Target Distillation, SoTD）和实例级再平衡（Instance-level Re-balancing, InRe）两种方法，在 ADReSS 与 CU-MARVEL 语料库上验证估计的样本分数与独立认知评估一致，并提升 AD 检测性能。该文为 Interspeech 2025 接收论文的扩展版本。
Motivation: AD 检测通常被建模为二分类任务，但同一诊断标签下的个体认知损伤程度差异很大，导致类别内变异显著，这种异质性和实例级不平衡会干扰标准分类模型的学习。
Method: 在二分类监督下估计每个样本特定的 AD 类别概率作为样本分数，并据此设计两种方法：SoTD 通过软目标蒸馏建模类别内异质性，InRe 通过实例级再平衡缓解样本间不平衡。
Result: 在 ADReSS 和 CU-MARVEL 两个语音语料库上，估计的样本分数与独立认知评估指标一致，且 SoTD 与 InRe 均提升了 AD 检测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为显式建模类别内变异能够改善基于语音的 AD 检测，并为后续研究处理同类问题提供了思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Graphon Particle Systems, Part II: Dynamics of Distributed Stochastic Continuum Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We study the distributed optimization problem over a graphon with a continuum of nodes, which is regarded as the limit of the distributed networked optimization as the number of nodes goes to infinity. Each node has a private local cost function. The global cost function, which all nodes cooperatively minimize, is the integral of the local cost functions on the node set. We propose stochastic gradient descent and gradient tracking algorithms over the graphon. We establish a general lemma for the upper bound estimation related to a class of time-varying differential inequalities with negative linear terms, based upon which, we prove that for both kinds of algorithms, the second moments of the nodes' states are uniformly bounded. Especially, for the stochastic gradient tracking algorithm, we transform the convergence analysis into the asymptotic property of coupled nonlinear differential inequalities with time-varying coefficients and develop a decoupling method. For both kinds of algorithms, we show that by choosing the time-varying algorithm gains properly, all nodes' states achieve $\mathcal{L}^{\infty}$-consensus for a connected graphon. Furthermore, if the local cost functions are strongly convex, then all nodes' states converge to the minimizer of the global cost function and the auxiliary states in the stochastic gradient tracking algorithm converge to the gradient value of the global cost function at the minimizer uniformly in mean square.

TL;DR: 本文研究图极限（graphon）上具有连续统节点的分布式优化问题，将其视为节点数趋于无穷时分布式网络优化的极限。作者提出随机梯度下降与随机梯度跟踪两类算法，证明在连通 graphon 下节点状态可达 ℒ∞-一致，并在局部代价函数强凸时收敛到全局代价函数的最小值点。
Motivation: 大规模网络化分布式优化中节点数量庞大，需要理解节点数趋于无穷时系统的极限行为；graphon 为这种连续统节点网络提供了合适的极限模型。
Method: 在 graphon 上提出随机梯度下降与随机梯度跟踪算法，建立一类带负线性项的时变微分不等式上界估计引理；对随机梯度跟踪，将收敛性分析转化为时变系数耦合非线性微分不等式的渐近性质，并发展解耦方法。
Result: 摘要证明两类算法的节点状态二阶矩一致有界；选取合适的时变增益时，连通 graphon 上所有节点状态实现 ℒ∞-一致；若局部代价函数强凸，则所有节点状态在均方意义下收敛到全局代价函数的最小值，梯度跟踪的辅助状态也均方一致收敛到全局梯度值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为连续统节点上的分布式随机优化提供了收敛性理论保证，并给出了时变增益的选择条件。

papers.title: Forecasting with an N-dimensional Langevin Equation and a Neural-Ordinary Differential Equation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate prediction of electricity day-ahead prices is essential in competitive electricity markets. Although stationary electricity-price forecasting techniques have received considerable attention, research on non-stationary methods is comparatively scarce, despite the common prevalence of non-stationary features in electricity markets. Specifically, existing non-stationary techniques will often aim to address individual non-stationary features in isolation, leaving aside the exploration of concurrent multiple non-stationary effects. Our overarching objective here is the formulation of a framework to systematically model and forecast non-stationary electricity-price time series, encompassing the broader scope of non-stationary behavior. For this purpose we develop a data-driven model that combines an N-dimensional Langevin equation (LE) with a neural-ordinary differential equation (NODE). The LE captures fine-grained details of the electricity-price behavior in stationary regimes but is inadequate for non-stationary conditions. To overcome this inherent limitation, we adopt a NODE approach to learn, and at the same time predict, the difference between the actual electricity-price time series and the simulated price trajectories generated by the LE. By learning this difference, the NODE reconstructs the non-stationary components of the time series that the LE is not able to capture. We exemplify the effectiveness of our framework using the Spanish electricity day-ahead market as a prototypical case study. Our findings reveal that the NODE nicely complements the LE, providing a comprehensive strategy to tackle both stationary and non-stationary electricity-price behavior. The framework's dependability and robustness is demonstrated through different non-stationary scenarios by comparing it against a range of basic naive methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个数据驱动框架，将 N 维 Langevin 方程 (LE) 与神经常微分方程 (NODE) 结合，用于建模和预测非平稳的电力日前价格时间序列。LE 负责刻画平稳区间的精细价格行为，NODE 学习并预测真实序列与 LE 模拟轨迹之间的差异，从而重建 LE 无法捕捉的非平稳成分。作者以西班牙电力日前市场为例验证框架，并在一系列非平稳场景下与多种朴素基准方法对比，认为 NODE 能够很好地补充 LE。
Motivation: 日前电价预测对竞争性电力市场至关重要，但现有非平稳预测方法通常只单独处理某一种非平稳特征，缺乏对多种并发非平稳效应的系统建模。
Method: 构建一个结合 N 维 Langevin 方程与神经常微分方程 (NODE) 的数据驱动模型：LE 生成平稳区间的模拟价格轨迹，NODE 学习真实时间序列与 LE 模拟轨迹之间的差异，以此重构非平稳分量。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在西班牙电力日前市场案例中有效，NODE 能补充 LE 并同时处理平稳与非平稳电价行为；在不同非平稳场景下与多种朴素基准方法对比，展示了框架的可靠性和稳健性，但未给出具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架为系统建模和预测非平稳电价时间序列提供了全面策略，但其有效性仅在西班牙电力日前市场这一原型案例上得到验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Vision Foundation Model Driven Foreground-Aware Pseudo-LiDAR Generation for Monocular 3D Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Pseudo-LiDAR has become a promising paradigm for monocular 3D object detection by transforming monocular images into point cloud representations that can be processed by LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. Recent vision foundation models provide powerful geometric and semantic priors, creating new opportunities for improving the quality of pseudo-LiDAR generation. However, effectively exploiting these priors to produce reliable pseudo-LiDAR remains challenging due to inaccurate depth estimation, insufficient foreground awareness, and redundant background points.In this paper, we propose VFMM3D, a vision foundation model-driven framework for foreground-aware pseudo-LiDAR generation. VFMM3D leverages the depth prior provided by the Depth Anything Model (DAM) and the foreground prior provided by the Segment Anything Model (SAM). A foreground-aware pseudo-LiDAR painting operation is introduced to associate projected 3D points with object-level foreground information, thereby strengthening object structures and suppressing irrelevant background regions. Furthermore, a sparsification strategy is developed to remove redundant points, reduce computational overhead, and improve the compatibility of the generated point clouds with LiDAR-based 3D object detectors. Comprehensive experiments are conducted on two challenging 3D object detection datasets, KITTI and Waymo. Our VFMM3D establishes a new state-of-the-art performance on both datasets. Additionally, experimental results demonstrate the generality of VFMM3D, showcasing its seamless integration into various LiDAR-based 3D object detectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VFMM3D，一个由视觉基础模型驱动的框架，用于单目 3D 物体检测中的前景感知伪 LiDAR 生成。VFMM3D 利用 Depth Anything Model (DAM) 提供的深度先验和 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 提供的前景先验，通过前景感知伪 LiDAR 着色操作强化物体结构、抑制背景点，并用稀疏化策略去除冗余点以降低计算开销。实验在 KITTI 和 Waymo 两个数据集上取得当前最优性能，并展示了可与多种基于 LiDAR 的 3D 检测器无缝集成。
Motivation: 伪 LiDAR 范式依赖将单目图像转换为点云供 LiDAR 检测器使用，但现有方法受限于不准确的深度估计、前景感知不足以及冗余背景点，难以充分利用视觉基础模型提供的几何与语义先验。
Method: 提出 VFMM3D 框架：利用 DAM 的深度先验和 SAM 的前景先验，引入前景感知伪 LiDAR 着色操作，将投影后的 3D 点与物体级前景信息关联以增强物体结构并抑制背景区域；同时设计稀疏化策略去除冗余点，降低计算开销并提高生成点云与 LiDAR 检测器的兼容性。
Result: 在 KITTI 和 Waymo 两个挑战性 3D 检测数据集上，VFMM3D 均达到新的最优性能，且实验显示其能无缝集成到多种基于 LiDAR 的 3D 物体检测器中。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，联合利用深度模型与分割模型提供的先验并配合前景感知与稀疏化策略，可有效提升伪 LiDAR 生成质量及其对检测器的适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exact and general decoupled solutions of the LMC Multitask Gaussian Process model
papers.abstract_en: The Linear Model of Co-regionalization (LMC) is a very general multitask gaussian process model for regression or classification. While its expressiveness and conceptual simplicity are appealing, naive implementations have cubic complexity in the product (number of datapoints $\times$ number of tasks), making approximations mandatory for most applications. However, recent work has shown that in some settings the latent processes of the model can be decoupled, leading to a complexity that is only linear in the number of said processes. We here extend these results, showing from the most general assumptions that the only condition necessary to an efficient exact computation of the LMC is a mild hypothesis on the noise model. We introduce a full parametrization of the resulting \emph{projected LMC} model, enabling its efficient optimization. The effectiveness of this approach is assessed through synthetic and real-data experiments, testing in particular the behavior of its underlying noise model restriction.\\ Overall, the projected LMC appears as a competitive and simpler alternative to state-of-the art multitask gaussian process models. It greatly facilitates some computations such as training data updates or leave-one-out cross-validation, and is more interpretable, for it gives access to its low-dimensional quantities and to their explicit relation with the full-dimensional data. These qualities could facilitate the adoption by various industries of entire classes of methodologies, notably multitask bayesian optimization.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Linear Model of Co-regionalization (LMC) 这一多任务高斯过程模型的精确且高效计算问题。作者证明，在仅对噪声模型施加温和假设的条件下，LMC 的潜在过程可以被解耦，从而将朴素实现中随（数据点数×任务数）三次方增长的复杂度降为随潜在过程数线性增长。基于此，文章提出完整参数化的 projected LMC 模型，并通过合成与真实数据实验验证其有效性。
Motivation: LMC 表达力强且概念简单，但朴素实现的复杂度为 O((N×T)^3)（N 为数据点数，T 为任务数），大多数应用不得不引入近似。已有的解耦结果仅在部分设定下成立，本文希望从最一般的假设出发，找出实现精确高效计算所需的最小条件，并给出可优化的完整模型参数化。
Method: 从最一般的建模假设出发，推导出高效精确计算 LMC 的唯一必要条件是噪声模型满足一个温和假设；基于该假设对潜在过程进行解耦，提出完整的 projected LMC 参数化，并给出其高效优化方法。
Result: 合成和真实数据实验表明，projected LMC 可媲美当前最优的多任务高斯过程模型，同时大幅简化训练数据更新、留一交叉验证等计算，并能显式访问低维潜在量及其与全维数据的关系，从而提升可解释性。
Conclusion: projected LMC 可作为多任务高斯过程建模的竞争性且更简单的替代方案，其计算便利性与可解释性有助于工业界采用多任务贝叶斯优化等一类方法；但有效性依赖于对噪声模型的限制性假设。

papers.title: AI-driven Prices for Externalities and Sustainability in Production Markets
papers.abstract_en: Traditional competitive markets do not account for negative externalities; indirect costs that some participants impose on others, such as the cost of over-appropriating a common-pool resource (which diminishes future stock, and thus harvest, for everyone). Quantifying appropriate interventions to market prices has proven to be quite challenging. We propose a practical approach to computing market prices and allocations via a deep reinforcement learning policymaker agent, operating in an environment of other learning agents. Our policymaker allows us to tune the prices with regard to diverse objectives such as sustainability and resource wastefulness, fairness, buyers' and sellers' welfare, etc. As a highlight of our findings, our policymaker is significantly more successful in maintaining resource sustainability, compared to the market equilibrium outcome, in scarce resource environments.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 22nd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2023)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统竞争性市场无法处理负外部性（如公共池资源过度占用导致未来存量减少）的问题，提出由深度强化学习 (deep reinforcement learning) 政策制定智能体 (policymaker agent) 在由其他学习智能体组成的环境中计算市场价格与配置。该政策制定者可根据可持续性、资源浪费、公平性、买卖双方福利等目标调节价格，并在稀缺资源环境中比市场均衡更有效地维持资源可持续性。
Motivation: 传统竞争性市场未将参与者施加给他人的间接成本（负外部性）纳入价格，例如对共享资源的过度占用会减少未来存量并损害所有人的长期收益；而量化合适的价格干预措施一直很有挑战。
Method: 提出一种实用方法，通过一个深度强化学习政策制定者智能体，在包含其他学习智能体的市场环境中学习设定价格与分配方案，从而针对多样化的目标（如可持续性、资源浪费、公平性及买卖双方福利）调节市场结果。
Result: 摘要的亮点结果是：在资源稀缺环境中，所提出的政策制定者相比市场均衡 (market equilibrium) 结果能显著更成功地维持资源可持续性。
Conclusion: 作者提出该方法可以作为一种对市场价格进行干预以兼顾外部性与可持续性等目标的可行途径；摘要未明确说明其局限或适用范围。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要的亮点结果是：在资源稀缺环境中，所提出的政策制定者相比市场均衡 (market equilibrium) 结果能显著更成功地维持资源可持续性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者提出该方法可以作为一种对市场价格进行干预以兼顾外部性与可持续性等目标的可行途径；摘要未明确说明其局限或适用范围。

papers.title: When Failures Propagate: Causal Failure Attribution in Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interleaves retrieval, reasoning, and answer generation across multiple hops. A retrieval error at hop 1 can surface only as a wrong answer at hop 3, while later retrieval can also repair the trajectory. This paper introduces AgenticRAG-FP, an interventional benchmark for causal failure attribution in agentic RAG. The benchmark injects a certified fault at a specified hop, re-executes the downstream trajectory, and evaluates diagnosers against the known intervention. Its central question is whether a post-hoc trace still identifies the injected hop after the suffix changes. In the completed strict dense Claude Haiku 4.5 sweep on 80 three-hop MuSiQue questions, coverage-based diagnosis is 0.91 at hop 1 and 0.00 at hops 2 and 3 (n=43,36,21 failed trajectories). A smaller content-corruption study changes an answer-bearing or bridge fact in topically intact evidence. At depth 2, where 18 failed cases remain after filtering, coverage-based diagnosis is 0.00 and a frozen-hop counterfactual probe is 0.67 in an exploratory pooled comparison. Depth-3 content estimates are descriptive only because they contain three failed cases. These results make propagation depth an explicit evaluation axis for diagnosing agentic RAG failures while distinguishing broad evidence of post-hoc signal loss from small-sample method comparisons.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgenticRAG-FP，一个用于智能体 RAG（agentic retrieval-augmented generation）因果失败归因的干预式基准。基准在指定跳（hop）注入认证故障（certified fault），重新执行下游轨迹，并让诊断器对照已知干预评估；核心问题是当后缀变化后，事后轨迹是否仍能识别注入跳。在 80 个三跳 MuSiQue 问题的严格稠密 Claude Haiku 4.5 扫描中，覆盖率式诊断（coverage-based diagnosis）在跳 1 为 0.91，跳 2 和跳 3 为 0.00；研究还将传播深度作为诊断智能体 RAG 失败的显式评估轴。
Motivation: 智能体 RAG 在多次检索、推理和答案生成之间交错进行，跳 1 的检索错误可能直到跳 3 才表现为错误答案，而后继检索也可能修复轨迹；现有事后轨迹诊断缺乏对已知干预的对照评估，难以确定诊断器能否识别故障传播的源头跳。
Method: 构建干预式基准 AgenticRAG-FP，在指定跳注入认证故障并重放下游轨迹，用已知干预评估诊断器；采用覆盖率式诊断和冻结跳反事实探针（frozen-hop counterfactual probe），在严格稠密扫描与内容损坏（content-corruption）两种研究设计中比较诊断方法。
Result: 在 80 个三跳 MuSiQue 问题的严格稠密 Claude Haiku 4.5 扫描中，覆盖率式诊断在跳 1 为 0.91，跳 2 与跳 3 为 0.00（失败轨迹 n=43,36,21）；内容损坏研究中深度 2 过滤后剩 18 个失败案例，覆盖率式诊断为 0.00，冻结跳反事实探针在探索性合并比较中为 0.67；深度 3 仅含 3 个失败案例，结果只作为描述性证据。
Conclusion: 摘要将传播深度确立为诊断智能体 RAG 失败的显式评估维度，并区分了广泛的事后信号丢失证据与小样本方法比较的局限；深度 3 的小样本使得相应估计仅具描述性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Applying Anthropic Primitives at Large Enterprises: Harness Paradigm for Knowledge Work
papers.abstract_en: Frontier models have collapsed the cost of writing custom code: a niche problem a specialist sees in their own domain now costs an afternoon. The cost of reviewing and maintaining that code hasn't collapsed. Each solution drifts from the next; understanding one means reading its codebase from scratch. Large enterprises build something centrally governed instead: at worst an off-the-shelf product, at best a graph-orchestration framework wired bespoke per use case, or a low-code platform used as the orchestrator. These are custom every time and limited in scope. Enterprises don't weigh a third option that escapes both constraints: the harness paradigm. Recent work treats the coding-agent harness as enterprise infrastructure rather than a coding tool, converging on three findings: harnesses suffice at the task level and outperform more elaborate architectures on enterprise work (arXiv:2604.00073, arXiv:2604.13107); harness choice accounts for most of the variance in agent benchmark results, more than model choice does (arXiv:2605.23950); and the gap between that finding and enterprise adoption is governance (arXiv:2605.10223, arXiv:2605.18747). We propose an architecture that closes that gap. One harness runs unmodified as the backbone; the code stays identical across every deployment, so reviewing what gets built collapses to reading its instructions file. Section 4 gives four mechanisms: credential-scoped tooling, where each backend gets one generic request tool and a scoped credential instead of a hand-built method; authorization logic outside the harness, so one artifact runs as a cron backbone, a chat-surface engine, and a terminal tool; registration is a side effect of pushing code, collapsing an audit a review of a text file. Built on microcc (<https://pypi.org/project/micro-cc/>), our reference harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型企业中智能体代码维护成本高、集中治理方案每次定制且范围有限的问题，提出第三种选择：编码智能体 harness 范式。作者基于近期三项研究发现（harness 在任务层面足够且优于复杂架构、harness 选择比模型选择对基准结果方差贡献更大、从研究到企业采用的差距在于治理），提出一个统一 harness 架构，使同一份代码在所有部署中保持一致，并将审查简化为阅读指令文件。摘要未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 前沿模型大幅降低了写自定义代码的成本，但审查和维护这些代码的成本没有下降；企业现有的集中治理方案（现成产品、图编排框架、低代码平台）每次都需定制且范围有限。
Method: 提出一个架构：一个 harness 作为骨干且在所有部署中原样运行，代码保持一致，审查退化为阅读指令文件。第 4 节给出四个机制：凭据作用域工具（每个后端一个通用请求工具加作用域凭据）、harness 外部的授权逻辑、推送代码即注册（审计变成文本文件审查），并基于 microcc 提供参考实现。
Result: 摘要引用 arXiv:2604.00073、arXiv:2604.13107、arXiv:2605.23950、arXiv:2605.10223、arXiv:2605.18747 等研究，说明 harness 范式在任务层面足够、harness 选择主导基准方差、差距在于治理；未给出本文自己的量化实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该架构通过保持 harness 不变、将审查归结为读取指令文件，弥合了研究结论与企业采用之间的治理差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RECOUNT: Reference-guided Counting with Synthetic Visual Exemplars
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided zero-shot object counters excel at spatial localization but categorize poorly on novel or fine-grained classes: natural language is too coarse to fully specify visual identity, so they fail to separate visually similar distractors. Few-shot counters sidestep this with visual exemplars, but require manual annotations on every image. To resolve this dilemma, we introduce RECOUNT, a plug-and-play framework for image-guided zero-shot counting. Rather than specify a category with a text prompt, our key insight is to specify it visually, from a single off-scene reference image. However, we find that a lone reference image provides narrow coverage of a category's appearance and is unreliable across diverse scenes. We therefore repurpose a diffusion model as an automated contrastive data engine that expands the reference into a diverse exemplar gallery, supplying the discriminative detail that text cannot. RECOUNT preserves the class-agnostic proposals of any frozen counter and offloads categorization to a separate visual module (a frozen backbone with a lightweight head trained on this synthetic data) that matches each proposal against the target and distractor galleries. Applied to a frozen counter, RECOUNT attains the best zero-shot accuracy on both benchmarks, cutting counting error (MAE) by 55% on LookAlikes and 21% on PairTally relative to the strongest prior zero-shot counter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RECOUNT，一个即插即用的图像引导零样本计数框架。核心思路是用一张场景外参考图来视觉指定目标类别，并借助扩散模型将参考图扩展为多样化的示例图库，提供文本提示无法给出的判别性细节。框架保留任意冻结计数器的类无关提案，用冻结骨干加轻量分类头在每个提案上匹配目标与干扰示例图库，在 LookAlikes 和 PairTally 基准上取得最佳零样本计数精度。
Motivation: 文本引导的零样本计数器擅长空间定位，但在新类别或细粒度类别上分类能力弱，因为自然语言不足以完整指定视觉身份，难以区分视觉相似的干扰物；少样本计数器虽使用视觉示例，但需要对每张图像进行人工标注。
Method: 提出即插即用框架 RECOUNT，用单张 off-scene 参考图像而非文本提示来指定类别；将扩散模型用作自动化的对比数据引擎，把参考图扩展为多样的示例图库；保留任何冻结计数器的类无关提案，并将分类任务交给一个在合成数据上训练的轻量级头部与冻结骨干组成的独立视觉模块，匹配提案与目标及干扰图库。
Result: 摘要报告 RECOUNT 在 LookAlikes 和 PairTally 两个基准上取得最佳零样本计数精度，相对最强的先前零样本计数器，计数误差（MAE）分别降低 55% 和 21%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，用视觉参考图配合合成示例图库能够提供文本所缺乏的判别性细节，在不修改冻结计数器的情况下提升零样本计数的类别区分能力。

papers.title: Dual-Cache Latent Space Communication between Heterogeneous Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems split work across models, so answering often requires knowledge that sits in another agent's context: a Sharer has encoded information that a Receiver needs to complete its task. They usually communicate by exchanging text, which puts autoregressive decoding on the critical path and reduces the exchange to a discrete message written without sight of the receiver's state. Recent latent protocols instead translate the sharer's key-value (KV) cache into the receiver's: C2C supports heterogeneous models but requires both to read the same input, while LCF-X removes this shared-context requirement through position-free sharer-cache pooling. Three restrictions remain: LCF-X compresses the sharer alone, supplies the same layer-local summary to every receiver position with no joint cross-layer memory to retrieve from, and assumes matched layer count and KV geometry. We introduce XKV, which lifts all three: learned-query attention pools both caches; self-attention over receiver-aligned layer tokens, with a learned layer map reconciling different depths, mixes the pooled summaries into a compact joint memory; and a shared position decoder lets every raw receiver cache position retrieve its own per-head-gated residual in the receiver's native KV geometry. Both models stay frozen and may differ in family, depth, KV-head count, head dimension, and tokenizer; only the translator is trained. Across 45 dataset-model-pair settings (six heterogeneous and three same-model ordered pairings, five datasets), XKV attains the highest macro score and best average rank, improving on LCF-X on every dataset (by 4.6 exact-match and 4.2 F1 points on ROPES) and surpassing text communication on four of the five, while training 76% fewer parameters and translating a cache pair 10.3x faster (5.8 vs. 59.9 ms); end to end, XKV is 26% faster than LCF-X and 6.8x faster than text communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XKV，一种在异构语言模型之间进行潜在空间通信的方法，利用共享者（Sharer）与接收者（Receiver）双方的关键值缓存（KV cache）传递信息，而无需生成文本。XKV 用可学习查询注意力（learned-query attention）池化两个缓存，通过接收者对齐的层 token 自注意力与可学习层映射构建紧凑的跨层联合记忆，并让每个接收者缓存位置在原生 KV 几何中检索自己的 per-head 门控残差。摘要报告在 45 个数据集-模型对设置上取得最高宏观分数和最佳平均排名，且训练参数减少 76%、缓存对翻译快 10.3 倍。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中的模型常需要另一个智能体上下文中的知识，传统文本通信把自回归解码放在关键路径上，且无法看到接收者状态。已有潜在协议 C2C 要求双方读取相同输入，LCF-X 虽去掉共享上下文要求，但仍只压缩共享者、向所有接收者位置提供相同的层局部摘要且缺乏跨层联合记忆，并要求层数与 KV 几何匹配。
Method: 提出 XKV 翻译器：用可学习查询注意力同时池化两个缓存；在接收者对齐的层 token 上做自注意力，并用可学习层映射（learned layer map）调和不同深度，将池化摘要混合成紧凑联合记忆；通过共享位置解码器（shared position decoder）让每个原始接收者缓存位置在接收者原生 KV 几何中检索各自 per-head 门控残差。两个模型保持冻结，可以来自不同家族、深度、KV 头数、头维度和 tokenizer，只有翻译器被训练。
Result: 在 45 个数据集-模型对设置（六个异构和三个同模型有序配对，五个数据集）上，XKV 取得最高宏观分数和最佳平均排名；在每个数据集上都优于 LCF-X，在 ROPES 上提升 4.6 exact-match 和 4.2 F1 点；五个数据集中四个超过文本通信。训练参数少 76%，缓存对翻译快 10.3 倍（5.8 ms vs 59.9 ms）；端到端比 LCF-X 快 26%，比文本通信快 6.8 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 XKV 同时解除了共享上下文、层数/几何匹配等限制，通过双缓存池化、跨层联合记忆与位置感知解码，在更快、参数更少的情况下优于现有潜在协议和文本通信。

summary_sections.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统中的模型常需要另一个智能体上下文中的知识，传统文本通信把自回归解码放在关键路径上，且无法看到接收者状态。已有潜在协议 C2C 要求双方读取相同输入，LCF-X 虽去掉共享上下文要求，但仍只压缩共享者、向所有接收者位置提供相同的层局部摘要且缺乏跨层联合记忆，并要求层数与 KV 几何匹配。
summary_sections.method: 提出 XKV 翻译器：用可学习查询注意力同时池化两个缓存；在接收者对齐的层 token 上做自注意力，并用可学习层映射（learned layer map）调和不同深度，将池化摘要混合成紧凑联合记忆；通过共享位置解码器（shared position decoder）让每个原始接收者缓存位置在接收者原生 KV 几何中检索各自 per-head 门控残差。两个模型保持冻结，可以来自不同家族、深度、KV 头数、头维度和 tokenizer，只有翻译器被训练。
summary_sections.result: 在 45 个数据集-模型对设置（六个异构和三个同模型有序配对，五个数据集）上，XKV 取得最高宏观分数和最佳平均排名；在每个数据集上都优于 LCF-X，在 ROPES 上提升 4.6 exact-match 和 4.2 F1 点；五个数据集中四个超过文本通信。训练参数少 76%，缓存对翻译快 10.3 倍（5.8 ms vs 59.9 ms）；端到端比 LCF-X 快 26%，比文本通信快 6.8 倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 XKV 同时解除了共享上下文、层数/几何匹配等限制，通过双缓存池化、跨层联合记忆与位置感知解码，在更快、参数更少的情况下优于现有潜在协议和文本通信。

papers.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agent programs are moving from prototypes into production, where reusable skills, tools, and workflow packages must be reviewed with evidence rather than prose. Current gates often scan these artifacts for structure, style, and security, but they do not answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete enterprise tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy? We present ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills), a repository-native framework for evaluating skills and product capability packages as executable agent artifacts. ACES runs paired live trials with and without a target skill, normalizes trajectories into the Agent Trajectory Interchange Format (ATIF), grades six default runtime metrics, and reports Skill Lift: the target skill's added value for a fixed task, harness, workspace, and scorer. The same protocol supports product-owned task suites that compare baseline, skill, bundle, team-skill, and plugin targets. On 145 real skills from internal enterprise repositories and public catalogs, scan-only gates surface useful authoring issues but measure complementary facets (structural versus LLM-judge Spearman $ρ= 0.14$). Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 of 64 production skills and four primary harnesses, mean composite Skill Lift is 0.2134 (95\% paired-case CI [0.1967, 0.2301]); mean outcome-only lift, the average of accuracy and goal accuracy, is 0.1799. Composite lift is positive in 72.8\% of paired cases. The largest process-metric gains appear in skill execution, behavior check, and skill efficiency---signals about discovery, routing, workflow following, and tool use that document scans cannot observe. An open-source implementation of the methodology is available in NVIDIA SkillEvaluator.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Extended preprint incorporating versions accepted at Agent Skills '26 (ACM CAIS 2026) and the KDD 2026 Workshop on Enterprise AI Agents: From Prototypes to Production (oral presentation). Open-source implementation: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillEvaluator
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ACES（Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills），一个面向企业 Agent 技能与能力包的仓库原生评估框架，把技能当作可执行的 Agent 工件来评估，而不是只评估 Agent 或检查文档。ACES 通过有/无目标技能的配对实时试验，将轨迹归一化为 ATIF 格式，用六个默认运行时指标计算 Skill Lift。在 145 个真实技能和 947 个评分配对用例上，平均复合 Skill Lift 为 0.2134，且过程性指标能捕捉到文档扫描无法观察的信号。
Motivation: 企业 Agent 程序正从原型走向生产，可复用的技能、工具和工作流包需要基于证据的评审；现有门禁只检查结构、风格和安全，无法回答关键部署问题：能力包在相同模型、沙箱和评分策略下是否真的帮助实时 Agent 完成企业任务。
Method: ACES 以仓库原生方式运行配对实时试验（有和无目标技能两种条件），将轨迹归一化为 Agent Trajectory Interchange Format（ATIF），对六个默认运行时指标打分，并报告 Skill Lift，即目标技能在固定任务、测试框架、工作区和评分器下的增量价值。同一协议还支持产品自有的任务套件，比较 baseline、skill、bundle、team-skill 和 plugin 等目标。
Result: 在来自内部企业仓库和公共目录的 145 个真实技能上，纯扫描门禁与 LLM-judge 的 Spearman ρ=0.14，说明两者测量的是互补维度。在 58/64 个生产技能、四个主要测试框架的 947 个评分配对用例中，平均复合 Skill Lift 为 0.2134（95% CI [0.1967, 0.2301]），平均 outcome-only lift（accuracy 与 goal accuracy 的均值）为 0.1799，复合 lift 在 72.8% 的配对用例中为正。
Conclusion: 最大的过程性指标提升出现在 skill execution、behavior check 和 skill efficiency，这些信号涉及技能发现、路由、工作流遵循和工具使用，是文档扫描无法观察到的。作者认为技能类能力包应作为可执行工件进行证据化评估，并开源了 NVIDIA SkillEvaluator 实现。

papers.title: Difficulty-Aware Semantic-ID Optimization for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation casts retrieval and ranking as autoregressive generation over hierarchical item identifiers. A common recipe is SFT followed by GRPO, yet vanilla GRPO is poorly matched to this tree-structured task. Under the frozen SFT checkpoint, the exact target is absent from the first 16 candidates of the 50-beam constrained ranking for many prompts, and in harder cases none of these candidates enters the target SID branch. This prompt-level diagnostic motivates a training concern: when on-policy GRPO groups are similarly target-missing, item-level rewards may produce weak or degenerate reward variation even if some candidates follow part of the target path. We propose Difficulty-Aware Semantic-ID Optimization (DASO), a tree-aware post-training method that addresses this failure mode as an online rollout-allocation problem. Instead of using fixed difficulty buckets or uniformly injecting ground-truth completions, DASO profiles each current rollout group by prefix-match depth, locates the bottleneck SID levels where candidates leave the target path, and reallocates a bounded portion of the group to prefix-guided completions while retaining raw rollouts for contrast. A SID-prefix reward provides graded credit, while an auxiliary SFT anchor mitigates regression on examples already solved by the SFT checkpoint. On the public benchmarks, DASO improves over MiniOneRec-style GRPO on 11 of 12 metrics and achieves the best result on 9 of 12 metrics; it also improves most level-wise recall metrics on the internal recommendation task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Difficulty-Aware Semantic-ID Optimization (DASO)，一种针对语义 ID 生成式推荐的后训练方法。作者指出 vanilla GRPO 与树结构语义 ID 任务不匹配：在冻结 SFT checkpoint 下，许多 prompt 的 50-beam 约束排序前 16 个候选中没有精确目标，部分困难 case 中甚至没有候选进入目标 SID 分支。DASO 将这一问题建模为在线 rollout 分配问题，按前缀匹配深度定位瓶颈层级并重新分配 rollout，同时引入 SID-prefix reward 与 SFT anchor。在公共基准上，DASO 在 12 项指标中的 11 项上超过 MiniOneRec-style GRPO，并在 9 项指标上取得最佳结果。
Motivation: 语义 ID 生成式推荐常用 SFT 后接 GRPO 的流程，但 vanilla GRPO 在这种树结构任务上匹配不佳。prompt 级诊断显示，冻结 SFT checkpoint 下许多 prompt 的 beam 候选中缺少精确目标，而更困难的情况下没有任何候选中进入目标 SID 分支；当 on-policy GRPO 组同样缺失目标时，item-level reward 可能产生弱或退化的奖励变化。
Method: DASO 将上述失败模式视为在线 rollout 分配问题。它不使用固定难度桶或均匀注入 ground-truth completions，而是对每个当前 rollout 组按 prefix-match depth 进行剖析，定位候选中离开目标路径的瓶颈 SID 层级，并将组内有限比例重新分配到 prefix-guided completions，同时保留原始 rollouts 用于对比。方法还包括提供分级奖励的 SID-prefix reward，以及缓解 SFT checkpoint 已解决示例回归的辅助 SFT anchor。
Result: 在公共基准上，DASO 在 12 项指标中的 11 项上优于 MiniOneRec-style GRPO，并在 12 项指标中的 9 项上取得最佳结果；在内部推荐任务上也提升了大多数 level-wise recall 指标。
Conclusion: 作者将 DASO 总结为一种树感知的后训练方法，通过在线 rollout 分配和难度感知的奖励设计解决语义 ID 生成式推荐中 GRPO 的失败模式。摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Let Time Tell: Identification and Gaussian Process Estimation for Interrupted Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We study causal inference in interrupted time series designs where a treatment affects every unit simultaneously, so that the contemporaneous controls used by difference-in-differences and synthetic control are unavailable and the counterfactual must be extrapolated from a unit's own pre-treatment history. We establish identification within the potential outcomes framework and estimate the counterfactual by Gaussian process regression. Rather than committing to a single best-fitting trend, the estimator retains the functions consistent with the pre-treatment series and widens its intervals where extrapolation magnifies their divergence. Connecting it to reproducing kernel Hilbert space theory, we derive a bias decomposition that isolates the component extrapolation inflates and a worst-case bound on that component, justifying the Gaussian process estimator's posterior variance as extrapolation-aware uncertainty quantification. In closed form, the band equals the worst-case divergence the model class permits among functions consistent with the pre-treatment data. The method is illustrated with calibrated simulations and an analysis of handgun purchases after the Supreme Court's Heller decision, a universal treatment whose practical effect concentrates in a single jurisdiction. An R package, gpss, implements the approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究中断时间序列 (interrupted time series) 设计中的因果推断，即处理同时影响所有单元、因而无法使用差分法和合成控制的同期对照组时，如何从单元自身的处理前历史外推反事实。作者在潜在结果框架下建立可识别性，并用高斯过程回归 (Gaussian process regression) 估计反事实，保留与处理前序列一致的全部函数而非单一最优拟合，从而在推断区间中体现外推放大的分歧。方法通过校准模拟和 Heller 判决后手枪购买数据分析进行说明，并提供 R 包 gpss 实现。
Motivation: 在中断时间序列设计中，当处理对所有单元同时生效时，差分法 (difference-in-differences) 和合成控制 (synthetic control) 依赖的同期对照组不可用，反事实必须从单元自身处理前历史外推，这一问题需要专门的识别与估计框架。
Method: 在潜在结果框架下给出识别条件，采用高斯过程回归估计反事实；与再生核希尔伯特空间 (reproducing kernel Hilbert space, RKHS) 理论建立联系后，推导出偏差分解以隔离外推放大的分量，并给出该分量的最坏情形界，从而将高斯过程估计的后验方差解释为对外推敏感的 (extrapolation-aware) 不确定性量化。
Result: 摘要报告推导了外推放大分量的最坏情形界，并指出闭式置信带等于模型类中与处理前数据一致函数之间的最坏情形分歧；方法通过校准模拟和 Heller 判决后的手枪购买分析得到展示，R 包 gpss 实现了该方法。
Conclusion: 高斯过程估计器能够在缺乏同期对照组时提供外推感知的不确定性量化，其闭式区间对应模型类允许的最坏情形分歧；该方法以 gpss 软件包形式发布，可推广到类似通用处理场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Dataset-Centric Benchmark of Deep Learning Methods for Grape Leaf Disease Classification and Detection
papers.abstract_en: Grape leaf disease recognition is important for precision agriculture, enabling early diagnosis, timely intervention, and improved vineyard management. Although deep learning has achieved strong results, many studies rely on few datasets, often acquired under controlled conditions, and may not reflect real vineyard challenges such as complex backgrounds, variable illumination, occlusion, leaf pose, disease severity, and device differences. This paper presents a dataset-centric benchmark of deep learning methods for grape leaf disease classification and detection. We analyze publicly available datasets in terms of disease categories, annotation types, acquisition conditions, image characteristics, class distributions, provenance, and task suitability. Representative models are evaluated in three settings: image-level classification, region-level classification, and object detection. Classification is assessed using accuracy, while detection is evaluated using mAP@50 and mAP@50:95. Cross-dataset experiments further examine transfer between datasets with compatible disease categories but different visual and annotation characteristics. Results show near-saturated classification performance on several controlled or derivative datasets, greater difficulty on heterogeneous datasets, and substantial variation in detection performance across annotation settings. Cross-dataset performance drops sharply, especially for object detection, indicating that shared disease labels do not necessarily define equivalent recognition tasks. The benchmark emphasizes dataset provenance, realistic field evaluation, annotation compatibility, and external validation for reliable vineyard disease recognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个以数据集为中心的深度学习基准，用于葡萄叶病害的分类与检测。作者系统分析了公开数据集在病害类别、标注类型、采集条件、图像特征、类别分布、来源和任务适配性等方面的差异，并在图像级分类、区域级分类和物体检测三种设置下评估代表性模型。跨数据集实验显示性能急剧下降，尤其是检测任务，表明共享病害标签并不必然构成等价的识别任务。研究强调真实田间评测、标注兼容性和外部验证的重要性。
Motivation: 现有葡萄叶病害识别研究多依赖少量受控条件下采集的数据集，难以反映真实葡萄园中的复杂背景、光照变化、遮挡、叶片姿态、病害严重度和设备差异等挑战，导致模型在实际场景中的可靠性存疑。
Method: 提出以数据集为中心的基准评测方法：分析公开数据集的多维属性，在图像级分类、区域级分类和物体检测三种设置下评估代表性模型，并设计跨数据集迁移实验，考察标签兼容但视觉和标注特征不同数据集之间的泛化能力。

papers.title: JuryProbe: An Empirical Consensus-Risk Diagnostic for Routing Reference-Free Factuality Judge Panels to Grounded Verification
papers.abstract_en: Panels of inexpensive LLM judges increasingly make accept-or-escalate decisions. In factuality settings, accepting a claim because several reference-free judges agree can create a hidden risk: agreement may reflect shared false-negative blind spots rather than independent evidence. We introduce JuryProbe, an empirical consensus-risk diagnostic for reference-free factuality judge panels, paired with a calibration-based routing policy. JuryProbe estimates consensus risk from a labeled calibration probe using false-negative-only (FN-only) judge correlation and false-consensus lift; when flagged high-risk, reference-free majority accepts are routed to the same judges with trusted references. On audited FEVER corruptions, reference-free panels show correlated false negatives (FN-only correlations 0.402 and 0.368; lifts 3.13x and 18.13x), while unanimous false consensus drops to zero under a trusted-reference best-case diagnostic on both minimal-pair and non-minimal-pair evidence. In flagged settings, the routed policy is by construction equivalent to grounding every reference-free majority accept (verified in 34/34 splits): improvement comes from accept-conditioned grounding, while the diagnostic determines whether to activate it. A fixed, pre-specified rule flags 8-10 of 10 splits across synthetic, benchmark-authored, and scientific families and 0 of 10 on a negative control, where standing down avoids 28% of reference acquisitions at a 0.004 increase in false accepts. False-accept reduction persists under weak BM25 retrieval at substantial coverage cost, while stale stand-down labels require periodic recalibration. JuryProbe provides no formal risk guarantee and does not establish reliable stand-down on natural panels; its supported contribution is an empirical diagnostic of high-risk panel error dependence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JuryProbe，一种面向无参考 (reference-free) 事实性法官小组 (factuality judge panel) 的经验性共识风险诊断工具，并配套基于校准的路由策略。JuryProbe 利用仅假阴性 (false-negative-only) 的法官相关性和假共识提升 (false-consensus lift) 从带标签的校准探针中估计共识风险；当风险被标记为高时，将无参考的多数接受 (majority accepts) 路由到同一组法官并附带可信参考。在 FEVER corruptions 上的审计实验中，无参考小组表现出相关的假阴性，而统一假共识在可信参考的最佳情形诊断下降为零。
Motivation: 多个廉价 LLM 法官组成的法官小组越来越多地做出接受或升级 (accept-or-escalate) 决策。在事实性场景中，因为几个无参考法官同意就接受一个主张会带来隐藏风险：这种一致可能反映共享的假阴性盲区，而非独立证据。
Method: JuryProbe 从带标签的校准探针中，通过仅假阴性法官相关性和假共识提升来估计共识风险作为诊断指标；当风险被标记为高时，路由策略将无参考的多数接受转交由同一组法官配合可信参考进行接地验证 (grounded verification)。
Result: 在审计的 FEVER corruptions 上，无参考小组显示相关假阴性（仅假阴性相关性 0.402 和 0.368；提升 3.13x 和 18.13x），而在可信参考最佳情形诊断下，最小对和非最小对证据的统一假共识均降至零。在标记场景中，路由策略在 34/34 个分割中经构造与对所有多数接受逐条接地等价。固定预指定规则在合成、基准作者和科学族系的 10 个分割中标记 8-10 个，在阴性对照的 10 个分割中标记 0 个；放弃接地可避免 28% 的参考获取，同时假接受增加 0.004。在弱 BM25 检索下假接受减少仍然存在，但覆盖代价显著；过时的弃守标签需定期重新校准。
Conclusion: JuryProbe 不提供正式的风险保证，也不建立自然法官面板上可靠的弃守 (stand-down) 行为；其被支持的贡献是一种针对高风险面板误差依赖性的经验性诊断工具。

papers.title: Sparse Light Field Sampling Improves Casual 3D and 4D Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Many consumer smartphones, stereo cameras, and light field cameras record multiple synchronized viewpoints in a single exposure event. However, novel view synthesis pipelines commonly use only a monocular stream and rely on camera motion or learned priors to obtain angular coverage. In this paper, we ask: why do we use only one viewpoint? We analyze sensor-limited multi-view, where one sensor trades off spatial and angular resolution, and exposure-limited multi-view, where multiple sensors on one commodity device observe each event simultaneously. We introduce a new dataset incorporating three types of commodity multi-view cameras, and evaluate sparse-view 3DGS and 4DGS baselines measuring reconstruction quality as a function of number of exposures and angle between extreme views. Our results demonstrate that using multiple cameras, even with a low baseline, significantly improves reconstruction quality in single-shot, few-shot, and casual video settings. In addition, under a fixed sensor budget, angular sampling improves reconstruction when exposures are scarce despite lower spatial resolution. The gains are most pronounced for single-shot and dynamic scenes, where a stationary monocular camera lacks the angular diversity to recover scene geometry and motion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对新视角合成中通常只使用单目流的问题，研究消费级设备在单次曝光事件中记录多个同步视角的稀疏光场采样价值。作者区分了传感器受限多视角与曝光受限多视角两种设定，引入一个包含三类消费级多视角相机的新数据集，并用稀疏视角 3DGS 和 4DGS 基线评估重建质量。结果显示即使低基线的多相机也能显著提升单次拍摄、少样本和日常视频设置下的重建质量，且固定传感器预算下曝光稀缺时角度采样优于降低空间分辨率。
Motivation: 现有新视角合成流程通常只用单目流，依靠相机运动或学习先验获取角度覆盖；论文质疑为何不用同一曝光事件中的多个同步视角，并分析消费级多视角设备在传感器分辨率和曝光次数受限条件下的重建增益。
Method: 提出 sensor-limited multi-view 与 exposure-limited multi-view 两类设定，构建包含三种消费级多视角相机的新数据集，并以稀疏视角 3DGS/4DGS 为基线，测量重建质量随曝光数和极端视角夹角的变化。
Result: 摘要报告多相机采样（即使基线很低）在单次、少样本和 casual video 设置下显著提升重建质量；在固定传感器预算下，曝光稀缺时角度采样比低空间分辨率更有效，且增益在单次拍摄和动态场景中最明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为静止单目相机缺乏角度多样性以恢复场景几何和运动，建议在新视角合成中利用同一曝光事件的多视角采样。

papers.title: Testing and Evaluation of Agentic AI Systems In Military Command and Control
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI systems are being procured for military command and control (C2) under public commitments to rigorous testing and human oversight. Whether such commitments can be discharged depends on their supporting assurance case, which requires three elements: claims specifying the conditions for acceptability, evidence bearing on those claims, and an argument connecting the two. Through a structured review of 240 documented Testing and Evaluation (T&E) practices, spanning eight evaluation dimensions and three lifecycle stages, we identify eight assumptions that established methods make about their test article, grouped into four clusters: system specifiability, stability, composability, and supervisability. Agentic properties weaken all eight assumptions. This erosion affects the argument connecting evidence to claims, not the claims or evidence themselves. As a result, test results may satisfy process requirements, but they do not warrant the inference from tested to fielded behavior. We derive ten assurance claims for the first three assumption clusters and assess whether current and emerging methods can address each, mapping operational consequences through five C2 scenarios. Supervisability is identified but not assessed here, since evidencing it depends on system stability results and human factors T&E methods beyond the present scope. The documented record does not support broad claims about system-level behavior, but narrower claims remain recoverable in principle, contingent on mature methods: bounded mission envelopes, trajectory-grounded correctness, executable runtime constraints, and characterized run-to-run variance. Part of the evidentiary burden shifts into deployment, making the determination to field a continuing act. Where evidence cannot be generated, the residual uncertainty can be governed through defined expiry conditions and assigned ownership.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过结构化审查 240 项已记录的测试与评估 (T&E) 实践，覆盖八个评估维度与三个生命周期阶段，识别出既有方法对被测对象做出的八项假设，并将其归为四类：系统可规约性 (system specifiability)、稳定性 (stability)、可组合性 (composability) 和可监督性 (supervisability)。作者论证 agentic 属性会削弱全部八项假设，而这种侵蚀影响的是连接证据与声明的论证，而非声明或证据本身；因此测试结果可能满足流程要求，却无法保证从测试行为外推到实际部署行为的推断。论文从前三类假设推导出十条保障声明 (assurance claims)，评估当前与新兴方法能否应对，并通过五个指挥控制 (C2) 场景映射其作战后果。
Motivation: 军事指挥控制领域正在采购 agentic AI 系统，并公开承诺严格测试与人工监督，但这些承诺能否兑现取决于其保障论证 (assurance case)。既有 T&E 方法隐含的假设在 agentic 属性下被削弱，导致测试结论难以支持从测试到实战的推广，这一问题需要被系统识别并给出可操作的应对路径。
Method: 作者对 240 项已记录的 T&E 实践进行结构化审查，覆盖八个评估维度和三个生命周期阶段，提炼出四类共八项关于测试对象的假设；针对前三个假设类簇推导出十条保障声明，逐一评估当前与新兴方法能否支撑这些声明，并通过五个 C2 场景映射其作战后果。
Result: 摘要表明 agentic 属性削弱了全部八项假设，侵蚀发生在连接证据与声明的论证环节；现有记录无法支持对系统级行为的宽泛主张，但原则上仍可恢复较窄的声明，前提是方法成熟，包括有界任务包线 (bounded mission envelopes)、基于轨迹的 correctness、可执行的运行时约束以及刻画 run-to-run 方差。部分证据负担被转移到部署阶段，使是否部署成为一个持续进行的判断。
Conclusion: 作者指出可监督性虽被识别但未在此评估，因为为其提供证据依赖于系统稳定性结果以及超出本文范围的人因 T&E 方法；在无法生成证据的地方，残余不确定性可通过明确的到期条件 (expiry conditions) 和指定所有权来治理。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Aggregate, Don't Adapt: Subject-Level Posterior Aggregation and Transductive Calibration for Cross-Site Parkinsonian Gait Severity
papers.abstract_en: We describe the winning entry to the MoCha 2026 Benchmark and Challenge on Parkinsonian Gait, which predicts MDS-UPDRS gait severity from canonicalized SMPL motion recorded at clinical sites unseen during training. The system reaches 0.6945 macro-F1 on the hidden test and ranked first of 58 entries, ahead of the runner-up at 0.5807 and the organizers' baseline at 0.4289, on a frozen public motion encoder with a single $4\times512$ linear layer. Nearly all of the margin comes from three stages usually treated as bookkeeping: reproducing the reference benchmark's exact head recipe, averaging per-walk posteriors within the subject grouping the organizers ship, and a label-free transductive calibration of the feature mean and the decision operating point. Fine-tuning the encoder lost in four distinct forms, and ten alternative encoders were worse. Every ablation number is a paid read on the hidden test, because our own leave-two-cohort-out cross-validation proved anti-correlated with the deciding score over eleven configurations. We give the negative record in full, and identify our largest gain, subject-level aggregation, as the binding ceiling on this benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 MoCha 2026 帕金森步态严重程度预测基准（预测 MDS-UPDRS 步态严重程度，输入为临床站点采集并规范化后的 SMPL 动作数据）的获胜方案描述。系统在隐藏测试集上达到 0.6945 macro-F1，在 58 个参赛队伍中排名第一，远超第二名（0.5807）和组织者基线（0.4289），且只在冻结的公共动作编码器之上加了一层 4×512 线性层。作者将绝大部分收益归因于三个通常被视为'记账'的环节：复现参考基准的精确头部配方、在组织者提供的受试者分组内对逐次行走的后验做平均、以及无标签的转导式（transductive）特征均值与决策操作点校准。
Motivation: 跨站点泛化是帕金森步态严重程度预测的关键难题，训练中未见过的临床站点导致模型性能显著下降；作者试图揭示在冻结编码器设定下，哪些处理环节真正决定了跨站点基准成绩。
Method: 系统采用冻结的公共运动编码器，仅训练单个 4×512 线性层作为预测头，并在推理阶段执行三阶段处理：按参考基准复现精确的头部结构，在受试者（subject）分组内平均每条行走的类别后验（posterior aggregation），以及无需标签的转导式校准（transductive calibration），同时调整特征均值与决策操作点。作者还系统测试了微调编码器与十种替代编码器。
Result: 系统在隐藏测试集上达到 0.6945 macro-F1，排名 58 个参赛队伍中的第一，高于第二名（0.5807）与组织者基线（0.4289）。四种形式的编码器微调均造成性能下降，十种替代编码器也都不如原方案；作者在 11 种配置上发现自建的留两队列交叉验证（leave-two-cohort-out cross-validation）与最终评分呈反相关，因此所有消融数字均在隐藏测试集上付费验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为最大的增益来自受试者级后验聚合（subject-level aggregation），并将其认定为该基准上的约束性上限；同时完整公开了负面记录，强调通常被视为'记账'的复现与校准步骤对跨站点性能的贡献超过模型本身。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Wind farms as sensor arrays of turbulent boundary layer spatio-temporal flow structure
papers.abstract_en: Temporal fluctuations of wind farm-generated power arise from the interaction between atmospheric turbulence, turbine properties, and wind-farm layout. However, accurately characterizing these fluctuations remains an open challenge. We here present and extend an analytical framework to predict the temporal spectrum of wind farm power-fluctuations, and compare its predictions with detailed large-eddy-simulations (LES) of a wind farm operating within a conventionally neutral boundary layer. The modeling framework assembles several established concepts from turbulent boundary layer physics: a spatio-temporal turbulence spectral model accounting for mean advection and assuming random sweeping by large eddies, a top-down wind farm model of a fully developed wind turbine array boundary layer flow providing the required mean-flow and turbulence scales, and a spatial sampling kernel representing turbine positions and finite rotor size. The latter is extended to three dimensions to represent filtering of spatial fluctuations of turbulence along the vertical direction. Using only atmospheric, turbine, and layout parameters, the model predictions are evaluated against an extensive LES database of a large wind farm on flat terrain. The model accurately predicts the aggregate power frequency spectrum, including peaks associated with advection between turbine rows, the decay of inertial-range turbulence fluctuations due to rotor averaging, and spectra of aggregate power signals from various arrangements of groups of turbines within the array (e.g. staggered or random subsets). The ability to predict wind power fluctuation spectra from fundamental fluid dynamics and existing boundary layer turbulence models could help improve wind farm grid integration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并扩展了一个解析框架，用于预测风电场功率波动的时间频谱，并与常规中性边界层中风电场的大涡模拟（LES）数据对比。框架整合了考虑平均平流和随机扫掠效应的时空湍流谱模型、充分发展的风轮机阵列边界层顶-down模型，以及表示涡轮位置和有限转子尺寸的空间采样核，并将采样核扩展到三维以表示垂直方向的滤波。模型仅使用大气、涡轮和布局参数，即可准确预测聚合功率频谱，包括行间平流峰值、转子平均导致的惯性区湍流衰减，以及交错或随机子集等不同涡轮分组下的聚合功率信号频谱。
Motivation: 风电场功率的时间波动源于大气湍流、涡轮特性和风电场布局的相互作用，而准确刻画这些波动仍是开放挑战。该工作旨在从基础流体力学和现有边界层湍流模型出发，为风功率波动频谱提供可预测的解析描述，以支持风电并网。
Method: 将若干已有概念组装为解析模型：用考虑平均平流和随机大涡扫掠的时空湍流谱模型描述湍流，用顶-down风电场模型提供平均流和湍流尺度，并用空间采样核表示涡轮位置和有限转子尺寸；采样核被扩展到三维以表示沿垂直方向的湍流空间波动滤波。模型仅依赖大气、涡轮和布局参数，与大型平坦地形风电场的LES数据库比较验证。
Result: 摘要报告模型能准确预测聚合功率频率谱，包括与涡轮行间平流相关的峰值、因转子平均导致的惯性区湍流波动衰减，以及阵列内不同涡轮分组（如交错或随机子集）的聚合功率信号频谱。
Conclusion: 作者指出，能够从基础流体动力学和现有边界层湍流模型预测风功率波动频谱，可能有助于改善风电场与电网的整合。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: Keyed Provenance Watermarking with Complementary Lattice-Based Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) is vulnerable to multi-level attacks. However, existing methods address them separately, leaving FL exposed to data leakage, unauthorized reuse, and malicious gradient manipulation. In this work, we propose an FL framework that couples keyed context-provenance watermarking with verifiable lattice-based secure aggregation of Real-World Anchored Watermarking and Lattice-Based Zero-Knowledge Secure Aggregation. At the data layer, we propose a Kerckhoffs-compliant scheme that utilizes Physical Anchor Metadata (PAM) to ensure data provenance. PAM is defined as a context-provenance token derived from trusted infrastructure data (time, location, and server ID) and then subjected to a keyed HMAC-SHA-256 transformation to produce a watermark payload that cannot be generated without the client's secret key. We further design FMGAN, a GAN-based robust image watermarking framework that embeds this transformed payload using a feature fusion module and a Mamba-guided linear attention mechanism. At the computation layer, we adopt a lattice-based zero-knowledge secure aggregation (LZKSA) protocol that verifies key correctness, L2 norm bounds, and cosine similarity constraints over committed gradients without revealing private updates. The RLWE-based design guarantees post-quantum security. Extensive experiments validate the complementary protection of the two layers under composite attack scenarios. To our knowledge, no prior verification workflow has jointly evaluated both layers in a hybrid, end-to-end trustworthy FL framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将带密钥的上下文来源水印与基于格的可验证安全聚合相结合的联邦学习框架，旨在同时防护数据泄露、未授权重用和恶意梯度操纵。数据层设计了基于物理锚点元数据（PAM）的Kerckhoffs合规水印方案，并采用GAN框架FMGAN嵌入水印；计算层采用RLWE基础的零知识安全聚合（LZKSA）验证梯度约束。实验在复合攻击场景下验证了两层互补保护。
Motivation: 现有联邦学习方法分别处理多层级攻击，缺乏统一的端到端可信框架，使数据泄露、未授权重用和恶意梯度操纵问题同时存在。
Method: 数据层提出基于物理锚点元数据（PAM）的上下文来源令牌，经密钥化HMAC-SHA-256变换生成水印载荷，并由FMGAN（含特征融合模块与Mamba引导线性注意力）嵌入；计算层采用基于格的零知识安全聚合（LZKSA），在不泄露私有更新的前提下验证密钥正确性、L2范数界和余弦相似度约束，且RLWE设计提供后量子安全性。
Result: 大量实验验证了该框架在复合攻击场景下数据层与计算层的互补保护效果；作者声明此前没有验证工作以混合端到端方式联合评估这两个层面。
Conclusion: 该混合的可信联邦学习框架首次联合验证了密钥化来源水印与后量子安全聚合的互补防护，适用于需要同时保证数据来源可信和梯度安全的联邦学习场景。

papers.title: FlavourBench: Ranking Frontier Language Models with Executable Culinary Ground Truth
papers.abstract_en: Open-ended language-model benchmarks usually inherit a judge: a human preference panel, another model, or a brittle exact-match key. We introduce FlavourBench, an automated benchmark in which a versioned culinary system supplies dense, executable ground truth. Each task presents eight ingredients and asks for a three-ingredient portfolio; before model execution, Epicure scores all 56 possible portfolios. We evaluate 27 frontier endpoints on an identical 534-task core spanning substitution, pairing, and constrained composition. Every ranked model has exactly 89 valid responses per panel and family (14,418 model-task cells total), eliminating differential missingness from the leaderboard. The FlavourBench Score is the equal-family mean of the frozen task scores. We use 50,000 anchor-cluster bootstrap replicates for simultaneous 95% score bands and 100,000 sign-flip draws for all 351 paired model contrasts, with Holm control. The two independently compiled panels correlate at r = 0.89 (rank rho = 0.80). Grok 4.6 has the largest point estimate at 65.1 (simultaneous 95% CI 61.0-69.2); 101 of 351 model pairs are resolved. The release includes the prompts, all portfolio score maps, raw responses, exact routes, content hashes, and an offline verifier that reconstructs every result.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures. Evaluation of 27 frontier language-model endpoints on 534 identical tasks per model, comprising 14,418 scored model-task cells. Code: https://github.com/josefchen/flavourbench Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/josefchen/flavourbench Interactive leaderboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/josefchen/flavourbench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 FlavourBench，用可执行的烹饪真值自动评估 27 个前沿语言模型，在 534 个任务上打分，Grok 4.6 得分最高。
Motivation: 现有开放式基准依赖人类偏好、模型评判或脆弱精确匹配，缺乏可执行真值。
Method: 用 Epicure 系统预计算所有组合分数作为真值，评估模型在替换、配对和约束组合任务上的表现。
Result: Grok 4.6 得分 65.1（95% CI 61.0-69.2），101/351 对模型差异显著，面板相关性 r=0.89。
Conclusion: 提供可复现的基准和离线验证器，但仅覆盖烹饪领域，泛化性未知。

papers.title: Faults That Fortify: CNN Adversarial Robustness via GPU Undervolting
papers.abstract_en: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) face a dual challenge: vulnerability to adversarial attacks and prohibitive training cost. Adversarial training is effective but expensive, a burden that grows as learning shifts to the energy-constrained edge. This paper addresses both through GPU undervolting during training. Reducing supply voltage introduces stochastic perturbations that act as implicit regularization, improving robustness while lowering power. We characterize undervolting-induced faults at the bit level, then train LeNet, VGG-6, and MobileNetV3 on MNIST and CIFAR-10 under two training regimes, standard and adversarial, each at nominal and undervolted voltage, and evaluate all models against adversarial attacks. In both regimes, the undervolted model consistently achieves higher adversarial accuracy than its nominal-voltage counterpart, showing that hardware-induced faults strengthen even adversarial training. Because dynamic power scales quadratically with supply voltage, these robustness gains arrive with substantial energy savings. GPU undervolting is therefore a readily deployable hardware-level defense requiring no algorithmic change, and opens a promising direction in which robustness and energy efficiency move together.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE HOST 2027
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在训练卷积神经网络（CNN）时对GPU进行欠压（undervolting）操作，利用电压降低引起的硬件故障作为隐式正则化，同时提升模型对抗鲁棒性并降低能耗。作者在比特层面刻画欠压引起的故障，并在MNIST和CIFAR-10上用LeNet、VGG-6和MobileNetV3在标准训练与对抗训练两种模式下比较欠压与标称电压模型的对抗精度，发现欠压模型在两种模式下均取得更高对抗精度。
Motivation: CNN面临对抗攻击脆弱性和训练成本高昂的双重挑战，对抗训练虽然有效但开销大，且在向能量受限的边缘设备迁移时负担更重。
Method: 在训练过程中对GPU进行欠压，通过降低供电电压引入随机扰动作为隐式正则化；先对欠压诱导的故障进行比特级刻画，再分别在标准和对抗训练模式下训练模型并评估对抗攻击下的表现。
Result: 在标准和对抗训练两种模式下，欠压模型始终比标称电压模型取得更高的对抗精度；由于动态功耗与供电电压呈二次方关系，鲁棒性提升伴随显著的能耗节省。
Conclusion: 作者认为GPU欠压是一种可直接部署的硬件级防御手段，无需改变算法，并开辟了鲁棒性与能效协同提升的研究方向。

papers.title: Open-Weight Masked Introspection: Measuring What Language Models Can Report About Their Own Computation
papers.abstract_en: Are frontier models able to introspect about their internal states? Recent work suggests that under certain conditions a complex enough model can audit its own internals, call out what changed, and report back confidently about it. We tested that claim on eight open-weight models from seven families and found no such ability: asked whether their own computation had been altered, none answered better than chance. To test it we built Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI), a framework that intervenes on residual-stream sites, attention heads and sparse-autoencoder features, then interrogates the model about the change against the null conditions an answer has to beat: sham runs where nothing was altered, impact-matched random perturbations, and a text-only observer that sees only the visible output. Over 78,000 measurements, no model's report discriminates a real intervention from a sham beyond chance (AUROC ~0.5007), and an equivalence test bounds the effect below 0.15 percentage points of AUROC. Surprisingly, all the information needed is in the models. A model fine-tuned to report this class of intervention reaches near-perfect recovery on held-out directions, and a linear probe recovers intervention presence from the same activations at 75% to 95.8% accuracy, sharpening to no held-out error at the last layer before the model speaks. In one model the signal surfaces in the confidence rather than the words: its yes-or-no report never varies, while the confidence attached to it separates intervention from sham at AUROC 0.647. The failure sits in the path from internal state to verbal report, so oversight that reads a model's own testimony needs validating against an internal reference. While our results show the inability of current open-weight models to introspect, the debate is not settled for future models.
papers.comment: We release OWMI as a library so that this emerging ability can be measured as it develops. Hugging Face OWMI library: https://huggingface.co/emilioferrara/owmi
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Open-Weight Masked Introspection (OWMI) 框架，用于检验开放权重语言模型能否报告自身计算是否被干预。作者在八个模型上进行了超过 78,000 次测量，发现所有模型的报告都无法超越随机水平区分真实干预与伪干预 (AUROC 约 0.5007)，等价检验将效应上界限制在 0.15 个百分点以内。然而信息本身存在于模型内部：微调模型能近乎完美恢复干预，线性探针从中间激活中达到 75%–95.8% 的准确率，且一个模型的置信度中包含可分离的信号 (AUROC 0.647)。作者将失败归因于内部状态到口头报告之间的路径，并发布了 OWMI 库。
Motivation: 近期研究声称在特定条件下模型能够审计自身内部状态、指出变化并自信地报告，作者希望验证开放权重模型是否真的具备这种内省能力。该问题对依赖模型自我证词的 AI 监督机制有直接影响。
Method: 作者构建 OWMI 框架，对残差流位点、注意力头和稀疏自编码器 (sparse autoencoder) 特征进行干预，然后向模型询问变化信息，并将其与必须击败的零条件进行比较：无改动的伪运行、影响匹配的随机扰动，以及只观察可见输出的纯文本观察者。
Result: 在八个开放权重模型上，没有模型的报告能超越随机水平区分真实干预与伪干预 (AUROC 约 0.5007)，效果上界低于 0.15 个百分点；但微调模型可近乎完美恢复，线性探针在同一激活上恢复干预存在性的准确率为 75%–95.8%，最后一层达到无保留误差；一个模型中信号出现在置信度而非文字上，AUROC 为 0.647。
Conclusion: 当前开放权重模型无法内省自身计算，失败位于内部状态到语言报告的路径上；因此读取模型自我证词的监督方法需要对照内部参考进行验证。作者强调这一结论针对当前模型，未来模型的能力尚未定论。

papers.title: Actuator Disk Models reproduce Actuator Line Model power and thrust fluctuation statistics in wind farm simulations
papers.abstract_en: Actuator-disk models (ADM) are widely used in wind-farm simulations, but their accuracy in reproducing power and thrust temporal fluctuation statistics has not yet been compared to the more accurate and detailed predictions of actuator-line models (ALM). This work provides a detailed comparison of such model predictions under three distinct atmospheric conditions. Data is obtained from a database (JHTDB-Wind) containing actuator-line turbine-response and time-resolved flow field data from a large-eddy simulation of a small windfarm operating over a full diurnal cycle. Power and thrust time series corresponding to ADM are constructed from disk-averaged velocity signals and compared with the corresponding more detailed actuator-line signals over three temporal windows within the diurnal cycle. The analysis compares time series, power spectral densities, and both the fluctuation and increment probability density distributions. The results show that the ADM time-series capture the dominant temporal, spectral, and statistical features of the ALM values at resolved and disk-averaged flow-field time scales, i.e. slower than the rotor frequency. Effects of temporal filtering that are often applied to ADM inputs are examined. Overall, the results provide strong support for the use of ADM for predicting power and thrust fluctuation statistics in wind-farm simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用JHTDB-Wind数据库的全昼夜大涡模拟数据，比较了风电场模拟中致动盘模型（ADM）与致动线模型（ALM）在三种大气条件下对功率和推力时间波动统计的预测能力。作者从盘平均速度信号构造ADM时间序列，并在三个时间窗口内比较时间序列、功率谱密度以及波动和增量概率分布，发现ADM在慢于转子频率的解析和盘平均流场时间尺度上能复现ALM的主要统计特征。
Motivation: 致动盘模型（ADM）广泛用于风电场模拟，但其能否准确再现功率和推力的时间波动统计，尚未与更精确细致的致动线模型（ALM）预测进行系统对比。
Method: 基于JHTDB-Wind数据库中包含ALM涡轮响应和时变流场数据的大涡模拟，从盘平均速度信号构造ADM对应的功率和推力时间序列，并与ALM信号在昼夜循环内的三个时间窗口进行比较，分析时间序列、功率谱密度、波动分布和增量概率分布，同时考察常施加于ADM输入的时间滤波效应。
Result: 结果显示，ADM时间序列能够在解析和盘平均流场时间尺度（即慢于转子频率）上捕捉ALM值的优势时间、谱和统计特征。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些结果为在风电场模拟中使用ADM预测功率和推力波动统计提供了有力支持。

papers.title: AgentDecarbonizer: Carbon-Aware Execution for AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: AI agents extend large language models from single prompt-response interactions to long-running, goaldirected workflows that issue many model calls, invoke tools, and interact with external environments. These workflows enable tasks such as software repair, data analysis, and experiment management, but their repeated model invocations can incur substantial carbon emissions. This paper characterizes the carbon emissions of OpenClaw agent workloads using WildClawBench, and shows that emissions depend on token consumption, context cache reuse, and the carbon intensity of the grid. Our characterization identifies deadline flexibility as an opportunity for carbon-aware execution: agent tasks can wait for lower-carbon-intensity periods or shift to lower-carbon grids. However, doing so requires handling uncertain execution time for temporal shifting and cached context recomputation during spatial shifting. We present AgentDecarbonizer, a carbon optimizer for AI agents that runs alongside OpenClaw. Given a task prompt and user-specified deadline, AgentDecarbonizer conservatively estimates task duration and selects deadline-feasible execution schedules, while accounting for cache recomputation overhead during spatial shifting. Evaluated on WildClawBench workloads with 60 agent tasks across four grids, AgentDecarbonizer reduces carbon emissions by up to 57.9 % compared with a carbon-agnostic baseline and by up to 37.5 % compared with a baseline that selects the carbon-optimal grid at task start time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理（如OpenClaw）长时目标任务工作流反复调用模型所产生的碳排放问题，基于WildClawBench对OpenClaw工作负载进行碳排放特征刻画，并提出AgentDecarbonizer——一个与OpenClaw并行运行的碳优化器。它通过任务截止期限的灵活性，保守估计任务时长并选择满足期限的调度，在60个代理任务和四个电网的评测中最高减排57.9%。
Motivation: AI代理将大语言模型从单次提示-响应用于多调用、工具交互和外部环境交互的长期工作流，重复模型调用会带来可观碳排放，而现有执行调度通常不考虑碳排放。
Method: 提出AgentDecarbonizer，给定任务提示和用户指定截止期限后，保守估计任务持续时间，并在考虑空间偏移（spatial shifting）时缓存上下文重计算开销的情况下，选择截止期限内可行的执行计划，支持等待低碳时段或切换到低碳电网。
Result: 在WildClawBench的60个代理任务、四个电网的评估中，相比碳不可知基线最高降低碳排放57.9%，相比任务开始时选择碳最优电网的基线最高降低37.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明利用任务截止期限的灵活性并结合缓存感知的调度，可以在不违反用户期限的前提下显著降低AI代理工作负载的碳排放。

papers.title: Consilience: Conformally Calibrated Communication Control for Hidden-Profile Multi-Agent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems can improve reasoning by pooling diverse perspectives, but their effectiveness depends on coordinating communication, particularly in hidden-profile settings where each agent holds only part of the evidence required for a correct decision. Existing protocols, including fixed schedules, round-robin exchange, and unstructured debate, provide no guarantee that a conversational action is appropriate. We propose Consilience, an inference-time orchestration framework that both steers and certifies multi-agent communication under distributed private information. At each turn, Consilience summarizes the discussion using a compact state capturing uncertainty, disagreement, evidence gain, redundancy, and premature consensus, then selects both a communication intervention (challenge, clarify, seek evidence, or route) and an appropriate speaker. Its central contribution is a round-wise conformal calibration procedure that provides a distribution-free, finite-sample guarantee: at each discussion round, conditional on reaching that round, the one-step regret of a controller's proposed action is bounded by a calibrated threshold with marginal probability at least 1 - alpha; an acceptance mechanism enforces the same guarantee for the executed action by replacing inadmissible proposals. On HiddenBench-style hidden-profile tasks spanning 12 open and closed weight language models, Consilience improves decision accuracy and communication efficiency over fixed and unstructured discussion protocols, sometimes surpassing a full-information baseline where every agent observes all evidence. These results demonstrate that certified adaptive communication control can be more valuable than increasing information availability, providing a practical mechanism for reliable multi-agent LLM coordination.
papers.comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Includes appendix with full proof of Proposition 1, expanded results, ablations, and complete prompt templates
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Consilience，一个面向隐藏信息 (hidden-profile) 多智能体推理的推理时通信编排框架，用于在分布式私有信息条件下对智能体间的对话动作进行引导与认证。框架在每一轮用紧凑状态刻画不确定性、分歧、证据增益、冗余和过早共识，并据此选择通信干预类型（挑战、澄清、寻求证据或路由）及发言者；其核心贡献是逐轮共形校准 (conformal calibration) 过程，提供无分布假设的有限样本保证：给定到达该轮，控制器提议动作的一步遗憾 (one-step regret) 以至少 1-alpha 的边缘概率被校准阈值界定，接受机制通过替换不可接受的提议来确保已执行动作满足同样保证。在 12 个开源与闭源语言模型上的 HiddenBench 风格任务中，Consilience 在决策准确率和通信效率上优于固定与无结构讨论协议，有时甚至超过所有智能体都看到全部证据的全信息基线。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统通过汇聚不同视角可以提升推理，但在 hidden-profile 场景下，每个智能体只掌握部分证据，系统效果取决于通信协调。现有协议（固定时间表、轮询交换、无结构辩论）无法保证某个对话动作在当时是否恰当。
Method: 提出推理时编排框架 Consilience：先用紧凑状态摘要讨论（包含不确定性、分歧、证据增益、冗余与过早共识），再选择通信干预类型和发言者；同时引入逐轮共形校准流程，给出分布无关、有限样本的一步遗憾概率上界，并用接受机制拒绝不可接受的动作以保证执行动作满足校准保证。
Result: 在 HiddenBench 风格的隐藏信息任务上，跨 12 个开源和闭源权重语言模型，Consilience 相比固定和无结构讨论协议提升了决策准确率与通信效率，有时甚至超过每个智能体都能观察全部证据的全信息基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明，经过认证的自适应通信控制可能比增加信息可得性更有价值，为可靠的多智能体 LLM 协调提供了实用机制。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 Consilience，一个面向隐藏信息 (hidden-profile) 多智能体推理的推理时通信编排框架，用于在分布式私有信息条件下对智能体间的对话动作进行引导与认证。框架在每一轮用紧凑状态刻画不确定性、分歧、证据增益、冗余和过早共识，并据此选择通信干预类型（挑战、澄清、寻求证据或路由）及发言者；其核心贡献是逐轮共形校准 (conformal calibration) 过程，提供无分布假设的有限样本保证：给定到达该轮，控制器提议动作的一步遗憾 (one-step regret) 以至少 1-alpha 的边缘概率被校准阈值界定，接受机制通过替换不可接受的提议来确保已执行动作满足同样保证。在 12 个开源与闭源语言模型上的 HiddenBench 风格任务中，Consilience 在决策准确率和通信效率上优于固定与无结构讨论协议，有时甚至超过所有智能体都看到全部证据的全信息基线。
summary_sections.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统通过汇聚不同视角可以提升推理，但在 hidden-profile 场景下，每个智能体只掌握部分证据，系统效果取决于通信协调。现有协议（固定时间表、轮询交换、无结构辩论）无法保证某个对话动作在当时是否恰当。
summary_sections.method: 提出推理时编排框架 Consilience：先用紧凑状态摘要讨论（包含不确定性、分歧、证据增益、冗余与过早共识），再选择通信干预类型和发言者；同时引入逐轮共形校准流程，给出分布无关、有限样本的一步遗憾概率上界，并用接受机制拒绝不可接受的动作以保证执行动作满足校准保证。
summary_sections.result: 在 HiddenBench 风格的隐藏信息任务上，跨 12 个开源和闭源权重语言模型，Consilience 相比固定和无结构讨论协议提升了决策准确率与通信效率，有时甚至超过每个智能体都能观察全部证据的全信息基线。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果表明，经过认证的自适应通信控制可能比增加信息可得性更有价值，为可靠的多智能体 LLM 协调提供了实用机制。

papers.title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon security LLM agents must carry information and decisions across many dependent interactions, where later actions often depend on services, state, or access discovered much earlier. This makes final task success difficult to interpret: an agent may fail before it ever reaches the point where the capability of interest can be exercised. We present a diagnostic methodology that instruments security tasks with checkpoints, separates failures before and after capability exposure, and uses controlled interventions to test suspected upstream bottlenecks. We evaluate the methodology across four task families involving delayed reuse of discovered information, reuse of observed state, recovery from failed strategies, and decision making after uncertain outcomes. On observed state reuse, checkpoint analysis shows that many Gemini 2.5 Flash failures occur before the model observes the state it is later expected to reuse. In a pre-specified 92-seed study, targeted protocol-disambiguation guidance increases state observation from 65.5\% under a matched non-guidance control message to 95.4\%. Repeating the same design with Gemini 3.7 Flash produces the opposite effect, while state observation no longer reliably predicts task completion. These results show that the dominant source of failure can shift across model generations, motivating evaluation that diagnoses where and why long-horizon security agents fail rather than relying only on aggregate task success.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于诊断长视界安全 LLM 智能体（long-horizon security LLM agents）失败环节的方法论：在安全任务中插入检查点，区分能力暴露前与暴露后的失败，并用受控干预验证上游瓶颈。基于四个任务族的评估显示，不同模型代际的主导失败来源会发生转移；例如在状态复用任务上，Gemini 2.5 Flash 的多数失败发生在模型观察到后续需复用的状态之前，而相同设计在 Gemini 3.7 Flash 上产生相反结果。
Motivation: 长视界安全 LLM 智能体的最终任务成功难以解释，因为智能体可能在到达能体现目标能力的环节之前就已失败，仅看端到端成功率无法定位失败发生在何处以及为何发生。
Method: 提出诊断方法论：用检查点（checkpoints）对安全任务进行插桩，分离能力暴露前后的失败，并采用受控干预（controlled interventions）检验怀疑的上游瓶颈；在四个任务族上评估，涵盖延迟复用已发现信息、复用已观察状态、从失败策略恢复以及不确定结果后的决策。
Result: 在已观察状态复用任务上，检查点分析显示 Gemini 2.5 Flash 的许多失败发生在模型观察到后续需复用状态之前；在预指定的 92 个种子（92-seed）研究中，针对协议消歧的定向指导将状态观察率从配对的非指导对照组 65.5% 提升到 95.4%。相同设计在 Gemini 3.7 Flash 上产生相反效果，且状态观察不再可靠预测任务完成。
Conclusion: 结果表明长视界安全智能体的主导失败来源可能随模型代际发生转移，因此应转向诊断性评估以判断失败发生在何处、为何发生，而非仅依赖聚合任务成功率。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders for Mixed-Type Data
papers.abstract_en: Mixed-type data containing both numerical and categorical variables arise in many scientific and real-world applications. Existing representation learning and generative modeling approaches typically focus either on reconstruction accuracy or unconditional data generation, but often fail to recover the full conditional distribution of the data while preserving interpretable structural relationships between heterogeneous variable types. In this work, we introduce Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders, a framework for learning low-dimensional representations of mixed-type data through conditional distribution matching and structural regularization. Our method combines an energy-score-based objective for numerical variables, a likelihood-based objective for categorical variables, and an auxiliary conditional independence regularization term encouraging the learned representation to capture the dependence between numerical and categorical components. We provide theoretical analysis showing that the optimal representation balances unexplained numerical variability, conditional entropy of categorical variables, and residual conditional dependence. Empirically, the proposed method achieves strong performance on both synthetic and real-world datasets, substantially improving categorical distribution recovery, achieving competitive overall conditional distribution recovery, and preserving mixed-type dependence structure. The code has been made available at GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出条件独立正则化的分布自编码器 (Conditional-Independence-Regularized Distributional Autoencoders)，用于混合类型数据（数值变量与类别变量并存）的低维表示学习。方法结合基于能量分数的数值目标、基于似然的类别目标，以及鼓励表示捕捉数值与类别成分之间依赖的辅助条件独立正则项。理论分析刻画了最优表示所平衡的三项：未解释的数值变异性、类别变量的条件熵与残差条件依赖。实验在合成和真实数据上提升了类别分布恢复，并保持混合类型依赖结构。
Motivation: 现有表示学习与生成建模方法通常只关注重建精度或无条件下的数据生成，难以在恢复完整条件分布的同时保留异构变量类型间可解释的结构关系。
Method: 提出一个结合条件分布匹配与结构正则化的框架：对数值变量使用基于能量分数 (energy score) 的目标，对类别变量使用基于似然的目标，并加入辅助条件独立正则项，使学到的表示同时捕获数值与类别成分之间的依赖。
Result: 在合成和真实数据上取得了强性能：显著提升类别分布恢复，整体条件分布恢复达到有竞争力水平，并保持了混合类型依赖结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过条件独立正则化可以在低维表示中平衡数值变异、类别条件熵与残差条件依赖，从而改善混合类型数据的分布恢复与结构保持。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Consistency Models for Fast MRI Reconstruction Using Regularization by Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models (DMs) have emerged as powerful generative priors for MRI reconstruction with promising results. Yet DM-based methods require extensive iterative refinement, limiting their practical deployment. Consistency models (CMs) provide a compelling alternative, aiming to map out the diffusion trajectory in a single pass, enabling faster generation. In this work, we propose CM-RED, a novel MRI reconstruction method that integrates a pretrained CM into the regularization by denoising (RED) scheme. Our method builds on accelerated proximal gradient RED (RED-APG), and further incorporates controlled noise injection during the update steps to enhance generative diversity and accelerate convergence. Extensive experiments on the fastMRI knee and brain datasets demonstrate that CM-RED achieves high-quality reconstructions across multiple anatomies, contrast weights, acceleration factors, and undersampling patterns, using only 4 network function evaluations (NFEs). The proposed method consistently outperforms existing DM- and CM-based approaches in both quantitative metrics and visual fidelity, and exhibits strong robustness to hyperparameter variations, highlighting CM-RED as an efficient and effective generative framework for accelerated MRI reconstruction. The source code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/MerveGulle/CM-RED.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CM-RED，一种将预训练的一致性模型 (consistency model, CM) 集成到去噪正则化 (regularization by denoising, RED) 框架中的快速 MRI 重建方法。方法基于加速近端梯度 RED (RED-APG)，并在更新步骤中注入受控噪声以增强生成多样性并加速收敛。在 fastMRI 膝盖和脑部数据集上的实验表明，仅用 4 次网络函数评估 (NFE) 即可取得高质量重建，并在定量指标和视觉保真度上优于现有 DM 和 CM 方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型 (diffusion model, DM) 作为 MRI 重建的先验虽然效果好，但需要大量迭代细化，限制了实际部署；一致性模型虽可单步生成，但尚未被有效整合进重建算法。作者希望在保持生成质量的同时大幅减少计算开销。
Method: 提出 CM-RED，将预训练的 CM 嵌入到 RED 方案中，以 RED-APG 为基础，并在更新过程中引入受控噪声注入，以增强生成多样性并加速收敛。
Result: 在 fastMRI 膝盖和脑部数据集上，CM-RED 使用仅 4 次 NFE 即可在多种解剖部位、对比度权重、加速因子和欠采样模式下实现高质量重建，并在定量指标与视觉保真度上一致优于现有 DM 和 CM 方法，且对超参数变化具有较强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CM-RED 是一种高效且有效的加速 MRI 重建生成式框架，并公开了源代码和预训练模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Zero-Shot Color Image Manipulation Localization via Noise Residual Artifact Pattern Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Digital cameras embed device-specific artifacts into every acquired image through demosaicing, in-camera post-processing, and lossy compression. These traces constitute a forensic signal that can be exploited to assess image authenticity. Existing passive methods rely predominantly on the green channel of the Bayer residual, discarding the correlated information available in the remaining color channels and typically requiring training data or device enrollment. This work proposes a zero-shot, training-free blind image manipulation localization pipeline that estimates a reference artifact pattern directly from the noise residual of a single suspect image, without assuming a fixed filter configuration, color layout, or block period. The pipeline incorporates a principled denoiser selection criterion based on the acquired-to-interpolated noise variance ratio, a block-level correlation analysis against the estimated reference pattern, and a two-component Gaussian Mixture Model scoring stage that produces a pixel-level tampering probability map. An ablation study evaluates the impact of denoiser choice and block size on localization accuracy, and comparisons against state-of-the-art passive methods demonstrate the competitiveness of the proposed zero-shot approach.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本、免训练的盲图像篡改定位流水线，直接从单张可疑图像的噪声残差中估计参考伪影模式，无需假设固定滤波器配置、颜色布局或块周期。流程包括基于采集-插值噪声方差比的去噪器选择准则、块级相关分析，以及双分量高斯混合模型评分阶段，最终输出像素级篡改概率图。消融实验评估去噪器选择和块大小的影响，与现有被动方法的比较表明该零样本方法具有竞争力。
Motivation: 现有被动篡改定位方法主要依赖Bayer残差的绿色通道，丢弃了其余颜色通道中的相关信息，且通常需要训练数据或设备注册；本文目标是在零样本、无训练条件下，仅凭单张可疑图像估计参考伪影来完成盲定位。
Method: 提出一个无训练流水线：先按采集-插值噪声方差比这一准则选择去噪器；随后从单张图像噪声残差估计参考伪影模式；再进行块级相关分析；最后用双分量高斯混合模型评分生成像素级篡改概率图。全程不假设固定滤波配置、颜色布局或块周期。
Result: 消融研究表明去噪器选择与块大小会影响定位精度；与state-of-the-art被动方法的比较显示，该零样本方法具有竞争力。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 本文强调零样本方法无需训练数据或设备注册，且能利用多颜色通道信息获得有竞争力的篡改定位性能。
Relevance: 0
