papers.title: Learning Prostate Anatomy at Test Time for Cancer Detection in Micro-Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Domain shift across clinical centers using different imaging hardware or acquisition protocols remains a fundamental barrier to deploying deep learning models for prostate cancer (PCa) detection. Existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods address distribution shift through entropy minimization or augmentation-based self-supervision, correcting for statistical differences in image appearance but ignoring the anatomical structure of the target domain. We propose ANT, a segmentation-guided TTA framework that adapts a pretrained cancer detection encoder to the target domain by solving an auxiliary prostate segmentation task at test time, supervised by pseudo-masks from a frozen pretrained segmentation network. By aligning encoder representations to prostate anatomy in the target domain, ANT corrects domain-specific feature drift while preserving cancer-discriminative structure. The model was trained on 693 patients imaged with an earlier-generation micro-ultrasound scanner in a multi-center clinical trial, and evaluated on 118 patients acquired with a newer-generation system across two centers in another clinical trial. Under a leave-one-center-out protocol with identical evaluation conditions across all methods, ANT improves mean AUC by 2.9% and 3.6% at the biopsy-core and patient levels, respectively, over no adaptation, outperforming TTA baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/ObedDzik/ant.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ANT，一个分割引导的测试时适应（test-time adaptation, TTA）框架，用于微超声图像中的前列腺癌（PCa）检测。ANT 在测试时借助冻结的预训练分割网络生成的伪掩码，求解辅助的前列腺分割任务，从而把预训练癌症检测编码器适配到目标域。模型在 693 名患者（旧代微超声扫描仪、多中心临床试验）上训练，并在 118 名患者（新代系统、两个中心）上评估；在留一中心（leave-one-center-out）协议下，ANT 相比无适应在活检核心和患者级别分别平均提升 AUC 2.9% 和 3.6%，优于现有 TTA 基线。
Motivation: 跨临床中心的域偏移（不同成像硬件或采集协议）是深度学习前列腺癌检测模型部署的根本障碍；现有 TTA 方法通过熵最小化或基于增强的自监督来校正图像外观的统计差异，却忽略了目标域的解剖结构。
Method: ANT 提出分割引导的 TTA 框架：在测试时用冻结预训练分割网络的伪掩码监督一个辅助前列腺分割任务，将编码器表示对齐到目标域的前列腺解剖结构，从而纠正域特定的特征漂移，同时保留癌症判别性结构。

papers.title: aiXamine: Unified Black-Box Evaluation of Cross-Dimensional Trade-offs in LLM Safety, Security, and Privacy
papers.abstract_en: The critical failure modes in deployed large language models (LLMs) are cross-dimensional: a model can score 99.3 in safety alignment while refusing one in three benign queries, or improve across every capability metric while losing 21 points in privacy. Existing evaluation frameworks that assess safety, security, and privacy independently cannot detect these patterns. We introduce aiXamine, a unified black-box platform that evaluates LLM trustworthiness across safety, security, and privacy as interdependent properties. aiXamine orchestrates 46 tests across nine services through an automated red-teaming pipeline, producing hierarchical risk profiles, from prompt-level diagnostics to cross-service trade-off analytics, that enable reproducible comparison of proprietary and open-weight systems under identical conditions. Applying aiXamine to over 120 LLMs through more than 5,000 test runs, we conduct the largest joint safety, security, and privacy study to date and uncover three cross-dimensional phenomena invisible to single-axis evaluation. First, safety enforcement incurs a quantifiable safety tax: stronger alignment systematically increases over-refusal, forcing providers to choose between protection and utility. Second, privacy is near-orthogonal to other trustworthiness dimensions and not captured by standard alignment. Third, we identify and formally characterize distillation-induced robustness collapse: off-policy distillation without on-policy correction causes entropy collapse, catastrophically destroying robustness (56.9$\to$2.6) on the same base architecture. These findings, compounded by diminishing returns from scale and category-dependent safety behaviors, demonstrate that trustworthiness is inherently multi-dimensional: progress along one axis does not guarantee, and can actively undermine, progress along others, yet current alignment methods treat it as a single objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 aiXamine，一个统一黑盒评估平台，将 LLM 的安全（safety）、安全性（security）和隐私视为相互依赖的属性进行联合评估。平台通过自动化红队流水线编排 46 个测试、覆盖 9 个服务，对 120 多个 LLM 进行 5000 多次测试运行，发现三个单轴评估无法观察到的跨维度现象：安全强制带来可量化的“安全税”、隐私与其它可信度维度近似正交、以及蒸馏诱导的鲁棒性崩溃。作者由此论证可信度本质上是多维的，当前单目标对齐方法存在局限。
Motivation: 现有评估框架独立评估安全、安全和隐私，无法检测跨维度的失效模式——例如模型在安全对齐上得分 99.3 却拒绝三分之一的良性查询，或能力指标全面提升但隐私损失 21 分。这种单轴评估的盲区使部署中的真实风险被掩盖，需要统一的跨维度评估方法。
Method: 引入 aiXamine，一个统一的黑盒评估平台，将安全、安全和隐私作为相互依赖的属性进行评测。它通过自动化红队流水线编排 46 个测试、覆盖 9 个服务，生成从 prompt 级诊断到跨服务权衡分析的分层风险画像，从而在相同条件下对专有和开源系统进行可复现比较。
Result: 对 120 多个 LLM、5000 多次测试运行，进行了迄今最大规模的联合安全、安全和隐私研究，发现三个跨维度现象：更强制对齐系统性增加过度拒绝，即“安全税”；隐私与其它可信度维度近似正交，标准对齐无法覆盖；离策略蒸馏不做在策略校正会引发熵崩溃，使同一基础架构上的鲁棒性从 56.9 降至 2.6。此外还观察到规模带来的收益递减和类别相关的安全行为。
Conclusion: 可信度是内在多维的：在一个轴上的进展并不能保证、甚至可能主动损害其它轴上的进展，而现有对齐方法将其当作单一目标处理。作者强调需要联合的多维评估框架来捕捉这些跨维度权衡。

papers.title: Volumetric Radiology AI in the Era of Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are extending radiological artificial intelligence (AI) beyond task-specific image analysis toward multimodal understanding and reasoning. Volumetric radiology, however, presents a fundamental representational mismatch: clinical interpretation often requires full-volume spatial context and acquisition-dependent quantitative information, whereas current MLLMs are commonly conditioned on selected two-dimensional (2D) images, compressed visual representations, or report-derived text. Reliable volumetric radiology AI therefore requires representations that preserve task-relevant three-dimensional (3D) information and systems that can access, verify, and integrate this information across clinical workflows. In this Review, we examine more than 200 publications through July 2026. We organize the literature around volumetric representation and multimodal understanding at the model level, agentic orchestration at the system level, and their links to clinical applications and evaluation. We review volumetric foundation models, language alignment and compression strategies, and agentic systems that extend MLLMs through planning, tools, memory, and workflow interaction. We distinguish settings in which selected 2D views or report-mediated reasoning may suffice from those that warrant native volumetric modeling. We also introduce a Claim-Design-Validation framework to assess whether technical, workflow, and clinical claims are matched by appropriate design and validation. Across the literature, native volumetric modeling and agentic capabilities depend on the spatial, quantitative, contextual, and workflow requirements of the intended task. Clinical credibility requires faithful volumetric representation, traceable system behavior, claim-aligned validation, and clearly defined human oversight in realistic workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述（Review），考察截至 2026 年 7 月的 200 余篇文献，讨论多模态大语言模型（MLLM）时代下体素级放射学人工智能的发展。作者在模型层面围绕体素表征与多模态理解、在系统层面围绕智能体编排（agentic orchestration）来组织文献，并梳理临床应用与评估。文章还提出一个 Claim-Design-Validation 框架，用于判断技术、工作流和临床主张是否得到恰当设计与验证。
Motivation: 体素级放射学存在根本性的表征不匹配：临床判读往往需要全容积空间上下文和依赖采集方式的定量信息，而现有 MLLM 通常基于选定的 2D 图像、压缩视觉表征或报告文本。可靠的体素放射学 AI 需要保留任务相关 3D 信息的表征，以及能够在临床工作流中访问、核验和整合这些信息的系统。
Method: 作者对 200 余篇文献进行结构化综述，从模型层面综述体素基础模型、语言对齐与压缩策略，从系统层面综述通过规划、工具、记忆和工作流交互扩展 MLLM 的智能体系统，并提出 Claim-Design-Validation 框架来评估技术、工作流与临床主张是否匹配相应的设计和验证。
Result: 综述区分了选定 2D 视图或报告中介推理可能足够的场景，与需要原生体素建模（native volumetric modeling）的场景。文献整体显示，原生体素建模和智能体能力的必要性取决于任务在空间、定量、上下文和工作流方面的要求；摘要中未给出定量实验数值。
Conclusion: 临床可信度要求忠实体素表征、可追踪的系统行为、与主张一致的验证，以及在现实工作流中明确界定的人工监督。作者强调这些要素对于将体素放射学 AI 落地到临床应用的重要性。

papers.title: Keep Your Friends Close, and the Right Neighbours Closer: Disaster-Conditioned Kernel-Regularized Graph Attention for Building Damage Classification
papers.abstract_en: Disaster damage is spatial: buildings rarely fail in isolation. Yet using spatial context for damage classification remains surprisingly underexplored, and many pipelines still rely primarily on per-building appearance cues even when the dominant uncertainty is spatially structured. Complicating matters, the right neighbourhood is not the same across events. Floods, hurricanes, and wildfires can exhibit very different clustering behaviour, making spatial reasoning valuable but easy to misuse - naive context aggregation can improve visual coherence while oversmoothing boundaries or propagating structured errors. We study this tension on xBD (the dataset used in the xView2 challenge) in a controlled post-localization, classification-only setup: each building is represented by a pre/post combined (PPC) patch cropped from the provided polygons, and spatial context is modelled with GPS-derived building graphs. Our approach keeps local evidence "close" by preserving strong spatial relationships in disaster damage patterns, while bringing only the right neighbours "closer" through a disaster-type-conditioned graph model that injects a learnable multi-scale spatial kernel prior into attention, allowing the effective neighbourhood scale to adapt across disaster types rather than being learned as a single global smoothing rule. To discourage coherence-by-smoothing, we add a residual de-correlation loss that penalizes positive Moran's~I in prediction residuals. We evaluate the method under event and dataset shift with a leave-one-event-out (LOEO) protocol on xBD and cross-dataset transfer from xBD to Ida-BD. The model improves macro-F1 and substantially reduces residual spatial autocorrelation under zero-shot event shift, indicating better use of spatial context rather than naive smoothing and enabling more reliable transfer to unseen events within known disaster types.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对建筑震害/灾损分类中空间上下文利用不足的问题，提出一种灾害类型条件化的图注意力模型。每个建筑用从给定多边形裁剪的灾前/灾后组合 (PPC) 图像块表示，并用 GPS 构建建筑图来建模空间关系；模型把可学习的多尺度空间核先验注入注意力，使邻域尺度能随灾害类型自适应，同时用惩罚预测残差正 Moran's I 的去相关损失避免单纯平滑。在 xBD 上按 leave-one-event-out (LOEO) 协议和 xBD 到 Ida-BD 的跨数据集迁移中评估，零样本事件偏移下提升了 macro-F1 并大幅降低残差空间自相关。
Motivation: 灾害损伤具有强空间性，但现有流程主要依赖单建筑外观线索，空间上下文未被充分利用；而直接聚合邻域信息容易过度平滑边界或传播结构化误差，且不同灾害类型（洪水、飓风、野火）的最优邻域尺度并不相同。
Method: 提出灾害类型条件化的图注意力模型：以 PPC 图像块为节点特征、GPS 导出建筑图为拓扑，将可学习多尺度空间核先验注入注意力机制，使有效邻域尺度随灾害类型自适应，并添加残差去相关损失以抑制预测残差中的正空间自相关 (Moran's I)。
Result: 在 xBD 数据集上的 leave-one-event-out 零样本事件偏移测试以及 xBD 到 Ida-BD 的跨数据集迁移中，该方法提升了 macro-F1，并显著降低残差空间自相关，表明模型确实利用了空间上下文而非单纯平滑。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明灾害条件化的空间建模能提升对已知灾害类型内未见事件的迁移可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: GOES-East full-disk AI nowcasting of cloud evolution in observation space
papers.abstract_en: Clouds affect aviation, solar energy, remote sensing, and storm prediction, yet they remain among the hardest atmospheric features to forecast, particularly at convective scales. Because clouds are shaped by processes spanning a wide range of space and time scales, numerical weather prediction, extrapolation methods, and existing machine learning (ML) approaches are each limited by some combination of accuracy, domain size, and temporal resolution. We present DOP+, an ML approach for clouds that forecasts GOES-East full-disk infrared brightness temperatures by extending direct observation prediction (DOP) with conditioning on meteorological fields. The domain covers tropical, midlatitude, and marine regimes across $\sim 10^8 ~ km^2$, roughly a fifth of Earth's surface. DOP+ forecasts cloud evolution at 10-minute resolution and outperforms persistence, synoptic-scale NWP, and a pure DOP baseline across 0-6 h lead times in fractions skill score and mean absolute error skill score. Convective structure is retained out to 2-3 h. DOP+ thus achieves a state-of-the-art combination of accuracy, temporal resolution, and spatial coverage. Our work lays the foundation for fully global cloud nowcasting at convective timescales.

papers.title: ExploraTwin, a Non-Profit Research Platform for Digital Twin Simulations
papers.abstract_en: Digital twin simulations show promise, but current empirical evidence suggests that the approach should be tested before being deployed in any particular context. To lower the friction for researchers and practitioners to test and deploy digital twin simulations, this brief commentary introduces ExploraTwin (https://exploratwin.org), an open-access, non-profit research platform for digital twin survey simulations. ExploraTwin supports two modes. In survey mode, researchers can upload a Qualtrics survey file or create a survey within the platform; select an available sample of digital twins; configure and run the simulation, and export analysis-ready data. In panel mode, researchers can assemble a small group of twins for open-ended conversations, document annotation, and moderated, focus-group-style voice discussions. We also developed CroissantTwin, a standardized data format for adding samples of digital twins to the platform. We demonstrate the survey mode workflow by using the platform to replicate 19 experiments on digital twins from the Twin-2K-500 dataset. ExploraTwin's survey execution fidelity is high: 99.6% of 197,000 answer units returned a structurally valid response on the first run.
papers.comment: 44 pages (32-page manuscript plus web appendix), 8 figures. Platform: https://exploratwin.org

Motivation: 数字孪生模拟虽有前景，但现有经验证据表明该方法在特定场景部署前应先进行测试；本文旨在降低研究者和从业者测试与部署此类模拟的摩擦。
Method: 提出 ExploraTwin 平台，包含调查模式和面板模式，并开发了用于向平台添加数字孪生样本的标准化数据格式 CroissantTwin；摘要以调查模式工作流进行演示。

papers.title: Grounded-Exo2Ego: Structured Semantic Grounding for Robust Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating egocentric video from a single exocentric video is an emerging and important topic for AR/VR and physical AI. Compared with conventional novel view synthesis, exo-to-ego generation is a significantly harder task because the standard geometric conditioning becomes highly unreliable under extreme view changes and large unobservable regions. We present Grounded-Exo2Ego, a principled framework that addresses these challenges at both the architectural and data levels. Architecturally, Grounded-Exo2Ego is a dual-branch video diffusion model that couples a geometric anchoring branch, which conditions the generation on the rendering of a 3D reconstruction, with a novel semantic grounding branch, which goes beyond the prevailing geometry-based approach and improves quality by synthesizing challenging regions based on object-level context. Additionally, we found that the overlooked issue of camera-reconstruction misalignment severely undermines exo-to-ego learning. We thus introduce a camera re-localization algorithm that resolves this issue and substantially improves quality across all metrics. We further develop a fully automated synthetic data engine that generates and renders rigged 3D characters in procedurally generated environments. Evaluation on the challenging EgoExo4D dataset shows that our method outperforms recent state-of-the-art approaches by large margins across all metrics. Detailed ablations validate improvements from each of our contributions at both the data and architectural level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Grounded-Exo2Ego，一个用于从单目 exocentric 视频生成 egocentric 视频的双分支视频扩散模型。该方法在几何锚定分支之外引入语义 grounding 分支，以对象级上下文生成极端视角变化下难以重建的区域，并针对相机重建错位问题提出重定位算法。在 EgoExo4D 数据集上，该方法在全部指标上大幅超过近期 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 与常规新视角合成相比，exo-to-ego 生成在极端视角变化和大范围不可观测区域下，标准几何条件变得高度不可靠；此外，作者发现相机-重建错位是一个被忽视但严重损害训练效果的问题。
Method: 提出双分支视频扩散模型：几何锚定分支以 3D 重建的渲染结果作为生成条件，语义 grounding 分支基于对象级上下文合成困难区域。另提出相机重定位算法解决错位问题，并构建全自动合成数据引擎，在程序化生成的环境中渲染带有骨骼绑定的 3D 角色。
Result: 在 EgoExo4D 数据集上的评估显示，该方法在所有指标上大幅优于近期 SOTA；详细消融实验验证了数据和架构层面每项贡献带来的提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为在架构和数据两个层面同时解决几何高不确定性、语义生成和相机错位问题，可以显著提升极端视角下 egocentric 视频生成的质量，并强调相机重定位对学习过程的关键作用。

papers.title: Learning Exact NVIDIA SASS Encoders with $\mathbb{F}_2$ Linear Algebra
papers.abstract_en: NVIDIA provides a SASS disassembler but no public SASS assembler for recent data-center GPUs, limiting controlled machine-code rewriting. We present F2Asm, which learns exact 128-bit SASS encoders from paired disassembly and original CUBIN instruction words. To our knowledge, F2Asm is the first system to learn SASS instruction encoders as vector-valued affine maps over F2 and the first open-source NVIDIA SASS assembler to support Rubin SM107. F2Asm uses Gaussian elimination over F2 to incrementally build a compact basis, detect inconsistencies, and reject inputs outside the learned span. F2Asm separates target-specific control bits, relocation rules, and CUBIN metadata from its learning algorithm. We train encoders for Hopper SM90/SM90a, Blackwell SM100, and Rubin SM107 using 3,225 CUBINs from pinned NVIDIA and third-party production libraries, CUDA 13.3 packages, and CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview archives. In round-trip tests, F2Asm reassembles the disassembled SASS for each CUBIN, and all compared executable text sections match the originals exactly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 F2Asm，据称是首个以 F2 上的向量值仿射映射学习精确 128 位 NVIDIA SASS 编码器的系统，也是首个开源支持 Rubin SM107 的 NVIDIA SASS 汇编器。它用高斯消元在 F2 上增量构建紧凑基，检测不一致并拒绝学习跨度外的输入，同时将目标相关控制位、重定位规则和 CUBIN 元数据与学习算法分离。作者使用 3,225 个 CUBIN 在 Hopper SM90/SM90a、Blackwell SM100 和 Rubin SM107 上训练编码器，round-trip 测试中所有可执行文本段与原始 CUBIN 完全匹配。
Motivation: NVIDIA 提供 SASS 反汇编器但没有面向近期数据中心 GPU 的公开 SASS 汇编器，限制了受控机器码改写。
Method: F2Asm 把 SASS 指令编码学习建模为 F2 上的向量值仿射映射，用高斯消元增量建立紧凑基，并分离目标相关控制位、重定位规则及 CUBIN 元数据。训练数据来自 NVIDIA 和第三方生产库、CUDA 13.3 包以及 CUDA 13.4 Developer Preview 中的 3,225 个 CUBIN。
Result: 在 round-trip 测试中，F2Asm 对每个 CUBIN 将反汇编得到的 SASS 重新汇编，所有被比较的可执行文本段与原始内容完全一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 F2Asm 是首个在 F2 上学习 SASS 编码器的系统，并首次开源支持 Rubin SM107 的 NVIDIA SASS 汇编器；摘要未给出额外实验细节或明确局限。

papers.title: Frozen CLIP Priors for Robust Self-Supervised Poisson Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning for imaging inverse problems is increasingly important in photon-limited settings, where acquiring clean ground truth is impractical and reconstruction must remain stable under dataset and acquisition shifts. This challenge is amplified under Poisson noise, whose signal-dependent statistics interact with sampling operators (e.g., CFA mosaicing). Meanwhile, foundation vision encoders trained at web scale offer distortion-invariant, content-related representations that generalize well across domains, suggesting a promising route to build priors that transfer beyond the training distribution without expensive fine-tuning. This paper proposes an ADMM-inspired unrolled plug-and-play solver for Poisson inverse problems that decouples a closed-form data-consistency update from a parameter-efficient prior. The prior is implemented as a lightweight decoder operating on frozen CLIP RN50 dense multi-scale features, adapting foundation representations with less trainable parameters. For self-supervision, the method integrates GR2R measurement-domain re-corruption with an Equivariant Imaging regularizer via virtual acquisitions. Experiments on Poisson CFA demosaicing and deblurring show competitive quality, improved robustness under shifts, and self-supervised performance approaching supervised training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光子受限场景下的泊松逆问题（Poisson inverse problems），提出一种 ADMM 启发的展开式即插即用求解器。求解器将闭式数据一致性更新与参数高效的先验解耦，先验由作用于冻结 CLIP RN50 稠密多尺度特征的轻量解码器实现。自监督训练整合 GR2R 测量域重破坏与基于虚拟采集的 Equivariant Imaging 正则项。在泊松 CFA 去马赛克和去模糊实验上，该方法获得有竞争力的质量，并提升对数据集与采集偏移的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 光子受限成像中难以获取干净真值，重建必须对数据集与采集偏移保持稳定；泊松噪声的信号相关统计与采样算子（如 CFA 马赛克）耦合，使自监督重建更具挑战。网络规模预训练的基础视觉编码器提供跨域泛化的失真不变内容表征，但如何低成本地将其用于泊松逆问题仍待探索。
Method: 提出 ADMM 启发的展开式即插即用求解器，将闭式数据一致性更新与参数高效先验解耦。先验是轻量解码器，作用于冻结的 CLIP RN50 稠密多尺度特征，以较少可训练参数适配基础表征。自监督部分结合 GR2R 测量域重破坏机制与通过虚拟采集实现的 Equivariant Imaging 正则项。
Result: 在泊松 CFA 去马赛克与去模糊任务上的实验显示，该方法取得有竞争力的重建质量，在数据与采集偏移下鲁棒性更好，且自监督性能接近监督训练水平。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调冻结的基础视觉先验配合轻量自适应，能够在无需昂贵微调的前提下为泊松逆问题提供可跨分布迁移的自监督先验；其验证范围限于泊松 CFA 去马赛克与去模糊任务。
Relevance: 8

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调冻结的基础视觉先验配合轻量自适应，能够在无需昂贵微调的前提下为泊松逆问题提供可跨分布迁移的自监督先验；其验证范围限于泊松 CFA 去马赛克与去模糊任务。

papers.title: Large Scale AI Grading of Handwritten Physics Assessments: Score Agreement and Olympiad Team Selection Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal AI can read handwritten physics solutions, but high-stakes grading requires agreement with official scores and outcomes. This study evaluated GPT-5.5-based grading on 10364 scanned pages from 520 handwritten submissions by 416 unique candidates or students across three assessments: a national Physics Olympiad theory examination, the final Olympiad selection camp with theory and experiment components, and a university quantum-mechanics examination. Each submission was graded twice by AI using the official rubrics. The second round used revised page-by-page and evidence-location instructions developed after first-round disagreement analysis. During grading, AI did not see official human marks or AI--human comparisons. Total-score correlations with official marks were high (0.91--0.97). For the final Olympiad selection, AI recovered the same five-student team as official grading. The second round improved aggregate question-part agreement, especially where first-round disagreements were larger. The main difficulty remained exact partial-credit grading, especially in experimental work. Reliable AI grading therefore depends on detailed rubrics and should be used as a second reader or audit tool under examiner control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了基于 GPT-5.5 的多模态 AI 对手写物理答卷的评分能力，规模为 10364 张扫描页、520 份手写答卷，覆盖 416 名考生/学生，涉及三场考试：全国物理奥赛理论考试、含理论与实验环节的奥赛终选营、以及大学量子力学考试。每份答卷均按官方评分标准 (rubric) 由 AI 评分两次，第二轮使用了根据第一轮分歧分析修订的逐页与证据定位指令；评分过程中 AI 未看到人工分数或人机对比。结果显示总分与官方分数的相关系数为 0.91–0.97，且 AI 在奥赛终选中恢复了与官方一致的五人团队。
Motivation: 多模态 AI 虽能阅读手写物理解答，但高利害评分场景要求 AI 分数与官方得分及选拔结果保持一致，现有证据尚不足以支撑其在此类场景的可靠性。
Method: 使用 GPT-5.5 对每份答卷按官方评分标准进行两轮独立评分；第二轮采用基于第一轮分歧分析改进的逐页 (page-by-page) 与证据定位 (evidence-location) 指令，并在评分过程中屏蔽人工分数与人机对比信息。
Result: AI 总分与官方分数的相关系数达到 0.91–0.97；在奥赛终选中 AI 选出了与官方评分相同的五名学生团队；第二轮评分显著提升了问题分项的总体一致性，尤其是在第一轮分歧较大的部分。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，可靠的 AI 评分高度依赖详细评分标准，且应仅作为第二阅卷人或考官控制下的审计工具；精确的按步给分（partial-credit）仍是主要难点，尤其在实验题中。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An integrated diffusion-weighted imaging processing and interpretation platform for MR-guided radiotherapy
papers.abstract_en: Background: Magnetic resonance imaging-guided linear accelerators (MR-Linacs) allow diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) to be acquired at every treatment fraction, but converting these low-signal-to-noise-ratio acquisitions into clinical decisions requires both reliable quantitative processing and an interpretation that reconciles a scattered and often contradictory literature. Purpose: To describe and evaluate an integrated, web-based platform that carries raw MR-Linac DWI to a structured, literature-grounded clinical interpretation, and to assess its retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) interpretation module by independent expert rating. Methods: The platform couples a deep-learning processing pipeline, comprising distortion correction, denoising, and intravoxel incoherent motion (IVIM)/apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) fitting, with longitudinal region-of-interest analysis and a RAG interpretation agent. The agent reasons over a two-layer knowledge base of curated publications (a structured catalog index plus line-indexed full text), delegates arithmetic to deterministic tools, and is designed to trace each statement to a source document, section, and line range. One medical physicist and one physician independently rated the agent's reports for nine longitudinal glioblastoma cases on a 1-5 scale across three metrics: clinical-reasoning soundness, literature-citation quality, and overall clinical utility. Results: Across 54 ratings, the pooled mean was 4.65 +/- 0.80, with 93% of ratings >= 4; metric means were 4.6 (reasoning), 4.5 (citation), and 4.8 (utility), and raters agreed within one point on 85% of paired ratings. Conclusions: A single platform can integrate MR-Linac DWI post-processing with traceable, expert-evaluated clinical interpretation, while highlighting the safeguards needed to verify LLM-generated reasoning in radiation oncology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍一个基于网络集成的 DWI（弥散加权成像）处理与解读平台，面向 MR-Linac 放疗场景。平台将深度学习处理流水线（畸变校正、去噪、IVIM/ADC 拟合）、纵向感兴趣区分析，以及基于检索增强生成（RAG）的解读智能体整合在一起，并让每条陈述可溯源到来源文档、章节和行范围。独立专家对 9 例纵向胶质母细胞瘤病例的 RAG 报告进行 1-5 分评级，54 项评分的汇总均值为 4.65±0.80，其中 93% 的评分不低于 4 分。
Motivation: MR-Linac 可在每次治疗分次采集 DWI，但这些低信噪比的采集要转化为临床决策，既需要可靠的定量处理，又需要能够协调零散且有时相互矛盾的文献的解读；现有流程缺少整合这两者的平台。
Method: 平台将深度学习 DWI 处理流水线与 RAG 解读智能体相结合；该智能体在一个两层知识库（结构化目录索引加按行索引的全文）上进行推理，把算术交给确定性工具完成，并设计为将每句话都追溯到来源文档、章节和行范围。
Result: 一名医学物理师和一名医师独立对 9 例纵向胶质母细胞瘤病例的智能体报告，在临床推理合理性、文献引用质量和整体临床实用性三个指标上按 1-5 分评分；54 项评分的汇总均值为 4.65±0.80，93% 的评分≥4，各指标均值分别为 4.6（推理）、4.5（引用）和 4.8（实用性），85% 的配对评分差在 1 分以内。
Conclusion: 摘要认为单一平台可以把 MR-Linac DWI 后处理与可追溯、经专家评估的临床解读整合起来，同时强调了在放射肿瘤学中验证 LLM 生成推理所需的安全保障。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FL-MAESTRO: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration for Resource-Constrained Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: In Federated Learning (FL), the communication topology is a runtime variable rather than a fixed design choice, since links and edge devices drop in and out during training. Each round, the server must commit three coupled decisions, namely the communication topology, per-client resource allocation, and the aggregation rule for combining local updates. Recent agentic systems have begun bringing large language models (LLM) into FL, but the existing line of work either operates at setup time or handles a single runtime dimension such as client selection. We propose FL-MAESTRO, a multi-agent orchestrator that makes the joint runtime FL decision directly through three specialist LLM agents, one per decision dimension. A coordinator combines their analyses into a single decision, and a non-LLM feasibility check confirms it before the round executes. Because the orchestrator consumes the server's predicted-failure list, it withholds clients whose updates would never be aggregated, which removes the dominant source of wasted round energy in classical FL on volatile edge networks. Because client state is read as natural-text profiles, the same orchestrator extends to heterogeneous device classes without per-class energy models. On a non-IID CIFAR-10 benchmark, FL-MAESTRO matches the accuracy of the strongest energy-aware baseline while cutting wasted round energy from over a third to near zero. Code is available at https://github.com/denoslab/FL-MAESTRO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FL-MAESTRO，一个用于资源受限联邦学习的多智能体编排器，通过三个专家 LLM 智能体分别处理通信拓扑、每客户端资源分配和聚合规则这三个耦合的运行时决策，并由协调器合并、非 LLM 可行性检查确认。在非 IID CIFAR-10 基准上，FL-MAESTRO 匹配最强能量感知基线的精度，同时将浪费的回合能量从超过三分之一降至接近零。
Motivation: 联邦学习中通信拓扑是运行时变量，每轮服务器需同时承诺通信拓扑、每客户端资源分配和聚合规则三个耦合决策。现有将 LLM 引入 FL 的 agentic 系统要么只在设置时操作，要么只处理单一运行时维度（如客户端选择），缺乏统一处理多维运行时决策的方案。
Method: 提出多智能体编排器 FL-MAESTRO，三个专家 LLM 智能体各负责一个决策维度，协调器将其分析合并为单一决策，并在回合执行前由非 LLM 可行性检查确认。编排器读取服务器的预测失败列表，扣留其更新永远不会被聚合的客户端，以消除经典 FL 在易失边缘网络中浪费回合能量的主要来源；客户端状态以自然文本配置文件读取，使编排器无需每类能量模型即可扩展到异构设备类别。
Result: 在非 IID CIFAR-10 基准上，FL-MAESTRO 匹配最强能量感知基线的精度，同时将浪费的回合能量从超过三分之一降至接近零。
Conclusion: 摘要表明联合做出运行时 FL 决策并利用预测失败列表可以消除浪费能量的主导来源，且自然文本配置使方法能扩展到异构设备类别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Graph-JEPA Learns the Wrong Thing: Diagnosing and Repairing Category-Conditional Collapse
papers.abstract_en: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are selected almost universally by linear probing and effective rank. We report a case where both read healthily while the representation carries zero usable instance information. We repair it, and a second failure appears: the repaired metric saturates on a target carrying no structural information. Our corpus is a scientific-reasoning graph over 57,903 articles, each a subgraph. A Graph-JEPA predicts one masked aspect from a subgraph's remaining aspects, attaining linear-probe accuracy 0.871 and effective rank 18-47, yet retrieval recovers 0.00 of 14.4 bits (MRR 1.9e-4 vs chance 1.99e-4, p=0.98). Three upper bounds on the same pool and code recover nearly everything (+14.28, +14.34, +14.22 bits), ruling out corpus, masking, pool, and metric as causes. We trace this to variance allocation - frozen inputs place 86.05% of variance on subgraph identity and 0.40% on aspect identity, while trained latents place 0.39% and 99.61%. This is a property of the objective's optimum: the degenerate solution is a global minimum of the coupled predictor/EMA-target objective, present already at init. A repaired configuration reaches 14.377 of 14.379 bits, above the 13.865-bit oracle; reverting the loss to regression drops it to 0.307 bits, confirming it. Yet the repair licenses nothing about reasoning: the target is reducible, since intra-subgraph edges are a deterministic function of node census. The oracle reaches 96.4% of the ceiling, and our largest effect is the learning-rate schedule, not architecture. Bits and a reasoning probe show no relation across ten cells. A data-derived target fails a quality gate - 25.96% of nodes are duplicate placeholders, and the rest is more generic than supporting evidence. Rank, probes, and metrics can all saturate on an unsupportive evaluation. We release a harness with a reducibility audit and target gate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告联合嵌入预测架构 (Graph-JEPA) 在科学推理图上的一种失败模式：线性探针准确率 0.871、有效秩 18-47 等指标都健康，但表示承载的可用实例信息为零（检索恢复 0.00 位，MRR 1.9e-4 接近随机）。作者定位到方差分配颠倒、退化解是目标全局最小值，并给出修复配置使其达到 14.377 位，但随后发现目标本身可约简且数据质量不佳。
Motivation: 线性探针和有效秩几乎被普遍用作联合嵌入预测架构的选择标准，但本文指出这些指标可能完全掩盖表示的无用性，说明需要更严格的审计手段来验证自监督表示是否真正保留实例级信息。
Method: 在 57,903 篇文章构成的科学推理图上训练 Graph-JEPA 预测掩码方面，通过检索任务暴露失效，并借助方差分配分析、全局最小值证明和上下界对比定位原因；提出修复配置，并发布带可约简性审计与目标门控的测试平台 (harness)。
Result: 三个上界在相同池和代码上恢复约 +14.3 位，排除数据与实现因素；冻结输入将 86.05% 方差放在子图身份、0.40% 放在方面身份，而训练潜在变量相反。修复配置恢复 14.377 位（超过 13.865 位 oracle），但改用回归损失后跌至 0.307 位；最大效果来自学习率调度而非架构。目标可约简（子图内边由节点普查确定性决定），且 25.96% 的节点是重复占位符。
Conclusion: 有效秩、线性探针等指标可能在不可靠的评估上集体饱和，不能作为表示质量的充分证据；需要对目标任务的可约简性和数据本身做审计，不能仅凭指标健康就信任表示。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 三个上界在相同池和代码上恢复约 +14.3 位，排除数据与实现因素；冻结输入将 86.05% 方差放在子图身份、0.40% 放在方面身份，而训练潜在变量相反。修复配置恢复 14.377 位（超过 13.865 位 oracle），但改用回归损失后跌至 0.307 位；最大效果来自学习率调度而非架构。目标可约简（子图内边由节点普查确定性决定），且 25.96% 的节点是重复占位符。
summary_sections.conclusion: 有效秩、线性探针等指标可能在不可靠的评估上集体饱和，不能作为表示质量的充分证据；需要对目标任务的可约简性和数据本身做审计，不能仅凭指标健康就信任表示。

papers.title: DiffVC-ONE: Diffusion-based Generative Video Compression with One-Step Video Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Generative video compression can recover rich visual details at low bitrates, but simultaneously achieving high temporal consistency and low inference cost remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose DiffVC-ONE, a diffusion-based generative video compression framework built on a one-step Video Diffusion Transformer. First, we introduce a Unified Unidirectional Latent Compressor that uses a shared model to efficiently and uniformly compress compact latent slices. We then develop a Video DiT-based One-Step Diffusion Enhancer that uses the reconstructed latent slices as content anchors and performs single-step spatio-temporal perceptual enhancement over an entire group of pictures. Finally, a Hybrid Condition Generator extracts structural, strength, and semantic conditions from the reconstructed content and quantization information. These conditions preserve faithful regions, control the degree of generative enhancement, and supplement content-aware perceptual details during one-step diffusion enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple standard benchmarks demonstrate that DiffVC-ONE achieves state-of-the-art perceptual quality and temporal consistency with low inference cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffVC-ONE，一种基于扩散模型的生成式视频压缩框架，核心是一个单步视频扩散 Transformer (Video Diffusion Transformer)。框架包含统一单向潜在压缩器、基于视频 DiT 的单步扩散增强器，以及从重建内容和量化信息提取结构、强度和语义条件的混合条件生成器。实验表明该方法在多个标准基准上取得领先的感知质量和时间一致性，同时推理成本较低。
Motivation: 生成式视频压缩能在低码率下恢复丰富视觉细节，但现有方法难以同时获得高时间一致性和低推理成本。
Method: 提出 Unified Unidirectional Latent Compressor，用共享模型对紧凑潜在切片进行统一压缩；开发 Video DiT-based One-Step Diffusion Enhancer，以重建潜在切片为内容锚点，对整个图像组做单步时空感知增强；并用 Hybrid Condition Generator 从重建内容和量化信息中提取保持忠实区域、控制生成增强程度并补充内容感知细节的条件。
Result: 在多个标准基准上的实验显示，DiffVC-ONE 在获得领先感知质量和时间一致性的同时保持较低推理成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过单步视频扩散 Transformer 与混合条件生成，可以在低推理成本下同时改善视频压缩的感知质量与时间一致性。

papers.title: Making Deployments Safe at Meta: Health Checks for Continuous Change-Safety
papers.abstract_en: Continuous deployment to large scale production systems creates a tension between release velocity and reliability. Every change is a potential reliability incident, yet every delay is a missed opportunity. This paper describes the deployment time health check infrastructure that Meta uses to mediate this tension across thousands of heterogeneous services. We summarize the architecture of this prevention based distributed system's service called Service Health Checker, explain how check authors compose templated metric queries, thresholds, and workflow predicates; and discuss how the system is integrated with tiered and phased rollouts so that regressions trigger automatic rollback. We then describe the operational problems that emerged at scale, such as noise, alert fatigue, drift, and uncovered regressions, and the program of measurement, tooling, and improved defaults we deployed to address them. We close with lessons learned from years of operating deployment health checks at Meta, and the directions we are exploring next, including AI assisted health check tuning. Index Terms: deployment safety, continuous deployment, monitoring, software reliability, release engineering, software reliability engineering, AIOps, anomaly detection

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述了 Meta 在数千个异构服务上用于保障持续部署安全的部署时健康检查基础设施。文章总结了名为 Service Health Checker 的基于预防的分布式系统架构，说明检查作者如何组合模板化指标查询、阈值和工作流谓词，并介绍其与分层分阶段发布 (tiered and phased rollouts) 的集成方式，使回归可触发自动回滚。文中还讨论了规模化运营中出现的问题（噪声、告警疲劳、漂移、未覆盖回归）以及相应的测量、工具和默认值改进，最后给出多年运营经验教训与 AI 辅助健康检查调优等未来方向。
Motivation: 持续部署到大规模生产系统会在发布速度与可靠性之间产生张力：每次变更都可能是可靠性事故，而每次延迟都意味着错失机会。文章旨在介绍 Meta 如何通过部署时健康检查来缓解这一矛盾。
Method: 描述一个名为 Service Health Checker 的分布式预防系统，检查作者通过组合模板化指标查询、阈值和工作流谓词来定义健康检查，系统与分层分阶段发布集成，在回归发生时自动回滚；针对规模化问题，采用测量、工具和改善默认值的方案加以应对。
Result: 摘要没有给出具体实验数据或量化结果，主要贡献是总结生产级健康检查基础设施的架构、运营问题与应对措施，以及从多年运营中提炼的经验教训。
Conclusion: 作者总结了在 Meta 运营部署健康检查多年得到的经验教训，并指出下一步探索方向包括 AI 辅助健康检查调优。

papers.title: EDGE: a closed-form directed test for the calibration of probabilistic binary classifiers
papers.abstract_en: A probabilistic binary classifier is judged almost everywhere by discrimination - accuracy, the ROC curve, the area under it. Every such criterion is invariant to a monotone distortion of the predicted probabilities, so a classifier can rank perfectly and still return probabilities that are badly wrong. Calibration is the property decisions need, and the field's instrument for it, the binned expected calibration error with its reliability diagram, is descriptive: it has no null distribution, so it cannot say whether the miscalibration it displays is real or noise, and it depends on the binning. We propose EDGE, a calibration test for the canonical probabilistic classifier, logistic regression. EDGE reads the same binned predicted-versus-observed table a reliability diagram plots, and projects its standardized bin residuals onto a small pre-specified basis of smooth calibration-distortion shapes. Its null distribution is a weighted sum of chi-square variables in closed form, costing one pass over the data and one small eigendecomposition: no refit, no resampling, no tuning, so it can run inside cross-validation loops. Binning also makes it robust to the sparsity continuous features create. Across link and feature misspecification the pre-specified default led or tied every rival binned test on the fitted index in 19 of 22 detectable scenarios, and stayed computable where the refit-based Stukel score test separates in 20% to 28% of sparse samples. Its honest limit is rough, high-frequency miscalibration, where omnibus statistics win - a limit an elementary resolution argument shows is shared by every binned instrument, the calibration error included.
papers.comment: 47 pages, 6 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to Advances in Data Analysis and Classification. Reproduction materials: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21247541. This paper develops in full a method introduced in one chapter of the author's M.Sc. thesis (arXiv:2608.11140); it shares that chapter's setting and notation but is otherwise new work, with new theory, simulations and applications
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EDGE，一种针对概率二元分类器（主要面向逻辑回归）校准的封闭形式检验。它读取可靠性图所用的分箱预测-观测表，将标准化箱残差投影到一组预指定的平滑校准失真形状基底上，原假设下统计量服从加权卡方变量的闭合形式分布。摘要报告该方法无需重拟合、重采样或调参，可嵌入交叉验证循环，并在链接与特征误设定下多数场景优于对手分箱检验；其局限是对高频粗糙误校准不敏感。
Motivation: 判别性指标（准确率、ROC、AUC）对预测概率的单调扭曲不变，因此分类器可以排序完美但概率严重失真。现有校准工具如分箱期望校准误差（ECE）和可靠性图本质上是描述性的，没有零分布，无法区分真实误校准与噪声，且结果依赖分箱选择。
Method: EDGE 将可靠性图对应的分箱期望与观测残差标准化后，投影到若干预指定的平滑校准失真形状（smooth calibration-distortion shapes）上；其零分布为加权卡方变量之和的闭合形式，仅需一遍数据遍历和一次小型特征分解。分箱设计同时使方法对连续特征造成的稀疏性具有稳健性。
Result: 摘要报告在链接和特征误设定下，预指定默认基在 22 个可检测场景中的 19 个于拟合指标上领先或并列领先所有对手分箱检验；在 20%–28% 的稀疏样本中，基于重拟合的 Stukel score test 因分离（separation）无法计算时，EDGE 仍可计算。
Conclusion: 作者指出 EDGE 的诚实边界是对高频粗糙误校准不敏感，此时 omnibus 统计量更优，并通过基本分辨率论证表明这一局限是包括校准误差在内的所有分箱工具共有的。

papers.title: A Temporal Planning Approach for Intelligent Flood Response
papers.abstract_en: Effective response to multiple, simultaneously flooded areas requires coordinating appropriate actions in the correct temporal order, under severe resource constraints. Automated planning provides a foundation for addressing this challenge by generating time-aware schedules, given a formal description of available resources, constraints, and goals. This work presents an intelligent flood-response framework that exploits temporal planning and models the complete operational life cycle of flood response. The framework incorporates priority-driven triage, route accessibility and travel costs, resource allocation, and supply management, while also supporting mid-execution re-planning in response to unexpected environmental changes. The framework is formulated both in the Action Notation Modeling Language (ANML) and the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) 2.1, facilitating compatibility with a wider range of temporal planners. Experimental results establish the feasibility and scalability of the proposed framework, showing that flood response scenarios can be effectively modeled and solved using temporal planning, while providing guidance on planner selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于时间规划（temporal planning）的智能洪水响应框架，针对多个同时受灾区域在资源受限条件下生成时间感知的行动计划。框架覆盖优先级驱动的分诊、路线可达性与旅行成本、资源分配和供应管理，并支持执行中重新规划（mid-execution re-planning）。作者用ANML和PDDL 2.1两种语言建模，实验验证了可行性与可扩展性，并给出规划器选择指导。
Motivation: 多个区域同时被淹时，需要按正确时间顺序协调行动，且资源约束严重；现有方法缺乏对洪水响应完整操作生命周期进行形式化建模和自动生成时间感知计划的手段。
Method: 将洪水响应问题建模为时间规划（temporal planning）问题，整合优先级分诊、路线可达性与旅行成本、资源分配及供应管理约束，并用Action Notation Modeling Language (ANML) 和Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) 2.1两种语言形式化，以兼容更多时间规划器，同时支持执行中针对环境变化的重新规划。
Result: 实验结果表明该框架具有可行性和可扩展性，证明洪水响应场景可以被时间规划有效建模和求解，并为不同场景下的规划器选择提供了指导。
Conclusion: 作者认为时间规划是构建智能洪水响应系统的可行基础，但应依据具体场景选择合适的时间规划器。
Relevance: 28

papers.title: Bern2Edge: A Neurosymbolic Compiler for Edge Deployment via Bernstein Polynomial Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deploying high-accuracy neural networks on resource-constrained edge devices remains challenging, as existing approaches treat training, compression, and hardware synthesis as separate stages, leaving a gap between software-trained models and efficient end-to-end deployment with limited support for interpretability. We propose Bern2Edge, an end-to-end framework that uses knowledge distillation to convert a pretrained teacher feed-forward network into hardware-efficient representations via Bernstein polynomial activations. This representation enables two deployment paths: (i) a high-fidelity LUT-based realization that preserves model fidelity under compression, and (ii) a symbolic rule-based representation derived from Bernstein activation geometry, enabling interpretable inference with explicit input-space constraints. The resulting BNNs achieve up to 2.12 percentage-point (pp) accuracy improvement over ReLU under identical compression constraints. At the system level, Bern2Edge achieves up to 99.8% latency reduction and 95.2% BRAM reduction relative to a W8A8 quantized teacher on an AMD Xilinx KV260 FPGA, while maintaining accuracy within 0.5 pp, and further deploys on a low-power Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA. The rule-based path reduces DSP usage by up to 89.0% at a cost of 1.5 pp in total accuracy.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 10 figures. Accepted at CODES+ISSS 2026, TCAD journal 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Bern2Edge，一个端到端框架，通过知识蒸馏将预训练教师前馈网络转换为基于 Bernstein 多项式激活的硬件高效表示，并提供两条部署路径：高保真 LUT 实现和基于符号规则的表示。在 AMD Xilinx KV260 FPGA 上，相比 W8A8 量化教师，框架实现最高 99.8% 延迟降低和 95.2% BRAM 降低，同时精度保持在 0.5 pp 以内，并进一步部署到低功耗 Spartan-7 XC7S15 FPGA。
Motivation: 现有方法将训练、压缩和硬件综合视为独立阶段，导致软件训练模型与资源受限边缘设备上的高效端到端部署之间存在差距，且对可解释性的支持有限。
Method: 使用知识蒸馏将预训练教师前馈网络转换为 Bernstein 多项式网络 (BNN)，利用 Bernstein 激活几何实现两种部署路径：一是高保真的查找表 (LUT) 实现以在压缩下保持模型保真度，二是从 Bernstein 激活几何导出的符号规则表示，用于带显式输入空间约束的可解释推理。
Result: 在相同压缩约束下，BNN 相比 ReLU 实现最高 2.12 个百分点 (pp) 的准确率提升；系统层面在 KV260 FPGA 上实现最高 99.8% 延迟降低和 95.2% BRAM 降低，精度损失在 0.5 pp 内；规则路径减少 DSP 使用最高 89.0%，代价是总精度损失 1.5 pp。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 Bern2Edge 弥合了软件训练模型与高效边缘部署之间的差距，同时提供可解释的推理路径，并验证了在低功耗 FPGA 上的可行部署。

papers.title: Towards Traffic Modelling of Multi-Agent Systems: The Role of Coordination Topology
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent LLM systems are an emerging networked workload whose rapid deployment raises questions about the traffic patterns they generate. Compared to conventional applications, these systems generate requests internally: a single user task can induce a structured sequence of model calls whose timing is governed by coordination logic rather than by user arrival rate. It is not clear whether classical traffic models, designed for human-driven workloads, apply to this setting. We present an empirical characterisation of LLM-call interarrival time distributions across sequential, star, and full-mesh agentic coordination topologies, using a multi-layer measurement framework over 500 repeated runs per topology. We find that topology fundamentally shapes the arrival process of requests to the LLM backend: fan-out coordination introduces a structural bimodality absent in sequential execution, and the reasoningphase component is best described by a log-normal distribution, with the Poisson exponential null model decisively rejected across all topologies. These differences propagate to inference and network level metrics. The framework and analysis pipeline are released openly at https://github.com/dlamagna/agentraffic.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Published at the ACM SIGCOMM Workshop on Networks for AI Computing (NAIC '26)
papers.journal_ref: SIGCOMM '26: Proceedings of the ACM SIGCOMM 2026 Conference, 2060 - 2066
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对多智能体 LLM 系统的网络流量特征进行实证刻画，针对 sequential、star、full-mesh 三种协调拓扑测量 LLM 调用到达间隔分布。作者基于每拓扑 500 次重复运行的多层测量框架，发现拓扑会从根本上改变到达过程：fan-out 协调引入顺序执行中不存在的结构双峰性，reasoning 阶段分量最接近 log-normal 分布，而 Poisson 指数零模型在所有拓扑下均被拒绝。这些差异会进一步传导到推理和网络层指标，框架与分析流程已开源。
Motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统是新兴的网络化负载，单个用户任务会在系统内部触发一系列结构化模型调用，其时间由协调逻辑而非用户到达率决定；经典流量模型是否适用于这种内部生成请求的场景尚不清楚。
Method: 提出多层测量框架，在 sequential、star、full-mesh 三种 agentic coordination topology 下每拓扑重复运行 500 次，对 LLM 调用间隔时间分布进行经验刻画，并用统计检验比较不同分布假设。
Result: 摘要报告协调拓扑从根本上塑造了请求到达过程：fan-out 引入结构双峰性，reasoning 阶段分量最好由 log-normal 分布描述，Poisson 指数零模型在所有拓扑下均被拒绝；这些差异还传播到推理和网络层指标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调协调拓扑是决定 LLM 后端请求到达过程的关键因素，传统面向人类驱动负载的流量模型并不适用于该场景，并公开了测量框架与分析流程。

papers.title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become a prevailing paradigm for unified video perception. However, post-training on large multi-task datasets remains challenging, as existing reinforcement learning methods sample on-policy groups with few high-quality rollouts even with costly chain-of-thought (CoT) generation. In this paper, we study the sample efficiency and scalability of RL post-training for video MLLMs and introduce OraRL. We identify an overlooked role for annotations: Beyond scoring rollouts, each can enter its on-policy group as an oracle rollout, a direct positive optimization target. Direct oracle integration, however, is nontrivial: a high-reward oracle raises the group baseline and inverts otherwise positive policy advantages, a failure we term advantage inversion. At the core of OraRL is a decoupled advantage estimator: policy rollouts determine an oracle-free baseline, while the oracle-policy gap modulates both a directional gain and a separate detached oracle advantage. Sign-balanced pruning improves efficiency: by retaining only the oracle and the strongest rollouts of each sign, OraRL requires just 2.2x the step time of SFT, less than half the 4.9x required by GRPO with CoT. OraRL scales with model size and data, surpassing its backbone from 0.8B to 9B and GRPO up to 100k prompts. Without chain-of-thought, Video-ORA-9B decodes in 130 ms instead of 4,780 ms. Compared with the respective prior best models, it raises temporal mIoU from 62.5 to 66.0, tracking AO from 73.0 to 78.2, segmentation from 64.3 to 70.4, and the three-benchmark spatial-intelligence macro average from 51.0 to 56.1; on VSI-Bench, it scores 73.1 against 55.0 for GPT-5 and 55.1 for Gemini-3-Pro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频多模态大模型 (video MLLM) 的强化学习后训练提出 OraRL，发现注释 (annotations) 除了打分之外还可以作为 oracle rollout 直接进入 on-policy 组参与优化。为解决高奖励 oracle 抬升基线导致优势反转 (advantage inversion) 的问题，作者提出解耦优势估计器，并引入符号平衡剪枝。摘要报告 OraRL 仅需 SFT 的 2.2 倍步长时间，在多个视频理解基准上超越 GRPO 和既有最优模型。
Motivation: 现有视频 MLLM 在多任务数据上的 RL 后训练依赖于少数高质量 rollout，即使配合昂贵的 chain-of-thought (CoT) 生成，样本效率与可扩展性仍然不足。
Method: 将每条注释作为 oracle rollout 加入其 on-policy 组，成为直接的正优化目标；核心是解耦优势估计器，用策略 rollout 计算不含 oracle 的基线，并用 oracle-策略差距调节方向增益和独立的 detached oracle 优势；符号平衡剪枝只保留 oracle 与每个符号下最强的 rollout 以提升效率。
Result: 摘要报告 OraRL 的步长时间为 SFT 的 2.2 倍，低于 GRPO 加 CoT 的 4.9 倍；在 0.8B 到 9B 模型及最多 100k prompts 上持续超越 backbone 与 GRPO。无需 CoT 时 Video-ORA-9B 解码从 4780 ms 降至 130 ms；相比各自先前最优模型，时间 mIoU 从 62.5 升至 66.0，跟踪 AO 从 73.0 升至 78.2，分割从 64.3 升至 70.4，三基准空间智能宏平均从 51.0 升至 56.1，VSI-Bench 上得分 73.1，高于 GPT-5 的 55.0 与 Gemini-3-Pro 的 55.1。
Conclusion: 作者认为注释作为 oracle rollout 是一种被忽视的优化信号，结合解耦优势估计可以有效提升视频 MLLM 的 RL 后训练效率与可扩展性，并显著降低推理时延。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lost in Translation: How Universal Ethical Values Fail to Translate Across Global Contexts
papers.abstract_en: AI ethics frameworks treat values such as fairness, transparency, and accountability as universal and uniformly operationalizable across contexts. We examined how 14 experts across 10 countries made sense of AI in practice, reinterpreted core values, and envisioned governance alternatives. We found that AI deployment is characterized by structurally unequal conditions, marked by infrastructural constraints, extractive practices, and a "mystification" of technology, which fundamentally shape perceptions of risks and opportunities. Our findings reveal that experts reinterpret values to fit local moral logics: privacy as collective and relational rather than individual; transparency as trust-building accountability rather than technical disclosure; and fairness as equity in access and representation rather than parity in outcomes. We identify these as translation gaps between encoded global frameworks and situated local practices. Finally, we propose pathways toward plural governance that redistributes epistemic authority and treats ethical negotiation as an ongoing, context-sensitive process rather than a settled technical standard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究AI伦理框架中的普世价值（如公平、透明、问责）为何在不同国家与本地实践中失效。作者考察了10个国家共14名专家如何在实际中理解AI、重新诠释核心价值并设想治理替代方案，发现这些价值被按本地道德逻辑重新定义，并将编码化的全球框架与情境化的本地实践之间的差异称为“翻译鸿沟”。
Motivation: 现有AI伦理框架把公平、透明和问责等价值视为普世且可统一操作化，但忽视不同社会情境下价值含义的差异，导致框架与实际部署条件脱节。
Method: 作者对来自10个国家的14名专家进行调研，考察他们在实践中如何理解AI、重新诠释核心价值以及构想治理替代方案，并基于这些经验材料归纳价值“翻译”过程中的系统性问题。
Result: 研究发现AI部署存在结构性不平等条件，包括基础设施约束、提取性实践和技术的“神秘化”，这些条件深刻影响对风险与机会的认知；专家将隐私重新诠释为集体性和关系性而非个体性，将透明视为建立信任的问责而非技术披露，将公平视为获取和代表的公平而非结果平等。
Conclusion: 作者提出通向多元治理（plural governance）的路径，主张重新分配 epistemic authority（认知权威），并将伦理协商视为持续的、情境敏感的过程，而非固化的技术标准。

papers.title: Metag: A dataset to build agentic meta-reviewing capabilities
papers.abstract_en: AI tools increasingly support tasks across the scientific research cycle, from experiment design and manuscript preparation to peer review. At the same time, the continuing growth in conference submissions has increased the burden on meta-reviewers, who must synthesize reviewer feedback, author rebuttals, and manuscript revisions. To address this concern, this paper introduces Metag, a dataset to accelerate the development of meta-reviewing agents, specifically to identify changes made to scientific articles during the review-rebuttal process. Each instance contains a reviewer concern, the author's proposed resolution, and the manuscript diffs implementing the stated change. Metag is collected by obtaining manuscript versions from before the review deadline and after acceptance, computing differences between the two documents, and asking human annotators to align these differences with action items from OpenReview discussions. The resulting dataset consists of 349 high-quality action items tied to paper differences and will enable building methods to empower meta reviewers to quickly identify whether authors have addressed reviewer statements and where in the paper those changes have been made, resulting in additional transparency and traceability throughout peer review. The dataset is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Metag，一个用于构建 meta-reviewing 智能体（meta-reviewing agents）能力的数据集，目标是识别论文在审稿- rebuttal 过程中发生的变化。每个实例包含审稿人关注点、作者提出的解决方案以及实现该变化的稿件 diff；通过对比审稿截止前与录用后的稿件版本，并由人工标注将差异与 OpenReview 讨论中的行动项对齐，最终得到 349 个高质量行动项。数据集公开于 GitHub，旨在帮助 meta-reviewer 快速判断作者是否回应了审稿意见以及修改位置，增强同行评审的透明度和可追溯性。
Motivation: 会议投稿量持续增长，meta-reviewer 需要综合审稿意见、作者 rebuttal 和稿件修订，负担日益加重；现有 AI 工具虽已覆盖科研流程多个环节，但缺少专门的数据集来开发自动核对稿件修改的 meta-reviewing 智能体。
Method: 收集稿件在审稿截止前和录用后的版本，计算两个版本之间的文档差异，并要求人工标注者将这些差异与 OpenReview 讨论中的行动项（action items）进行对齐，从而构造“审稿人关注点—作者拟议解决方式—稿件 diff”三元组形式的数据实例。
Result: 摘要报告最终数据集包含 349 个高质量、与论文差异绑定的行动项，并公开提供下载链接（https://github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset）。
Conclusion: 作者认为该数据集将支持开发方法，使 meta-reviewer 能快速定位作者是否处理了审稿意见以及修改在论文中的位置，从而提升同行评审流程的透明度和可追溯性。

summary_sections.motivation: 会议投稿量持续增长，meta-reviewer 需要综合审稿意见、作者 rebuttal 和稿件修订，负担日益加重；现有 AI 工具虽已覆盖科研流程多个环节，但缺少专门的数据集来开发自动核对稿件修改的 meta-reviewing 智能体。
summary_sections.method: 收集稿件在审稿截止前和录用后的版本，计算两个版本之间的文档差异，并要求人工标注者将这些差异与 OpenReview 讨论中的行动项（action items）进行对齐，从而构造“审稿人关注点—作者拟议解决方式—稿件 diff”三元组形式的数据实例。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告最终数据集包含 349 个高质量、与论文差异绑定的行动项，并公开提供下载链接（https://github.com/microsoft/Metag-dataset）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该数据集将支持开发方法，使 meta-reviewer 能快速定位作者是否处理了审稿意见以及修改在论文中的位置，从而提升同行评审流程的透明度和可追溯性。

papers.title: Terminal Agents: A Survey of AI Agents in Command-Line Environments
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly act through terminals, yet existing surveys disperse terminal-mediated behavior across software engineering, tool use, and computer-use research. We regard terminal agents as systems whose dominant progress-bearing action--observation loop is mediated by terminal command execution, textual feedback, and stateful environment interaction. Using terminal-mediated execution as an organizing lens, this survey establishes workload-level boundaries and connects system architecture, competence acquisition, and evaluation through a seven-dimensional terminal competence profile. Our synthesis shows that realized behavior is jointly shaped by the model, interface, harness, runtime, and environment. Executable trajectories ground learning in action consequences, verification, and recovery, whereas prevailing evaluations emphasize final outcomes and expose process quality, recovery, and governance unevenly. Bounded fixed-condition diagnostics illustrate two implications: benchmark families expose different process signals, and matched system comparisons reveal benchmark-dependent performance and limits of component attribution. These findings motivate explicit reporting of system and runtime conditions, supported by replayable traces and process-level evidence. The framework provides a unified basis for studying terminal-mediated agency across software engineering and emerging application domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于命令行环境下AI代理的综述，提出将终端代理定义为以终端命令执行、文本反馈和状态化环境交互为中介的主导行动-观测循环。作者以终端介导执行为组织视角，建立工作负载级边界，并通过七维终端能力画像连接系统架构、能力获取与评估，为软件工程及新兴应用领域的终端介导机构研究提供统一基础。
Motivation: 现有综述将终端介导行为分散在软件工程、工具使用和计算机使用研究中，缺乏统一视角，难以系统理解终端代理的行为塑造因素与评估现状。
Method: 以终端介导执行为组织透镜，建立工作负载级边界，提出七维终端能力画像（seven-dimensional terminal competence profile），从系统架构、能力获取和评估三个层面进行综合分析。
Result: 综述表明实际行为由模型、接口、harness、运行时和环境共同塑造；可执行轨迹将学习锚定在动作后果、验证和恢复上，而现有评估侧重最终结果，对过程质量、恢复和治理覆盖不均。有界固定条件诊断显示不同基准族暴露不同过程信号，匹配系统比较揭示基准依赖的性能以及组件归因的局限。
Conclusion: 研究动机是显式报告系统和运行时条件，并借助可重放轨迹和过程级证据支撑评估；该框架为终端介导agency研究提供统一基础，适用于软件工程与新兴应用领域。

papers.title: Uncertainty propagation in auto-regressive random neural network models
papers.abstract_en: We develop analytical and particle-based methods for uncertainty propagation in random neural network models, where both the inputs and network parameters are allowed to be random. Building on the piecewise-linear structure of the Leaky ReLU activation function, we derive a local approximation of the neural network output with respect to perturbations in both its inputs and parameters. This approximation is exact for perturbations that preserve the network activation pattern, and it allows us to compute analytical expressions for the probability density function and characteristic function of the network output, together with closed-form approximations for its mean and covariance. We extend this uncertainty propagation framework to autonomous dynamical systems whose one-step evolution map is represented by a random neural network. Repeated application of this map defines an autoregressive model, for which we derive recursive equations to propagate uncertainty in both the state and network parameters over time. These equations explicitly account for the state-parameter cross-covariance that develops under successive iterations of the network. Numerical experiments on the Lorenz-63 system and the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation demonstrate accurate uncertainty propagation through the predictability horizon and the applicability of the proposed framework to high-dimensional dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向随机神经网络模型的解析与粒子两类不确定性传播方法，允许输入和网络参数同时为随机量。作者利用 Leaky ReLU 的分段线性结构，推导了网络输出关于输入和参数扰动的局部近似，该近似在激活模式不变时是精确的，并据此得到输出概率密度函数、特征函数以及均值和协方差的闭式近似。随后将该框架推广到由随机神经网络定义一步演化映射的自回归动力学系统，推导出随时间传播状态与参数不确定性的递推方程，显式计入状态-参数交叉协方差。在 Lorenz-63 和 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程上的数值实验表明，该方法能在可预报时域内保持准确的不确定性传播，并适用于高维动力系统。
Motivation: 随机神经网络模型在输入和参数均不确定时需要有效的置信度传播方法，而现有分析手段难以处理非线性激活带来的非高斯输出分布；同时，将这类不确定性传播推广到自回归动力系统时，状态与参数在迭代中会产生交叉协方差，需要专门的递推框架。
Method: 基于 Leaky ReLU 的分段线性结构，构造网络输出关于输入和参数的局部线性化近似，该近似对保持激活模式的扰动精确；由此解析地给出输出概率密度函数、特征函数及均值和协方差的闭式近似。对自回归模型，迭代应用该随机网络一步映射，并推导状态与参数不确定性随时间演化的递推方程，显式保留状态-参数交叉协方差项。
Result: 数值实验在 Lorenz-63 系统和 Kuramoto-Sivashinsky 方程上验证了所提方法能够在可预报时域（predictability horizon）内准确传播不确定性，并表明该框架可扩展到高维动力系统。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的框架为随机自回归神经网络模型提供了解析与粒子两种不确定性传播途径，且能够显式刻画状态-参数交叉协方差的累积效应。

papers.title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open source JSON-RPC protocol that standardizes how large language models (LLMs) interact with external systems through programmatic functions known as tools. Attackers or malicious agents can exploit certain modalities of these MCP tools to degrade the overall quality of service of agent-based applications. For example, an agent may request an excessively large search radius or very long videos, overloading backend systems and potentially causing slowdowns or denial-of-service. Each modality including text, images, video, and location introduces distinct vectors for resource abuse, complicating the development of consistent mitigation strategies. Moreover, multimodal and crossdomain tools expose diverse request schemas and parameters, making it difficult to define policies that are both generalizable and precise enough to enforce meaningful resource constraints. In this paper, we present AEGIS, a policy enforcement component that enables administrators to define fine-grained safeguards against resource abuse across heterogeneous MCP tools and modalities. AEGIS leverages the reasoning capabilities of large language models to analyze, categorize, and normalize diverse tool invocations into a unified, policy-friendly representation accessible to security practitioners. Integrated with the Open Policy Agent and the ContextForge AI Gateway, AEGIS detects and mitigates abusive behaviors while preserving the flexibility of MCP-based agent ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AEGIS，一个面向模型上下文协议（MCP）的策略执行组件，用于防止跨工具与跨模态的资源滥用。AEGIS 借助大语言模型的推理能力，将异构的 MCP 工具调用分析、分类并归一化为统一、策略友好的表示，并与 Open Policy Agent 和 ContextForge AI Gateway 集成，以检测和缓解滥用行为，同时保留 MCP 代理生态系统的灵活性。摘要未提供量化实验数据。
Motivation: MCP 工具支持文本、图像、视频、位置等多种模态，恶意代理可通过请求过大搜索半径或超长视频等方式过载后端系统，引发服务质量下降或拒绝服务。不同模态与跨域工具暴露的请求模式和参数差异很大，使现有缓解策略难以兼顾通用性与精确性。
Method: AEGIS 利用大语言模型的推理能力，对多样化的工具调用进行分析、分类和归一化，将其转换成统一、可供安全从业者使用的策略表示；随后在 Open Policy Agent 和 ContextForge AI Gateway 环境中执行资源约束和策略，从而检测并缓解滥用行为。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的量化指标或基准实验；它声称 AEGIS 能够检测和缓解滥用行为，同时保持 MCP 生态系统的灵活性。
Conclusion: 作者认为，借助 LLM 驱动的归一化表示与现有策略引擎的集成，可以在异构 MCP 工具和模态上实现一致且精细的资源滥用防护。

papers.title: When Clean Data Hurts: Learning with Monotone Corruptions Beyond Binary Classification
papers.abstract_en: Optimal learners are tailored to exploit the i.i.d.\ data assumption underlying the classic PAC model. What if an i.i.d.\ training sample were corrupted with correctly labeled examples drawn from an otherwise unrelated, even adversarial source? This model of learning with monotone adversarial corruptions was recently introduced by Larsen et al. (2026), who demonstrated that all known optimal binary learners suffer increased error rates in this setting, from $O(d / n)$ in the PAC model to $Ω(d \log(n / d) / n)$ under monotone corruption. Mehrotra (2026) proved this logarithmic factor to be necessary for binary classification, but left open the consequences of corruption for more general learning settings, such as multiclass classification and partial binary concept classes. As our primary result, we demonstrate that monotone adversaries are frighteningly more powerful in each of these settings. We exhibit a learnable multiclass problem, of DS dimension only 2, that becomes altogether unlearnable under a monotone adversary, and show an analogous result for partial binary concept classes. These results are achieved by an adaptive adversary permitted to view the original i.i.d.\ training set $S$ and to insert $b < \infty$ corrupted datapoints into $S$. In the multiclass example, the adversary need only insert a linear number $b = |S| = n$ of datapoints. We complement these impossibility results by proving that every class remains learnable when the number of adaptive additions is $o(n)$, which our previous multiclass lower bound proves to be tight. We further observe that the classic multiclass error rate of $O(d_{\mathrm{DS}} / n)$ remains achievable against adaptive adversaries restricted to a known constant budget $b = O(1)$, against semi-adaptive adversaries viewing only a $p$-fraction of $S$ for $p \in (0, 1)$, and against oblivious adversaries that cannot view $S$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习理论中的单调对抗污染 (monotone adversarial corruptions) 模型：在经典 PAC 假设的 i.i.d. 训练样本之外，额外插入来自无关甚至对抗来源的、标签正确的样本。作者证明这类单调对抗者在多分类 (multiclass) 和部分二分类概念类 (partial binary concept classes) 中比二分类情形强大得多：一个 DS 维数为 2 的可学习多分类问题在单调对抗者下变得完全不可学习，部分二分类概念类也有类似结果。另一方面，当自适应插入数量为 o(n) 时所有概念类仍可学习，且该界限被证明是紧的。
Motivation: Larsen et al. (2026) 引入单调对抗污染模型并表明所有已知最优二分类学习器在此设定下错误率上升，Mehrotra (2026) 证明该对数因子对二分类是必要的，但未回答更一般设定（如多分类与部分二分类概念类）下的后果。本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 作者构造可学习问题的具体反例，利用一个能查看原始 i.i.d. 训练集 S 并插入 b 个污染样本的自适应对抗者，证明多分类与部分二分类问题在单调污染下不可学习；同时证明自适应插入数量为 o(n) 时所有概念类仍可学习，并给出紧性论证。文章还考察了常数预算 b=O(1) 的自适应对抗者、仅查看 S 的 p 部分的半自适应对抗者以及不能查看 S 的 oblivious 对抗者。
Result: 摘要报告：存在 DS 维数仅为 2 的可学习多分类问题，在单调对抗者下彻底不可学习，且对抗者只需插入线性数量 b=n 个数据点；部分二分类概念类有类似的反例。作为补充，当自适应插入数量为 o(n) 时所有类仍可学习，该下界被证明是紧的。此外，经典多分类错误率 O(d_DS/n) 在常数预算自适应、半自适应和 oblivious 等受限对抗设定下仍然可达。
Conclusion: 作者强调单调对抗者在多分类和部分二分类设定中比二分类更可怕，可以在仅插入线性数量样本时摧毁可学习性；但若对抗者能力受限（o(n) 自适应、常数预算、半自适应或 oblivious），学习仍然可行且经典错误率可达。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 作者构造可学习问题的具体反例，利用一个能查看原始 i.i.d. 训练集 S 并插入 b 个污染样本的自适应对抗者，证明多分类与部分二分类问题在单调污染下不可学习；同时证明自适应插入数量为 o(n) 时所有概念类仍可学习，并给出紧性论证。文章还考察了常数预算 b=O(1) 的自适应对抗者、仅查看 S 的 p 部分的半自适应对抗者以及不能查看 S 的 oblivious 对抗者。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告：存在 DS 维数仅为 2 的可学习多分类问题，在单调对抗者下彻底不可学习，且对抗者只需插入线性数量 b=n 个数据点；部分二分类概念类有类似的反例。作为补充，当自适应插入数量为 o(n) 时所有类仍可学习，该下界被证明是紧的。此外，经典多分类错误率 O(d_DS/n) 在常数预算自适应、半自适应和 oblivious 等受限对抗设定下仍然可达。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调单调对抗者在多分类和部分二分类设定中比二分类更可怕，可以在仅插入线性数量样本时摧毁可学习性；但若对抗者能力受限（o(n) 自适应、常数预算、半自适应或 oblivious），学习仍然可行且经典错误率可达。

papers.title: STCO: Conditional Neural Operators for Time-Dependent PDEs
papers.abstract_en: Neural operators have emerged as efficient surrogates for time-dependent physical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs), but their future-state predictions are often conditioned only on observed states and static problem descriptors. For control or optimization, however, body motion, inflow, or forcing are prescribed for the query without being determined solely by the observed state. We introduce the Spatiotemporal Conditional Operator (STCO) for prescribed-condition operator learning (PCOL), a common interface that supplies prescribed target-time condition fields to heterogeneous backbone architectures while retaining their architecture-specific core computation and context pathways. Its condition interface combines Flow-Aware Graph Leaf (FAGL) with Dual-Site Feature-wise Linear Modulation (DSFiLM). Non-learned FAGL uses vorticity from the final observed frame to construct a fixed-cardinality adaptive partition, then co-locates the observed history and target-time condition fields at its regional coordinates. DSFiLM injects separate motion, inflow, and force routes before and after operator computation through current-feature-driven slot- and channel-wise gates. We evaluate twelve matched backbone architectures with different existing physical and temporal inputs. The immersed-boundary computational fluid dynamics (CFD) benchmark spans prescribed motion, inflow disturbances, body-force actuation, and morphology. Across twelve matched backbones, three regimes, and two lead ranges, STCO yields mean paired reductions of 31.1% in relative-L2 field error and 24.7% in normalized pressure-derived load error. It also lowers longer-lead field error for 11 backbones, while interventions on individual condition groups produce measurable prediction changes for every group evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Spatiotemporal Conditional Operator (STCO)，一个用于 prescribed-condition operator learning (PCOL) 的公共条件接口，使面向时间相关 PDE 的神经算子能吸收查询时刻被指定的身体运动、入流或体力等条件场。STCO 结合非学习的 Flow-Aware Graph Leaf (FAGL) 与 Dual-Site Feature-wise Linear Modulation (DSFiLM)，可配接到异构骨干架构而不改变其核心计算。在 immersed-boundary CFD 基准的十二种匹配骨架上，平均配对相对-L2 场误差降低 31.1%，归一化压力导出载荷误差降低 24.7%。
Motivation: 现有神经算子对时间相关 PDE 的未来状态预测通常只以观测状态和静态问题描述为条件；但在控制或优化中，物体运动、入流或强迫是查询时预先规定的，不能仅由观测状态决定。这需要一种通用机制把这些规定条件注入异构骨干架构。
Method: 提出 STCO，用于指定条件算子学习的公共接口。其条件接口将 FAGL 与 DSFiLM 结合：非学习的 FAGL 用最终观测帧的涡量构造固定基数的自适应分区，把观测历史与目标时间条件场共同定位到区域坐标；DSFiLM 在算子计算前后通过当前特征驱动的 slot 与 channel 门分别注入运动、入流与力三条条件路径。
Result: 在覆盖规定运动、入流扰动、体力驱动和形态的 immersed-boundary CFD 基准上，对十二种匹配骨干、三个工况和两个提前量范围，STCO 实现平均配对相对-L2 场误差降低 31.1%，归一化压力导出载荷误差降低 24.7%；对 11 种骨干降低更长提前量的场误差，且针对每个条件组的干预都能产生可测量的预测变化。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 STCO 能作为通用条件注入接口，在不改动骨干核心计算和上下文通路的前提下提升异构神经算子的场与载荷预测精度，适用于控制/优化中条件被规定而非仅由观测决定的时间相关 PDE。摘要未讨论明确局限性。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport for VideoLM Token Compression
papers.abstract_en: Video language models process videos as dense visual-token sequences with substantial representational redundancy. Compressing these sequences is therefore essential for reducing the visual-token burden on language-model decoding. The central challenge is to preserve visual information dispersed across frames under such compression. To this end, we introduce Aggregating Visual Information with Optimal Transport (AVIOT), which casts video token compression as transporting a dense empirical measure of frame observations onto a compact target measure. The resulting source-to-target coupling induces a distribution over source observations for each target support, directly specifying how the compressed video representation is constructed. We further adapt this construction along task and spatial axes. Question conditioning modulates the transport cost between source frames and target supports, while influencing how many supports are allocated to each temporal segment, thereby directing representation capacity toward question-relevant content. At multiple spatial granularities, AVIOT computes region-specific temporal transport plans and adaptively fuses the representations they yield, allowing different regions within the same compact representation to draw from different moments. Evaluations across varying compression ratios show that AVIOT matches or outperforms the uncompressed baseline on multiple video-understanding benchmarks while retaining strong performance at higher compression ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视频语言模型（VideoLM）将视频表示为高冗余密集视觉 token 序列的问题，提出基于最优传输（Optimal Transport）的视觉信息聚合方法 AVIOT。AVIOT 将视频 token 压缩建模为从帧观测的经验测度到紧凑目标测度的传输，通过源-目标耦合直接指定压缩表示如何构建，并从任务轴和空间轴两方面适配该构建过程。摘要报告在多种压缩比下，AVIOT 在多个视频理解基准上匹配或超过未压缩基线，并在高压缩比下保持较强性能。
Motivation: 视频语言模型将视频处理为密集视觉 token 序列，存在大量表征冗余；压缩这些序列对减轻语言模型解码的视觉 token 负担至关重要。核心挑战在于压缩过程中保留分散在帧间的视觉信息。
Method: AVIOT 将视频 token 压缩形式化为把帧观测的稠密经验测度传输到紧凑目标测度上的最优传输问题，源到目标的耦合为每个目标支撑点诱导出源观测上的分布，从而规定压缩表示的构造方式。方法沿任务轴和空间轴适配：问题条件化（question conditioning）调制源帧与目标支撑点之间的传输代价，并影响每个时间片段分配的支撑点数量；在多个空间粒度上，AVIOT 计算区域特定的时间传输计划并自适应融合其表示，使同一紧凑表示内的不同区域可从不同时刻取材。
Result: 摘要报告在多种压缩比下的评估显示，AVIOT 在多个视频理解基准上匹配或超过未压缩基线，并在较高压缩比下仍保持较强性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将视频 token 压缩视为最优传输问题并沿任务与空间轴适配，可以在压缩下保留分散的视觉信息，从而在压缩视觉 token 的同时维持视频理解性能。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and Spatial Control
papers.abstract_en: Digital 3D objects used in games and animation are often required to be compositional; that is, decomposed into semantically meaningful parts. Recent 3D generation methods can produce high-quality compositional objects conditioned on image or text prompts. Yet, such global conditioning lacks the precise part-level controllability required for professional creative workflows. To address this, we introduce MultiCube, a novel compositional 3D generation method that provides explicit, independent control over both the semantics and spatial arrangement of each part. MultiCube takes as input a global text prompt, a text schema specifying the desired parts, and a spatial layout indicating the bounding boxes of the parts in the given schema. It outputs a 3D object composed of distinct meshes, one per specified part, that adhere to the given semantic and spatial conditions. Our approach employs a two-stage diffusion process, first generating a schema- and layout-aligned monolithic mesh, then decomposing the mesh into individual parts simultaneously. A novel Part Layout Adapter is used to encode per-part conditions independently of the other parts. Experiments demonstrate that our method can generate high-quality compositional 3D objects with precise part-level control, including those with unique layouts difficult to achieve with text or image prompting alone. Project page: https://multi-cube.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiCube，一种组合式 3D 生成方法，支持对每个部件的语义和空间布局进行显式、独立的控制。输入为全局文本提示、描述目标部件的文本 schema 以及指示各部件包围盒的空间布局，输出由多个独立网格组成的 3D 物体。方法采用两阶段扩散过程，先生成与 schema 和布局对齐的整体网格，再同时分解为各个部件；新颖的 Part Layout Adapter 用于独立于其他部件地编码逐部件条件。实验表明该方法能生成高质量、具有精细部件级控制的组合式 3D 物体，包括难以仅靠文本或图像提示实现的独特布局。
Motivation: 现有 3D 生成方法可以基于图像或文本提示生成高质量的组合式对象，但这类全局条件缺乏专业创意工作流所需的精确部件级可控性。
Method: 提出两阶段扩散流程：首先生成与给定 schema 和空间布局对齐的整体网格，再将该网格同时分解为各独立部件；并引入 Part Layout Adapter，对每个部件的条件进行独立于其他部件的编码。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明该方法能生成具有精确部件级控制的高质量组合式 3D 物体，包括难以仅靠文本或图像提示实现的独特布局。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为组合式 3D 生成提供了显式、独立的部件级语义与空间控制能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mutual information and sensitivity analysis for feature selection in customer targeting: a comparative study
papers.abstract_en: Feature selection is a highly relevant task in a data-driven knowledge discovery project. Several techniques have been developed aiming at finding the features that influence most an outcome to predict, including mutual information and, in recent years, the data-based sensitivity analysis. The present research focus on analyzing the advantages and disadvantages of each of these two techniques, by applying both to a bank telemarketing case. Thereafter, a logistic regression model is built on the tuned set of features identified by each of the two techniques as the most influencing set of features on the success of a telemarketing contact, in a total of 13 features for mutual information and 9 features for the data-based sensitivity analysis. The latter performs better for lower values of false positives while the former is slightly better for a higher false positive ratio. Thus, mutual information becomes a better choice if bank managers intend to reduce slightly the cost of contacts without risking losing a high number of successes. Such results show that mutual information, although not recent, is still a valid method for feature selection. On the other side, the data-based sensitivity analysis selection achieved good prediction results with less features.
papers.journal_ref: Barraza, N., Moro, S., Ferreyra, M., & de la Peña, A. (2019). Mutual information and sensitivity analysis for feature selection in customer targeting: A comparative study. Journal of Information Science, 45(1), 53-67
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对客户精准营销中的特征选择问题，对比了互信息 (mutual information) 与基于数据的敏感性分析 (data-based sensitivity analysis) 两种技术，并将其应用于银行电话营销 (telemarketing) 场景。随后基于两种技术各自筛选出的特征集构建逻辑回归模型，其中互信息筛选出 13 个特征，敏感性分析筛选出 9 个特征。结果表明，敏感性分析在较低的假阳性率区间表现更好，而互信息在较高的假阳性率区间略优。
Motivation: 特征选择是数据驱动知识发现项目中的关键任务，已有多种技术用于识别对预测结果影响最大的特征，包括互信息以及近年出现的基于数据的敏感性分析；本文旨在分析这两种技术的优缺点。
Method: 将互信息与基于数据的敏感性分析同时应用于银行电话营销案例，分别选出对电话营销接触成功影响最大的特征集，并基于各自筛选出的特征构建逻辑回归模型进行比较。互信息方法选出 13 个特征，敏感性分析方法选出 9 个特征。
Result: 摘要报告，基于数据的敏感性分析在较低的假阳性率取值下表现更好，而互信息在较高的假阳性率比例下略优；若银行管理者希望在不冒大量丢失成功案例风险的前提下适当降低接触成本，互信息是更合适的选择。敏感性分析则以更少的特征取得了良好的预测结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为互信息尽管并非新技术，仍然是有效的特征选择方法；同时基于数据的敏感性分析可以用更少的特征获得好的预测性能。

summary_sections.motivation: 特征选择是数据驱动知识发现项目中的关键任务，已有多种技术用于识别对预测结果影响最大的特征，包括互信息以及近年出现的基于数据的敏感性分析；本文旨在分析这两种技术的优缺点。
summary_sections.method: 将互信息与基于数据的敏感性分析同时应用于银行电话营销案例，分别选出对电话营销接触成功影响最大的特征集，并基于各自筛选出的特征构建逻辑回归模型进行比较。互信息方法选出 13 个特征，敏感性分析方法选出 9 个特征。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告，基于数据的敏感性分析在较低的假阳性率取值下表现更好，而互信息在较高的假阳性率比例下略优；若银行管理者希望在不冒大量丢失成功案例风险的前提下适当降低接触成本，互信息是更合适的选择。敏感性分析则以更少的特征取得了良好的预测结果。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为互信息尽管并非新技术，仍然是有效的特征选择方法；同时基于数据的敏感性分析可以用更少的特征获得好的预测性能。

papers.title: Amortized Bandwidth Learning for Kernel Density Estimation under Logarithmic Score
papers.abstract_en: Kernel density estimation converts finite samples into probability densities, but its performance depends critically on bandwidth selection. Classical selectors prescribe the sample-to-bandwidth rule analytically or asymptotically, or solve a new optimization for each sample. An amortized framework is proposed that instead learns this mapping across a distribution of density-estimation tasks by optimizing the logarithmic score. A truncated-and-renormalized bounded-support formulation enables stable learning across heterogeneous tasks, while affine standardization allows a selector trained on a single reference interval to transfer across bounded intervals. Experiments under Gaussian sampling, a multi-family benchmark, and randomized Gaussian-mixture training show that the amortized selector consistently and substantially outperforms Silverman's rule, the Sheather--Jones selector, and least-squares cross-validation, with especially large gains in small and heterogeneous samples. Finite Gaussian mixtures provide a generic training mechanism supported by their $L^1$ approximation property. Selectors trained in this way generalize strongly across different density structures, allowing the same trained selector to be applied directly to finite samples from unknown densities without specifying or fitting a distributional family. This combination of broad applicability and strong empirical performance makes the framework attractive for a wide range of applications in which finite samples or ensembles must be converted into continuous probability densities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种摊销式带宽学习 (amortized bandwidth learning) 框架用于核密度估计，通过优化对数分数 (logarithmic score) 学习从有限样本到带宽的映射，而非依赖解析/渐近规则或逐样本优化。截断重归一化的有界支撑公式配合仿射标准化使选择器可在不同有界区间间迁移；实验显示其一致且显著优于 Silverman、Sheather-Jones 和最小二乘交叉验证，尤其在样本量小且异质时。
Motivation: 经典带宽选择器要么通过解析或渐近方式规定样本到带宽的规则，要么对每个样本重新求解优化问题，缺乏跨任务学习与迁移能力。
Method: 提出摊销式学习框架，在一个密度估计任务分布上学习样本到带宽的映射并优化对数分数；采用截断重归一化的有界支撑公式以稳定跨异质任务的学习，并用仿射标准化让在单一参考区间上训练的选择器迁移到其他有界区间；利用有限高斯混合作为通用训练机制，借助其 L1 逼近性质。
Result: 在 Gaussian 采样、多族基准和随机高斯混合训练中，摊销选择器一致且大幅优于 Silverman 规则、Sheather-Jones 选择器和最小二乘交叉验证，在小样本和异质样本上增益尤其显著；训练后的选择器能强泛化到不同密度结构，可直接应用于未知密度的有限样本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架兼具广泛的适用性和强经验表现，适用于需要将有限样本或集合转换为连续概率密度的一系列应用，且无需指定或拟合分布族。

papers.title: Stored in Optimizer State, Valued by Later Training: A Causal Account of Subliminal Trait Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Subliminal trait transfer allows a student model to acquire behavioral dispositions from teacher-generated data in which the trait is not semantically expressed. Recent work explains how such signals enter gradients, but not how they survive source removal or acquire different signs under later training. We treat parameters and optimizer moments as a single trainer state and derive an exact transport-valuation identity separating observer-independent propagation of the source perturbation from the value assigned by a future continuation and behavioral readout. State surgery identifies the first moment as a causal carrier. Transplanting it alone leaves parameters, hidden states, and outputs unchanged at the cut, yet source-free updates generate growing parameter and hidden-state differences; transplanting parameters with the first moment recovers the terminal behavioral response. Sending the same source-induced difference through matched futures produces negative, near-zero, and positive Qwen effects (-0.658, +0.008, and +0.658 seed means). This ordering recurs in all 12 Llama-3.2-1B seeds after eight updates, while state-difference norms remain nearly equal across routes. Both contrasts grow in every paired seed when the continuation extends to sixteen updates. A full-horizon costate predicts all 42 Qwen route-mean signs and all 21 resolved Llama ordinary-route signs. Observer-independent transport also replicates across Qwen, SmolLM2, and Llama, while the complete-state recurrence predicts physical, hidden, and fixed-head responses in non-LoRA MNIST systems, including CNNs trained with AdamW and momentum SGD. Together, these results identify a two-stage mechanism for subliminal trait transfer: optimizer state transports the source perturbation, and later training determines its behavioral value.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种因果解释框架，将参数与优化器矩（optimizer moments）视为统一的训练者状态，用以解释次阈值特质迁移（subliminal trait transfer）中扰动如何通过优化器一阶矩在源数据被移除后继续传播，并由后续训练决定其行为价值。作者推导了精确的运输-价值恒等式（transport-valuation identity），并通过状态手术（state surgery）与跨模型实验（Qwen、Llama-3.2-1B、SmolLM2 及 MNIST CNN）验证：一阶矩是因果载体，而同一源扰动在不同后续训练下可产生负、近零或正的行为效应，形成两阶段机制。
Motivation: 已有工作解释了次阈值特质如何进入梯度，但未解释这些信号如何在源数据被移除后幸存，以及为何在后续训练中呈现不同符号的行为效应。作者希望从训练状态动态的角度给出因果解释，而不是仅停留在梯度层面的描述。
Method: 将参数与优化器矩合并为一个训练者状态，推导精确的运输-价值恒等式，把源扰动的观测者无关传播（transport）与未来延续及行为读出所赋予的价值（valuation）相分离。提出状态手术方法：单独移植一阶矩（first moment）作为因果载体，在切点（cut）处保持参数、隐藏状态和输出不变，但后续无源更新会产生差异；同时用完整状态递推与 full-horizon costate 预测符号，并在 Qwen、Llama-3.2-1B、SmolLM2 以及非 LoRA MNIST 系统（AdamW 和动量 SGD 训练的 CNN）上验证。
Result: 摘要报告：单独移植一阶矩在切点处不改变参数、隐藏状态和输出，但后续无源更新产生持续增长差异；移植参数加一阶矩可恢复终端行为响应。将同一源诱导差异送入不同未来后，Qwen 产生负、近零、正效应（种子均值 -0.658、+0.008、+0.658），该顺序在 12 个 Llama-3.2-1B 种子中经八次更新后全部重现，且状态差异范数几乎相等；延续到十六次更新时对比在每对配对种子中均增长。Full-horizon costate 预测全部 42 个 Qwen 路由均值符号与全部 21 个可解析 Llama 普通路由符号，且观测者无关传输在 Qwen、SmolLM2、Llama 间复现。
Conclusion: 摘要将次阈值特质迁移归结为两阶段机制：优化器状态负责运输源扰动，后续训练决定其行为价值。该结论在多种模型与优化器设置下得到验证。

papers.title: Shared Physics Responses Recover Hidden Rankings in Neural Operator Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Selecting the optimal neural-operator prediction during deployment is challenging when high-fidelity reference solutions are unavailable. We demonstrate that under a squared Hilbert-space loss, ranking a finite model library depends strictly on the low-dimensional span of candidate differences, allowing us to score all models simultaneously using a single anchor-based linearized response of the governing equation. This shared physical diagnostic accurately recovered over 99.6\% of pairwise preferences and 99.0\% of optimal checkpoints across diverse Fourier and convolutional operator libraries for fluid, reaction-diffusion, and wave dynamics. Furthermore, the corrected physical proxy frequently outperformed the best individual candidates, and we establish computable sufficient conditions that rigorously certify exact decisions for strongly monotone discretizations. By exploiting the local dynamical response rather than raw defect magnitude, this framework enables the reliable and highly efficient deployment of scientific surrogates without requiring ground-truth data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在缺少高保真参考解时如何为神经算子模型库选择最优预测。作者证明在平方 Hilbert 空间损失下，模型库的排名完全由候选模型差分的低维张成空间决定，因而可以用一个基于锚点的线性化物理响应同时对所有模型打分。该共享物理诊断在流体、反应扩散和波动动力学上恢复了超过 99.6% 的成对偏好和 99.0% 的最优检查点，并给出可计算的充分条件来严格保证强单调离散化下的精确决策。
Motivation: 部署神经算子（neural operator）时，若没有高保真参考解，很难选出最优模型；传统做法通常依赖原始缺陷大小，不够可靠且成本高。
Method: 利用平方 Hilbert 空间损失下排名仅依赖候选差分低维张成空间的性质，构造单个锚点基线性化的控制方程响应（shared physical diagnostic），一次性对所有候选模型评分，并给出强单调离散化下精确决策的可计算充分条件。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在流体、反应扩散和波动动力学的 Fourier 与卷积算子库上正确恢复超过 99.6% 的成对偏好和 99.0% 的最优检查点；经过校正的物理代理常优于最佳单个候选模型。
Conclusion: 本文强调利用局部动力学响应而非原始缺陷大小，可在无需真实数据的情况下可靠且高效地部署科学替代模型（scientific surrogates）。
