papers.title: Decision Tree and K-Means Analysis of Raman Spectra for Edible Oils: A Physics-Informed AI Approach
papers.abstract_en: Authentication of edible oils in processed foods is important for food quality, fraud prevention, and regulatory compliance. This study establishes an integrated Raman spectroscopy and machine-learning framework that links intrinsic spectral organization, interpretable classification, and Physics-Informed Artificial Intelligence (PI-AI). Five edible oils were investigated in pure form and within a fried-potato-chip matrix using t-SNE, K-means clustering, Decision Trees, and Non-Negative Least Squares (NNLS)-based spectral decomposition. Unsupervised analyses revealed substantially stronger class organization and separability in pure oils, whereas food-matrix effects introduced pronounced spectral overlap. Decision Trees achieved 100% classification accuracy for pure oils using only four Raman variables from the original 1866-feature spectral space. These four variables, consistently identified by both pre-pruned and post-pruned models, represented only approximately 0.21% of the available spectral information while retaining perfect test-set performance. For matrix-containing samples, NNLS-based PI-AI spectral decomposition substantially improved classification by separating oil-related signatures from paper and potato contributions. Optimized post-pruned models achieved accuracies of 86.4% and 85.4% for paper-subtracted and paper-plus-potato-subtracted datasets, respectively, while reducing the number of important Raman variables to only five and four. The compact four-feature representation further reduced the data footprint by 99.44% without loss of classification accuracy. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that accurate Raman-based oil identification can be achieved through physically meaningful, highly compact, and interpretable spectral representations, providing a promising foundation for Frugal AI, Edge AI, portable sensing, and embedded food-quality monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结合拉曼光谱与机器学习的食用油鉴别框架，以 t-SNE、K-means 聚类、决策树和基于非负最小二乘（NNLS）的谱分解来关联光谱内在结构、可解释分类与物理信息 AI（PI-AI）。在纯油和油炸薯片基质两类样本上，决策树用原始 1866 维光谱中的 4 个变量即对纯油达到 100% 测试准确率；加入基质后用 NNLS 分解分离油、纸和马铃薯贡献，后剪枝模型在两类基质处理数据上分别达到 86.4% 和 85.4% 的准确率。作者认为物理上有意义且高度紧凑的可解释光谱表示足以支撑准确、低成本的油品鉴别。
Motivation: 加工食品中的食用油真伪鉴别对食品质量、防欺诈和监管合规很重要，但食品基质带来的光谱重叠使分类变得困难，需要既准确又可解释且数据足迹小的机器学习方案。
Method: 构建集成框架，对五种食用油（纯油与薯片基质中）使用 t-SNE 和 K-means 做无监督组织分析，用决策树做可解释分类，并用 NNLS 进行物理信息引导的光谱分解，以将油类信号与纸、马铃薯等基质贡献分离。
Result: 纯油样本上决策树仅用原始 1866 特征中的 4 个拉曼变量即获 100% 分类准确率，这 4 个变量约占全部光谱信息的 0.21%，且在前剪枝与后剪枝模型中一致；基质样本上优化后的后剪枝模型在扣除纸和扣除纸与马铃薯的数据集上分别达 86.4% 和 85.4% 准确率，重要变量分别缩减到 5 个和 4 个，四特征表示使数据占用减少 99.44% 且不损失准确率。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，准确、紧凑且可解释的拉曼光谱表示可支持食用油识别，并为 Frugal AI、Edge AI、便携式传感和嵌入式食品质量监测提供基础；其范围限于五种食用油和薯片基质场景。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一个结合拉曼光谱与机器学习的食用油鉴别框架，以 t-SNE、K-means 聚类、决策树和基于非负最小二乘（NNLS）的谱分解来关联光谱内在结构、可解释分类与物理信息 AI（PI-AI）。在纯油和油炸薯片基质两类样本上，决策树用原始 1866 维光谱中的 4 个变量即对纯油达到 100% 测试准确率；加入基质后用 NNLS 分解分离油、纸和马铃薯贡献，后剪枝模型在两类基质处理数据上分别达到 86.4% 和 85.4% 的准确率。作者认为物理上有意义且高度紧凑的可解释光谱表示足以支撑准确、低成本的油品鉴别。
summary_sections.motivation: 加工食品中的食用油真伪鉴别对食品质量、防欺诈和监管合规很重要，但食品基质带来的光谱重叠使分类变得困难，需要既准确又可解释且数据足迹小的机器学习方案。
summary_sections.method: 构建集成框架，对五种食用油（纯油与薯片基质中）使用 t-SNE 和 K-means 做无监督组织分析，用决策树做可解释分类，并用 NNLS 进行物理信息引导的光谱分解，以将油类信号与纸、马铃薯等基质贡献分离。
summary_sections.result: 纯油样本上决策树仅用原始 1866 特征中的 4 个拉曼变量即获 100% 分类准确率，这 4 个变量约占全部光谱信息的 0.21%，且在前剪枝与后剪枝模型中一致；基质样本上优化后的后剪枝模型在扣除纸和扣除纸与马铃薯的数据集上分别达 86.4% 和 85.4% 准确率，重要变量分别缩减到 5 个和 4 个，四特征表示使数据占用减少 99.44% 且不损失准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要指出，准确、紧凑且可解释的拉曼光谱表示可支持食用油识别，并为 Frugal AI、Edge AI、便携式传感和嵌入式食品质量监测提供基础；其范围限于五种食用油和薯片基质场景。

papers.title: Wrong-Physics Backdoors in Neural PDE Operators
papers.abstract_en: Neural PDE operators are increasingly trained on reusable solver archives, yet validation often relies on clean prediction error and parameter-agnostic plausibility checks. We introduce cross-parameter relinking, a data-poisoning primitive that makes a triggered input select a valid solution from the same PDE family under an incorrect physical parameter. We term this a wrong-physics backdoor: the output remains physically plausible but is wrong for the intended parameter. The attack exploits tensor-to-parameter provenance failures in multi-parameter archives by stamping the surrogate input and relinking its supervision to a cached alternate-parameter solution for the same latent sample. Across 476 attack campaigns, we evaluate Burgers, advection-diffusion, two-dimensional Navier-Stokes, and an elliptic Poisson case. Fourier Neural Operators and DeepONet provide the primary evidence, with Transformer, GRU, and LSTM models as support. FNO reaches a backdoor success rate of 1.0000 on both advection-diffusion and two-dimensional Navier-Stokes while retaining low clean relative L2 error. Clean-label, label-only, and shuffled controls show that high attack success alone is insufficient: successful attacks must move predictions toward the intended alternate-physics target while preserving bounded clean error. These results expose a structural validation gap: smoothness or generic solver-like behavior is insufficient unless the provenance of the intended physical parameter is also verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 wrong-physics backdoor，一种针对神经 PDE 算子的数据投毒攻击。核心是 cross-parameter relinking 原语：触发输入被重链接到同一 PDE 族在错误物理参数下的合法解，使输出物理上看似合理但参数错误。作者在 476 个攻击战役中评估 Burgers、对流扩散、二维 Navier-Stokes 与椭圆 Poisson 情形；FNO 在两个情形上达到 1.0000 后门成功率，同时保持较低干净相对 L2 误差。
Motivation: 现有验证常依赖干净预测误差和与参数无关的合理性检查，忽略了多参数求解器档案中 tensor-to-parameter 来源（provenance）的失败，攻击者可借此将输出链接到错误物理参数下的有效解，暴露结构性验证缺口。
Method: 提出 cross-parameter relinking 数据投毒原语：通过印记替代输入（surrogate input）并将其监督重链接到同一潜在样本对应的缓存替代参数解，使触发输入选择同族 PDE 在错误物理参数下的合法解；以 Fourier Neural Operators（FNO）和 DeepONet 为主要证据，Transformer、GRU、LSTM 为辅助模型。
Result: 摘要报告在 476 个攻击战役中，FNO 在 advection-diffusion 和二维 Navier-Stokes 上达到 1.0000 后门成功率且保持低干净相对 L2 误差；clean-label、label-only 与 shuffled 对照表明仅高攻击成功率不够，成功攻击需同时将预测移向预期替代物理目标并保持有界干净误差。
Conclusion: 平滑性或一般类求解器行为不足以验证物理参数正确性，除非同时验证预期物理参数的 provenance；否则神经 PDE 算子在多参数档案场景下存在验证盲区。

papers.title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources
papers.abstract_en: Population-level behavior in large-language-model (LLM) agents cannot be characterized by single-agent benchmarks. We introduce PV-SST, a peer-voted social-platform testbed, and report a separately frozen, preregistered matched-exposure experiment spanning four topics, four unused seeds, four open-weight model families, and three prespecified larger variants. The experiment comprises 448 trials and 112 complete model-by-topic-by-seed blocks. Relative to a topic-only control, a feed of previous-round peer posts ranked by peer-generated likes increases final-round lexical similarity in both the four-family core panel (paired mean difference +0.0082 TF-IDF cosine units, 95% block-bootstrap CI [0.0043, 0.0121], randomization p=0.000105, n=64 blocks) and the three-variant size extension (+0.0109 [0.0069, 0.0151], p=0.000001, n=48). This contrast bundles peer-post exposure with ranking and therefore does not identify a ranking-only effect. Opposite-side survival falls in the core panel (-3.9 percentage points [-6.8, -1.6], p=0.0068) but not conclusively in the larger variants (-1.0 pp [-3.1, 0.4], p=0.50). Holding adversarial impressions fixed, four distributed sources do not reliably move honest-agent stance more than one source. The preregistered distributed-minus-single contrast is positive but inconclusive in the core panel (+0.057 [-0.009, 0.125], p=0.112) and negative in the larger variants (-0.040 [-0.113, 0.035], p=0.332), failing the prespecified cross-model and cross-topic consistency criterion. Thus the robust result is lexical convergence under the tested peer-ranked feed, not general opinion capture or a general coordination advantage. The study evaluates synthetic LLM-agent populations; it does not estimate effects on people or production platforms.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Code, frozen protocol, configurations, summary tables, and data are publicly available at https://github.com/ranausmanai/synthetic-social-networks and https://huggingface.co/datasets/ranausmans/synthetic-social-networks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PV-SST，一个基于同行投票的社交平台测试床，用于研究 LLM 智能体群体层面的行为，而非单智能体基准。作者报告了一项预先冻结、预注册的匹配暴露实验，涵盖四个主题、四个未用种子、四个开放权重模型家族和三个更大变体，共 448 次试验和 112 个完整块。核心结果显示，与仅主题对照相比，前一轮同行帖子（按同行点赞排序）的推送会增加最终轮词汇相似度（TF-IDF 余弦配对均值差 +0.0082，p=0.000105），但分布式来源与单一来源相比并未可靠地改变诚实智能体的立场。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体研究多依赖单智能体基准，无法刻画群体层面的行为动态；本文旨在测试社交平台上的信息暴露如何影响智能体群体的词汇收敛与观点一致性。
Method: 引入 PV-SST 测试床，进行预注册的匹配暴露实验：对比仅主题对照与包含前一轮按同行点赞排序的帖子推送条件，并比较四个分布式来源与单一来源的影响；实验跨越多个模型家族、主题和种子。
Result: 同行排名推送显著提高最终轮词汇相似度（核心面板 +0.0082，95% CI [0.0043, 0.0121]；更大变体 +0.0109 [0.0069, 0.0151]）。反向立场存活率在核心面板下降 3.9 个百分点，但在更大变体中不显著。分布式与单一来源对比在核心面板为 +0.057（p=0.112），在更大变体中为 -0.040（p=0.332），均未通过预指定的一致性标准。
Conclusion: 稳健结论是同行排名推送导致词汇收敛，而非普遍的立场捕获或分布式来源的一般性协调优势。研究基于合成 LLM 智能体群体，不估计对真实人群或生产平台的影响。

papers.title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery
papers.abstract_en: The coordination of multi-scale tasks is an effective strategy for computational materials discovery, yet the repeated application of diverse algorithms and tools renders it challenging. We report MAESTRO, a large language model (LLM) agent system capable of executing the entire screening pipeline for metal-organic frameworks (MOFs). It processes a large body of MOF literature, links relevant publications to their crystal structures, and curates the results into a computation-ready database, which is then screened through a strategy of progressively increasing computational cost. The promising candidates identified for separation under wet flue gas conditions all originate from unrelated studies. By connecting the heterogeneous stages of computational materials discovery, the LLM-based agents of MAESTRO can operate across application domains and uncover high-performance materials that conventional screening approaches would be unlikely to consider.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告 MAESTRO，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统，用于端到端的计算材料发现，针对金属有机框架（MOFs）执行完整筛选流水线：处理大量 MOF 文献、将相关出版物关联到晶体结构、整理成计算就绪（computation-ready）数据库，并通过逐步增加计算成本的策略进行筛选。摘要称，在湿烟气条件下分离任务中识别出的候选材料均来自不相关的研究，说明该系统能跨异质阶段发现常规筛选方法不太可能考虑的高性能材料。
Motivation: 多尺度任务协调是计算材料发现的有效策略，但反复应用多种算法和工具使其颇具挑战。MAESTRO 旨在利用 LLM 智能体连接计算材料发现中异质的阶段，从而降低端到端筛选的难度。
Method: MAESTRO 是一个 LLM 智能体系统：先处理大量 MOF 文献并将相关出版物链接到其晶体结构，再整理结果形成计算就绪数据库；随后采用逐步增加计算成本的筛选策略来识别候选材料。
Result: 摘要报告，在湿烟气条件下分离任务中识别出的有前景候选材料均来自不相关的研究；这表明 MAESTRO 能发现传统筛选方法不太可能考虑的高性能材料。
Conclusion: 作者强调，通过连接计算材料发现中异质的阶段，基于 LLM 的 MAESTRO 智能体可以跨应用领域运行，并发现常规筛选方法难以覆盖的候选物。摘要未报告定量性能指标。

papers.title: ProofJudge: Tool-Grounded LLM Evaluation of Formal Proof Quality in Mathlib
papers.abstract_en: Formal proofs in Lean 4 that pass the kernel's type checker can nonetheless vary widely in quality. We introduce ProofJudge, an agentic LLM-as-judge system that scores formal proof quality along five dimensions beyond correctness: library leverage, automation fit, structural clarity, statement quality, and Mathlib conventions. We evaluate ProofJudge on a novel dataset of 218 declarations drawn from distinct Mathlib PRs. The judge agent is grounded by tool access to the commit the PR is applied to, enabling it to query the library state when scoring. A judge is considered aligned with human preferences when it rates the version of the PR Mathlib accepted above the initial version that was sent back for revision. All six judge models evaluated recover the reviewers' preference well above chance, from 80.8% to 63.5%, and two open-weight judges reach roughly 70% at a tenth of the best judge's cost. We release the judge harness, evaluation dataset, and evaluation traces as open-source artifacts to support further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProofJudge，一个基于工具访问的 agentic LLM-as-judge 系统，用于在 Lean 4 的 Mathlib 中评估形式化证明的质量。ProofJudge 在正确性之外沿五个维度打分，并在一个包含 218 个声明的数据集上评估六种 judge 模型，全部以高于随机水平（80.8% 到 63.5%）的准确率恢复审稿人偏好。作者还发布了 judge 框架、评估数据集和评估轨迹作为开源资源。
Motivation: 通过 Lean 4 kernel 类型检查的形式化证明在质量上仍可能有很大差异，而单纯的正确性无法反映证明是否充分利用库、是否符合自动化实践或是否遵循 Mathlib 约定。该工作针对如何自动化且可靠地评估形式化证明质量这一缺口。
Method: 构建 agentic LLM-as-judge 系统，从库利用率 (library leverage)、自动化契合度 (automation fit)、结构清晰度 (structural clarity)、命题质量 (statement quality) 和 Mathlib 约定五个维度给证明打分。judge 被赋予访问 PR 所基于 commit 的工具权限，可在评分时查询库状态；对齐标准是 judge 对 Mathlib 接受的 PR 版本的评分高于被退回修改的初始版本。
Result: 在 218 个取自不同 Mathlib PR 的声明构成的数据集上，六种被评估的 judge 模型恢复审稿人偏好的准确率从 80.8% 到 63.5%，均显著高于随机水平；其中两个开放权重 judge 以约为最优 judge 十分之一的成本达到约 70% 的准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为工具接地 (tool grounding) 的 LLM-as-judge 能可靠区分形式化证明的质量差异，并发布 judge harness、评估数据集与评估轨迹以支持后续研究。

summary_sections.motivation: 通过 Lean 4 kernel 类型检查的形式化证明在质量上仍可能有很大差异，而单纯的正确性无法反映证明是否充分利用库、是否符合自动化实践或是否遵循 Mathlib 约定。该工作针对如何自动化且可靠地评估形式化证明质量这一缺口。
summary_sections.method: 构建 agentic LLM-as-judge 系统，从库利用率 (library leverage)、自动化契合度 (automation fit)、结构清晰度 (structural clarity)、命题质量 (statement quality) 和 Mathlib 约定五个维度给证明打分。judge 被赋予访问 PR 所基于 commit 的工具权限，可在评分时查询库状态；对齐标准是 judge 对 Mathlib 接受的 PR 版本的评分高于被退回修改的初始版本。
summary_sections.result: 在 218 个取自不同 Mathlib PR 的声明构成的数据集上，六种被评估的 judge 模型恢复审稿人偏好的准确率从 80.8% 到 63.5%，均显著高于随机水平；其中两个开放权重 judge 以约为最优 judge 十分之一的成本达到约 70% 的准确率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为工具接地 (tool grounding) 的 LLM-as-judge 能可靠区分形式化证明的质量差异，并发布 judge harness、评估数据集与评估轨迹以支持后续研究。

papers.title: RISE: Adaptive Imagination for World Action Models
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models (WAMs) improve planning by incorporating future world evolution into action generation, yet existing methods allocate a fixed imagination budget to every scene. We propose RISE (\textbf{R}efining \textbf{I}magination through \textbf{SE}lective Rollout), a system-level adaptive imagination framework that makes sequential \textsc{Roll}/\textsc{Stop} decisions according to the expected planning benefit of continued rollout. At each step, a Latent Evaluator estimates the risk revealed by the current prefix and how much planning could improve if imagination continues, while a Rollout Gate weighs this expected benefit against additional computation cost. Since factual driving logs expose only one realized future, we further construct \textbf{CounterDrive}, a counterfactual dataset with diverse outcomes and risk levels, to enrich future dynamics and provide localized risk supervision. Each retained sample undergoes expert verification and annotation of trajectory validity, incident onset, and causal category, providing a reusable resource for safety-critical world-modeling research. Experiments on NAVSIM and nuScenes show that RISE achieves the best overall planning performance while reducing unnecessary rollout, with additional transfer results supporting its plug-in generality across WAM architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISE，一种用于世界动作模型 (World Action Models, WAMs) 的系统级自适应想象框架，通过序列化的 Roll/Stop 决策按需分配想象预算。Latent Evaluator 评估当前前缀暴露的风险以及继续想象可能带来的规划提升，Rollout Gate 在预期收益与额外计算成本之间权衡。作者还构造了反事实数据集 CounterDrive，以提供多样化未来结果和风险监督；实验在 NAVSIM 和 nuScenes 上取得最佳整体规划性能，同时减少不必要的 rollout。
Motivation: 现有 WAM 方法对每个场景分配固定的想象预算 (imagination budget)，无法根据场景的规划收益动态调整，导致算力浪费或关键场景想象不足。
Method: 提出 RISE 框架，包含 Latent Evaluator 和 Rollout Gate：前者估计当前前缀揭示的风险及继续想象可能带来的规划改进，后者基于预期收益与额外计算成本决定继续 Roll 或停止。同时构造反事实数据集 CounterDrive，经专家验证并标注轨迹有效性、事故起始与因果类别，用于丰富未来动态并提供局部风险监督。
Result: 在 NAVSIM 和 nuScenes 上，RISE 取得最佳整体规划性能，同时减少不必要的 rollout；额外的迁移实验表明其作为即插即用模块在不同 WAM 架构上具有通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应想象预算分配能提升 WAM 规划性能并降低计算开销，且方法具有跨架构的即插即用性；CounterDrive 数据集本身可作为安全关键世界建模研究的可复用资源。

papers.title: Maximum Entropy Encoding of Energy-Weighted Spherical Moments
papers.abstract_en: We study how angular energy signals composed of non-negative Monte Carlo path samples can be compressed and reconstructed for irradiance using finite moments. Writing each sample as an energy-weighted directional feature $x = r u$, we adopt total energy, the first directional moment, and the traceless second moment as $1+3+5$ linearly additive, rotationally covariant statistics. Under a fixed Lebesgue reference measure, the maximum-entropy closure yields $p(r,u) \propto \exp(-βr g(u))$, where $g(u) = 1 - b \cdot u + u^T Q u$, whose directional probability and angular energy density are proportional to $g^{-3}$ and $g^{-4}$, respectively. When $g_{\min} > 0$ the closure is normalizable and the reconstruction is strictly positive. We further provide analytic moment matching, variance, inverse sampling, and closed-form diffuse response for the pure-dipole four-parameter subfamily, as well as the realizability domain, partition function, azimuthal algebraic integral, and LUT-oriented reconstruction form for the dipole-second-moment coaxial five-parameter subfamily. Experiments cover 981 Poly Haven HDRI 2K scenes and three Debevec probes. Five-parameter MaxEnt achieves a 78.7% per-scene win rate against stored QZH, with mean luminance RMSE reduced by 15.8%; the advantage is more pronounced in scenes with strong directionality. Both MaxEnt variants maintain zero negative irradiance across all scenes. Full second-order SH-2 yields the lowest overall error, while five-parameter MaxEnt ranks second and outperforms SH-2 in the high-directionality bucket; the coaxial subfamily shows systematic closure error on non-coaxial multi-source scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何用有限阶矩对由非负蒙特卡洛路径样本构成的角能量信号进行压缩并按辐照度重建。作者采用总能量、一阶方向矩和无迹二阶矩，即1+3+5个线性可加且旋转协变的统计量，在固定勒贝格参考测度下推导出最大熵闭包，得到 p(r,u) ∝ exp(-βr g(u)) 的形式，其中 g(u) = 1 - b·u + u^T Q u。显著结果是五参数最大熵变体在981个HDRI场景中与存储的QZH相比获得78.7%的每场景胜率，平均亮度RMSE降低15.8%，且所有场景均保持非负辐照度。
Motivation: 辐照度重建中，蒙特卡洛路径样本构成的角能量信号需要被压缩和重建，但现有方法（如球谐）可能产生负辐照度或对强方向性场景精度不足。本文希望通过保持旋转协变和正性的有限矩统计量，导出可解析处理的概率闭包。
Method: 提出用1+3+5维统计量（总能量、一阶方向矩、无迹二阶矩）描述能量加权方向特征 x = r u，并在最大熵原理下推导出指数族闭包。作者还给出了纯偶极四参数子族的解析矩匹配、方差、逆采样和闭式漫反射响应，以及偶极-二阶矩同轴五参数子族的可实现域、配分函数、方位角代数积分和面向LUT的重建形式。
Result: 实验覆盖981个Poly Haven HDRI 2K场景和三个Debevec探针。五参数MaxEnt对存储的QZH取得78.7%的每场景胜率，平均亮度RMSE降低15.8%，且优势在强方向性场景更明显；两种MaxEnt变体在所有场景均保持零负辐照度。完整二阶SH-2总体误差最低，五参数MaxEnt位列第二并在高方向性场景中优于SH-2；同轴子族在非共轴多光源场景表现出系统性闭包误差。
Conclusion: 摘要表明最大熵矩闭包能在保持严格非负辐照度的同时实现高精度重建，尤其适合强方向性场景；同轴子族的系统性闭包误差提示其适用范围的限制。

papers.title: FM-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Management with Competing Agents
papers.abstract_en: Language model agents now execute bounded tasks reliably. Whether they can sustain effective decision-making over long horizons, where actions have cumulative consequences and the environment responds to their choices, remains largely unmeasured. FM-Bench (Football Management Benchmark) measures this. An LLM agent runs a football club for 20 in-game years through 26 tools and roughly 340 to 400 decision stops. It drafts a squad on the same budget as every rival, trades players, negotiates contracts, invests in facilities and youth, sets lineups, and answers to a board that can fire it, while a deterministic engine accumulates every year into one final score with no LLM judge or human rater. The solo track plays each of 15 frontier models against a frozen scripted world, and the Arena places the same models plus a scripted anchor in one shared 20-year world; to our knowledge, the first head-to-head evaluation at this scale. We measure six behavioral capabilities behind the score. Across three seeds, all 15 models complete every horizon while the blind scripted baselines die out in most of theirs, and claude-fable-5 tops the solo board on mean score and the Arena, where the title nonetheless rotates among ten models. Neither scale, price, nor vendor predicts the order; the order settles only late in the horizon, and the best first-play human lands only at the bottom of the model board. What separates the models is managerial behavior rather than computation. Higher-scoring models reduce slow-payoff investment near the end, keep cash invested rather than idle, and open renewals well before the deadline, while token spend predicts nothing. No model learns the market's hidden prices from hundreds of rejected bids, and self-managed memory fails in two opposite modes: an archive that only grows or a plan rewritten every season. Code is available at https://github.com/Analogy-AI/fm-bench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FM-Bench 是一个面向长周期管理决策的基准，让 LLM 智能体通过 26 个工具和约 340–400 个决策节点经营一家足球俱乐部 20 个赛季，并由确定性引擎逐年累积为最终分数，无需 LLM 评判或人工打分。摘要报告 15 个前沿模型在三个随机种子下都完成了整个时间跨度，而以盲脚本为基线的智能体大多中途失败；claude-fable-5 在 solo 赛道和 Arena 共享世界中均排名第一，但冠军在十个模型间轮换。论文发现模型间的差异来自管理行为而非算力：高分模型在赛季末期减少慢回报投资、保持现金投入并提前开启续约，而 token 花费无法预测成绩，也没有模型能从数百次被拒的出价中学会市场的隐藏价格。
Motivation: 语言模型智能体在受限任务上已表现可靠，但在动作具有累积后果且环境会响应的长周期决策中能否维持有效决策，仍缺乏系统测量；FM-Bench 正是针对这一空白而设计。
Method: FM-Bench 采用确定性足球管理引擎，智能体负责选秀、交易、谈判、投资设施与青训、排兵布阵并面对可能解雇它的董事会；每赛季结果由引擎累计成单一最终分数。实验包含两条赛道：solo 赛道让 15 个前沿模型分别面对冻结的脚本化世界，Arena 则将相同模型与一个脚本锚点放入共享的 20 年世界，构成作者所称首个该规模的头对头评估；同时测量分数背后的六种行为能力。
Result: 三个随机种子下 15 个模型均完成全部时间跨度，而盲脚本基线在大多数场景中失败；claude-fable-5 在 solo 平均分与 Arena 中均居首，但冠军在十个模型间轮换。规模、价格或厂商都无法预测排名，排名到时间轴后期才稳定，最佳的人类首次玩家也只落在模型排行榜底部。高分模型在赛季末期减少慢回报投资、保持现金运作并提前开启续约，而 token 花费不具预测力；没有任何模型能从数百次被拒出价中学到市场隐藏价格，自管理记忆也以两种相反模式失败：只增不减的档案或每赛季重写的计划。
Conclusion: 论文强调区分模型表现的是管理行为而非计算资源，并提出一种无需 LLM 评判、可扩展的头对头长周期评估框架，用于衡量智能体在累积后果环境中的决策能力。

papers.title: The Lifecycle of LLM-as-a-Judge for Large-Scale Recommendation Explanations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-a-Judge, which leverages a large language model to evaluate natural language generated by another AI application or model, has become a standard, scalable approach for accelerating and extending costly human evaluation. However, most work treats a judge as a static artifact, evaluating it once at construction or against a fixed benchmark. In contrast, we argue that an LLM judge running in a production system is better understood as having a lifecycle: it must be built, trained, deployed, and continuously maintained as the surrounding data evolves, and each phase poses distinct technical and operational challenges. We present such a lifecycle for the LLM judges that evaluate user-facing recommendation explanations at Netflix, where our pipeline generates and the judges assess hundreds of thousands of distinct show-level explanations per week, served across the mobile experience to millions of members. Our framework has four phases: (I) Birth, defining multiple evaluation criteria and building curated benchmark datasets with human labels and rationales; (II) Training, refining the judges' rubrics via Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning (RART), a rubric-tuning procedure that uses a meta-judge over reasoning output as the learning signal; (III) Deployment, in which one judge serves two production roles: quality gating and reflective generation; and (IV) Monitoring, a continuous Human-in-the-Loop alignment process that detects drift and triggers re-tuning behind a human review gate. We report post-launch results from a five-week A/B test over tens of millions of members, in which the judge-aligned explanations shifted member viewing toward novel content (previously unwatched) and increased successful browse-to-play sessions relative to a no-explanation control, with no quality-related takedowns.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将生产环境中的 LLM-as-a-Judge 理解为一个具有生命周期、而非静态工件，并以 Netflix 评估用户可见推荐解释的裁判系统为例，给出 Birth、Training、Deployment、Monitoring 四阶段框架。摘要报告了覆盖数千万会员的五周 A/B 测试结果：裁判对齐的解释使会员观看转向此前未看过的新内容，并增加了成功的 browse-to-play 会话，且没有质量相关的下架。
Motivation: 现有工作大多把 LLM 裁判当作静态工件，只在构建时或固定基准上评估一次；而在生产系统中数据不断演化，裁判需要构建、训练、部署并持续维护，每个阶段都有不同的技术与运营挑战。
Method: 提出四阶段生命周期框架：(I) Birth，定义多个评估准则并构建带人工标签和理由的基准数据集；(II) Training，通过 Reasoning-Aligned Rubric Tuning (RART) 用元裁判 (meta-judge) 对推理输出的信号来微调裁判的评分标准；(III) Deployment，一个裁判同时承担质量门控和反思生成两个生产角色；(IV) Monitoring，以 Human-in-the-Loop 流程检测漂移并在人工审核门后触发重新调优。
Result: 在数千万会员上的五周 A/B 测试中，裁判对齐的解释相比无解释对照，将会员观看行为转向此前未观看的新内容，并提高了成功的 browse-to-play 会话，且没有质量相关的下架。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，生产系统中的 LLM 裁判应被视为一个需要持续维护的生命周期对象，其每个阶段都伴随独特的技术与运营挑战，而不是一次性构建的静态工件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automated ACL Footprint Identification Using 3D Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: One of the most common reasons for anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) reconstruction failure is femoral tunnel malpositioning (ACL footprint center and tunnel orientation). Such failures may lead to the development of meniscal pathology and osteoarthritis. Accurate ACL femoral footprint identification is therefore essential for precise tunnel placement, restoration of the native knee joint mechanics, post-surgical knee joint health and prevention of graft failure. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) bring new opportunities to improve image-guided orthopedic surgery. However, at present, existing AI research focuses primarily on ACL segmentation and rupture classification based on pre- and post-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images. Identification of the ACL footprint center using deep learning methods has not been thoroughly researched. Thus, the purpose of this study is to explore 3D deep learning models for ACL femoral footprint identification directly from 3D MR images. Two comprehensive 3D deep learning architectures were developed: a 3D graph convolutional neural network-based geometric model applied to 3D femoral meshes; and a 3D landmark-enhanced identification model based on 3D MR images. A total of 4883 right and 3087 left knee image sets were used from a publicly available database. Eighty percent (80%) were applied to model generation, and twenty percent (20%) were preserved for model testing. Both models achieved excellent performance; however, the image-based method outperformed the model-based method (average error of 2.1mm vs 2.8 mm). Thus, 3D deep learning provides a feasible clinical approach for ACL footprint localization and has the potential to improve ACL reconstruction footprint accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索用 3D 深度学习直接从三维磁共振 (MR) 图像识别前交叉韧带 (ACL) 股骨足迹中心，以辅助 ACL 重建中的隧道定位。作者开发了两种架构：基于 3D 股骨网格的图卷积神经网络 (graph convolutional neural network) 几何模型，以及基于 3D MR 图像的 landmark 增强识别模型；使用公开数据库中 4883 例右膝和 3087 例左膝图像集（80% 训练、20% 测试）进行评估。两种模型均表现良好，其中基于图像的方法平均误差 2.1mm，优于基于模型的 2.8mm。
Motivation: 股骨隧道位置不当（ACL 足迹中心与隧道方向不准确）是 ACL 重建失败的最常见原因之一，可能进而导致半月板病变和骨关节炎。现有 AI 研究主要集中于基于术前术后 MR 图像的 ACL 分割和断裂分类，而用深度学习方法直接识别 ACL 足迹中心尚未被充分研究。
Method: 提出两种 3D 深度学习架构用于 ACL 股骨足迹中心识别：一是应用于 3D 股骨网格的 3D 图卷积神经网络几何模型；二是基于 3D MR 图像的 landmark 增强识别模型。两者均直接面向 3D MR 数据。
Result: 在公开数据库的 4883 例右膝和 3087 例左膝图像集上，80% 用于模型生成、20% 用于测试。两种模型均取得优秀性能；其中基于图像的方法平均误差为 2.1mm，优于基于模型的方法的 2.8mm。
Conclusion: 作者认为 3D 深度学习为 ACL 足迹定位提供了一种可行的临床途径，并有潜力提高 ACL 重建中的足迹精度。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: KernelArc: A Multi-Agent Framework for GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We present KernelArc, a multi-agent framework for autonomous GPU kernel optimization across heterogeneous workloads. Strategy-specialized agents run in parallel and coordinate through conclusions-only shared memory, a deterministic benchmark guard, and read-only cross-agent state with plateau-triggered drafting. We evaluate KernelArc on NVIDIA H100 and B200 GPUs using category-representative SOL-ExecBench workloads. The resulting implementations span custom BF16 GEMM, static cuBLASLt Expert-API configuration tables, fused mixture-of-experts backward, shape-gated decoder-layer fusion, native NVFP4 grouped-query attention, and paged prefill attention. In the public SOL-ExecBench leaderboard snapshot recorded on August~20, 2026, KernelArc ranked first on every representative L1, L2, Quantization, and FlashInfer task evaluated. The trajectories support the paper's central motivation: shared multi-agent search can broaden exploration and reach stronger incumbents within a fixed candidate budget, while the value of individual coordination features depends on the kernel and optimization stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KernelArc，一个用于异构负载下 GPU 内核自动优化的多智能体框架。策略专化的智能体并行运行，通过仅结论共享内存、确定性基准守护与只读跨智能体状态配合平台触发的 drafting 进行协调。在 NVIDIA H100 和 B200 上使用 SOL-ExecBench 的类别代表性负载进行评估，生成的实现覆盖自定义 BF16 GEMM、静态 cuBLASLt Expert-API 配置表、融合 MoE 反向、形状门控解码器层融合、原生 NVFP4 分组查询注意力与分页预填充注意力。在 2026 年 8 月 20 日的公开 SOL-ExecBench 快照中，KernelArc 在所有受评估的 L1、L2、Quantization 和 FlashInfer 代表任务上均排名第一。
Motivation: GPU 内核优化在异构工作负载下耗时且依赖专家经验，单一搜索策略难以在固定候选预算内充分探索，需要协调多个搜索智能体以拓宽探索并达到更强的 incumbent。
Method: 提出多智能体框架 KernelArc，策略专化的智能体并行搜索，通过 conclusions-only 共享内存、确定性 benchmark guard、只读跨智能体状态与 plateau-triggered drafting 进行协调，从而在固定候选预算内协作优化内核实现。
Result: 在 NVIDIA H100 和 B200 上，KernelArc 在 SOL-ExecBench 的 L1、L2、Quantization 和 FlashInfer 代表任务上均取得公开排行榜第一名；轨迹表明共享多智能体搜索能拓宽探索并增强 incumbent，而各协调特征的价值随内核与优化阶段而异。
Conclusion: 论文的核心论点是共享多智能体搜索可在固定候选预算内扩大探索并达到更强的优化结果；个别协调机制对不同内核和优化阶段的贡献并不一致，需要按具体场景评估。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GEO-Flag: Detecting and Measuring GEO-Optimized Web Content
papers.abstract_en: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) modifies web content to increase its likelihood of being selected and cited by generative search engines. This can give strategically optimized pages visibility disproportionate to their authority or relevance and even make weak or false information appear well supported. Unlike conventional search, generative search synthesizes information into direct answers rather than presenting competing sources, which can further amplify these risks, as assessing source provenance and authority requires additional user interaction. Despite these concerns, systematic methods for detecting GEO-optimized webpages remain underexplored. We introduce \texttt{GEOFlagBench}, a benchmark of 3,200 web content instances spanning 400 queries, four domains, and eight GEO optimizer families, and use it to systematically evaluate existing GEO detection methods. Although the strongest baseline achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.880, method-level and authorship-conditioned evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses and potential reliance on authorship-related shortcuts. We therefore propose \emph{Intervention-Paired Training} (IPT), which supervises detector responses to GEO interventions and non-GEO AI polishing; on ModernBERT, IPT improves F1 from 0.862 to 0.944 and worst-group accuracy from 0.725 to 0.883. We develop a GEO-gated Agent system for auditing the Source Tier and verifiability of Citation URLs in detected GEO pages. Finally, we deploy the complete pipeline on released Google Search and Gemini-grounded retrieval results for 1,000 real-user queries. Across 10,095 available pages, we estimate an overall GEO prevalence of 8.90\%, reaching 16.36\% among pages modified in 2026. Our results establish a foundation for systematically detecting, auditing, and measuring GEO in real-world search ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GEOFlagBench，一个包含 3,200 个网页内容实例、覆盖 400 个查询、四个领域和八个 GEO 优化器家族的基准，用于系统评估生成引擎优化 (GEO) 内容的检测方法。作者发现最强基线在聚合 F1 上达 0.880，但在方法级和作者条件评估中暴露明显弱点。他们进一步提出 Intervention-Paired Training (IPT)，在 ModernBERT 上将 F1 从 0.862 提升到 0.944，最差组准确率从 0.725 提升到 0.883，并部署完整流水线估计真实搜索生态中 GEO 的整体流行度约为 8.90%。
Motivation: GEO 会修改网页内容以提高被生成式搜索引擎选中和引用的概率，使低权威性或低相关性的页面获得不成比例的可见度，甚至让薄弱或虚假信息显得有据可依；而生成式搜索将信息综合成直接答案，进一步放大溯源风险。尽管存在这些担忧，系统性检测 GEO 优化网页的方法仍鲜有探索。
Method: 构建 GEOFlagBench 基准并系统评估现有 GEO 检测方法；提出 Intervention-Paired Training (IPT)，让检测器同时监督 GEO 干预与非 GEO 人工智能润色的响应；开发 GEO-gated Agent 系统用于审计检测到 GEO 页面的 Source Tier 和 Citation URL 可验证性；最后将完整流水线部署在 1,000 个真实用户查询的 Google Search 和 Gemini-grounded 检索结果上。
Result: 最强的基线达到聚合 F1 0.880，但方法级和作者条件评估显示其存在弱点并可能依赖与作者相关的捷径。IPT 在 ModernBERT 上将 F1 从 0.862 提升至 0.944，最差组准确率从 0.725 提升至 0.883。在 10,095 个可用页面中，估计 GEO 整体流行度为 8.90%，在 2026 年修改的页面中高达 16.36%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作为真实搜索生态中系统性检测、审计和测量 GEO 建立了基础，并指出现有检测方法的评估短板及 IPT 带来的显著改善。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DFM Mimir v1: An Open HRM Delivering Frontier Performance at 1B Parameters Using Only Permissible Post-Training Data
papers.abstract_en: Current large language model development relies on massive, often non-permissible datasets, creating a high barrier for researchers committed to open-source and ethically sourced data. We introduce Mimir v1, a 1-billion-parameter language model based on the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) architecture, that is trained from scratch and delivers highly competitive performance for English and sets a new state of the art for Danish using only permissible post-training data. Trained on a mixture of 161 datasets, Mimir v1 outperforms the original HRM-Text 1B and competes with larger frontier models like Qwen 3.5 4B and Gemma 4 E2B, tested across 20 benchmarks for English, Math & Code and Danish. The model is available on the Hugging Face Hub: https://huggingface.co/danish-foundation-models/DFM-Mimir
papers.comment: Technical Report, 20 Pages, 1 Model, Hierarchical Reasoning Model, v2: added memorization audits
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Mimir v1，一个基于 Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) 架构的 10 亿参数语言模型，从头训练并仅使用可许可的后训练数据（161 个数据集混合）。摘要称其在英语上表现极具竞争力，并在丹麦语上取得新的最优结果，且已开源在 Hugging Face Hub。技术报告 v2 补充了记忆审计（memorization audits）。
Motivation: 当前大语言模型开发依赖海量且常不具备许可的数据集，这对致力于开源和合伦理数据来源的研究者构成了高门槛。论文试图证明仅用可许可数据也能训练出有竞争力的模型。
Method: 基于 HRM 架构从头训练一个 10 亿参数模型，后训练阶段仅使用可许可数据，数据来源为 161 个数据集的混合。
Result: Mimir v1 在 20 个基准上超越原始 HRM-Text 1B，并能与更大的模型（如 Qwen 3.5 4B 和 Gemma 4 E2B）竞争，在丹麦语上刷新最优结果。

papers.title: Hamilton-Zero: A Neural Tensor-Network Foundation Model for Ground States of Arbitrary Quadratic Qubit Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: A central promise of useful quantum advantage is the ability to compute ground states of Hamiltonian systems beyond the reach of classical simulation methods. Here we demonstrate that this problem can be effectively amortized across an arbitrary and universal set of Hamiltonians by a foundation model with $\sim0.5$B variational parameters, trained with contemporary techniques from large language models and deep reinforcement learning. To do this, we formulate $\text{spin-}1/2$ quantum ground-state learning as manifold variational optimisation over centrally odd scalar functions on $\mathrm{SU}(2)^N$. This replaces explicit Hilbert-space vector amplitudes with manifold functions on which the Hamiltonian acts through Lie derivatives, evaluated by custom automatic differentiation primitives. We prove that the resulting variational principle on this manifold preserves the $\text{spin-}1/2$ sector's ground-state upper bound using the Peter-Weyl theorem and justify the choice of such a representation with a no-go theorem for pure state foundation NQS. We then pre-train our foundation model on a dataset of hundreds of thousands of different Hamiltonian systems, varying the connection topology, system size, interaction types and strengths, bringing together a century of many-body literature. Using a novel $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ replica-exchange Langevin sampler and sharded natural-gradient optimisation, we train our model with our own extension of the Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (KFAC) optimiser on system sizes up to 64 qubits. On a held-out generalisation dataset, we fine-tune our model on system sizes of up to 1024 qubits, and evaluate on systems up to 8100 qubits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hamilton-Zero，一个约 0.5B 变分参数的基础模型 (foundation model)，用于任意二次型量子比特哈密顿量的基态计算。作者将自旋 1/2 基态学习表述为 SU(2)^N 上中心奇标量函数的流形变分优化，哈密顿量通过李导数作用并由自定义自动微分实现。模型在数十万个不同哈密顿量系统上预训练，随后在多达 1024 量子比特的系统上微调，并在多达 8100 量子比特的系统上评估。
Motivation: 有用量子优势的核心承诺之一在于计算经典模拟方法无法企及的哈密顿系统基态；本文试图将这一问题在一组任意且普遍的哈密顿量上有效地摊销 (amortized)，使其不再需要从头逐个求解。
Method: 将 spin-1/2 量子基态学习构造为 SU(2)^N 上中心奇标量函数的流形变分优化，用李导数表示哈密顿量作用并配合自定义自动微分原语；利用 Peter-Weyl 定理证明该流形上变分原理保持 spin-1/2 扇区基态上界，并以纯态基础 NQS 的 no-go 定理论证表示选择。训练上使用约 0.5B 参数，结合大型语言模型与深度强化学习技术、SU(2) 副本交换 Langevin 采样器、分片自然梯度优化，以及作者扩展的 KFAC 优化器。
Result: 模型在系统规模不超过 64 量子比特上预训练，在保留泛化数据集上对最高 1024 量子比特系统微调，并评估至 8100 量子比特；摘要强调该方法可有效摊销跨任意通用哈密顿量集合的基态求解。
Conclusion: 摘要表明借助流形变分表示与现代训练技术，基态计算问题可在大规模哈密顿量集合上摊销，并通过预训练-微调范式推广到远大于训练规模的系统。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Inverse Theory of Mind Modeling for Content Recommendation: From Web Browsing to Dynamic Intelligent Interfaces
papers.abstract_en: Modern recommender systems treat observed actions as reliable proxies for user preferences, yet interactions often reflect exploration or comparison rather than stable preference expression. As interfaces evolve from static layouts toward generative UIs and immersive extended reality (XR), the need for deeper, modality-agnostic user understanding grows: these adaptive environments must decide not only what to present but where, when, how prominently, and most importantly why a user acts. We propose an Inverse Theory of Mind (IToM) pipeline that reasons backward from observed interactions to infer the beliefs, preferences, and decision-making traits that explain behavior. The pipeline reconstructs each user's decision context, including what was chosen and what alternatives were available, applies LLM-driven counterfactual reasoning to produce evidence-grounded natural-language belief statements, and synthesizes these beliefs through multi-hypothesis abductive inference into a structured user persona. We evaluate on the OPeRA dataset against ground-truth personality assessments, attitudinal surveys, and interview-based personas across four tasks: next action prediction, shopping attitude alignment, Big Five personality inference, and held-out category prediction. Results show that inferred personas match or exceed ground-truth personas and that multi-hypothesis reasoning is essential for accurate personality prediction. We further demonstrate cross-modal transferability with a persona-driven spatial banking application on VisionOS.
papers.comment: Preprint for conference full paper at 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), Minneapolis, MN, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个 Inverse Theory of Mind (IToM) 管线，从观察到的用户交互反向推断其信念、偏好与决策特征，进而生成结构化用户画像 (persona)。在 OPeRA 数据集上的四项任务中，推断画像与真实画像相当或更优，并指出多假设推理对人格预测至关重要。作者还在 VisionOS 上演示了画像驱动的空间银行应用的跨模态迁移能力。
Motivation: 现代推荐系统把可观察行为当作用户偏好的可靠代理，但交互往往反映探索或比较而非稳定的偏好表达。随着界面从静态布局走向生成式 UI 和扩展现实 (XR)，系统需要更深层、跨模态的用户理解，以决定呈现什么以及用户为何行动。
Method: IToM 管线首先重建每个用户的决策上下文，包括被选项与可用替代项；然后利用 LLM 驱动的反事实推理产生有证据支撑的自然语言信念陈述；最后通过多假设溯因推理 (multi-hypothesis abductive inference) 将这些信念综合为结构化用户画像。
Result: 在 OPeRA 数据集上对照真实人格评估、态度调查和基于访谈的画像，IToM 在下一动作预测、购物态度对齐、Big Five 人格推断和保留类别预测四个任务上达到或超过真实画像；多假设推理对准确人格预测不可缺少。
Conclusion: 作者认为，随着界面朝自适应、生成式和 XR 环境演进，推荐系统需要超越表层行为的用户建模，而本文的 IToM 管线作为一种模态无关框架可支持这种深层理解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ELVAE: Evidential Learning-Based Variational Autoencoder for Uncertainty-Aware Generation
papers.abstract_en: ELVAE places an input-dependent normal--inverse-gamma (NIG) hierarchy at each VAE latent coordinate, separating location uncertainty $u_{\mathrm{epi}}=β/[ν(α-1)]$ from conditional variability $u_{\mathrm{var}}=β/(α-1)$. The marginalized latent law, however, identifies only the three quotient coordinates $(γ,α,c)$ with $c=β(1+1/ν)$; reconstruction is blind to one $(ν,β)$ fiber direction. A companion theoretical analysis shows that the complete NIG prior and forward KL select a unique prior-relative canonical representative on each fiber, so canonical inverse allocation is not a fourth independent information channel. Empirically, trained inverse evidence $1/ν$ remains the strongest sensitivity-ranking score. At $τ_{\mathrm{epi}}=1$, the three-seed mean high/low-$u_{\mathrm{epi}}$ semantic-transition ratios are 1.98 on MNIST and 1.66 on Fashion-MNIST, falling to 1.33 and 1.16 under scale-matched controls. In the 20-draw MNIST component study with equal per-anchor perturbation energy, $1/ν$ gives high/low ratios 1.69 and 1.65 under the $u_{\mathrm{epi}}$ and $u_{\mathrm{var}}$ fields and 1.69 (95\% interval 1.45--1.97) under a geometry-free isotropic field, whereas $u_{\mathrm{var}}$ reverses the isotropic ordering to 0.76. Under the experimental prior, canonical $1/ν_{\mathrm{can}}$ is a strictly increasing transform of $T=c/[α(γ^2+2)]$ and is bounded above by $3+\sqrt{10}$. Thus ELVAE exposes a controllable sensitivity mechanism whose trained four-output realization is operationally informative, while the exact reconstruction-visible information remains three-dimensional and baseline image quality is a separate question.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Substantially revised: expanded quotient/canonical analysis, added Fashion-MNIST and energy-matched/isotropic controls, added a canonical-closure ablation, and updated the discussion and conclusions
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELVAE，在 VAE 的每个潜在坐标上叠加输入相关的正态-逆伽马 (normal-inverse-gamma, NIG) 层次，将位置不确定性 u_epi=β/[ν(α-1)] 与条件变异性 u_var=β/(α-1) 分离。理论分析表明，边缘化后的潜在分布只能识别三个商坐标 (γ,α,c)，重建对 (ν,β) 纤维方向不敏感；完整 NIG 先验与前向 KL 在每个纤维上选出唯一的先验相对规范代表，因此规范逆分配并非独立的第四信息通道。实验显示训练后的逆证据 1/ν 是最强的敏感性排序分数，在 MNIST 与 Fashion-MNIST 上高/低 u_epi 语义转换比分别为 1.98 与 1.66，且受控实验与各向同性场下结果保持稳健。
Motivation: 生成模型需要表达不确定性，但 VAE 的潜在表示中位置不确定性与条件变异性通常混在一起，难以区分哪些不可约成分真正对重建可见、哪些只是先验诱导的规范选择。本文用 NIG 层次显式分离两类不确定性，并从理论上厘清重建可见信息的真实维度。
Method: 在每个 VAE 潜在坐标上放置输入相关的 NIG 层次，定义位置不确定性 u_epi 与条件变异性 u_var；通过商坐标分析 (quotient/canonical analysis) 刻画边缘化潜在律的不可识别纤维，并用完整 NIG 先验加前向 KL 选择唯一的先验相对规范代表；实验采用三种子均值、尺度匹配控制、等每锚点扰动能量以及能量匹配/各向同性控制等设置对比敏感性排序分数。
Result: 摘要报告在 τ_epi=1 时，MNIST 与 Fashion-MNIST 上高/低 u_epi 语义转换比的三种子均值分别为 1.98 和 1.66，尺度匹配控制下降至 1.33 和 1.16；20 次抽样 MNIST 组件研究中，1/ν 在 u_epi、u_var 及各向同性字段下的高/低比约为 1.69，而 u_var 将各向同性顺序反转为 0.76；规范 1/ν_can 是 T=c/[α(γ^2+2)] 的严格递增变换且有上界 3+√10。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ELVAE 暴露了一种可控的敏感性机制，其训练后的四输出实现在操作上提供信息，但重建可见信息仍是三维的，且基线图像质量是独立问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
papers.abstract_en: Rooftop photovoltaic (PV) systems account for the vast majority of PV grid connections, yet no open, comprehensive, installation-level dataset of these systems exists: public registries aggregate data only above a capacity threshold, and remote sensing-based detection efforts, while extensive, are typically confined to a single method, a limited geographic scope, or a single point in time. We introduce OpenPVMapper, a nationwide, multi-source database of rooftop PV installations in mainland France, built by aggregating and reconciling complementary sources: a deep learning-based detection pipeline deployed on nationwide aerial imagery, OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level detection dataset. The resulting database contains 1,135,850 installations, totaling approximately 15.01~GWp of installed capacity, each documented with its provenance, detection method, and, where available, a manual validation flag. Manual review of a stratified sample of 1,862 installations places the database's overall precision at approximately 74--75\%, with corroboration across independent sources bringing a substantial, quantified precision gain. By aggregating independent sources rather than relying on any single detection method, OpenPVMapper reaches a level of confidence beyond what any one source could provide on its own, while remaining extensible to further sources as they become available. It is released under an open (CC-BY) license alongside the full source code used to build it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 OpenPVMapper，一个覆盖法国本土的全国性屋顶光伏安装多源数据库，通过整合基于深度学习的全国航拍影像检测管道、OpenStreetMap 和建筑级概率检测数据集构建。数据库包含 1,135,850 个安装，总装机容量约 15.01 GWp，每个安装记录来源、检测方法及可用的人工验证标志；分层随机抽样的 1,862 个安装人工复核显示总体精度约 74–75%。数据库以 CC-BY 许可开放，并附带完整构建源码。
Motivation: 屋顶光伏占光伏并网的大多数，但缺少开放、全面的安装级数据集：公共注册表仅聚合超过容量阈值的数据，遥感检测工作通常局限于单一方法、有限地理范围或单一时间点。
Method: 聚合并协调互补数据源：部署在全国航拍影像上的深度学习检测管道、OpenStreetMap 以及建筑级概率检测数据集，并为每个安装记录来源、检测方法和可用的人工验证标志；通过分层抽样样本进行人工复核以评估精度。
Result: 数据库包含 1,135,850 个安装，总容量约 15.01 GWp；对 1,862 个安装的分层抽样人工复核给出约 74–75% 的总体精度，且多源相互印证带来了显著的、可量化的精度提升。

papers.title: Continual Test-Time Adaptation in Computer Vision: Methods, Benchmarks, and Future Directions
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural nets achieve remarkable performance when training and test data share the same distribution, but this assumption frequently breaks in real-world deployment, where data undergoes continual distributional shifts. Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) addresses this challenge by adapting pretrained models to non-stationary target distributions on-the-fly, without access to source data or labeled targets, while mitigating two critical failure modes: catastrophic forgetting of source knowledge and error accumulation from noisy pseudo-labels over extended time horizons. In this comprehensive survey, we formally define the CTTA problem, analyze the diverse continual domain shift patterns that characterize different evaluation protocols, and propose a hierarchical taxonomy that categorizes existing methods into three families: optimization-based strategies (entropy minimization, pseudo-labeling, parameter restoration), parameter-efficient methods (normalization layer adaptation, adaptive parameter selection), and architecture-based approaches (teacher-student frameworks, adapters, visual prompting, masked modeling). We systematically review representative methods within each category and present comparative benchmarks and experimental results across standard evaluation settings. Finally, we discuss the limitations of current approaches and highlight emerging research directions, including the adaptation of foundation models and black-box systems, thereby providing a roadmap for future research in robust continual test-time adaptation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是计算机视觉中持续测试时适应（Continual Test-Time Adaptation, CTTA）的综合性综述。作者形式化定义了CTTA问题，分析了不同评估协议下的持续域偏移模式，并提出一个分层分类法，将现有方法划分为优化策略、参数高效方法和基于架构的方法三类。文章系统回顾了各类代表性方法，呈现了标准评估设置下的比较基准与实验结果，并讨论了当前方法的局限性与未来研究方向。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在训练和测试数据同分布时表现优异，但实际部署中数据会持续发生分布偏移。CTTA 面向无法访问源数据或无标签目标数据的场景，要求模型在线适应非平稳目标分布，同时缓解两个关键失败模式：源知识的灾难性遗忘和长时间跨度上噪声伪标签导致的错误累积。
Method: 提出一个分层分类法（hierarchical taxonomy），将现有 CTTA 方法分为三类：基于优化的策略（熵最小化、伪标签、参数恢复）、参数高效方法（归一化层适应、自适应参数选择）和基于架构的方法（教师-学生框架、适配器、视觉提示、掩码建模），并在此框架下系统综述代表性方法。
Result: 摘要报告了跨标准评估设置的比较基准（comparative benchmarks）和实验结果，但未给出具体数值；主要内容是对方法类别的结构化梳理与实验对比的汇总。
Conclusion: 作者指出当前方法的局限性，并强调新兴研究方向，包括基础模型（foundation models）和黑盒系统（black-box systems）的适应，为后续稳健 CTTA 研究提供路线图。

papers.title: What a World Model Represents Is Three Questions
papers.abstract_en: World models learn task-relevant information through many routes: observation reconstruction, recurrent state, temporal filtering, and explicit task supervision. Different routes can make different variables available. The same variable can also be available through several routes at once. When it is, looking at which route would increase the training loss most if removed does not tell you which route the model actually uses. The questions are reachability, whether a training signal can identify a task-relevant direction; admission, whether that direction is recoverable from the latent; and assignment, which eligible route carries it. We test them in environments with a known set of required coordinates. A direction cannot enter the latent unless some training signal can identify it. Reconstruction, recurrence, or filtering may already recover some of those coordinates; a reward or value head then has no residual direction to admit. For what remains, how many independent predictions the target supplies is how many coordinates install: one through four independent predictions admit one through four directions, including through the value head. Reachability is not admission: a temporal second-moment coefficient can remain absent under next-token prediction when accumulating it is a fraction of a percent of that loss, and a head that predicts the coefficient restores it. Assignment is a different test. Two routes that each carry the same variable when trained alone do not swap the carrier when we reverse which is more costly to remove. A recurrent model trained on a transformer's recorded sequences shows the same pattern. Near the point where the competing route is beginning to clear the probe threshold, independent training runs disagree. What a world model represents is therefore three questions: what information is reachable, what supervision admits, and which competing route carries it.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 12 figures. Substantial rewrite of v1 (title changed). v2 Adds the reachability / admission / assignment split and the assignment experiments / the route-boundary / RSSM-transfer / stochastic-onset and reachability-versus-admission experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究世界模型（world model）中任务相关信息如何经由观测重建、循环状态、时间滤波和显式任务监督等不同路径进入隐变量。作者将问题拆为可达性（reachability）、准入（admission）和分配（assignment）三个可测试问题，并在已知所需坐标集合的环境中实验。摘要表明，同一条变量经多条路径同时可得时，移除各路径导致的训练损失增幅并不能反映模型实际使用的路径；独立预测的数量决定可安装的坐标方向数。
Motivation: 现有做法通常用‘移除某条训练路径会使损失上升多少’来判断模型实际使用哪条路径。作者指出当同一变量可通过多条路径同时获得时，该指标无法区分模型真正依赖的路径，因此需要更细的表示归因框架。
Method: 提出三个分离的问题：reachability（训练信号能否识别任务相关方向）、admission（该方向能否从隐变量中恢复）、assignment（哪条有资格的竞争路径承载该方向）。在一组已知所需坐标的环境中进行实验，涉及重建、循环、滤波、奖励/价值头，以及循环模型在 Transformer 记录序列上的迁移测试。
Result: 摘要报告：方向唯有被某种训练信号识别才能进入隐变量；重建、循环或滤波可能已恢复部分坐标，使奖励或价值头没有残余方向可准入；1到4个独立预测分别可装入1到4个方向。可达性不等于准入——时间二阶矩系数在 next-token prediction 下可保持缺失，而预测该系数的头能恢复它；assignment 是另一种测试，两条单独训练时都携带同一变量的路径，在反转移除成本后并不互换载体。接近竞争路径刚越过探针阈值时，独立训练运行的结果不一致。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，世界模型表示什么取决于三个问题：什么信息可达、什么监督可准入、哪条竞争路径承载它。实验设置依赖具有已知所需坐标集合的环境，结论在此类受控条件下得出。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
papers.abstract_en: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. On 9 out of 11 challenging real-world benchmarks, which are 5-10x longer than the most complex cases studied in prior work, AgRefactor outperforms or matches the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM-based baseline built on the same framework backbone. Further agentic performance optimization yields a 6.51x geometric mean speedup over the SoTA pragma tuning tool and a 1.20x speedup over optimized open-source designs with less than 20% extra resources. AgRefactor is fully-automated and open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgRefactor，一个基于 LLM 的多智能体工作流，用于将软件重构为 HLS（High-Level Synthesis）兼容程序。该系统包含自进化记忆系统，可跨任务积累并检索事实性与策略性知识，并集成自动化重构工具以降低计算成本。在 11 个真实世界基准中的 9 个上，AgRefactor 达到或超过现有最强自动化重构工具和基于相同框架的强 LLM 基线；进一步进行智能体性能优化后，相比 SoTA pragma 调优工具取得 6.51x 几何平均加速，相比优化后的开源设计取得 1.20x 加速且额外资源开销低于 20%。
Motivation: 将真实软件转换为可综合的 HLS 代码仍然困难，原因在于 HLS 对语言支持有限制以及软硬件编程实践之间存在鸿沟；现有自动化与 LLM 重构方法灵活性不足、扩展性差且计算成本高。
Method: AgRefactor 采用 LLM 驱动的多智能体工作流，核心是一个自进化记忆系统，用于跨任务积累和检索事实性与策略性知识；同时集成自动化重构工具，使智能体能够在 LLM 重写与高效工具化变换之间取得平衡。
Result: 在 11 个比先前工作最复杂案例长 5-10 倍的挑战性真实世界基准上，AgRefactor 在其中 9 个上超越或持平最强自动化重构工具及基于同一框架的强 LLM 基线；智能体性能优化带来相对于 SoTA pragma 调优工具 6.51x 的几何平均加速，以及相对于优化开源设计 1.20x 的加速且额外资源少于 20%。
Conclusion: AgRefactor 是完全自动化且开源的，摘要强调其通过自进化记忆与工具集成在更长、更复杂的程序上实现了鲁棒性和效率提升。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Metanym Game: An LLM Benchmark Without Ground Truth That Rises With the Models It Measures
papers.abstract_en: We present evidence that analogy is at the core of LLM intelligence. In our benchmark, LLMs compete in generating sets of analogous statements and rate each other's sets on their own understandings of factual correctness, beauty, intelligence, distinctness, length, and structural diversity. Nothing enters from outside: the only given is the game rules; every item is generated in play; the scores come from the players' ratings alone. Ground truth is replaced by the SVD of the factual rating matrix, which scores players as generators and judges at once -- to our knowledge the first eigen-equation that judges the judges for an LLM council-of-peers. For subjective criteria like beauty, judges are weighted by their rating consistency. The best generators turn out to be middling judges. GPQA Diamond -- difficult multiple-choice questions written by human experts -- could not be more different in method, yet the two benchmarks correlate at Pearson $r = 0.97$, 95% CI [0.92, 0.99]; no leakage could be found. A council of the five best issues the official ratings; its contestable seats let the benchmark scale to any number of players and rise with the models it measures -- a candidate steering signal for self-improving AI. Playing interweaves at least eight constructs of intelligence; the total scores the broad composite, the components allow reductionistic analysis. Every number recomputes from a released package at https://github.com/dnordfors/metanym-game-paper
papers.comment: 69 pages (main text + four appendices: A. Mathematical Theory and Derivations B. generation/evaluation prompts, C. council-evaluation excerpt D. Auditing the Metanym Game-GPQA correlation: No Leaks Found), 3 figures, 19 tables. Github repo with pages/figures/tables/code and data for reproducing results: https://github.com/dnordfors/metanym-game-paper
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无外部 ground truth 的 LLM 基准 Metanym Game，让模型生成类比陈述集合并互相评级，用事实评分矩阵的 SVD 替代真值，同时给生成者和评判者打分。摘要报告该基准与人类专家出题的 GPQA Diamond 高度相关（Pearson r = 0.97，95% CI [0.92, 0.99]），且未发现数据泄漏；作者认为类比处于 LLM 智能的核心，该基准可作为自我改进 AI 的候选导向信号。
Motivation: 现有基准通常依赖外部真值标注，难以随被测模型的能力增长而同步提升；作者希望构造一个完全自包含、仅由游戏规则驱动的评估方法，并借此检验类比能力是否是 LLM 智能的核心。
Method: LLM 玩家生成并互相评分各自的类比陈述集合，评分维度包括事实正确性、美感、智能性、独特性、长度和结构多样性；用事实评分矩阵的 SVD 作为 ground truth 替代，主观标准下评委按评分一致性加权。官方评分由五个最佳生成者组成的评委会给出，席位可竞争，从而支持任意数量玩家并随模型一起扩展。
Result: 摘要报告 Metanym Game 与 GPQA Diamond 的 Pearson 相关系数为 0.97（95% CI [0.92, 0.99]），且审计未发现泄漏；同时发现最佳生成者只是中等水平的评委。

papers.title: Detecting Functional Memorization in Code Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate code at scale. Meanwhile, prior work has investigated whether training data may be recoverable from model outputs, by auditing the textual overlap between training examples and model generations. Code, however, can preserve the same logic while differing substantially in syntax and structure. We here study functional memorization: the leakage of training data logic from LLM generations in ways that textual audits fail to detect. We leverage AI coding agents to generate diverse test inputs for training data functionality and evaluate whether model-generated continuations produce the same outputs. We formalize this through a counterfactual framework, comparing target models (exposed to specific code) against reference models (not exposed) and requiring functional equivalence only for the target. We instantiate this framework across 4 open-source models and explicitly filter for functions with meaningful logic in 5 programming languages. We find that 0.3-3.4% of filtered functions are counterfactually functionally memorized, i.e., reproduced with equivalent behavior in restructured code that textual metrics fail to detect. We further show that LLM-based judges offer a scalable proxy for execution-based testing, achieving a true positive rate of 68% at 1% false positive rate, and find that functional memorization is associated with semantic duplication in the training corpus.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究代码语言模型中的功能记忆（functional memorization）：模型在生成代码时可能泄漏训练数据中的程序逻辑，即使语法和结构已重构，文本层面的重叠审计无法发现。作者提出基于AI编码智能体生成测试输入的反事实框架，在4个开源模型和5种编程语言上量化该现象，发现0.3-3.4%的过滤函数被反事实功能记忆，并验证LLM判断器可作为执行测试的近似代理。
Motivation: 现有训练数据恢复研究依赖训练样本与模型输出之间的文本重叠来审计，但代码可以在保持相同逻辑的同时大幅改变语法和结构，导致文本审计漏检逻辑层面的数据泄漏。
Method: 利用AI编码智能体为训练数据中的函数生成多样化测试输入，再比较暴露于特定代码的目标模型与未暴露的参考模型，要求仅目标模型在生成续写上满足功能等价；同时引入LLM判断器作为执行测试的可扩展替代。
Result: 在过滤后的函数中，0.3-3.4%被反事实功能记忆，即重构代码中行为等价但文本指标无法检测；LLM判断器在1%假阳性率下达到68%真阳性率，且功能记忆与训练语料中的语义重复相关。
Conclusion: 功能记忆是代码LLM中真实存在且文本审计无法捕获的泄漏形式，作者强调了新检测机制的必要性，并指出训练语料语义重复是相关因素。

papers.title: SuTRA : Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awareness
papers.abstract_en: Existing subword tokenizers optimize statistical compression but ignore morphological structure, particularly the relationship between roots and affixes. This is harmful for morphologically rich Indic languages, where basic units are complex orthographic syllables (aksharas) rather than letters. Frequency-based methods over-fragment words, arbitrarily splitting roots and affixes - a phenomenon we term Morphological Shattering. We propose SuTRA (Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awareness), a morphology-aware algorithm that preserves akshara indivisibility and penalizes merges crossing morphological boundaries. We also release a new morphological segmentation dataset for Hindi, Marathi, and Gujarati. SuTRA reduces shattering, achieving peak gains of +14.7% in morphological alignment (Boundary F1) and +34% in semantic recoverability (Hindi) over BPE. These structural gains yield an average improvement of +8.08 chrF2 in machine translation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SuTRA 是一种面向形态丰富的印度语言的形态感知分词算法，保持 akshara 音节不可分割，并对跨越词根-词缀边界的合并施加惩罚，以缓解作者所称的 Morphological Shattering 现象。作者同时发布了印地语、马拉地语和古吉拉特语的新形态切分数据集。摘要报告该方法在形态对齐、语义可恢复性和机器翻译 chrF2 上相对 BPE 有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有的子词分词器只优化统计压缩，忽略词根与词缀之间的形态结构；对以 akshara 为基本单位的印度语言而言，基于频率的方法会把词根和词缀任意切断，造成 Morphological Shattering。
Method: 提出 SuTRA，一种保留 akshara 不可分割性并在合并过程中惩罚跨形态边界操作的形态感知分词算法，并配套发布新的形态切分数据集。
Result: SuTRA 相比 BPE 在形态对齐（Boundary F1）上最高提升 +14.7%，在印地语的语义可恢复性上提升 +34%，并在机器翻译任务上平均提升 +8.08 chrF2。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结构性收益能够转化为下游机器翻译的改进，并且该工作已被 Interspeech 2026 接收。

papers.title: On Finite-sample Concentration of Median of Incomplete U-Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Median-of-means (MoM) is a powerful technique that theoretically enables near sub-Gaussian finite-sample rate for parameter estimation when the underlying data distribution is heavy-tailed (e.g., assumed to have only two first finite moments). A recent work has extrapolated this technique to median-of-\textit{randomized}-U-Statistics (MoRU) and median-of-\textit{incomplete}-U-Statistics (MoIU) for estimating expectations of heavy-tailed pairwise kernels. In \citet{pmlr-v97-clemencon19a}, a concentration rate that scales like $O(n^{-1/2})$ with sample size has been proven for MoRU. However, despite the computational advantage of the latter, the analysis of finite-sample bound for MoIU remains a significant theoretical challenge. As noted by the authors, a straightforward application of McDiarmid's inequality yields a loose bound of order $O(n^{-1/4})$. In this work, we prove a finite-sample concentration bound for the MoIU estimator that scales as $O(n^{-1/2})$ with respect to the sample size. Then, we extrapolate our results into different block sampling schemes including the regime where data pairs are selected without replacement across blocks, breaking the usual block-wise independence condition. Finally, we use similar techniques to extend our proofs to the concentration of geometric median for vector-valued kernels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究不完整 U 统计量中位数（median-of-incomplete U-statistics, MoIU）的有限样本集中界。作者证明 MoIU 估计量关于样本量的集中速率可达 O(n^{-1/2})，替代了直接应用 McDiarmid 不等式得到的 O(n^{-1/4}) 松界；并将结果推广到多种分块采样方案，包括块间无放回选择数据对的设定，以及向量值核的几何中位数情形。
Motivation: 中位数均值（median-of-means, MoM）在重尾分布下具备接近亚高斯的有限样本速率；MoRU 已被证明有 O(n^{-1/2}) 速率，而计算上更优的 MoIU 的有限样本界仍是显著理论挑战，简单使用 McDiarmid 不等式只能得到较松的 O(n^{-1/4}) 界。
Method: 作者证明了 MoIU 估计量关于样本量的 O(n^{-1/2}) 有限样本集中界；随后把证明推广到不同块采样方案，包括跨块无放回选择数据对的 regime（打破通常的块间独立性条件）；还用类似技术将证明扩展到向量值核的几何中位数（geometric median）集中性。
Result: 摘要称所证明的 MoIU 有限样本集中界为 O(n^{-1/2})，优于直接从 McDiarmid 不等式得到的 O(n^{-1/4})；该结果还覆盖无放回块采样以及向量值核几何中位数的情形。
Conclusion: 这项工作是纯理论性的，填补了 MoIU 有限样本分析的重要空白，使 MoIU 的集中速率与 MoRU 相当，并将分析扩展到更一般的采样方案与向量值设定。摘要未报告实验或具体常数限制。

papers.title: The Fast Mixing Mechanism for Differential Privacy
papers.abstract_en: Randomized sketching is a central tool for compressing large-scale optimization problems while preserving accuracy. In particular, sketches that are based on structured matrices, such as the Hadamard matrix, can be applied efficiently and often yield solutions that approximate those of the original problem at much lower computational cost. In differential privacy (DP), Gaussian sketching has been used to solve DP linear regression, beginning with \citet{sheffet2017differentially, sheffet2019old} and later refined by \citet{lev2025gaussianmix, lev2026near}. However, although these methods achieve strong utility guarantees, they usually do not improve runtime over classical DP approaches. In this work, we introduce a new DP sketching mechanism based on fast transforms, which, in certain cases, matches the runtime of classical fast sketching methods. We prove state-of-the-art privacy guarantees for this mechanism and show that, in favorable regimes, they match those of the Gaussian sketch up to a constant factor. As an application, we combine this mechanism with recent sketch-based methods for DP linear regression to obtain a new algorithm with strong utility and improved runtime. We establish privacy and accuracy guarantees for this algorithm, yielding, to the best of our knowledge, the first fast method for DP ordinary least squares.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对差分隐私（DP）中高斯sketching方法虽有强效用保证但通常不改善运行时间的问题，提出一种基于快速变换的新型DP sketching机制。作者证明该机制在有利情形下能达到与高斯sketch至多相差常数因子的隐私保证，并在某些情况下匹配经典快速sketching的运行时间。结合该机制与近期基于sketch的DP线性回归方法，作者得到首个快速DP普通最小二乘（OLS）算法，并给出隐私与精度保证。
Motivation: 现有DP线性回归中，高斯sketching能提供强效用保证，但运行时间相比经典DP方法没有优势；需要一种既能保持隐私与效用、又能提升运行效率的sketching机制。
Method: 引入基于快速变换（fast transforms）的DP sketching机制，并证明其隐私保证；随后将该机制与近期基于sketch的DP线性回归方法结合，构造新的快速DP OLS算法。
Result: 摘要报告该机制在有利情形下隐私保证与高斯sketch匹配至常数因子，且运行时间在若干情况下与经典快速sketching方法一致；得到的DP OLS算法据作者所知是首个快速方法，兼具强效用与改进的运行时间。
Conclusion: 作者强调该快速变换sketching机制为DP优化提供了隐私-运行时间更优的权衡，并具体推动了DP线性回归的实用化。

papers.title: Tetris: Tile-level Sampling for Efficient and High-Fidelity Video Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Track materialization converts raw videos into reusable object tracks that downstream queries can run against without rerunning tracking, but extracting those tracks efficiently and with high fidelity remains expensive. Prior systems reduce track materialization cost through temporal frame sampling, but aggressive sampling spaces each track's detection points too far apart to faithfully capture the object's actual trajectory. In stationary video, however, large portions of each frame contain no objects of interest, and different sampling rates can be used to extract tracks from the remaining regions. Leveraging this idea, we present Tetris, a track-extraction system that decomposes videos into a tile-based polyomino data model, enabling fine-grained spatiotemporal pruning that reduces detector calls with minimal fidelity loss. Tetris implements track materialization in three steps: first, a classifier identifies relevant tiles and groups them into polyominoes. Then, we use an integer linear program (ILP) to prune redundant polyominoes under a user-specified accuracy constraint, before packing the remaining polyominoes into canvases to minimize detector calls. Across 7 stationary-video datasets, Tetris stays within a 5% tracking accuracy loss as compared to a reference pipeline that processes every frame in its entirety, while prior systems exceed this bound on 3 of the 7 datasets. Moreover, with this 5% bound, Tetris achieves up to 17.4x higher throughput than prior systems, and up to 68.8x higher than the reference pipeline. Conversely, Tetris delivers up to 0.42 higher HOTA tracking accuracy than the best prior system at matched throughput. The project page is at https://tetris-db.github.io .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tetris，一个面向静态视频的轨道物化 (track materialization) 提取系统，将视频分解为基于瓦片的 polyomino 数据模型，从而在细粒度时空层面剪枝并减少检测器调用。系统先用分类器识别相关瓦片并聚成 polyomino，再用整数线性规划 (ILP) 在用户给定精度约束下剪除冗余 polyomino，最后将剩余 polyomino 打包成画布以最小化检测调用。在 7 个静态视频数据集上，相比逐帧全图处理的参考管线，Tetris 将跟踪精度损失控制在 5% 以内，同时吞吐量最高提升 68.8 倍。
Motivation: 从原始视频提取可复用物体轨道非常昂贵，现有系统通过时间帧采样降低成本，但激进采样会使同一轨道的检测点间隔过远，难以忠实还原目标实际轨迹。作者观察到静态视频中每帧大部分区域不含目标，因此可以用不同采样率从剩余区域提取轨道，实现更细粒度的时空剪枝。
Method: Tetris 将视频建模为瓦片级 polyomino 数据模型；首先由分类器识别相关瓦片并分组为 polyomino，然后使用整数线性规划 (ILP) 在精度约束下剪除冗余 polyomino，最后把剩余 polyomino 打包到画布中，以最小化检测器调用次数。
Result: 在 7 个静态视频数据集上，与逐帧全图处理的参考管线相比，Tetris 保持不超过 5% 的跟踪精度损失，而此前系统在 7 个数据集中的 3 个上超出该界限。在该 5% 界限下，Tetris 比此前系统吞吐量最高提升 17.4 倍，比参考管线最高提升 68.8 倍；在匹配吞吐量时，其 HOTA 跟踪精度最高比最优先前系统高 0.42。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，瓦片级采样配合 polyomino 剪枝与打包可以在静态视频中大幅降低轨道物化的检测成本，同时将保真度损失控制在用户指定的精度范围内。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Compared to What? Baselines and Metrics for Counterfactual Prompting
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual prompting (i.e., perturbing a single factor and measuring output change) is widely used to evaluate things like LLM bias and CoT faithfulness. But in this work we argue that observed effects cannot be attributed to the targeted factor without accounting for baseline "meaning-preserving" modifications to text that establish general model sensitivity. This is because every counterfactual edit is a compound treatment that bundles the variable of interest with incidental surface-form variation; this violates treatment variation irrelevance. We observe prediction flip rates on MedQA of 14.9% when we surgically change patient gender. However, this is statistically indistinguishable from the flip rates induced by simply paraphrasing inputs (14.1%). In this case, it would therefore be unwarranted to conclude that the LLM is especially sensitive to patient gender. To account for this and robustly measure the effects of targeted interventions, we propose a framework in which we compare (via statistical testing) differences observed under target interventions to those induced by paraphrasing inputs. We then use this framework to revisit a analysis done on the MedPerturb dataset, which reported evidence of model sensitivity to patient demographics and stylistic cues. We find that these effects largely dissipate when we account for general model sensitivity, with only 5 of 120 tests reaching statistical significance. Applying the same framework to occupational biography classification, we detect clearly significant directional gender bias, showing that the framework identifies real directional effects even when they are small. We evaluate a range of metrics (aggregate, per-sample distributional, and regression) and find that per-sample metrics are dramatically more powerful than aggregate metrics and regression powerfully and uniquely characterizes effect direction and magnitude.
papers.comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. 33 pages, 10 figures, 18 tables. Code: https://github.com/redagavin/counterfactual-prompting-baselines ; Python package (cfprompt): https://github.com/redagavin/cfprompt
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑反事实提示（counterfactual prompting）评估的因果归因有效性，指出每次反事实编辑都是复合处理，将目标变量与偶然的表面形式变化捆绑在一起，违反处理变量无关性（treatment variation irrelevance）。在MedQA上，手术式改变患者性别导致的预测翻转率为14.9%，与简单改写输入引起的14.1%在统计上不可区分。作者提出通过统计检验比较目标干预与改写诱导变化的框架，并用它重新审视MedPerturb数据集分析，发现120个测试中仅5个显著。在职业传记分类上，该框架检测到明确显著的方向性性别偏见，说明它能识别小而真实的方向性效应。
Motivation: 反事实提示广泛用于评估LLM偏见和CoT忠实性，但观察到的效应不能仅归因于目标因素，因为每次编辑都混入了无关的表面形式变化，必须考虑一般模型敏感性，否则容易得出无根据的敏感性结论。
Method: 提出一个评估框架：通过统计检验，将目标干预下观察到的输出差异与简单改写输入（meanking-preserving modifications）所诱导的差异进行对比，以分离真正因果效应与一般敏感性；并比较聚合、逐样本分布和回归三类指标。
Result: MedQA上改变患者性别的翻转率（14.9%）与改写输入的翻转率（14.1%）统计上不可区分；重新分析MedPerturb后，120个测试中仅5个达到统计显著；在职业传记分类上检测到显著的方向性性别偏见。逐样本指标比聚合指标更强大，回归能独特地表征效应的方向和幅度。
Conclusion: 评估反事实干预时必须引入意义保持的基线修改来校准一般模型敏感性，否则会高估对特定因素的敏感性；所提框架能稳健测量定向干预并识别真实的方向性效应。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: AutoOR: Scalably Post-training LLMs to Autoformulate Operations Research Problems
papers.abstract_en: Optimization problems are central to decision-making in manufacturing, logistics, scheduling, and other industrial settings. Translating complicated descriptions of these problems into solver-ready formulations requires specialized operations research (OR) expertise, making it hard to scale. We present AutoOR, a scalable synthetic data generation and reinforcement learning pipeline that trains LLMs to autoformulate optimization problems specified in natural language across linear, mixed-integer, and non-linear categories. AutoOR generates verified training data from standard optimization forms and uses solver execution feedback as the reward signal for RL post-training. AutoOR applied to an 8B model achieves state-of-the-art or competitive results across six established OR benchmarks, matching significantly larger frontier models. For a non-linear problem class involving physical dynamics, where frontier models score near 0%, we introduce a curriculum RL strategy that bootstraps from limited initial training data to make this class tractable for post-training. We believe that methods such as AutoOR can significantly accelerate industrial decision-making with AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoOR，一个可扩展的合成数据生成与强化学习（RL）后训练流水线，用于训练 LLM 将自然语言描述的优化问题自动转写成求解器可直接使用的公式，覆盖线性、混合整数和非线性三类问题。AutoOR 从标准优化形式生成经校验的训练数据，并以求解器执行反馈作为 RL 奖励信号；将该流程应用于 8B 模型后，在六个既有 OR 基准上达到领先或具有竞争力的结果，与显著更大的前沿模型相当。对于涉及物理动力学的非线性问题类（前沿模型得分接近 0%），作者引入课程 RL 策略，从有限的初始训练数据出发引导训练，使该类问题变得可后训练。
Motivation: 将复杂的优化问题描述转化为求解器就绪的公式需要专门的运筹学（OR）专业知识，难以规模化，制约了制造、物流、调度等工业场景中的决策效率。
Method: AutoOR 是一个可扩展的合成数据生成与 RL 后训练流水线：从标准优化形式生成经过验证的训练数据，并使用求解器执行反馈作为 RL 的奖励信号；针对涉及物理动力学的非线性问题类，提出课程 RL 策略来从有限的初始数据中引导训练。
Result: 摘要报告 AutoOR 应用于 8B 模型后在六个既有 OR 基准上取得 SOTA 或具有竞争力的结果，可匹配显著更大的前沿模型；在先前前沿模型得分接近 0% 的非线性物理动力学问题上，课程 RL 使该类问题变得可处理。
Conclusion: 作者认为 AutoOR 这类方法可以显著加速基于 AI 的工业决策制定。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ChemGraph-XANES: An Agentic Framework for XANES Simulation and Curation
papers.abstract_en: Computational X-ray absorption near-edge structure (XANES) is widely used to interpret local coordination environments, oxidation states, and electronic structure, but large computational campaigns are often limited by workflow complexity. We present ChemGraph-XANES, a large language model (LLM)-based agentic framework that combines documentation-grounded parameter retrieval via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), schema-constrained tool execution, deterministic FDMNES input generation, Parsl-backed execution, and provenance-aware data curation. Scripted and natural-language interfaces share a common scientific backend for structure handling, parameterization, execution, spectral extraction, and optional post-processing. We evaluate three workflow modes: documentation-grounded parameter propagation, structure-file-based execution, and composition-based execution from a chemistry-level request. Repeated trials yielded end-to-end completion in 10/10 composition-based runs, 10/10 structure-file-based runs, and 9/10 documentation-grounded RAG runs. In every RAG run, the energy-grid specification retrieved from the FDMNES manual was correctly propagated, with the single end-to-end failure occurring downstream during multi-structure handling. In a separate task-parallel demonstration, the framework retrieved 21 TiO$_2$ structures from the Materials Project and submitted one FDMNES calculation per structure. All calculations completed successfully, with Parsl distributing the independent tasks across the user-configured worker pool. Together, these results show that ChemGraph-XANES provides a constrained and reproducible orchestration layer for computational spectroscopy, supporting consistent execution of representative tasks, documentation-linked parameter selection, and task-parallel generation of structure-linked XANES collections.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChemGraph-XANES，一个基于大语言模型 (LLM) 的智能体框架，用于计算 X 射线吸收近边结构 (XANES) 模拟与数据策展。框架结合了基于检索增强生成 (RAG) 的文档参数检索、schema 约束的工具执行、确定性的 FDMNES 输入生成、Parsl 支持的并行执行以及带来源追踪的数据策展。评估显示组合驱动、结构文件驱动和文档 RAG 三种工作模式的端到端完成率分别为 10/10、10/10 和 9/10；任务并行演示中从 Materials Project 检索 21 个 TiO2 结构并成功提交全部单结构 FDMNES 计算。
Motivation: 计算 XANES 在解释局域配位、氧化态和电子结构方面用途广泛，但大规模计算活动常受工作流复杂度限制，缺少约束明确且可复现的编排层。
Method: 提出 LLM 智能体框架，包含 RAG 参数检索、schema 约束的工具执行、确定性 FDMNES 输入生成、Parsl 后端执行和来源感知的数据策展；脚本接口与自然语言接口共享同一科学后端，用于结构处理、参数化、执行、谱提取与可选后处理。评估了文档驱动参数传播、结构文件驱动执行和基于化学组成的执行三种工作模式。
Result: 重复试验中，组合驱动运行 10/10 完成，结构文件驱动运行 10/10 完成，文档 RAG 运行 9/10 完成；唯一失败发生在多结构处理的后续阶段，而每次 RAG 运行中从 FDMNES 手册检索的能量网格规范均正确传播。任务并行演示中框架检索 21 个 TiO2 结构并为每个结构提交一个 FDMNES 计算，全部成功完成，Parsl 将独立任务分配到用户配置的工作池。
Conclusion: 摘要认为该框架为计算光谱学提供了一个受约束且可复现的编排层，支持代表性任务的稳定执行、文档关联的参数选择，以及任务并行的、与结构关联的 XANES 数据集生成。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Automatic classification pipeline for glitches in the Virgo detector
papers.abstract_en: Glitches frequently contaminate data in gravitational-wave detectors, complicating the observation and analysis of astrophysical signals. This work introduces VIGILant, an automatic pipeline for classification and visualization of glitches in the Virgo detector. Using a curated dataset of Virgo O3b glitches, two machine learning approaches are evaluated: tree-based models (Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost) using structured Omicron parameters, and Convolutional Neural Networks (ResNet) trained on spectrogram images. While tree-based models offer higher interpretability and fast training, the ResNet34 model achieved superior performance, reaching a F1 score of 0.9772 and accuracy of 0.9833 in the testing set, with inference times of tens of milliseconds per glitch. The pipeline has been deployed for daily operation at the Virgo site since observing run O4c, providing the Virgo collaboration with an interactive dashboard to monitor glitch populations and detector behavior. This allows to identify low-confidence predictions, highlighting glitches requiring further attention.

papers.title: Topological Detection of Hopf Bifurcations via Persistent Homology: A Functional Criterion from Time Series
papers.abstract_en: We propose a topological framework for detecting Hopf-type dynamical transitions directly from scalar time series. The method combines delay-coordinate reconstruction with persistent homology and uses the maximum persistence of one-dimensional homology classes as a scalar descriptor of cyclic structure. For the supercritical Hopf setting, we derive finite-resolution persistence bounds that relate detectability of the reconstructed periodic orbit to its geometry, sampling quality, and finite-data perturbations. A derivative-based estimator is then introduced to localize the critical parameter from the sampled topological functional. The approach is evaluated on the Hopf normal form, the Lorenz system, and a reduced Belousov--Zhabotinsky model. The numerical experiments show accurate finite-resolution localization of the corresponding transitions and illustrate the effects of embedding parameters, temporal sampling, smoothing, observational noise, and transient removal. These results support persistent homology as an interpretable data-driven tool for detecting geometric reorganizations in nonlinear time series.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从标量时间序列中检测 Hopf 型动力系统转变的拓扑框架，结合延迟坐标重构 (delay-coordinate reconstruction) 与持续同调 (persistent homology)，以一维同调类的最大持续值作为循环结构的标量描述子。作者推导了超临界 Hopf 情形下有限分辨率的持续界，并引入基于导数的估计器来定位临界参数。数值实验在 Hopf 正规形、Lorenz 系统和简化 Belousov–Zhabotinsky 模型上验证了方法的准确性，并分析了嵌入参数、时间采样、平滑、观测噪声和瞬态去除的影响。
Motivation: 动力系统中的 Hopf 分岔常表现为时间序列中拓扑结构的几何重组，但现有方法难以直接从标量时序中可解释地检测这类转变，需要一种不依赖模型且能刻画循环结构出现的数据驱动判据。
Method: 方法结合延迟坐标重构与持续同调，使用一维同调类的最大持续值 (maximum persistence) 作为循环结构描述子；针对超临界 Hopf 情形推导有限分辨率下的持续界，并设计基于导数的估计器从采样得到的拓扑泛函中定位临界参数。
Result: 数值实验在 Hopf 正规形、Lorenz 系统和简化 Belousov–Zhabotinsky 模型上实现了准确的有限分辨率转变定位，并展示了嵌入参数、时间采样、平滑、观测噪声和瞬态去除等因素对检测结果的影响。
Conclusion: 作者认为持续同调可作为解释性强的数据驱动工具，用于检测非线性时间序列中的几何重组，支持其作为 Hopf 型转变检测的可行框架。

papers.title: Efficient Exploration at Scale
papers.abstract_en: We develop an online learning algorithm that dramatically improves the data efficiency of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). Our algorithm incrementally updates reward and language models as choice data is received. The reward model is fit to the choice data, while the language model is updated by a variation of reinforce, with reinforcement signals provided by the reward model. Several features enable the efficiency gains: a small affirmative nudge added to each reinforcement signal, an epistemic neural network that models reward uncertainty, and information-directed exploration. With Gemma large language models (LLMs), our algorithm matches the performance of offline RLHF trained on 200K labels using fewer than 20K labels, representing more than a 10x gain in data efficiency. Extrapolating from our results, we expect our algorithm trained on 1M labels to match offline RLHF trained on 1B labels. This represents a 1,000x gain. To our knowledge, these are the first results to demonstrate that such large improvements are possible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在线学习算法，大幅提升基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的数据效率。算法在收到选择数据（choice data）时增量更新奖励模型与语言模型：奖励模型拟合选择数据，语言模型通过一种 REINFORCE 变体并利用奖励模型提供的强化信号进行更新。关键设计包括对每个强化信号加入一个小的肯定性微扰（affirmative nudge）、用认知神经网络（epistemic neural network）建模奖励不确定性，以及信息导向探索（information-directed exploration）。使用 Gemma LLM 的实验显示，该算法以少于 20K 标签匹配离线 RLHF 在 200K 标签上的性能，数据效率提升超过 10 倍；外推结果显示训练于 1M 标签可匹配离线 RLHF 在 1B 标签上的表现，即 1000 倍增益。
Motivation: 现有 RLHF 通常需要大量人类偏好标签，数据效率低；该工作旨在显著降低达到同等性能所需的标签数量，使基于人类反馈的强化学习更适合大规模应用。
Method: 提出增量更新的在线 RLHF 算法，语言模型采用奖励信号驱动的 REINFORCE 变体训练；效率增益来自三个核心组件：附加在每个强化信号上的小的肯定性微扰、建模奖励不确定性的认知神经网络，以及信息导向探索。
Result: 基于 Gemma 大语言模型，算法用少于 20K 标签即可匹配离线 RLHF 在 200K 标签上的性能，实现超过 10 倍的数据效率提升；作者进一步外推，预计 1M 标签可匹配 1B 标签的离线 RLHF，即 1000 倍增益。
Conclusion: 摘要指出这是首批证明此类大规模数据效率改进可能性的结果，但 1000 倍增益属外推预期，且实验仅在 Gemma LLM 上验证。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Interpretability in Deep Time Series Models Demands Semantic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Deep time series models continue to improve predictive performance, yet their deployment remains limited by their black-box nature. In response, existing interpretability approaches in the field keep focusing on explaining the internal model computations, without addressing whether they align or not with how a human would reason about the studied phenomenon. Instead, we state interpretability in deep time series models should pursue semantic alignment: predictions should be expressed in terms of variables that are meaningful to the end user, mediated by spatial and temporal mechanisms that admit user-dependent constraints. In this paper, we formalize this requirement and state that, once established, semantic alignment must be preserved under temporal evolution: a constraint with no analog in static settings. Provided with this definition, we outline a blueprint for semantically aligned deep time series models, identify properties that support trust, and discuss implications for model design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度时间序列模型的可解释性应追求语义对齐 (semantic alignment)，即预测应使用对终端用户有意义的变量来表达，并受满足用户约束的时空机制调节。作者将该要求形式化，并指出语义对齐必须在时间演化下保持，这是静态设置中没有的约束。基于这一定义，论文给出了语义对齐时间序列模型的设计蓝图，并讨论了支撑信任的属性与模型设计启示。
Motivation: 深度时间序列模型预测性能持续提升，但其黑箱特性限制了部署。现有可解释性方法主要解释模型内部计算，而未考虑这些解释是否与人类对研究现象的推理方式一致。
Method: 形式化定义语义对齐要求，提出对齐必须随时间的演化而保持这一静态设置中不存在的新约束；基于该定义给出构建语义对齐时间序列模型的蓝图，并识别支撑信任的性质及模型设计启示。
Result: 本文为概念性工作，摘要未报告实验数据；核心论点是语义对齐须在时间演化下保持，并据此提出设计蓝图。
Conclusion: 作者主张可解释性研究应转向语义对齐，并强调该约束对时间序列模型设计的具体含义；摘要未明确讨论局限，但表明这是面向未来模型设计的框架性建议。
Relevance: 40
