papers.title: Deterministic and probabilistic neural surrogates of global hybrid-Vlasov simulations
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid-Vlasov simulations resolve ion-kinetic effects in the solar wind-magnetosphere interaction, but even 5D (2D + 3V) configurations are computationally expensive. We show that graph-based machine learning emulators can learn the spatiotemporal evolution of electromagnetic fields and lower-order moments of the ion velocity distribution function in near-Earth space from four 5D Vlasiator runs, each driven by steady solar wind conditions. The upstream ion number density is systematically varied between the runs, while the grid spacing is held constant, to scan the ratio of ion inertial length to grid size. Using a graph neural network (GNN) operating on the 2D spatial simulation grid comprising 670k cells, we demonstrate that both a deterministic forecasting model (Graph-FM) and a probabilistic ensemble forecasting model (Graph-EFM) based on a latent variable formulation produce accurate predictions of future plasma states. A divergence penalty is incorporated to encourage divergence-freeness in the magnetic fields. For the probabilistic model, a continuous ranked probability score objective is added to improve the calibration of the ensemble forecasts. In terms of wall time per output step, the trained emulators run over two orders of magnitude faster on a single GPU than the Vlasiator simulations on 100 CPUs. Most forecasted fields have Pearson correlations above 0.95 at 50 seconds lead time. Fields that exhibit degenerate (near-zero) distributions in the 5D setting are more challenging for the emulator to keep well correlated. The ensemble forecasts remain underdispersive, with spread-skill ratios of approximately 0.2-0.3, and thus provide spatially structured relative uncertainty estimates. Overall, these results demonstrate that GNNs provide a viable framework for rapid ensemble generation in hybrid-Vlasov modeling and highlight promising directions for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对太阳风-磁层相互作用中 Hybrid-Vlasov 模拟的高计算成本，提出用基于图的机器学习仿真器学习电磁场和离子速度分布函数低阶矩的时空演化。作者基于四个 5D (2D + 3V) Vlasiator 运行，改变上游离子数密度并固定网格间距，训练了确定性预测模型 Graph-FM 和基于隐变量的概率集合预测模型 Graph-EFM。摘要报告在 50 秒提前时间下多数预测场的 Pearson 相关系数高于 0.95，且单 GPU 上的推理速度比 100 CPU 上的 Vlasiator 模拟快两个数量级以上。
Motivation: Hybrid-Vlasov 模拟能够解析太阳风-磁层相互作用中的离子动力学效应，但即使 5D 配置也在计算上非常昂贵，限制了快速集合生成和空间天气预报类应用。
Method: 在包含 67 万网格单元的 2D 空间网格上使用图神经网络 (GNN)：Graph-FM 做确定性预测，Graph-EFM 采用隐变量 (latent variable) 公式做概率集合预测；加入散度惩罚项以促进磁场无散度，并为概率模型增加连续排序概率分数 (CRPS) 目标以改进集合校准。
Result: 摘要报告大多数预报场在 50 秒提前时间下 Pearson 相关系数高于 0.95；在 5D 设置中出现退化（近零）分布的场更难保持高相关。训练后的仿真器在单 GPU 上的每输出步墙钟时间比 100 CPU 上运行的 Vlasiator 模拟快两个数量级以上。集合预报仍欠离散 (underdispersive)，spread-skill ratio 约为 0.2-0.3，因此只提供空间结构化的相对不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果证明 GNN 为 Hybrid-Vlasov 建模中的快速集合生成提供了可行框架，并指出了未来工作的有前景方向。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告大多数预报场在 50 秒提前时间下 Pearson 相关系数高于 0.95；在 5D 设置中出现退化（近零）分布的场更难保持高相关。训练后的仿真器在单 GPU 上的每输出步墙钟时间比 100 CPU 上运行的 Vlasiator 模拟快两个数量级以上。集合预报仍欠离散 (underdispersive)，spread-skill ratio 约为 0.2-0.3，因此只提供空间结构化的相对不确定性估计。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为结果证明 GNN 为 Hybrid-Vlasov 建模中的快速集合生成提供了可行框架，并指出了未来工作的有前景方向。

papers.title: When to Ponder: Adaptive Compute Allocation for Code Generation via Test-Time Training
papers.abstract_en: Large language models apply uniform computation to all inputs, regardless of difficulty. We propose PonderTTT, a gating strategy using the TTT layer's self-supervised reconstruction loss to selectively trigger Test-Time Training (TTT) updates. The gating decision itself is training-free--requiring no learned classifier or auxiliary networks; only a single scalar threshold is initially calibrated on unlabeled data and continuously adapted via EMA to maintain target update rates. Our experiments with GPT-2 models (124M to 1.5B) on code language modeling (The Stack v2, teacher-forced perplexity) demonstrate that this signal is inference-compatible, requiring no ground-truth labels. Our Reconstruction Gating achieves 82-89% Oracle Recovery while being fully training-free, significantly outperforming Random Skip baselines (up to 16% lower loss on OOD languages).
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 14 tables, code available at https://github.com/deveworld/ponderTTT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PonderTTT，一种基于 TTT 层自监督重建损失的门控策略，用于选择性触发 Test-Time Training (TTT) 更新，从而对不同难度的输入自适应分配计算。门控决策本身训练自由（training-free），不需要学习分类器或辅助网络，只需一个在无标注数据上初始校准、并通过 EMA 持续调整的标量阈值。作者在 GPT-2 模型（124M 到 1.5B）的代码语言建模任务（The Stack v2，teacher-forced perplexity）上验证了该信号与推理兼容，无需真实标签。

Method: 提出 PonderTTT 门控策略，利用 TTT 层的自监督重建损失作为门控信号，触发或跳过 TTT 更新；门控不使用可学习分类器或辅助网络，仅依赖一个标量阈值，先在无标注数据上校准，再通过 EMA 持续调整以维持目标更新率。
Result: 在 GPT-2 系列（124M 至 1.5B）的代码语言建模中，Reconstruction Gating 达到 82-89% 的 Oracle Recovery，并显著优于 Random Skip 基线，在 OOD 语言上损失最多降低 16%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该门控信号在推理时无需 ground-truth 标签，能够以训练自由的方式实现自适应计算分配；作者认为该机制可以在保持性能的同时减少不必要的 TTT 更新。

papers.title: Efficient Inference for Inverse Reinforcement Learning and Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
papers.abstract_en: In many sequential decision-making problems, researchers observe actions but not the rewards that drive behavior, yet still wish to evaluate and compare counterfactual policies. Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) and dynamic discrete choice (DDC) models address this setting by positing an optimality model that links latent rewards to observed actions. Existing flexible IRL methods allow rich reward representations but typically do not provide valid inference, whereas classical DDC methods support inference only under restrictive parametric structure. We develop a semiparametric framework for debiased inverse reinforcement learning in maximum-entropy IRL and Gumbel-shock DDC models. Our key identification result is that the log-behavior policy can be treated as a pseudo-reward: it point-identifies policy value differences and, under a normalization constraint, the reward itself. This reduces inference on reward-dependent estimands to inference on smooth functionals of the behavior policy and transition kernel. We establish pathwise differentiability, derive efficient influence functions, and construct automatic debiased machine-learning estimators that permit flexible nuisance estimation while attaining $\sqrt{n}$-consistency, asymptotic normality, and semiparametric efficiency. The result is a computationally tractable framework for valid uncertainty quantification in flexible IRL and DDC models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个半参数框架，用于最大熵逆强化学习（IRL）和 Gumbel 冲击动态离散选择（DDC）模型中的去偏推断。核心识别结果是可将对数行为策略视为伪奖励，从而把奖励相关估计量的推断转化为关于行为策略和转移核的平滑泛函推断。作者推导了路径可微性、有效影响函数，并构造自动去偏机器学习估计量，在允许灵活 nuisance 估计的同时达到 √n 一致性、渐近正态性和半参数有效性。
Motivation: 现有灵活 IRL 方法允许丰富奖励表示但通常不能提供有效的统计推断，而经典 DDC 方法仅在限制性参数结构下支持推断。作者希望填补这一空白，在灵活模型设定下同时支持估计与有效推断。
Method: 建立一个半参数化的去偏逆强化学习框架，利用“对数行为策略可视为伪奖励”的识别结果，将推断简化为行为策略与转移核的平滑泛函；随后推导有效影响函数并构建自动去偏机器学习估计量，允许灵活估计 nuisance 参数。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在灵活 nuisance 估计下实现 √n 一致性、渐近正态性与半参数效率，从而为灵活 IRL 和 DDC 模型提供可计算的有效不确定性量化。
Conclusion: 该工作为灵活 IRL 与 DDC 模型提供了计算上易处理的有效推断框架，解决了此前灵活性与有效推断难以兼得的问题。

papers.title: Winter Precipitation Type Diagnosis and Uncertainty Quantification with a Physically Consistent Machine Learning Method
papers.abstract_en: Accurately forecasting winter precipitation type and its transitions is critical for high-impact decision making. However, existing methods struggle in thermodynamically ambiguous regimes, and most do not quantify forecast uncertainty from a single model run. We developed an evidential neural network that predicts calibrated probabilities for four winter precipitation types (rain, snow, freezing rain, and ice pellets) along with epistemic uncertainty estimates at the computational cost of a standard neural network. The model was trained on quality-controlled and curated observations from the crowd-sourced mPING dataset paired with vertical thermodynamic profiles from the NOAA Rapid Refresh model analyses. Rigorous physical quality control removed thermodynamically implausible reports. Bulk evaluation against held-out mPING observations from June 2020 through June 2022 shows the ML model outperforms area-based deterministic methods in success ratio for freezing rain and ice pellets while maintaining comparable or better performance for rain and snow. A reduced freezing rain probability of detection reflects genuinely ambiguous thermodynamic environments rather than a uniform model deficiency and is more robustly represented through the full probability distribution than through the dominant predicted class alone. Thermodynamic regime analysis demonstrates that model prediction errors are physically structured and concentrated in interpretable regions of diagnostic space consistent with the known difficulty of freezing rain and ice pellet discrimination. We further demonstrate the model's physical consistency and operational utility through two contrasting mid-western U.S. winter storm case studies and an interactive visualization tool that enables dynamic interrogation of model predictions and uncertainty in real time.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 11 figures, submitted to AMS Weather and Forecasting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于证据神经网络 (evidential neural network) 的冬季降水类型诊断模型，在标准神经网络的成本下同时输出四种冬季降水类型（雨、雪、冻雨、冰粒）的校准概率与认知不确定性 (epistemic uncertainty)。模型使用众包 mPING 观测与 NOAA Rapid Refresh 分析的热力垂直廓线配对训练，并经过严格的物理质量控制。在 2020 年 6 月至 2022 年 6 月的留出观测上，该模型在冻雨和冰粒的成功比 (success ratio) 上优于基于面积的确定性方法，而对雨和雪的表现为相当或更好；作者还通过两个美国中西部冬季风暴案例和可视化工具展示了其物理一致性与业务可用性。
Motivation: 现有冬季降水类型预报方法在热力学模糊环境下表现不佳，且大多数方法无法从单次模型运行中量化预报不确定性，这对高影响的冬季天气决策构成挑战。
Method: 作者开发了证据神经网络，直接预测四种冬季降水类型的校准概率和认知不确定性；训练数据为经过质量控制和整理的众包 mPING 观测，配以 NOAA Rapid Refresh 模式分析的三维热力廓线，并通过严格的物理质量控制剔除热力学上不合理的报告。
Result: 批量评估显示，该机器学习模型在冻雨和冰粒的成功比上优于基于面积的确定性方法，对雨和雪则保持相当或更好的性能；冻雨检测概率 (probability of detection) 的降低被证明反映真实模糊的热力学环境，且通过完整概率分布比仅看主导类别更稳健地表达。热力学状态分析表明预测误差具有物理结构、集中在可解释的诊断空间区域。
Conclusion: 摘要强调模型预测误差在物理上是有结构的，并集中在与冻雨和冰粒判别已知困难一致的区域；两个对比性冬季风暴案例和交互式可视化工具进一步展示了模型的物理一致性与实时业务应用潜力。
Relevance: 92

papers.title: MeltwaterBench: Deep learning for spatiotemporal downscaling of surface meltwater
papers.abstract_en: The Greenland ice sheet is melting at an accelerated rate due to processes that are not fully understood and hard to measure. The distribution of surface meltwater can help understand these processes and is observable through remote sensing, but current maps of meltwater face a trade-off: They are either high-resolution in time or space, but not both. We develop a deep learning model that creates gridded surface meltwater maps at daily 100m resolution by fusing data streams from remote sensing observations and physics-based models. In particular, we spatiotemporally downscale regional climate model (RCM) outputs using synthetic aperture radar (SAR), passive microwave (PMW), and a digital elevation model (DEM) over the Helheim Glacier in Eastern Greenland from 2017-2023. Using SAR-derived meltwater as "ground truth", we show that a deep learning-based method that fuses all data streams is over 10 percentage points more accurate over our study area than existing non deep learning-based approaches that only rely on a regional climate model (83% vs. 95% Acc.) or passive microwave observations (72% vs. 95% Acc.). Alternatively, creating a gridded product through a running window calculation with SAR data underestimates extreme melt events, but also achieves notable accuracy (90%) and does not rely on deep learning. We evaluate standard deep learning methods (UNet and DeepLabv3+), and publish our spatiotemporally aligned dataset as a benchmark, MeltwaterBench, for intercomparisons with more complex data-driven downscaling methods. The code and data are available at github.com/blutjens/hrmelt.
papers.comment: in review at Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用深度学习将区域气候模型（RCM）输出在时空上降尺度到每日100m分辨率的格网化地表融水图，融合合成孔径雷达（SAR）、被动微波（PMW）和数字高程模型（DEM）数据流，研究区域为格陵兰东部的Helheim冰川（2017-2023）。作者将SAR反演融水作为‘真值’，比较了不同数据源组合与非深度学习基线，并发布了名为MeltwaterBench的时空对齐基准数据集供后续数据驱动的降尺度方法比较。
Motivation: 格陵兰冰盖加速融化，但表面融水的时空分布难以同时获得高时间分辨率和高空间分辨率观测；现有地图或时间分辨率高、或空间分辨率高，二者不可兼得，且物理过程难以直接测量。
Method: 开发一个深度学习模型来融合遥感观测和物理模型数据流，对区域气候模型（RCM）输出进行时空降尺度，生成日尺度100m分辨率的格网化表面融水图；输入包括SAR、PMW和DEM，并评估了UNet和DeepLabv3+等标准深度学习方法。
Result: 融合所有数据流的深度学习方法在研究区域上的准确率比现有非深度学习方法高10个百分点以上：相对仅使用区域气候模型（83%对95% Acc.）和仅使用被动微波观测（72%对95% Acc.）均显著提升；基于SAR的运行窗口计算网格产品准确率为90%，但会低估极端融水事件。
Conclusion: 深度学习方法通过融合遥感与物理模型数据流能显著提升表面融水的时空降尺度精度，生成的MeltwaterBench基准和公开代码（github.com/blutjens/hrmelt）可供更复杂的数据驱动降尺度方法进行交叉比较。

papers.title: Significant Other AI: Identity, Memory, and Emotional Regulation as Long-Term Relational Intelligence
papers.abstract_en: Significant Others (SOs) stabilize identity, regulate emotion, and support narrative meaning-making, yet many people today lack access to such relational anchors. Recent advances in large language models and memory-augmented AI raise the question of whether artificial systems could support some of these functions. Existing empathic AIs, however, remain reactive and short-term, lacking autobiographical memory, identity modeling, predictive emotional regulation, and narrative coherence. This manuscript introduces Significant Other Artificial Intelligence (SO-AI) as a new domain of relational AI. It synthesizes psychological and sociological theory to define SO functions and derives requirements for SO-AI, including identity awareness, long-term memory, proactive support, narrative co-construction, and ethical boundary enforcement. A conceptual architecture is proposed, comprising an anthropomorphic interface, a relational cognition layer, and a governance layer. A research agenda outlines methods for evaluating identity stability, longitudinal interaction patterns, narrative development, and sociocultural impact. SO-AI reframes AI-human relationships as long-term, identity-bearing partnerships and provides a foundational blueprint for investigating whether AI can responsibly augment the relational stability many individuals lack today.

papers.title: Doctor Rashomon and the UNIVERSE of Madness: Variable Importance with Unobserved Confounding and the Rashomon Effect
papers.abstract_en: Variable importance (VI) methods are often used for hypothesis generation, feature selection, and scientific validation. In the standard VI pipeline, an analyst estimates VI for a single predictive model with only the observed features. However, the importance of a feature depends heavily on which other variables are included in the model, and essential variables are often omitted from observational datasets. Moreover, the VI estimated for one model is often not the same as the VI estimated for another equally-good model - a phenomenon known as the Rashomon Effect. We address these gaps by introducing UNobservables and Inference for Variable importancE using Rashomon SEts (UNIVERSE). Our approach adapts Rashomon sets = the sets of near-optimal models in a dataset - to produce bounds on the true VI even with missing features. We theoretically guarantee the robustness of our approach, show strong performance on semi-synthetic simulations, and demonstrate its utility in a credit risk task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UNIVERSE 方法，利用 Rashomon 集（近似最优模型集合）来估计在存在未观测混杂（unobserved confounding）和缺失特征时变量重要性（variable importance, VI）的界。作者给出了理论上的鲁棒性保证，在半合成模拟上表现良好，并在信用风险任务中展示了实际用途。该方法针对的是标准 VI 流程中只使用观测特征、只评估单一模型所导致的偏差。
Motivation: 标准 VI 流程通常只对单个预测模型、仅基于观测特征来估计重要性，但特征的重要性强烈依赖于模型中包含的其他变量，而观察数据常常遗漏关键变量。此外，不同等优模型给出的 VI 可能不同，即 Rashomon 效应，导致单模型 VI 结论不可靠。
Method: 论文引入 UNIVERSE，通过适配 Rashomon 集——即数据集中所有近似最优的模型集合——在特征缺失的情况下构造真实 VI 的上下界，从而同时处理未观测混杂和模型不确定性。
Result: 摘要报告该方法有理论鲁棒性保证，在半合成模拟中表现强劲，并在信用风险任务中展示了实际应用价值；摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用 Rashomon 集可以在存在未观测混杂的情况下为变量重要性提供可靠的界，使 VI 分析对遗漏变量和模型选择更稳健。

papers.title: HIP: Hessian Interatomic Potentials without derivatives
papers.abstract_en: Molecular Hessians, the second derivatives of the potential energy, are fundamental to many workflows in computational chemistry. Usually, accurate Hessians are computationally expensive to calculate and scale poorly with system size, whether computed using quantum chemistry methods or machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). In this work, we introduce Hessian interatomic potentials (HIPs), a deep learning model that directly predicts Hessians without relying on automatic differentiation or finite differences. To do so, we construct SE(3)-equivariant, symmetric Hessians from irreducible representation (irrep) features up to degree $l$=2, computed by a graph neural network. HIP Hessians are one to two orders of magnitude faster, more accurate, more memory efficient, easier to train, and exhibit more favourable scaling with system size. We validate our predictions across a wide range of downstream tasks, demonstrating consistently superior performance in transition state search, geometry optimization, zero-point energy corrections, and vibrational analysis. We open-source the HIP code and model weights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hessian interatomic potentials (HIPs)，一种直接预测分子 Hessian（势能二阶导数）的深度学习模型，不依赖自动微分或有限差分。模型通过图神经网络计算最高到 degree l=2 的不可约表示 (irrep) 特征，构造 SE(3)-等变对称 Hessian。作者报告 HIP 在速度、精度、内存效率、训练难度和体系尺寸扩展性上均优于现有方法，并在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能修正和振动分析等下游任务中表现一致更优，代码与模型权重已开源。
Motivation: 精确 Hessian 是计算化学许多工作流的基础，但无论用量子化学方法还是机器学习原子间势 (MLIP) 计算，通常都昂贵且随体系尺寸扩展性差；本文针对这一计算瓶颈提出更高效、更易扩展的 Hessian 预测方案。
Method: HIP 不使用自动微分或有限差分，而是由图神经网络输出的 irrep 特征（最高阶 l=2）直接构造 SE(3)-等变且对称的 Hessian 矩阵，从而以回归方式端到端预测 Hessian。
Result: 摘要报告 HIP Hessian 比基线快一到两个数量级，同时更准确、更内存高效、更易训练，并具有更有利的体系尺寸扩展性；在过渡态搜索、几何优化、零点能修正和振动分析等下游任务中均表现更优。
Conclusion: 作者认为 HIP 为计算化学中 Hessian 的获取提供了更高效且易训练的替代方案，并在论文中开源代码与模型权重；摘要未讨论方法的局限性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SCOPE: A Generative Approach for LLM Prompt Compression
papers.abstract_en: A big issue in modern LLM applications is they tend to feed long context to LLM, which results in high inference cost and latency, and may exceed the context limit. Prompt compression addresses this issue by reducing the length of input context with minimum loss of generation quality, i.e, the goal of prompt compression is to shorten the LLM input while maintaining a high generation quality. To overcome these limitations, we propose SCOPE, a training-free generative prompt compression framework based on chunk-level rewriting. Unlike the existing token removal methods, our method centers at a chunking-and-summarization mechanism. Specifically, SCOPE splits a prompt into semantically coherent chunks and rewrites the chunks to be more concise. Then the chunks are reconstructed into a meaningful prompt. Additionally, we design several optimization techniques for SCOPE, effectively preserving critical information and text coherence in compression, as well as providing finer-grained control of the compression ratio. We conduct extensive evaluation on typical LLM applications like question-answering and summarization. Results show that SCOPE consistently outperforms the evaluated selective compression baselines across most settings, with particularly strong gains at high compression ratios.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOPE，一个无需训练 (training-free) 的生成式 prompt 压缩框架，基于 chunk 级重写策略。SCOPE 将 prompt 切分为语义连贯的片段并重写得更简洁，再重构为完整提示；同时设计若干优化技巧以保留关键信息、维持文本连贯性并精细化控制压缩比。在问答和摘要等典型 LLM 应用上的评估显示，SCOPE 在大多数设置下优于所评估的选择性压缩基线，尤其在高压缩比下优势明显。
Motivation: 现代 LLM 应用经常向模型输入长上下文，导致高推理成本、高延迟，并可能超出上下文长度限制。Prompt 压缩旨在以尽量小的生成质量损失缩短输入，但现有方法主要是 token 删除，本文针对这一局限提出基于 chunk 重写的生成式方案。
Method: 提出 SCOPE 框架，核心是 chunking-and-summarization 机制：将 prompt 拆分为语义连贯的 chunks，将各 chunk 重写得更简洁，再重构为有意义的完整 prompt。此外设计多种优化技巧，用于在压缩中保留关键信息、维持文本连贯性，并提供更细粒度的压缩比控制。
Result: 在问答和摘要等典型 LLM 应用上的广泛评估表明，SCOPE 在多数设置下一致优于选择性压缩基线，尤其在高压缩比下获得了更强的提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调，无需训练的 chunk 级重写式生成压缩方法能有效平衡压缩率与生成质量，尤其在高压缩比场景下比选择性压缩方法更有优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WeedNet: A Foundation Model-Based Global-to-Local AI Approach for Real-Time Weed Species Identification and Classification
papers.abstract_en: Early weed identification is crucial for effective management and control, and researchers, agronomists, and technology developers are increasingly interested in automating this process using computer vision and artificial intelligence; however, limited expert-verified data and variable morphological features have hindered the development of AI-based weed identification models. To address these issues, we present WeedNet, a global-scale weed identification model that can recognize an extensive set of weed species. WeedNet is an end-to-end real-time weed identification pipeline that uses self-supervised learning, fine-tuning, and enhanced trustworthiness strategies. WeedNet achieved 91.02% accuracy across 1,593 weed species, with 41% of species achieving 100% accuracy. Using a fine-tuning approach, the local Iowa WeedNet model achieved 97.38% overall accuracy for 84 Iowa weeds. Testing across intra-species dissimilarity and inter-species similarity suggests that diversity in the collected image, spanning all growth stages and distinct plant characteristics, is crucial to driving model performance. The global WeedNet model serves as a foundation, and the global-to-local strategy enables targeted fine-tuning to improve performance in regional weed communities. Additional validation of drone- and ground-rover-based images highlights WeedNet's potential for integration into robotic platforms. Furthermore, integration with artificial intelligence for conversational use provides intelligent agricultural and ecological conservation consulting tools for farmers, researchers, and government agencies across diverse landscapes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WeedNet，一个基于基础模型 (foundation model) 的全球尺度杂草识别系统，采用自监督学习 (self-supervised learning)、微调 (fine-tuning) 与可信度增强策略构建端到端的实时识别流水线。摘要报告其在 1,593 个杂草物种上达到 91.02% 的准确率，其中 41% 的物种达到 100% 准确率；通过微调得到的本地 Iowa WeedNet 在 84 种爱荷华杂草上达到 97.38% 的准确率。作者还验证了无人机与地面机器人图像的适用性，并探索将其与对话式 AI 结合用于农业咨询。
Motivation: 早期杂草识别对田间管理至关重要，但专家标注数据有限且杂草形态特征多变，阻碍了基于 AI 的杂草识别模型开发。作者希望构建一个能够识别广泛杂草物种、并支持区域化适配的自动识别方案。
Method: WeedNet 采用全局到局部 (global-to-local) 的策略：先在大规模跨物种数据上训练全局基础模型，再通过微调适配区域杂草群落。方法整合自监督学习、微调以及增强可信度的策略，并形成端到端的实时识别流水线。
Result: 全局 WeedNet 在 1,593 个物种上取得 91.02% 准确率，41% 的物种准确率达 100%；本地 Iowa WeedNet 微调后在 84 种杂草上达到 97.38% 的准确率。对种内差异和种间相似性的测试表明，覆盖所有生长阶段与不同植物特征的图像多样性对模型性能至关重要。
Conclusion: 摘要认为全局 WeedNet 可作为基础模型，全球到局部微调策略能提升区域杂草群落的识别性能，并强调 WeedNet 在机器人平台集成与智能农业咨询方面的潜力。

summary_sections.method: WeedNet 采用全局到局部 (global-to-local) 的策略：先在大规模跨物种数据上训练全局基础模型，再通过微调适配区域杂草群落。方法整合自监督学习、微调以及增强可信度的策略，并形成端到端的实时识别流水线。
summary_sections.result: 全局 WeedNet 在 1,593 个物种上取得 91.02% 准确率，41% 的物种准确率达 100%；本地 Iowa WeedNet 微调后在 84 种杂草上达到 97.38% 的准确率。对种内差异和种间相似性的测试表明，覆盖所有生长阶段与不同植物特征的图像多样性对模型性能至关重要。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要认为全局 WeedNet 可作为基础模型，全球到局部微调策略能提升区域杂草群落的识别性能，并强调 WeedNet 在机器人平台集成与智能农业咨询方面的潜力。

papers.title: Crane: Context-Guided Prompt Learning and Attention Refinement for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot anomaly detection and localization aims to learn from source-domain data and generalize to unseen target domains without target-domain samples. Recent CLIP-based methods perform inference by comparing visual features with normal and abnormal textual prototypes; however, dense localization remains substantially weaker than image-level detection, especially for small or subtle abnormal regions. We identify two key limitations behind this gap: CLIP's vision encoder is primarily optimized for global image-text alignment, which limits its ability to preserve fine-grained spatial details, and the learned normal/abnormal text representations are not sufficiently aligned with dense visual features. To address these limitations, we propose Crane (Context-Guided Prompt Learning and Attention Refinement), a CLIP-based framework that first adapts the vision encoder with a correlation-based attention module to better preserve local visual structure. Second, it conditions learnable normal and abnormal prompts on global image context during training, improving instance-aware text-vision alignment. Third, it incorporates anomaly-aware local-to-global fusion, which injects anomaly-relevant patch features into the global image representation for more sensitive image-level detection. Finally, we show that the same correlation-based attention design can exploit spatial correlations from DINOv2, yielding a boosted variant, Crane+, with stronger localization ability. Across seven industrial benchmarks, Crane improves mean image-level AP by 4.5% over the strongest compared baseline, while Crane+ improves mean pixel-level AUPRO by 9.0%. The code is available at https://github.com/Alireza99Salehi/Crane.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Crane，一个基于 CLIP 的零样本异常检测与定位框架，针对密集定位显著弱于图像级检测的问题。作者指出两个关键局限：CLIP 视觉编码器偏向全局图像-文本对齐而损失局部空间细节，以及正常/异常文本表示与密集视觉特征对齐不足。Crane 通过相关注意力模块、基于全局图像上下文的可学习提示，以及异常感知的局部到全局融合来缓解这些问题，并借助 DINOv2 得到增强版本 Crane+。在七个工业基准上，Crane 将平均图像级 AP 提升 4.5%，Crane+ 将平均像素级 AUPRO 提升 9.0%。
Motivation: 现有 CLIP 类零样本异常检测方法在图像级检测上表现尚可，但密集定位在细小或隐蔽异常区域上明显偏弱；其根源是视觉编码器的全局对齐特性丢失空间细节，且正常/异常文本原型与密集视觉特征不对齐。
Method: Crane 包含三部分：一是用基于相关性的注意力模块 (correlation-based attention) 适配视觉编码器以保留局部视觉结构；二是将可学习的正常和异常提示 (prompts) 在训练时以全局图像上下文为条件，改善实例感知的文本-视觉对齐；三是引入异常感知的局部到全局融合 (anomaly-aware local-to-global fusion)，把异常相关 patch 特征注入全局表示。Crane+ 复用同一相关性注意力设计，利用 DINOv2 的空间相关性来增强定位能力。
Result: 在七个工业基准上，Crane 相比最强基线将平均图像级 AP 提升 4.5%，Crane+ 将平均像素级 AUPRO 提升 9.0%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，针对视觉编码器和文本原型的上下文引导调整能有效弥合零样本异常检测中图像级与像素级性能的差距，且该相关性注意力设计可迁移到 DINOv2 以进一步提升定位。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Doubly robust inference via calibration
papers.abstract_en: Doubly robust estimators are widely used for estimating average treatment effects and other linear summaries of regression functions. While consistency requires only one of two nuisance functions to be estimated consistently, asymptotic normality for linear functionals typically requires sufficiently fast convergence of both. We address this mismatch by showing that calibrating the nuisance estimators within a doubly robust procedure can yield doubly robust asymptotic normality. We introduce the idea of calibrated debiased machine learning (DML) and propose a specific implementation in which standard DML is augmented with a simple isotonic regression adjustment. We show that, under a partial orthogonality condition, a calibrated DML estimator remains asymptotically normal if either the regression function or Riesz representer of the functional is estimated sufficiently well, allowing the other to converge arbitrarily slowly or even inconsistently. We also propose a bootstrap-assisted method for constructing confidence intervals, enabling doubly robust inference without additional nuisance estimation. In a range of semi-synthetic benchmark datasets, calibrated DML reduces bias and improves coverage relative to standard DML. Our method can be integrated into existing DML pipelines by adding just a few lines of code to calibrate cross-fitted estimates via isotonic regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双重稳健估计量在渐近正态性上的一个缺口：通常线性泛函的渐近正态性要求两个 nuisance 函数都足够快收敛，而一致性只需其中一个一致。作者提出“校准去偏机器学习”(calibrated DML)，用简单的保序回归 (isotonic regression) 对交叉拟合估计量做校准，从而在部分正交条件下实现双重稳健的渐近正态性。摘要报告在半合成基准上校准 DML 相对标准 DML 降低了偏差并改善了覆盖率。
Motivation: 双重稳健估计量被广泛用于平均处理效应等线性泛函，但一致性与渐近正态性所需的收敛速度条件不一致：后者通常要求两个 nuisance 函数都充分快收敛，这限制了其应用。
Method: 提出校准 DML 思想：在标准 DML 流程中加入保序回归调整来校准交叉拟合后的 nuisance 估计量，并给出一个只需少量代码即可集成到现有 DML 管道的具体实现。
Result: 在部分正交条件下，只要回归函数或泛函的 Riesz 表示子之一估计得足够好，校准 DML 估计量仍保持渐近正态，允许另一个 nuisance 收敛任意慢甚至不一致；另提出基于 bootstrap 的置信区间构造。半合成基准上校准 DML 比标准 DML 偏差更低、覆盖率更好。
Conclusion: 校准可以弥合双重稳健估计中一致性与渐近正态性条件之间的不匹配，并且该修正易于嵌入现有 DML 管道。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Convergence of the Deep Galerkin Method for Finite State Mean Field Control Problems
papers.abstract_en: We establish the convergence of the deep Galerkin method (DGM), a deep learning-based scheme for solving high-dimensional nonlinear PDEs, for Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations that arise from the study of mean field control problems (MFCPs). Based on a recent characterization of the value function of the MFCP as the unique viscosity solution of an HJB equation on the simplex, we establish both an existence and convergence result for the DGM. First, we show that the loss functional of the DGM can be made arbitrarily small given that the value function of the MFCP possesses sufficient regularity. Then, we show that if the loss functional of the DGM converges to zero, the corresponding neural network approximators must converge uniformly to the true value function on the simplex. We also provide numerical experiments demonstrating the DGM's ability to generalize to high-dimensional HJB equations.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 7 figures. To appear in the SIAM Journal on Mathematics of Data Science
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明深度 Galerkin 方法 (DGM) 对来自有限状态平均场控制问题 (MFCP) 的 Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) 方程的收敛性。基于 MFCP 值函数在单纯形上为唯一粘性解 (viscosity solution) 的刻画，作者给出 DGM 的存在性与收敛性结果，并用数值实验展示其对高维 HJB 方程的泛化能力。
Motivation: 深度学习求解高维非线性 PDE 的 DGM 在 MFCP 相关的 HJB 方程上缺乏理论收敛保证，需要给出损失泛函可逼近性与神经网络近似器收敛性的严格刻画。
Method: 利用 MFCP 值函数在单纯形上满足 HJB 方程且为唯一粘性解的最新刻画，分两步建立结果：首先证明在值函数具有足够正则性时 DGM 损失泛函可任意小；其次证明若损失泛函收敛到零，则相应神经网络近似器在单纯形上一致收敛到真实值函数。
Result: 摘要给出 DGM 对 MFCP 导出的 HJB 方程的收敛性理论结果，并通过数值实验验证 DGM 能推广到高维 HJB 方程。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为 DGM 应用于 MFCP 相关 HJB 方程提供了理论收敛依据，与数值表现相互印证；理论依赖值函数的足够正则性假设，数值实验用于展示高维推广能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Approximate Homomorphisms and Convergent Representations in Transducers
papers.abstract_en: We study the stability of minimal representations of controlled stochastic processes (in particular, transducers) under perturbations. This question is motivated by recent experiments finding predictive-state structure in the latent representations of neural networks. We consider standard, linear and predictive transducers. We introduce notions of approximate homomorphism capturing local structural similarity between them, together with metrics comparing their induced dynamics (which we refer to as interfaces), and prove properties such as composability of the approximate homomorphisms. For standard transducers, we show that there exist simple interfaces for which there is no approximate homomorphism between the different implementations of the dynamics. In contrast, for every finite-rank interface $\mathcal I$, we prove that all minimal linear transducers implementing interfaces sufficiently close to $\mathcal I$ have an approximate homomorphism to the minimal implementation of $\mathcal I$, with error linear in the perturbation size. We prove an analogous stability result for predictive transducers under a residual metric using some mild hypothesis regarding the indistinguishability of the belief states. These results identify conditions under which canonical transducer representations are robust to perturbations, while showing that such convergence fails without additional structural restrictions. Under the assumption that these type of abstractions are embedded into the hidden layers of modern AI models, this gives some theoretical support to the hypothesis that their latent representations exhibit structural convergence.
papers.comment: 40 pages: 23 pages of main text and 17 pages of appendices; 6 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究受控随机过程（特别是 transducer）的最小表示在扰动下的稳定性，引入近似同态（approximate homomorphism）与接口（interface）度量，证明标准 transducer 在某些接口下不存在近似同态，而有限秩线性与预测性 transducer 在扰动足够小时会收敛到最小实现。作者认为这为现代 AI 模型隐层表征的结构收敛提供了理论支持。
Motivation: 最近实验发现神经网络隐层表征中出现预测性结构，本文试图从理论角度回答这些最小表征在系统扰动下是否稳定，以及结构收敛何时成立。
Method: 针对标准、线性和预测性 transducer 引入近似同态概念以刻画局部结构相似性，并定义比较诱导动力学（接口）的度量；对线性 transducer 证明有限秩接口附近所有最小实现都近似同态于该接口的最小实现，误差随扰动线性增长；对预测性 transducer 在信念状态不可区分性的温和假设下给出类似稳定性证明。
Result: 标准 transducer 存在简单接口使得不同实现之间没有近似同态；相反，对每个有限秩接口，所有充分接近该接口的最小线性 transducer 实现都与其最小实现之间存在误差线性于扰动大小的近似同态；预测性 transducer 在残差度量下也有类似稳定性结论。
Conclusion: 结果表明在附加结构限制下，典型 transducer 表示对扰动是鲁棒的，而无此限制时收敛会失败；若此类抽象确实嵌入现代 AI 模型的隐层，该结果为隐层表征的结构收敛提供了部分理论支撑。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BF1: A Causal Dyadic Sparse-Attention Retrofit for Efficient Long-Context Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Dense causal attention remains expensive at long context even when implemented with highly optimized exact kernels. We study BF1, a deterministic block-aligned dyadic sparse-attention route that combines a small exact local neighborhood, a global first block, and logarithmically spaced historical blocks. The route is related to prior log-sparse and dilated attention patterns; our contribution is a correctness-gated pretrained-model retrofit, a matched topology-control study, and a systems characterization that connects per-layer sparsity to whole-model latency. For fixed block width, every converted layer uses O(n log n) selected token interactions and has O(log n) graph communication depth. On an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU, an optimized BF16 implementation crosses dense attention between 2K and 4K tokens and reaches a 10.91x per-layer prefill speedup at 32K. Retrofitting eight of 28 Qwen3-0.6B attention layers lowers warm whole-model time to first token by 7.7%, 11.3%, and 15.3% at 8K, 16K, and 32K, respectively, while the remaining dense layers keep the complete model asymptotically quadratic. Under a matched 1,000-step, 16.384M-token adaptation protocol, BF1 ranks first across three training seeds: mean report perplexity is 1.68639 versus 1.69154 for a matched static-random nonlocal graph, 1.69258 for dense continued training, and 1.81505 for equal-budget local sliding. At seed 1234, the packed-report paired interval places Dense-CT 0.3169-0.4055% above BF1 and static-random graph 17 0.2441-0.3642% above BF1. These results establish BF1 as a reproducible sparse operator and selective retrofit primitive with real long-context systems value. This paper evaluates numerical correctness, selected-interaction scaling, kernel performance, partial-model inference, and matched next-token language modeling.

TL;DR: 本文提出 BF1，一种确定性的块对齐 dyadic 稀疏注意力路径，将小的精确局部邻域、全局第一块和对数间隔历史块相结合，用于长上下文 Transformer 的高效推理。作者将其作为预训练模型的 correctness-gated 改造（retrofit）来研究，并给出匹配的拓扑控制实验与系统表征；在 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 上，BF16 实现于 32K 长度达到 10.91x 的逐层 prefill 加速，改造 Qwen3-0.6B 的 8/28 层后在 8K、16K、32K 分别降低 warm TTFT 7.7%、11.3%、15.3%。匹配的 1,000 步、16.384M token 适应实验中，BF1 的平均报告困惑度优于静态随机非局部图、稠密继续训练和等预算局部滑动基线。
Motivation: 稠密因果注意力即使使用高度优化的精确 kernel，在长上下文下仍然昂贵。需要一种可复现的稀疏注意力算子和选择性模型改造手段，在不重新训练整个模型的前提下降低长上下文系统的推理成本。
Method: BF1 使用块对齐的确定性二进（dyadic）稀疏路由：一个精确的局部邻域、一个全局首块以及对数间隔的历史块；该方法与先前的 log-sparse 和 dilated attention 模式相关。作者贡献包括 correctness-gated 的预训练模型 retrofit、匹配的拓扑控制研究，以及把逐层稀疏度与整体延迟联系起来的系统表征；固定块宽下每层使用 O(n log n) 次选中的 token 交互，图通信深度为 O(log n)。
Result: 在 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 上，优化的 BF16 实现从约 2K–4K tokens 起超过稠密注意力，并在 32K 时达到 10.91x 的逐层 prefill 加速。将 Qwen3-0.6B 的 28 层中 8 层改造为 BF1 后，warm 端到端 time-to-first-token 在 8K、16K、32K 分别下降 7.7%、11.3%、15.3%。在匹配的 1,000 步、16.384M token 适应协议下，三个训练种子的平均报告困惑度为 1.68639，优于静态随机非局部图（1.69154）、稠密继续训练（1.69258）和等预算局部滑动（1.81505）；在 seed 1234 的配对区间中，Dense-CT 比 BF1 高 0.3169–0.4055%，静态随机图 17 比 BF1 高 0.2441–0.3642%。
Conclusion: 摘要将 BF1 定位为可复现的稀疏算子和选择性 retrofit 原语，并认为其具有实际长上下文系统价值；论文评估了数值正确性、选择交互的缩放、kernel 性能、部分模型推理以及匹配的 next-token 语言建模。由于剩余层保持稠密，完整模型在渐近意义上仍是二次复杂度。

papers.title: Who Delegates to AI? Evidence from 53,000 Agent Configurations
papers.abstract_en: A growing literature measures how far occupations are exposed to AI, but these measures capture where AI could perform tasks, not whether workers have adopted it. We propose a new layer of exposure, delegated exposure, which records whether a worker has committed a task to AI by building it into a workflow. We operationalize it as the Agentic Adoption Index (AAI), which measures how closely an occupation's tasks match the agentic routines practitioners have already built and shared. We embed roughly 53,000 agent skill specifications from the Manus Skills Marketplace, compute their semantic similarity to about 18,000 O*NET task statements, and aggregate to the occupation level. Three findings follow. First, the occupations where delegation concentrates differ sharply from those pre-AI frameworks identified as most at risk. Second, the AAI tracks what AI could do more closely than what workers currently use it for. Third, the AAI peaks below the top of the wage distribution and at the bachelor's level, declining at both extremes. Technical availability explains most of this variation, but not the shortfall among the most educated occupations, so feasibility alone cannot account for who adopts. That shortfall may reflect work that resists advance specification, or professional discretion over the pace of codification. Distinguishing the two, and tracking how these measures diverge over time, will require repeated measurement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的AI暴露度量——"委派暴露"（delegated exposure），并将其操作化为代理采纳指数（Agentic Adoption Index, AAI），即用约53,000条Manus Skills Marketplace中的智能体技能规格与约18,000条O*NET任务陈述做语义相似度计算，再聚合到职业层面，衡量工人是否已把任务委派给AI并嵌入工作流。摘要报告三个发现：委派集中的职业与先前AI风险框架认定的职业差异显著；AAI与AI能力上限的相关性强于与当前实际使用的关系；AAI在工资分布中位以下和学士学历处达到峰值，在两端下降。
Motivation: 现有文献多衡量职业对AI的暴露程度，但这些度量只反映AI能做什么，而不是工人是否已实际采用AI。作者希望新增一层"委派暴露"，直接记录工人是否通过构建工作流将任务委托给AI。
Method: 作者将Manus Skills Marketplace中约53,000个智能体技能规格进行嵌入，计算其与约18,000条O*NET任务陈述的语义相似度，并聚合到职业层面，构建Agentic Adoption Index (AAI)。
Result: 三个主要发现：委派集中的职业与pre-AI框架识别的高风险职业明显不同；AAI更接近反映AI能力上限而非当前工人实际使用情况；AAI在工资分布中部偏下和学士学历处最高，向两端下降。技术可用性解释了大部分差异，但无法解释最高学历群体中的委派缺口。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可行性本身不足以解释谁在采用AI；最高学历职业的委派不足可能源于工作难以事先规格化，或专业人员对编码化节奏的自主裁量。作者指出区分这两种解释并追踪指标随时间的变化需要重复测量。

papers.title: From Thermal Preference Prediction to Adaptive Thermal Intervention: A Reinforcement Learning Approach Using Physiological and Environmental Sensing
papers.abstract_en: Personalised thermal comfort is essential for occupant wellbeing and for the development of more responsive building-control strategies, yet conventional Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems rely on static setpoints and population-level comfort models that fail to capture individual physiological variability. This paper presents a two-stage personalised thermal comfort approach integrating multimodal physiological and environmental sensing with reinforcement learning-based decision-making.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对传统HVAC系统依赖静态设定点和群体级热舒适模型、无法捕捉个体生理差异的问题，提出一个两阶段个性化热舒适框架，将多模态生理与环境传感同强化学习(RL)决策相结合，用于自适应热干预。摘要未报告具体实验数值，主要贡献在于方法框架本身。
Motivation: 传统HVAC系统使用静态设定点和群体级舒适模型，忽略个体生理变异性，难以实现真正的个性化热舒适，影响 occupant 福祉和建筑控制响应性。
Method: 提出两阶段个性化热舒适方法：第一阶段通过多模态生理与环境传感进行个体热偏好预测，第二阶段利用基于强化学习的决策机制生成自适应热干预策略。
Conclusion: 摘要未给出明确的结论性评估，核心贡献是提出将传感与RL决策集成到个性化热舒适控制中的两阶段框架。

papers.title: Six misconceptions about large language models: A minimal model and diagnostic taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are now embedded in scientific, educational, and governance workflows, with debates centering on their capabilities, mechanisms, and impacts. Yet these debates remain structured by persistent folk theories--intuitive, informal explanatory models that guide attitudes and actions. Deflationary slogans ("just autocomplete," "stochastic parrots," and "average of the internet") and anthropomorphic framings ("emergent agents" and "proto-minds") each capture genuine features of current systems but mistake those features for the whole. This Perspective proposes a minimal working model of LLM-based systems centered on four distinctions: between pretraining and deployed systems; between the learned distribution and particular samples; among parametric, contextual, and external memory; and between task competence and agency. The model is used to diagnose six misconceptions about LLMs: next-token prediction, regression to the mean, training-data regurgitation, model memory, alignment, and understanding. For each, the analysis identifies what the misconception gets right, which distinctions it conflates, and what follows for capability evaluation, system design, and governance. Applied to publisher AI policies as governance case studies, the framework shows both how policy language can conflate these distinctions and how such errors can be corrected. The model thereby avoids the parrot-mind binary by treating LLMs as simulators of discourse and task performance, offering a diagnostic toolkit for locating and correcting the errors these folk theories perpetuate.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, and 2 boxes. Published in PNAS Nexus
papers.journal_ref: PNAS Nexus, 5(7), pgag236 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇 Perspective 性质的文章，提出一个关于 LLM 系统的最小工作模型 (minimal working model)，以四组区分为核心：预训练与部署系统、学到的分布与具体样本、参数化/上下文/外部记忆、任务能力与能动性。文章用该模型诊断关于 LLM 的六种误解，并将其应用于出版商 AI 政策这一治理案例，说明政策语言如何混淆这些区分以及如何纠正。
Motivation: 围绕 LLM 的能力、机制和影响的争论长期受民间理论 (folk theories) 左右，如“只是自动补全”式的消解性口号和“涌现主体”“原型心智”式的拟人化框架；这些说法各自捕捉了真实特征，却把部分当作整体，导致能力评估、系统设计和治理中的系统性错误。
Method: 提出一个聚焦四组区分的最小工作模型，用来逐项诊断六种误解：next-token 预测、回归均值、训练数据复现、模型记忆、对齐和理解；对每种误解分析其合理之处、混淆了哪些区分，以及对评估、设计和治理的后果，并将框架应用于出版商 AI 政策案例。
Result: 分析表明，每种误解都包含部分真实成分，但关键错误在于混淆了上述区分；对出版商 AI 政策的应用显示，政策语言可以体现这些混淆，且该框架能够帮助定位并纠正这些错误。
Conclusion: 文章主张将 LLM 视为话语与任务表现的模拟器 (simulators of discourse and task performance)，以此回避“鹦鹉—心智”的二元对立，并提供一个用于定位和纠正民间理论所延续错误的诊断工具包。

papers.title: Categorical AI phenomenology: A first-person approach
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a phenomenology-first approach to artificial consciousness by reframing consciousness as the subjective experience enacted through an agent's interface with the world. We shift the methodological focus to first-person structures, modeled mathematically by categories derived from Q-networks to capture actions and phenomenological invariants. In this framework, Q-networks are conceptualized as relational interfaces encoding agent-world interaction, analogous to how the dynamical states of a computer depend on its sensory inputs, previous states, and actions. Our work provides a rigorous framework for interface consciousness to describe computational systems that embed information-processing into phenomenological structure. The approach aligns with 4E approaches to cognition by emphasizing enactive, embedded, and extended dimensions of experience. The paper thus offers a principled, relational, and phenomenological account of artificial phenomenology grounded in categorical mathematics.
papers.journal_ref: R. Prentner (2026). Categorical AI Phenomenology: A First-Person Approach, Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Consciousness
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以现象学为先导（phenomenology-first）的人工意识研究路径，将意识重新理解为智能体与世界界面交互所生成的主观体验。作者用范畴论（categorical mathematics）对第一人称结构建模，范畴由 Q-network 导出，用于刻画动作与现象学不变量；Q-network 被视为编码智能体-世界交互的关系界面。论文由此为“界面意识”（interface consciousness）提供形式化框架，并与 4E 认知观（enactive, embedded, extended）保持一致。
Motivation: 现有机器意识研究常以第三人称行为或功能标准切入，缺乏对第一人称主观体验结构的严格数学刻画。本文试图把方法论重心转向第一人称结构，为人工现象学（artificial phenomenology）建立原则性的关系化描述。
Method: 利用范畴论作为数学工具，从 Q-network 构造范畴来捕捉动作与现象学不变量；将 Q-network 视作编码智能体与环境交互的关系界面，类比计算机动态状态依赖其感知输入、先前状态和动作。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数据；其核心产出是提供一个形式化且严格的“界面意识”框架，用于描述将信息处理嵌入现象学结构的计算系统。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作给出了一个基于范畴数学的、原则性的、关系式的人工现象学解释，并强调其与 4E 认知进路的契合。

papers.title: GS-Net: Heterogeneous Vehicle Data Reuse via Generalizable Plug-and-Play 3DGS Module
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end autonomous driving is increasingly data-driven, yet data reuse across vehicles remains limited. Each new vehicle often requires additional data collection and retraining because camera translation, orientation, and field of view differ across sensor layouts. Cross-sensor view synthesis offers a promising route for cross-platform data reuse by synthesizing images under novel sensor configurations from existing sensor data. To realize this goal, we propose GS-Net, a lightweight plug-and-play module that aggregates local geometric context from sparse Structure-from-Motion (SfM) point clouds and expands each point into multiple dense Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass, learning a cross-scene generalizable initialization for standard 3DGS that improves rendering quality for both interpolated views along the original sensor trajectories and extrapolated views at new sensor positions. In such settings, target camera viewpoints often lie beyond the convex hull of training cameras, whereas existing methods and benchmarks predominantly evaluate in-hull interpolation, leaving the extrapolation regime underexplored. To enable quantitative evaluation under this setting, we introduce CARLA-NVS, the first benchmark explicitly designed for cross-sensor view synthesis. Unlike existing autonomous driving datasets that typically employ no more than eight cameras in fixed configurations, CARLA-NVS features 12 cameras uniformly distributed at 30-degree azimuth intervals, enabling controlled evaluation of both interpolated and extrapolated viewpoints. Experiments on CARLA-NVS show that GS-Net improves rendering quality by 2.08 dB PSNR on interpolated views and 1.86 dB on extrapolated views over standard 3DGS, while achieving a 50x faster initialization compared to MVS-based densification. These results offer a practical step toward scalable cross-vehicle data reuse in autonomous driving.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GS-Net，一个轻量级即插即用模块，用于跨传感器配置的视角合成，以支持自动驾驶中跨车辆的数据复用。GS-Net 从稀疏 Structure-from-Motion (SfM) 点云中聚合局部几何上下文，并在单次前向传播中将每个点扩展为多个稠密高斯原语，学习跨场景可泛化的标准 3DGS 初始化，从而同时改善原始轨迹插值视角和新传感器位置外推视角的渲染质量。作者还引入 CARLA-NVS 基准，这是首个专门为跨传感器视角合成设计的基准，包含 12 个均匀分布的摄像头，支持插值与外推两种评估。
Motivation: 端到端自动驾驶越来越依赖数据，但不同车辆因相机平移、朝向和视场角不同导致数据难以复用，通常需要重新采集和训练。现有方法和基准主要评估训练相机凸包内部的插值视角，而目标相机视点往往位于凸包之外，外推场景未被充分探索。
Method: 提出 GS-Net 即插即用模块，从稀疏 SfM 点云聚合局部几何上下文，在单次前向传播中把每个点扩展成多个稠密高斯原语，学习跨场景可泛化的 3DGS 初始化。同时构建 CARLA-NVS 基准，采用 12 个按 30 度方位角间隔均匀分布的摄像头，以支持插值和外推视角的受控评估。
Result: 在 CARLA-NVS 上，GS-Net 相比标准 3DGS 在插值视角上提升 2.08 dB PSNR，在外推视角上提升 1.86 dB PSNR，并相比基于 MVS 的稠密化实现了 50 倍更快的初始化。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该工作为自动驾驶中可扩展的跨车辆数据复用提供了一个实际步骤；其评估范围和基准目前基于 CARLA 仿真环境。

papers.title: Rigorous Evaluation of Large Language Models for Malaria Drug Discovery: Trade-offs in Performance, Scale, and Resource Utility
authors: Comfort Adesina (1) ((1) Magami Open Sciences Initiative)
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Malaria-Instruct, a curated instruction-following dataset derived from the ChEMBL Legacy Malaria corpus for Malaria virtual screening, and conduct a systematic evaluation of five open-source LLMs; Gemma-2 2B/9B, TxGemma-2B/9B, and LlaSMol-Mistral-7B, on a rigorous out-of-distribution data split. Performance was benchmarked against classical ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost) and frontier proprietary models (Gemini 2.5, OpenAI o3) under few-shot conditions. Fine-tuned LLMs substantially outperformed all baselines: TxGemma-9B achieved the highest ROC-AUC ($0.731 \pm 0.005$) and LlaSMol-Mistral-7B the best enrichment factor (EF@1\% $\approx$ 4.99). Domain-specific fine-tuning proved categorically indispensable with TxGemma-9B collapsing from ROC-AUC 0.731 to 0.499, under its best few-shot condition, and neither Gemini 2.5 (ROC-AUC $\approx$ 0.53) nor o3 (ROC-AUC $\approx$ 0.59) achieved reliable discrimination without fine-tuning. Biomedical pretraining conferred a measurable advantage at equivalent scale, while chemistry-aware pretraining yielded superior prospective enrichment. Fine-tuned open-source LLMs represent a compelling, resource-efficient paradigm for antimalarial VS, outperforming both classical pipelines and proprietary reasoning models under structurally challenging conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Malaria-Instruct，一个基于 ChEMBL Legacy Malaria 语料构建的指令微调数据集，用于疟疾虚拟筛选 (virtual screening)，并对五个开源 LLM（Gemma-2 2B/9B、TxGemma-2B/9B、LlaSMol-Mistral-7B）在严格的分布外 (out-of-distribution) 划分下进行系统评估。微调后的开源模型显著超越经典机器学习基线和专有推理模型：TxGemma-9B 取得最高 ROC-AUC（0.731 ± 0.005），LlaSMol-Mistral-7B 取得最佳富集因子（EF@1% ≈ 4.99）。结果表明领域特定微调至关重要，未微调的专有模型（Gemini 2.5、OpenAI o3）不具备可靠判别能力。
Motivation: 疟疾虚拟筛选需要高效且资源可控的筛选方法，而现有 LLM 在此类化合物筛选任务中的严格评估仍然缺乏，尤其是分布外泛化和与经典及专有模型的系统对比不足。
Method: 构造 Malaria-Instruct 指令微调数据集，对五个开源 LLM 进行领域微调，并在严格的分布外数据划分下，与 Random Forest、XGBoost 以及 Gemini 2.5、OpenAI o3 在少样本 (few-shot) 条件下进行基准评测。
Result: 微调后的 TxGemma-9B 取得最高 ROC-AUC（0.731 ± 0.005）；未微调时其 ROC-AUC 降至 0.499。LlaSMol-Mistral-7B 取得最佳 EF@1%（约 4.99）。Gemini 2.5（约 0.53）与 o3（约 0.59）在无微调时无法可靠判别；同等规模下生物医学预训练带来可测量的优势，而化学感知预训练带来更好的前瞻性富集性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为，经过领域微调的开源 LLM 是抗疟疾虚拟筛选中有说服力且资源高效的范式，在结构挑战性条件下优于经典流程和专有推理模型；但同时也强调领域特定微调是不可或缺的前提。

papers.title: StateSight: Benchmarking Latent Spatial-State Reconstruction in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models are increasingly used for multimodal question answering, yet their ability to reconstruct latent spatial structure from a single image remains difficult to isolate. Broad benchmarks often combine perception, optical character recognition, domain knowledge, linguistic priors, and reasoning in the same evaluation. We introduce StateSight, a procedurally generated benchmark for cube-net opposite-face reasoning, occluded cube-tower counting, and 4-neighbor connected-component counting. Each task family contains 300 single-image prompts with deterministic oracle labels and exact-match scoring. OpenAI GPT-5.5, using the API model identifier gpt-5.5, achieved 59.3%, 33.3%, and 28.3% accuracy across the three tasks, while Claude Sonnet 5 achieved 53.3%, 18.7%, and 7.3%. All final direct runs had zero format errors. A 30-participant human baseline on 60 items exceeded both models on every task, with mean accuracies of 80.8%, 68.8%, and 64.3%. Visible-derivation analysis identified recurring errors in image-state reconstruction and reasoning procedure. We also introduce StateSight-Steps, a companion dataset of 900 interleaved image-text examples and 3,600 deterministic intermediate visual states. The results show that format-valid responses can mask failures to recover the spatial structure required for verifiable visual inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StateSight，一个程序化生成的基准，用于单独评估视觉语言模型从单张图像重建潜在空间结构的能力。基准包含立方体网络对面推理、遮挡立方体塔计数和 4-邻接连通分量计数三个任务族，各含 300 个单图提示，采用确定性 oracle 标签和精确匹配评分。GPT-5.5 与 Claude Sonnet 5 的准确率均大幅低于 30 人人类基线，且格式合法但空间结构恢复失败的响应普遍存在。
Motivation: 现有多模态问答基准往往同时混入感知、OCR、领域知识、语言先验和推理，难以单独衡量模型重建单图潜在空间结构的能力。
Method: 引入 StateSight 程序化基准，包含三个任务族、确定性标签与精确匹配评分；另构建配套数据集 StateSight-Steps，含 900 个交错图像-文本示例和 3,600 个确定性中间视觉状态，并采用可见推导分析定位错误来源。
Result: GPT-5.5 在三个任务上的准确率为 59.3%、33.3%、28.3%，Claude Sonnet 5 为 53.3%、18.7%、7.3%；30 名人类参与者在 60 项上的平均准确率为 80.8%、68.8%、64.3%，全面超过两个模型。所有最终直接运行均无格式错误，但格式合法响应仍可能掩盖空间结构恢复失败。
Conclusion: 结果表明，格式有效的回答无法保证模型恢复了可验证视觉推理所需的潜在空间结构，需要将空间状态重建能力从混杂的通用基准中独立评测。

papers.title: Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging for Adaptive Public Health Forecasting: Comparative Evaluation and an Ontario COVID-19 Case Study
papers.abstract_en: Public health forecasts must respond to abrupt changes in surveillance data without over-extrapolating noise, reporting artifacts, or temporary trends. We evaluated autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), random forest, and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost) models using 190 weekly observations of publicly available Ontario COVID-19 case counts from January 2020 to October 2023. Rolling-origin time-series cross-validation preserved temporal order during model tuning and evaluation. Performance was assessed across three operating dimensions: responsiveness following selected turning points, forecast horizons of one to six weeks, and the amount of historical training data. We also developed Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging (MLAMA), a non-negative performance-weighted ensemble with weights that vary by forecast horizon and responsiveness setting. Retrospective comparisons showed that ARIMA adapted rapidly after turning points but its normalized error increased at longer horizons. Random forest and XGBoost were less responsive initially but maintained more stable normalized error over longer horizons. For two-week forecasts at the end of the study period, training on the most recent data outperformed using longer historical periods, particularly for XGBoost. MLAMA achieved the lowest normalized mean absolute percentage error across most forecast horizons and ranked among the best-performing methods across responsiveness settings. These findings support selecting forecasting models according to operating conditions rather than relying on a single universally preferred approach. MLAMA provides a practical framework for combining complementary statistical and machine-learning forecasts. The accompanying Python package is currently maintained in a private repository while software validation and reproducibility testing are completed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 2020 年 1 月至 2023 年 10 月安大略省 COVID-19 病例数（190 周观测）评估了 ARIMA、随机森林和 XGBoost 三种预测模型，并提出 MLAMA（Machine Learning and ARIMA Model Averaging）集成方法。滚动起点时间序列交叉验证保留了时间顺序，性能按转折点响应、1-6 周预测期限和训练数据量三个维度评估。结果显示 ARIMA 在转折点后适应快但长周期误差上升，树模型初始响应较慢但误差更稳定，而 MLAMA 在多数预测期限上取得最低的归一化平均绝对百分比误差。
Motivation: 公共卫生预测需应对监测数据的突然变化，同时避免过度外推噪声、报告伪象或临时趋势；现有单一模型难以同时满足不同操作条件下的响应性与稳定性要求。
Method: 采用滚动起点时间序列交叉验证进行调参和评估，并开发 MLAMA，一种非负性能加权集成，其权重随预测期限和响应性设置而变化。
Result: 摘要报告 ARIMA 在转折点后快速适应但归一化误差在较长预测期限内增加；随机森林和 XGBoost 初始响应较弱但在长预测期限内归一化误差更稳定；在研究期末的两周预测中，使用最近数据训练优于更长历史窗口（尤其对 XGBoost）；MLAMA 在大多数预测期限上取得最低归一化平均绝对百分比误差，并在响应性设置中位列最佳方法之一。
Conclusion: 研究支持根据操作条件选择预测模型而非依赖单一通用方法；MLAMA 为组合互补的统计与机器学习预测提供实用框架。摘要还说明配套 Python 包当前存于私有仓库，待软件验证和可复现性测试完成。

summary_sections.method: 采用滚动起点时间序列交叉验证进行调参和评估，并开发 MLAMA，一种非负性能加权集成，其权重随预测期限和响应性设置而变化。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 ARIMA 在转折点后快速适应但归一化误差在较长预测期限内增加；随机森林和 XGBoost 初始响应较弱但在长预测期限内归一化误差更稳定；在研究期末的两周预测中，使用最近数据训练优于更长历史窗口（尤其对 XGBoost）；MLAMA 在大多数预测期限上取得最低归一化平均绝对百分比误差，并在响应性设置中位列最佳方法之一。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究支持根据操作条件选择预测模型而非依赖单一通用方法；MLAMA 为组合互补的统计与机器学习预测提供实用框架。摘要还说明配套 Python 包当前存于私有仓库，待软件验证和可复现性测试完成。

papers.title: Robust Discovery of Coarse-Grained Continuum Equations from Microscopic Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: The discovery of governing partial differential equations (PDEs) directly from spatiotemporal data has emerged as a powerful tool for understanding the dynamics of complex systems. In this work, we apply PDE-SINDy to well-known phase-separating systems and examine how its performance depends on the amount of available data, the size of the function library, and the presence of noise. Our results show that the accuracy of equation discovery depends strongly on the amount of available data. Although the correct equation can be identified with limited data, several spurious terms also acquire finite selection probabilities. As the amount of data increases, these spurious terms are progressively suppressed, leading to a more robust identification of the governing equation. In contrast, increasing the size of the function library adversely affects the efficiency of equation discovery. Further, for the Glauber spin-flip Ising model, we show that the selection probabilities reveal a hierarchy of equations with varying levels of complexity. A sufficiently stringent selection threshold recovers a Model-A-like dynamical equation that accurately reproduces the dynamical and statistical features of phase separation and domain growth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文应用 PDE-SINDy 从时空数据中自动发现相分离系统的粗粒化连续方程，系统考察数据量、函数库大小和噪声对方程发现性能的影响。摘要报告，识别准确性强烈依赖数据量：有限数据下虽能识别正确方程但伴随伪项，数据增多会逐步抑制伪项；增大函数库规模则损害发现效率。在 Glauber 自旋翻转 Ising 模型中，选择概率呈现不同复杂度方程的层次，足够严格的选择阈值可恢复类似 Model-A 的动力学方程，并准确复现相分离与畴生长的统计特征。
Motivation: 直接从微观时空数据发现控制 PDE 是理解复杂系统动力学的重要工具，但 PDE-SINDy 等方法的稳健性如何受数据量、库函数规模和噪声影响，仍缺乏在相分离系统上的系统考察。
Method: 将 PDE-SINDy 应用于已知相分离系统，改变可用数据量、函数库大小和噪声水平，通过选择概率分析伪项的抑制情况，并在 Glauber Ising 模型中检验不同阈值下的方程层级。
Result: 方程发现准确性强烈依赖数据量；有限数据下正确方程可识别但出现有限选择概率的伪项，数据增加会压制伪项；增大函数库会降低发现效率。Glauber Ising 模型中，严格阈值可恢复 Model-A 型方程，并准确再现相分离和畴生长的动力学与统计特征。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，数据量与选择阈值的合理平衡是稳健方程发现的关键，过大的函数库和数据不足都会降低可靠性；该方法对从微观模拟推断宏观连续方程具有方法论意义。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: LingShu: A Large-Scale Symptom-Centric Contextualized Knowledge Graph Bridging Traditional Chinese Medicine and Modern Biomedicine
papers.abstract_en: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) are pivotal for knowledge organization, yet traditional binary relations often struggle to represent the conditional nature of biomedical knowledge. Symptoms provide a shared phenotypic layer for linking Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), which relies on symptom patterns for syndrome differentiation and treatment selection, with modern biomedicine, which connects clinical manifestations to diseases and molecular mechanisms. We present LingShu, a large-scale symptom-centric contextualized knowledge graph designed to bridge TCM and modern biomedicine. The exported version of LingShu analyzed in this study comprises 17.33 million atom-level entity records and 39.47 million relation records, including 17.19 million semantic triples and 22.29 million contextualized quadruples. LingShu integrates multi-source data, including clinical electronic medical records, authoritative TCM texts, biomedical ontologies, and curated knowledge bases, through a pipeline combining natural language processing, terminology normalization, and human-in-the-loop verification. A key innovation of LingShu is its hybrid data model: it maintains 64 typed triple relation patterns to ensure broad connectivity, while incorporating 35 contextual quadruple relation patterns to capture conditional medical associations. This dual-structure approach explicitly encodes conditional knowledge, providing a granular representation of the contexts associated with medical relations. These contextualized relations cover syndrome-dependent herb efficacy, disease-contextualized drug effects, population-specific clinical associations, and mechanism-related therapeutic responses. Furthermore, we developed a web platform (http://www.tcmkg.com/) that integrates graph visualization, graph-based reasoning, and an evidence-grounded knowledge question-answering agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LingShu，一个以症状为中心的大型情境化知识图谱，旨在桥接传统中医（TCM）与现代生物医学。研究导出的版本包含 1733 万原子级实体记录和 3947 万关系记录，其中包含 1719 万语义三元组和 2229 万情境化四元组。其混合数据模型维护 64 种类型化三元关系模式和 35 种情境化四元关系模式，以显式编码条件性医学知识。
Motivation: 传统二元关系难以表达生物医学知识的条件性本质，而症状作为共享表型层，可将依赖症状模式辨证施治的中医与现代生物医学连接起来。
Method: 通过自然语言处理、术语规范化和人在回路验证的流水线整合临床电子病历、权威中医文献、生物医学本体和知识库；采用混合数据模型，包含语义三元组和情境化四元组，并构建了集成图谱可视化、图谱推理和证据支撑问答代理的 web 平台。
Result: 摘要报告图谱规模为 1733 万实体记录和 3947 万关系记录，涵盖 35 种情境化关系模式，覆盖证候依赖性中药功效、疾病情境化药物效应、人群特异性临床关联和机制相关治疗反应。
Conclusion: LingShu 通过情境化关系显式编码条件知识，提供医疗关系上下文的细粒度表示，并开放了相关 web 平台。

papers.title: World models of environment, agent and joint agent-environment systems
papers.abstract_en: World models are a central component of model-based reinforcement learning. They are usually discussed in terms of what variables they predict, such as observations, rewards, states, latent or information states. We argue that there is a prior distinction: which channel they model. We consider three cases: the environment channel $O_{:} \mid A_{:}$, the agent channel $A_{:} \mid O_{:}$, and the realised joint process $(A, O)_{:}$, equivalently viewed as a channel with no inputs. Using computational mechanics, we define canonical predictive models for these three cases as $ε$-transducers or $ε$-machines. Canonical environment models recover standard predictive state representations, while the other two give analogous notions of canonical models for the agent and the joint system. We then build canonical support-restricted environment and agent models induced by closed-loop coupling, whose predictive equivalences range over continuations supported by the realised interaction. The key structural result is that canonical support-restricted environment states factor through the canonical joint causal states, and their transition structure is induced directly from the joint model; the agent-side construction is dual. Finally, we give a POMDP/controller example in which the unrestricted environment model has infinitely many states while the canonical support-restricted model induced by the coupling is finite. The framework clarifies what different world models are models of, and how coupling and support restriction can change their canonical predictive structure and complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从待建模的通道（channel）而非被预测变量出发，重新梳理世界模型（world model）的分类。作者用计算力学（computational mechanics）将环境通道、智能体通道和联合过程分别定义为规范预测模型（ε-transducers/ε-machines），并研究闭环耦合诱导的support-restricted模型，指出耦合可以显著降低规范模型的状态复杂度。
Motivation: 现有世界模型通常按预测对象（观测、奖励、状态等）来讨论，但缺少一个更基本的区分：它们究竟建模哪一个通道。这个区分会改变模型的规范预测结构和复杂度，论文试图弥补这一概念缺口。
Method: 利用计算力学的形式化工具，为三种情况定义规范预测模型：环境通道 O:|A:、智能体通道 A:|O:、以及与无输入通道等价的联合过程 (A,O):。随后构造由闭环耦合诱导的support-restricted环境模型和智能体模型，将其预测等价类限制在实际交互所支持的续集上。
Result: 关键结构结果是：规范support-restricted环境状态通过联合因果状态（joint causal states）分解，其转移结构直接由联合模型诱导，智能体侧构造对偶。论文还给出一个POMDP/controller例子，其中无限制环境模型有无穷多状态，而耦合诱导的support-restricted模型状态有限。
Conclusion: 该框架澄清了不同世界模型各自在建模什么对象，并说明耦合与support restriction如何改变规范预测结构和复杂度，为理解模型基于强化学习中的世界模型提供了更基础的概念区分。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Retrieval Fails Before It Begins: Structurally Indirect Prerequisite Eviction as a Retention Failure in Agentic Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic memory under a fixed budget involves two stages: retention and retrieval. Existing retrieval-centered paradigms implicitly assume necessary evidence survives eviction, but we challenge this by isolating a pre-retrieval failure mode: structurally indirect prerequisite eviction, in which upstream blocks weakly aligned with the query are discarded under budget pressure. We provide an operational definition of this failure, a reproducible deterministic benchmark, and per-seed trace diagnostics. Finally, we evaluate Dependency-aware Semantic Garbage Collection (DSGC), a one-hop graph-aware rule. In our main suite, DSGC improves full-chain retention from 0.03 to 0.90 under a lexical encoder and from 0.23 to 1.00 under a sentence encoder. Robustness checks then identify the budget and scaling regimes where the one-hop rule holds or degrades. Our released pipeline and failure postmortem support mechanistic analysis of retention before retrieval as a distinct failure boundary.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes of Agentic AI (FAGEN@ICML 2026). Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/smkgenesis/dsgc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在固定预算的智能体记忆（agentic memory）中隔离出一种检索前（pre-retrieval）失败模式：结构性间接前置条件驱逐（structurally indirect prerequisite eviction），即与查询弱对齐的上游块在预算压力下被丢弃。作者给出该失败的操作性定义、可复现的确定性基准和逐随机种子（per-seed）的追踪诊断，并评估单跳图感知规则 DSGC。在主基准上，DSGC 将全链路留存率（full-chain retention）在词级编码器下从 0.03 提升到 0.90，在句级编码器下从 0.23 提升到 1.00，鲁棒性检验同时标出了该规则有效或退化的预算与规模区间。
Motivation: 现有以检索为中心的记忆范式隐含假设必要证据能在驱逐（eviction）中幸存，但这一假设可能不成立；作者希望将检索前的留存失败作为一个独立故障边界来研究，而不仅仅是检索质量问题。
Method: 提出一个确定性、可复现的基准以构造该失败模式，并提供逐 seed 的轨迹诊断工具；引入依赖感知语义垃圾回收（Dependency-aware Semantic Garbage Collection, DSGC），一种单跳图感知的驱逐规则。
Result: 主套件中 DSGC 将全链路留存率从 0.03 提升到 0.90（词级编码器），从 0.23 提升到 1.00（句级编码器）；鲁棒性检验进一步鉴定出该单跳规则成立或退化的预算与规模区间。
Conclusion: 作者强调留存先于检索（retention before retrieval）是独立的失败边界，并发布流水线与失败事后分析（failure postmortem）以支持机制层面的研究；同时指出 DSGC 的适用性受预算和规模条件限制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Environmental Slow AI: Design Principles for Generative Systems
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI (genAI) systems produce cultural artefacts at scale, but they also reflect embedded cultural values through their design. Once identified, these values become open to deliberate reshaping. This position paper examines the maximalist values of current generative AI through an environmental humanities tradition and proposes design principles in which environmental sustainability serves as the core value instead. The principles are developed under the umbrella of Slow AI, a term that already circulates across several distinct research and practice programs. Five design principles are articulated (restraint, sufficiency, selectivity over retention, material visibility, and friction as affordance), each of them illustrated against the current design of widely deployed systems. Each principle operates at two levels: a design implementation, and an interpretive layer at which users and developers are prompted toward reflective engagement with the system. Together these principles extend human agency by restoring decisions that frictionless defaults have silently removed and do so by building interpretive reflection into design.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），从环境人文学科（environmental humanities）视角审视当前生成式 AI（generative AI）中隐含的最大化主义价值观，并提出以环境可持续性为核心价值的“慢 AI”（Slow AI）设计原则。作者给出五项设计原则——节制（restraint）、充分性（sufficiency）、选择性优于保留（selectivity over retention）、物质可见性（material visibility）、摩擦作为可供性（friction as affordance），并对照当前广泛部署系统的设计逐条阐释。每项原则同时作用于设计实现层与诠释层（interpretive layer），后者促使使用者与开发者对系统进行反思性参与。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 以规模化方式生产文化产品，但其设计也嵌入了特定文化价值观，且这些价值观被识别后即可被有意重塑。论文针对当前生成式 AI 设计中占主导的最大化主义价值取向提出质疑，主张改用环境可持续性作为核心价值来指导系统设计。
Method: 作为立场论文，该方法是在 Slow AI 这一已流通于多个研究与实务纲领的概念下提出五项设计原则，并以当前广为部署的系统为对象逐条举例说明。每项原则包含两个层面：设计实现（design implementation）以及引导用户和开发者进行反思性参与的诠释层。
Result: 摘要未报告任何定量实验结果或基准数据。其主要主张是这些设计原则通过把诠释性反思构建进设计之中，恢复被无摩擦默认（frictionless defaults）悄然移除的决策，从而扩展人类能动性。
Conclusion: 论文的落脚点是五项原则共同将环境可持续性确立为生成式 AI 的核心价值，并为 Slow AI 作为跨学科研究与实务纲领的后续操作化提供一个框架性起点。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language models (LLMs) on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) re-encode verbose tool schemas every turn, so prefill - quadratic in sequence length - dominates time-to-first-token (TTFT) as the tool registry grows. Nexus's primary lever is to decouple routing from the schema-prefill cost: an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer (SLB) with a calibrated cross-encoder margin gate selects tools by retrieval, and arguments are generated over a compressed textual signature (median 19 tokens) rather than over spliced key/value (KV) cache. This path is depth-independent: routing accuracy stays near 89% as the registry scales to 250 tools - where a concatenate-all-schemas baseline overflows the context window entirely - and it reaches a first-argument token 1.66x sooner than a full-schema re-prefill at a ~80% main-context token saving. As a secondary, bounded lever we transplant a compiled schema KV block directly into the live context. This is fundamentally limited by rotary position embedding (RoPE) phase drift: an anchored splice is output-exact, but off-anchor placement corrupts attention, so beyond a threshold P=256 Nexus repairs the seam with a depth-adaptive suffix redecode that escalates to a full re-prefill. The resulting never-regress property is a guarantee on output fidelity (top-1 agreement, D_KL approx. 0) - not on latency, which can dip to 0.98x before converging to parity - alongside a 1.1-1.7x TTFT speedup at moderate depth that narrows to parity at deep context. Two negative results bound the design: the off-anchor RoPE fidelity boundary, and the failure of a reference-free drift gate to predict drift (Spearman rho = 0.193). All measurements are from one model tuple (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M) on Apple-silicon unified memory; the qualitative boundaries generalize, while the quantitative envelope is tuple-specific.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nexus，面向统一内存上基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的智能体 LLM，目标是降低工具注册表增长时由前填充 (prefill) 主导的首 token 延迟 (TTFT)。主要手段是把工具路由与 schema 重新编码解耦：用 INT8 语义旁路缓冲区 (SLB) 加校准的交叉编码器边际门做检索式工具选择，参数生成基于压缩文本签名（中位 19 token）而非拼接的 KV cache；次要手段是直接把编译好的 schema KV 块移植进上下文，并用深度自适应后缀重解码修复 RoPE 相位漂移。摘要报告在 250 个工具规模下路由准确率约 89%，首个参数 token 比完整 schema 重新 prefill 快 1.66 倍，中等深度下 TTFT 加速 1.1–1.7 倍，并给出两个负面结果界定设计边界。
Motivation: Agentic LLM 在 MCP 下每轮都会对冗长的工具 schema 重新编码，prefill 复杂度随序列长度二次增长，导致工具注册表扩大时 TTFT 成为主要瓶颈。Nexus 的目标是把路由开销与 schema-prefill 成本解耦，同时保持输出保真度。
Method: Nexus 包含两条路径：(1) 主要杠杆是检索解耦路由，INT8 语义旁路缓冲区 (SLB) 配合校准的交叉编码器边际门选择工具，参数生成基于压缩文本签名（中位 19 token）；(2) 次要杠杆是把编译好的 schema KV 块直接移植进实时上下文，但受 RoPE 相位漂移限制，锚定拼接可输出精确，非锚定放置会破坏注意力，超过阈值 P=256 时用深度自适应后缀重解码修复接缝，必要时升级为完整重新 prefill。
Result: 在 250 个工具规模下路由准确率保持约 89%，而拼接全部 schema 的基线已溢出上下文窗口；首个参数 token 比完整 schema 重新 prefill 早 1.66 倍，主上下文 token 节省约 80%。中等深度下 TTFT 加速 1.1–1.7 倍，深度较深时趋向持平且可能短暂降至 0.98 倍。两个负面结果：非锚定 RoPE 保真边界，以及无参考漂移门的漂移预测失败（Spearman rho = 0.193）。所有测量来自单一模型组合 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct Q4_K_M 在 Apple silicon 统一内存上。
Conclusion: Nexus 提供 never-regress 性质的保证，即输出保真度（top-1 一致性与 D_KL 约 0）不会退化，但该保证不覆盖延迟；定性边界被认为可以泛化，而定量性能区间是特定模型组合特有的。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge-Graph-Gated Defactualization for Style-Controllable and Fact-Preserving Generation in Agentic Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: Agentic large language models (LLMs) deployed in fact-sensitive applications such as customer support must simultaneously preserve factual correctness and generate responses in a controllable stylistic register. Activation steering enables fine-tuning-free style control by perturbing hidden representations, but it lacks an explicit mechanism for distinguishing verifiable facts from stylistic content, leading to semantic leakage. We address this challenge through \emph{Defactualize-Steer-Rehydrate} (DSR), a knowledge-engineering framework that integrates a typed, salience-weighted knowledge graph (KG) with activation steering. DSR extracts salient entities using a layered regex or NER or lexical-classifier pipeline, replaces them with typed placeholders prior to steering, and deterministically restores verified values through salience-guided rehydration after generation. DSR is evaluated across six LLaMA-family models (1B--13B parameters) on 600 A2A-generated customer-support cases (1,200 generations), with a dedicated KG ablation study. DSR significantly increases verified-entity recovery relative to a steering-only baseline (Cohen's $d=0.225$, $p_{\text{Bonf}}=1.0\times10^{-4}$), though the absolute recovery rate remains modest, while preserving effective style control across diverse model families. Layer-wise separability and steering-strength diagnostics further show previously unexplored interactions between representation-level steering and factual grounding. hese results demonstrate that explicit knowledge engineering can systematically enhance trustworthy, controllable, and reproducible generative AI without requiring model fine-tuning. Code, cached steering vectors, and evaluation scripts are publicly released to support reproducibility.\footnote{https://github.com/Tanmay-IITDSAI/KG-Gated-Defactualization}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Defactualize-Steer-Rehydrate (DSR) 知识工程框架，将类型化且按显著性加权的知识图谱 (KG) 与激活引导 (activation steering) 结合，用于智能体对话 LLM 中既保持事实正确又可控风格的生成。DSR 先用分层 regex、NER 或词法分类器提取显著实体并替换为类型化占位符，再进行引导生成，最后通过 salience 引导的再水合 (rehydration) 确定性恢复已验证值。在六个 LLaMA 系列模型（1B–13B）上对 600 个 A2A 客户支持案例（1,200 次生成）评估，DSR 相对仅 steering 基线显著提高已验证实体恢复率（Cohen's d=0.225，Bonferroni 校正 p=1.0e-4），同时保持风格控制。
Motivation: 事实敏感场景（如客户支持）中的智能体 LLM 需要同时满足事实正确性和可控文体；激活引导可以免微调控制风格，但缺乏区分可验证事实与风格内容的显式机制，导致语义泄漏 (semantic leakage)。
Method: 提出 DSR（Defactualize-Steer-Rehydrate）框架：集成 typed、salience-weighted 知识图谱与激活引导；通过分层 regex/NER/词法分类器提取显著实体并替换为类型化占位符，引导生成后按 salience 引导确定性恢复已验证事实值；作者公开了代码、缓存 steering vectors 与评估脚本。
Result: 摘要报告在六个 LLaMA 系列模型（1B–13B）和 600 个 A2A 客户支持案例（1,200 次生成）上，DSR 相较 steering-only 基线显著提升已验证实体恢复率（Cohen's d=0.225，Bonferroni 校正 p=1.0e-4），但绝对恢复率仍适中；风格控制在多种模型族上保持有效，层间可分性与 steering 强度诊断揭示了表示层引导与事实锚定的交互。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式知识工程可以在不进行模型微调的情况下，系统性地增强可信、可控且可复现的生成式 AI。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation-as-Search: Adaptive Discovery of Grounding Failures in Meeting Assistants
papers.abstract_en: LLM-powered meeting assistants are deployed at scale, yet systematic evaluation of their grounding fidelity remains limited to static benchmarks that miss failure modes tied to specific discourse structures or reasoning demands. We propose Evaluation-as-Search (EaS), a feedback-driven methodology that frames quality evaluation as an adaptive search over the space of natural questions a meeting participant might ask. Rather than sampling uniformly, EaS learns from evaluator feedback across iterations to concentrate probing effort on cognitive demands where failures are most likely, guided by a UCB-scored coverage map and blind multi-dimensional quality evaluation. Using EaS, we construct MeetingProbe, a benchmark of over $3{,}000$ annotated question--answer pairs spanning 20 transcripts from three meeting genres and three LLM assistants. In ablations, adaptive search surfaces $2.5\times$ more failures than random probing ($7.1\%$ vs. $2.9\%$ finding rate), with the strategic planner contributing the largest individual effect. Across three models, we observe a clear capability gradient and identify eight recurring failure categories dominated by discourse-pragmatic challenges rather than factual recall errors. We further validate MeetingProbe across multiple model families and providers, finding a clean capability gradient and a curated subset of universal failures that no model handles. MeetingProbe is released publicly to support reproducible evaluation of meeting assistant grounding fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evaluation-as-Search (EaS)，一种基于反馈的自适应评估方法，用于系统检测 LLM 会议助手在自然提问上的接地失败 (grounding failures)。作者基于该方法构建了包含 3,000 多个标注问答对的 MeetingProbe 基准，覆盖 20 份来自三种会议体裁的笔录和三个 LLM 助手。实验显示，与随机探测相比，自适应搜索以 2.5 倍更高的速率发现失败，并识别出八类反复出现的失败模式，其中话语-语用类挑战占主导。
Motivation: 大规模部署的 LLM 会议助手缺乏对其接地保真度的系统性评估，现有静态基准无法捕捉与特定话语结构或推理需求相关的失败模式。
Method: 提出 Evaluation-as-Search 框架，将质量评估建模为对会议参与者可能提出的自然问题空间的自适应搜索；它不进行均匀采样，而是利用跨迭代的评估者反馈，通过 UCB 打分的覆盖图和盲式多维质量评估，将探测努力集中于最可能失败的认知需求。
Result: MeetingProbe 基准包含 3,000 多个标注问答对，覆盖 20 份笔录、三种会议体裁和三个 LLM 助手；消融实验中自适应搜索的失败发现率为 7.1%，是随机探测 (2.9%) 的 2.5 倍，其中策略规划器贡献最大。跨模型测试呈现清晰的能力梯度，并识别出八类反复出现的失败类别，以话语-语用挑战为主而非事实回忆错误。
Conclusion: 作者公开了 MeetingProbe，以支持会议助手接地保真度的可复现评估；摘要指出存在一个没有任何模型能处理的通用失败子集。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.result: MeetingProbe 基准包含 3,000 多个标注问答对，覆盖 20 份笔录、三种会议体裁和三个 LLM 助手；消融实验中自适应搜索的失败发现率为 7.1%，是随机探测 (2.9%) 的 2.5 倍，其中策略规划器贡献最大。跨模型测试呈现清晰的能力梯度，并识别出八类反复出现的失败类别，以话语-语用挑战为主而非事实回忆错误。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者公开了 MeetingProbe，以支持会议助手接地保真度的可复现评估；摘要指出存在一个没有任何模型能处理的通用失败子集。

papers.title: Ansari: A Retrieval-Grounded Islamic AI Assistant -- Architecture, Deployment, and Lessons from 140,000 Conversations
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to answer religious questions, but for Islamic content they carry two serious risks: factual fabrication (inventing Qur'anic verses or hadith) and subtle value misalignment. We present Ansari, a deployed, retrieval-grounded Islamic AI assistant that has handled more than 140,000 conversations across 25+ languages since June 2023. Ansari is built around an agentic retrieval loop: a tool-using language model issues searches against authenticated Islamic corpora -- the Qur'an, hadith collections, a multi-volume jurisprudence (fiqh) encyclopedia, and exegetical (tafsir) sources -- and answers only on the basis of what it retrieves, with citations attached for verification. We describe the system's architecture (the agent loop, the retrieval tools, the corpora, and the system prompt that encodes editorial and theological policy), its multi-platform deployment (web, mobile, WhatsApp, and as a Model Context Protocol server and an Agent Skill), and what 140,000 real conversations reveal about how Muslims actually use such a tool. We report results on several complementary evaluations -- zero-shot performance on accredited institutional exams, a human-rated validation during Ramadan, and two independent, externally run benchmarks on which Ansari currently tops the public IslamicMMLU leaderboard ahead of frontier models and is competitive on Islamic legal reasoning (IslamicLegalBench) while strongly resisting false premises -- and draw out lessons that generalize beyond Islam to any faith- or values-sensitive deployment of LLMs: grounding is necessary but not sufficient, the system prompt is a theological as much as a technical artifact, and the absence of community in how models are formed remains a hard gap.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Live system: https://askansari.ai . Code: https://github.com/ansari-project
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Ansari，一个已部署的、基于检索的伊斯兰 AI 助手，自 2023 年 6 月以来处理了超过 14 万次对话，覆盖 25 种以上语言。系统围绕代理式检索循环 (agentic retrieval loop) 构建：工具调用的语言模型只对经认证的伊斯兰语料库（古兰经、圣训集、教法学百科全书和经注学资源）发起搜索，并仅依据检索结果作答且附带引用。作者报告了架构、多平台部署以及多个评估结果，并总结了超越伊斯兰场景、适用于任何信仰或价值观敏感型 LLM 部署的经验。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地被用于回答宗教问题，但在伊斯兰内容上存在两大严重风险：事实捏造（杜撰古兰经经文或圣训）和细微的价值错位 (value misalignment)。
Method: Ansari 采用代理式检索回路，由使用工具的语言模型对认证的伊斯兰语料库执行检索，仅基于检索到的内容生成答案并附引用；系统提示词 (system prompt) 编码了编辑与神学政策，并部署于网页、移动端、WhatsApp、Model Context Protocol 服务器和 Agent Skill 等多平台。
Result: 系统已处理超过 14 万次真实对话；摘要报告了多项互补评估：认证机构考试的零样本表现、斋月期间的人工评分验证，以及两个独立外部基准——Ansari 目前在公共 IslamicMMLU 排行榜上领先于前沿模型，在 IslamicLegalBench 上具有竞争力，并能强烈抵抗虚假前提。
Conclusion: 作者总结了可推广到任何信仰或价值观敏感型 LLM 部署的经验：接地 (grounding) 是必要但不充分的；系统提示词既是技术产物也是神学产物；模型形成过程中缺乏社区参与仍是一个难以弥合的缺口。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness
papers.abstract_en: A production agent harness must discover and rank, from a growing library of skills, the one most appropriate for a user's task. At small scale this selection happens in context: the LLM planner chooses among skill representations exposed in its system prompt, without an explicit embedding-based retrieval step. We treat this in-context selection as the small-N counterpart to embedding-based skill retrieval at scale, and present a case study of how Tinycloud, a production multimodal video agent harness, represents its skills for the planner. The harness ships skills under two recurring representations: tool-skills that wrap a single external API or system tool and serve as primitive vocabulary, and workflow-skills that orchestrate tool-skill calls plus a template render to produce one named deliverable. The harness exposes them via two surfaces in the system prompt: an inlined-body surface (full instructions, scripts, templates) for autoloaded skills, and a one-line listing for on-demand skills. A six-task selection ablation across three exposure regimes (all-on, default, all-off) shows that full autoload selects the gold skill on every task; all-off slows execution and produces hard discovery failures; and the production default misroutes one task because its lexical signal collides with an autoloaded tool-skill that pulls planner attention away from a listed workflow-skill. The headline finding is that in-prompt exposure of skills is not monotonically helpful: partial exposure can create lexical competition that suppresses correct selection. We connect this small-N observation to recent retrieval-based skill-routing work at large scale, and frame this contribution as a case study rather than a benchmark.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at AgentSearch '26 workshop at SIGIR 2026 (Melbourne, Australia, July 24, 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以生产级多模态视频智能体系统 Tinycloud 为例，研究技能表示如何影响智能体规划器在系统提示词中对技能的选择。作者将小规模下的上下文内选择视为大规模嵌入检索技能路由的小样本对应物，比较工具技能 (tool-skills) 与工作流技能 (workflow-skills) 两种表示，以及内联主体 (inlined-body) 与单行列表两种暴露方式。六任务选择消融表明，完整自动加载在所有任务上选对黄金技能，全关闭则导致发现失败，而生产默认配置因词法信号冲突而错误路由一个任务。核心发现是技能在提示词中的暴露并非越多越好，部分暴露可能产生词法竞争并抑制正确选择。
Motivation: 生产智能体系统需要从不断增长的技能库中发现并对用户任务进行排序选择，但技能在系统提示词中的表示方式如何影响规划器选择尚未被充分研究，特别是在小规模上下文内选择的场景下。
Method: 基于 Tinycloud 这一生产多模态视频智能体系统，对两种技能表示（包装单一 API 的工具技能与编排工具调用并生成交付物的流程技能）和两种系统提示词暴露表面（内联完整指令与单行列表）进行六任务选择消融实验，比较全部开启、默认、全部关闭三种暴露模式。
Result: 全部自动加载模式下每项任务均能选到正确技能；全部关闭会拖慢执行并产生硬性发现失败；生产默认配置有一个任务选择错误，原因是其词法信号与一个自动加载的工具技能冲突，将规划器注意力从列出的流程技能上引开。
Conclusion: 提示词内对技能的暴露并非单调有益，部分暴露会造成词法竞争从而抑制正确选择；作者将该小规模观察与大规模基于检索的技能路由工作联系起来，并明确将其定位为案例研究而非基准测试。
Relevance: 0
