papers.title: Poly-InstructTTS: Learning In-the-Wild Expressive Speech Synthesis from Open-Ended Instructions
papers.abstract_en: While recent text-to-speech (TTS) models achieve high naturalness, controlling fine-grained expression via natural-language instructions remains challenging. We introduce Poly- InstructTTS, which learns expressive speech from open-ended instructions using in-the-wild audiovisual data. We build a scalable multi-modal pipeline to construct a 1,000-hour instruction-annotated corpus covering 1,000+ fine-grained emotions and styles. The framework uses a prompt-free GPT with attribute-based thinking tokens, followed by a flow-matching module that injects timbre from a reference audio. We also present a speaker fine-tuning procedure to transfer instruction control to specific speakers while preserving persona. We further extend InstructTTSEval with broader tasks. Experiments show that Poly-InstructTTS delivers strong performance in instruction adherence and expressiveness. Audio demos and the expanded testset are available on our project page.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Poly-InstructTTS，一个从开放式自然语言指令学习表现力语音合成的 TTS 框架，利用 in-the-wild 音视频数据构建 1,000 小时带指令标注的语料库，覆盖 1,000+ 种细粒度情感与风格。框架采用 prompt-free GPT 与 attribute-based thinking tokens，再经 flow-matching 模块注入参考音频音色；另提出 speaker fine-tuning 流程，将指令控制迁移到特定说话人并保持 persona。作者扩展了 InstructTTSEval 评测任务，实验显示该方法在指令遵循度（instruction adherence）与表现力上表现强。
Motivation: 现有 TTS 模型虽然自然度很高，但通过自然语言指令控制细粒度表达（fine-grained expression）仍然困难，缺少能利用开放指令和真实世界音视频数据来学习表现力语音的方法。
Method: 构建可扩展的多模态 pipeline，从 in-the-wild 音视频数据自动构造带指令标注的大规模语料；提出基于 attribute-based thinking tokens 的 prompt-free GPT 作为指令建模核心，并由 flow-matching 模块从参考音频注入音色；同时给出 speaker fine-tuning 流程，在特定说话人上迁移指令控制并保持其 persona。
Result: 摘要报告构建了 1,000 小时、覆盖 1,000+ 细粒度情感与风格的指令标注语料库，并扩展了 InstructTTSEval；实验表明 Poly-InstructTTS 在指令遵循度和表现力上取得 strong performance，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 Poly-InstructTTS 能有效从开放式指令和真实世界数据学习表现力语音，并在指令遵循与表达性上表现良好；项目页面公开了音频 demo 与扩展测试集。

papers.title: Interpretable Multimodal Classification with Linear Discriminant Tree Ensembles
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal affect and behaviour classifiers that fuse heterogeneous text, audio, and visual streams must simultaneously achieve competitive accuracy and produce human-understandable explanations of the cues driving their decisions -- a dual objective that current high-capacity models, notably Transformers, only partially address. While Transformers attain strong predictive performance, their distributed representations and deep nonlinearity make it difficult to assign meaningful importance weights to individual multimodal features, limiting their use in trust-sensitive applications such as clinical affect monitoring and educational assessment. We address this gap by developing a framework based on tree-based ensembles that balances accuracy and interpretability. The framework encodes each modality into tokens, extracts and clusters concepts to reduce dimensionality, routes the fused modalities through tree-based ensemble classifiers, and interprets trends using a novel modified feature importance metric. The modified importance reduces the influence of the negative class in binary classification tasks, thereby improving indicator or marker detection. The proposed tree-based ensembles -- Linear Discriminant Tree (LDT), Linear Discriminant Forest (LDF), and Linear Discriminant AdaBoost (LDAB) -- achieve F1-mod gains of 4.3\% over the Multimodal Transformer and accuracy gains of 3.0\% over the primary interpretable multimodal baseline, Interpretable Multimodal Routing (IMR). The proposed multimodal feature importance extracts salient inter-modal concepts with substantially higher human-annotator agreement scores than default feature importance (62.2\% vs.\ 43.2\% on IEMOCAP; 46.7\% vs.\ 32.1\% on CMU-MOSI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于线性判别树集成（Linear Discriminant Tree, LDF, LDAB）的框架，用于多模态情感与行为分类，在保持竞争力的同时提升可解释性。该方法将各模态编码为 token、聚类概念降维、经树集成分类，并用改进的特征重要性指标解释趋势；在 IEMOCAP 与 CMU-MOSI 上相比多模态 Transformer 和可解释基线 IMR 取得 F1-mod 与准确率提升，且人机标注一致性更高。
Motivation: 高容量模型（如 Transformer）在多模态情感与行为分类中虽预测性能强，但分布式表示与深度非线性使其难以对单个多模态特征赋予有意义的权重，限制其在临床情感监测、教育评估等信任敏感场景中的使用。
Method: 提出一个树集成框架：将各模态编码为 token，提取并聚类概念以降维，融合后的模态经过树集成分类器（LDT、LDF、LDAB），并使用一种新修改的特征重要性指标；该指标降低二分类中负类影响，从而改进指示物或标记检测。
Result: 摘要报告所提树集成相比多模态 Transformer 获得 4.3% 的 F1-mod 提升，相比主要可解释多模态基线 IMR 获得 3.0% 准确率提升；提出的多模态特征重要性在 IEMOCAP 上人机标注一致性为 62.2% vs. 默认 43.2%，在 CMU-MOSI 上为 46.7% vs. 32.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过树集成与修改的特征重要性，可以在多模态分类中同时实现较强预测性能与更高的人类可理解解释，尤其在二分类标记检测场景下提升显著。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告所提树集成相比多模态 Transformer 获得 4.3% 的 F1-mod 提升，相比主要可解释多模态基线 IMR 获得 3.0% 准确率提升；提出的多模态特征重要性在 IEMOCAP 上人机标注一致性为 62.2% vs. 默认 43.2%，在 CMU-MOSI 上为 46.7% vs. 32.1%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过树集成与修改的特征重要性，可以在多模态分类中同时实现较强预测性能与更高的人类可理解解释，尤其在二分类标记检测场景下提升显著。

papers.title: Infrared Hotspot-Guided Early Warning of Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway Under Mechanical Abuse
papers.abstract_en: Mechanical abuse can trigger thermal runaway (TR) in lithium-ion batteries through localized heat generation before sensor signals become decisive. This paper proposes a two-stage early-warning approach that estimates localized thermal instability from infrared hotspot dynamics and then fuses this instability score with mechanical, electrical, thermal, and image-intensity features for a 20-frame warning horizon. Evaluation uses repeated experiment-wise three-fold validation, with out-of-fold Stage-I scores during Stage-II training to prevent stacked-model optimism. Hotspot dynamics alone achieve Stage-I ROC-AUC 0.945, and the two-stage classifier reaches Stage-II ROC-AUC 0.908, exceeding direct multimodal fusion while preserving an interpretable intermediate instability signal. Thermal gradient rise precedes voltage-based detection by 40 frames (4 seconds) on average, enabling earlier battery management system intervention. Lead-time analysis at a fixed 0.5 threshold yields a 14.8-frame mean lead time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于红外热斑动力学的锂离子电池热失控早期预警方法，面向机械滥用场景。方法分两阶段：先由红外热斑动力学估计局部热不稳定性分数，再将该分数与机械、电气、热和图像强度特征融合，在20帧预警窗口内进行分类。实验采用重复的实验方式三折验证，热斑动力学单独达到Stage-I ROC-AUC 0.945，两阶段分类器达到Stage-II ROC-AUC 0.908，并优于直接多模态融合；热梯度上升平均比电压检测提前40帧（4秒），在固定0.5阈值下平均提前14.8帧。
Motivation: 机械滥用可在传感器信号变得决定性之前通过局部产热触发锂离子电池热失控（TR），现有检测在早期阶段不够及时。需要利用红外热斑动力学捕获局部热不稳定，以提供更早的预警窗口。
Method: 提出两阶段预警方法：第一阶段从红外热斑动力学估计局部热不稳定性分数，第二阶段将该分数与机械、电气、热和图像强度特征融合，用于20帧预警时域内的分类。Stage-II训练时使用折外Stage-I分数以避免堆叠模型乐观偏差，评估采用重复的实验方式三折验证。
Result: 热斑动力学单独实现Stage-I ROC-AUC 0.945，两阶段分类器实现Stage-II ROC-AUC 0.908，超过直接多模态融合，并保留可解释的中间不稳定性信号。热梯度上升平均比基于电压的检测提前40帧（4秒），在固定0.5阈值下的平均预警提前量为14.8帧。
Conclusion: 作者强调，红外热斑动力学与多模态特征的两阶段融合可以在机械滥用场景下实现比直接融合更早、更可解释的热失控预警，有利于电池管理系统更早干预。

papers.title: Decoupled Vision-Language System for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a new architecture design for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), Libra, capable of both multimodal understanding and generation. Libra architecture contains one vision system and one language system, connected by cross-modal bridges. This design decouples self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction, enabling each modality to learn its unique representations while maintaining effective cross-modal comprehension. The decoupling is mainly achieved in a switch attention module and a switch FFN module, which dynamically routes the computation flow for self-modal modeling and cross-modal interaction scenarios. We evaluate the effectiveness in two important settings: \textbf{Libra-1} for the understanding-only image-to-text setting, and \textbf{Libra-2} for unified image-to-text understanding and text-to-image generation. In addition to the architecture design, we discuss various improvements on tokenization, positional encoding, and supervision. Experiments demonstrate that the dedicated Libra design enables mutual improvements on multimodal understanding and generation, achieving strong performance on both understanding and generation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 架构 Libra，同时支持多模态理解与生成。Libra 由一个视觉系统和一个语言系统通过跨模态桥接 (cross-modal bridges) 连接，用 switch attention 模块和 switch FFN 模块动态路由计算流，以解耦自身模态建模与跨模态交互。作者给出两个设置：Libra-1 为纯理解（图像到文本），Libra-2 为统一的图像到文本理解与文本到图像生成。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 通常将多模态理解与生成混合建模，缺少对自身模态建模与跨模态交互的显式解耦，可能限制各模态学习独特表示并影响跨模态理解效率。
Method: 提出 Libra 架构，将视觉系统与语言系统分离，通过跨模态桥接连接；核心是 switch attention 模块和 switch FFN 模块，按需动态路由计算流以区分自模态建模和跨模态交互场景。此外还讨论了 tokenization、位置编码和监督信号方面的改进。
Result: 实验表明，这种解耦设计使多模态理解与生成相互促进，在理解和生成基准上都取得了强性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Libra 的解耦架构能够同时改善多模态理解与生成表现，并在理解（Libra-1）和统一理解-生成（Libra-2）两种设置下验证了有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: EditPPT: Faithful Long-Deck Slide Editing via Structured Tool-Using Multi-Agent with Dual-Modal Validators
papers.abstract_en: Automating slide editing requires simultaneously satisfying modification accuracy, preservation fidelity, and robustness to deck length. Existing LLM-based systems often fail on real-world presentation files because they rely on idealized intermediate representations or open-ended code generation, which are prone to cascading errors in long decks. We introduce EditPPT, a multi-agent framework that reformulates slide editing as a constrained tool-selection problem. By executing localized shape-level operations through the native PowerPoint COM interface, EditPPT narrows the LLM action space while preserving the application-resolved structure of user-authored decks. By separating validation across modalities, our dual-modal validation provides more robust assessment of both instruction fidelity and visual quality. We also present DeckEdit-Bench, a benchmark with 28 human-authored decks, 582 slides, and 183 editing prompts across short, medium, and long deck tiers. Experiments show that EditPPT achieves a 99.5% execution rate, 88.7% slide-targeting F1, 82.5% instruction following, and 91.5% object preservation overall, while maintaining strong performance on long decks. Our code and benchmark are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EditPPT-0E27/
papers.comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables, EMNLP 2026 submitted, under review
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EditPPT，一个多智能体框架，将幻灯片编辑重构为受限的工具选择问题，通过原生 PowerPoint COM 接口执行局部形状级操作，并用双模态验证器分离指令忠实度与视觉质量评估。作者同时提出 DeckEdit-Bench 基准，包含 28 个人工编写的演示文稿、582 张幻灯片和 183 个编辑提示，覆盖短、中、长三档长度。摘要报告执行率 99.5%、幻灯片定位 F1 88.7%、指令跟随 82.5%、对象保留 91.5%，并在长 deck 上保持较强性能。
Motivation: 自动化幻灯片编辑需要同时满足修改准确度、保留保真度以及对 deck 长度的鲁棒性；现有基于 LLM 的系统依赖理想化中间表示或开放式代码生成，在真实长演示文稿中容易产生级联错误。
Method: 将幻灯片编辑建模为受限的工具选择问题，通过 PowerPoint COM 接口执行局部形状级操作，缩小 LLM 的动作空间并保留应用解析出的用户文稿结构；采用跨模态分离的双模态验证（dual-modal validation），分别评估指令跟随与视觉质量；并构建带短/中/长分层的新基准 DeckEdit-Bench。
Result: 摘要报告 EditPPT 整体执行率 99.5%、幻灯片定位 F1 88.7%、指令跟随 82.5%、对象保留 91.5%，且在长 deck 上仍保持强性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为将编辑约束为形状级工具选择并分离验证模态，可提升长 deck 下幻灯片编辑的忠实度与稳健性；代码与基准已公开。

papers.title: Interpretable Information-Decomposed Brain Graph Learning for fMRI-based Disease Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (rs-fMRI) has enabled non-invasive mapping of functional brain interactions for computer-aided diagnosis, yet most existing approaches reduce inter-regional relationships to correlation-based edge weights. Such representations capture co-fluctuation strength but obscure how information is shared across brain regions. Because brain disorders may disrupt not only connectivity strength but also the organization of redundancy, uniqueness and synergy, traditional functional connectivity may miss disease-relevant information structures. Here we introduce IID-GCN, an interpretable graph learning framework that decomposes rs-fMRI interactions into redundancy, uniqueness and synergy graphs using partial entropy decomposition. These information-specific graphs separately characterize shared, region-specific and jointly emergent components of brain activity. A multi-channel graph convolutional network then integrates the decomposed graphs through edge recalibration, cross-information interaction, ROI-attention readout and channel-attentive fusion. Across three datasets, IID-GCN consistently captures complementary diagnostic information beyond traditional functional connectivity. The learned information profiles reveal disorder-specific patterns of altered redundancy, uniqueness and synergy, suggesting that brain diseases reshape functional information organization rather than merely changing connection strength. These results establish information-decomposed brain graphs as an interpretable representation for rs-fMRI-based diagnosis. Our code is available at https://github.com/Zdy12/IID-GCN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IID-GCN，一个可解释的图学习框架，利用部分熵分解 (partial entropy decomposition) 将 rs-fMRI 脑区交互分解为冗余、独特和协同三类信息图，并通过多通道图卷积网络整合用于疾病诊断。摘要称在三个数据集上，该方法能捕获传统功能连接之外的互补诊断信息，并揭示疾病特异的信息组织改变。代码已在 GitHub 公开。
Motivation: 现有 rs-fMRI 诊断方法通常将脑区关系简化为基于相关的边权重，只能刻画共波动强度，却无法区分信息共享中的冗余、独特与协同结构，可能遗漏疾病相关的信息组织异常。
Method: 引入 IID-GCN：先用部分熵分解将 rs-fMRI 交互分解为冗余、独特和协同三种信息图，再通过多通道图卷积网络 (multi-channel GCN) 集成，包括边重标定、跨信息交互、ROI 注意力读出和通道注意力融合。
Result: 在三个数据集上，IID-GCN 一致地捕获了超越传统功能连接的互补诊断信息；学习到的信息剖面显示疾病特异的冗余、独特与协同改变模式。
Conclusion: 摘要认为信息分解脑图可作为 rs-fMRI 诊断的可解释表示，并暗示脑疾病重塑的是功能信息组织而不仅是连接强度。

papers.title: A Survey on Foundations and Frontiers of Multimodal Agentic Frameworks: Techniques and Applications
papers.abstract_en: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have fueled a wave of research into agency: the ability to reason, plan, and act. This effort has produced agentic frameworks that orchestrate perception, memory, and decision-making around powerful LLM backbones. With the advent of large multimodal models (LMMs), these systems can process and integrate diverse modalities, including images, audio, and video, thereby improving their real-world applicability. Yet, while surveys of LLM-based agents exist, the role of multimodality in shaping agency has not been systematically examined in recent years. This survey fills the gap by analyzing the impact of multimodality across the core functional modules of the agentic framework: perception, reasoning, planning, memory, and action. Using this lens, we trace the evolution from text-centric agents to multimodal frameworks, examine how modalities are integrated through delegated, late-fusion, and early-fusion architectures, and assess the emergence of agentic behaviors enabled by grounded perception and multimodal reasoning. We organize existing work through a modality-centric taxonomy that links architectural design choices to agent capabilities. Moreover, we review multimodal agentic systems across various application domains, including Robotics, GUI & Web Navigation, Multimedia Content Generation & Editing, and Long-form Video Understanding & Retrieval. Beyond capabilities, we analyze performance across these settings and discuss efficiency-scalability trade-offs, including training and inference costs, latency, and deployment constraints. By focusing on the impact of multimodality in agentic design, we aim to identify key gaps and chart a roadmap toward robust and general-purpose intelligent systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于多模态智能体框架（multimodal agentic frameworks）的综述，系统分析多模态性如何影响以 LLM/LMM 为核心的智能体的感知、推理、规划、记忆与行动等核心功能模块。作者提出一个以模态为中心的分类法（modality-centric taxonomy），梳理从文本中心智能体到多模态框架的演进，并比较 delegated、late-fusion、early-fusion 等模态集成架构。综述还覆盖 Robotics、GUI & Web Navigation、多媒体生成与编辑、长视频理解与检索等应用领域，并讨论效率与可扩展性之间的权衡。
Motivation: 尽管已有针对基于 LLM 的智能体的综述，但近年来多模态性对智能体能力塑造的作用尚未被系统审视，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 采用以模态为中心的组织方式，围绕智能体框架的核心功能模块分析多模态的影响，考察不同模态集成架构，并汇总多模态智能体系统在多个应用领域的表现与效率问题。

papers.title: Truth Lies Deep: Countering Semantic Camouflage via Latent Intent Verification
papers.abstract_en: Safety alignment in Large Language Models (LLMs) is often superficial, relying on refusal mechanisms that trigger only at the final stages of generation without erasing the foundational knowledge of harmful concepts acquired during pretraining. This study demonstrates that this architectural disconnect leaves models vulnerable to Semantic Camouflage -- adversarial attacks that wrap harmful intent in benign narrative contexts (e.g., creative writing), effectively bypassing standard input and output guardrails. By analyzing the latent activation trajectories of three distinct Small Language Model (SLM) families (Phi-3, Qwen2.5, and Gemma-2b) under adversarial stress, this research identifies a universal ``Intent Horizon'' -- a critical depth (typically 15--20\% of total layers) where the model's distinct, pre-trained representation of harmful intent collapses as it contextualizes the query into a ``safe'' narrative. Results indicate that while late-layer representations of camouflaged attacks are mathematically indistinguishable from safe queries (Detection Rate $< 20\%$), early-layer representations retain a distinct, detectable ``harm signature.'' Leveraging this insight, this paper proposes Latent Intent Verification (LIV), a lightweight probing defense. Experiments on the PKU-SafeRLHF dataset demonstrate that LIV outperforms standard guardrails by a margin of 20--50\% across all tested architectures, effectively neutralizing zero-day semantic attacks without requiring model retraining.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出大语言模型（LLM）的安全对齐往往是表面性的，拒绝机制仅在生成末期触发，并未消除预训练阶段习得的有害概念知识。作者提出“语义伪装”（Semantic Camouflage）攻击，将有害意图包装在良性叙事（如创意写作）中以绕过输入输出护栏。通过分析 Phi-3、Qwen2.5 和 Gemma-2b 三个小语言模型（SLM）家族在对抗压力下的潜在激活轨迹，识别出一个“意图视界”（Intent Horizon）——约 15–20% 层深度处有害意图的表征坍缩为“安全”叙事。基于此提出潜在意图验证（LIV），一种轻量探测防御，在 PKU-SafeRLHF 数据集上比标准护栏的检测性能高 20–50%，且无需重新训练模型。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 安全对齐依赖只在生成末端触发的拒绝机制，无法清除预训练中获得的有害概念知识，导致模型容易被语义伪装这类对抗攻击绕过。
Method: 通过分析 Phi-3、Qwen2.5 和 Gemma-2b 在对抗压力下的激活轨迹，发现“意图视界”位于总层数约 15–20% 的深度，早期层保留可检测的“危害签名”（harm signature），而晚期层与安全查询在数学上不可区分。据此提出 LIV，一种利用早期层表征进行意图验证的轻量探测防御。
Result: 实验表明，伪装攻击的晚期层表征检测率低于 20%，而早期层保留可辨别的危害签名。LIV 在 PKU-SafeRLHF 数据集上比标准护栏领先 20–50%，并能中和零日（zero-day）语义攻击，且无需重新训练模型。
Conclusion: 摘要强调安全对齐需要从早期层表征入手，LIV 提供了一种无需重训练的轻量防御方案，可有效抵御语义伪装与零日攻击。

papers.title: If It Walks Like an Arbitrage: Protocol-Agnostic Detection with Decidable Structural Equivalence
papers.abstract_en: Ethereum transactions admit a canonical structural form. Each execution trace is built into an abstract syntax tree of token transfers grouped by call-frame nesting and reduced by a convergent term rewriting system of 15 rules to a unique canonical form. The system is terminating, sound, and confluent, and the induced structural equivalence on fund flows is decidable. All five properties are mechanized in Rocq with zero admitted obligations. The canonical form makes structural questions about fund flows decidable, opening the way to strategy-family classification, bot fingerprinting, and equivalence-based attribution. In this paper, we demonstrate the canonical form on arbitrage detection: cycles emerge at fixpoint and are read off the canonical form, with no protocol-specific patterns. The pipeline depends only on the standard ERC token and WETH ABIs and no protocol-specific events, so the same binary runs unmodified on Arbitrum and BSC. We evaluate on 220 000 Ethereum blocks against Eigenphi (production MEV platform) and on 1 000 shared blocks against ArbiNet (GNN classifier). The system produces 469 801 confirmed detections and 245 497 attempted arbitrages; across all detections it agrees with Eigenphi on 83.5% and covers 81% of ArbiNet, while surfacing 60 199 exclusive confirmed detections. 99.2% of all detections are produced by the fixpoint alone and are sound by construction. Manual validation of 500 transactions finds no false positives in the confirmed tier. Forensic reanalysis of 200 Eigenphi-exclusive detections finds 63.5% have no cycle in canonical form; 9.0% have cycles the fixpoint detects but our conservative classifier does n
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将每一条以太坊交易执行轨迹中的代币转移构建为按调用帧嵌套分组的抽象语法树，并用一个由15条规则组成的收敛项重写系统归约到唯一规范形式；该结构等价性可判定，且终止性、可靠性、合流性等性质在Rocq中机械验证、零admitted义务。论文将该规范形式用于协议无关的套利检测，环在不动点处浮现并可读自规范形式，无需任何协议特定模式。实验在220,000个以太坊区块上对照Eigenphi、在1,000个共享区块上对照ArbiNet，并附有大规模确认检测与人工验证结果。
Motivation: 现有套利检测通常依赖协议特定的事件或模式，难以推广到不同链和不同协议；论文希望让资金流动的结构性问题（如是否存在套利环）变得可判定，从而支持策略族分类、机器人指纹识别和基于等价性的归因。
Method: 利用以太坊交易固有的规范结构，将执行轨迹构建为代币转移的AST，再用15条收敛项重写规则归约为唯一规范形式。该归约系统被证明是可终止、可靠、合流的，因而诱导的结构等价性可判定；随后通过不动点计算在规范形式上读出环，套利检测不依赖协议特定事件，只依赖标准ERC token与WETH ABI，同一二进制可无修改地运行在Arbitrum和BSC上。
Result: 在220,000个以太坊区块上与Eigenphi对比、在1,000个共享区块上与ArbiNet对比，系统产生469,801个确认检测和245,497个尝试套利；所有检测中与Eigenphi一致率为83.5%，覆盖ArbiNet的81%，另有60,199个独占的确认检测。99.2%的检测由不动点单独产生且按构造可靠；人工验证500笔交易在确认层未发现假阳性；对200个Eigenphi独占检测的重分析中，63.5%在规范形式下没有环。
Conclusion: 规范形式使关于资金流动的结构性问题可判定，可支撑策略族分类、机器人指纹识别与基于等价性的归因；该流水线仅依赖标准ABI且跨链无需修改，但在保守分类器上仍存在与外部平台的差异（部分Eigenphi独占检测在规范形式下无环），说明不同检测范式之间需要进一步对齐。

papers.title: TH-GNN: Heterogeneous Temporal Graph Neural Networks for LLM-Agent Shilling Attack Detection
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents can now generate realistic shilling profiles, fluent reviews, and coherent ratings at scale, systematically defeating recommender-system defenses. Text-only detectors that flag semantic drift in review embeddings are blind to graph structure and temporal coordination, while graph-only detectors that exploit neighborhood anomalies cannot reason over review semantics or the cross-modal inconsistencies produced by LLM-generated content. We propose TH-GNN, a heterogeneous temporal graph neural network with a two-layer Heterogeneous Graph Transformer backbone that applies per-type and per-relation attention augmented with learnable sinusoidal temporal encodings on every edge. Cross-modal attention fuses structural user embeddings with frozen RoBERTa representations of reviews and item descriptions, while a GRU operating over log inter-arrival times captures temporal burstiness. Evaluated across five attack families and four benchmark datasets, TH-GNN achieves a grand-mean F1 score of 0.870, outperforming the strongest text-only baseline on Agent4SR attacks by 10.9 percentage points and 11.5 percentage points at the lowest injection rate. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly modeling temporal, structural, and semantic signals for detecting sophisticated LLM-driven shilling attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TH-GNN，一个异构时序图神经网络，用于检测 LLM 智能体批量生成的 shilling 攻击（虚假评论与评分）。方法以两层 Heterogeneous Graph Transformer 为骨干，在每条边上施加带可学习正弦时间编码的逐类型、逐关系注意力，并用跨模态注意力融合冻结 RoBERTa 的文本表征。在五个攻击家族和四个基准数据集上，TH-GNN 取得 grand-mean F1 0.870，在 Agent4SR 攻击上以最低注入率超过最强文本基线 10.9 和 11.5 个百分点。
Motivation: LLM 智能体能规模化生成逼真的 shilling 画像、流畅评论和一致评分，系统性击穿推荐系统防御。纯文本检测器只看审查向量语义漂移，忽略图结构与时间协同；纯图检测器利用邻域异常，却无法推理评论语义或 LLM 内容导致的跨模态不一致。
Method: TH-GNN 采用两层 Heterogeneous Graph Transformer 主干，对每条边应用加入可学习正弦时序编码的 per-type 与 per-relation 注意力；跨模态注意力将结构用户嵌入与冻结 RoBERTa 表征的评论和物品描述融合，同时用 GRU 对 log 间隔到达时间建模以捕捉时序爆发性。
Result: 在五个攻击家族和四个公开数据集上，TH-GNN 的 grand-mean F1 达到 0.870；针对 Agent4SR 攻击，在最低注入率下分别比最强文本基线高出 10.9 个百分点和 11.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合建模时序、结构与语义信号对检测复杂 LLM 驱动的 shilling 攻击的有效性；但未讨论对自适应攻击、真实平台部署等场景下的泛化局限。

papers.title: VA-DPO: Valence-Arousal Direct Preference Optimization for Controllable Emotion Generation in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: How precisely can we tell a language model how to feel? Most work on emotional generation answers with a discrete label - happy, angry, sad - which cannot express a target like "mildly downcast but calm." We instead specify the desired affect as a continuous point (v*, a*) in the Valence-Arousal plane and train the model to hit it. Our method, VA-DPO, is a small modification to Direct Preference Optimization: a frozen VA regressor scores each sampled generation by its Euclidean distance to the target, we keep only candidate pairs whose distance gap clears a margin tau, and we optimize a LoRA adapter with the ordinary DPO loss against a frozen reference. The DPO objective itself is unchanged; what is new is how the preference data is built. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct this cuts mean VA distance to the target by 33% over system-prompting and 25% over few-shot prompting, lifting valence/arousal correlation to r_v=0.93 and r_a=0.75. The gains carry over to Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.2-3B, and they do not come at the usual price: MMLU is unchanged (Delta=+0.0) and HellaSwag and TruthfulQA are preserved. We release the code, configs, and the preference-construction pipeline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VA-DPO，一种针对语言模型可控情感生成的偏好优化方法。作者在 Valence-Arousal（效价-唤醒）平面上用连续目标点 (v*, a*) 指定期望情感，用冻结的 VA 回归器为采样生成按欧氏距离打分，仅保留距离差超过阈值 tau 的候选对来构建偏好数据，再以普通 DPO loss 优化 LoRA adapter。摘要报告在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上相比 system prompting 将平均 VA 距离降低 33%，相比 few-shot prompting 降低 25%，valence 与 arousal 相关系数分别达 r_v=0.93 与 r_a=0.75，且 MMLU、HellaSwag、TruthfulQA 等通用能力保持。
Motivation: 现有情感生成大多使用 happy、angry、sad 这类离散标签，无法表达像 “mildly downcast but calm” 这样的细粒度情感目标；需要一种能够以连续情感坐标进行精确控制的方法。
Method: 在 Valence-Arousal 平面上把目标情感指定为连续点 (v*, a*)；冻结的 VA 回归器对每个采样生成按到目标的欧氏距离打分；只保留距离差超过 margin tau 的候选对作为偏好数据；随后用标准 DPO loss 优化 LoRA adapter，参考模型保持冻结。DPO 目标本身未改动，创新点在于偏好数据的构造方式。
Result: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，平均 VA 距离较 system prompting 降低 33%，较 few-shot prompting 降低 25%，valence/arousal 相关系数达到 r_v=0.93、r_a=0.75；效果迁移到 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.2-3B；MMLU 不变（Delta=+0.0），HellaSwag 与 TruthfulQA 保持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过带距离间隔的偏好对构造，可以在不牺牲通用能力的前提下实现细粒度连续情感控制，并开源代码、配置和偏好构建流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Edge-Based Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Autonomous FHWA Bridge Inspection Compliance
papers.abstract_en: The Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) mandates that over 600,000 bridges in the United States be evaluated against the Recording and Coding Guide for the National Bridge Inventory (NBI). Manual compliance verification is labor-intensive, error-prone, and impractical in connectivity-limited field environments. This paper introduces BridgeGuard, a fully air-gapped agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for autonomous bridge inspection compliance. BridgeGuard integrates vector search over the FHWA Recording and Coding Guide with structured SQL queries against NBI tabular data, orchestrated by a stateful multi-step ReAct planning loop executing locally on commodity edge hardware. A section-aware chunking algorithm preserves hierarchical regulatory item boundaries, achieving 94.2% chunk integrity compared with 28.4% for naive fixed-size splitting. Evaluated on the full Delaware 2023 NBI inventory (874 bridges) and a Texas sample (200 bridges), the system achieves 99.77% and 100.0% classification accuracy, respectively, for Structurally Deficient bridge identification, with 100.0% citation accuracy, at 197.0 bridges per hour with out external network access. Ablation experiments confirm that both vector search and the multi-step agentic loop are necessary for correct compliance reasoning.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Pre-print submitted to the ASCE Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering. Code and data available at: https://github.com/virajdarji/bridgeguard
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BridgeGuard，一个完全离线（air-gapped）的智能体检索增强生成（agentic RAG）系统，用于 FHWA 桥梁检查合规判定。系统将 FHWA Recording and Coding Guide 的向量检索与 NBI 表格数据的 SQL 查询结合，并由本地边缘硬件上运行的多步 ReAct 规划循环编排。在 Delaware 2023 年全部 874 座桥梁和 Texas 的 200 座桥梁样本上，系统对 Structurally Deficient 桥梁识别分别达到 99.77% 和 100.0% 的准确率，引文准确率 100.0%，吞吐量为 197.0 座桥/小时且无需外部网络访问。消融实验表明向量检索与多步智能体循环对正确合规推理均必不可少。
Motivation: FHWA 要求对美国超过 60 万座桥梁依据 NBI 记录与编码指南进行评估，人工合规核查劳动密集、易出错，且在联网受限的现场环境中不切实际。
Method: BridgeGuard 集成对 FHWA Recording and Coding Guide 的向量搜索（vector search）与针对 NBI 表格数据的结构化 SQL 查询，由在商用边缘硬件上本地执行的有状态多步 ReAct 规划循环（ReAct planning loop）统一调度；采用保留层级监管条目边界的 section-aware 分块算法。
Result: section-aware 分块达到 94.2% 的块完整性（chunk integrity），而朴素固定大小切分仅为 28.4%；在 Delaware 2023 全量库存（874 座桥）上分类准确率 99.77%，在 Texas 样本（200 座桥）上为 100.0%，引文准确率 100.0%，处理速度 197.0 座桥/小时且无外部网络访问；消融实验确认向量检索与多步 agentic loop 均不可或缺。
Conclusion: 论文表明，一个完全离线的边缘端 RAG 系统可以在自主桥梁检查合规判定中实现高准确率与可靠引文，其评估范围限定于 NBI 数据及所测试的两个州库存。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Do LLMs Replace Fine-Tuned NLU? A Decision Framework for Intent Detection in Production Conversational Systems
papers.abstract_en: A common claim is that zero-shot large language models (LLMs) can replace fine-tuned NLU classifiers for intent detection. We test this claim head-to-head and find that the honest answer is: it depends on the intent space. On full ATIS and CLINC150 we compare a fine-tuned RoBERTa, a TF-IDF+logistic-regression baseline, sentence-embedding kNN, and Claude Haiku zero-shot, reporting bootstrap 95% confidence intervals and paired significance tests. When abundant in-domain labels exist, fine-tuned RoBERTa is as good or better and three orders of magnitude cheaper and faster: on ATIS it beats Claude zero-shot by 11.8 points (95.9 vs. 84.1, p<0.001). On the broad 150-intent CLINC150 schema the two are statistically tied (89.1 vs. 88.5, p=0.24): the LLM matches a fully supervised model with no training data. The LLM's advantages appear in three production-relevant regimes: out-of-scope detection (OOS recall 85.6 vs. 58.1 for RoBERTa); robustness to realistic ASR noise via a controlled text-to-speech to noise to Whisper pipeline (92.5 vs. 80.0 at 0 dB); and dynamic per-deployment schemas, where a classifier trained on one app's intents scores 0% on a new app's intents while the schema-prompted LLM serves both at ~94% with zero retraining. We distill these findings into a decision framework for practitioners.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 ATIS 与 CLINC150 上对比微调 RoBERTa、TF-IDF+逻辑回归、句子向量 kNN 与 Claude Haiku 零样本意图识别，检验“零样本 LLM 可取代微调 NLU”这一常见说法。结论是取决于意图空间：当领域内标注充足时微调模型更优且便宜/快三个数量级；在 150 意图的 CLINC150 上两者统计持平；LLM 的优势集中在 OOS 检测、ASR 噪声鲁棒性和动态 per-deployment schema 场景，作者据此给出面向实践者的决策框架。
Motivation: 针对“零样本大语言模型可以替代微调 NLU 分类器”的常见说法缺乏严格的 head-to-head 检验，生产对话系统从业者需要知道在何种条件下可以替换、何时应保留微调模型。
Method: 采用直接对比实验，包括微调 RoBERTa、TF-IDF+逻辑回归、句子向量 kNN 与 Claude Haiku 零样本，报告 bootstrap 95% 置信区间和配对显著性检验；并通过受控的 TTS→噪声→Whisper 管道构造 ASR 噪声鲁棒性测试，以及设计动态 per-deployment schema（每个部署应用独立意图集）场景。
Result: ATIS 上微调 RoBERTa 以 95.9 对 84.1 超过 Claude 零样本（p<0.001），且便宜且快三个数量级；CLINC150 上两者统计持平（89.1 vs 88.5，p=0.24）。LLM 的显著优势出现在：OOS 检测 recall 85.6 vs 58.1；0 dB ASR 噪声下 92.5 vs 80.0；跨 schema 场景中针对某个 app 意图训练的微调分类器在新 app 上得 0%，而 schema-prompted LLM 无需重训即可在两个 app 上均达约 94%。
Conclusion: 作者强调“是否能用 LLM 取代微调 NLU”取决于意图空间的具体形态，并将发现蒸馏为面向生产对话系统的决策框架；LLM 的价值主要体现在 OOS 检测、ASR 噪声鲁棒性和动态 schema 这三类生产相关场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ASTAR: Automated induction of STAndardized radiology Reporting templates from large-scale clinical free-text corpora
papers.abstract_en: Structured reporting converts free-text radiology narratives into queryable data keys, facilitating cohort assembly, longitudinal tracking, and training label generation for medical AI. The prevailing paradigm follows a two-stage pipeline: (1) constructing a reporting template, (2) extracting information to populate it. While the extraction stage has benefited from advances in large language models (LLMs), template construction remains a manual bottleneck relying on labor-intensive expert consensus that is static, difficult to scale, and may fail to capture real-world reporting diversity. We address this limitation with \textbf{\texttt{ASTAR}}, an LLM-based framework for Automated induction of STAndardized radiology Reporting templates from large-scale clinical free-text corpora. Extensive experiments on 4,215 fetal brain MRI reports from multiple centers demonstrate that the \textbf{\texttt{ASTAR}}-induced template surpasses two expert-curated templates across template coverage, information fidelity, diagnostic fidelity, and expert-rated usability, reducing template development from weeks of committee deliberation to hours of automated processing. Code: https://github.com/birthlab/ASTAR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ASTAR，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，用于从大规模临床自由文本语料库中自动归纳标准化放射学报告模板。在 4215 份多中心胎儿脑 MRI 报告上的实验表明，ASTAR 诱导的模板在模板覆盖率、信息保真度、诊断保真度和专家评定可用性上均优于两个专家人工构建的模板，并将模板开发时间从数周委员会讨论缩短为数小时自动处理。
Motivation: 结构化报告目前遵循两阶段流程：先构建报告模板，再抽取信息填充。抽取阶段已受益于 LLM，但模板构建仍依赖耗时的人工专家共识，静态、难以扩展，且可能无法捕捉真实世界中的报告多样性。
Method: ASTAR 是基于 LLM 的自动化报告模板归纳框架，输入大规模临床自由文本语料，输出标准化报告模板，用以替代人工专家委员会的手工模板构建流程。
Result: 在 4215 份来自多中心的胎儿脑 MRI 报告上，ASTAR 诱导的模板在模板覆盖率、信息保真度、诊断保真度和专家评定可用性四项指标上均超过两个专家人工模板；开发周期从数周委员会讨论缩短为数小时自动处理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LLM 驱动的自动化模板归纳能够解决人工模板构建的可扩展性瓶颈，并更真实地反映临床报告多样性；该工作已被 MICCAI 接收。

papers.title: A Hybrid Edge Cloud Digital Twin for Welfare-Constrained Control in Poultry Production
papers.abstract_en: Poultry production operates under tightly coupled environmental and biological dynamics, yet commercial climate control remains largely heuristic, limiting welfare assurance and operational efficiency. We introduce an edge-cloud digital twin framework for real-time, welfare-constrained environmental control in poultry facilities. The framework integrates distributed sensing, on-device state estimation, a hybrid physics-data model, and model predictive control to enable anticipatory and adaptive management under practical farm constraints. A grey-box thermodynamic and mass-balance formulation is augmented with a learned residual that captures unmodeled biological variability, including activity-dependent metabolic heat. This hybrid model is embedded within a state-space representation for real-time estimation and control at the edge, while cloud coordination supports cross-farm learning and long-horizon optimization. Bandwidth-aware processing and asynchronous synchronization enable deployment in connectivity-limited environments. Evaluation in a high-fidelity broiler production testbed demonstrates substantial gains over rule-based control and physics-only modeling. Temperature prediction error is reduced from 1.8 degrees Celsius to 0.4 degrees Celsius, ammonia constraint violations decrease by 90 percent, and communication requirements are lowered approximately 30-fold through edge-first processing. A Domain Transfer Score of 0.92 further indicates strong robustness across facility conditions. These results show that physically grounded digital twins, coupled with real-time control, enable scalable and welfare-aware management of biological production systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向家禽生产的边云协同数字孪生框架，用于实时、福利约束的环境控制。框架结合分布式感知、设备端状态估计、混合物理-数据模型与模型预测控制，采用灰箱热力学与质量平衡公式，并加入学习残差来捕获未建模的生物变异性。在肉鸡生产测试台上，该方法相比基于规则的控制和纯物理建模显著降低了温度预测误差、氨气约束违规次数和通信需求。
Motivation: 家禽生产受紧密耦合的环境与生物动态影响，但商业气候控制仍主要依赖启发式规则，难以同时保证动物福利和运营效率。
Method: 提出边-云数字孪生架构：边缘端执行灰箱热力学与质量平衡建模，叠加学习残差以刻画活动相关代谢热等生物变异；模型嵌入状态空间表示用于边缘实时估计与控制，云端协调支持跨农场学习与长时域优化，并采用带宽感知处理和异步同步以适应弱连接环境。
Result: 在高保真肉鸡生产测试台上，温度预测误差从1.8摄氏度降至0.4摄氏度，氨气约束违规减少90%，通信需求因边缘优先处理降低约30倍；Domain Transfer Score为0.92，表明跨设施条件的鲁棒性较强。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于物理的数字孪生结合实时控制，能够为生物生产系统提供可扩展且福利感知的管理方案。

papers.title: Harmonic Torsional Diffusion for Protein-Ligand Flexible Docking
papers.abstract_en: Molecular docking requires reasoning jointly about ligand pose and protein flexibility. Most diffusion-based docking models predict torsional updates with generic Euclidean heads that ignore the periodic geometry of angular variables. This mismatch is especially limiting in flexible docking, where ligand conformations and pocket side chains co-adapt to form the bound complex. Here, we introduce Harmony, a harmonic torsional diffusion framework for flexible protein-ligand docking. Harmony parameterizes ligand and side-chain torsional score fields as derivatives of learned harmonic potentials on the circle, whose noise-level dependence is supplied analytically by the heat semigroup of variance-exploding diffusion on the torus. This construction makes periodicity explicit and gives the model a frequency-aware inductive bias over rotameric motion. On the PDBBind benchmark, Harmony improves ligand pose accuracy and pocket all-atom reconstruction over recent flexible docking methods. On PoseBusters, it improves the physical validity of generated complexes. Case studies on EBNA1 and KRAS G12D illustrate the method's behavior on a polar and a shallow binding site, respectively. Together, these results indicate that aligning the score parameterization with the geometry of the diffusion process is a simple and effective lever for improving flexible docking.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2026 Workshop on Generative and Agentic AI for Biology (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Harmony，一种用于柔性蛋白-配体对接的谐波扭转扩散框架。它将配体和侧链的扭转分数场参数化为圆上学习的谐波势的导数，其噪声依赖由环面上方差爆炸扩散的热半群解析给出，从而显式利用周期性并引入频率感知的归纳偏置。在 PDBBind 基准上，Harmony 在配体姿态精度和口袋全原子重建上优于最近的柔性对接方法；在 PoseBusters 上提升生成复合物的物理有效性。EBNA1 与 KRAS G12D 案例分别展示了其在极性和浅结合位点上的行为。
Motivation: 大多数基于扩散的对接模型使用通用欧几里得头部预测扭转更新，忽略角度变量的周期几何；这种不匹配在柔性对接中尤其受限，因为配体构象和口袋侧链需要共同适应才能形成结合复合物。
Method: Harmony 将配体和侧链扭转分数场参数化为圆上学习的谐波势的导数，噪声级依赖由环面上 variance-exploding diffusion 的热半群解析提供，使周期性显式化，并为模型赋予关于转子运动的频率感知归纳偏置。
Result: 在 PDBBind 基准上，Harmony 改善配体姿态精度和口袋全原子重建，优于最近的柔性对接方法；在 PoseBusters 上改善生成复合物的物理有效性。EBNA1 和 KRAS G12D 案例研究分别展示了该方法在极性和浅结合位点上的行为。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将分数参数化与扩散过程的几何对齐是改善柔性对接的一个简单且有效的杠杆。

papers.title: Trilingual Topic Modeling of Sri Lankan Parliamentary Debates
papers.abstract_en: Sri Lankan parliamentary debates (Hansards) constitute a trilingual corpus of speeches in Sinhala, Tamil, and English, including code-mixed content, yet remain inaccessible to standard NLP pipelines due to layout-complex PDFs, multilingual scripts, and agglutinative morphology. We present an end-to-end framework that addresses these challenges through LLM-based text extraction followed by a multilingual embedding and density-based clustering pipeline for topic modeling. A hybrid semantic-lexical extension, BiTopic, is further explored to improve interpretability and recover speeches otherwise discarded as noise. Applied to 19,553 speeches spanning 2017-2026, the pipeline recovers 30 macro-topics achieving a cluster purity (BCP) of 0.673, whose temporal trajectories align unsupervised with major national events including the 2019 Easter Sunday attacks and the 2022 economic crisis. Traditional LDA fails on this corpus due to cross-lingual fragmentation, whereas the proposed approach successfully identifies thematic structure across all three languages without supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端框架，用于对斯里兰卡议会辩论（Hansard）这一三语语料（僧伽罗语、泰米尔语、英语，含语码混合内容）进行主题建模。流程先用基于 LLM 的文本提取处理版式复杂的 PDF，再用多语言嵌入和基于密度的聚类发现主题；此外提出混合语义-词汇扩展 BiTopic 以提升可解释性并回收被当作噪声丢弃的演讲。在 2017-2026 年共 19,553 段演讲上，该方法恢复出 30 个宏观主题，聚类纯度（BCP）为 0.673，且主题的时间轨迹与 2019 年复活节爆炸案、2022 年经济危机等重大国家事件在无监督条件下吻合。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡议会辩论语料包含三种语言与语码混合内容，且受版式复杂的 PDF、多语言文字系统和黏着语形态影响，标准 NLP 流程无法直接处理；传统 LDA 因跨语言碎片化在该语料上失效，需要不需要监督的跨语言主题结构发现方法。
Method: 框架首先使用基于 LLM 的文本提取来解析复杂 PDF，随后采用多语言嵌入（multilingual embedding）与基于密度的聚类流程进行主题建模；为增强可解释性并找回被当作噪声丢弃的演讲，进一步探索了混合语义-词汇扩展 BiTopic。
Result: 在 19,553 段演讲（2017-2026）上，该流程恢复出 30 个宏观主题，聚类纯度（BCP）为 0.673；主题时间轨迹无监督地对齐了 2019 年复活节爆炸案与 2022 年经济危机等事件。传统 LDA 因跨语言碎片化在该语料上失败，而所提方法能在三种语言上无监督地识别主题结构。
Conclusion: 作者认为该流水线能够在不依赖监督的情况下跨三种语言识别主题结构，而传统 LDA 无法处理该语料；摘要侧重于方法有效性，未给出超出这些语料与指标外的泛化性声明。

papers.title: Hadith computational science in the age of large language models: a critical narrative review
authors: Riasat Islam (1 and 2) ((1) Greentech Apps Foundation
papers.abstract_en: We examine how hadith computational science is being reshaped by transformer models, retrieval-grounded pipelines, and large language models (LLMs). Recent reviews document growth in the literature, but they do not yet provide a critical account of which advances are methodologically robust, which remain benchmark-bound, and which unresolved problems still limit scholarly use. We address this gap through a critical narrative review that combines critique of existing reviews, paper-level appraisal of representative original studies, and synthesis of Islamic scholar and domain-expert perspectives on authenticity, authority, and responsible use. We find uneven progress. Data resources have expanded, segmentation tasks have matured, narrator and source-verification problems are better formalized, and LLM-assisted workflows now support corpus-scale enrichment, multilingual access, and grounded evaluation. At the same time, progress remains constrained by narrow corpora, weak benchmark comparability, synthetic-to-real transfer gaps, narrator identity resolution, preprocessing fragility, limited reproducibility, and sparse expert-grounded validation. We show that important gaps lie beyond dominant benchmarks: non-canonical and obscure corpora, commentary and explanatory literature, cross-source links with Qur'an and seerah, and fiqh-facing evidence support. We argue that hadith computation should be assessed less as isolated model performance than as an evidence infrastructure problem requiring knowledge integration, provenance, and expert supervision. On this basis, we define a research agenda for making the field methodologically stronger and more useful to Islamic scholarship.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于圣训计算科学 (hadith computational science) 在大型语言模型时代发展的批判性叙述综述，考察 Transformer 模型、检索增强流水线和 LLM 如何重塑该领域。作者发现进展不均衡：数据资源扩展、分段任务成熟、叙事者与来源验证问题得到更好形式化，LLM 辅助工作流支持语料库规模扩充、多语言访问和接地评估；但进展仍受限于狭窄语料库、基准可比性弱、合成到真实迁移差距、叙事者身份消解、预处理脆弱性、可复现性有限以及专家接地验证稀疏。
Motivation: 现有综述记录了文献增长，但尚未对哪些进展在方法上稳健、哪些仍受限于基准、哪些未解决问题限制学术使用提供批判性说明，本文针对这一空白展开。
Method: 采用批判性叙述综述方法，结合对已有综述的评论、对代表性原始研究的论文级评估，以及对伊斯兰学者和领域专家关于真实性、权威性和负责任使用观点的综合。
Result: 摘要报告了不均衡的进展并列出具体瓶颈，同时指出重要空白位于主流基准之外，包括非正典和冷门语料库、注释与解释性文献、与 Qur'an 和 seerah 的跨源链接，以及面向 fiqh 的证据支持。
Conclusion: 作者主张圣训计算不应被视为孤立的模型性能问题，而应作为需要知识整合、溯源和专家监督的证据基础设施问题，并据此定义了使该领域方法上更强且对伊斯兰学术更有用的研究议程。

papers.title: Multilingual Verifier Bias in RLVR: Benchmark, Rollout Diagnosis, and the Cross-Lingual Selection Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is a standard recipe for training large language models on mathematical reasoning, where an answer verifier serves as a language-neutral reward function. We show that this assumption fails in multilingual settings: an exact-match verifier turns format and script variation into language-dependent false-negative reward noise. We introduce a reusable protocol for auditing multilingual RLVR rewards: a verifier-robustness suite, a rollout-diagnosis procedure, and language-conditioned reward-error metrics for Japanese, English, and Chinese answers. On MGSM rollouts with k=8, the exact-match proxy rejects trusted-correct answers at sharply different rates by language across Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; for Qwen3-8B, the false-negative rate reaches 0.642 on JP against 0.122 on EN and 0.073 on CN. A plain-numeric probe localizes the mechanism to the final-answer interface: an interface model drives reward-error VLB to zero while the residual accuracy gap is unchanged. We then expose a cross-lingual selection bottleneck: on MGSM250 rollouts, a target-local aggregation rule using no trusted labels closes 55-78% of the average selection gap, and over 95% of repairs require genuine cross-lingual support. The bottleneck replicates on a 483-problem MATH-500 set. A controlled training audit shows that rule-GRPO raises trusted accuracy while the reward-error VLB stays high. The unifying message is operational: multilingual RLVR rewards should be audited by language and by answer interface before they are optimized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多语言环境下 RLVR（Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards）的验证器偏差问题，指出 exact-match 验证器并非语言中立的奖励函数，格式与脚本差异会变成语言相关的假阴性奖励噪声。作者提出一套可复用审计协议，包括 verifier-robustness 套件、rollout-diagnosis 流程和针对日语、英语、中文答案的语言条件化奖励误差指标，并在 Qwen3 系列和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上展示了跨语言假阴性率差异及跨语言选择瓶颈。
Motivation: RLVR 通常将答案验证器视为语言中立的奖励函数，但这一假设在多语言数学推理场景下不成立；格式和脚本差异会以不同速率拒绝正确回答，导致奖励信号按语言产生系统性偏差，从而影响策略优化。
Method: 引入可复用的多语言 RLVR 奖励审计协议：包含 verifier-robustness 测试套件、rollout-diagnosis 程序，以及针对日语、英语、中文答案的语言条件化 reward-error 指标；并用 plain-numeric probe 定位机制，提出 target-local aggregation rule 与 rule-GRPO 训练审计。

papers.title: Toward Auto-Research: Mining Falsifiable Research Ideas from Paper Knowledge Graphs with Categorical Structure
papers.abstract_en: Automated research-idea generation systems built on large language models (LLMs) share a structural weakness: they reduce ideation to free-text recombination, random paper pairing, or embedding-similarity retrieval. The three approaches fail in the same way: each treats a paper as a flat object, a string or a vector, and so quotients away the typed problem-method-metric-claim arrows a researcher actually uses when reasoning about a cross-domain analogy. We recover the missing structure with the minimal piece of category theory that a typed graph alone does not provide: composition, together with identity arrows, which makes it possible to ask whether a proposed analogy preserves relation chains. Concretely, each paper $p$ is modelled as a small category $C_p$ whose objects are extracted typed research entities and whose morphisms are the relations the paper asserts; a cross-paper bridge from $p$ to $q$ is then a partial functor candidate $F: C_p -> C_q$ that preserves object kinds and covered relation classes. We instantiate the model as a three-layer algorithm: categorical signature clustering, a functor-preservation gate, and a six-axis LLM plausibility judge. Evaluated on a corpus of tens of thousands of full-text-parsed papers under four ablation conditions, the categorical gate filters cross-domain candidates at roughly a 17:1 ratio while the quantitative-falsifier rate of accepted ideas stays above 83% throughout; every rejected candidate is retained with its per-axis rationale, so the gate doubles as a logging layer rather than a silent filter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将论文知识图谱中的跨论文类比构造从扁平文本/向量匹配升级为范畴论结构：每篇论文建模为一个小范畴，对象是抽取的研究实体，态射是论文断言的关系；跨论文桥是保持对象类型与关系类的部分函子候选。算法分三层：范畴签名聚类、函子保持门控、六轴LLM合理性判定。在数万篇全文解析论文和四种消融条件下，门控以约17:1比率过滤跨域候选，被接受想法的定量可证伪率保持在83%以上。
Motivation: 现有LLM自动研究想法生成系统把论文视为字符串或向量，丢失研究者推理跨域类比时实际使用的类型化问题-方法-指标-主张关系箭头，导致想法生成退化为自由文本重组、随机配对或嵌入相似度检索。
Method: 将每篇论文p建模为小范畴C_p，对象为抽取的类型化研究实体，态射为论文断言的关系；候选跨论文桥定义为部分函子F: C_p -> C_q，要求保持对象种类与覆盖的关系类。实现为三层流水线：范畴签名聚类、函子保持门控、六轴LLM合理性判定。
Result: 在数万篇全文解析论文上，函子保持门控以约17:1的比率过滤跨域候选，同时被接受想法的定量可证伪率（quantitative-falsifier rate）始终高于83%；每个被拒候选保留其逐轴理由。
Conclusion: 摘要强调门控并非静默过滤器，而是同时作为日志层保留每个被拒候选的各轴判断理由，使自动研究想法生成过程可审计、可解释，并借此维持想法的可证伪性。

papers.title: TriPLU: Bypassing the Gate with Direct Trilinear Product FFNs in Tiny Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We study whether tiny decoder-only language models benefit from feed-forward layers that directly multiply learned feature projections. TriPLU, a Trilinear Product Linear Unit, replaces the usual gated FFN branch with a product-only degree-3 branch that multiplies three projected streams coordinatewise. In a character-level TinyStories 1M-byte prefix study, TriPLU reaches a mean best validation loss of 1.0637, compared with 1.1017 for closely matched SwiGLU, 1.0780 for a degree-4 product control, and 1.1026 for a degree-2 control. In train-only Byte-BPE experiments, TriPLU also lowers validation and heldout bits per byte on TinyStories and WikiText-2 raw under low-learning-rate settings, with PMI-slice evidence suggesting gains on seen middle- and high-PMI adjacent-token pairs. Constant-learning-rate diagnostics show that product-branch normalization can reduce the high-learning-rate best-checkpoint gap, although final BPB still degrades under hot schedules. The resulting claim is deliberately narrow: direct product FFNs can improve fixed-budget small-model loss in specific low-compute regimes, but the branch is optimization-sensitive and does not establish FLOP-normalized efficiency, scaling behavior, or broad LLM performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究极小型 decoder-only 语言模型中，用直接三线性乘积的前馈层替代常见门控 FFN 的效果。所提出的 TriPLU（Trilinear Product Linear Unit）将门控分支替换为三个投影流的逐元素乘积（degree-3）分支。在字符级 TinyStories 1M-byte 前缀实验中，TriPLU 取得均值最佳验证损失 1.0637，优于相近配置的 SwiGLU（1.1017）、degree-4 乘积控制（1.0780）和 degree-2 控制（1.1026）；在仅训练的 Byte-BPE 实验中，低学习率设置下也降低了 TinyStories 和 WikiText-2 raw 的验证与留出 bits per byte。作者明确将结论限定为：直接乘积 FFN 能在特定低计算预算下改善小模型损失，但该分支对优化敏感，并未建立 FLOP 归一化效率、扩展行为或广泛 LLM 性能。
Motivation: 现有小语言模型常用带门控的 FFN 分支，本文想验证直接乘以多个学习到的特征投影（而不经过门控）是否能在固定预算下带来损失收益，从而探索 tiny LM 中 FFN 结构的更优设计。
Method: 提出 TriPLU，用三线性乘积（trilinear product）的 degree-3 分支替代常见门控 FFN 分支，将三个投影流逐元素相乘；研究还包含 degree-4 和 degree-2 乘积控制变体，并在不同学习率与归一化设置下进行诊断。
Result: 在字符级 TinyStories 前缀研究中，TriPLU 均值最佳验证损失 1.0637，低于 SwiGLU 的 1.1017、degree-4 控制的 1.0780 和 degree-2 控制的 1.1026；Byte-BPE 实验中低学习率下验证与留出 BPB 也下降，PMI 切片显示对 seen 的中高 PMI 相邻 token 对有效。高学习率诊断表明乘积分支归一化可缩小最佳检查点差距，但最终 BPB 在热调度下仍退化。
Conclusion: 作者刻意将主张收窄：直接乘积 FFN 能在特定低计算预算下改善小模型损失，但该分支对优化敏感，不证明 FLOP 归一化效率、扩展行为或广泛 LLM 性能。

papers.title: Clarify-Then-Search: A Clarification Benchmark for Deep Search with End-to-End Nugget Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Deep search is brittle on underspecified user queries: missing constraints such as time, location, scope, or definitions can lead to retrieval drift and incomplete answers. We introduce Clarify-Then-Search, a benchmark for evaluating whether LLM-generated clarification questions improve downstream deep-search utility. Built on real-world query data from the Baidu search engine, the benchmark contains 518 curated instances, each with an intent query and a corresponding underspecified query. For each intent query, we run WebDancer once to archive evidence and construct a static golden reference as weighted, evidence-grounded nuggets with traceable source identifiers. At evaluation time, a Clarifier asks k in {1, 2, 3} questions; a closed-book User Answerer replies only with information explicitly stated in the intent query, otherwise returning unknown; and a closed-book Rewriter produces a rewritten query using only the underspecified query and the elicited question-answer pairs. WebDancer then executes on the rewritten query, and we score end-to-end utility using restore_score_100, a weighted nugget-recall score with partial credit against the static gold. Across all evaluated models, clarification improves over the no-interaction baseline at k=1, and larger budgets generally yield further gains. GPT-5.2 achieves the highest mean score at k=1, while ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K becomes the overall top-performing model at k=3. Diagnostics reveal a consistent failure mode: many systems over-ask region-only questions that are often unanswerable from the intent and thus elicit unknown. Clarify-Then-Search enables leakage-resistant and reproducible evaluation of clarify-then-search pipelines, with fine-grained analyses of question utility, answerability, and budget effects in deep search.
papers.comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 Datasets and Benchmarks Track. 12 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Clarify-Then-Search，一个用于评估 LLM 生成的澄清问题能否提升下游深度搜索（deep search）效用的基准。基准基于百度搜索引擎的真实查询构建了 518 个实例，每个实例包含意图查询和对应的未充分指定查询，并用 WebDancer 归档证据、构建带可追踪来源标识的加权 nugget 黄金参考。评测流程包含 Clarifier 提问、闭书 User Answerer 回答、闭书 Rewriter 重写查询，再由 WebDancer 执行并计算 restore_score_100。结果显示在 k=1 时澄清优于无交互基线，更大预算通常带来更多收益；诊断发现许多系统过度询问仅区域性问题，导致回答为 unknown。
Motivation: 深度搜索对未充分指定的用户查询很脆弱，缺少时间、地点、范围或定义等约束会造成检索漂移和不完整答案。现有评估缺乏可复现、防泄漏的方式来衡量澄清问题对下游搜索效用的影响，因此需要专门基准。
Method: 构建端到端评估流水线：为每个意图查询运行一次 WebDancer 归档证据并构造静态黄金参考（加权、证据锚定的 nugget 且带来源标识）。评测时 Clarifier 依次问 k 个（k∈{1,2,3}）问题，闭书 User Answerer 只利用意图查询中明确陈述的信息回答，否则返回 unknown；闭书 Rewriter 仅基于未充分指定查询和问答对重写查询；WebDancer 执行重写后的查询，并用带部分得分的加权 nugget 召回分数 restore_score_100 计算端到端效用。
Result: 在所有被评估模型中，k=1 时澄清均优于无交互基线，且更大的提问预算通常带来进一步收益。GPT-5.2 在 k=1 时获得最高平均分，ERNIE-4.5-Turbo-128K 在 k=3 时成为整体最佳模型。诊断显示一个普遍失败模式：许多系统过度提问仅涉及区域的问题，而这类问题常无法从意图查询中回答，从而得到 unknown。
Conclusion: Clarify-Then-Search 能够支持防泄漏、可复现的澄清-搜索流水线评估，并提供关于问题效用（question utility）、可回答性（answerability）和预算影响的细粒度分析。摘要强调该基准适用于深度搜索中澄清流程的系统化评测。

papers.title: ExpertIVS: Sociological Expert Driven Individual Value Simulation in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated considerable potential for social simulation, yet struggle to accurately model individual value systems. Most existing methods mechanically stitch survey responses into prompts, which suffer from semantic fragmentation, failing to capture the internal coherence of human value systems. The value systems of LLMs are typically assessed using static multiple-choice questions, which fail to evaluate the value orientation in real-world dialogue interactions. To address these issues, we propose ExpertIVS, a framework employing 14 Sociological Expert Agents to interpret World Values Survey (WVS) responses through structured professional perspectives, rather than direct responses concatenation. These expert agents perform deep semantic reconstruction to generate robust and internally consistent individual profiles. To evaluate the consistency between LLMs and individual value systems during dynamic interactions, we further introduce a multi-agent debate mechanism. Extensive experiments across 480 individuals from 12 countries demonstrate that ExpertIVS achieves 90.78% value restoration fidelity and significantly outperforms baselines in value generalization (+5.3%). Moreover, ExpertIVS exhibits strong personality discriminability and behavioral consistency, enabling a shift from mere response concatenation to genuine sociological role-playing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ExpertIVS，一个利用 14 个“社会学专家智能体”(Sociological Expert Agents) 从结构化专业视角解读 World Values Survey (WVS) 问卷、而非直接拼接问卷文本的框架，用于为 LLM 智能体生成稳健且内部一致的个体画像。作者还引入多智能体辩论机制，以在动态对话交互中评估 LLM 与个体价值体系的一致性。在来自 12 个国家的 480 名个体上的实验显示，ExpertIVS 达到 90.78% 的价值还原保真度，价值泛化相比基线提升 5.3%，并表现出较强的个性区分度与行为一致性。

papers.title: NeuroStrata: An Electroencephalographic Connectivity-Aware Deep Representation Learning Framework for Dynamic Brain Network Analysis of Mental Stress
papers.abstract_en: This study introduces NeuroStrata, a connectivity-aware deep representation learning framework for EEG-based mental stress analysis using Time-Varying Partial Directed Coherence (TV-PDC). Unlike conventional EEG classification approaches based on static features, NeuroStrata models the temporal evolution of frequency-specific directed connectivity across distributed brain regions. EEG signals from the 32-channel SAM 40 dataset recorded during mental arithmetic tasks were used to generate TV-PDC connectivity maps. These maps were processed using pretrained Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) to extract deep connectivity embeddings, which were subsequently classified using lightweight machine learning models. Experimental results demonstrate that beta-band connectivity provides the highest discriminative capability, achieving a peak accuracy of 97.3% using the LAION-CLIP-ViT-L14 backbone with a Support Vector Machine classifier, while alpha-band connectivity exhibits consistently stable performance across model configurations. Connectivity analysis revealed prominent frontal-driven alpha influences and centrally integrated beta connectivity patterns associated with stress-related neural dynamics. Temporal evaluation further indicated that classification performance stabilizes in mid-to-late temporal windows, suggesting progressive consolidation of stress-related connectivity signatures. The proposed framework integrates time-varying effective connectivity modelling with deep representation learning to provide an interpretable and automated approach for EEG-based mental stress analysis.
papers.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, Manuscript currently under review at Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuroStrata，一个基于时变偏定向相干 (Time-Varying Partial Directed Coherence, TV-PDC) 的连通性感知深度表示学习框架，用于 EEG 精神应激分析。研究使用 SAM 40 数据集的 32 通道脑电信号生成 TV-PDC 连通性图，再用预训练 CNN 和 ViT 提取深度连通性嵌入，并用轻量级机器学习模型分类。结果显示 β 频段连通性判别力最强，LAION-CLIP-ViT-L14 骨干结合 SVM 达到 97.3% 的峰值准确率，α 频段性能稳定。作者认为该框架将时变有效连通性建模与深度表示学习结合，为 EEG 应激分析提供了可解释的自动化途径。
Motivation: 传统 EEG 分类方法基于静态特征，忽略了频段特异性定向连通性随时间的动态演化。作者希望建模精神应激下分布式脑区之间时变的频率特定连通性，从而更准确地刻画应激相关神经动力学。
Method: 从 32 通道 SAM 40 数据集中心算任务记录的 EEG 信号生成 TV-PDC 连通性图；使用预训练卷积神经网络 (CNN) 和视觉 Transformer (ViT) 提取深度连通性嵌入，再以轻量级机器学习模型（如支持向量机）进行分类，并辅以连通性模式分析与时间窗口评估。
Result: 摘要报告 β 频段连通性具有最高判别能力，LAION-CLIP-ViT-L14 骨干配合 SVM 分类器达到 97.3% 的峰值准确率，α 频段连通性在不同模型配置下表现稳定。连通性分析显示与应激相关的额叶主导 α 影响和中央整合的 β 模式；时间评估表明分类性能在中期至后期时间窗口趋于稳定。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将时变有效连通性建模与深度表示学习整合可得到可解释且自动化的 EEG 精神应激分析框架，并指出 β 频段连通性和 ViT 特征提取的优势，以及应激相关连通性签名的时间巩固现象。

papers.title: The Divergence Hypothesis: Unmasking Lexical Interference and Label Bias in Mental Health NLP
papers.abstract_en: Computational mental health (CMH) classifiers often degrade under distribution shift because human annotators and distant-supervision pipelines reward different linguistic signals. We introduce TSS (Triple-Stream Stress probe), a multi-channel diagnostic framework that decomposes text into (A) lexical character n-grams, (B) a small, mostly content-free morpho-syntactic channel, and (C) a 154-feature psycholinguistic style channel. Across four English datasets (N=12,906), TSS reveals a lexical interference effect: adding lexical features to the style channel reduces Macro-F1 on human-labeled data (mean drop 0.072, p<10^-4) but not on auto-labeled data. We propose Degree of Divergence (DoD), a difference-in-differences statistic adapted from econometrics for label-source auditing, with instance-level bootstrap inference; the headline estimate is DoD(BC-A) = 0.0374, 95% CI [0.0097, 0.0651], p=0.0032. A platform-stratified Twitter-only DoD (which removes the Reddit vs. Twitter contrast) reproduces the pattern with bootstrap inference: DoD-Tw(BC-A) = +0.096 (p<0.001) and DoD-Tw(AC-A) = -0.089 (p<0.001). Interventional masking (pos_only) retains ~95-99% of Channel C's performance after destroying content words on human datasets, indicating that the style channel does not rely primarily on lexical surface form. TSS is positioned as a diagnostic audit framework, not a clinical screening tool: it flags label-source-specific shortcut learning before generalization claims are made.
papers.comment: 14 pages including appendices. Code, decontamination scripts, and qualitative workbook are publicly available
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对计算心理健康 (computational mental health, CMH) 分类器在分布偏移下性能退化的问题，提出 TSS (Triple-Stream Stress probe) 多通道诊断框架，将文本分解为词法字符 n-gram、形态句法通道和 154 维心理语言学风格通道。在四个英文数据集 (N=12,906) 上，TSS 发现词法干扰效应：在人类标注数据上，向风格通道加入词法特征会使 Macro-F1 平均下降 0.072 (p<10^-4)，但在自动标注数据上不显著。作者进一步提出 Degree of Divergence (DoD) 差异中差异统计量用于标注来源审计，并通过跨平台与平台内分析验证了该模式。
Motivation: CMH 分类器常因人类标注者与远距离监督 (distant supervision) 管线奖励不同的语言信号而在分布偏移下退化，因此需要一种诊断工具来揭示词法干扰与标签来源偏差。
Method: TSS 将文本分解为 (A) 词法字符 n-gram、(B) 简洁的形态句法通道和 (C) 154 特征的文体风格通道；提出 DoD 这一基于计量经济学中差异中差异思想的统计量，并配以实例级 bootstrap 推断；还使用破坏内容词的干预性掩蔽 (pos_only) 来检验各通道的依赖。
Result: 头部估计 DoD(BC-A)=0.0374，95% CI [0.0097, 0.0651]，p=0.0032；平台分层后的 Twitter-only DoD 复现该模式：DoD-Tw(BC-A)=+0.096 (p<0.001)，DoD-Tw(AC-A)=-0.089 (p<0.001)。干预性掩蔽在人类数据集上保留约 95-99% 的 Channel C 性能，表明风格通道不主要依赖词法表面形式。
Conclusion: TSS 被定位为诊断审计框架而非临床筛查工具，目的是在提出泛化性主张之前识别标签来源特定的捷径学习 (shortcut learning)。

papers.title: Exploratory As-Analyzed No-Detection of Culturally-Marked Predicate-Triggered PII Amplification in a Synthetic-English RAG Probe: A Predicate-Resource-Confounded Audit
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether stereotype-loaded queries about culturally marked people leak more personal information from a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system than otherwise-equivalent neutral queries. We pre-register a four-culture audit (en-Anglo, es-LATAM, Arabic, Hindi) on a synthetic English PII corpus, comparing five query arms we call the Stereotype-Trigger Leakage Delta (STLD). Two caveats up front. Our locked confirmatory estimator was never run, so every test in the paper is exploratory or sensitivity, with all plan deviations listed in the appendix. And the name-leakage metric is contaminated by a prompt-echo artifact: the model often just re-emits the name we asked about, which inflates apparent leakage without any retrieval at all. On the cleaner channels (email, phone, ssn-like, address), we find no stereotype-driven amplification on any of the four cultures after multiple-comparison correction. Because our sample is only powered for mid-sized effects, and because the culturally marked probes mix stereotype content with cultural markers and heritage practices, we present this as no detection, not evidence of no effect, of culturally marked predicate leakage that is confounded with the underlying resource.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过预注册的 RAG 审计，考察带刻板印象的文化相关查询是否比中性查询泄露更多个人身份信息。作者在合成英文 PII 语料上对四种文化（en-Anglo、es-LATAM、Arabic、Hindi）比较五种查询臂（称为 Stereotype-Trigger Leakage Delta, STLD）。由于锁定验证估计器从未运行，论文所有检验均为探索性或敏感性分析；且姓名泄露指标被提示回声（prompt-echo）污染，即模型常直接重复被查询的名字。在更干净的渠道（email、phone、ssn-like、address）上，多重比较校正后未发现任何文化群体的刻板印象驱动放大，因此论文将其表述为“未检出”（no detection）而非“无效应”。
Motivation: 研究问题是有刻板印象加载的文化相关查询是否会让 RAG 系统比等价中性查询泄露更多个人信息，这关系到文化标记提示可能带来的隐私风险。
Method: 预注册了一个四文化审计，在合成英文 PII 语料上比较五种查询臂（STLD），并因确认性估计器未运行而将所有检验转为探索性或敏感性分析；同时区分了姓名泄露中的提示回声伪影与更干净的渠道指标。
Result: 在 email、phone、ssn-like、address 等较干净渠道上，经过多重比较校正后，四种文化均未发现刻板印象驱动的泄露放大；姓名渠道的明显泄露主要来自模型重新输出查询中出现的名字。
Conclusion: 作者明确将结果表述为无效应证据的缺失（no detection）而非无效应本身，强调样本量仅能检出中等效应，且文化标记探针将刻板印象内容与文化标记和传统实践混杂在一起，使泄露与底层资源相混淆。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How to Train a Real-World Silicon Concierge? Internalizing Complex Business Workflow to Only OneModel
papers.abstract_en: Traditional industrial agents rely on modular pipelines, including Router, Retriever, Planner, Executor, Responder, Reviewer, and other components. These systems often fracture into a labyrinth of ad-hoc patches, leading to cascading errors and high latency. We propose OneModel, an applicable paradigm shift from external workflows to internalized knowledge representation. Unlike modular systems that slice fluid user intents into static steps, OneModel consolidates complex business logic and SOPs directly into the model parameters. Through Continual Pre-training (CPT) and logic-compilation SFT, we transform fragmented business rules into intuitive model reasoning within a unified attention space. Deployed in our global financial service system, OneModel effectively breaks the trade-off between latency, accuracy, and complexity. Online A/B testing demonstrates an end-to-end latency reduction of more than 50 percent, from 18.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds, while the Intelligent Resolution Rate (IRR) increases from 64.3 percent to 83.3 percent. papers.title: Beyond Prompt Engineering: A Systematic Analysis of Prompt Lexical Sensitivity and Its Impacts on Quality
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit extreme sensitivity to surface-level prompt variations, in which minor lexical changes can trigger disproportionate performance fluctuations. Moving beyond black-box optimization and coarse-grained templates, we present the first large-scale, n-gram token-level mechanistic analysis of prompt stability, leveraging a dataset of 132,000 prompt variants. Our investigation reveals a fundamental Scaling Law of Prompt Performance Stability: higher average task performance is strongly associated with lower variance and greater robustness across prompt perturbation. We identify two core linguistic drivers underlying this robustness: (1) Domain-Specific Terminology, which tightly anchors semantic boundaries, and (2) Explicit Action Directives, which formalize reasoning trajectories. Together, these elements constrain the model's interpretative space, effectively ``locking in'' more deterministic generation behavior. Building on these insights, we introduce an automated Prompt-Refining Agent that systematically restructures input queries by injecting domain anchoring and operational constraints. Empirical evaluation shows that our approach reduces performance variance by 40.7% in code generation task, while preserving or improving mean performance. These findings provide a statistically grounded and mechanistically interpretable framework for achieving robust prompt engineering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 提示词稳定性做了首次大规模 n-gram 词元级机制分析，基于 132,000 个提示词变体数据集，发现提示性能稳定性的缩放定律：平均任务性能越高，往往对应跨扰动的更低方差和更强鲁棒性。作者识别出两类核心语言驱动因素——领域特定术语和显式行动指令——并提出自动化的 Prompt-Refining Agent 来重构输入查询。摘要报告该方法在代码生成任务上将性能方差降低 40.7%，同时保持或提升平均性能。
Motivation: LLM 对表层提示词变化极其敏感，微小的词汇改动可能引发不成比例的性能波动；现有工作多依赖黑箱优化或粗粒度模板，缺乏对提示稳定性的系统性、机制性理解。
Method: 基于 132,000 个提示词变体数据集，进行 n-gram 词元级的提示稳定性机制分析，归纳出 Prompt Performance Stability 缩放定律；识别领域特定术语（Domain-Specific Terminology）与显式行动指令（Explicit Action Directives）两类语言驱动因素，并据此提出自动 Prompt-Refining Agent，通过注入领域锚定和操作约束来重构输入查询。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在代码生成任务上将性能方差降低 40.7%，同时保持或改进平均性能，并建立了性能高低与稳健性之间的统计关联规律。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作为稳健提示工程提供了统计上有依据、机制上可解释的框架；摘要未明确讨论局限或适用范围。

papers.title: Inhibitory Attention for Clinical Long-Context Reasoning: Characterizing and Mitigating Lost-in-the-Middle Effects in EHR Processing
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records now routinely exceed 100,000 tokens per patient. Yet large language models exhibit the lost-in-the-middle (LitM) effect: information near the center of a long context is retrieved less reliably than information near the edges. In clinical use this is not benign: the single most consequential fact in a note can sit at its center. We term this the clinical lost-in-the-middle (CLitM) problem, give its first systematic characterization using MedAlign, and compare context-selection strategies as remedies. Across 2,196 instruction-response pairs and six language models, we observe a 21.9 percentage-point gap between peak accuracy (59.5%, 95% CI [46.3, 71.0], 20-30% decile) and trough accuracy (37.6% [23.2, 52.5] at 70-80%); 67.8% of reference answers fall between the 10th and 90th percentiles of the EHR timeline, inside the CLitM trough. We introduce Query-Conditioned Clinical Suppression (QCCS), a lightweight query-conditioned selection gate, and evaluate it against BM25, BM25 with section-header filtering, dense retrieval, and cross-encoder reranking (N=83 held-out instructions). With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (16k context), QCCS outperforms all five comparators under LLM-as-judge scoring: for middle-position instructions QCCS reaches 16.7% versus BM25 3.3%, cross-encoder 0.0%, dense 0.0%, and full context 6.7%; overall QCCS reaches 25.3% versus at most 3.6% for retrieval-only comparators. This advantage is not explained by retrieval recall: at k=20, BM25 retrieves the gold evidence sentence in 98.8% of instructions (QCCS 34.9%), yet retrieval arms stay at most 2.6% accurate even when they retrieve it, whereas QCCS reaches 25.0% even when it does not. In this proof-of-concept evaluation, query-aligned context selection predicts EHR instruction-following accuracy better than gold-sentence retrieval recall.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录（EHR）长上下文推理中的 lost-in-the-middle（LitM）效应，提出临床版 CLitM 问题，并基于 MedAlign 进行首次系统刻画。作者在 2,196 个指令-响应对和六个语言模型上观察到峰值与谷值准确率间 21.9 个百分点的差距，并提出轻量级查询条件选择门控 QCCS（Query-Conditioned Clinical Suppression）。在 83 条保留指令上以 LLM-as-judge 评估时，QCCS 在中间位置指令和总体准确率上均显著优于 BM25、稠密检索、cross-encoder 重排序等基线。
Motivation: EHR 每名患者常超过 100,000 token，而大语言模型存在 LitM 效应，长上下文中心位置的信息检索可靠性低于两端；在临床场景中，笔记中心可能恰恰包含最重要的单一事实，因此需要系统刻画并缓解这一问题。
Method: 首次使用 MedAlign 对临床 lost-in-the-middle（CLitM）问题进行系统表征，并比较多种上下文选择策略；提出 QCCS，一种轻量级的查询条件选择门控，根据查询条件抑制或选择临床上下文片段。
Result: 在 2,196 个指令-响应对和六个语言模型上，峰值准确率（59.5%，20-30% 分位）与谷值准确率（37.6%，70-80% 分位）相差 21.9 个百分点，67.8% 的参考答案位于 CLitM 低谷内。在 83 条保留指令上，QCCS 对中间位置指令达到 16.7%，而 BM25、cross-encoder、dense 和 full context 分别为 3.3%、0.0%、0.0% 和 6.7%；总体 QCCS 达 25.3%，检索式对比方法最高仅 3.6%。尽管 BM25 在 k=20 时对金证据句的召回率为 98.8%（QCCS 为 34.9%），检索式方法即使检索到证据准确率也至多 2.6%，而 QCCS 在未检索到证据时仍达 25.0%。
Conclusion: 该概念验证表明，查询对齐的上下文选择比金句检索召回更能预测 EHR 指令遵循准确率；作者强调这是 proof-of-concept 评估，并未宣称该方法已在完整临床流水线中超越所有检索手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Who Do Language Models Think Is Competent? A Mechanistic Analysis of Occupational Bias
papers.abstract_en: Language models (LMs) often pass behavioral bias evaluations, but it remains unclear whether they no longer represent the underlying associations that give rise to biases, or have merely learned not to express them. In this study, we show that representational biases are often detectable, even when behavioral biases are not visible. We introduce a causal framework that decomposes occupational bias into two measurement points: a model's internal representation of a user's competence, and its observable outputs. We derive steering vectors for representations of user expertise, and verify that they causally mediate model behavior in both a question-answering task and a hiring task. Applying this framework to several open-weight models, we find that demographic attributes, such as gender, race, and socioeconomic status, influence a model's representation of user expertise, even in cases where behavioral metrics detect no disparity between demographics. We show that these model representations can influence downstream behavior under intervention, suggesting failure modes that behavioral metrics alone may not detect.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型在行为层面通过偏见评估时，其内部表征是否仍保留导致偏见的关联。作者提出一个因果框架，将职业偏见分解为模型对用户能力的内部表征和可观测输出两个测量点，并借助干预实验证明表征层面的偏见在行为指标无差异时仍可被检测到。
Motivation: 现有行为偏见评估无法区分模型是真正消除了潜在关联，还是只是学会了不表达偏见；这掩盖了可能在下游行为中浮现的失败模式。
Method: 引入因果框架，从模型对用户专业能力 (expertise) 的内部表征中推导 steering vectors，验证其对问答任务和招聘任务行为的因果中介作用，并在多个开放权重模型上检验人口统计属性对表征的影响。
Result: 在多个开放权重模型上，性别、种族和社会经济地位等属性会影响模型对用户专业能力的内部表征，即使行为指标检测不到人口统计差异；干预这些表征可以影响下游行为。
Conclusion: 表征层面的偏见可能比行为层面更普遍，仅依赖行为指标可能遗漏潜在失败模式，需要结合因果干预的表征分析来评估模型偏见。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Vocabulary Comprehension Fails Clinical Reasoning: Evaluating Therapy Bots' Safety Risks for Generation Alpha
papers.abstract_en: Conversational AI systems have become informal mental health support resources for Generation Alpha (Gen Alpha, born 2010-2024), with 13.1% of U.S. adolescents (5.4 million) using generative AI for mental health advice. While these systems, from therapy apps to general chatbots, rely on large language models trained on extensive psychological literature, their safety for youth communication patterns characterized by hyperbolic language, ironic positivity, rapid semantic drift, and contextual polysemy remains unvalidated. Following multiple adolescent deaths linked to AI chatbot interactions, systematic evaluation is critical. We present two benchmarks: (1) 64 Gen Alpha mental health expressions validated by native speakers (ICC=0.72) and clinicians (kappa=0.78); (2) 75 multi-turn conversations (780 turns) with paired Standard/Gen Alpha versions. Across evaluations of LLM architectures underlying therapy apps and general chatbots - Claude, GPT-4o, Llama-3.1 - models understand 76-82% of vocabulary but correctly calibrate only 64-72% of clinical risk, creating a 10-14 percentage point (pp) vocabulary-comprehension gap (p<.001, d>0.48) absent in human therapists (3pp, p=.22). The gap is architecturally consistent and widens with ambiguity (7pp -> 18pp). We identify six failure patterns: sarcasm masking (29pp), minimization acceptance (43pp), informal style bias (24pp), risk-stratified ambiguity (19pp), semantic drift (19pp), context-dependent violence (7pp). Patterns compound; three or more yield 94% miss rates. Lightweight mitigations fail; only heavy scaffolding achieves human performance (6.4x cost). With 34% baseline miss rate yielding 146,880 estimated annual missed crises, we recommend mandatory human-in-the-loop architectures, quarterly youth-specific validation, transparent performance disclosure, and regulatory frameworks for youth-facing mental health AI.
papers.comment: 42 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ACM FAccT '26
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Generation Alpha（2010-2024 年出生）青少年使用生成式 AI 获取心理健康建议的安全风险展开系统评估。作者构建了 64 条经母语者（ICC=0.72）和临床医生（kappa=0.78）验证的 Gen Alpha 心理表达，以及 75 段多轮对话（780 轮，含 Standard/Gen Alpha 配对版本），并评估 Claude、GPT-4o、Llama-3.1 等底层 LLM。结果显示模型能理解 76-82% 的词汇，但仅能正确校准 64-72% 的临床风险，形成 10-14 个百分点的词汇-理解差距，而人类治疗师仅 3 个百分点。作者还识别出六类失败模式，并据此提出人在回路、季度验证和监管框架等建议。
Motivation: 美国 13.1% 的青少年（540 万）使用生成式 AI 获取心理健康建议，但面向青少年的夸张语言、反讽式积极、快速语义漂移和语境多义词等现象，使模型安全性未经验证；加之已有多起青少年因 AI 聊天交互死亡的案例，亟需系统性评估。
Method: 提出两个基准：一是 64 条由母语者和临床医生验证的 Gen Alpha 心理健康表达；二是 75 段多轮对话（780 轮），每段含配对的 Standard 与 Gen Alpha 版本。研究对支撑疗法应用和通用聊天机器人的 LLM 架构（Claude、GPT-4o、Llama-3.1）进行词汇理解与临床风险校准的对比评估。
Result: 模型词汇理解率为 76-82%，临床风险正确校准率仅 64-72%，词汇-理解差距为 10-14 个百分点（p<.001, d>0.48），而人类治疗师差距仅 3 个百分点（p=.22）。该差距在架构上一致，并随模糊性从 7 个百分点扩大到 18 个百分点。六类失败模式包括：讽刺遮蔽（29pp）、最小化接受（43pp）、非正式风格偏差（24pp）、风险分层模糊（19pp）、语义漂移（19pp）、依赖语境的暴力（7pp）；三种及以上模式叠加时漏检率达 94%。轻量缓解措施无效，只有重脚手架（heavy scaffolding）能达到人类水平（6.4 倍成本）。34% 的基础漏检率估计对应每年漏掉 146,880 起危机。
Conclusion: 作者强调，面向青少年的心理健康 AI 需要强制采用人类在回路（human-in-the-loop）架构、季度性青少年特定验证、透明的性能披露，并建立针对青少年心理健康 AI 的监管框架。

papers.title: Bankruptcy Prediction via Hybrid Resampling and Stacking Ensemble Techniques with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI)-Driven Analysis
papers.abstract_en: This study develops and evaluates a bankruptcy prediction framework that integrates consensus-based feature selection, hybrid resampling, stacking ensembles, and explainable artificial intelligence to improve minority-class detection in severely imbalanced financial data. Using the Taiwanese Bankruptcy Prediction dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository, five feature-selection algorithms were first applied, and a consensus retention rule reduced the input space to 23 robust variables. The balanced training data were then generated using SVM-SMOTE, SMOTE-Tomek, and SMOTE-ENN. Five ensemble machine learning classifiers, namely gradient boosting, extreme gradient boosting, histogram-based gradient boosting, LightGBM, and AdaBoost, were compared with five deep learning models, including RNN, LSTM, GRU, DNN, and MLP. In addition, hybrid stacking ensembles combined the five machine learning classifiers as base learners with each deep learning model as a meta-learner. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, recall, specificity, G-mean, and ROC-AUC, while SHAP was used to explain feature contributions. The results show that resampling strategy materially shaped model behavior. SVM-SMOTE and SMOTE-Tomek favored accuracy and specificity, whereas SMOTE-ENN delivered stronger minority-class detection. Among standalone models, the GRU with SMOTE-ENN achieved the best overall predictive balance, with recall of 0.8627, G-mean of 0.8517, and ROC-AUC of 0.9431. Among stacking ensembles, SMOTE-ENN with (GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM provided the strongest compromise between sensitivity and specificity. SHAP analysis identified leverage, profitability, solvency, and operational efficiency indicators as the most influential predictors of bankruptcy risk. These findings support more reliable and interpretable early warning systems for financially distressed firms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个破产预测框架，将共识式特征选择、混合重采样、堆叠集成（stacking ensemble）与可解释人工智能（XAI）结合，用于改善严重不平衡金融数据中的少数类（破产企业）检测。研究基于 UCI 的台湾破产预测数据集，先由五种特征选择算法按共识保留规则将输入降至 23 个变量，再用 SVM-SMOTE、SMOTE-Tomek 和 SMOTE-ENN 生成平衡训练数据，并比较五种集成学习模型与五种深度学习模型。结果显示 SMOTE-ENN 配合 GRU 的独立模型表现最佳，SMOTE-ENN 配合 (GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM 的堆叠集成则在敏感性与特异性之间取得最好折中。
Motivation: 破产预测面临少数类样本严重不平衡的问题，模型容易偏向多数类而漏检财务困境企业，同时传统预测模型缺乏可解释性，难以用于实际风控预警。
Method: 提出一个端到端框架：先用五种特征选择算法并依据共识保留规则筛选出 23 个稳健特征，再用 SVM-SMOTE、SMOTE-Tomek、SMOTE-ENN 三种混合重采样技术平衡训练数据；随后比较五种机器学习集成模型（梯度提升、XGBoost、直方图梯度提升、LightGBM、AdaBoost）与五种深度学习模型（RNN、LSTM、GRU、DNN、MLP），并构造以五种集成模型为基学习器、深度学习模型为元学习器的混合堆叠集成；最后用 SHAP 解释特征贡献。
Result: 摘要报告重采样策略显著影响模型行为：SVM-SMOTE 和 SMOTE-Tomek 偏向准确率与特异性，而 SMOTE-ENN 带来更强的少数类检测能力。独立模型中 GRU+SMOTE-ENN 达到最佳整体平衡，召回率 0.8627、G-mean 0.8517、ROC-AUC 0.9431；堆叠集成中 SMOTE-ENN+(GB+XGB+HGB+LGBM+AB)+LSTM 在敏感性与特异性之间折中最好。SHAP 分析表明杠杆、盈利、偿债能力和运营效率指标是破产风险的最重要预测因子。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架支持更可靠且可解释的财务困境早期预警系统；摘要未报告明显的局限性或适用范围限制。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PrimeAgentOrchestrator: Memory-Primed Agent Spawning for Personal AI Infrastructure
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) coding agents start each session with an empty context window, discarding accumulated knowledge from prior work. We present PrimeAgentOrchestrator (PAO), a system that spawns new instances of Claude Code -- Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent -- pre-loaded with relevant memories compiled from the user's existing personal databases. At spawn time, PAO queries two independently-operated memory backends in parallel (a PostgreSQL entity-observation database and a Cloudflare Worker semantic search index), fuses results using backend-specific retrieval strategies, and delivers the compiled briefing via filesystem injection that exploits the host agent's configuration auto-read behavior. PAO manages the full agent lifecycle including trust pre-seeding, readiness polling with error detection, and adaptive terminal text injection. We report on four months of regular deployment (December 2025 through March 2026) as an experience report, documenting three generations of context delivery mechanisms, the failure modes that motivated each redesign, and the engineering tradeoffs of bridging heterogeneous memory systems rather than building a unified one.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PrimeAgentOrchestrator (PAO)，一个为个人 AI 基础设施设计的系统，在启动 Claude Code 编码智能体时预先注入从用户个人数据库编译的相关记忆。PAO 并行查询 PostgreSQL 实体-观测数据库与 Cloudflare Worker 语义搜索索引，按后端特定策略融合结果，并通过文件系统注入利用宿主 agent 的配置自动读取行为来加载简报。作者以经验报告形式记录 2025 年 12 月至 2026 年 3 月四个月部署中的三代上下文传递机制、失败模式与工程权衡。
Motivation: LLM 编码 agent 每次会话从空上下文窗口开始，丢弃先前工作积累的知识，造成跨会话记忆缺失。作者希望在不重建统一记忆库的前提下，桥接用户已有的异构记忆系统，为新生成的 agent 实例提供相关记忆。
Method: PAO 在 spawn 时并行查询两个独立运行的记忆后端（PostgreSQL 实体-观测数据库和 Cloudflare Worker 语义搜索索引），使用后端特定的检索策略融合结果，并通过文件系统注入记忆简报以利用宿主 agent 的配置自动读取行为。系统还管理 agent 全生命周期，包括信任预置 (trust pre-seeding)、带错误检测的就绪轮询，以及自适应终端文本注入。
Result: 摘要以经验报告形式报告了四个月常规部署的结果，记录了三代上下文传递机制、促使每次重设计的失败模式，以及桥接异构记忆系统而非构建统一系统所涉及的工程权衡。
Conclusion: 作者强调异构记忆系统桥接的工程权衡，并认为这种经验报告可以为个人 AI 基础设施中长期运行的 LLM agent 记忆管理提供实践参考。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SDAD: Spec-Driven Agentic Development for the AI-Native SDLC
papers.abstract_en: Frontier coding agents backed by large language models with context windows from hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens are restructuring the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Rich context handling and multi-step reasoning now allow substantial Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs) and repository context to be ingested in a single workflow, making specification quality the execution fuel for autonomous delivery. This report formalises Spec-Driven Agentic Development (SDAD) as a synthesis of disciplined up-front formalisation and high-velocity implementation: intent capture, machine-readable specification, agentic synthesis, and independent multi-agent verification under human sign-off. We revisit the historical pendulum between Waterfall and Agile, introduce AI-code as a fourth production paradigm, and compare Human-Agile (circa 2020) with Agentic-SDAD (circa 2026) across artefacts, cadence, accountability, and security posture. Beyond process description, we extend the model to team role metamorphosis (engineer, QA, platform, and product functions), quantitative governance (Ambiguity Tax, Spec Fidelity, SER, and TCI_agentic with repair multiplier phi), and pragmatic adoption via hybrid estimation and a staged migration blueprint. Industrial and research evidence on AI-augmented testing and verification is integrated to motivate separation between synthesis and release authority. Overall, the paper argues that agentic speed does not eliminate engineering discipline; it relocates discipline upstream into specification precision, explicit gates, and auditable provenance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出规范驱动的智能体开发（Spec-Driven Agentic Development, SDAD）框架，用于 AI 原生的软件开发生命周期（SDLC）。该框架综合了前置的规范化形式化与高速实现：意图捕获、机器可读规范、智能体合成以及人工签署下的独立多智能体验证。文章还讨论了 Waterfall 与 Agile 的历史摇摆、将 AI 代码视为第四生产范式、团队角色转变、量化治理指标（如 Ambiguity Tax、Spec Fidelity、SER、TCI_agentic）以及分阶段迁移蓝图。
Motivation: 前沿编码智能体具备超大上下文窗口和多步推理能力，可以单流程消化大量功能需求文档（FRD）和仓库上下文，使得规范质量成为自主交付的执行燃料；现有 SDLC 流程尚未系统性地将这种规范驱动的智能体范式形式化。
Method: 提出 SDAD 作为规范驱动智能体开发的形式化方法，包含意图捕获、机器可读规范、智能体合成和独立多智能体验证四个环节，并扩展出团队角色演变、量化治理（使用修复乘数 phi）以及混合估算和分阶段迁移蓝图等配套机制。
Result: 文章整合工业界和研究界关于 AI 增强测试与验证的证据，主张分离合成与发布权限；但摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果，更多是过程框架与论证。
Conclusion: 论文核心论点是智能体的速度并不消除工程纪律，而是将纪律前移到规范精度、显式门控和可审计溯源（auditable provenance）上。
Relevance: 0
